WITH combined_returns AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
        cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss,
        cr.cr_return_amount AS return_amount,
        cr.cr_return_quantity AS return_qty,
        'catalog' AS source
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
        sr.sr_net_loss AS net_loss,
        sr.sr_return_amt AS return_amount,
        sr.sr_return_quantity AS return_qty,
        'store' AS source
    FROM store_returns sr
),
 daily_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date AS calendar_date,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_current_month,
        SUM(cr.net_loss) AS daily_net_loss,
        SUM(cr.return_amount) AS daily_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.return_qty) AS daily_return_qty,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cr.source = 'catalog') AS catalog_return_cnt,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cr.source = 'store') AS store_return_cnt
    FROM combined_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d ON cr.date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_date, d.d_year, d.d_current_month
)
SELECT
    da.calendar_date,
    da.d_year,
    da.d_current_month,
    da.daily_net_loss,
    da.daily_return_amount,
    da.daily_return_qty,
    da.catalog_return_cnt,
    da.store_return_cnt,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY da.daily_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank,
    SUM(da.daily_net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY da.calendar_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_net_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN da.daily_net_loss > 2000 THEN 'Critical'
        WHEN da.daily_net_loss > 500 THEN 'Warning'
        ELSE 'Normal'
    END AS alert_level
FROM daily_agg da
ORDER BY da.calendar_date DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH store_monthly AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_store_sk,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_current_month,
        d.d_month_seq,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
        SUM(sr.sr_store_credit) AS total_store_credit,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 5000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 1000 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS loss_category,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) DESC) AS loss_rank_year
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk, d.d_year, d.d_current_month, d.d_month_seq
)
SELECT
    sm.sr_store_sk,
    sm.d_year,
    sm.d_current_month,
    sm.total_net_loss,
    sm.total_return_amt,
    sm.loss_category,
    sm.loss_rank_year,
    SUM(sm.total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY sm.sr_store_sk ORDER BY sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_loss
FROM store_monthly sm
ORDER BY sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq, sm.sr_store_sk

WITH reason_state AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_reason_sk AS reason_sk,
        ca.ca_state AS state,
        cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss,
        cr.cr_return_quantity AS qty,
        'catalog' AS source
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        sr.sr_reason_sk AS reason_sk,
        ca.ca_state AS state,
        sr.sr_net_loss AS net_loss,
        sr.sr_return_quantity AS qty,
        'store' AS source
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
),
 state_reason_rank AS (
    SELECT
        rs.state,
        rs.reason_sk,
        SUM(rs.net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        SUM(rs.qty) AS total_qty,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rs.state ORDER BY SUM(rs.net_loss) DESC) AS rn
    FROM reason_state rs
    GROUP BY rs.state, rs.reason_sk
)
SELECT
    srr.state,
    srr.reason_sk,
    srr.total_net_loss,
    srr.total_qty,
    srr.return_cnt,
    CASE
        WHEN srr.total_net_loss > 10000 THEN 'Severe'
        WHEN srr.total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'Moderate'
        ELSE 'Mild'
    END AS severity_level
FROM state_reason_rank srr
WHERE srr.rn <= 3
ORDER BY srr.state, srr.rn

WITH combined_customer AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        d.d_date AS return_date,
        cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss,
        ca.ca_state AS state,
        'catalog' AS source
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        sr.sr_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        d.d_date AS return_date,
        sr.sr_net_loss AS net_loss,
        ca.ca_state AS state,
        'store' AS source
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT
        customer_sk,
        SUM(net_loss) AS total_net_loss
    FROM combined_customer
    GROUP BY customer_sk
),
customer_rank AS (
    SELECT
        ct.customer_sk,
        ct.total_net_loss,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ct.total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank,
        CASE
            WHEN ct.total_net_loss > 20000 THEN 'Platinum'
            WHEN ct.total_net_loss > 10000 THEN 'Gold'
            WHEN ct.total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'Silver'
            ELSE 'Bronze'
        END AS tier
    FROM customer_totals ct
)
SELECT
    cc.customer_sk,
    cc.state,
    cc.return_date,
    cc.net_loss,
    SUM(cc.net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cc.customer_sk ORDER BY cc.return_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_loss,
    cr.loss_rank,
    cr.tier
FROM combined_customer cc
JOIN customer_rank cr ON cc.customer_sk = cr.customer_sk
WHERE cc.return_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
ORDER BY cr.loss_rank, cc.return_date
LIMIT 200

WITH all_returns AS (
    SELECT
        cr_returned_date_sk AS return_date_sk,
        cr_return_tax AS tax,
        cr_item_sk AS item_sk,
        'Catalog' AS source
    FROM catalog_returns
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        wr_returned_date_sk AS return_date_sk,
        wr_return_tax AS tax,
        wr_item_sk AS item_sk,
        'Web' AS source
    FROM web_returns
),
returns_with_item AS (
    SELECT
        ar.return_date_sk,
        ar.tax,
        ar.source,
        i.i_category,
        CASE
            WHEN ar.tax < 5 THEN 'Low'
            WHEN ar.tax BETWEEN 5 AND 15 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'High'
        END AS tax_bucket
    FROM all_returns ar
    LEFT JOIN item i ON ar.item_sk = i.i_item_sk
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        return_date_sk,
        tax_bucket,
        i_category,
        SUM(tax) AS total_tax,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt
    FROM returns_with_item
    GROUP BY return_date_sk, tax_bucket, i_category
)
SELECT
    return_date_sk,
    tax_bucket,
    i_category,
    total_tax,
    return_cnt,
    SUM(total_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY tax_bucket ORDER BY return_date_sk
                         ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_tax_by_bucket,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tax_bucket ORDER BY total_tax DESC) AS bucket_rank
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY return_date_sk, tax_bucket

WITH catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cr_item_sk AS item_sk,
        SUM(cr_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss,
        SUM(cr_fee) AS catalog_fee,
        COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt
    FROM catalog_returns
    GROUP BY cr_item_sk
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        wr_item_sk AS item_sk,
        SUM(wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
        SUM(wr_fee) AS web_fee,
        COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt
    FROM web_returns
    GROUP BY wr_item_sk
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_brand,
        i.i_category,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_fee, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_fee, 0) AS total_fee,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_cnt, 0) AS total_return_cnt,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 10000 THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 5000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 1000 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS loss_severity
    FROM item i
    LEFT JOIN catalog_agg c ON i.i_item_sk = c.item_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_agg w ON i.i_item_sk = w.item_sk
)
SELECT
    i_item_sk,
    i_product_name,
    i_brand,
    i_category,
    total_net_loss,
    total_fee,
    total_return_cnt,
    loss_severity,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank,
    SUM(total_net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
                              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_loss
FROM combined
WHERE total_return_cnt > 0
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH catalog_cust AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS catalog_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i.i_brand) AS catalog_brands
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk
),
web_cust AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS web_return_amount,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i.i_brand) AS web_brands
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk
),
combined_cust AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(c.customer_sk, w.customer_sk) AS customer_sk,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_amount, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_amount, 0) AS total_return_amount,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_cnt, 0) AS total_return_cnt,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 5000 THEN 'High Loss'
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 1000 THEN 'Medium Loss'
            ELSE 'Low Loss'
        END AS loss_category,
        ARRAY_JOIN(COALESCE(c.catalog_brands, ARRAY[]), ', ') AS catalog_brands_str,
        ARRAY_JOIN(COALESCE(w.web_brands, ARRAY[]), ', ') AS web_brands_str
    FROM catalog_cust c
    FULL OUTER JOIN web_cust w ON c.customer_sk = w.customer_sk
)
SELECT
    customer_sk,
    total_return_amount,
    total_net_loss,
    total_return_cnt,
    loss_category,
    catalog_brands_str,
    web_brands_str,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS amount_rank,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank,
    SUM(total_return_amount) OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC
                                   ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return_amount
FROM combined_cust
WHERE total_return_cnt > 0
ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH max_year AS ( SELECT MAX(d_year) AS max_year FROM date_dim ), monthly_sales AS ( SELECT w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_id, w.w_city, w.w_state, cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name AS call_center_name, d.d_year, d.d_moy, d.d_year * 100 + d.d_moy AS month_num, CONCAT(CAST(d.d_year AS varchar), '-', LPAD(CAST(d.d_moy AS varchar), 2, '0')) AS month, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS net_profit, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk CROSS JOIN max_year my WHERE d.d_year = my.max_year GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_id, w.w_city, w.w_state, cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, d.d_year, d.d_moy ) SELECT w_warehouse_id, w_city, w_state, call_center_name, month, net_paid, net_profit, order_cnt, LAG(net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY w_warehouse_id ORDER BY month_num) AS prev_month_net_profit, CASE WHEN LAG(net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY w_warehouse_id ORDER BY month_num) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN net_profit > LAG(net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY w_warehouse_id ORDER BY month_num) THEN 'Increase' ELSE 'Decrease' END AS profit_trend, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM monthly_sales ORDER BY w_warehouse_id, month

WITH latest_year AS ( SELECT MAX(d_year) AS max_year FROM date_dim ), call_center_sales AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk AS cc_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT w.w_warehouse_id) AS distinct_warehouses, CASE WHEN cc.cc_employees > 200 THEN 'Large' WHEN cc.cc_employees BETWEEN 100 AND 200 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Small' END AS size_category FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk CROSS JOIN latest_year ly WHERE d.d_year = ly.max_year GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_employees ) SELECT cc_sk, cc_name, cc_city, cc_state, size_category, total_net_paid, total_net_profit, total_orders, distinct_warehouses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS sales_rank, CASE WHEN total_net_profit / NULLIF(total_net_paid,0) > 0.20 THEN 'High Margin' ELSE 'Low Margin' END AS profit_category FROM call_center_sales ORDER BY sales_rank LIMIT 10

WITH shipping_metrics AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name AS call_center_name, w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_id, AVG(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost, AVG(date_diff('day', sold_d.d_date, ship_d.d_date)) AS avg_ship_days, COUNT(*) AS shipments FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN date_dim sold_d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = sold_d.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim ship_d ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = ship_d.d_date_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_id ) SELECT call_center_name, w_warehouse_id, avg_ship_cost, avg_ship_days, shipments, CASE WHEN avg_ship_cost < 5 AND avg_ship_days <= 2 THEN 'Highly Efficient' WHEN avg_ship_cost < 10 AND avg_ship_days <= 3 THEN 'Efficient' ELSE 'Inefficient' END AS efficiency_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_ship_days ASC, avg_ship_cost ASC) AS shipping_rank FROM shipping_metrics WHERE shipments > 50 ORDER BY shipping_rank LIMIT 20

WITH latest_quarter AS ( SELECT MAX(d_quarter_name) AS max_quarter FROM date_dim ), call_center_discount AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_tax_percentage, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, AVG(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price, AVG(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost, COUNT(*) AS total_transactions FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk CROSS JOIN latest_quarter lq WHERE d.d_quarter_name = lq.max_quarter GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_tax_percentage ) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, cc_state, cc_tax_percentage, avg_discount, avg_sales_price, avg_ship_cost, total_transactions, CASE WHEN avg_discount > 0.15 * avg_sales_price THEN 'High Discount' ELSE 'Standard Discount' END AS discount_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_discount DESC) AS discount_rank, CASE WHEN cc_tax_percentage > 7.5 THEN 'High Tax' WHEN cc_tax_percentage BETWEEN 5 AND 7.5 THEN 'Medium Tax' ELSE 'Low Tax' END AS tax_category FROM call_center_discount WHERE total_transactions > 100 ORDER BY discount_rank LIMIT 20

WITH latest_quarter AS ( SELECT MAX(d_quarter_name) AS max_quarter FROM date_dim ), call_center_stats AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk CROSS JOIN latest_quarter lq WHERE d.d_quarter_name = lq.max_quarter AND cc.cc_employees > 200 GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state ) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, cc_state, total_quantity, total_net_paid, avg_discount, CASE WHEN total_net_paid > 500000 THEN 'High Revenue' ELSE 'Low Revenue' END AS revenue_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_state ORDER BY total_quantity DESC) AS state_quantity_rank FROM call_center_stats WHERE avg_discount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY revenue_category, state_quantity_rank LIMIT 25

WITH latest_quarter AS ( SELECT MAX(d_quarter_name) AS max_quarter FROM date_dim ), call_center_discount AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_tax_percentage, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, AVG(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price, COUNT(*) AS total_transactions FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_quarter_name = (SELECT max_quarter FROM latest_quarter) AND cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax > 1000 GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_tax_percentage ) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, cc_state, cc_tax_percentage, avg_discount, avg_sales_price, total_transactions, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY avg_discount ASC) AS discount_quartile FROM call_center_discount WHERE total_transactions >= 20 ORDER BY discount_quartile, avg_discount DESC LIMIT 30

WITH latest_quarter AS ( SELECT MAX(d_quarter_name) AS max_quarter FROM date_dim ), call_center_discount AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_tax_percentage, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, AVG(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price, AVG(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost, COUNT(*) AS total_transactions FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk CROSS JOIN latest_quarter lq WHERE d.d_quarter_name = lq.max_quarter AND w.w_state = 'CA' GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_tax_percentage ) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, cc_state, cc_tax_percentage, avg_discount, avg_sales_price, avg_ship_cost, total_transactions, CASE WHEN avg_discount > 0.12 * avg_sales_price THEN 'Elevated Discount' ELSE 'Normal Discount' END AS discount_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_transactions DESC) AS transaction_rank FROM call_center_discount WHERE total_transactions BETWEEN 50 AND 200 ORDER BY transaction_rank LIMIT 15

WITH latest_quarter AS ( SELECT MAX(d_quarter_name) AS max_quarter FROM date_dim ), call_center_analysis AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_tax_percentage, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sum_sales, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, MAX(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS max_ship_cost, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk CROSS JOIN latest_quarter lq WHERE d.d_quarter_name = lq.max_quarter AND w.w_city = 'NEW YORK' GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_tax_percentage ) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, cc_state, cc_tax_percentage, sum_sales, avg_discount, max_ship_cost, txn_count, CASE WHEN avg_discount > 0.2 * sum_sales / txn_count THEN 'Aggressive Discount' ELSE 'Conservative Discount' END AS discount_intensity, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sum_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM call_center_analysis WHERE txn_count > 10 ORDER BY sales_rank LIMIT 10

WITH latest_year AS ( SELECT MAX(d_year) AS max_year FROM date_dim ), call_center_sales AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk AS cc_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT w.w_warehouse_id) AS distinct_warehouses, DATE_TRUNC('month', d.d_date) AS sales_month FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk CROSS JOIN latest_year ly WHERE d.d_year = ly.max_year GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, DATE_TRUNC('month', d.d_date) ) SELECT cc_sk, cc_name, cc_city, cc_state, sales_month, total_net_paid, total_net_profit, total_orders, distinct_warehouses, SUM(total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_state ORDER BY sales_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_sales FROM call_center_sales ORDER BY cc_state, sales_month

WITH latest_year AS ( SELECT MAX(d_year) AS max_year FROM date_dim ), call_center_sales AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk AS cc_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_net_paid_inc_tax, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, AVG(cs.cs_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT w.w_warehouse_id) AS distinct_warehouses FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk CROSS JOIN latest_year ly WHERE d.d_year = ly.max_year AND cc.cc_state = 'CA' GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state ) SELECT cc_sk, cc_name, cc_city, cc_state, total_net_paid_inc_tax, total_discount, avg_quantity, distinct_warehouses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_state ORDER BY total_net_paid_inc_tax DESC) AS state_sales_rank FROM call_center_sales ORDER BY state_sales_rank, total_net_paid_inc_tax DESC LIMIT 10

WITH latest_year AS ( SELECT MAX(d_year) AS max_year FROM date_dim ), call_center_sales AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk AS cc_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT w.w_warehouse_id) AS distinct_warehouses FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk CROSS JOIN latest_year ly WHERE d.d_year = ly.max_year AND cs.cs_ext_discount_amt > 0 GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state ) SELECT cc_sk, cc_name, cc_city, cc_state, total_net_paid, total_net_profit, total_orders, distinct_warehouses, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS sales_quartile, CASE WHEN total_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profitability FROM call_center_sales WHERE total_net_paid > 10000 ORDER BY sales_quartile, total_net_paid DESC LIMIT 15

WITH unified_sales AS (
   SELECT
      ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
      ss.ss_net_profit AS net_profit,
      ss.ss_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
      'store' AS channel,
      ss.ss_cdemo_sk AS cd_demo_sk,
      ss.ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk
   FROM store_sales ss
   UNION ALL
   SELECT
      ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
      ws.ws_net_profit AS net_profit,
      ws.ws_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
      'web' AS channel,
      ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk AS cd_demo_sk,
      ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
   FROM web_sales ws
),
sales_with_demo_cust AS (
   SELECT
      us.sold_date_sk,
      us.channel,
      cd.cd_gender,
      us.net_profit,
      us.discount_amt,
      c.c_customer_id,
      c.c_first_name,
      c.c_last_name
   FROM unified_sales us
   JOIN customer_demographics cd ON us.cd_demo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
   JOIN customer c ON us.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
)
SELECT
   swdc.sold_date_sk,
   swdc.channel,
   swdc.cd_gender,
   COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt,
   SUM(swdc.net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
   AVG(swdc.discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
   DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY swdc.channel ORDER BY SUM(swdc.net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank,
   CASE 
      WHEN AVG(swdc.discount_amt) > 50 THEN 'HighDiscount'
      WHEN AVG(swdc.discount_amt) BETWEEN 20 AND 50 THEN 'MediumDiscount'
      ELSE 'LowDiscount'
   END AS discount_level,
   MIN(swdc.c_customer_id) AS example_customer_id,
   MIN(swdc.c_first_name) AS example_first_name,
   MIN(swdc.c_last_name) AS example_last_name
FROM sales_with_demo_cust swdc
GROUP BY swdc.sold_date_sk, swdc.channel, swdc.cd_gender
ORDER BY swdc.sold_date_sk, swdc.channel, swdc.cd_gender

WITH store_agg AS (
   SELECT ss_customer_sk AS c_customer_sk,
          SUM(ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit,
          COUNT(*) AS store_sales_cnt
   FROM store_sales
   GROUP BY ss_customer_sk
),
web_agg AS (
   SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk AS c_customer_sk,
          SUM(ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
          COUNT(*) AS web_sales_cnt
   FROM web_sales
   GROUP BY ws_bill_customer_sk
),
customer_total AS (
   SELECT c.c_customer_sk,
          c.c_customer_id,
          c.c_first_name,
          c.c_last_name,
          c.c_birth_month,
          cd.cd_gender,
          cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
          COALESCE(sa.store_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_profit, 0) AS total_net_profit,
          COALESCE(sa.store_sales_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_sales_cnt, 0) AS total_sales_cnt
   FROM customer c
   JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
   LEFT JOIN store_agg sa ON c.c_customer_sk = sa.c_customer_sk
   LEFT JOIN web_agg wa ON c.c_customer_sk = wa.c_customer_sk
)
SELECT
   c_total.c_customer_id,
   c_total.c_first_name,
   c_total.c_last_name,
   c_total.c_birth_month,
   c_total.cd_gender,
   c_total.total_net_profit,
   RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c_total.cd_gender ORDER BY c_total.total_net_profit DESC) AS gender_profit_rank,
   CASE 
      WHEN c_total.cd_purchase_estimate >= 5000 THEN 'High'
      WHEN c_total.cd_purchase_estimate BETWEEN 2000 AND 4999 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Low'
   END AS purchase_estimate_category,
   CASE 
      WHEN c_total.total_net_profit > 10000 THEN 'VIP'
      WHEN c_total.total_net_profit > 5000 THEN 'Gold'
      ELSE 'Silver'
   END AS customer_value_tier
FROM customer_total c_total
WHERE c_total.total_net_profit > 0
ORDER BY c_total.total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH sales_month AS (
   SELECT 
      mod(cast(ss.ss_sold_date_sk / 100 as integer), 100) AS month,
      ss.ss_net_profit AS net_profit
   FROM store_sales ss
   UNION ALL
   SELECT 
      mod(cast(ws.ws_sold_date_sk / 100 as integer), 100) AS month,
      ws.ws_net_profit AS net_profit
   FROM web_sales ws
),
monthly_stats AS (
   SELECT
      month,
      AVG(net_profit) AS avg_monthly_profit,
      SUM(net_profit) AS total_monthly_profit,
      COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt
   FROM sales_month
   GROUP BY month
),
ranked_months AS (
   SELECT
      month,
      avg_monthly_profit,
      RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_monthly_profit DESC) AS month_rank
   FROM monthly_stats
),
top_months AS (
   SELECT month, avg_monthly_profit
   FROM ranked_months
   WHERE month_rank = 1
)
SELECT 
   c.c_customer_id,
   c.c_first_name,
   c.c_last_name,
   c.c_birth_month,
   cd.cd_credit_rating,
   tm.avg_monthly_profit AS birth_month_avg_profit,
   CASE WHEN c.c_birth_month = tm.month THEN 'BirthdayMonthTopSeller' ELSE 'Other' END AS birthday_month_flag,
   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tm.month ORDER BY c.c_customer_id) AS row_in_birth_month
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN top_months tm ON c.c_birth_month = tm.month
ORDER BY tm.avg_monthly_profit DESC, c.c_customer_id
LIMIT 20

WITH store_product AS (
   SELECT 
      ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
      SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_total_profit,
      SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS store_total_qty,
      AVG(ss.ss_sales_price) AS store_avg_price
   FROM store_sales ss
   GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk
),
web_product AS (
   SELECT 
      ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
      SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_total_profit,
      SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS web_total_qty,
      AVG(ws.ws_sales_price) AS web_avg_price
   FROM web_sales ws
   GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk
),
product_comparison AS (
   SELECT 
      COALESCE(sp.item_sk, wp.item_sk) AS item_sk,
      sp.store_total_profit,
      sp.store_total_qty,
      sp.store_avg_price,
      wp.web_total_profit,
      wp.web_total_qty,
      wp.web_avg_price,
      (sp.store_total_profit - wp.web_total_profit) AS profit_diff,
      (sp.store_avg_price - wp.web_avg_price) AS price_diff
   FROM store_product sp
   FULL OUTER JOIN web_product wp ON sp.item_sk = wp.item_sk
)
SELECT 
   pc.item_sk,
   pc.store_total_profit,
   pc.web_total_profit,
   pc.profit_diff,
   pc.store_avg_price,
   pc.web_avg_price,
   pc.price_diff,
   DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pc.profit_diff DESC) AS profit_diff_rank,
   CASE 
      WHEN pc.profit_diff > 10000 THEN 'HugeDiff'
      WHEN pc.profit_diff > 5000 THEN 'LargeDiff'
      WHEN pc.profit_diff > 0 THEN 'PositiveDiff'
      ELSE 'NegativeDiff'
   END AS profit_diff_category,
   top_c.c_customer_id AS top_store_customer_id,
   top_c.c_first_name AS top_store_customer_first_name,
   top_c.c_last_name AS top_store_customer_last_name,
   top_c.cd_gender AS top_customer_gender
FROM product_comparison pc
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT 
      c.c_customer_id,
      c.c_first_name,
      c.c_last_name,
      cd.cd_gender
   FROM store_sales ss
   JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
   JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
   WHERE ss.ss_item_sk = pc.item_sk
   ORDER BY ss.ss_net_profit DESC
   LIMIT 1
) AS top_c ON TRUE
WHERE pc.profit_diff IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY profit_diff_rank
LIMIT 25

WITH customer_metrics AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_loss, MAX(t_sale.t_time) AS latest_sale_time, COUNT(*) AS total_sales, COUNT(cs.cs_promo_sk) FILTER (WHERE cs.cs_promo_sk IS NOT NULL) AS promo_sales, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y') AS active_promo_sales FROM catalog_sales cs LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk LEFT JOIN time_dim t_sale ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sale.t_time_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk) SELECT cm.customer_sk, cm.total_profit, cm.total_loss, (cm.total_profit - cm.total_loss) AS net_profit, CASE WHEN cm.total_profit > cm.total_loss THEN 'Net Gain' ELSE 'Net Loss' END AS profit_status, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (cm.total_profit - cm.total_loss) DESC) AS net_profit_rank, SUM(cm.total_profit - cm.total_loss) OVER (ORDER BY (cm.total_profit - cm.total_loss) DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_profit, ROUND(100.0 * (cm.total_profit - cm.total_loss) / NULLIF(SUM(cm.total_profit - cm.total_loss) OVER (), 0), 2) AS pct_of_total_net_profit, CAST(cm.latest_sale_time AS VARCHAR) AS latest_sale_time, cm.total_sales, cm.promo_sales, cm.active_promo_sales, CASE WHEN cm.total_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE cm.active_promo_sales / CAST(cm.total_sales AS DOUBLE) END AS active_promo_ratio FROM customer_metrics cm ORDER BY net_profit_rank LIMIT 15

WITH sp AS (SELECT cs.cs_order_number, cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_promo_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, cs.cs_net_profit, cs.cs_quantity, t.t_shift FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk), rp AS (SELECT cr.cr_order_number, cr.cr_item_sk, cr.cr_net_loss, cr.cr_return_quantity FROM catalog_returns cr), base AS (SELECT p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, sp.t_shift, sp.cs_sold_date_sk, SUM(sp.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(COALESCE(rp.cr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_loss, SUM(sp.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(COALESCE(rp.cr_return_quantity, 0)) AS total_return_quantity FROM sp LEFT JOIN rp ON rp.cr_order_number = sp.cs_order_number AND rp.cr_item_sk = sp.cs_item_sk JOIN promotion p ON sp.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, sp.t_shift, sp.cs_sold_date_sk) SELECT b.p_promo_sk, b.p_promo_name, b.t_shift AS sale_shift, b.cs_sold_date_sk AS sale_date, b.total_profit, b.total_loss, (b.total_profit - b.total_loss) AS net_contribution, CASE WHEN (b.total_profit - b.total_loss) > 1000 THEN 'High' WHEN (b.total_profit - b.total_loss) BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS contribution_level, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.p_promo_sk ORDER BY b.cs_sold_date_sk) AS sale_seq, AVG(b.total_profit - b.total_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY b.p_promo_sk ORDER BY b.cs_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_net_contribution FROM base b WHERE b.total_profit > 0 ORDER BY net_contribution DESC LIMIT 20

WITH agg AS (SELECT t.t_hour, CASE WHEN t.t_hour BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN 'Night' WHEN t.t_hour BETWEEN 6 AND 11 THEN 'Morning' WHEN t.t_hour BETWEEN 12 AND 17 THEN 'Afternoon' ELSE 'Evening' END AS period, p.p_channel_email, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cs.cs_sales_price * cs.cs_quantity) AS total_sales_amount FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN time_dim t ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY t.t_hour, CASE WHEN t.t_hour BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN 'Night' WHEN t.t_hour BETWEEN 6 AND 11 THEN 'Morning' WHEN t.t_hour BETWEEN 12 AND 17 THEN 'Afternoon' ELSE 'Evening' END, p.p_channel_email) SELECT agg.t_hour, agg.period, agg.p_channel_email, agg.total_return_amount, agg.total_sales_amount, CASE WHEN agg.total_sales_amount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE agg.total_return_amount / agg.total_sales_amount END AS return_rate, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY agg.period ORDER BY CASE WHEN agg.total_sales_amount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE agg.total_return_amount / agg.total_sales_amount END DESC) AS rate_rank FROM agg ORDER BY agg.period, rate_rank LIMIT 20

WITH agg AS (SELECT p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS discount_status, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_loss, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS net_contribution, AVG(t_return.t_time - t_sale.t_time) AS avg_time_diff_seconds FROM promotion p JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk JOIN time_dim t_sale ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sale.t_time_sk JOIN time_dim t_return ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t_return.t_time_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 0) SELECT agg.p_promo_sk, agg.p_promo_name, agg.discount_status, agg.total_profit, agg.total_loss, agg.net_contribution, agg.avg_time_diff_seconds, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY agg.net_contribution DESC) AS profit_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN agg.discount_status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) AS discount_rank FROM agg ORDER BY agg.net_contribution DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT grouping_type, grouping_key, AVG(net_profit) AS avg_net_profit, AVG(discount_amount) AS avg_discount, CASE WHEN AVG(net_profit) > 1000 THEN 'High Profit' ELSE 'Low Profit' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY grouping_type ORDER BY AVG(net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM (SELECT 'catalog_department' AS grouping_type, cp.cp_department AS grouping_key, cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit, cs.cs_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amount FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk UNION ALL SELECT 'store' AS grouping_type, CAST(ss.ss_store_sk AS VARCHAR) AS grouping_key, ss.ss_net_profit AS net_profit, ss.ss_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amount FROM store_sales ss) combined GROUP BY grouping_type, grouping_key HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY grouping_type, profit_rank LIMIT 50

SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_net_paid_inc_tax, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax), 0) > 0.2 THEN 'High Profit' ELSE 'Low Profit' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk WHERE c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) > 10000 ORDER BY total_net_paid_inc_tax DESC LIMIT 10

WITH monthly_sales AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_PARSE(CAST(cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS VARCHAR), '%Y%m%d')) AS month_key, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_net_paid FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_PARSE(CAST(cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS VARCHAR), '%Y%m%d')) UNION ALL SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk, DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_PARSE(CAST(ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS VARCHAR), '%Y%m%d')) AS month_key, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_net_paid FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk, DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_PARSE(CAST(ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS VARCHAR), '%Y%m%d')) ) SELECT c.c_customer_id, month_key, total_net_paid, LAG(total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_customer_id ORDER BY month_key) AS prev_month_net_paid, CASE WHEN LAG(total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_customer_id ORDER BY month_key) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN total_net_paid > LAG(total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_customer_id ORDER BY month_key) * 1.1 THEN 'Boom' WHEN total_net_paid < LAG(total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_customer_id ORDER BY month_key) * 0.9 THEN 'Decline' ELSE 'Stable' END AS growth_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS customer_spend_rank FROM monthly_sales ms JOIN customer c ON ms.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk WHERE c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' ORDER BY c.c_customer_id, month_key

WITH returns_agg AS (SELECT wr_returned_date_sk, SUM(wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM web_returns GROUP BY wr_returned_date_sk), inventory_agg AS (SELECT inv_date_sk, SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT inv_item_sk) AS distinct_items FROM inventory GROUP BY inv_date_sk), store_closed_agg AS (SELECT s_closed_date_sk, COUNT(*) AS stores_closed FROM store WHERE s_closed_date_sk IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s_closed_date_sk) SELECT d.d_date, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, r.total_net_loss, i.total_inventory_qty, s.stores_closed, CASE WHEN r.total_net_loss > 10000 THEN 'High Loss' ELSE 'Moderate Loss' END AS loss_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM returns_agg r JOIN date_dim d ON r.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN inventory_agg i ON d.d_date_sk = i.inv_date_sk LEFT JOIN store_closed_agg s ON d.d_date_sk = s.s_closed_date_sk ORDER BY r.total_net_loss DESC LIMIT 5

WITH store_dates AS (SELECT s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_closed_date_sk, d.d_date, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq FROM store s LEFT JOIN date_dim d ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk), returns_by_store AS (SELECT sd.s_store_sk, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS cumulative_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS total_returns FROM store_dates sd JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk <= sd.s_closed_date_sk GROUP BY sd.s_store_sk), inventory_monthly AS (SELECT d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, AVG(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory_qty FROM inventory i JOIN date_dim d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq) SELECT sd.s_store_id, sd.s_store_name, sd.d_year, sd.d_month_seq, COALESCE(r.cumulative_net_loss,0) AS cumulative_net_loss, COALESCE(r.total_returns,0) AS total_returns, im.avg_inventory_qty, CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.cumulative_net_loss,0) > 50000 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Normal' END AS loss_severity, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(r.cumulative_net_loss,0) DESC) AS loss_rank FROM store_dates sd LEFT JOIN returns_by_store r ON sd.s_store_sk = r.s_store_sk LEFT JOIN inventory_monthly im ON sd.d_year = im.d_year AND sd.d_month_seq = im.d_month_seq WHERE sd.s_closed_date_sk IS NOT NULL ORDER BY cumulative_net_loss DESC LIMIT 10

WITH store_closure AS (SELECT s_closed_date_sk, COUNT(*) AS stores_closed FROM store GROUP BY s_closed_date_sk), daily_stats AS (SELECT d.d_date, d.d_day_name, d.d_weekend, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, COUNT(wr.wr_return_amt) AS return_cnt, SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty, COALESCE(sc.stores_closed,0) AS stores_closed FROM date_dim d LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN store_closure sc ON sc.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date, d.d_day_name, d.d_weekend, sc.stores_closed), day_agg AS (SELECT ds.d_day_name, ds.d_weekend, SUM(ds.total_return_amt) AS sum_return_amt, SUM(ds.total_inventory_qty) AS sum_inventory_qty, COUNT(*) AS days_count, AVG(ds.total_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt_per_day, CASE WHEN ds.d_weekend = 'Y' THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type FROM daily_stats ds GROUP BY ds.d_day_name, ds.d_weekend) SELECT da.d_day_name, da.d_weekend, da.sum_return_amt, da.sum_inventory_qty, da.days_count, da.avg_return_amt_per_day, da.day_type, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY da.sum_return_amt DESC) AS return_amount_day_rank, SUM(da.sum_return_amt) OVER (ORDER BY da.sum_return_amt DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return_amt FROM day_agg da ORDER BY da.sum_return_amt DESC

WITH monthly_returns AS (SELECT d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amt_inc_tax, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq), monthly_inventory AS (SELECT d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty FROM inventory i JOIN date_dim d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq), monthly_store_closure AS (SELECT d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, COUNT(*) AS stores_closed_month FROM store s JOIN date_dim d ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq) SELECT mr.d_year, mr.d_month_seq, mr.total_return_amt_inc_tax, mi.total_inventory_qty, mr.total_return_amt_inc_tax - LAG(mr.total_return_amt_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY mr.d_year ORDER BY mr.d_month_seq) AS return_amt_change, CASE WHEN LAG(mr.total_return_amt_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY mr.d_year ORDER BY mr.d_month_seq) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (mr.total_return_amt_inc_tax - LAG(mr.total_return_amt_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY mr.d_year ORDER BY mr.d_month_seq)) / LAG(mr.total_return_amt_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY mr.d_year ORDER BY mr.d_month_seq) * 100 END AS return_pct_change, mi.total_inventory_qty - LAG(mi.total_inventory_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY mi.d_year ORDER BY mi.d_month_seq) AS inventory_change, CASE WHEN LAG(mi.total_inventory_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY mi.d_year ORDER BY mi.d_month_seq) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (mi.total_inventory_qty - LAG(mi.total_inventory_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY mi.d_year ORDER BY mi.d_month_seq)) / LAG(mi.total_inventory_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY mi.d_year ORDER BY mi.d_month_seq) * 100 END AS inventory_pct_change, CASE WHEN (mr.total_return_amt_inc_tax - LAG(mr.total_return_amt_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY mr.d_year ORDER BY mr.d_month_seq)) > 0.2 * LAG(mr.total_return_amt_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY mr.d_year ORDER BY mr.d_month_seq) THEN 'Spike' ELSE 'Stable' END AS return_trend_flag, sc.stores_closed_month, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY mr.total_return_amt_inc_tax DESC) AS return_amount_rank FROM monthly_returns mr JOIN monthly_inventory mi ON mr.d_year = mi.d_year AND mr.d_month_seq = mi.d_month_seq LEFT JOIN monthly_store_closure sc ON mr.d_year = sc.d_year AND mr.d_month_seq = sc.d_month_seq ORDER BY mr.d_year, mr.d_month_seq

WITH web_ship AS (SELECT sm.sm_ship_mode_id, sm.sm_type, hd.hd_income_band_sk, SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM web_sales ws JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY sm.sm_ship_mode_id, sm.sm_type, hd.hd_income_band_sk), store_disc AS (SELECT hd.hd_income_band_sk, SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS store_total_discount, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_total_sales FROM store_sales ss JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY hd.hd_income_band_sk) SELECT ws.sm_ship_mode_id, ws.sm_type, ws.hd_income_band_sk, ws.total_discount, ws.total_sales, CASE WHEN ws.total_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ws.total_discount / ws.total_sales END AS web_discount_ratio, sd.store_total_discount, sd.store_total_sales, CASE WHEN sd.store_total_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE sd.store_total_discount / sd.store_total_sales END AS store_discount_ratio, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ws.hd_income_band_sk ORDER BY CASE WHEN ws.total_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ws.total_discount / ws.total_sales END DESC) AS web_discount_rank, CASE WHEN CASE WHEN ws.total_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ws.total_discount / ws.total_sales END > 0.2 THEN 'High' WHEN CASE WHEN ws.total_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ws.total_discount / ws.total_sales END > 0.1 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS discount_category FROM web_ship ws JOIN store_disc sd ON ws.hd_income_band_sk = sd.hd_income_band_sk ORDER BY ws.hd_income_band_sk, web_discount_rank FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

WITH sales_combined AS (SELECT ss.ss_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk, ss.ss_net_profit AS net_profit, ss.ss_ticket_number AS transaction_id, CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS ship_mode_id FROM store_sales ss UNION ALL SELECT ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk, ws.ws_net_profit AS net_profit, ws.ws_order_number AS transaction_id, sm.sm_ship_mode_id AS ship_mode_id FROM web_sales ws JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk), agg_by_household AS (SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_vehicle_count, hd.hd_buy_potential, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.transaction_id) AS txn_count, SUM(sc.net_profit) AS total_net_profit, AVG(sc.net_profit) AS avg_net_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.ship_mode_id) AS distinct_ship_modes FROM household_demographics hd LEFT JOIN sales_combined sc ON hd.hd_demo_sk = sc.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_vehicle_count, hd.hd_buy_potential) SELECT hd_demo_sk, hd_vehicle_count, hd_buy_potential, txn_count, total_net_profit, avg_net_profit, distinct_ship_modes, avg_profit_percentile, CASE WHEN avg_profit_percentile <= 0.10 THEN 'Top 10% Performer' ELSE 'Standard' END AS performance_category FROM (SELECT hd_demo_sk, hd_vehicle_count, hd_buy_potential, txn_count, total_net_profit, avg_net_profit, distinct_ship_modes, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_net_profit DESC) AS avg_profit_percentile FROM agg_by_household WHERE hd_vehicle_count >= 2 AND hd_buy_potential = 'HIGH') t ORDER BY avg_profit_percentile FETCH FIRST 15 ROWS ONLY

WITH store_agg AS (SELECT ss_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk, SUM(ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit, SUM(ss_quantity) AS store_quantity FROM store_sales GROUP BY ss_hdemo_sk), web_agg AS (SELECT ws_bill_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk, SUM(ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit, SUM(ws_quantity) AS web_quantity FROM web_sales GROUP BY ws_bill_hdemo_sk), ship_mode_cnt AS (SELECT ws_ship_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk, COUNT(DISTINCT sm.sm_ship_mode_sk) AS distinct_ship_modes FROM web_sales ws JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY ws_ship_hdemo_sk), combined AS (SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_income_band_sk, COALESCE(sa.store_net_profit,0)+COALESCE(wa.web_net_profit,0) AS total_net_profit, COALESCE(sa.store_quantity,0)+COALESCE(wa.web_quantity,0) AS total_quantity, hd.hd_buy_potential, COALESCE(sc.distinct_ship_modes,0) AS distinct_ship_modes FROM household_demographics hd LEFT JOIN store_agg sa ON hd.hd_demo_sk = sa.hd_demo_sk LEFT JOIN web_agg wa ON hd.hd_demo_sk = wa.hd_demo_sk LEFT JOIN ship_mode_cnt sc ON hd.hd_demo_sk = sc.hd_demo_sk) SELECT hd_demo_sk, hd_income_band_sk, total_net_profit, total_quantity, distinct_ship_modes, hd_buy_potential, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS net_profit_rank, CASE WHEN hd_buy_potential = 'HIGH' THEN 'Premium' WHEN hd_buy_potential = 'MEDIUM' THEN 'Midrange' ELSE 'Budget' END AS potential_category FROM combined ORDER BY net_profit_rank FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

WITH latest_quarter AS ( SELECT MAX(d_quarter_name) AS max_quarter FROM date_dim ), call_center_analysis AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sum_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_item_sk) AS distinct_items, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_quarter_name = (SELECT max_quarter FROM latest_quarter) AND cc.cc_country = 'USA' GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state ) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, cc_state, sum_sales, distinct_items, total_discount, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY sum_sales DESC) AS sales_quartile FROM call_center_analysis WHERE distinct_items > 20 ORDER BY sum_sales DESC LIMIT 15

WITH latest_quarter AS ( SELECT MAX(d_quarter_name) AS max_quarter FROM date_dim ), call_center_analysis AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sum_sales, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS txn_count, SUM(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS total_ship_cost FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk CROSS JOIN latest_quarter lq WHERE d.d_quarter_name = lq.max_quarter AND cc.cc_employees > 100 AND w.w_country = 'USA' GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state ) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, cc_state, sum_sales, avg_discount, txn_count, total_ship_cost, CASE WHEN total_ship_cost > 5000 THEN 'High Shipping Cost' ELSE 'Low Shipping Cost' END AS shipping_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_discount DESC) AS discount_rank FROM call_center_analysis WHERE sum_sales > 10000 ORDER BY discount_rank LIMIT 8

WITH latest_quarter AS ( SELECT MAX(d_quarter_name) AS max_quarter FROM date_dim ), call_center_analysis AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_tax_percentage, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sum_sales, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, MIN(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS min_ship_cost, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk CROSS JOIN latest_quarter lq WHERE d.d_quarter_name = lq.max_quarter AND w.w_state = 'CA' AND cc.cc_tax_percentage > 5.0 GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_tax_percentage ) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, cc_state, cc_tax_percentage, sum_sales, avg_discount, min_ship_cost, txn_count, CASE WHEN avg_discount > 0.15 * sum_sales / txn_count THEN 'High Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_discount ASC) AS discount_rank FROM call_center_analysis WHERE txn_count BETWEEN 5 AND 50 ORDER BY discount_rank LIMIT 5

WITH latest_quarter AS ( SELECT MAX(d_quarter_name) AS max_quarter FROM date_dim ), call_center_analysis AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_tax_percentage, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sum_sales, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, MAX(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS max_ship_cost, COUNT(*) AS txn_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc.cc_state ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) DESC) AS state_rank FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk CROSS JOIN latest_quarter lq WHERE d.d_quarter_name = lq.max_quarter AND w.w_city IN ('NEW YORK','LOS ANGELES') GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_tax_percentage ) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, cc_state, cc_tax_percentage, sum_sales, avg_discount, max_ship_cost, txn_count, CASE WHEN state_rank = 1 THEN 'Top in State' ELSE 'Other' END AS state_position FROM call_center_analysis WHERE txn_count > 20 AND cc_tax_percentage BETWEEN 0 AND 10 ORDER BY sum_sales DESC LIMIT 12

WITH catalog_cust AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_catalog_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i.i_brand) AS catalog_brands
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk
),
web_cust AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        AVG(wr.wr_return_amt) AS avg_web_return_amount,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i.i_brand) AS web_brands
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk
),
combined_cust AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(c.customer_sk, w.customer_sk) AS customer_sk,
        COALESCE(c.avg_catalog_return_amount, 0) + COALESCE(w.avg_web_return_amount, 0) AS total_avg_return_amount,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_cnt, 0) AS total_return_cnt,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 3000 THEN 'High Loss'
            ELSE 'Low/Medium Loss'
        END AS loss_category,
        ARRAY_JOIN(COALESCE(c.catalog_brands, ARRAY[]), ', ') AS catalog_brands_str,
        ARRAY_JOIN(COALESCE(w.web_brands, ARRAY[]), ', ') AS web_brands_str
    FROM catalog_cust c
    FULL OUTER JOIN web_cust w ON c.customer_sk = w.customer_sk
)
SELECT
    customer_sk,
    total_avg_return_amount,
    total_net_loss,
    total_return_cnt,
    loss_category,
    catalog_brands_str,
    web_brands_str,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_avg_return_amount DESC) AS avg_amount_rank,
    SUM(total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY loss_category) AS loss_sum_by_category,
    MAX(total_return_cnt) OVER () AS max_return_cnt_overall
FROM combined_cust
WHERE total_return_cnt >= 2
ORDER BY total_avg_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH catalog_cust AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS catalog_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i.i_brand) AS catalog_brands,
        MIN(cr.cr_returned_date_sk) AS first_return_date_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
web_cust AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS web_return_amount,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i.i_brand) AS web_brands,
        MIN(wr.wr_returned_date_sk) AS first_web_return_date_sk
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
combined_cust AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(c.customer_sk, w.customer_sk) AS customer_sk,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_amount, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_amount, 0) AS total_return_amount,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_cnt, 0) AS total_return_cnt,
        LEAST(COALESCE(c.first_return_date_sk, 9999999), COALESCE(w.first_web_return_date_sk, 9999999)) AS earliest_return_date_sk,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 8000 THEN 'High Loss'
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 2000 THEN 'Medium Loss'
            ELSE 'Low Loss'
        END AS loss_category,
        ARRAY_JOIN(COALESCE(c.catalog_brands, ARRAY[]), ', ') AS catalog_brands_str,
        ARRAY_JOIN(COALESCE(w.web_brands, ARRAY[]), ', ') AS web_brands_str
    FROM catalog_cust c
    FULL OUTER JOIN web_cust w ON c.customer_sk = w.customer_sk
)
SELECT
    customer_sk,
    total_return_amount,
    total_net_loss,
    total_return_cnt,
    loss_category,
    catalog_brands_str,
    web_brands_str,
    earliest_return_date_sk,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank,
    SUM(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY loss_category ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS cum_amount_by_loss_category
FROM combined_cust
WHERE total_return_cnt >= 3
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 25

WITH catalog_cust AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS catalog_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i.i_brand) AS catalog_brands,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_returned_time_sk) AS distinct_return_times
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk
),
web_cust AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS web_return_amount,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i.i_brand) AS web_brands,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_returned_time_sk) AS distinct_web_return_times
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk
),
combined_cust AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(c.customer_sk, w.customer_sk) AS customer_sk,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_amount, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_amount, 0) AS total_return_amount,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_cnt, 0) AS total_return_cnt,
        COALESCE(c.distinct_return_times, 0) + COALESCE(w.distinct_web_return_times, 0) AS total_distinct_return_times,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 6000 THEN 'High Loss'
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 1500 THEN 'Medium Loss'
            ELSE 'Low Loss'
        END AS loss_category,
        ARRAY_JOIN(COALESCE(c.catalog_brands, ARRAY[]), ', ') AS catalog_brands_str,
        ARRAY_JOIN(COALESCE(w.web_brands, ARRAY[]), ', ') AS web_brands_str
    FROM catalog_cust c
    FULL OUTER JOIN web_cust w ON c.customer_sk = w.customer_sk
)
SELECT
    customer_sk,
    total_return_amount,
    total_net_loss,
    total_return_cnt,
    total_distinct_return_times,
    loss_category,
    catalog_brands_str,
    web_brands_str,
    NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS amount_quartile,
    SUM(total_net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_loss,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY loss_category ORDER BY total_return_cnt DESC) AS rank_within_loss_category
FROM combined_cust
WHERE total_distinct_return_times > 1
ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 30

WITH catalog_cust AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS catalog_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i.i_brand) FILTER (WHERE i.i_brand IS NOT NULL) AS catalog_brands
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2451000
    GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk
    HAVING SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) > 1000
),
web_cust AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS web_return_amount,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i.i_brand) FILTER (WHERE i.i_brand IS NOT NULL) AS web_brands
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2451000
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
combined_cust AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(c.customer_sk, w.customer_sk) AS customer_sk,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_amount, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_amount, 0) AS total_return_amount,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_cnt, 0) AS total_return_cnt,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 10000 THEN 'Very High Loss'
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 5000 THEN 'High Loss'
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 1000 THEN 'Medium Loss'
            ELSE 'Low Loss'
        END AS loss_category,
        ARRAY_JOIN(COALESCE(c.catalog_brands, ARRAY[]), ', ') AS catalog_brands_str,
        ARRAY_JOIN(COALESCE(w.web_brands, ARRAY[]), ', ') AS web_brands_str
    FROM catalog_cust c
    FULL OUTER JOIN web_cust w ON c.customer_sk = w.customer_sk
)
SELECT
    customer_sk,
    total_return_amount,
    total_net_loss,
    total_return_cnt,
    loss_category,
    catalog_brands_str,
    web_brands_str,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS amount_rownum,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_percentile,
    SUM(total_return_amount) OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return_amount
FROM combined_cust
WHERE total_return_cnt >= 1 AND loss_category <> 'Low Loss'
ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH household_summary AS (
  SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk,
         hd.hd_vehicle_count,
         hd.hd_dep_count,
         ib.ib_lower_bound,
         ib.ib_upper_bound,
         COALESCE(SUM(ws.ws_net_profit), 0) AS total_profit,
         COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) AS total_loss,
         COALESCE(SUM(ws.ws_net_profit), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) AS net_contribution
  FROM household_demographics hd
  LEFT JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  GROUP BY hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_vehicle_count, hd.hd_dep_count,
           ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound
)
SELECT hd_demo_sk,
       hd_vehicle_count,
       hd_dep_count,
       ib_lower_bound,
       ib_upper_bound,
       total_profit,
       total_loss,
       net_contribution,
       CASE WHEN net_contribution > 0 THEN 'PROFIT' ELSE 'LOSS' END AS net_category,
       profit_rank
FROM (
  SELECT *,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_contribution DESC) AS profit_rank
  FROM household_summary
) t
WHERE profit_rank <= 10
ORDER BY profit_rank

WITH joined_data AS (
  SELECT sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS date_key,
         sr.sr_return_amt,
         ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
         ws.ws_ext_discount_amt,
         ib.ib_lower_bound,
         ib.ib_upper_bound
  FROM store_returns sr
  JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
  JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
  WHERE ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
),
 daily_agg AS (
  SELECT date_key,
         COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt,
         SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt,
         SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amt,
         AVG(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
         SUM(sr_return_amt) / NULLIF(SUM(ws_ext_sales_price), 0) AS return_rate,
         MIN(ib_lower_bound) AS income_lower_bound,
         MAX(ib_upper_bound) AS income_upper_bound
  FROM joined_data
  GROUP BY date_key
)
SELECT date_key,
       txn_cnt,
       total_return_amt,
       total_sales_amt,
       avg_discount,
       return_rate,
       CASE WHEN avg_discount > 5 THEN 'HIGH_DISCOUNT' ELSE 'LOW_DISCOUNT' END AS discount_category,
       income_lower_bound,
       income_upper_bound,
       LAG(return_rate) OVER (ORDER BY date_key) AS prev_return_rate,
       return_rate - LAG(return_rate) OVER (ORDER BY date_key) AS return_rate_change,
       CASE 
         WHEN return_rate - LAG(return_rate) OVER (ORDER BY date_key) > 0 THEN 'INCREASE'
         WHEN return_rate - LAG(return_rate) OVER (ORDER BY date_key) < 0 THEN 'DECREASE'
         ELSE 'NO_CHANGE'
       END AS trend
FROM daily_agg
WHERE total_sales_amt > 0
ORDER BY date_key

WITH returns_agg AS (
  SELECT hd.hd_income_band_sk AS income_band_sk,
         SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss
  FROM store_returns sr
  JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  GROUP BY hd.hd_income_band_sk
),
sales_agg AS (
  SELECT hd.hd_income_band_sk AS income_band_sk,
         SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  GROUP BY hd.hd_income_band_sk
)
SELECT ib.ib_lower_bound,
       ib.ib_upper_bound,
       COALESCE(r.total_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
       COALESCE(s.total_net_profit, 0) AS total_net_profit,
       COALESCE(s.total_net_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_net_loss, 0) AS net_contribution,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.total_net_loss, 0) > 10000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS loss_category,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(r.total_net_loss, 0) DESC) AS loss_rank
FROM income_band ib
LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON ib.ib_income_band_sk = r.income_band_sk
LEFT JOIN sales_agg s ON ib.ib_income_band_sk = s.income_band_sk
WHERE COALESCE(r.total_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(s.total_net_profit, 0) <> 0
ORDER BY loss_rank

WITH reason_stats AS (
  SELECT ib.ib_income_band_sk AS income_band_sk,
         ib.ib_lower_bound,
         ib.ib_upper_bound,
         sr.sr_reason_sk,
         COUNT(*) AS reason_cnt,
         AVG(sr.sr_refunded_cash) AS avg_refunded_cash
  FROM store_returns sr
  JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
  GROUP BY ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, sr.sr_reason_sk
),
ranked_reasons AS (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY income_band_sk ORDER BY reason_cnt DESC) AS reason_rank
  FROM reason_stats
),
top_reasons AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM ranked_reasons
  WHERE reason_rank <= 3
),
sales_avg AS (
  SELECT ib.ib_income_band_sk AS income_band_sk,
         AVG(ws.ws_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
  GROUP BY ib.ib_income_band_sk
)
SELECT tr.ib_lower_bound,
       tr.ib_upper_bound,
       tr.income_band_sk,
       tr.sr_reason_sk AS return_reason,
       tr.reason_cnt,
       tr.avg_refunded_cash,
       sa.avg_sales_price,
       CASE WHEN tr.avg_refunded_cash > sa.avg_sales_price THEN 'REFUND_HIGHER' ELSE 'SALES_HIGHER' END AS refund_vs_sales,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tr.income_band_sk ORDER BY tr.avg_refunded_cash DESC) AS refund_amount_rank
FROM top_reasons tr
LEFT JOIN sales_avg sa ON tr.income_band_sk = sa.income_band_sk
ORDER BY tr.income_band_sk, tr.reason_rank

WITH page_reason_stats AS ( SELECT wp.wp_web_page_sk AS wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url AS wp_url, wp.wp_type AS wp_type, wp.wp_image_count AS wp_image_count, r.r_reason_desc AS r_reason_desc, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, AVG(wr.wr_fee) AS avg_fee, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, AVG(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_per_return, CASE WHEN wp.wp_image_count = 0 THEN 'No Images' WHEN wp.wp_image_count BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 'Few Images' ELSE 'Many Images' END AS image_category FROM web_page wp INNER JOIN web_returns wr ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wr_web_page_sk INNER JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url, wp.wp_type, wp.wp_image_count, r.r_reason_desc ) SELECT wp_web_page_sk, wp_url, wp_type, image_category, r_reason_desc, total_return_amount, avg_fee, return_cnt, avg_vehicle_per_return, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY wp_web_page_sk ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS reason_rank_per_page, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS overall_return_rank, SUM(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY image_category) AS total_return_by_image_category FROM page_reason_stats WHERE total_return_amount > 0 ORDER BY wp_web_page_sk, reason_rank_per_page LIMIT 30

WITH household_return_stats AS ( SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_income_band_sk, hd.hd_vehicle_count, r.r_reason_desc, wp.wp_type, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_sk) AS distinct_pages, CASE WHEN hd.hd_income_band_sk < 5 THEN 'Low Income' WHEN hd.hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 5 AND 10 THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'High Income' END AS income_category FROM web_returns wr INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk INNER JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk INNER JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_income_band_sk, hd.hd_vehicle_count, r.r_reason_desc, wp.wp_type ) SELECT hd_demo_sk, income_category, hd_vehicle_count, r_reason_desc, wp_type, total_net_loss, return_cnt, distinct_pages, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY income_category ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS rank_within_income, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS overall_rank FROM household_return_stats WHERE total_net_loss > 0 ORDER BY overall_rank LIMIT 15

WITH pair_base AS ( SELECT ret_hd.hd_demo_sk AS returning_hd_demo, ret_hd.hd_income_band_sk AS returning_income_band, ref_hd.hd_demo_sk AS refunded_hd_demo, ref_hd.hd_income_band_sk AS refunded_income_band, wr.wr_net_loss, wr.wr_account_credit, wr.wr_reason_sk, r.r_reason_desc, ret_hd.hd_dep_count AS returning_dep_count, wp.wp_type AS page_type FROM web_returns wr INNER JOIN household_demographics ret_hd ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = ret_hd.hd_demo_sk INNER JOIN household_demographics ref_hd ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = ref_hd.hd_demo_sk INNER JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk INNER JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk ), pair_agg AS ( SELECT returning_hd_demo, returning_income_band, refunded_hd_demo, refunded_income_band, SUM(wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(wr_account_credit) AS total_account_credit, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, returning_dep_count, COUNT(DISTINCT page_type) AS distinct_page_types, CASE WHEN returning_dep_count = 0 THEN 'No Dependents' WHEN returning_dep_count BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Few Dependents' ELSE 'Many Dependents' END AS returning_dep_category FROM pair_base GROUP BY returning_hd_demo, returning_income_band, refunded_hd_demo, refunded_income_band, returning_dep_count ), reason_counts AS ( SELECT returning_hd_demo, refunded_hd_demo, r_reason_desc, COUNT(*) AS reason_cnt FROM pair_base GROUP BY returning_hd_demo, refunded_hd_demo, r_reason_desc ), reason_rank AS ( SELECT returning_hd_demo, refunded_hd_demo, r_reason_desc, reason_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY returning_hd_demo, refunded_hd_demo ORDER BY reason_cnt DESC) AS rn FROM reason_counts ) SELECT pa.returning_hd_demo, pa.returning_income_band, pa.refunded_hd_demo, pa.refunded_income_band, pa.total_net_loss, pa.total_account_credit, pa.return_cnt, pa.returning_dep_category, pa.distinct_page_types, COALESCE(rr.r_reason_desc, 'Unknown') AS most_common_reason, CASE WHEN pa.total_account_credit = 0 THEN NULL ELSE pa.total_net_loss / pa.total_account_credit END AS loss_to_credit_ratio, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pa.total_net_loss DESC) AS overall_loss_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.returning_dep_category ORDER BY pa.total_net_loss DESC) AS dep_category_rank FROM pair_agg pa LEFT JOIN reason_rank rr ON pa.returning_hd_demo = rr.returning_hd_demo AND pa.refunded_hd_demo = rr.refunded_hd_demo AND rr.rn = 1 WHERE pa.total_net_loss > 0 ORDER BY overall_loss_rank LIMIT 25

WITH daily_store_returns AS ( SELECT sr.sr_store_sk, sr.sr_returned_date_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS daily_return_amt, COUNT(*) AS daily_return_cnt, AVG(i.i_current_price) AS avg_item_price FROM store_returns sr JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk, sr.sr_returned_date_sk ) SELECT dsr.sr_store_sk, dsr.sr_returned_date_sk, dsr.daily_return_amt, dsr.daily_return_cnt, dsr.avg_item_price, AVG(dsr.daily_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY dsr.sr_store_sk ORDER BY dsr.sr_returned_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS three_month_moving_avg, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dsr.sr_returned_date_sk ORDER BY dsr.daily_return_amt DESC) AS store_return_amt_rank FROM daily_store_returns dsr ORDER BY dsr.sr_returned_date_sk, dsr.sr_store_sk

WITH cat_state_stats AS ( SELECT i.i_category, ca.ca_state, COUNT(*) AS total_returns, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS sum_return_amt, SUM(i.i_current_price * sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_original_sales FROM store_returns sr JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY i.i_category, ca.ca_state ) SELECT i_category, ca_state, total_returns, sum_return_amt, total_original_sales, CASE WHEN total_original_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE sum_return_amt / total_original_sales END AS return_rate, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY CASE WHEN total_original_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE sum_return_amt / total_original_sales END DESC) AS category_return_rank_in_state, CASE WHEN sum_return_amt > 10000 THEN 'Very High' WHEN sum_return_amt > 5000 THEN 'High' WHEN sum_return_amt > 1000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS volume_category FROM cat_state_stats ORDER BY ca_state, category_return_rank_in_state

WITH cust_item_losses AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, i.i_category, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS category_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS returns_in_category FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, i.i_category ), cust_window AS ( SELECT c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, category_net_loss, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c_customer_id) AS categories_returned, SUM(category_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY c_customer_id) AS total_net_loss, AVG(category_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY c_customer_id) AS avg_category_net_loss, STDDEV_POP(category_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY c_customer_id) AS net_loss_stddev FROM cust_item_losses ) SELECT DISTINCT c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, categories_returned, total_net_loss, avg_category_net_loss, net_loss_stddev, CASE WHEN net_loss_stddev > 500 THEN 'Highly Variable' WHEN net_loss_stddev > 200 THEN 'Variable' WHEN net_loss_stddev > 50 THEN 'Moderately Variable' ELSE 'Consistent' END AS variability_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_loss_stddev DESC) AS variability_rank FROM cust_window WHERE categories_returned >= 3 AND total_net_loss > 1000 ORDER BY variability_rank LIMIT 50

WITH cust_return AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, i.i_category, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_transactions FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, i.i_category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ) SELECT c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, ca_city, ca_state, i_category, total_return_amt, total_net_loss, return_transactions, CASE WHEN total_return_amt > 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_level, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC) AS return_amt_rank FROM cust_return ORDER BY return_amt_rank LIMIT 100

WITH catalog_cust AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) FILTER (WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 0) AS avg_catalog_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i.i_brand) AS catalog_brands
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk
),
web_cust AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        AVG(wr.wr_return_amt) FILTER (WHERE wr.wr_return_amt > 0) AS avg_web_return_amount,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i.i_brand) AS web_brands
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk
),
combined_cust AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(c.customer_sk, w.customer_sk) AS customer_sk,
        COALESCE(c.avg_catalog_return_amount, 0) + COALESCE(w.avg_web_return_amount, 0) AS total_avg_return_amount,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_cnt, 0) AS total_return_cnt,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 3000 THEN 'High Loss'
            ELSE 'Low/Medium Loss'
        END AS loss_category,
        ARRAY_JOIN(COALESCE(c.catalog_brands, ARRAY[]), ', ') AS catalog_brands_str,
        ARRAY_JOIN(COALESCE(w.web_brands, ARRAY[]), ', ') AS web_brands_str,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss,0)+COALESCE(w.web_net_loss,0) DESC) AS loss_percentile
    FROM catalog_cust c
    FULL OUTER JOIN web_cust w ON c.customer_sk = w.customer_sk
)
SELECT
    customer_sk,
    total_avg_return_amount,
    total_net_loss,
    total_return_cnt,
    loss_category,
    catalog_brands_str,
    web_brands_str,
    loss_percentile,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY loss_category) AS customers_in_category,
    MAX(total_avg_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY loss_category) AS max_avg_amount_in_category
FROM combined_cust
WHERE loss_percentile <= 0.9
ORDER BY loss_percentile DESC, total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 30

WITH catalog_cust AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_catalog_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt,
        ARRAY_AGG(i.i_brand ORDER BY i.i_brand) AS catalog_brands_ordered
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
web_cust AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
