        AVG(wr.wr_return_amt) AS avg_web_return_amount,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt,
        ARRAY_AGG(i.i_brand ORDER BY i.i_brand) AS web_brands_ordered
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
combined_cust AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(c.customer_sk, w.customer_sk) AS customer_sk,
        COALESCE(c.avg_catalog_return_amount, 0) + COALESCE(w.avg_web_return_amount, 0) AS total_avg_return_amount,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_cnt, 0) AS total_return_cnt,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 4000 THEN 'High Loss'
            ELSE 'Low/Medium Loss'
        END AS loss_category,
        ARRAY_JOIN(COALESCE(c.catalog_brands_ordered, ARRAY[]), '|') AS catalog_brands_str,
        ARRAY_JOIN(COALESCE(w.web_brands_ordered, ARRAY[]), '|') AS web_brands_str
    FROM catalog_cust c
    FULL OUTER JOIN web_cust w ON c.customer_sk = w.customer_sk
)
SELECT
    customer_sk,
    total_avg_return_amount,
    total_net_loss,
    total_return_cnt,
    loss_category,
    catalog_brands_str,
    web_brands_str,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_cnt DESC) AS cnt_rank,
    AVG(total_avg_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY loss_category) AS avg_amount_by_category,
    MAX(total_net_loss) OVER () AS max_net_loss_overall
FROM combined_cust
WHERE loss_category = 'High Loss'
ORDER BY total_return_cnt DESC,
         total_avg_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH catalog_cust AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_catalog_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i.i_brand) FILTER (WHERE i.i_brand IS NOT NULL) AS catalog_brands
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 20000101 AND 20001231
    GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk
),
web_cust AS (

        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        AVG(wr.wr_return_amt) AS avg_web_return_amount,

    FROM web_returns wr

    GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk
),
combined_cust AS (

            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 2000 THEN 'High Loss'

        END AS loss_category,

SELECT

    total_net_loss,
    total_return_cnt,
    loss_category,
    catalog_brands_str,

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank,
    SUM(total_return_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY loss_category) AS cnt_sum_by_category,
    MIN(total_avg_return_amount) OVER () AS min_avg_amount
FROM combined_cust
WHERE total_return_cnt >= 3 AND total_avg_return_amount > 0
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH catalog_cust AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS sum_catalog_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss,

web_cust AS (

),
combined_cust AS (

        END AS loss_category,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(c.customer_sk, w.customer_sk) ORDER BY COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss,0)+COALESCE(w.web_net_loss,0) DESC) AS loss_rank_per_customer

FROM combined_cust
WHERE total_return_cnt BETWEEN 2 AND 5
ORDER BY loss_rank_per_customer ASC
LIMIT 25

WITH store_agg AS (
    SELECT ss_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk,
           SUM(ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit,
           SUM(ss_quantity) AS store_quantity
    FROM store_sales
    GROUP BY ss_hdemo_sk
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT ws_bill_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk,
           SUM(ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
           SUM(ws_quantity) AS web_quantity
    FROM web_sales
    GROUP BY ws_bill_hdemo_sk
),
ship_mode_cnt AS (
    SELECT ws_ship_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk,
           COUNT(DISTINCT sm.sm_ship_mode_sk) AS distinct_ship_modes
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    GROUP BY ws_ship_hdemo_sk
),
combined AS (
    SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk,
           hd.hd_income_band_sk,
           COALESCE(sa.store_net_profit,0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_profit,0) AS total_net_profit,
           COALESCE(sa.store_quantity,0) + COALESCE(wa.web_quantity,0) AS total_quantity,
           hd.hd_buy_potential,
           COALESCE(sc.distinct_ship_modes,0) AS distinct_ship_modes,
           CASE WHEN hd.hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'Low Income'
                WHEN hd.hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Middle Income'
                ELSE 'High Income' END AS income_category
    FROM household_demographics hd
    LEFT JOIN store_agg sa ON hd.hd_demo_sk = sa.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_agg wa ON hd.hd_demo_sk = wa.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode_cnt sc ON hd.hd_demo_sk = sc.hd_demo_sk
)
SELECT hd_demo_sk,
       income_category,
       total_net_profit,
       total_quantity,
       distinct_ship_modes,
       CASE WHEN hd_buy_potential = 'HIGH' THEN 'Premium'
            WHEN hd_buy_potential = 'MEDIUM' THEN 'Midrange'
            ELSE 'Budget' END AS potential_category,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY income_category ORDER BY total_quantity DESC) AS qty_rank_by_income
FROM combined
WHERE total_net_profit > 0
ORDER BY qty_rank_by_income ASC,
         total_net_profit DESC
FETCH FIRST 25 ROWS ONLY

ORDER BY income_band_profit_total DESC,

WITH store_agg AS (

    GROUP BY ws_bill_hdemo_sk

FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

WITH store_agg AS (

),

    SELECT ws_bill_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk,

    FROM web_sales

    GROUP BY ws_bill_hdemo_sk
),
ship_mode_cnt AS (
    SELECT ws_ship_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk,

),
combined AS (

       blended_avg_price,
       distinct_ship_modes,

       CASE WHEN hd_buy_potential = 'HIGH' THEN 'Premium'
            WHEN hd_buy_potential = 'MEDIUM' THEN 'Midrange'
            ELSE 'Budget' END AS potential_category,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM combined
WHERE total_quantity > 1000
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 15

WITH returns_item AS (
  SELECT cr.cr_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
         cr.cr_item_sk AS item_sk,
         SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS return_qty,
         SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS return_amount,
         SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS return_loss
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  GROUP BY cr.cr_warehouse_sk, cr.cr_item_sk
),
sales_item AS (
  SELECT ws.ws_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
         ws.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk,
         ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
         SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS sales_qty,
         SUM(ws.ws_sales_price) AS sales_price,
         SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS sales_profit
  FROM web_sales ws
  GROUP BY ws.ws_warehouse_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk, ws.ws_item_sk
),
items_combined AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(r.warehouse_sk, s.warehouse_sk) AS warehouse_sk,
    COALESCE(r.item_sk, s.item_sk) AS item_sk,
    r.return_qty,
    r.return_amount,
    r.return_loss,
    s.sales_qty,
    s.sales_price,
    s.sales_profit,
    s.site_sk
  FROM returns_item r
  FULL OUTER JOIN sales_item s
    ON r.warehouse_sk = s.warehouse_sk AND r.item_sk = s.item_sk
)
SELECT w.w_warehouse_sk,
       w.w_warehouse_name,
       site.web_name,
       ic.item_sk,
       COALESCE(ic.return_qty, 0) AS return_qty,
       COALESCE(ic.sales_qty, 0) AS sales_qty,
       COALESCE(ic.return_amount, 0) AS return_amount,
       COALESCE(ic.sales_price, 0) AS sales_price,
       COALESCE(ic.return_loss, 0) AS return_loss,
       COALESCE(ic.sales_profit, 0) AS sales_profit,
       CASE 
         WHEN COALESCE(ic.sales_price, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE (COALESCE(ic.sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(ic.return_loss, 0)) / COALESCE(ic.sales_price, 0)
       END AS profit_margin,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_sk, site.web_site_sk ORDER BY (COALESCE(ic.return_qty,0) + COALESCE(ic.sales_qty,0)) DESC) AS item_rank
FROM items_combined ic
JOIN warehouse w ON ic.warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN web_site site ON ic.site_sk = site.web_site_sk
WHERE (COALESCE(ic.return_qty,0) + COALESCE(ic.sales_qty,0)) > 0
ORDER BY w.w_warehouse_sk, site.web_site_sk, item_rank
LIMIT 20

WITH return_by_warehouse AS (
  SELECT cr.cr_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
         SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
         SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  GROUP BY cr.cr_warehouse_sk
),
sales_by_warehouse_site AS (
  SELECT ws.ws_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
         ws.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk,
         SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit,
         SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
         SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_sales_qty
  FROM web_sales ws
  GROUP BY ws.ws_warehouse_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk
)
SELECT w.w_warehouse_sk,
       w.w_warehouse_name,
       r.total_return_loss,
       s.total_sales_profit,
       CASE WHEN s.total_sales_profit = 0 THEN NULL ELSE r.total_return_loss / s.total_sales_profit END AS loss_to_profit_ratio,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.total_sales_profit = 0 THEN 0 ELSE r.total_return_loss / s.total_sales_profit END DESC) AS loss_profit_rank,
       site.web_name AS site_name
FROM warehouse w
LEFT JOIN return_by_warehouse r ON w.w_warehouse_sk = r.warehouse_sk
JOIN sales_by_warehouse_site s ON w.w_warehouse_sk = s.warehouse_sk
JOIN web_site site ON s.site_sk = site.web_site_sk
WHERE r.total_return_loss IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY loss_profit_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH returns_daily AS (
  SELECT cr.cr_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
         cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
         SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS daily_return_loss,
         SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS daily_return_qty
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  GROUP BY cr.cr_warehouse_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk
),
sales_daily AS (
  SELECT ws.ws_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
         ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
         ws.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk,
         SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS daily_sales_profit,
         SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS daily_sales_qty
  FROM web_sales ws
  GROUP BY ws.ws_warehouse_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk
),
combined AS (
  SELECT s.site_sk,
         w.w_city,
         w.w_state,
         COALESCE(r.date_sk, s.date_sk) AS date_sk,
         COALESCE(r.daily_return_loss, 0) AS daily_return_loss,
         COALESCE(s.daily_sales_profit, 0) AS daily_sales_profit,
         COALESCE(r.daily_return_qty, 0) AS daily_return_qty,
         COALESCE(s.daily_sales_qty, 0) AS daily_sales_qty,
         (COALESCE(s.daily_sales_profit,0) - COALESCE(r.daily_return_loss,0)) AS net_contribution
  FROM sales_daily s
  LEFT JOIN returns_daily r 
    ON s.warehouse_sk = r.warehouse_sk 
   AND s.date_sk = r.date_sk
  JOIN warehouse w ON s.warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
)
SELECT c.site_sk,
       site.web_name,
       c.date_sk,
       c.net_contribution,
       SUM(c.net_contribution) OVER (PARTITION BY c.site_sk ORDER BY c.date_sk) AS cumulative_net,
       CASE 
         WHEN c.net_contribution > 0 THEN 'Positive'
         WHEN c.net_contribution < 0 THEN 'Negative'
         ELSE 'Zero'
       END AS contribution_flag
FROM combined c
JOIN web_site site ON c.site_sk = site.web_site_sk
WHERE c.date_sk IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY c.site_sk, c.date_sk
LIMIT 100

WITH site_profit AS (
  SELECT ws.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk,
         SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
         SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
         SUM(ws.ws_ext_tax) AS total_tax
  FROM web_sales ws
  GROUP BY ws.ws_web_site_sk
),
site_return_loss AS (
  SELECT ws.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk,
         SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  GROUP BY ws.ws_web_site_sk
),
site_combined AS (
  SELECT sp.site_sk,
         sp.total_profit,
         sp.total_sales,
         sp.total_tax,
         COALESCE(srl.total_return_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss,
         sp.total_profit - COALESCE(srl.total_return_loss, 0) AS net_contribution
  FROM site_profit sp
  LEFT JOIN site_return_loss srl ON sp.site_sk = srl.site_sk
)
SELECT t.site_sk,
       site.web_name,
       site.web_city,
       t.total_profit,
       t.total_return_loss,
       t.net_contribution,
       t.net_contrib_percentile,
       CASE
         WHEN t.net_contrib_percentile >= 0.8 THEN 'Top 20%'
         WHEN t.net_contrib_percentile >= 0.5 THEN 'Middle 30%'
         ELSE 'Bottom 50%'
       END AS performance_tier
FROM (
  SELECT sc.site_sk,
         sc.total_profit,
         sc.total_return_loss,
         sc.net_contribution,
         PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sc.net_contribution) AS net_contrib_percentile
  FROM site_combined sc
) t
JOIN web_site site ON t.site_sk = site.web_site_sk
ORDER BY t.net_contrib_percentile DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH page_stats AS ( SELECT wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_url, wp.wp_type, c.c_customer_id AS page_owner_id, cd.cd_gender AS owner_gender, cd.cd_marital_status AS owner_marital_status, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_revenue, SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers, SUM(wp.wp_image_count) AS total_images FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN customer c ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_url, wp.wp_type, c.c_customer_id, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status HAVING SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) > 5000 ) SELECT ps.wp_web_page_id, ps.wp_url, ps.wp_type, ps.page_owner_id, ps.owner_gender, ps.owner_marital_status, ps.total_revenue, ps.total_discount, ps.avg_discount, ps.distinct_customers, ps.total_images, CASE WHEN ps.wp_type = 'home' THEN 'Landing' WHEN ps.wp_type = 'product' THEN 'Product' WHEN ps.wp_type = 'search' THEN 'Search' ELSE 'Other' END AS page_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ps.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank, LAG(ps.total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY ps.total_revenue DESC) AS prev_page_revenue, LEAD(ps.total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY ps.total_revenue DESC) AS next_page_revenue, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ps.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_percentile FROM page_stats ps ORDER BY ps.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 20

WITH item_group_sales AS ( SELECT cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, ws.ws_item_sk, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_qty, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_type) AS distinct_page_types, MAX(wp.wp_type) AS most_common_page_type FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, ws.ws_item_sk ) SELECT t.cd_gender, t.cd_marital_status, t.ws_item_sk, t.total_qty, t.total_sales, t.total_profit, t.distinct_page_types, t.most_common_page_type, t.volume_category, t.sales_rank, t.sales_percentile FROM ( SELECT igs.cd_gender, igs.cd_marital_status, igs.ws_item_sk, igs.total_qty, igs.total_sales, igs.total_profit, igs.distinct_page_types, igs.most_common_page_type, CASE WHEN igs.total_qty >= 1000 THEN 'High Volume' WHEN igs.total_qty >= 500 THEN 'Medium Volume' ELSE 'Low Volume' END AS volume_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY igs.cd_gender, igs.cd_marital_status ORDER BY igs.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY igs.cd_gender, igs.cd_marital_status ORDER BY igs.total_sales DESC) AS sales_percentile FROM item_group_sales igs WHERE igs.total_sales > 0 ) t WHERE t.sales_rank <= 3 ORDER BY t.cd_gender, t.cd_marital_status, t.sales_rank

WITH month_cohort AS ( SELECT c.c_birth_month, c.c_birth_year, cd.cd_education_status, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS month_net_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS orders_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_web_page_sk) AS distinct_pages FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY c.c_birth_month, c.c_birth_year, cd.cd_education_status ) SELECT mc.c_birth_year, mc.c_birth_month, mc.cd_education_status, mc.month_net_profit, mc.orders_cnt, mc.distinct_pages, CASE WHEN mc.c_birth_month IN (12,1,2) THEN 'Winter' WHEN mc.c_birth_month IN (3,4,5) THEN 'Spring' WHEN mc.c_birth_month IN (6,7,8) THEN 'Summer' WHEN mc.c_birth_month IN (9,10,11) THEN 'Fall' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS season, SUM(mc.month_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY mc.cd_education_status ORDER BY mc.c_birth_year, mc.c_birth_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit_by_edu, AVG(mc.month_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY mc.cd_education_status ORDER BY mc.c_birth_year, mc.c_birth_month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS three_month_moving_avg_profit, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY mc.month_net_profit DESC) AS profit_percentile, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY mc.month_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM month_cohort mc WHERE mc.month_net_profit IS NOT NULL ORDER BY mc.c_birth_year, mc.c_birth_month

WITH cust_sales AS ( SELECT c_bill.c_customer_id AS billing_customer_id, c_ship.c_customer_id AS shipping_customer_id, cd_bill.cd_gender AS billing_gender, cd_ship.cd_gender AS shipping_gender, cd_bill.cd_credit_rating AS billing_credit_rating, cd_ship.cd_credit_rating AS shipping_credit_rating, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_type) AS distinct_page_types, MAX(ws.ws_sold_date_sk) AS last_sale_date_sk FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer c_bill ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_bill.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk JOIN customer c_ship ON ws.ws_ship_customer_sk = c_ship.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship ON ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY c_bill.c_customer_id, c_ship.c_customer_id, cd_bill.cd_gender, cd_ship.cd_gender, cd_bill.cd_credit_rating, cd_ship.cd_credit_rating ) SELECT cs.billing_customer_id, cs.shipping_customer_id, cs.billing_gender, cs.shipping_gender, cs.billing_credit_rating, cs.shipping_credit_rating, cs.total_sales, cs.total_quantity, cs.avg_discount, cs.distinct_page_types, cs.last_sale_date_sk, CASE WHEN cs.total_sales >= 200000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN cs.total_sales >= 100000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN cs.total_sales >= 50000 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS customer_tier, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_sales DESC) AS overall_sales_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.billing_gender ORDER BY cs.total_sales DESC) AS gender_sales_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_sales) AS sales_percentile, CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_sales DESC) AS sales_cume_dist FROM cust_sales cs WHERE cs.total_sales > 10000 ORDER BY cs.total_sales DESC LIMIT 50

WITH monthly_state_return AS ( SELECT d.d_current_year AS year, d.d_current_month AS month, ca.ca_state, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_inc_tax FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY d.d_current_year, d.d_current_month, ca.ca_state ), ranked_state_return AS ( SELECT year, month, ca_state, total_return_inc_tax, CASE WHEN total_return_inc_tax > 100000 THEN 'High' WHEN total_return_inc_tax > 50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS volume_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year, month ORDER BY total_return_inc_tax DESC) AS state_rank FROM monthly_state_return ) SELECT year, month, ca_state, total_return_inc_tax, volume_category, state_rank FROM ranked_state_return WHERE state_rank <= 10 ORDER BY year, month, state_rank

WITH monthly_category_loss AS ( SELECT date_trunc('month', d.d_date) AS month_start, i.i_category, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE ca.ca_country = 'United States' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', d.d_date), i.i_category ) SELECT month_start, i_category, total_net_loss, ROUND(AVG(total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY month_start ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS moving_avg_3m, CASE WHEN LAG(total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY month_start) IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN total_net_loss > LAG(total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY month_start) THEN 'Increasing' WHEN total_net_loss < LAG(total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY month_start) THEN 'Decreasing' ELSE 'Flat' END AS trend FROM monthly_category_loss ORDER BY i_category, month_start

WITH item_year_loss AS ( SELECT d.d_current_year AS year, i.i_item_sk, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY d.d_current_year, i.i_item_sk, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category ), state_per_item_year AS ( SELECT d.d_current_year AS year, i.i_item_sk, ca_ref.ca_state, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS state_net_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer_address ca_ref ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_ref.ca_address_sk GROUP BY d.d_current_year, i.i_item_sk, ca_ref.ca_state ), top_state_per_item_year AS ( SELECT year, i_item_sk, ca_state, state_net_loss, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, i_item_sk ORDER BY state_net_loss DESC) AS rn FROM state_per_item_year ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT iy.year, iy.i_item_id, iy.i_product_name, iy.i_category, iy.total_net_loss, tsp.ca_state AS top_refunded_state, CASE WHEN iy.total_net_loss > 10000 THEN 'Critical' WHEN iy.total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'High' WHEN iy.total_net_loss > 1000 THEN 'Moderate' ELSE 'Low' END AS loss_severity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY iy.year ORDER BY iy.total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM item_year_loss iy JOIN top_state_per_item_year tsp ON iy.year = tsp.year AND iy.i_item_sk = tsp.i_item_sk AND tsp.rn = 1 ) ranked WHERE loss_rank <= 5 ORDER BY year, loss_rank

WITH address_daily_loss AS ( SELECT ca_ret.ca_address_id, ca_ret.ca_state, d.d_date, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS daily_net_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN customer_address ca_ret ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_ret.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca_ret.ca_address_id, ca_ret.ca_state, d.d_date ), address_cumulative AS ( SELECT adl.ca_address_id, adl.ca_state, adl.d_date, adl.daily_net_loss, SUM(adl.daily_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY adl.ca_address_id ORDER BY adl.d_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_net_loss FROM address_daily_loss adl ), address_total AS ( SELECT ca_address_id, ca_state, SUM(daily_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY SUM(daily_net_loss) DESC) AS address_state_rank FROM address_daily_loss GROUP BY ca_address_id, ca_state ), address_top_item AS ( SELECT ca_ret.ca_address_id AS address_id, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS item_net_loss, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_ret.ca_address_id ORDER BY SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) DESC) AS rn FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer_address ca_ret ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_ret.ca_address_sk JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY ca_ret.ca_address_id, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name ) SELECT ac.ca_address_id, ac.ca_state, ac.d_date, ac.cumulative_net_loss, at.address_state_rank, CASE WHEN ac.cumulative_net_loss > 20000 THEN 'HighLoss' ELSE 'Normal' END AS loss_flag, ati.i_item_id AS top_item_id, ati.i_product_name AS top_item_name, ati.item_net_loss AS top_item_net_loss FROM address_cumulative ac JOIN address_total at ON ac.ca_address_id = at.ca_address_id AND ac.ca_state = at.ca_state LEFT JOIN address_top_item ati ON ac.ca_address_id = ati.address_id AND ati.rn = 1 ORDER BY ac.ca_state, at.address_state_rank, ac.d_date

WITH catalog_cust AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS sum_catalog_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i.i_brand) FILTER (WHERE i.i_brand IS NOT NULL) AS catalog_brands
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_return_ship_cost > 0 AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk >= 20000101
    GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk
),
web_cust AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS sum_web_return_amount,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i.i_brand) FILTER (WHERE i.i_brand IS NOT NULL) AS web_brands
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_return_ship_cost > 0 AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk >= 20000101
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk
),
combined_cust AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(c.customer_sk, w.customer_sk) AS customer_sk,
        COALESCE(c.sum_catalog_return_amount, 0) + COALESCE(w.sum_web_return_amount, 0) AS total_return_amount,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_cnt, 0) AS total_return_cnt,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 5000 THEN 'Very High Loss'
             WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 2500 THEN 'High Loss'
             ELSE 'Low/Medium Loss' END AS loss_category,
        ARRAY_JOIN(COALESCE(c.catalog_brands, ARRAY[]), ', ') AS catalog_brands_str,
        ARRAY_JOIN(COALESCE(w.web_brands, ARRAY[]), ', ') AS web_brands_str,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(c.customer_sk, w.customer_sk) ORDER BY COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss,0)+COALESCE(w.web_net_loss,0) DESC) AS loss_rank_per_customer
    FROM catalog_cust c
    FULL OUTER JOIN web_cust w ON c.customer_sk = w.customer_sk
)
SELECT
    customer_sk,
    total_return_amount,
    total_net_loss,
    total_return_cnt,
    loss_category,
    catalog_brands_str,
    web_brands_str,
    loss_rank_per_customer,
    SUM(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY loss_category) AS amount_sum_by_category,
    MIN(total_return_cnt) OVER () AS min_return_cnt_overall,
    MAX(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY loss_category) AS max_amount_by_category
FROM combined_cust
WHERE total_return_cnt BETWEEN 1 AND 3
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC, loss_rank_per_customer ASC
LIMIT 20

SELECT sub.wp_web_page_id, sub.wp_type, sub.cd_education_status, sub.total_sales, sub.total_discount, sub.avg_coupon, CASE WHEN sub.total_discount > sub.total_sales * 0.15 THEN 'High Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sub.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank, SUM(sub.total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY sub.wp_type) AS total_sales_by_type FROM ( SELECT wp.wp_web_page_id AS wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_type AS wp_type, cd.cd_education_status AS cd_education_status, SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales, SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, AVG(ws.ws_coupon_amt) AS avg_coupon FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_type, cd.cd_education_status ) sub ORDER BY sales_rank

SELECT time_sk, wp_type, total_loss, total_profit, net_diff, CASE WHEN net_diff > 0 THEN 'Loss exceeds profit' ELSE 'Profit exceeds loss' END AS diff_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_diff DESC) AS net_diff_rank, SUM(total_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type ORDER BY time_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_loss_by_type, SUM(total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type ORDER BY time_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_profit_by_type FROM ( SELECT cr.cr_returned_time_sk AS time_sk, wp.wp_type, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_loss, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) - SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS net_diff FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN web_sales ws ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = ws.ws_sold_time_sk JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_returned_time_sk, wp.wp_type ) sub ORDER BY time_sk, net_diff_rank

WITH returns AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS return_orders FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status ), sales AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS sales_orders FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk ) SELECT r.cd_gender, r.cd_marital_status, r.total_return_loss, s.total_sales, CASE WHEN s.total_sales > 0 THEN r.total_return_loss / s.total_sales ELSE NULL END AS loss_to_sales_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.total_return_loss DESC) AS return_loss_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.cd_gender ORDER BY s.total_sales DESC) AS gender_sales_rank FROM returns r JOIN sales s ON r.cd_demo_sk = s.cd_demo_sk WHERE r.total_return_loss > 0 ORDER BY return_loss_rank

WITH returns AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS return_orders FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status ), sales AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_type, SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS sales_orders FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk, wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_type ) SELECT r.cd_gender, r.cd_marital_status, s.wp_web_page_id, s.wp_type, r.total_return_loss, s.total_sales, CASE WHEN s.total_sales > 0 THEN r.total_return_loss / s.total_sales ELSE NULL END AS loss_to_sales_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.total_return_loss DESC) AS return_loss_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.wp_type ORDER BY s.total_sales DESC) AS page_sales_rank FROM returns r JOIN sales s ON r.cd_demo_sk = s.cd_demo_sk WHERE r.total_return_loss > 0 ORDER BY return_loss_rank, page_sales_rank

WITH sales_with_month AS (
    SELECT
        ss.*, 
        s.s_store_sk,
        s.s_store_name,
        CAST(FLOOR(ss.ss_sold_date_sk / 10000) AS VARCHAR) || '-' ||
        LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(ss.ss_sold_date_sk / 100) % 100 AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') AS year_month,
        p.p_discount_active
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
),
monthly_store_profit AS (
    SELECT
        s_store_sk,
        s_store_name,
        year_month,
        SUM(ss_net_profit) AS monthly_net_profit,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN ss_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS promo_sales,
        SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales
    FROM sales_with_month
    GROUP BY s_store_sk, s_store_name, year_month
)
SELECT
    s_store_sk,
    s_store_name,
    year_month,
    monthly_net_profit,
    moving_avg_3_months,
    CASE WHEN moving_avg_3_months > 5000 THEN 'Above Threshold' ELSE 'Normal' END AS profit_trend_flag,
    promo_sales,
    total_sales,
    promo_sales / NULLIF(total_sales, 0) AS promo_sales_ratio
FROM (
    SELECT
        s_store_sk,
        s_store_name,
        year_month,
        monthly_net_profit,
        promo_sales,
        total_sales,
        AVG(monthly_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_sk ORDER BY year_month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3_months
    FROM monthly_store_profit
) t
ORDER BY s_store_sk, year_month

WITH agg_customer_store AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_sk,
        s.s_store_name,
        c.c_customer_id,
        CONCAT(c.c_first_name, ' ', c.c_last_name) AS customer_name,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_promo_id) AS distinct_promo_used
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    GROUP BY s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_name, c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name
)
SELECT
    s_store_sk,
    s_store_name,
    c_customer_id,
    customer_name,
    total_net_profit,
    total_discount,
    transaction_count,
    distinct_promo_used,
    profit_rank,
    profit_category
FROM (
    SELECT
        s_store_sk,
        s_store_name,
        c_customer_id,
        customer_name,
        total_net_profit,
        total_discount,
        transaction_count,
        distinct_promo_used,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_sk ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
        CASE WHEN total_net_profit > 10000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Normal' END AS profit_category
    FROM agg_customer_store
) t
WHERE profit_rank <= 5
ORDER BY s_store_sk, profit_rank

WITH promo_agg AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_promo_name,
        p.p_discount_active,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_store_id) AS distinct_stores
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y'
    GROUP BY p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_discount_active
)
SELECT
    p_promo_id,
    p_promo_name,
    p_discount_active,
    total_sales,
    total_profit,
    avg_discount,
    distinct_customers,
    distinct_stores,
    sales_rank,
    discount_category
FROM (
    SELECT
        p_promo_id,
        p_promo_name,
        p_discount_active,
        total_sales,
        total_profit,
        avg_discount,
        distinct_customers,
        distinct_stores,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
        CASE WHEN avg_discount > 5 THEN 'High Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category
    FROM promo_agg
) t
WHERE sales_rank <= 10
ORDER BY sales_rank

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        CONCAT(c.c_first_name, ' ', c.c_last_name) AS full_name,
        c.c_birth_year,
        c.c_birth_month,
        CASE 
            WHEN c.c_birth_year < 1960 THEN 'Pre-1960'
            WHEN c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1960 AND 1979 THEN '1960s-70s'
            WHEN c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1980 AND 1999 THEN '80s-90s'
            ELSE '2000s+'
        END AS birth_decade_group,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_spent,
        AVG(ss.ss_net_paid) AS avg_net_paid,
        COUNT(*) AS purchase_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN ss.ss_ext_discount_amt ELSE 0 END) AS total_discount_active_promo,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_store_id) AS distinct_store_count
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    LEFT JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_birth_year,
        c.c_birth_month,
        CASE 
            WHEN c.c_birth_year < 1960 THEN 'Pre-1960'
            WHEN c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1960 AND 1979 THEN '1960s-70s'
            WHEN c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1980 AND 1999 THEN '80s-90s'
            ELSE '2000s+'
        END
)
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    full_name,
    c_birth_year,
    c_birth_month,
    birth_decade_group,
    total_spent,
    avg_net_paid,
    purchase_count,
    total_discount_active_promo,
    distinct_store_count,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY birth_decade_group ORDER BY total_spent DESC) AS spend_rank_in_group,
    CASE 
        WHEN total_spent > 5000 THEN 'VIP'
        WHEN total_spent > 1000 THEN 'Gold'
        ELSE 'Regular'
    END AS customer_tier
FROM customer_spend
WHERE purchase_count >= 5
ORDER BY birth_decade_group, spend_rank_in_group

WITH combined AS ( SELECT sp.item_sk, sp.sales_profit, COALESCE(rli.return_loss,0) AS total_return_loss, sp.sales_profit - COALESCE(rli.return_loss,0) AS net_profit, (sp.sales_profit - COALESCE(rli.return_loss,0)) / NULLIF(sp.sales_amount,0) AS net_profit_margin, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (sp.sales_profit - COALESCE(rli.return_loss,0)) DESC) AS profit_rank, rli.reason_desc, CASE WHEN rli.reason_desc IS NULL THEN 'No Return' WHEN LOWER(rli.reason_desc) LIKE '%defect%' THEN 'Defective' WHEN LOWER(rli.reason_desc) LIKE '%late%' THEN 'Late' ELSE 'Other' END AS reason_category FROM ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS sales_profit, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS sales_amount FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk ) sp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cr.cr_item_sk AS item_sk, r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS return_loss FROM catalog_returns cr LEFT JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk, r.r_reason_desc ) rli ON sp.item_sk = rli.item_sk ) SELECT combined.item_sk, combined.net_profit, combined.net_profit_margin, combined.profit_rank, combined.reason_desc, combined.reason_category FROM combined WHERE combined.profit_rank <= 5 ORDER BY combined.profit_rank

WITH sales_daily AS ( SELECT cs.cs_promo_sk, d.d_date, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS daily_sales, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS daily_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_promo_sk, d.d_date ), returns_daily_total AS ( SELECT cs.cs_promo_sk, d.d_date, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS daily_return_loss FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_promo_sk, d.d_date ), returns_daily_reason AS ( SELECT cs.cs_promo_sk, d.d_date, r.r_reason_desc, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS return_loss FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_promo_sk, d.d_date, r.r_reason_desc ) SELECT s.cs_promo_sk, s.d_date, s.daily_sales, COALESCE(rt.daily_return_loss,0) AS daily_return_loss, s.daily_sales - COALESCE(rt.daily_return_loss,0) AS net_daily_sales, LAG(s.daily_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY s.cs_promo_sk ORDER BY s.d_date) AS prev_day_sales, LEAD(s.daily_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY s.cs_promo_sk ORDER BY s.d_date) AS next_day_sales, CASE WHEN LAG(s.daily_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY s.cs_promo_sk ORDER BY s.d_date) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (s.daily_sales - LAG(s.daily_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY s.cs_promo_sk ORDER BY s.d_date)) / NULLIF(LAG(s.daily_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY s.cs_promo_sk ORDER BY s.d_date),0) * 100 END AS pct_change_from_prev, CASE WHEN LEAD(s.daily_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY s.cs_promo_sk ORDER BY s.d_date) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (LEAD(s.daily_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY s.cs_promo_sk ORDER BY s.d_date) - s.daily_sales) / NULLIF(s.daily_sales,0) * 100 END AS pct_change_to_next, COALESCE(rr.return_cnt,0) AS return_count, COALESCE(rr.return_loss,0) AS return_loss_by_reason, rr.r_reason_desc AS return_reason, CASE WHEN rr.r_reason_desc IS NULL THEN 'No Return' WHEN LOWER(rr.r_reason_desc) LIKE '%defect%' THEN 'Defective' WHEN LOWER(rr.r_reason_desc) LIKE '%late%' THEN 'Late' ELSE 'Other' END AS return_reason_category FROM sales_daily s LEFT JOIN returns_daily_total rt ON s.cs_promo_sk = rt.cs_promo_sk AND s.d_date = rt.d_date LEFT JOIN returns_daily_reason rr ON s.cs_promo_sk = rr.cs_promo_sk AND s.d_date = rr.d_date WHERE s.daily_sales > 0 ORDER BY s.cs_promo_sk, s.d_date LIMIT 200

WITH sales_month AS (
   SELECT 
      mod(cast(ss.ss_sold_date_sk / 100 as integer), 100) AS month,
      ss.ss_net_profit AS net_profit,
      ss.ss_quantity AS qty
   FROM store_sales ss
   UNION ALL
   SELECT 
      mod(cast(ws.ws_sold_date_sk / 100 as integer), 100) AS month,
      ws.ws_net_profit AS net_profit,
      ws.ws_quantity AS qty
   FROM web_sales ws
),
monthly_stats AS (
   SELECT
      month,
      AVG(net_profit) AS avg_monthly_profit,
      SUM(net_profit) AS total_monthly_profit,
      SUM(qty) AS total_qty,
      COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt
   FROM sales_month
   GROUP BY month
),
ranked_months AS (
   SELECT
      month,
      avg_monthly_profit,
      total_qty,
      RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_qty DESC) AS qty_rank
   FROM monthly_stats
),
top_months AS (
   SELECT month, avg_monthly_profit, total_qty
   FROM ranked_months
   WHERE qty_rank = 1
)
SELECT

   c.c_birth_month,

ranked_months AS (

),

   FROM monthly_stats

WITH demo_item_agg AS (SELECT hd.hd_income_band_sk, i.i_category, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, AVG(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_quantity, AVG(s.s_floor_space) AS avg_floor_space FROM store_returns sr JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk GROUP BY hd.hd_income_band_sk, i.i_category) SELECT di.hd_income_band_sk, di.i_category, di.total_return_amount, di.total_net_loss, di.avg_return_quantity, di.avg_floor_space, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY di.hd_income_band_sk ORDER BY di.total_return_amount DESC) AS category_rank_within_income_band, AVG(di.total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY di.i_category ORDER BY di.hd_income_band_sk ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_return_amount_by_income_band, CASE WHEN di.total_return_amount > 50000 THEN 'High' WHEN di.total_return_amount > 20000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_amount_category FROM demo_item_agg di ORDER BY di.hd_income_band_sk, category_rank_within_income_band LIMIT 30

WITH class_agg AS (SELECT i.i_class, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, AVG(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_quantity, AVG(s.s_floor_space) AS avg_store_floor_space, AVG(CASE WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = 'HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_buy_potential_ratio FROM store_returns sr JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY i.i_class) SELECT ca.i_class, ca.total_return_amount, ca.total_net_loss, ca.avg_return_quantity, ca.avg_store_floor_space, ca.high_buy_potential_ratio, CASE WHEN ca.total_return_amount > 200000 THEN 'Very High' WHEN ca.total_return_amount > 100000 THEN 'High' WHEN ca.total_return_amount > 50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_amount_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_return_amount DESC) AS class_return_rank, SUM(ca.total_return_amount) OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_return_amount DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return_amount FROM class_agg ca ORDER BY ca.total_return_amount DESC LIMIT 15

WITH store_item_category AS (SELECT sr.sr_store_sk, i.i_category, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS category_return_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_store_sk ORDER BY SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) DESC) AS rn_category FROM store_returns sr JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk, i.i_category), store_agg AS (SELECT sr.sr_store_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state, s.s_floor_space, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, AVG(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_item_sk) AS distinct_items_returned, AVG(CASE WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = 'HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_buy_potential_ratio FROM store_returns sr JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state, s.s_floor_space) SELECT sa.s_store_name, sa.s_city, sa.s_state, sa.total_return_amount, sa.total_net_loss, sa.avg_return_quantity, sa.distinct_items_returned, sa.high_buy_potential_ratio, sic.i_category AS top_return_category, sic.category_return_qty AS top_category_return_qty, CASE WHEN sa.s_floor_space > 50000 THEN 'Large' WHEN sa.s_floor_space > 20000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Small' END AS store_size_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.total_return_amount DESC) AS store_return_rank FROM store_agg sa LEFT JOIN store_item_category sic ON sa.sr_store_sk = sic.sr_store_sk AND sic.rn_category = 1 ORDER BY store_return_rank LIMIT 20

WITH cust_base AS (SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_item_sk) AS distinct_item_count, AVG(CASE WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = 'HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_buy_potential_ratio FROM store_returns sr JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_customer_sk), cust_item_rank AS (SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS item_return_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_customer_sk ORDER BY SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) DESC) AS rn_item FROM store_returns sr JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_customer_sk, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name), cust_store_rank AS (SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS store_return_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_customer_sk ORDER BY SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) DESC) AS rn_store FROM store_returns sr JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_customer_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state), cust_ranked AS (SELECT cb.sr_customer_sk, cb.total_net_loss, cb.total_return_amount, cb.distinct_item_count, cb.high_buy_potential_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cb.total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank FROM cust_base cb) SELECT cr.sr_customer_sk, cr.total_net_loss, cr.total_return_amount, cr.distinct_item_count, cr.high_buy_potential_ratio, cr.net_loss_rank, ci.i_item_id AS top_item_id, ci.i_product_name AS top_item_name, ci.item_return_qty AS top_item_return_qty, cs.s_store_name AS top_store_name, cs.s_city AS top_store_city, cs.s_state AS top_store_state, cs.store_return_qty AS top_store_return_qty, CASE WHEN cr.total_net_loss > 50000 THEN 'Very High' WHEN cr.total_net_loss > 20000 THEN 'High' WHEN cr.total_net_loss > 10000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS net_loss_category FROM cust_ranked cr LEFT JOIN cust_item_rank ci ON cr.sr_customer_sk = ci.sr_customer_sk AND ci.rn_item = 1 LEFT JOIN cust_store_rank cs ON cr.sr_customer_sk = cs.sr_customer_sk AND cs.rn_store = 1 WHERE cr.net_loss_rank <= 10 ORDER BY cr.net_loss_rank

WITH quarterly_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk, d.d_quarter_name, d.d_year, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS profit, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS qty_sold, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, d.d_quarter_name, d.d_year ), quarterly_inventory AS ( SELECT i.inv_item_sk AS item_sk, d.d_quarter_name, d.d_year, SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS inventory_qty FROM inventory i JOIN date_dim d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY i.inv_item_sk, d.d_quarter_name, d.d_year ), website_tax_quarter AS ( SELECT d.d_quarter_name, d.d_year, AVG(ws.web_tax_percentage) AS avg_tax_pct FROM web_site ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_quarter_name, d.d_year ) SELECT qs.d_year, qs.d_quarter_name, qs.item_sk, qs.profit, qs.qty_sold, qs.sales_amount, COALESCE(qi.inventory_qty, 0) AS inventory_qty, COALESCE(wt.avg_tax_pct, 0) AS avg_tax_pct, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY qs.d_year, qs.d_quarter_name ORDER BY qs.profit DESC) AS profit_dense_rank, LAG(qs.profit) OVER (PARTITION BY qs.item_sk ORDER BY qs.d_year, qs.d_quarter_name) AS profit_prev_quarter, CASE WHEN LAG(qs.profit) OVER (PARTITION BY qs.item_sk ORDER BY qs.d_year, qs.d_quarter_name) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE qs.profit - LAG(qs.profit) OVER (PARTITION BY qs.item_sk ORDER BY qs.d_year, qs.d_quarter_name) END AS profit_change_from_prev_quarter FROM quarterly_sales qs LEFT JOIN quarterly_inventory qi ON qs.item_sk = qi.item_sk AND qs.d_year = qi.d_year AND qs.d_quarter_name = qi.d_quarter_name LEFT JOIN website_tax_quarter wt ON qs.d_year = wt.d_year AND qs.d_quarter_name = wt.d_quarter_name WHERE qs.profit > 0 ORDER BY qs.d_year, qs.d_quarter_name, profit_dense_rank LIMIT 200

WITH customer_year_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, d.d_year, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS yearly_profit, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS yearly_sales FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, d.d_year ), inventory_summary AS ( SELECT d.d_year, SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty FROM inventory i JOIN date_dim d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_year ), website_by_year AS ( SELECT ws.web_site_sk, ws.web_name, ws.web_state, d_open.d_year AS open_year FROM web_site ws JOIN date_dim d_open ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk ) SELECT cys.cs_bill_customer_sk, cys.d_year, cys.yearly_profit, cys.total_quantity, cys.yearly_sales, COALESCE(isum.total_inventory_qty, 0) AS total_inventory_qty, wbw.web_name, wbw.web_state, CASE WHEN cys.yearly_profit >= 20000 THEN 'A' WHEN cys.yearly_profit >= 10000 THEN 'B' WHEN cys.yearly_profit >= 5000 THEN 'C' ELSE 'D' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cys.d_year ORDER BY cys.yearly_profit DESC) AS profit_rank, SUM(cys.yearly_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cys.cs_bill_customer_sk ORDER BY cys.d_year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit FROM customer_year_sales cys LEFT JOIN inventory_summary isum ON cys.d_year = isum.d_year LEFT JOIN website_by_year wbw ON cys.d_year = wbw.open_year ORDER BY cys.d_year, profit_rank LIMIT 50

WITH sales_monthly AS ( SELECT d.d_year, d.d_moy, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(CASE WHEN cs.cs_promo_sk IS NOT NULL THEN cs.cs_net_paid ELSE 0 END) AS promo_net_paid, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_moy ), website_monthly AS ( SELECT d.d_year, d.d_moy, ws.web_state, AVG(ws.web_tax_percentage) AS avg_tax_pct FROM web_site ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_moy, ws.web_state ), inventory_monthly AS ( SELECT d.d_year, d.d_moy, AVG(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory_qty FROM inventory i JOIN date_dim d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_moy ) SELECT sm.d_year, sm.d_moy, wm.web_state, sm.total_net_paid, sm.promo_net_paid, CASE WHEN sm.total_net_paid = 0 THEN 0 ELSE sm.promo_net_paid / sm.total_net_paid END AS promo_ratio, wm.avg_tax_pct, im.avg_inventory_qty, sm.total_net_paid - LAG(sm.total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY sm.d_year ORDER BY sm.d_moy) AS mom_growth, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.d_year ORDER BY sm.total_net_paid DESC) AS sales_rank FROM sales_monthly sm LEFT JOIN website_monthly wm ON sm.d_year = wm.d_year AND sm.d_moy = wm.d_moy LEFT JOIN inventory_monthly im ON sm.d_year = im.d_year AND sm.d_moy = im.d_moy ORDER BY sm.d_year, sm.d_moy, sales_rank LIMIT 100

WITH ship_date_stats AS ( SELECT d.d_date AS ship_date, d.d_year, d.d_moy, d.d_day_name, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, AVG(cs.cs_coupon_amt) AS avg_coupon, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date, d.d_year, d.d_moy, d.d_day_name ), inventory_on_ship AS ( SELECT d.d_date, SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty, AVG(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory_qty FROM inventory i JOIN date_dim d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date ), website_dates AS ( SELECT ws.web_site_sk, open_d.d_date AS open_date, close_d.d_date AS close_date, ws.web_tax_percentage FROM web_site ws JOIN date_dim open_d ON ws.web_open_date_sk = open_d.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim close_d ON ws.web_close_date_sk = close_d.d_date_sk ), website_tax_on_ship AS ( SELECT sds.ship_date, AVG(wd.web_tax_percentage) AS avg_tax_pct FROM ship_date_stats sds LEFT JOIN website_dates wd ON sds.ship_date BETWEEN wd.open_date AND wd.close_date GROUP BY sds.ship_date ) SELECT sds.ship_date, sds.d_year, sds.d_moy, sds.d_day_name, sds.total_orders, sds.avg_discount, CASE WHEN sds.avg_discount >= 20 THEN 'VERY HIGH' WHEN sds.avg_discount >= 10 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN sds.avg_discount >= 5 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS discount_category, COALESCE(ios.total_inventory_qty, 0) AS total_inventory_qty, COALESCE(ios.avg_inventory_qty, 0) AS avg_inventory_qty, COALESCE(wts.avg_tax_pct, 0) AS avg_tax_pct, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sds.avg_discount DESC) AS discount_rank FROM ship_date_stats sds LEFT JOIN inventory_on_ship ios ON sds.ship_date = ios.d_date LEFT JOIN website_tax_on_ship wts ON sds.ship_date = wts.ship_date WHERE sds.total_orders >= 10 ORDER BY discount_rank LIMIT 10

WITH store_profit_by_hour AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        td.t_hour,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
        CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 0
             THEN SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) / SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price)
             ELSE 0 END AS discount_rate
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, td.t_hour
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) > 0
)
SELECT
    spb.ss_store_sk,
    spb.t_hour,
    spb.total_net_profit,
    spb.total_sales,
    spb.total_discount,
    spb.discount_rate,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY spb.t_hour ORDER BY spb.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_per_hour
FROM store_profit_by_hour spb
ORDER BY spb.t_hour, profit_rank_per_hour

WITH returns_by_page_meal AS (
    SELECT
        wp.wp_type,
        td.t_meal_time,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        AVG(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_qty
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN time_dim td ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    GROUP BY wp.wp_type, td.t_meal_time
    HAVING SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) > 0
)
SELECT
    rwp.wp_type,
    rwp.t_meal_time,
    rwp.total_return_amount,
    rwp.total_net_loss,
    rwp.avg_return_qty,
    CASE 
        WHEN rwp.total_net_loss > 1000 THEN 'HIGH_LOSS'
        WHEN rwp.total_net_loss BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 THEN 'MEDIUM_LOSS'
        ELSE 'LOW_LOSS'
    END AS loss_category,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rwp.wp_type ORDER BY rwp.total_return_amount DESC) AS return_amount_rank
FROM returns_by_page_meal rwp
ORDER BY rwp.wp_type, return_amount_rank

WITH page_returns AS (
    SELECT
        wp.wp_web_page_id,
        wp.wp_url,
        wp.wp_type,
        wp.wp_char_count,
        wp.wp_image_count,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS return_transactions
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    WHERE td.t_am_pm = 'PM'
    GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_url, wp.wp_type, wp.wp_char_count, wp.wp_image_count
    HAVING SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) > 0
)
SELECT
    pr.wp_web_page_id,
    pr.wp_url,
    pr.wp_type,
    pr.wp_char_count,
    pr.wp_image_count,
    pr.total_return_amount,
    pr.return_transactions,
    CASE 
        WHEN pr.wp_type = 'PRODUCT' THEN 'PRODUCT_PAGE'
        WHEN pr.wp_type = 'CATEGORY' THEN 'CATEGORY_PAGE'
        ELSE 'OTHER_PAGE'
    END AS page_category,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pr.total_return_amount DESC) AS return_amount_percentile
FROM page_returns pr
ORDER BY pr.total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH sales AS (
    SELECT
        td.t_hour,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY td.t_hour
),
returns AS (
    SELECT
        td.t_hour,
        wp.wp_type,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_returns,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN time_dim td ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    GROUP BY td.t_hour, wp.wp_type
)
SELECT
    s.t_hour,
    r.wp_type,
    s.total_sales,
    r.total_returns,
    s.total_profit,
    r.total_loss,
    (s.total_sales - r.total_returns) AS net_sales,
    (s.total_profit - r.total_loss) AS net_profit,
    CASE WHEN (s.total_profit - r.total_loss) > 0 THEN 'PROFITABLE' ELSE 'LOSS' END AS profit_status,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.t_hour ORDER BY (s.total_profit - r.total_loss) DESC) AS page_profit_rank
FROM sales s
JOIN returns r ON s.t_hour = r.t_hour
ORDER BY s.t_hour, page_profit_rank

WITH catalog_cust AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) FILTER (WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 0) AS avg_catalog_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i.i_brand) AS catalog_brands,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk
    HAVING SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) > 10
),
web_cust AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        AVG(wr.wr_return_amt) FILTER (WHERE wr.wr_return_amt > 0) AS avg_web_return_amount,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i.i_brand) AS web_brands,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk
    HAVING SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) > 10
),
combined_cust AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(c.customer_sk, w.customer_sk) AS customer_sk,
        COALESCE(c.avg_catalog_return_amount, 0) + COALESCE(w.avg_web_return_amount, 0) AS total_avg_return_amount,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_cnt, 0) AS total_return_cnt,
        COALESCE(c.total_return_qty, 0) + COALESCE(w.total_return_qty, 0) AS total_return_quantity,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 3500 THEN 'High Loss'
            ELSE 'Low/Medium Loss'
        END AS loss_category,
        ARRAY_JOIN(COALESCE(c.catalog_brands, ARRAY[]), ', ') AS catalog_brands_str,
        ARRAY_JOIN(COALESCE(w.web_brands, ARRAY[]), ', ') AS web_brands_str,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss,0)+COALESCE(w.web_net_loss,0) DESC) AS loss_quartile
    FROM catalog_cust c
    FULL OUTER JOIN web_cust w ON c.customer_sk = w.customer_sk
)
SELECT
    customer_sk,
    total_avg_return_amount,
    total_net_loss,
    total_return_cnt,
    total_return_quantity,
    loss_category,
    loss_quartile,
    catalog_brands_str,
    web_brands_str,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY loss_quartile) AS customers_in_quartile,
    AVG(total_return_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY loss_category) AS avg_qty_per_category
FROM combined_cust
WHERE loss_quartile IN (1,2)
ORDER BY loss_quartile, total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 40

WITH store_daily AS ( SELECT d.d_date, d.d_day_name, d.d_weekend, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_profit FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date, d.d_day_name, d.d_weekend ), web_daily AS ( SELECT d.d_date, d.d_day_name, d.d_weekend, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_profit FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date, d.d_day_name, d.d_weekend ), inventory_daily AS ( SELECT d.d_date, SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty FROM inventory i JOIN date_dim d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date ), daily_combined AS ( SELECT COALESCE(s.d_date, w.d_date) AS d_date, COALESCE(s.d_day_name, w.d_day_name) AS d_day_name, COALESCE(s.d_weekend, w.d_weekend) AS d_weekend, COALESCE(s.store_profit, 0) AS store_profit, COALESCE(w.web_profit, 0) AS web_profit, COALESCE(s.store_profit, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_profit, 0) AS total_net_profit FROM store_daily s FULL OUTER JOIN web_daily w ON s.d_date = w.d_date ), daily_with_inventory AS ( SELECT dc.d_date, dc.d_day_name, dc.d_weekend, dc.store_profit, dc.web_profit, dc.total_net_profit, COALESCE(id.total_inventory_qty, 0) AS total_inventory_qty FROM daily_combined dc LEFT JOIN inventory_daily id ON dc.d_date = id.d_date ) SELECT dwi.d_date, dwi.d_day_name, CASE WHEN dwi.d_weekend = 'Y' THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type, dwi.store_profit, dwi.web_profit, dwi.total_net_profit, dwi.total_inventory_qty, AVG(dwi.total_net_profit) OVER (ORDER BY dwi.d_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_7d, SUM(dwi.total_net_profit) OVER (ORDER BY dwi.d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY dwi.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM daily_with_inventory dwi WHERE dwi.total_net_profit IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dwi.d_date LIMIT 100

WITH store_quarter AS ( SELECT 'store' AS location_type, ss.ss_store_sk AS location_id, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq, d.d_current_quarter, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS profit FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq, d.d_current_quarter ), warehouse_quarter AS ( SELECT 'warehouse' AS location_type, ws.ws_warehouse_sk AS location_id, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq, d.d_current_quarter, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS profit FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY ws.ws_warehouse_sk, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq, d.d_current_quarter ), inventory_quarter AS ( SELECT 'warehouse' AS location_type, i.inv_warehouse_sk AS location_id, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq, d.d_current_quarter, AVG(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory_qty FROM inventory i JOIN date_dim d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY i.inv_warehouse_sk, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq, d.d_current_quarter ), combined_quarter AS ( SELECT location_type, location_id, d_year, d_quarter_seq, d_current_quarter, profit, CAST(NULL AS double) AS avg_inventory_qty FROM store_quarter UNION ALL SELECT location_type, location_id, d_year, d_quarter_seq, d_current_quarter, profit, CAST(NULL AS double) AS avg_inventory_qty FROM warehouse_quarter UNION ALL SELECT location_type, location_id, d_year, d_quarter_seq, d_current_quarter, 0.0 AS profit, avg_inventory_qty FROM inventory_quarter ), aggregated_quarter AS ( SELECT location_type, location_id, d_year, d_quarter_seq, d_current_quarter, SUM(profit) AS total_profit, MAX(avg_inventory_qty) AS avg_inventory_qty FROM combined_quarter GROUP BY location_type, location_id, d_year, d_quarter_seq, d_current_quarter ) SELECT aq.location_type, aq.location_id, aq.d_year, aq.d_quarter_seq, aq.d_current_quarter, aq.total_profit, aq.avg_inventory_qty, SUM(aq.total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY aq.location_type, aq.location_id ORDER BY aq.d_year, aq.d_quarter_seq ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit, CASE WHEN aq.total_profit >= 50000 THEN 'Target Met' ELSE 'Target Missed' END AS target_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY aq.d_year, aq.d_quarter_seq ORDER BY aq.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM aggregated_quarter aq ORDER BY aq.d_year, aq.d_quarter_seq, profit_rank LIMIT 100

WITH store_weekly AS ( SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk, d.d_year, d.d_week_seq, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS store_qty FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, d.d_year, d.d_week_seq ), web_weekly AS ( SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk, d.d_year, d.d_week_seq, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS web_qty FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, d.d_year, d.d_week_seq ), weekly_sales AS ( SELECT COALESCE(s.item_sk, w.item_sk) AS item_sk, COALESCE(s.d_year, w.d_year) AS d_year, COALESCE(s.d_week_seq, w.d_week_seq) AS d_week_seq, COALESCE(s.store_qty, 0) AS store_qty, COALESCE(w.web_qty, 0) AS web_qty, COALESCE(s.store_qty, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_qty, 0) AS total_qty_sold FROM store_weekly s FULL OUTER JOIN web_weekly w ON s.item_sk = w.item_sk AND s.d_year = w.d_year AND s.d_week_seq = w.d_week_seq ), weekly_inventory AS ( SELECT i.inv_item_sk AS item_sk, d.d_year, d.d_week_seq, AVG(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_on_hand FROM inventory i JOIN date_dim d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY i.inv_item_sk, d.d_year, d.d_week_seq ) SELECT ws.d_year, ws.d_week_seq, ws.item_sk, ws.store_qty, ws.web_qty, ws.total_qty_sold, inv.avg_on_hand, CASE WHEN inv.avg_on_hand = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ws.total_qty_sold / inv.avg_on_hand END AS turnover_ratio, CASE WHEN inv.avg_on_hand = 0 THEN 'No Inventory' WHEN (ws.total_qty_sold / inv.avg_on_hand) > 5 THEN 'High Turnover' ELSE 'Normal Turnover' END AS turnover_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN inv.avg_on_hand = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ws.total_qty_sold / inv.avg_on_hand END DESC) AS turnover_rank FROM weekly_sales ws LEFT JOIN weekly_inventory inv ON ws.item_sk = inv.item_sk AND ws.d_year = inv.d_year AND ws.d_week_seq = inv.d_week_seq WHERE inv.avg_on_hand IS NOT NULL ORDER BY turnover_rank LIMIT 10

SELECT return_hour, total_return_loss, total_returns, loss_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_loss DESC) AS loss_rank, SUM(total_return_loss) OVER (ORDER BY return_hour ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_loss_by_hour FROM ( SELECT t.t_hour AS return_hour, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_ticket_number) AS total_returns, CASE WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 10000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 1000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS loss_category FROM store_returns sr JOIN time_dim t ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY t.t_hour ) sub ORDER BY loss_rank LIMIT 10

SELECT sm.sm_type AS ship_mode, t.t_hour AS hour_of_day, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) / SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) * 100, 2) END AS profit_margin_pct, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.sm_type ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank_in_mode FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY sm.sm_type, t.t_hour HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 0 ORDER BY ship_mode, profit_rank_in_mode LIMIT 20

WITH sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_sold_time_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_sales_quantity FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_sold_time_sk ), returns AS ( SELECT sr.sr_item_sk, sr.sr_return_time_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity FROM store_returns sr GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk, sr.sr_return_time_sk ) SELECT s.cs_item_sk AS item_sk, t.t_hour AS hour_of_day, s.total_sales_net_paid, r.total_return_amt, (s.total_sales_net_paid - COALESCE(r.total_return_amt, 0)) AS net_revenue, CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.total_return_amt, 0) = 0 THEN 'NO_RETURNS' WHEN r.total_return_amt / s.total_sales_net_paid > 0.5 THEN 'HIGH_RETURN_RATE' ELSE 'LOW_RETURN_RATE' END AS return_rate_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (s.total_sales_net_paid - COALESCE(r.total_return_amt, 0)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM sales s LEFT JOIN returns r ON s.cs_item_sk = r.sr_item_sk AND s.cs_sold_time_sk = r.sr_return_time_sk JOIN time_dim t ON s.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk WHERE s.total_sales_net_paid > 0 ORDER BY revenue_rank LIMIT 15

WITH store_metrics AS ( SELECT s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_city AS store_city, s.s_state AS store_state, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.ca_city) AS distinct_customer_cities, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, AVG(sr.sr_return_tax) AS avg_return_tax, AVG(i.i_wholesale_cost) AS avg_item_wholesale_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT i.i_brand) AS distinct_brands_returned FROM store_returns sr JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state ) SELECT s_store_sk, s_store_name, store_city, store_state, distinct_customer_cities, total_net_loss, total_return_amount, total_return_qty, avg_return_tax, avg_item_wholesale_cost, distinct_brands_returned, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_return_tax DESC) AS tax_density_rank FROM store_metrics ORDER BY net_loss_rank LIMIT 10

WITH item_metrics AS ( SELECT i.i_item_sk, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_current_price, i.i_class, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amt, AVG(sr.sr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_store_sk) AS distinct_stores, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.ca_city) AS distinct_customer_cities FROM store_returns sr JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk LEFT JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_current_price, i.i_class ) SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id, i_product_name, i_class, total_return_qty, total_return_amt, CASE WHEN i_current_price = 0 THEN 0 ELSE total_return_amt / (i_current_price * total_return_qty) END AS return_ratio, CASE WHEN total_return_qty >= 1000 THEN 'High Volume' WHEN total_return_qty >= 500 THEN 'Medium Volume' ELSE 'Low Volume' END AS volume_category, avg_net_loss, distinct_stores, distinct_customer_cities, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN total_return_qty >= 1000 THEN 'High Volume' WHEN total_return_qty >= 500 THEN 'Medium Volume' ELSE 'Low Volume' END ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC) AS volume_category_rank FROM item_metrics ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC LIMIT 25

WITH si_returns AS ( SELECT s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_city AS store_city, i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name, i.i_class, i.i_color, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_qty, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_amt, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, AVG(ca.ca_gmt_offset) AS avg_customer_gmt_offset, SUM(sr.sr_store_credit) AS total_store_credit, SUM(sr.sr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash FROM store_returns sr JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name, i.i_class, i.i_color ) SELECT s_store_sk, s_store_name, store_city, i_item_sk, i_product_name, i_class, i_color, total_qty, total_amt, total_net_loss, CASE WHEN total_qty = 0 THEN 0 ELSE total_net_loss / total_qty END AS net_loss_per_unit, avg_customer_gmt_offset, total_store_credit, total_refunded_cash, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_sk ORDER BY CASE WHEN total_qty = 0 THEN 0 ELSE total_net_loss / total_qty END DESC) AS store_item_net_loss_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amt DESC) AS overall_return_amount_rank FROM si_returns WHERE total_qty > 0 ORDER BY s_store_sk, store_item_net_loss_rank LIMIT 30

WITH city_item AS ( SELECT ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, i.i_class, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS qty, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS amt, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS net_loss FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, i.i_class ), city_stats AS ( SELECT ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_qty, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_amt, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(sr.sr_store_credit) AS total_store_credit, SUM(sr.sr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_store_sk) AS distinct_stores, COUNT(DISTINCT i.i_brand) AS distinct_brands FROM store_returns sr JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state ), city_top_class AS ( SELECT ca_city, ca_state, i_class, qty, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_city, ca_state ORDER BY qty DESC) AS class_rank FROM city_item ) SELECT cs.ca_city, cs.ca_state, cs.total_qty, cs.total_amt, cs.total_net_loss, CASE WHEN cs.total_net_loss < 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS net_loss_category, cs.total_store_credit / NULLIF(cs.total_return_amount,0) AS credit_ratio, cs.total_refunded_cash / NULLIF(cs.total_return_amount,0) AS cash_ratio, tc.i_class AS top_item_class, tc.qty AS top_class_qty, cs.distinct_stores, cs.distinct_brands, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_qty DESC) AS city_return_rank FROM city_stats cs LEFT JOIN city_top_class tc ON cs.ca_city = tc.ca_city AND cs.ca_state = tc.ca_state AND tc.class_rank = 1 ORDER BY city_return_rank LIMIT 20

WITH ship_date_stats AS ( SELECT d.d_date AS ship_date, d.d_year, d.d_moy, d.d_day_name, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, AVG(cs.cs_coupon_amt) AS avg_coupon, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date, d.d_year, d.d_moy, d.d_day_name ), inventory_on_ship AS ( SELECT d.d_date, SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty, AVG(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory_qty FROM inventory i JOIN date_dim d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date ), website_dates AS ( SELECT ws.web_site_sk, open_d.d_date AS open_date, close_d.d_date AS close_date, ws.web_tax_percentage FROM web_site ws JOIN date_dim open_d ON ws.web_open_date_sk = open_d.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim close_d ON ws.web_close_date_sk = close_d.d_date_sk ), website_tax_on_ship AS ( SELECT sds.ship_date, AVG(wd.web_tax_percentage) AS avg_tax_pct FROM ship_date_stats sds LEFT JOIN website_dates wd ON sds.ship_date BETWEEN wd.open_date AND wd.close_date GROUP BY sds.ship_date ) SELECT sds.ship_date, sds.d_year, sds.d_moy, sds.d_day_name, sds.total_orders, sds.avg_discount, sds.total_discount, sds.total_quantity, sds.total_net_paid, COALESCE(ios.total_inventory_qty, 0) AS total_inventory_qty, COALESCE(ios.avg_inventory_qty, 0) AS avg_inventory_qty, COALESCE(wts.avg_tax_pct, 0) AS avg_tax_pct, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sds.d_year ORDER BY sds.total_net_paid DESC) AS net_paid_rank FROM ship_date_stats sds LEFT JOIN inventory_on_ship ios ON sds.ship_date = ios.d_date LEFT JOIN website_tax_on_ship wts ON sds.ship_date = wts.ship_date WHERE sds.d_moy = 12 GROUP BY sds.ship_date, sds.d_year, sds.d_moy, sds.d_day_name, sds.total_orders, sds.avg_discount, sds.total_discount, sds.total_quantity, sds.total_net_paid, ios.total_inventory_qty, ios.avg_inventory_qty, wts.avg_tax_pct ORDER BY net_paid_rank LIMIT 15

WITH page_stats AS ( SELECT wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_url, wp.wp_type, c.c_customer_id AS page_owner_id, cd.cd_gender AS owner_gender, cd.cd_marital_status AS owner_marital_status, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_revenue, SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers, SUM(wp.wp_image_count) AS total_images FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN customer c ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_url, wp.wp_type, c.c_customer_id, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status ) SELECT ps.wp_web_page_id, ps.wp_url, ps.wp_type, ps.page_owner_id, ps.owner_gender, ps.owner_marital_status, ps.total_revenue, ps.total_discount, ps.avg_discount, ps.distinct_customers, ps.total_images, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY ps.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_quartile, LAG(ps.total_revenue, 2) OVER (ORDER BY ps.total_revenue DESC) AS lag_two_revenue FROM page_stats ps WHERE ps.total_discount > 1000 ORDER BY ps.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 25

WITH page_stats AS ( SELECT wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_url, wp.wp_type, c.c_customer_id AS page_owner_id, cd.cd_gender AS owner_gender, cd.cd_marital_status AS owner_marital_status, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_revenue, SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers, SUM(wp.wp_image_count) AS total_images FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN customer c ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE wp.wp_type IN ('home','product') GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_url, wp.wp_type, c.c_customer_id, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk) >= 10 ) SELECT ps.wp_web_page_id, ps.wp_url, ps.wp_type, ps.page_owner_id, ps.owner_gender, ps.owner_marital_status, ps.total_revenue, ps.total_discount, ps.avg_discount, ps.distinct_customers, ps.total_images, CASE WHEN ps.wp_type = 'home' THEN 'Landing' WHEN ps.wp_type = 'product' THEN 'Product' ELSE 'Other' END AS page_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ps.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM page_stats ps ORDER BY ps.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 15

WITH returns_daily AS (
  SELECT d.d_date,
         SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss
  FROM date_dim d
  JOIN catalog_returns cr ON d.d_date_sk = cr.cr_returned_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2022-01-01' AND DATE '2022-12-31'
  GROUP BY d.d_date
),
sales_daily_site AS (
  SELECT d.d_date,
         w.web_name,
         SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit
  FROM date_dim d
  JOIN web_sales ws ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
  JOIN web_site w ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk
  WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2022-01-01' AND DATE '2022-12-31'
  GROUP BY d.d_date, w.web_name
),
combined AS (
  SELECT s.d_date,
         s.web_name,
         COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss,
         s.total_sales_profit
  FROM sales_daily_site s
  LEFT JOIN returns_daily r ON s.d_date = r.d_date
)
SELECT d_date,
       web_name,
