WITH household_profit AS ( SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_store_profit, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss FROM household_demographics hd JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY hd.hd_demo_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound ) SELECT hd_demo_sk, ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound, total_store_profit, total_return_loss, (total_store_profit - total_return_loss) AS net_combined_profit, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (total_store_profit - total_return_loss) DESC) AS profit_rank, CASE WHEN ib_lower_bound >= 100000 THEN 'High Income' WHEN ib_lower_bound >= 50000 THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS income_category FROM household_profit WHERE total_store_profit > 0 ORDER BY net_combined_profit DESC LIMIT 5

WITH household_risk AS ( SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_spent, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) / SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) END AS loss_ratio, hd.hd_vehicle_count FROM household_demographics hd JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY hd.hd_demo_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, hd.hd_vehicle_count HAVING SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) > 0 ) SELECT hd_demo_sk, ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound, total_spent, total_return_loss, loss_ratio, CASE WHEN loss_ratio > 0.5 THEN 'High Risk' WHEN loss_ratio > 0.2 THEN 'Medium Risk' ELSE 'Low Risk' END AS risk_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY loss_ratio DESC) AS loss_rank, AVG(hd_vehicle_count) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN loss_ratio > 0.5 THEN 'High Risk' WHEN loss_ratio > 0.2 THEN 'Medium Risk' ELSE 'Low Risk' END) AS avg_vehicle_per_risk FROM household_risk ORDER BY loss_rank LIMIT 10

WITH monthly_metrics AS ( SELECT ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, (ss.ss_sold_date_sk / 100) % 100 AS month, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_profit, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS return_loss FROM store_sales ss JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk AND ((wr.wr_returned_date_sk / 100) % 100) = ((ss.ss_sold_date_sk / 100) % 100) GROUP BY ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, (ss.ss_sold_date_sk / 100) % 100 ) SELECT ib_income_band_sk, ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound, month, store_profit, return_loss, (store_profit - COALESCE(return_loss, 0)) AS net_monthly_profit, SUM(store_profit - COALESCE(return_loss, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY ib_income_band_sk ORDER BY month ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_net_profit, LAG(store_profit - COALESCE(return_loss, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY ib_income_band_sk ORDER BY month) AS prior_month_net_profit, CASE WHEN LAG(store_profit - COALESCE(return_loss, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY ib_income_band_sk ORDER BY month) IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN (store_profit - COALESCE(return_loss, 0)) > LAG(store_profit - COALESCE(return_loss, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY ib_income_band_sk ORDER BY month) THEN 'Increase' ELSE 'Decrease' END AS net_profit_trend FROM monthly_metrics ORDER BY ib_income_band_sk, month

WITH city_income_sales AS (SELECT ca.ca_state, ca.ca_city, ib.ib_income_band_sk, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_state, ca.ca_city, ib.ib_income_band_sk) SELECT ca_state, ca_city, ib_income_band_sk, total_sales, avg_discount, distinct_customers, total_quantity, CASE WHEN avg_discount > 50 THEN 'High Discount' WHEN avg_discount > 20 THEN 'Medium Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS city_sales_rank_in_state FROM city_income_sales WHERE total_quantity > 0 ORDER BY ca_state, city_sales_rank_in_state LIMIT 20

WITH state_sales AS (SELECT ca.ca_state, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, AVG(ss.ss_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(ib.ib_lower_bound) AS avg_income_lower, AVG(ib.ib_upper_bound) AS avg_income_upper FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_state) SELECT ca_state, total_net_profit, avg_sales_price, total_quantity, CASE WHEN total_net_profit > 1000000 THEN 'High' WHEN total_net_profit > 500000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_state_rank FROM state_sales ORDER BY profit_state_rank LIMIT 10

WITH household_sales AS (SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_vehicle_count, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity, MIN(ca.ca_city) AS sample_city, MIN(ca.ca_state) AS sample_state FROM store_sales ss JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_vehicle_count, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound) SELECT hd_demo_sk, total_net_profit, total_quantity, hd_vehicle_count, CASE WHEN hd_vehicle_count > 0 THEN total_net_profit / hd_vehicle_count ELSE total_net_profit END AS profit_per_vehicle, CASE WHEN total_net_profit > 100000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN total_net_profit > 50000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN total_net_profit > 20000 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS profit_tier, sample_city, sample_state, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS household_rank FROM household_sales WHERE total_quantity > 0 ORDER BY household_rank LIMIT 15

WITH city_returns AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_city,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY ca.ca_state, ca.ca_city
)
SELECT
    ca_state,
    ca_city,
    total_net_loss,
    total_return_amount,
    return_cnt,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank,
    SUM(total_net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) /
    SUM(total_net_loss) OVER () AS cumulative_net_loss_pct,
    CASE
        WHEN total_net_loss > 10000 THEN 'HIGH_LOSS'
        WHEN total_net_loss BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'MEDIUM_LOSS'
        ELSE 'LOW_LOSS'
    END AS loss_category
FROM city_returns
ORDER BY net_loss_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH hourly_zip AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_zip,
        t.t_hour,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS net_loss_sum,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
        AVG(wr.wr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY ca.ca_zip, t.t_hour
)
SELECT
    ca_zip,
    t_hour,
    net_loss_sum,
    return_cnt,
    avg_net_loss,
    SUM(net_loss_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_zip ORDER BY t_hour
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_loss,
    AVG(net_loss_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_zip ORDER BY t_hour
        ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_net_loss_last_3_hours,
    CASE
        WHEN avg_net_loss > 2000 THEN 'ALERT'
        ELSE 'NORMAL'
    END AS risk_level
FROM hourly_zip
ORDER BY ca_zip, t_hour

WITH page_meal_stats AS (
    SELECT
        wp.wp_type,
        t.t_meal_time,
        t.t_hour,
        COUNT(*) AS ret_cnt,
        AVG(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS avg_return_inc_tax,
        AVG(wr.wr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_qty
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN time_dim t ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    GROUP BY wp.wp_type, t.t_meal_time, t.t_hour
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
)
SELECT
    wp_type,
    t_meal_time,
    ret_cnt,
    avg_return_inc_tax,
    avg_net_loss,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t_meal_time ORDER BY avg_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank_by_meal,
    SUM(total_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type ORDER BY t_hour
        ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_qty_last_3_hours,
    CASE
        WHEN avg_net_loss > 2000 THEN 'ALERT'
        ELSE 'NORMAL'
    END AS risk_flag
FROM page_meal_stats
ORDER BY wp_type, t_meal_time

WITH state_page_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_state,
        wp.wp_type,
        COUNT(*) AS total_returns,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        AVG(CASE WHEN wr.wr_fee > 0 THEN wr.wr_fee END) AS avg_positive_fee,
        SUM(CASE WHEN wr.wr_fee > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fee_positive_cnt,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        t.t_shift
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY ca.ca_state, wp.wp_type, t.t_shift
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
)
SELECT
    ca_state,
    wp_type,
    t_shift,
    total_returns,
    total_net_loss,
    avg_positive_fee,
    fee_positive_cnt,
    100.0 * fee_positive_cnt / total_returns AS pct_returns_with_fee,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_state_rank,
    SUM(total_net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) /
    SUM(total_net_loss) OVER () AS cumulative_net_loss_share,
    CASE
        WHEN total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'HIGH_RISK'
        WHEN total_net_loss BETWEEN 2000 AND 5000 THEN 'MEDIUM_RISK'
        ELSE 'LOW_RISK'
    END AS risk_category
FROM state_page_stats
ORDER BY net_loss_state_rank
LIMIT 15

WITH city_income_sales AS (
    SELECT ca.ca_state,
           ca.ca_city,
           ib.ib_income_band_sk,
           SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
           AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
           SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
           MAX(ss.ss_net_profit) AS max_profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    GROUP BY ca.ca_state, ca.ca_city, ib.ib_income_band_sk
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 10000
)
SELECT ca_state,
       ca_city,
       ib_income_band_sk,
       total_sales,
       avg_discount,
       distinct_customers,
       total_quantity,
       max_profit,
       CASE WHEN avg_discount > 60 THEN 'Very High Discount'
            WHEN avg_discount > 30 THEN 'High Discount'
            WHEN avg_discount > 10 THEN 'Medium Discount'
            ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS city_sales_rank_in_state,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY max_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_in_state
FROM city_income_sales
WHERE total_quantity >= 5
ORDER BY ca_state, city_sales_rank_in_state
LIMIT 20

WITH city_income_sales AS (
    SELECT ca.ca_state,
           ca.ca_city,
           ib.ib_income_band_sk,
           SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
           AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
           SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
           SUM(ss.ss_ext_tax) AS total_tax
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    GROUP BY ca.ca_state, ca.ca_city, ib.ib_income_band_sk
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 50
)
SELECT ca_state,
       ca_city,
       ib_income_band_sk,
       total_sales,
       avg_discount,
       distinct_customers,
       total_quantity,
       total_tax,
       CASE WHEN avg_discount >= 45 THEN 'High Discount'
            WHEN avg_discount >= 20 THEN 'Medium Discount'
            ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY total_tax DESC) AS tax_rank_in_state,
       SUM(total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state) AS state_sales_total
FROM city_income_sales
WHERE total_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
ORDER BY ca_state, tax_rank_in_state
LIMIT 20

WITH city_income_sales AS (
    SELECT ca.ca_state,
           ca.ca_city,
           ib.ib_income_band_sk,
           SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
           AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
           SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss.ss_net_profit > 0) AS profitable_transactions
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    GROUP BY ca.ca_state, ca.ca_city, ib.ib_income_band_sk
)
SELECT ca_state,
       ca_city,
       ib_income_band_sk,
       total_sales,
       avg_discount,
       distinct_customers,
       total_quantity,
       profitable_transactions,
       CASE WHEN avg_discount > 55 THEN 'Very High Discount'
            WHEN avg_discount > 25 THEN 'High Discount'
            WHEN avg_discount > 5 THEN 'Low Discount'
            ELSE 'No Discount' END AS discount_category,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY profitable_transactions DESC) AS profit_txn_rank
FROM city_income_sales
WHERE profitable_transactions > 0
ORDER BY ca_state, profit_txn_rank
LIMIT 20

SELECT r.source, r.order_number, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, r.total_return_amt, CASE WHEN r.total_return_amt > 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Normal' END AS amount_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.total_return_amt DESC) AS overall_rank FROM ( SELECT cr_order_number AS order_number, cr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk, cr_item_sk AS item_sk, cr_return_amt_inc_tax AS total_return_amt, cr_return_quantity AS return_quantity, 'catalog' AS source FROM catalog_returns UNION ALL SELECT wr_order_number AS order_number, wr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk, wr_item_sk AS item_sk, wr_return_amt_inc_tax AS total_return_amt, wr_return_quantity AS return_quantity, 'web' AS source FROM web_returns ) AS r JOIN item i ON r.item_sk = i.i_item_sk ORDER BY overall_rank LIMIT 10

WITH customer_loss AS ( SELECT cr_returning_cdemo_sk AS demo_sk, cr_net_loss AS net_loss, cr_return_quantity AS return_qty FROM catalog_returns UNION ALL SELECT wr_returning_cdemo_sk AS demo_sk, wr_net_loss AS net_loss, wr_return_quantity AS return_qty FROM web_returns ), agg_loss AS ( SELECT cl.demo_sk, SUM(cl.net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(cl.return_qty) AS total_return_qty FROM customer_loss cl GROUP BY cl.demo_sk ) SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_credit_rating, al.total_net_loss, al.total_return_qty, CASE WHEN al.total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'High Loss' ELSE 'Low/Moderate' END AS loss_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.cd_gender ORDER BY al.total_net_loss DESC) AS gender_rank, SUM(al.total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cd.cd_gender ORDER BY al.total_net_loss DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_loss_by_gender FROM agg_loss al JOIN customer_demographics cd ON al.demo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk ORDER BY cd.cd_gender, gender_rank LIMIT 50

WITH daily_category_loss AS ( SELECT r.returned_date_sk, i.i_category, SUM(r.net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM ( SELECT cr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk, cr_item_sk AS item_sk, cr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM catalog_returns UNION ALL SELECT wr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk, wr_item_sk AS item_sk, wr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM web_returns ) r JOIN item i ON r.item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY r.returned_date_sk, i.i_category ) SELECT dcl.i_category, dcl.returned_date_sk, dcl.total_net_loss, AVG(dcl.total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY dcl.i_category ORDER BY dcl.returned_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 3 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_net_loss, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dcl.i_category ORDER BY dcl.total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM daily_category_loss dcl ORDER BY dcl.i_category, dcl.returned_date_sk

WITH agg_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_revenue, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk ), avg_inventory AS ( SELECT inv_item_sk, AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY inv_item_sk ) SELECT it.i_item_id, it.i_product_name, it.i_category, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, a.total_revenue, a.total_profit, a.total_profit / NULLIF(a.total_revenue,0) AS profit_margin, CASE WHEN a.total_profit / NULLIF(a.total_revenue,0) >= 0.20 THEN 'High' WHEN a.total_profit / NULLIF(a.total_revenue,0) >= 0.10 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_margin_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY it.i_category ORDER BY a.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_category, i.avg_inventory_qty, a.sales_cnt FROM agg_sales a JOIN item it ON a.cs_item_sk = it.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd ON a.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk LEFT JOIN avg_inventory i ON a.cs_item_sk = i.inv_item_sk WHERE i.avg_inventory_qty IS NOT NULL ORDER BY it.i_category, revenue_rank_in_category LIMIT 20

WITH shipping_agg AS ( SELECT cs.cs_ship_mode_sk, cs.cs_ship_date_sk, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk, SUM(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS total_ship_cost, AVG(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS total_orders, SUM(i_inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_at_ship, i_item.i_category AS item_category FROM catalog_sales cs LEFT JOIN item i_item ON cs.cs_item_sk = i_item.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN inventory i_inv ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = i_inv.inv_warehouse_sk AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk = i_inv.inv_date_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_ship_mode_sk, cs.cs_ship_date_sk, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk, i_item.i_category ) SELECT sa.cs_ship_mode_sk, sa.cs_ship_date_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, sa.item_category, sa.total_orders, sa.total_ship_cost, sa.avg_ship_cost, CASE WHEN sa.avg_ship_cost < 5 THEN 'Low' WHEN sa.avg_ship_cost BETWEEN 5 AND 15 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS ship_cost_bucket, sa.total_inventory_at_ship, SUM(sa.total_ship_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.cs_ship_mode_sk ORDER BY sa.cs_ship_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_ship_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sa.cs_ship_date_sk ORDER BY sa.total_ship_cost DESC) AS ship_mode_rank_by_cost FROM shipping_agg sa JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sa.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE sa.total_inventory_at_ship IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sa.cs_ship_date_sk, ship_mode_rank_by_cost LIMIT 100

WITH promo_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_promo_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax, cs.cs_net_profit, cs.cs_ext_discount_amt, cs.cs_coupon_amt, cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk, cs.cs_quantity FROM catalog_sales cs WHERE cs.cs_promo_sk IS NOT NULL ), promo_aggregated AS ( SELECT ps.cs_promo_sk, ps.cs_sold_date_sk, ps.cs_net_paid_inc_tax, AVG(ps.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY ps.cs_promo_sk ORDER BY ps.cs_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_7d, CASE WHEN ps.cs_net_paid_inc_tax >= 1000 THEN 'High' WHEN ps.cs_net_paid_inc_tax >= 500 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS paid_tax_category, ps.cs_net_profit, ps.cs_ext_discount_amt, ps.cs_coupon_amt, ps.cs_item_sk, ps.cs_ship_cdemo_sk, ps.cs_quantity FROM promo_sales ps ), inventory_daily AS ( SELECT inv_item_sk, inv_date_sk, SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_on_hand FROM inventory GROUP BY inv_item_sk, inv_date_sk ) SELECT pa.cs_promo_sk, pa.cs_sold_date_sk, pa.cs_net_paid_inc_tax, pa.moving_avg_7d, pa.paid_tax_category, pa.cs_net_profit, (pa.cs_ext_discount_amt + pa.cs_coupon_amt) AS total_discount, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_brand, inv.total_on_hand AS inventory_on_hand, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.cs_promo_sk ORDER BY pa.moving_avg_7d DESC) AS promo_effectiveness_rank FROM promo_aggregated pa JOIN item i ON pa.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN inventory_daily inv ON pa.cs_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk AND pa.cs_sold_date_sk = inv.inv_date_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON pa.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE inv.total_on_hand IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pa.cs_promo_sk, promo_effectiveness_rank LIMIT 200

WITH daily_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS daily_quantity_sold FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk ), inventory_daily AS ( SELECT inv_item_sk, inv_date_sk, SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_on_hand FROM inventory GROUP BY inv_item_sk, inv_date_sk ), shipping_demo AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, MAX(cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk) AS ship_cdemo_sk FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk ), merged AS ( SELECT ds.cs_item_sk, ds.cs_sold_date_sk, ds.daily_quantity_sold, inv.total_on_hand, ds.daily_quantity_sold / NULLIF(inv.total_on_hand,0) AS turnover_rate, sd.ship_cdemo_sk FROM daily_sales ds LEFT JOIN inventory_daily inv ON ds.cs_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk AND ds.cs_sold_date_sk = inv.inv_date_sk LEFT JOIN shipping_demo sd ON ds.cs_item_sk = sd.cs_item_sk AND ds.cs_sold_date_sk = sd.cs_sold_date_sk WHERE inv.total_on_hand IS NOT NULL ), avg_turnover AS ( SELECT i.i_item_id, AVG(m.turnover_rate) AS avg_turnover_rate FROM merged m JOIN item i ON m.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_id ) SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, m.cs_sold_date_sk, m.daily_quantity_sold, m.total_on_hand AS inventory_on_hand, m.turnover_rate, a.avg_turnover_rate, LAG(m.total_on_hand) OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_item_id ORDER BY m.cs_sold_date_sk) AS previous_inventory, (m.total_on_hand - LAG(m.total_on_hand) OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_item_id ORDER BY m.cs_sold_date_sk)) AS inventory_change, CASE WHEN (m.total_on_hand - LAG(m.total_on_hand) OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_item_id ORDER BY m.cs_sold_date_sk)) > 0 THEN 'Increasing' WHEN (m.total_on_hand - LAG(m.total_on_hand) OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_item_id ORDER BY m.cs_sold_date_sk)) < 0 THEN 'Decreasing' ELSE 'Stable' END AS inventory_trend, cd.cd_gender AS ship_gender, cd.cd_marital_status AS ship_marital_status, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.avg_turnover_rate DESC) AS turnover_rank FROM merged m JOIN item i ON m.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd ON m.ship_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN avg_turnover a ON i.i_item_id = a.i_item_id ORDER BY turnover_rank LIMIT 50

WITH cc_base AS (SELECT cs.cs_call_center_sk, t.t_meal_time, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount, SUM(cs.cs_coupon_amt) AS coupon_amount, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS discount_amount FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_call_center_sk, t.t_meal_time), cc_total AS (SELECT cs_call_center_sk, SUM(sales_amount) AS total_sales, SUM(coupon_amount) AS total_coupon, SUM(discount_amount) AS total_discount, CASE WHEN SUM(sales_amount) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(discount_amount) / SUM(sales_amount) END AS discount_rate FROM cc_base GROUP BY cs_call_center_sk) SELECT cb.cs_call_center_sk, cb.t_meal_time, cb.sales_amount, cb.coupon_amount, cb.discount_amount, ct.discount_rate, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ct.discount_rate DESC) AS discount_rate_rank, CASE WHEN ct.discount_rate > 0.15 THEN 'High' WHEN ct.discount_rate > 0.05 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS discount_category, ROUND(cb.sales_amount / ct.total_sales * 100, 2) AS sales_pct_of_total FROM cc_base cb JOIN cc_total ct ON cb.cs_call_center_sk = ct.cs_call_center_sk ORDER BY ct.discount_rate DESC, cb.t_meal_time

WITH sales_by_date AS (SELECT d.d_date, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS daily_sales, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS daily_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date), returns_by_date AS (SELECT d.d_date, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS daily_returns, SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS daily_refunded_cash FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date) SELECT s.d_date, s.daily_sales, r.daily_returns, s.daily_sales - COALESCE(r.daily_returns, 0) AS net_daily, SUM(s.daily_sales) OVER (ORDER BY s.d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_sales, SUM(COALESCE(r.daily_returns, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY s.d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_returns, (SUM(s.daily_sales) OVER (ORDER BY s.d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) - SUM(COALESCE(r.daily_returns, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY s.d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) AS cum_net, CASE WHEN (SUM(s.daily_sales) OVER (ORDER BY s.d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) - SUM(COALESCE(r.daily_returns, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY s.d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) > 100000 THEN 'Excellent' ELSE 'Average' END AS performance_category FROM sales_by_date s LEFT JOIN returns_by_date r ON s.d_date = r.d_date ORDER BY s.d_date

SELECT cs.cs_warehouse_sk, cs.cs_call_center_sk, d.d_year, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_sold_qty, COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity), 0) AS total_return_qty, CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_quantity) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity), 0) * 100.0 / SUM(cs.cs_quantity)) END AS return_rate_pct, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity), 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(cs.cs_quantity), 0)) > 5 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_rate_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_year ORDER BY (COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity), 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(cs.cs_quantity), 0)) DESC) AS yearly_return_rank, AVG(t.t_hour) AS avg_sale_hour FROM catalog_sales cs LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_warehouse_sk, cs.cs_call_center_sk, d.d_year

SELECT d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, cs.cs_item_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_net_loss), 0) AS total_net_loss, (SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_net_loss), 0)) AS net_profit_after_returns, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq ORDER BY (SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_net_loss), 0)) DESC) AS profit_rank, AVG(t.t_hour) AS avg_sale_hour FROM catalog_sales cs LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, cs.cs_item_sk

WITH latest_year AS ( SELECT MAX(d_year) AS max_year FROM date_dim ), call_center_sales AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk AS cc_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT w.w_warehouse_id) AS distinct_warehouses, MAX(cs.cs_sold_time_sk) AS latest_sold_time FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk CROSS JOIN latest_year ly WHERE d.d_year = ly.max_year AND cs.cs_ext_discount_amt BETWEEN 1 AND 3 GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state ) SELECT cc_sk, cc_name, cc_city, cc_state, total_net_paid, total_net_profit, total_orders, distinct_warehouses, latest_sold_time, SUM(total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_state) AS state_total_net_paid, CASE WHEN total_orders >= 100 THEN 'High Volume' ELSE 'Low Volume' END AS volume_category FROM call_center_sales WHERE total_net_profit <> 0 ORDER BY state_total_net_paid DESC LIMIT 12

WITH latest_year AS ( SELECT MAX(d_year) AS max_year FROM date_dim ), call_center_sales AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk AS cc_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_ext_tax) AS total_tax, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT w.w_warehouse_id) AS distinct_warehouses FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk CROSS JOIN latest_year ly WHERE d.d_year = ly.max_year AND cs.cs_quantity >= 10 GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state ) SELECT cc_sk, cc_name, cc_city, cc_state, total_net_paid, total_tax, total_orders, distinct_warehouses, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_tax DESC) AS tax_percentile, CASE WHEN total_net_paid > total_tax THEN 'Net > Tax' ELSE 'Tax >= Net' END AS net_tax_relation FROM call_center_sales WHERE total_tax > 0 GROUP BY cc_sk, cc_name, cc_city, cc_state, total_net_paid, total_tax, total_orders, distinct_warehouses ORDER BY tax_percentile ASC LIMIT 15

WITH latest_year AS ( SELECT MAX(d_year) AS max_year FROM date_dim ), call_center_sales AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk AS cc_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_net_paid_inc_tax, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT w.w_warehouse_id) AS distinct_warehouses FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk CROSS JOIN latest_year ly WHERE d.d_year = ly.max_year AND cs.cs_ext_discount_amt < 5 GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state ) SELECT cc_sk, cc_name, cc_city, cc_state, total_net_paid_inc_tax, total_net_profit, distinct_orders, distinct_warehouses, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_state ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS state_rank, CASE WHEN total_net_profit > 1000 THEN 'High Profit' ELSE 'Low Profit' END AS profit_category FROM call_center_sales WHERE distinct_orders > 50 ORDER BY state_rank, total_net_paid_inc_tax DESC LIMIT 10

WITH store_agg AS (
    SELECT ss_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk,
           SUM(ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit,
           AVG(ss_quantity) AS store_avg_quantity
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_sales_price > 100
    GROUP BY ss_hdemo_sk
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT ws_bill_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk,
           SUM(ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
           AVG(ws_quantity) AS web_avg_quantity
    FROM web_sales
    WHERE ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50 AND 500
    GROUP BY ws_bill_hdemo_sk
),
ship_mode_cnt AS (
    SELECT ws_ship_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk,
           COUNT(DISTINCT sm.sm_ship_mode_sk) AS distinct_ship_modes,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sm.sm_type = 'AIR') AS air_ship_modes,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sm.sm_type = 'GROUND') AS ground_ship_modes,
           MAX(sm.sm_contract) AS max_contract
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    WHERE sm.sm_carrier <> 'UNKNOWN'
    GROUP BY ws_ship_hdemo_sk
),
combined AS (
    SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk,
           hd.hd_income_band_sk,
           COALESCE(sa.store_net_profit,0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_profit,0) AS total_net_profit,
           COALESCE(sa.store_avg_quantity,0) + COALESCE(wa.web_avg_quantity,0) AS total_avg_quantity,
           hd.hd_buy_potential,
           COALESCE(sc.distinct_ship_modes,0) AS distinct_ship_modes,
           COALESCE(sc.air_ship_modes,0) AS air_ship_modes,
           COALESCE(sc.ground_ship_modes,0) AS ground_ship_modes,
           sc.max_contract
    FROM household_demographics hd
    LEFT JOIN store_agg sa ON hd.hd_demo_sk = sa.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_agg wa ON hd.hd_demo_sk = wa.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode_cnt sc ON hd.hd_demo_sk = sc.hd_demo_sk
)
SELECT hd_demo_sk,
       hd_income_band_sk,
       total_net_profit,
       total_avg_quantity,
       distinct_ship_modes,
       air_ship_modes,
       ground_ship_modes,
       max_contract,
       CASE WHEN hd_buy_potential = 'HIGH' THEN 'Premium'
            WHEN hd_buy_potential = 'MEDIUM' THEN 'Midrange'
            ELSE 'Budget' END AS potential_category,
       SUM(total_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY hd_income_band_sk) AS income_band_profit_total,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_avg_quantity DESC) AS avg_quantity_rank
FROM combined
WHERE distinct_ship_modes >= 2
  AND hd_income_band_sk IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY hd_demo_sk, hd_income_band_sk, total_net_profit, total_avg_quantity,
         distinct_ship_modes, air_ship_modes, ground_ship_modes, max_contract, hd_buy_potential
ORDER BY income_band_profit_total DESC, avg_quantity_rank ASC
FETCH FIRST 15 ROWS ONLY

WITH store_agg AS (
    SELECT ss_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk,
           SUM(ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ss_item_sk) AS store_unique_items
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_net_paid_inc_tax > 0
    GROUP BY ss_hdemo_sk
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT ws_bill_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk,
           SUM(ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ws_item_sk) AS web_unique_items
    FROM web_sales
    WHERE ws_net_paid_inc_tax > 0
    GROUP BY ws_bill_hdemo_sk
),
ship_mode_cnt AS (
    SELECT ws_ship_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk,
           COUNT(DISTINCT sm.sm_ship_mode_sk) AS distinct_ship_modes,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sm.sm_type = 'AIR') AS air_ship_modes,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sm.sm_type = 'GROUND') AS ground_ship_modes,
           MIN(sm.sm_type) AS first_ship_type
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    GROUP BY ws_ship_hdemo_sk
),
combined AS (
    SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk,
           hd.hd_income_band_sk,
           COALESCE(sa.store_net_profit,0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_profit,0) AS total_net_profit,
           COALESCE(sa.store_unique_items,0) + COALESCE(wa.web_unique_items,0) AS total_unique_items,
           hd.hd_buy_potential,
           COALESCE(sc.distinct_ship_modes,0) AS distinct_ship_modes,
           COALESCE(sc.air_ship_modes,0) AS air_ship_modes,
           COALESCE(sc.ground_ship_modes,0) AS ground_ship_modes,
           sc.first_ship_type
    FROM household_demographics hd
    LEFT JOIN store_agg sa ON hd.hd_demo_sk = sa.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_agg wa ON hd.hd_demo_sk = wa.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode_cnt sc ON hd.hd_demo_sk = sc.hd_demo_sk
)
SELECT hd_demo_sk,
       hd_income_band_sk,
       total_net_profit,
       total_unique_items,
       distinct_ship_modes,
       air_ship_modes,
       ground_ship_modes,
       first_ship_type,
       CASE WHEN hd_buy_potential = 'HIGH' THEN 'Premium'
            WHEN hd_buy_potential = 'MEDIUM' THEN 'Midrange'
            ELSE 'Budget' END AS potential_category,
       SUM(total_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY hd_income_band_sk) AS income_band_profit_sum,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hd_income_band_sk ORDER BY total_unique_items DESC) AS unique_item_rank
FROM combined
WHERE total_unique_items > 2
  AND distinct_ship_modes > 0
ORDER BY income_band_profit_sum DESC, unique_item_rank ASC
FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

WITH store_agg AS (
    SELECT ss_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk,
           SUM(ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit,
           MAX(ss_quantity) AS max_store_qty
    FROM store_sales
    GROUP BY ss_hdemo_sk
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT ws_bill_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk,
           SUM(ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
           MAX(ws_quantity) AS max_web_qty
    FROM web_sales
    GROUP BY ws_bill_hdemo_sk
),
ship_mode_cnt AS (
    SELECT ws_ship_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk,
           COUNT(DISTINCT sm.sm_ship_mode_sk) AS distinct_ship_modes,
           SUM(CASE WHEN sm.sm_type = 'AIR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS air_ship_modes,
           SUM(CASE WHEN sm.sm_type = 'GROUND' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ground_ship_modes
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    WHERE sm.sm_contract = 'STANDARD'
    GROUP BY ws_ship_hdemo_sk
),
combined AS (
    SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk,
           hd.hd_income_band_sk,
           COALESCE(sa.store_net_profit,0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_profit,0) AS total_net_profit,
           GREATEST(COALESCE(sa.max_store_qty,0), COALESCE(wa.max_web_qty,0)) AS max_quantity,
           hd.hd_buy_potential,
           COALESCE(sc.distinct_ship_modes,0) AS distinct_ship_modes,
           COALESCE(sc.air_ship_modes,0) AS air_ship_modes,
           COALESCE(sc.ground_ship_modes,0) AS ground_ship_modes
    FROM household_demographics hd
    LEFT JOIN store_agg sa ON hd.hd_demo_sk = sa.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_agg wa ON hd.hd_demo_sk = wa.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN ship_mode_cnt sc ON hd.hd_demo_sk = sc.hd_demo_sk
)
SELECT hd_demo_sk,
       hd_income_band_sk,
       total_net_profit,
       max_quantity,
       distinct_ship_modes,
       air_ship_modes,
       ground_ship_modes,
       CASE WHEN hd_buy_potential = 'HIGH' THEN 'Premium'
            WHEN hd_buy_potential = 'MEDIUM' THEN 'Midrange'
            ELSE 'Budget' END AS potential_category,
       SUM(total_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY hd_income_band_sk) AS income_band_total_profit,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY max_quantity DESC) AS quantity_dense_rank
FROM combined
WHERE distinct_ship_modes >= 1
  AND max_quantity > 0
GROUP BY hd_demo_sk, hd_income_band_sk, total_net_profit, max_quantity,
         distinct_ship_modes, air_ship_modes, ground_ship_modes, hd_buy_potential
ORDER BY income_band_total_profit DESC, quantity_dense_rank ASC
FETCH FIRST 25 ROWS ONLY

WITH daily_tax AS ( SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date, cp.cp_department, w.w_state, SUM(cr.cr_return_tax) AS total_return_tax FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date_sk, d.d_date, cp.cp_department, w.w_state ), dept_daily_tax AS ( SELECT cp_department, w_state, d_date, total_return_tax, LAG(total_return_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department, w_state ORDER BY d_date) AS prior_day_tax, LAG(total_return_tax, 365) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department, w_state ORDER BY d_date) AS prior_year_same_day_tax FROM daily_tax ) SELECT cp_department, w_state, d_date, total_return_tax, prior_day_tax, prior_year_same_day_tax, CASE WHEN prior_day_tax IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (total_return_tax - prior_day_tax) / prior_day_tax * 100 END AS day_over_day_change_pct, CASE WHEN prior_year_same_day_tax IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (total_return_tax - prior_year_same_day_tax) / prior_year_same_day_tax * 100 END AS year_over_year_change_pct, CASE WHEN prior_day_tax IS NULL THEN 'No Prior Day' WHEN total_return_tax > prior_day_tax THEN 'Increase' WHEN total_return_tax < prior_day_tax THEN 'Decrease' ELSE 'No Change' END AS day_over_day_trend, CASE WHEN prior_year_same_day_tax IS NULL THEN 'No Prior Year Data' WHEN total_return_tax > prior_year_same_day_tax THEN 'Increase YoY' WHEN total_return_tax < prior_year_same_day_tax THEN 'Decrease YoY' ELSE 'No Change YoY' END AS year_over_year_trend FROM dept_daily_tax WHERE d_date >= date_add('year', -2, current_date) ORDER BY cp_department, w_state, d_date DESC LIMIT 200

WITH page_returns AS ( SELECT cp.cp_department, w.w_city, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, MIN(d.d_date) AS first_return_date, MAX(d.d_date) AS last_return_date FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = year(current_date) GROUP BY cp.cp_department, w.w_city, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_catalog_page_number ) SELECT cp_department, w_city, cp_catalog_page_id, cp_catalog_page_number, total_return_qty, total_net_loss, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY total_return_qty DESC) AS qty_rank_in_dept, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank_in_dept, SUM(total_return_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY total_return_qty DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_qty_in_dept, CASE WHEN total_return_qty > 100 THEN 'High Return Volume' WHEN total_return_qty BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN 'Medium Return Volume' ELSE 'Low Return Volume' END AS return_volume_category FROM page_returns ORDER BY cp_department, qty_rank_in_dept

WITH dept_quarter_net AS ( SELECT cp.cp_department, d.d_quarter_name, w.w_state, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) > 1000 THEN 'High Return Volume' ELSE 'Low Return Volume' END AS return_volume_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_quarter_name ORDER BY SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) DESC) AS dept_rank_in_quarter FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_department, d.d_quarter_name, w.w_state ) SELECT cp_department, d_quarter_name, w_state, total_net_loss, total_return_amount, return_volume_category, dept_rank_in_quarter FROM dept_quarter_net WHERE dept_rank_in_quarter <= 5 ORDER BY d_quarter_name, dept_rank_in_quarter

WITH daily_warehouse_returns AS ( SELECT w.w_warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, cp.cp_type AS catalog_type, d.d_date, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS daily_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS daily_net_loss FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_name, cp.cp_type, d.d_date ) SELECT warehouse_name, catalog_type, d_date, SUM(daily_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_name, catalog_type ORDER BY d_date) AS cumulative_return_amount, AVG(daily_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_name, catalog_type ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS three_day_avg_net_loss, CASE WHEN SUM(daily_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_name, catalog_type ORDER BY d_date) > 50000 THEN 'Exceeds Threshold' ELSE 'Below Threshold' END AS threshold_flag FROM daily_warehouse_returns ORDER BY warehouse_name, catalog_type, d_date

WITH cc_perf AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_employees, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax - cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_tax, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid FROM call_center cc INNER JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_employees ) SELECT cc_call_center_id, cc_name, cc_employees, total_profit, total_tax, total_net_paid, CASE WHEN total_profit / NULLIF(cc_employees, 0) > 10000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Medium' END AS performance_flag, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS profit_percentile FROM cc_perf WHERE total_profit > 0 ORDER BY profit_percentile DESC LIMIT 10

WITH hd_sales AS ( SELECT hd.hd_income_band_sk AS income_band_sk, hd.hd_vehicle_count AS vehicle_count, hd.hd_buy_potential AS buy_potential, cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit FROM catalog_sales cs INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk UNION ALL SELECT hd.hd_income_band_sk, hd.hd_vehicle_count, hd.hd_buy_potential, cs.cs_net_profit FROM catalog_sales cs INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk ) SELECT income_band_sk, vehicle_count, AVG(net_profit) AS avg_net_profit, CASE WHEN MAX(buy_potential) = 'High' THEN 'High' WHEN MAX(buy_potential) = 'Medium' THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS buy_potential_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM hd_sales GROUP BY income_band_sk, vehicle_count ORDER BY profit_rank

WITH page_rev AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cc.cc_division_name, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid FROM catalog_sales cs INNER JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk INNER JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cc.cc_division_name ), ranked_pages AS ( SELECT pr.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_division_name ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS rnk FROM page_rev pr ) SELECT cp_catalog_page_id, cc_division_name, total_net_paid, rnk FROM ranked_pages WHERE rnk <= 5 ORDER BY cc_division_name, rnk

WITH weekly_sales AS ( SELECT cc.cc_state AS state, cp.cp_type AS cp_type, FLOOR(cs.cs_sold_date_sk / 7) AS week_id, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS week_revenue FROM catalog_sales cs INNER JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk INNER JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_state, cp.cp_type, FLOOR(cs.cs_sold_date_sk / 7) ) SELECT state, cp_type, week_id, week_revenue, LAG(week_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY state, cp_type ORDER BY week_id) AS prev_week_revenue, CASE WHEN LAG(week_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY state, cp_type ORDER BY week_id) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (week_revenue - LAG(week_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY state, cp_type ORDER BY week_id)) / NULLIF(LAG(week_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY state, cp_type ORDER BY week_id), 0) * 100 END AS growth_pct, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY week_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank_in_state FROM weekly_sales ORDER BY state, week_id, cp_type

WITH sales_cohort AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        d_sales.d_year,
        d_sales.d_moy,
        d_sales.d_quarter_seq,
        d_sales.d_date AS sales_date
    FROM customer c
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_sales ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
),
cohort_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        d_moy,
        d_quarter_seq,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c_customer_id) AS customers_in_cohort,
        SUM(hd_vehicle_count) AS total_vehicle_count
    FROM sales_cohort
    GROUP BY d_year, d_moy, d_quarter_seq
)
SELECT
    concat(CAST(d_year AS VARCHAR), '-', LPAD(CAST(d_moy AS VARCHAR), 2, '0')) AS cohort_month,
    d_quarter_seq AS cohort_quarter,
    customers_in_cohort,
    total_vehicle_count,
    LAG(total_vehicle_count) OVER (ORDER BY d_year, d_moy) AS prev_month_vehicle_total,
    CASE
        WHEN LAG(total_vehicle_count) OVER (ORDER BY d_year, d_moy) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (total_vehicle_count - LAG(total_vehicle_count) OVER (ORDER BY d_year, d_moy)) * 1.0 /
             LAG(total_vehicle_count) OVER (ORDER BY d_year, d_moy)
    END AS month_over_month_growth,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_vehicle_count DESC) AS vehicle_count_rank
FROM cohort_agg
ORDER BY d_year, d_moy
LIMIT 24

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_birth_country,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        ws.web_name,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        d_sales.d_year,
        c.c_birth_year,
        (hd.hd_vehicle_count *
            CASE WHEN c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) AS vehicle_score,
        CASE
            WHEN (d_sales.d_year - c.c_birth_year) < 20 THEN 'Teen'
            WHEN (d_sales.d_year - c.c_birth_year) BETWEEN 20 AND 35 THEN 'Young Adult'
            WHEN (d_sales.d_year - c.c_birth_year) BETWEEN 36 AND 55 THEN 'Adult'
            ELSE 'Senior'
        END AS age_group
    FROM customer c
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_sales ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_site ws ON c.c_first_shipto_date_sk BETWEEN ws.web_open_date_sk AND ws.web_close_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_open ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_close ON ws.web_close_date_sk = d_close.d_date_sk
    WHERE c.c_preferred_cust_flag IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    c_first_name,
    c_last_name,
    c_birth_country,
    age_group,
    web_name,
    vehicle_score,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY age_group, c_birth_country ORDER BY vehicle_score DESC) AS rank_within_country_age,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY vehicle_score DESC) AS global_dense_rank,
    SUM(vehicle_score) OVER (PARTITION BY web_name) AS total_vehicle_score_per_site
FROM base
ORDER BY global_dense_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH cust_reviews AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_birth_country,
        ws.web_name,
        d_ship.d_date AS ship_date,
        d_review.d_date AS review_date,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_year,
        date_diff('day', d_ship.d_date, d_review.d_date) AS days_to_review,
        CASE WHEN date_diff('day', d_ship.d_date, d_review.d_date) > 365 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS churn_flag
    FROM customer c
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ship ON c.c_first_shipto_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_review ON c.c_last_review_date = d_review.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site ws ON c.c_first_shipto_date_sk BETWEEN ws.web_open_date_sk AND ws.web_close_date_sk
),
country_stats AS (
    SELECT
        cr.c_birth_country,
        COALESCE(cr.web_name, 'No Site') AS web_name,
        COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
        SUM(cr.churn_flag) AS churned_customers,
        AVG(cr.days_to_review) AS avg_days_to_review,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(cr.churn_flag) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) END AS churn_rate
    FROM cust_reviews cr
    GROUP BY cr.c_birth_country, cr.web_name
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
)
SELECT
    c.c_birth_country,
    c.web_name,
    c.total_customers,
    c.churned_customers,
    c.avg_days_to_review,
    ROUND(100.0 * c.churn_rate, 2) AS churn_rate_pct,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.churn_rate DESC) AS churn_rate_rank,
    LAG(ROUND(100.0 * c.churn_rate, 2)) OVER (ORDER BY c.churn_rate DESC) AS previous_country_churn_rate,
    SUM(ROUND(100.0 * c.churn_rate, 2)) OVER (ORDER BY c.churn_rate DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_churn_rate_pct
FROM country_stats c
ORDER BY churn_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH site_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        ws.web_site_id,
        ws.web_name,
        d_open.d_date AS open_date,
        d_close.d_date AS close_date,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS customers_count,
        SUM(COALESCE(hd.hd_vehicle_count, 0)) AS total_vehicle_count,
        AVG(COALESCE(d_sales.d_year - c.c_birth_year, 0)) AS avg_customer_age_at_sale,
        date_diff('day', d_open.d_date, d_close.d_date) AS active_days
    FROM web_site ws
    JOIN date_dim d_open ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_close ON ws.web_close_date_sk = d_close.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer c
        ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk BETWEEN ws.web_open_date_sk AND ws.web_close_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_sales ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, d_open.d_date, d_close.d_date
)
SELECT
    web_site_id,
    web_name,
    open_date,
    close_date,
    active_days,
    customers_count,
    total_vehicle_count,
    avg_customer_age_at_sale,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_vehicle_count DESC) AS vehicle_count_rank,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY customers_count DESC) AS customer_percentile,
    SUM(customers_count) OVER (ORDER BY open_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_customers
FROM site_metrics
ORDER BY vehicle_count_rank
LIMIT 50

WITH returns_by_dept_state AS (
  SELECT
    cp.cp_department,
    ca.ca_state,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS state_net_loss,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS state_return_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
    MAX(w.w_gmt_offset) AS max_warehouse_gmt_offset
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  WHERE cr.cr_returned_date_sk >= 20000101  -- filter recent returns
  GROUP BY cp.cp_department, ca.ca_state
),
dept_totals AS (
  SELECT
    cp_department,
    SUM(state_net_loss) AS dept_net_loss,
    SUM(state_return_amount) AS dept_return_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS dept_state_cnt
  FROM returns_by_dept_state
  GROUP BY cp_department
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    r.cp_department,
    r.ca_state,
    r.state_net_loss,
    r.state_return_amount,
    r.return_cnt,
    r.max_warehouse_gmt_offset,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.cp_department ORDER BY r.state_return_amount DESC) AS state_rank,
    (r.state_net_loss / dt.dept_net_loss) * 100 AS net_loss_pct,
    (r.state_return_amount / dt.dept_return_amount) * 100 AS return_amount_pct,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.cp_department ORDER BY r.return_cnt DESC) AS return_cnt_rank
  FROM returns_by_dept_state r
  JOIN dept_totals dt ON r.cp_department = dt.cp_department
)
SELECT
  cp_department,
  ca_state,
  state_net_loss,
  state_return_amount,
  return_cnt,
  net_loss_pct,
  return_amount_pct,
  state_rank,
  CASE WHEN state_rank <= 5 THEN 'Top5' ELSE 'Other' END AS rank_category,
  max_warehouse_gmt_offset
FROM ranked
WHERE return_cnt_rank <= 10
ORDER BY cp_department, state_rank

WITH returns_by_dept_state AS (
  SELECT
    cp.cp_department,
    ca.ca_state,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS state_net_loss,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS state_return_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
    AVG(w.w_gmt_offset) AS avg_warehouse_gmt_offset
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  WHERE ca.ca_country = 'United States'  -- restrict to US addresses
  GROUP BY cp.cp_department, ca.ca_state
),
dept_totals AS (
  SELECT
    cp_department,
    SUM(state_net_loss) AS dept_net_loss,
    SUM(state_return_amount) AS dept_return_amount
  FROM returns_by_dept_state
  GROUP BY cp_department
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    r.cp_department,
    r.ca_state,
    r.state_net_loss,
    r.state_return_amount,
    r.return_cnt,
    r.avg_warehouse_gmt_offset,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.cp_department ORDER BY r.state_net_loss ASC) AS loss_rank,
    (r.state_net_loss / dt.dept_net_loss) * 100 AS net_loss_pct,
    (r.state_return_amount / dt.dept_return_amount) * 100 AS return_amount_pct,
    SUM(r.return_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY r.cp_department) AS total_returns_in_dept
  FROM returns_by_dept_state r
  JOIN dept_totals dt ON r.cp_department = dt.cp_department
)
SELECT
  cp_department,
  ca_state,
  state_net_loss,
  state_return_amount,
  return_cnt,
  net_loss_pct,
  return_amount_pct,
  loss_rank AS state_rank,
  CASE WHEN loss_rank <= 2 THEN 'LowLoss' ELSE 'HigherLoss' END AS rank_category,
  avg_warehouse_gmt_offset,
  total_returns_in_dept
FROM ranked
WHERE state_net_loss > 0
ORDER BY cp_department, state_rank DESC

WITH ship_daily AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_ship_date_sk,
        d.d_date,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_week_seq,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS total_ship_cost,
        SUM(cs.cs_wholesale_cost * cs.cs_quantity) AS total_wholesale_cost,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(cs.cs_wholesale_cost * cs.cs_quantity), 0) AS ship_to_wholesale_ratio,
        AVG(t.t_hour) AS avg_sale_hour
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY cs.cs_ship_date_sk, d.d_date, d.d_year, d.d_week_seq
), ship_with_lag AS (
    SELECT
        sd.*,
        LAG(sd.total_ship_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.d_year ORDER BY sd.d_date) AS prev_day_ship_cost,
        LEAD(sd.total_ship_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.d_year ORDER BY sd.d_date) AS next_day_ship_cost,
        CASE 
            WHEN sd.ship_to_wholesale_ratio > 0.1 THEN 'High Ship Cost'
            ELSE 'Normal Ship Cost'
        END AS ship_cost_category,
        CASE 
            WHEN sd.avg_sale_hour >= 15 THEN 'Evening Sales'
            ELSE 'Daytime Sales'
        END AS sale_hour_category
    FROM ship_daily sd
)
SELECT
    swl.d_date,
    swl.d_year,
    swl.d_week_seq,
    swl.total_ship_cost,
    swl.total_wholesale_cost,
    swl.ship_to_wholesale_ratio,
    swl.prev_day_ship_cost,
    swl.next_day_ship_cost,
    swl.ship_cost_category,
    swl.sale_hour_category,
    ws.web_name
FROM ship_with_lag swl
LEFT JOIN web_site ws
  ON swl.cs_ship_date_sk BETWEEN ws.web_open_date_sk AND ws.web_close_date_sk
ORDER BY swl.d_date

WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
        d.d_date,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        d.d_month_seq % 12 + 1 AS month_num,
        t.t_hour,
        CASE 
            WHEN t.t_hour BETWEEN 5 AND 11 THEN 'Morning'
            WHEN t.t_hour BETWEEN 12 AND 16 THEN 'Afternoon'
            WHEN t.t_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 20 THEN 'Evening'
            ELSE 'Night'
        END AS time_bucket,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk, d.d_date, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, t.t_hour,
        CASE 
            WHEN t.t_hour BETWEEN 5 AND 11 THEN 'Morning'
            WHEN t.t_hour BETWEEN 12 AND 16 THEN 'Afternoon'
            WHEN t.t_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 20 THEN 'Evening'
            ELSE 'Night'
        END
)
SELECT
    ds.d_date,
    ds.d_year,
    ds.time_bucket,
    ds.total_net_paid,
    ds.total_net_profit,
    ds.avg_discount,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ds.d_year, ds.month_num ORDER BY ds.total_net_paid DESC) AS rank_in_month,
    SUM(ds.total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY ds.d_year ORDER BY ds.d_date) AS cumulative_year_net_paid,
    ws.web_site_id,
    ws.web_name
FROM daily_sales ds
JOIN web_site ws
  ON ds.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN ws.web_open_date_sk AND ws.web_close_date_sk
ORDER BY ds.d_date, ds.time_bucket

WITH sales_with_dim AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_ext_discount_amt,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        d.d_date,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        t.t_hour,
        t.t_meal_time,
        ws.web_site_sk,
        ws.web_name
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN web_site ws ON d.d_date_sk BETWEEN ws.web_open_date_sk AND ws.web_close_date_sk
), customer_aggregates AS (
    SELECT
        csd.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        COUNT(*) AS purchase_count,
        SUM(csd.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(csd.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(csd.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
        SUM(csd.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(csd.cs_net_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(csd.cs_net_paid), 0) AS profit_margin
    FROM sales_with_dim csd
    GROUP BY csd.cs_bill_customer_sk
), customer_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ca.*,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
        CASE 
            WHEN ca.profit_margin >= 0.5 THEN 'VIP'
            WHEN ca.profit_margin >= 0.2 THEN 'Preferred'
            ELSE 'Standard'
        END AS customer_segment
    FROM customer_aggregates ca
), customer_top_purchases AS (
    SELECT
        csd.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        csd.cs_order_number,
        csd.cs_net_paid,
        csd.cs_net_profit,
        csd.d_date,
        csd.web_name,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY csd.cs_bill_customer_sk ORDER BY csd.cs_net_paid DESC) AS purchase_rank,
        AVG(csd.cs_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY csd.cs_bill_customer_sk ORDER BY csd.d_date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS three_purchase_moving_avg_profit
    FROM sales_with_dim csd
)
SELECT
    cr.cs_bill_customer_sk,
    cr.purchase_count,
    cr.total_net_paid,
    cr.total_net_profit,
    cr.profit_margin,
    cr.profit_rank,
    cr.customer_segment,
    tp.cs_order_number,
    tp.d_date,
    tp.web_name,
    tp.purchase_rank,
    tp.three_purchase_moving_avg_profit
FROM customer_ranked cr
JOIN customer_top_purchases tp
  ON cr.cs_bill_customer_sk = tp.cs_bill_customer_sk
WHERE tp.purchase_rank <= 5
ORDER BY cr.profit_rank, tp.purchase_rank

WITH site_month_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ws.web_site_sk,
        ws.web_name,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS month_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS month_net_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS month_discount_total,
        AVG(t.t_hour) AS avg_sale_hour
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_site ws ON d.d_date_sk BETWEEN ws.web_open_date_sk AND ws.web_close_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY ws.web_site_sk, ws.web_name, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq
), site_total AS (
    SELECT
        web_site_sk,
        web_name,
        SUM(month_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(month_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(month_discount_total) AS total_discount,
        SUM(month_net_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(month_net_paid), 0) AS overall_profit_margin,
        SUM(distinct_customers) AS total_distinct_customers,
        AVG(avg_sale_hour) AS overall_avg_sale_hour
    FROM site_month_sales
    GROUP BY web_site_sk, web_name
), site_month_lag AS (
    SELECT
        sm.web_site_sk,
        sm.web_name,
        sm.d_year,
        sm.d_month_seq,
        sm.month_net_paid,
        LAG(sm.month_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY sm.web_site_sk ORDER BY sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq) AS prev_month_net_paid
    FROM site_month_sales sm
), site_last_month AS (
    SELECT
        sm.web_site_sk,
        sm.prev_month_net_paid,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.web_site_sk ORDER BY sm.d_year DESC, sm.d_month_seq DESC) AS rn
    FROM site_month_lag sm
)
SELECT
    st.web_name,
    st.total_net_paid,
    st.total_net_profit,
    st.overall_profit_margin,
    st.total_distinct_customers,
    st.overall_avg_sale_hour,
    CASE 
        WHEN st.overall_profit_margin >= 0.30 THEN 'High Margin'
        WHEN st.overall_profit_margin >= 0.15 THEN 'Medium Margin'
        ELSE 'Low Margin'
    END AS margin_category,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY st.total_net_paid DESC) AS sales_rank,
    slm.prev_month_net_paid,
    (st.total_net_paid - COALESCE(slm.prev_month_net_paid, 0)) AS net_paid_change_from_last_month
FROM site_total st
LEFT JOIN site_last_month slm
  ON st.web_site_sk = slm.web_site_sk AND slm.rn = 1
ORDER BY st.total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH site_quarter_profit AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        w.web_name,
        w.web_state,
        d.d_current_year,
        d.d_quarter_name,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS orders_cnt,
        AVG(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN web_site w ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2022
    GROUP BY ws.ws_web_site_sk, w.web_name, w.web_state, d.d_current_year, d.d_quarter_name
)
SELECT
    sqp.ws_web_site_sk,
    sqp.web_name,
    sqp.web_state,
    sqp.d_current_year,
    sqp.d_quarter_name,
    sqp.total_profit,
    sqp.orders_cnt,
    sqp.avg_sales_price,
    CASE
        WHEN sqp.total_profit >= 200000 THEN 'Platinum'
        WHEN sqp.total_profit >= 100000 THEN 'Gold'
        WHEN sqp.total_profit >= 50000 THEN 'Silver'
        ELSE 'Bronze'
    END AS profit_tier,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sqp.d_current_year, sqp.d_quarter_name ORDER BY sqp.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM site_quarter_profit sqp
ORDER BY sqp.d_current_year, sqp.d_quarter_name, profit_rank

WITH monthly_category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_category,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        w.web_state,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS monthly_sales
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_site w ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2022
    GROUP BY i.i_category, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, w.web_state
)
SELECT
    mcs.i_category,
    mcs.d_year,
    mcs.d_month_seq,
    mcs.web_state,
    mcs.monthly_sales,
    LAG(mcs.monthly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY mcs.i_category, mcs.web_state ORDER BY mcs.d_year, mcs.d_month_seq) AS prev_month_sales,
    CASE
        WHEN LAG(mcs.monthly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY mcs.i_category, mcs.web_state ORDER BY mcs.d_year, mcs.d_month_seq) IS NULL THEN 'N/A'
        WHEN mcs.monthly_sales > LAG(mcs.monthly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY mcs.i_category, mcs.web_state ORDER BY mcs.d_year, mcs.d_month_seq) THEN 'Increase'
        WHEN mcs.monthly_sales < LAG(mcs.monthly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY mcs.i_category, mcs.web_state ORDER BY mcs.d_year, mcs.d_month_seq) THEN 'Decrease'
        ELSE 'Flat'
    END AS sales_trend,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (
            mcs.monthly_sales - COALESCE(LAG(mcs.monthly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY mcs.i_category, mcs.web_state ORDER BY mcs.d_year, mcs.d_month_seq), 0)
        ) / NULLIF(LAG(mcs.monthly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY mcs.i_category, mcs.web_state ORDER BY mcs.d_year, mcs.d_month_seq), 0),
        2
    ) AS pct_change
FROM monthly_category_sales mcs
ORDER BY mcs.i_category, mcs.web_state, mcs.d_year, mcs.d_month_seq

SELECT
    ws.ws_order_number,
    ws.ws_item_sk,
    i.i_category,
    d_sold.d_year,
    d_sold.d_month_seq,
    d_sold.d_date AS sold_date,
    d_ship.d_date AS ship_date,
    DATE_DIFF('day', d_sold.d_date, d_ship.d_date) AS ship_delay_days,
    CASE
        WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', d_sold.d_date, d_ship.d_date) <= 1 THEN 'Same Day'
        WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', d_sold.d_date, d_ship.d_date) <= 3 THEN 'Fast'
        WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', d_sold.d_date, d_ship.d_date) <= 7 THEN 'Normal'
        ELSE 'Slow'
    END AS delay_category,
    ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
    ws.ws_ext_wholesale_cost,
    (ws.ws_ext_sales_price - ws.ws_ext_wholesale_cost) AS gross_profit,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_sold.d_year, d_sold.d_month_seq ORDER BY DATE_DIFF('day', d_sold.d_date, d_ship.d_date) DESC) AS delay_rank_in_month,
    w.web_state,
    w.web_name
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d_ship ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN web_site w ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk
WHERE d_sold.d_year = 2022
  AND ws.ws_quantity > 0
ORDER BY delay_rank_in_month ASC, ws.ws_order_number
LIMIT 200

WITH customer_total AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
           SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
),
top_customers AS (
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk
    FROM customer_total
    ORDER BY total_profit DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
customer_monthly AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS monthly_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS monthly_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        AVG(i.i_current_price) AS avg_item_price,
        w.web_state
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_site w ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_bill_customer_sk IN (SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk FROM top_customers)
    GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, w.web_state
)
SELECT
    cm.ws_bill_customer_sk,
    cm.d_year,
    cm.d_month_seq,
    cm.web_state,
    cm.monthly_profit,
    cm.monthly_sales,
    cm.total_quantity,
    cm.avg_item_price,
    CASE
        WHEN cm.monthly_profit >= 50000 THEN 'Platinum'
        WHEN cm.monthly_profit >= 20000 THEN 'Gold'
        WHEN cm.monthly_profit >= 10000 THEN 'Silver'
        ELSE 'Bronze'
    END AS profit_segment,
    SUM(cm.monthly_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cm.ws_bill_customer_sk ORDER BY cm.d_year, cm.d_month_seq ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3month_profit,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cm.d_year ORDER BY cm.monthly_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_year
FROM customer_monthly cm
ORDER BY cm.monthly_profit DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH sales_agg AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS cust_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales_paid, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(cs.cs_coupon_amt) AS total_coupon FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk), returns_agg AS (SELECT wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk AS cust_sk, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM web_returns wr GROUP BY wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk), most_return_page_counts AS (SELECT wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk AS cust_sk, wr.wr_web_page_sk, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM web_returns wr GROUP BY wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk, wr.wr_web_page_sk), most_return_page_per_cust AS (SELECT cust_sk, wr_web_page_sk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cust_sk ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS rn FROM most_return_page_counts), most_page AS (SELECT cust_sk, wr_web_page_sk FROM most_return_page_per_cust WHERE rn = 1) SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) AS total_sales_profit, COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss, (COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) AS net_contribution, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) > 20000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) > 10000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) > 5000 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS profit_tier, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit,0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0)) DESC) AS profit_rank, wp.wp_url AS most_frequent_return_page FROM customer c LEFT JOIN sales_agg s ON c.c_customer_sk = s.cust_sk LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON c.c_customer_sk = r.cust_sk LEFT JOIN most_page mp ON c.c_customer_sk = mp.cust_sk LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON mp.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk WHERE c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' ORDER BY profit_rank FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

WITH daily_sales AS (SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS units_sold FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk), daily_returns AS (SELECT wr.wr_item_sk AS cs_item_sk, wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS return_amount, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS units_returned FROM web_returns wr GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk, wr.wr_returned_date_sk), combined AS (SELECT s.cs_item_sk, s.date_sk, s.sales_amount, COALESCE(r.return_amount, 0) AS return_amount, s.units_sold, COALESCE(r.units_returned, 0) AS units_returned FROM daily_sales s LEFT JOIN daily_returns r ON s.cs_item_sk = r.cs_item_sk AND s.date_sk = r.date_sk), customer_demo_sales AS (SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, AVG(c.c_birth_month) AS avg_birth_month FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk), most_return_page_counts AS (SELECT wr.wr_item_sk AS cs_item_sk, wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, wr.wr_web_page_sk, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM web_returns wr GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk, wr.wr_returned_date_sk, wr.wr_web_page_sk), most_return_page_per_product_date AS (SELECT cs_item_sk, date_sk, wr_web_page_sk FROM (SELECT cs_item_sk, date_sk, wr_web_page_sk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cs_item_sk, date_sk ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS rn FROM most_return_page_counts) t WHERE rn = 1) SELECT c.cs_item_sk, c.date_sk, c.sales_amount, c.return_amount, (c.sales_amount - c.return_amount) AS net_amount, SUM(c.sales_amount - c.return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.cs_item_sk ORDER BY c.date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net, LAG(c.sales_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.cs_item_sk ORDER BY c.date_sk) AS prev_day_sales, CASE WHEN LAG(c.sales_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.cs_item_sk ORDER BY c.date_sk) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN LAG(c.sales_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.cs_item_sk ORDER BY c.date_sk) = 0 THEN NULL WHEN (c.sales_amount - LAG(c.sales_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.cs_item_sk ORDER BY c.date_sk)) / LAG(c.sales_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.cs_item_sk ORDER BY c.date_sk) > 0.2 THEN 'Surge' ELSE 'Normal' END AS sales_change_flag, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.cs_item_sk ORDER BY (c.sales_amount - c.return_amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_per_day, d.avg_birth_month, wp.wp_url AS most_frequent_return_page_url FROM combined c LEFT JOIN customer_demo_sales d ON c.cs_item_sk = d.cs_item_sk AND c.date_sk = d.date_sk LEFT JOIN most_return_page_per_product_date mrp ON c.cs_item_sk = mrp.cs_item_sk AND c.date_sk = mrp.date_sk LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON mrp.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk WHERE c.sales_amount > 0 ORDER BY c.cs_item_sk, c.date_sk FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY

WITH page_returns AS (SELECT wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers FROM web_returns wr JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url), customer_sales AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS cust_sk, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk), customer_season AS (SELECT c.c_customer_sk, CASE WHEN c.c_birth_month IN (12,1,2) THEN 'Winter' WHEN c.c_birth_month IN (3,4,5) THEN 'Spring' WHEN c.c_birth_month IN (6,7,8) THEN 'Summer' WHEN c.c_birth_month IN (9,10,11) THEN 'Fall' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS birth_season FROM customer c), page_season_stats AS (SELECT pr.wp_web_page_sk, cs.birth_season, COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk) AS customers_in_season FROM page_returns pr JOIN web_returns wr ON pr.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wr_web_page_sk JOIN customer_season cs ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = cs.c_customer_sk GROUP BY pr.wp_web_page_sk, cs.birth_season), page_customer_sales AS (SELECT pr.wp_web_page_sk, SUM(cs.total_sales_amount) AS total_sales_of_return_customers FROM page_returns pr JOIN web_returns wr ON pr.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wr_web_page_sk JOIN customer_sales cs ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = cs.cust_sk GROUP BY pr.wp_web_page_sk) SELECT pr.wp_web_page_sk, pr.wp_url, pr.total_return_amount, pr.total_return_qty, pr.distinct_customers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pr.total_return_amount DESC) AS return_amount_rank, pcs.birth_season, pcs.customers_in_season, pcsales.total_sales_of_return_customers FROM page_returns pr LEFT JOIN page_season_stats pcs ON pr.wp_web_page_sk = pcs.wp_web_page_sk LEFT JOIN page_customer_sales pcsales ON pr.wp_web_page_sk = pcsales.wp_web_page_sk ORDER BY return_amount_rank FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

WITH store_agg AS (
       SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
              SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_net_loss,
              COUNT(*) AS store_return_cnt
       FROM store_returns sr
       WHERE sr.sr_fee > 0
       GROUP BY sr.sr_customer_sk
   ),
   web_agg AS (
       SELECT wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
              SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
              COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt
       FROM web_returns wr
       WHERE wr.wr_fee > 0
       GROUP BY wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk
   ),
   page_agg AS (
       SELECT wp.wp_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
              COUNT(*) AS page_cnt,
              SUM(wp.wp_image_count) AS total_image_count,
              SUM(wp.wp_link_count) AS total_link_count
       FROM web_page wp
       WHERE wp.wp_autogen_flag = 'N'
       GROUP BY wp.wp_customer_sk
   )
SELECT c.c_customer_id,
       c.c_first_name,
       c.c_last_name,
       COALESCE(sa.store_net_loss, 0) AS store_net_loss,
       COALESCE(wa.web_net_loss, 0) AS web_net_loss,
       COALESCE(sa.store_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
       COALESCE(pa.page_cnt, 0) AS page_count,
       COALESCE(pa.total_image_count, 0) AS total_image_count,
       COALESCE(pa.total_link_count, 0) AS total_link_count,
       SUM(COALESCE(sa.store_net_loss,0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_loss,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_birth_country) AS country_total_loss,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_birth_country ORDER BY COALESCE(sa.store_net_loss,0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_loss,0) DESC) AS country_loss_rank,
       NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(sa.store_net_loss,0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_loss,0) DESC) AS loss_quartile
FROM customer c
LEFT JOIN store_agg sa ON sa.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN web_agg wa ON wa.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN page_agg pa ON pa.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1970 AND 2000
  AND (COALESCE(sa.store_net_loss,0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_loss,0)) > 0
ORDER BY loss_quartile, total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 200

WITH store_agg AS (
       SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
              SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_net_loss,
              COUNT(*) AS store_return_cnt,
              AVG(sr.sr_fee) AS avg_store_fee
       FROM store_returns sr
       WHERE sr.sr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2453650   -- filter to a specific year
       GROUP BY sr.sr_customer_sk
   ),
   web_agg AS (
       SELECT wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
              SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
              COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt,
              MAX(wr.wr_return_amt) AS max_web_return_amt
       FROM web_returns wr
       WHERE wr.wr_returned_date_sk >= 2450000
       GROUP BY wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk
   ),
   page_agg AS (
       SELECT wp.wp_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
              COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_sk) AS page_cnt,
              SUM(wp.wp_image_count) AS total_image_count,
              AVG(wp.wp_char_count) AS avg_char_per_page
       FROM web_page wp
       WHERE wp.wp_type = 'article'
       GROUP BY wp.wp_customer_sk
   )
SELECT c.c_customer_id,
       c.c_first_name,
       c.c_last_name,
       COALESCE(sa.store_net_loss, 0) AS store_net_loss,
       COALESCE(wa.web_net_loss, 0) AS web_net_loss,
       COALESCE(sa.store_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
       COALESCE(pa.page_cnt, 0) AS page_count,
       COALESCE(pa.total_image_count, 0) AS total_image_count,
