       AVG(COALESCE(sa.store_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_loss, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_birth_month) AS avg_loss_by_birth_month,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_birth_country ORDER BY COALESCE(sa.store_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_loss, 0) DESC) AS country_loss_rank,
       SUM(COALESCE(sa.store_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_loss, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_birth_year) AS yearly_total_loss
FROM customer c
LEFT JOIN store_agg sa ON sa.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN web_agg wa ON wa.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN page_agg pa ON pa.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE COALESCE(sa.store_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_loss, 0) > 1000   -- higher threshold
ORDER BY c.c_last_name ASC, total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT time_sk,
       wp_type,
       total_loss,
       total_profit,
       net_diff,
       CASE WHEN net_loss_ratio > 1 THEN 'Loss > Profit' ELSE 'Profit >= Loss' END AS loss_profit_flag,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_diff DESC) AS overall_net_diff_rank,
       SUM(total_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type) AS total_loss_by_type,
       SUM(total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type) AS total_profit_by_type
FROM (
  SELECT cr.cr_returned_time_sk AS time_sk,
         wp.wp_type,
         SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_loss,
         SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
         SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) - SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS net_diff,
         (SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) / NULLIF(SUM(ws.ws_net_profit),0)) AS net_loss_ratio
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN web_sales ws ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = ws.ws_sold_time_sk
  JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
  GROUP BY cr.cr_returned_time_sk, wp.wp_type
  HAVING SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 1000
) sub
ORDER BY net_diff DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT time_sk,
       wp_type,
       total_loss,
       total_profit,
       net_diff,
       CASE WHEN net_diff > 0 THEN 'Loss exceeds profit' ELSE 'Profit exceeds loss' END AS diff_category,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type ORDER BY time_sk) AS row_num_by_type,
       SUM(total_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type ORDER BY time_sk ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS future_cum_loss,
       SUM(total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type ORDER BY time_sk ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS future_cum_profit
FROM (
  SELECT cr.cr_returned_time_sk AS time_sk,
         wp.wp_type,
         SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_loss,
         SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
         SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) - SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS net_diff
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN web_sales ws ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = ws.ws_sold_time_sk
  JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
  WHERE wp.wp_type IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY cr.cr_returned_time_sk, wp.wp_type
) sub
WHERE time_sk BETWEEN 20000101 AND 20001231
ORDER BY wp_type, time_sk

WITH daily_inventory AS (SELECT d.d_date, SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_quantity FROM inventory i JOIN date_dim d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date), daily_page_access AS (SELECT d.d_date, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_sk) AS pages_accessed FROM web_page wp JOIN date_dim d ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date), thresholds AS (SELECT approx_percentile(total_quantity, 0.9) AS quantity_90th, avg(pages_accessed) AS avg_pages_accessed FROM daily_inventory di JOIN daily_page_access dpa ON di.d_date = dpa.d_date), combined_scores AS (SELECT di.d_date, di.total_quantity, dpa.pages_accessed, (CASE WHEN di.total_quantity >= t.quantity_90th THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN dpa.pages_accessed >= t.avg_pages_accessed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS score FROM daily_inventory di JOIN daily_page_access dpa ON di.d_date = dpa.d_date CROSS JOIN thresholds t) SELECT cs.d_date, cs.total_quantity, cs.pages_accessed, cs.score, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.score DESC, cs.total_quantity DESC) AS rank_by_score, CASE WHEN cs.score = 2 THEN 'High' WHEN cs.score = 1 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS activity_level FROM combined_scores cs WHERE cs.score > 0 ORDER BY rank_by_score LIMIT 25

WITH monthly_inventory AS (SELECT i.inv_item_sk, d.d_year, d.d_moy, SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS qty_month FROM inventory i JOIN date_dim d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY i.inv_item_sk, d.d_year, d.d_moy), monthly_change AS (SELECT mi.inv_item_sk, mi.d_year, mi.d_moy, mi.qty_month, LAG(mi.qty_month) OVER (PARTITION BY mi.inv_item_sk ORDER BY mi.d_year, mi.d_moy) AS prev_qty_month, CASE WHEN LAG(mi.qty_month) OVER (PARTITION BY mi.inv_item_sk ORDER BY mi.d_year, mi.d_moy) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE mi.qty_month - LAG(mi.qty_month) OVER (PARTITION BY mi.inv_item_sk ORDER BY mi.d_year, mi.d_moy) END AS qty_change, CASE WHEN LAG(mi.qty_month) OVER (PARTITION BY mi.inv_item_sk ORDER BY mi.d_year, mi.d_moy) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE (mi.qty_month - LAG(mi.qty_month) OVER (PARTITION BY mi.inv_item_sk ORDER BY mi.d_year, mi.d_moy)) * 100.0 / LAG(mi.qty_month) OVER (PARTITION BY mi.inv_item_sk ORDER BY mi.d_year, mi.d_moy) END AS pct_change FROM monthly_inventory mi), holiday_stats AS (SELECT d.d_year, d.d_moy, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_holiday IS NOT NULL AND d.d_holiday <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS double) / COUNT(*) AS holiday_ratio FROM date_dim d GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_moy), page_access AS (SELECT d.d_year, d.d_moy, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_sk) AS pages_accessed FROM web_page wp JOIN date_dim d ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_moy) SELECT mc.inv_item_sk, mc.d_year, mc.d_moy, mc.qty_month, mc.prev_qty_month, mc.qty_change, ROUND(mc.pct_change,2) AS pct_change, hs.holiday_ratio, pa.pages_accessed, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY mc.pct_change DESC NULLS LAST) AS change_rank FROM monthly_change mc LEFT JOIN holiday_stats hs ON mc.d_year = hs.d_year AND mc.d_moy = hs.d_moy LEFT JOIN page_access pa ON mc.d_year = pa.d_year AND mc.d_moy = pa.d_moy WHERE mc.prev_qty_month IS NOT NULL ORDER BY change_rank LIMIT 20

WITH latest_month AS (SELECT d_year, d_moy FROM date_dim ORDER BY d_date DESC LIMIT 1), inventory_month AS (SELECT i.inv_warehouse_sk, SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_quantity, d.d_year, d.d_moy FROM inventory i JOIN date_dim d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN latest_month lm ON d.d_year = lm.d_year AND d.d_moy = lm.d_moy GROUP BY i.inv_warehouse_sk, d.d_year, d.d_moy), pages_month AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_sk) AS pages_created, d.d_year, d.d_moy FROM web_page wp JOIN date_dim d ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN latest_month lm ON d.d_year = lm.d_year AND d.d_moy = lm.d_moy GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_moy), sites_month AS (SELECT ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, d.d_year, d.d_moy FROM web_site ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN latest_month lm ON d.d_year = lm.d_year AND d.d_moy = lm.d_moy) SELECT im.inv_warehouse_sk, im.total_quantity, COALESCE(pm.pages_created,0) AS pages_created, s.web_site_id, s.web_name, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY im.total_quantity DESC) AS warehouse_rank FROM inventory_month im LEFT JOIN pages_month pm ON im.d_year = pm.d_year AND im.d_moy = pm.d_moy LEFT JOIN sites_month s ON im.d_year = s.d_year AND im.d_moy = s.d_moy ORDER BY im.total_quantity DESC LIMIT 10

WITH site_inventory AS (SELECT ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.d_date) AS days_active, SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory, AVG(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_daily_inventory FROM web_site ws JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk BETWEEN ws.web_open_date_sk AND ws.web_close_date_sk LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name), site_page_access AS (SELECT ws.web_site_id, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_sk) AS distinct_pages_accessed FROM web_site ws JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk BETWEEN ws.web_open_date_sk AND ws.web_close_date_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY ws.web_site_id) SELECT si.web_site_id, si.web_name, si.days_active, si.total_inventory, si.avg_daily_inventory, spa.distinct_pages_accessed, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY si.avg_daily_inventory DESC) AS site_inventory_rank, CASE WHEN si.days_active = 0 THEN 'Inactive' WHEN si.avg_daily_inventory > 1000 THEN 'High' WHEN si.avg_daily_inventory BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS inventory_level FROM site_inventory si LEFT JOIN site_page_access spa ON si.web_site_id = spa.web_site_id ORDER BY site_inventory_rank LIMIT 15

WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
           SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS cs_daily_sales,
           SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS cs_daily_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    GROUP BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk
),
 daily_store AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
           SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS ss_daily_sales,
           SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS ss_daily_profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    GROUP BY ss.ss_sold_date_sk
),
 daily_returns AS (
    SELECT wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
           SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS wr_daily_returns,
           SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS wr_daily_loss
    FROM web_returns wr
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returned_date_sk
),
 daily_combined AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(cs.date_sk, ss.date_sk, wr.date_sk) AS date_sk,
           COALESCE(cs.cs_daily_sales, 0) + COALESCE(ss.ss_daily_sales, 0) AS total_sales,
           COALESCE(cs.cs_daily_profit, 0) + COALESCE(ss.ss_daily_profit, 0) AS total_profit,
           COALESCE(wr.wr_daily_returns, 0) AS total_returns,
           COALESCE(wr.wr_daily_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss
    FROM daily_sales cs
    FULL OUTER JOIN daily_store ss ON cs.date_sk = ss.date_sk
    FULL OUTER JOIN daily_returns wr ON COALESCE(cs.date_sk, ss.date_sk) = wr.date_sk
)
SELECT
    date_sk,
    total_sales,
    total_profit,
    total_returns,
    total_return_loss,
    total_sales - total_returns AS net_sales,
    total_profit - total_return_loss AS net_profit,
    CASE 
        WHEN total_profit - total_return_loss > 50000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN total_profit - total_return_loss > 20000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS profit_bucket,
    SUM(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_sales,
    SUM(total_profit) OVER (ORDER BY date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_loss DESC) AS return_loss_rank
FROM daily_combined
WHERE date_sk IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY date_sk
LIMIT 30

WITH cs_sales AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_item_sk,
           cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk AS cd_demo_sk,
           SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS cs_sales,
           SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS cs_quantity,
           COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS cs_orders
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
),
ss_sales AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk,
           ss.ss_cdemo_sk AS cd_demo_sk,
           SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS ss_sales,
           SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS ss_quantity,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS ss_orders
    FROM store_sales ss
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_cdemo_sk
),
returns AS (
    SELECT wr.wr_item_sk,
           wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk AS cd_demo_sk,
           SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS return_sales,
           SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS return_quantity,
           COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_order_number) AS return_orders
    FROM web_returns wr
    GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk, wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
),
sales_combined AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(cs.cs_item_sk, ss.ss_item_sk) AS item_sk,
        COALESCE(cs.cd_demo_sk, ss.cd_demo_sk, r.cd_demo_sk) AS cd_demo_sk,
        COALESCE(cs.cs_sales, 0) + COALESCE(ss.ss_sales, 0) AS total_sales,
        COALESCE(cs.cs_quantity, 0) + COALESCE(ss.ss_quantity, 0) AS total_quantity,
        COALESCE(cs.cs_orders, 0) + COALESCE(ss.ss_orders, 0) AS total_transactions,
        COALESCE(r.return_sales, 0) AS total_return_sales,
        COALESCE(r.return_quantity, 0) AS total_return_quantity,
        COALESCE(r.return_orders, 0) AS total_return_orders
    FROM cs_sales cs
    FULL OUTER JOIN ss_sales ss
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND cs.cd_demo_sk = ss.cd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN returns r
        ON COALESCE(cs.cs_item_sk, ss.ss_item_sk) = r.wr_item_sk
        AND COALESCE(cs.cd_demo_sk, ss.cd_demo_sk) = r.cd_demo_sk
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        sc.item_sk,
        cd.cd_gender,
        cd.cd_marital_status,
        sc.total_sales,
        sc.total_return_sales,
        CASE 
            WHEN sc.total_sales = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE sc.total_return_sales / sc.total_sales
        END AS return_ratio,
        CASE 
            WHEN sc.total_sales = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE sc.total_sales - sc.total_return_sales
        END AS net_sales_after_return
    FROM sales_combined sc
    LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sc.cd_demo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE sc.total_sales > 0
)
SELECT
    item_sk,
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    total_sales,
    total_return_sales,
    return_ratio,
    net_sales_after_return,
    CASE 
        WHEN return_ratio > 0.5 THEN 'Very High'
        WHEN return_ratio > 0.3 THEN 'High'
        WHEN return_ratio > 0.1 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS return_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd_gender ORDER BY return_ratio DESC) AS gender_return_rank,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_sales_after_return DESC) AS net_sales_rank
FROM final
ORDER BY net_sales_rank
LIMIT 20

WITH cust_return_stats AS ( SELECT rc.c_customer_id, rc.c_birth_month, r.r_reason_desc, i.i_category, i.i_brand, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, AVG(wr.wr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer rc ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = rc.c_customer_sk JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY rc.c_customer_id, rc.c_birth_month, r.r_reason_desc, i.i_category, i.i_brand ) SELECT crs.c_customer_id, crs.c_birth_month, crs.r_reason_desc, crs.i_category, crs.i_brand, crs.total_return_amt, crs.return_cnt, crs.avg_return_amt, CASE WHEN crs.c_birth_month BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN 'H1' ELSE 'H2' END AS birth_half, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY crs.r_reason_desc ORDER BY crs.total_return_amt DESC) AS reason_category_rank FROM cust_return_stats crs WHERE crs.return_cnt >= 5 ORDER BY crs.r_reason_desc, reason_category_rank LIMIT 50

WITH customer_class_returns AS ( SELECT rc.c_customer_sk, rc.c_customer_id, i.i_class, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT i.i_item_sk) AS distinct_items, COUNT(DISTINCT i.i_class) OVER (PARTITION BY rc.c_customer_sk) AS total_distinct_classes_for_customer FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer rc ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = rc.c_customer_sk JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk WHERE r.r_reason_desc = 'Damaged' GROUP BY rc.c_customer_sk, rc.c_customer_id, i.i_class ) SELECT ccr.c_customer_id, ccr.i_class, ccr.total_return_qty, ccr.distinct_items, CASE WHEN ccr.total_distinct_classes_for_customer > 3 THEN 'Multi-Class' ELSE 'Single-Class' END AS customer_class_scope, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ccr.i_class ORDER BY ccr.total_return_qty DESC) AS class_customer_rank FROM customer_class_returns ccr WHERE ccr.total_return_qty > 0 ORDER BY ccr.i_class, class_customer_rank LIMIT 100

WITH monthly_reason_loss AS ( SELECT r.r_reason_desc, i.i_category, wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS return_date, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS monthly_net_loss, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS monthly_return_qty FROM web_returns wr JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer rc ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = rc.c_customer_sk WHERE rc.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc, i.i_category, wr.wr_returned_date_sk ), monthly_change AS ( SELECT mr.r_reason_desc, mr.i_category, mr.return_date, mr.monthly_net_loss, mr.monthly_return_qty, LAG(mr.monthly_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY mr.r_reason_desc, mr.i_category ORDER BY mr.return_date) AS prev_month_net_loss, LAG(mr.monthly_return_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY mr.r_reason_desc, mr.i_category ORDER BY mr.return_date) AS prev_month_return_qty FROM monthly_reason_loss mr ) SELECT mc.r_reason_desc, mc.i_category, mc.return_date, mc.monthly_net_loss, mc.monthly_return_qty, CASE WHEN mc.prev_month_net_loss IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN mc.monthly_net_loss > mc.prev_month_net_loss * 1.2 THEN 'Significant Increase' ELSE 'Normal' END AS net_loss_change_flag, CASE WHEN mc.prev_month_return_qty IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN mc.monthly_return_qty > mc.prev_month_return_qty * 1.2 THEN 'Significant Qty Increase' ELSE 'Normal' END AS return_qty_change_flag, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY mc.monthly_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank FROM monthly_change mc WHERE mc.monthly_net_loss > 0 ORDER BY mc.r_reason_desc, mc.return_date DESC LIMIT 100

WITH customer_loss AS ( SELECT rc.c_customer_sk, rc.c_customer_id, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, SUM(i.i_wholesale_cost * wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_wholesale_cost FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer rc ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = rc.c_customer_sk JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY rc.c_customer_sk, rc.c_customer_id ), customer_top_reason AS ( SELECT rc.c_customer_sk, r.r_reason_desc, COUNT(*) AS reason_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rc.c_customer_sk ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer rc ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = rc.c_customer_sk JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY rc.c_customer_sk, r.r_reason_desc ) SELECT cl.c_customer_id, cl.total_net_loss, cl.return_cnt, cl.total_wholesale_cost, ctr.r_reason_desc AS top_reason, ctr.reason_cnt AS top_reason_cnt, CASE WHEN cl.total_net_loss > 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS loss_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cl.total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM customer_loss cl LEFT JOIN customer_top_reason ctr ON cl.c_customer_sk = ctr.c_customer_sk AND ctr.rn = 1 ORDER BY loss_rank LIMIT 10

SELECT
    i.i_manufact,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(ss.ss_quantity) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) / SUM(ss.ss_quantity)
    END AS profit_per_unit,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_manufact ORDER BY SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank_within_manufact,
    SUM(SUM(ss.ss_net_profit)) OVER (
        PARTITION BY i.i_manufact
        ORDER BY i.i_item_id
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_profit_by_manufact
FROM store_sales ss
INNER JOIN item i
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN customer c
    ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE cd.cd_credit_rating = 'Excellent'
GROUP BY i.i_manufact, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name
HAVING SUM(ss.ss_quantity) > 10
ORDER BY i.i_manufact, profit_rank_within_manufact
LIMIT 100

WITH brand_customer_sales AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_brand,
        c.c_customer_id,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        cd.cd_gender,
        cd.cd_marital_status
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN item i
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY i.i_brand, c.c_customer_id, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status
)
SELECT
    i_brand,
    c_customer_id,
    total_net_profit,
    transaction_count,
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_brand ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS brand_customer_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN total_net_profit > 10000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN total_net_profit > 5000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS profit_category
FROM brand_customer_sales
WHERE transaction_count >= 5
ORDER BY i_brand, brand_customer_rank
LIMIT 50

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_id, ws.web_site_sk, ws.web_name, w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_name, s.ws_item_sk, SUM(s.ws_net_profit) AS item_profit, SUM(s.ws_ext_sales_price) AS item_sales, SUM(s.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS item_discount, CASE WHEN SUM(s.ws_ext_discount_amt) > 0.5 * SUM(s.ws_ext_sales_price) THEN 'High Discount' ELSE 'Normal Discount' END AS discount_flag, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_promo_sk, ws.web_site_sk ORDER BY SUM(s.ws_net_profit) DESC) AS rn FROM web_sales s JOIN promotion p ON s.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN web_site ws ON s.ws_web_site_sk = ws.web_site_sk JOIN warehouse w ON s.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_id, ws.web_site_sk, ws.web_name, w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_name, s.ws_item_sk ) sub WHERE sub.rn <= 5 ORDER BY sub.p_promo_sk, sub.web_site_sk, sub.rn

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_name, p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, CASE WHEN p.p_cost > 1000 THEN 'High Cost' ELSE 'Low Cost' END AS cost_category, ws.web_site_sk, ws.web_name, SUM(s.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(s.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(s.ws_ext_discount_amt) / NULLIF(SUM(s.ws_ext_sales_price), 0) AS avg_discount_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY SUM(s.ws_ext_sales_price) DESC) AS promo_rank FROM web_sales s JOIN promotion p ON s.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN warehouse w ON s.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN web_site ws ON s.ws_web_site_sk = ws.web_site_sk GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_name, p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_cost, ws.web_site_sk, ws.web_name ) t WHERE t.promo_rank <= 3 ORDER BY t.w_warehouse_sk, t.promo_rank

SELECT web_site_sk, web_name, sale_date_sk, daily_sales, daily_profit, SUM(daily_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY web_site_sk ORDER BY sale_date_sk) AS cumulative_sales, SUM(daily_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY web_site_sk ORDER BY sale_date_sk) AS cumulative_profit, CASE WHEN MOD(sale_date_sk, 4) = 0 THEN 'Q4' WHEN MOD(sale_date_sk, 3) = 0 THEN 'Q3' WHEN MOD(sale_date_sk, 2) = 0 THEN 'Q2' ELSE 'Q1' END AS quarter_bucket, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY web_site_sk, CASE WHEN MOD(sale_date_sk, 4) = 0 THEN 'Q4' WHEN MOD(sale_date_sk, 3) = 0 THEN 'Q3' WHEN MOD(sale_date_sk, 2) = 0 THEN 'Q2' ELSE 'Q1' END) AS days_in_quarter FROM ( SELECT ws.web_site_sk AS web_site_sk, ws.web_name AS web_name, s.ws_sold_date_sk AS sale_date_sk, SUM(s.ws_ext_sales_price) AS daily_sales, SUM(s.ws_net_profit) AS daily_profit FROM web_sales s JOIN web_site ws ON s.ws_web_site_sk = ws.web_site_sk JOIN promotion p ON s.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN warehouse w ON s.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk GROUP BY ws.web_site_sk, ws.web_name, s.ws_sold_date_sk ) d ORDER BY web_site_sk, sale_date_sk

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_name, AVG(s.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_per_sale, AVG(s.ws_ext_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price, SUM(s.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit, CASE WHEN AVG(s.ws_ext_discount_amt) > 0.2 * AVG(s.ws_ext_sales_price) THEN 'Aggressive' ELSE 'Conservative' END AS discount_strategy, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY AVG(s.ws_ext_discount_amt) DESC) AS promo_discount_rank FROM web_sales s JOIN promotion p ON s.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN warehouse w ON s.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN web_site ws ON s.ws_web_site_sk = ws.web_site_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_name HAVING SUM(s.ws_ext_sales_price) > 0 ) t WHERE t.promo_discount_rank = 1 ORDER BY t.w_warehouse_sk, t.avg_discount_per_sale DESC

WITH page_returns AS ( SELECT wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url, d_access.d_year, d_access.d_month_seq, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS monthly_return_amount FROM web_page wp JOIN date_dim d_access ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d_access.d_date_sk JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_access.d_date_sk WHERE d_access.d_year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023 GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url, d_access.d_year, d_access.d_month_seq ) SELECT wp_web_page_sk, wp_url, d_year, d_month_seq, monthly_return_amount, SUM(monthly_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_web_page_sk ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY monthly_return_amount DESC) AS yearly_page_rank FROM page_returns WHERE monthly_return_amount > 0 ORDER BY cumulative_return_amount DESC LIMIT 10

WITH cc_yearly AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_tax_percentage, d_open.d_year AS open_year, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, CASE WHEN cc.cc_tax_percentage < 5 THEN 'Low' WHEN cc.cc_tax_percentage BETWEEN 5 AND 10 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS tax_bucket FROM call_center cc JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN date_dim d_return ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_open ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk WHERE d_return.d_year = d_open.d_year GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_tax_percentage, d_open.d_year ) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, open_year, tax_bucket, total_net_loss, total_return_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tax_bucket ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank FROM cc_yearly ORDER BY tax_bucket, net_loss_rank LIMIT 20

WITH quarterly_agg AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, d_return.d_year, d_return.d_quarter_seq, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, AVG(cr.cr_fee) AS avg_fee, CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) < 0 THEN 'Loss' ELSE 'Profit' END AS performance FROM call_center cc JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN date_dim d_return ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d_return.d_date_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, d_return.d_year, d_return.d_quarter_seq ) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, d_year, d_quarter_seq, total_net_loss, avg_fee, performance, AVG(total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_sk ORDER BY d_year, d_quarter_seq ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3q_net_loss FROM quarterly_agg WHERE d_year >= 2020 ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC LIMIT 15

WITH reason_agg AS ( SELECT dr.d_year, cc.cc_name, wp.wp_url, cr.cr_reason_sk, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) < 100 THEN 'Small' WHEN SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) < 1000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS return_size_bucket FROM call_center cc JOIN date_dim d_open ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN date_dim dr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk WHERE d_open.d_year = dr.d_year GROUP BY dr.d_year, cc.cc_name, wp.wp_url, cr.cr_reason_sk HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT d_year, cc_name, wp_url, cr_reason_sk, total_return_amount, return_cnt, return_size_bucket, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, return_size_bucket ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS size_bucket_rank FROM reason_agg ORDER BY d_year, return_size_bucket, size_bucket_rank LIMIT 30

WITH sales_with_dim AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_net_paid,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_ext_discount_amt,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        d.d_date,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        t.t_hour,
        t.t_meal_time,
        ws.web_site_sk,
        ws.web_name,
        d.d_week_seq
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN web_site ws ON d.d_date_sk BETWEEN ws.web_open_date_sk AND ws.web_close_date_sk
    WHERE ws.web_state = 'CA'
), weekly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        csd.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        csd.d_week_seq,
        SUM(csd.cs_net_paid) AS week_net_paid,
        SUM(csd.cs_net_profit) AS week_net_profit
    FROM sales_with_dim csd
    GROUP BY csd.cs_bill_customer_sk, csd.d_week_seq
), customer_aggregates AS (
    SELECT
        ws.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.d_week_seq) AS active_weeks,
        SUM(ws.week_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ws.week_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(ws.week_net_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(ws.week_net_paid), 0) AS profit_margin
    FROM weekly_sales ws
    GROUP BY ws.cs_bill_customer_sk
), customer_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ca.*, 
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
        CASE WHEN ca.profit_margin > 0.4 THEN 'Gold' WHEN ca.profit_margin > 0.2 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS tier
    FROM customer_aggregates ca
), recent_purchases AS (
    SELECT
        csd.cs_bill_customer_sk,
        csd.cs_order_number,
        csd.cs_net_paid,
        csd.cs_net_profit,
        csd.d_date,
        csd.web_name,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY csd.cs_bill_customer_sk ORDER BY csd.d_date DESC) AS recent_rank,
        SUM(csd.cs_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY csd.cs_bill_customer_sk ORDER BY csd.d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit
    FROM sales_with_dim csd
    WHERE csd.d_date >= DATE '2022-01-01'
)
SELECT
    cr.cs_bill_customer_sk,
    cr.active_weeks,
    cr.total_net_paid,
    cr.total_net_profit,
    cr.profit_margin,
    cr.profit_rank,
    cr.tier,
    rp.cs_order_number,
    rp.d_date,
    rp.web_name,
    rp.recent_rank,
    rp.cumulative_profit
FROM customer_ranked cr
JOIN recent_purchases rp ON cr.cs_bill_customer_sk = rp.cs_bill_customer_sk
WHERE rp.recent_rank <= 3
ORDER BY cr.profit_rank, rp.recent_rank

WITH reason_agg AS (
   SELECT
       r.r_reason_sk,
       r.r_reason_desc,
       CASE 
           WHEN LOWER(r.r_reason_desc) LIKE '%customer%' THEN 'Customer'
           WHEN LOWER(r.r_reason_desc) LIKE '%system%' THEN 'System'
           ELSE 'Other'
       END AS reason_category,
       s.s_state,
       COUNT(*) AS total_returns,
       SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
       AVG(sr.sr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt,
       SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_loss_per_return
   FROM store_returns sr
   JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
   JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
   GROUP BY r.r_reason_sk, r.r_reason_desc, s.s_state
)
SELECT
   r_reason_sk,
   r_reason_desc,
   reason_category,
   s_state,
   total_returns,
   total_net_loss,
   avg_return_amt,
   avg_loss_per_return,
   DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_loss_per_return DESC) AS loss_per_return_rank,
   SUM(total_returns) OVER (PARTITION BY s_state) AS state_total_returns,
   SUM(total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY s_state) AS state_total_loss,
   PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_loss_per_return DESC) AS loss_per_return_percentile
FROM reason_agg
ORDER BY loss_per_return_rank
LIMIT 20

WITH demo_store_agg AS (
   SELECT
       hd.hd_income_band_sk,
       hd.hd_vehicle_count,
       hd.hd_dep_count,
       hd.hd_buy_potential,
       s.s_state,
       COUNT(*) AS num_returns,
       SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
       SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity,
       AVG(sr.sr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss_per_return,
       CASE 
           WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 30000 THEN 'High'
           WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) BETWEEN 10000 AND 30000 THEN 'Medium'
           ELSE 'Low'
       END AS loss_level
   FROM store_returns sr
   JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
   JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
   GROUP BY hd.hd_income_band_sk, hd.hd_vehicle_count, hd.hd_dep_count, hd.hd_buy_potential, s.s_state
)
SELECT
   hd_income_band_sk,
   hd_vehicle_count,
   hd_dep_count,
   hd_buy_potential,
   s_state,
   num_returns,
   total_net_loss,
   total_return_quantity,
   avg_net_loss_per_return,
   loss_level,
   NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY s_state ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_quintile_state,
   PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s_state ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_percentile_state,
   CASE WHEN loss_level = 'High' AND total_return_quantity > 100 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Normal' END AS risk_flag
FROM demo_store_agg
ORDER BY s_state, net_loss_quintile_state, hd_income_band_sk
LIMIT 50

WITH store_agg AS (
   SELECT
       s.s_store_sk,
       s.s_store_id,
       s.s_store_name,
       s.s_city,
       s.s_state,
       SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
       SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amt_inc_tax,
       SUM(sr.sr_store_credit) AS total_store_credit,
       SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity,
       SUM(CASE WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = 'HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS pct_high_buy_potential,
       CASE WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 50000 THEN 'High Loss' ELSE 'Moderate/Low Loss' END AS loss_category
   FROM store_returns sr
   JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
   JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
   GROUP BY s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state
)
SELECT
   s_store_id,
   s_store_name,
   s_city,
   s_state,
   total_net_loss,
   total_return_amt_inc_tax,
   total_store_credit,
   total_return_quantity,
   pct_high_buy_potential,
   loss_category,
   RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank,
   ROUND(total_net_loss / NULLIF(total_return_quantity, 0), 2) AS avg_loss_per_item
FROM store_agg
ORDER BY net_loss_rank
LIMIT 20

WITH latest_return AS (
   SELECT
       sr.sr_returned_date_sk,
       sr.sr_return_time_sk,
       sr.sr_store_sk,
       s.s_store_id,
       s.s_store_name,
       sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax,
       sr.sr_net_loss,
       r.r_reason_desc,
       hd.hd_buy_potential,
       SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_store_sk ORDER BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk, sr.sr_return_time_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_loss,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_store_sk ORDER BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk DESC, sr.sr_return_time_sk DESC) AS rn,
       CASE WHEN sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax > 500 THEN 'Large Return' ELSE 'Small Return' END AS return_size_category
   FROM store_returns sr
   JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
   LEFT JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
   LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
)
SELECT
   s_store_id,
   s_store_name,
   sr_returned_date_sk,
   sr_return_time_sk,
   sr_return_amt_inc_tax,
   sr_net_loss,
   cumulative_net_loss,
   return_size_category,
   r_reason_desc,
   hd_buy_potential
FROM latest_return
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY cumulative_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 25

WITH hourly_category_returns AS ( SELECT wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, t.t_hour AS hour, i.i_category AS category, hd.hd_buy_potential AS buy_potential, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS net_loss, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_qty, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM web_returns wr INNER JOIN time_dim t ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk INNER JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY wr.wr_returned_date_sk, t.t_hour, i.i_category, hd.hd_buy_potential ) SELECT date_sk, hour, category, buy_potential, net_loss, total_qty, return_cnt, LAG(net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY date_sk, category, buy_potential ORDER BY hour) AS prev_hour_net_loss, net_loss - LAG(net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY date_sk, category, buy_potential ORDER BY hour) AS net_loss_change, CASE WHEN net_loss - LAG(net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY date_sk, category, buy_potential ORDER BY hour) > 0 THEN 'Increase' WHEN net_loss - LAG(net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY date_sk, category, buy_potential ORDER BY hour) < 0 THEN 'Decrease' ELSE 'Stable' END AS net_loss_trend FROM hourly_category_returns WHERE net_loss IS NOT NULL ORDER BY date_sk, category, buy_potential, hour LIMIT 300

WITH returns_enriched AS ( SELECT wr.wr_order_number, wr.wr_return_amt, wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax, wr.wr_net_loss, wr.wr_return_quantity, wr.wr_item_sk, wr.wr_returned_time_sk, wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk, wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_brand, t.t_hour, t.t_meal_time, r_hd.hd_buy_potential AS returning_buy_potential, r_hd2.hd_buy_potential AS refunded_buy_potential FROM web_returns wr INNER JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk INNER JOIN time_dim t ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk INNER JOIN household_demographics r_hd ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = r_hd.hd_demo_sk INNER JOIN household_demographics r_hd2 ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = r_hd2.hd_demo_sk WHERE wr.wr_return_amt > 0 ), item_agg AS ( SELECT i_category, i_item_id, i_product_name, SUM(wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_count, AVG(wr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss, SUM(CASE WHEN returning_buy_potential = 'High' THEN wr_net_loss ELSE 0 END) AS high_potential_net_loss, SUM(CASE WHEN returning_buy_potential = 'Low' THEN wr_net_loss ELSE 0 END) AS low_potential_net_loss FROM returns_enriched GROUP BY i_category, i_item_id, i_product_name HAVING SUM(wr_net_loss) > 0 ) SELECT i_category AS category, i_item_id AS item_id, i_product_name AS product_name, total_net_loss, return_count, avg_net_loss, high_potential_net_loss, low_potential_net_loss, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS category_net_loss_rank FROM item_agg ORDER BY i_category, category_net_loss_rank LIMIT 20

WITH customer_returns AS ( SELECT wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS cust_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential AS buy_potential, hd.hd_income_band_sk AS income_band, i.i_brand AS brand, i.i_category AS category, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(*) AS return_events FROM web_returns wr INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk INNER JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk INNER JOIN time_dim t ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential, hd.hd_income_band_sk, i.i_brand, i.i_category ) SELECT cust_sk, buy_potential, income_band, brand, category, total_return_amount, total_net_loss, total_quantity, return_events, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank, SUM(total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY buy_potential ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_loss_by_potential, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'Very High' WHEN total_net_loss > 2000 THEN 'High' WHEN total_net_loss > 1000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS loss_level FROM customer_returns WHERE total_return_amount > 100 ORDER BY loss_rank LIMIT 20

WITH demo_item_time AS ( SELECT wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk AS demo_sk, hd.hd_income_band_sk AS income_band, hd.hd_vehicle_count AS vehicle_count, hd.hd_dep_count AS dep_count, i.i_category AS item_category, t.t_hour AS hour_of_day, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_events, AVG(wr.wr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amount FROM web_returns wr INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk INNER JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk INNER JOIN time_dim t ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk, hd.hd_income_band_sk, hd.hd_vehicle_count, hd.hd_dep_count, i.i_category, t.t_hour ) SELECT demo_sk, income_band, vehicle_count, dep_count, item_category, hour_of_day, total_return_amount, total_net_loss, avg_return_amount, total_quantity, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY item_category ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_percentile_by_category, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 2000 THEN 'Very High Loss' WHEN total_net_loss > 1000 THEN 'High Loss' WHEN total_net_loss > 500 THEN 'Medium Loss' ELSE 'Low Loss' END AS loss_category FROM demo_item_time WHERE total_return_amount > 0 ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC LIMIT 100

WITH item_state_sales AS ( SELECT ws.ws_item_sk, w.w_state, AVG(ws.ws_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price, AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt, CASE cd_bill.cd_credit_rating WHEN 'A' THEN 3 WHEN 'B' THEN 2 WHEN 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS credit_score, CASE cd_ship.cd_marital_status WHEN 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS marital_score FROM web_sales ws INNER JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd_bill ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_bill.cd_demo_sk INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd_ship ON ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk = cd_ship.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, w.w_state, cd_bill.cd_credit_rating, cd_ship.cd_marital_status ) SELECT iss.ws_item_sk AS item_sk, iss.w_state AS state, iss.avg_sales_price, iss.sales_cnt, CASE WHEN iss.avg_discount < 5 THEN 'Low Discount' WHEN iss.avg_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 20 THEN 'Medium Discount' ELSE 'High Discount' END AS discount_category, ROUND(iss.avg_sales_price * (1 + iss.credit_score * 0.05 + iss.marital_score * 0.02), 2) AS adjusted_avg_price, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY iss.w_state ORDER BY iss.avg_sales_price DESC) AS state_item_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY iss.avg_sales_price DESC) AS global_item_rank FROM item_state_sales iss WHERE iss.sales_cnt >= 10 ORDER BY iss.w_state, state_item_rank

WITH inv_by_wh_date AS ( SELECT inv.inv_warehouse_sk, inv.inv_date_sk, SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS inv_qty FROM inventory inv GROUP BY inv.inv_warehouse_sk, inv.inv_date_sk ), sales_by_wh_date AS ( SELECT ws.ws_warehouse_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS sales_qty FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_warehouse_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk ), joined AS ( SELECT w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_state, COALESCE(i.inv_date_sk, s.ws_sold_date_sk) AS date_sk, COALESCE(i.inv_qty, 0) AS total_inventory_qty, COALESCE(s.sales_qty, 0) AS total_sales_qty FROM warehouse w LEFT JOIN inv_by_wh_date i ON w.w_warehouse_sk = i.inv_warehouse_sk LEFT JOIN sales_by_wh_date s ON w.w_warehouse_sk = s.ws_warehouse_sk AND i.inv_date_sk = s.ws_sold_date_sk ) SELECT j.w_warehouse_name, j.w_state, j.date_sk, j.total_inventory_qty, j.total_sales_qty, CASE WHEN j.total_inventory_qty < j.total_sales_qty THEN 'Understocked' WHEN j.total_inventory_qty = j.total_sales_qty THEN 'Balanced' ELSE 'Overstocked' END AS stock_status, (j.total_inventory_qty / NULLIF(j.total_sales_qty, 0)) AS inventory_sales_ratio, AVG(j.total_inventory_qty / NULLIF(j.total_sales_qty, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY j.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY j.date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY j.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY j.total_inventory_qty DESC) AS inventory_qty_rank FROM joined j WHERE j.total_sales_qty > 0 ORDER BY j.w_warehouse_name, j.date_sk

WITH sales_month AS (
   SELECT 
      mod(cast(ss.ss_sold_date_sk / 100 as integer), 100) AS month,
      ss.ss_net_profit AS net_profit,
      ss.ss_quantity AS qty,
      ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk
   FROM store_sales ss
   UNION ALL
   SELECT 
      mod(cast(ws.ws_sold_date_sk / 100 as integer), 100) AS month,
      ws.ws_net_profit AS net_profit,
      ws.ws_quantity AS qty,
      ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk
   FROM web_sales ws
),
monthly_stats AS (
   SELECT
      month,
      SUM(net_profit) AS total_profit,
      SUM(qty) AS total_qty,
      MIN(date_sk) AS first_sale_sk,
      MAX(date_sk) AS last_sale_sk
   FROM sales_month
   GROUP BY month
),
recent_months AS (
   SELECT month, total_profit, total_qty,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY last_sale_sk DESC) AS recent_rank
   FROM monthly_stats
)
SELECT 
   c.c_customer_id,
   c.c_first_name,
   c.c_last_name,
   c.c_birth_month,
   cd.cd_education_status,
   rm.total_profit AS birth_month_total_profit,
   CASE WHEN c.c_birth_month = rm.month THEN 'MostRecentMonth' ELSE 'Other' END AS recent_flag,
   NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY rm.total_profit DESC) AS profit_quartile
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN recent_months rm ON c.c_birth_month = rm.month
WHERE rm.recent_rank <= 5
ORDER BY rm.total_profit DESC, c.c_customer_id
LIMIT 30

WITH sales_month AS (
   SELECT 
      mod(cast(ss.ss_sold_date_sk / 100 as integer), 100) AS month,
      ss.ss_net_profit AS net_profit,
      ss.ss_ext_discount_amt AS discount
   FROM store_sales ss
   UNION ALL
   SELECT 
      mod(cast(ws.ws_sold_date_sk / 100 as integer), 100) AS month,
      ws.ws_net_profit AS net_profit,
      ws.ws_ext_discount_amt AS discount
   FROM web_sales ws
),
monthly_stats AS (
   SELECT
      month,
      SUM(net_profit) AS total_profit,
      AVG(discount) AS avg_discount,
      COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt
   FROM sales_month
   GROUP BY month
),
profit_change AS (
   SELECT
      month,
      total_profit,
      LAG(total_profit) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_total_profit,
      total_profit - LAG(total_profit) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS profit_delta
   FROM monthly_stats
),
significant_months AS (
   SELECT month, total_profit, profit_delta
   FROM profit_change
   WHERE profit_delta IS NOT NULL AND profit_delta > 0 AND profit_delta > 1000
)
SELECT 
   c.c_customer_id,
   c.c_first_name,
   c.c_last_name,
   c.c_birth_month,
   cd.cd_credit_rating,
   sm.total_profit AS birth_month_total_profit,
   CASE WHEN c.c_birth_month = sm.month THEN 'ProfitIncreaseMonth' ELSE 'Other' END AS profit_month_flag,
   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.month ORDER BY c.c_customer_id) AS rn_in_month
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN significant_months sm ON c.c_birth_month = sm.month
WHERE cd.cd_credit_rating = 'A'
ORDER BY sm.profit_delta DESC, c.c_customer_id
LIMIT 10

WITH city_income_sales AS (
    SELECT ca.ca_state,
           ca.ca_city,
           ib.ib_income_band_sk,
           SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
           AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
           SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    WHERE ca.ca_state IN ('CA', 'TX', 'NY')
    GROUP BY ca.ca_state, ca.ca_city, ib.ib_income_band_sk
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 10000
)
SELECT ca_state,
       ca_city,
       ib_income_band_sk,
       total_sales,
       avg_discount,
       distinct_customers,
       total_quantity,
       NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_quartile,
       CASE WHEN avg_discount > 30 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Normal' END AS discount_flag
FROM city_income_sales
WHERE total_quantity BETWEEN 5 AND 500
ORDER BY ca_state, sales_quartile DESC
LIMIT 25

WITH city_income_sales AS (
    SELECT ca.ca_state,
           ca.ca_city,
           ib.ib_income_band_sk,
           SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
           AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
           SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
           COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    GROUP BY ca.ca_state, ca.ca_city, ib.ib_income_band_sk
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 20
)
SELECT ca_state,
       ca_city,
       ib_income_band_sk,
       total_sales,
       avg_discount,
       distinct_customers,
       total_quantity,
       transaction_count,
       CASE WHEN distinct_customers / NULLIF(transaction_count,0) > 0.5 THEN 'Loyal' ELSE 'Casual' END AS customer_type,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank_state,
       SUM(total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state) AS state_total_sales
FROM city_income_sales
WHERE total_sales BETWEEN 5000 AND 200000
ORDER BY ca_state, sales_rank_state DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH sales_with_time AS (SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_net_profit, ss.ss_ext_tax, ss.ss_ext_discount_amt, ss.ss_ext_list_price, ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_item_sk, td.t_shift FROM store_sales ss JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk) SELECT s.s_manager, s.s_division_name, s.s_division_id, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_store_sk) AS store_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN sw.t_shift = 'Morning' THEN sw.ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS morning_adj_profit, SUM(CASE WHEN sw.t_shift <> 'Morning' THEN sw.ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS other_adj_profit, SUM(sw.ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_adj_profit, AVG(s.s_tax_percentage) AS avg_store_tax, AVG(CASE WHEN sw.ss_ext_list_price > 0 THEN sw.ss_ext_discount_amt / sw.ss_ext_list_price END) AS avg_discount_ratio, CASE WHEN SUM(sw.ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) >= 500000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN SUM(sw.ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) BETWEEN 200000 AND 499999.99 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS profit_tier, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_division_id ORDER BY SUM(sw.ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) DESC) AS manager_division_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(sw.ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) DESC) AS overall_manager_rank FROM store s JOIN sales_with_time sw ON sw.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk AND sr.sr_ticket_number = sw.ss_ticket_number AND sr.sr_item_sk = sw.ss_item_sk GROUP BY s.s_manager, s.s_division_name, s.s_division_id HAVING SUM(sw.ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) > 0 ORDER BY total_adj_profit DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state, SUM(sw.ss_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit, COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) AS total_return_loss, SUM(sw.ss_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) AS net_margin, CASE WHEN SUM(sw.ss_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) >= 200000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN SUM(sw.ss_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) BETWEEN 100000 AND 199999.99 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS profit_tier, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(sw.ss_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0)) DESC) AS profit_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.s_state) AS state_rank FROM store s JOIN (SELECT ss.*, t.t_shift FROM store_sales ss JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk) sw ON sw.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk AND sr.sr_ticket_number = sw.ss_ticket_number AND sr.sr_item_sk = sw.ss_item_sk WHERE sw.t_shift = 'Evening' GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state ORDER BY net_margin DESC LIMIT 50

WITH ss AS (SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_quantity AS sold_qty, ss.ss_ext_discount_amt, ss.ss_ext_list_price, td.t_hour FROM store_sales ss JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk), sr AS (SELECT sr.sr_store_sk, sr.sr_item_sk, sr.sr_return_quantity AS returned_qty, td.t_hour AS return_hour FROM store_returns sr JOIN time_dim td ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk) SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk, CASE WHEN ss.t_hour BETWEEN 5 AND 11 THEN 'Morning' WHEN ss.t_hour BETWEEN 12 AND 16 THEN 'Afternoon' WHEN ss.t_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 20 THEN 'Evening' ELSE 'Night' END AS time_of_day, SUM(ss.sold_qty) AS total_sold_qty, COALESCE(SUM(sr.returned_qty), 0) AS total_returned_qty, SUM(ss.sold_qty) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.returned_qty), 0) AS net_quantity, AVG(CASE WHEN ss.ss_ext_list_price > 0 THEN ss.ss_ext_discount_amt / ss.ss_ext_list_price END) AS avg_discount_ratio, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_id, CASE WHEN ss.t_hour BETWEEN 5 AND 11 THEN 'Morning' WHEN ss.t_hour BETWEEN 12 AND 16 THEN 'Afternoon' WHEN ss.t_hour BETWEEN 17 AND 20 THEN 'Evening' ELSE 'Night' END ORDER BY (SUM(ss.sold_qty) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.returned_qty), 0)) DESC) AS item_rank FROM store s JOIN ss ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk LEFT JOIN sr ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk AND sr.return_hour = ss.t_hour GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.t_hour HAVING (SUM(ss.sold_qty) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.returned_qty), 0)) > 0 ORDER BY s.s_store_id, time_of_day, item_rank LIMIT 200

WITH store_perf AS (SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_state, hd.hd_buy_potential, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM store_sales ss INNER JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk INNER JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_state, hd.hd_buy_potential, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound) SELECT s_store_id, s_store_name, s_state, hd_buy_potential, ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound, total_net_profit, total_quantity, CASE WHEN total_net_profit >= 100000 THEN 'High' WHEN total_net_profit >= 50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_tier, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM store_perf

WITH discount_stats AS (SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_state, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(ss.ss_ext_list_price) AS total_list_price FROM store_sales ss INNER JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk INNER JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_state, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound) SELECT s_store_id, s_state, ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound, total_discount, total_list_price, CASE WHEN total_list_price = 0 THEN 0 ELSE total_discount / total_list_price END AS discount_ratio, CASE WHEN total_list_price = 0 THEN 'No List Price' WHEN total_discount / total_list_price > 0.20 THEN 'High Discount' WHEN total_discount / total_list_price > 0.10 THEN 'Medium Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound ORDER BY CASE WHEN total_list_price = 0 THEN 0 ELSE total_discount / total_list_price END DESC) AS discount_rank FROM discount_stats ORDER BY ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound, discount_rank

WITH demo_sales AS (SELECT s.s_division_id, s.s_division_name, hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_dep_count, hd.hd_vehicle_count, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, AVG(ss.ss_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price FROM store_sales ss INNER JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk INNER JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY s.s_division_id, s.s_division_name, hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_dep_count, hd.hd_vehicle_count, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound), ranked_demo AS (SELECT s_division_id, s_division_name, hd_demo_sk, hd_dep_count, hd_vehicle_count, ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound, avg_sales_price, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s_division_id ORDER BY avg_sales_price DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demo_sales) SELECT s_division_id, s_division_name, hd_demo_sk, hd_dep_count, hd_vehicle_count, ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound, avg_sales_price, CASE WHEN hd_vehicle_count > 2 THEN 'Multiple Vehicles' WHEN hd_vehicle_count = 1 THEN 'Single Vehicle' ELSE 'No Vehicles' END AS vehicle_category, sales_rank FROM ranked_demo WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY s_division_id, sales_rank

WITH daily_sales AS (SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS daily_total_sales FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk), daily_sales_ma AS (SELECT ds.ss_store_sk, ds.ss_sold_date_sk, ds.daily_total_sales, AVG(ds.daily_total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY ds.ss_store_sk ORDER BY ds.ss_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma_7d_sales FROM daily_sales ds), store_vehicle AS (SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, AVG(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_count FROM store_sales ss INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk), store_income AS (SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, AVG(ib.ib_lower_bound) AS avg_income_lower, AVG(ib.ib_upper_bound) AS avg_income_upper FROM store_sales ss INNER JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk INNER JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk) SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_city, s.s_state, dsma.ss_sold_date_sk AS sales_date_sk, dsma.daily_total_sales, dsma.ma_7d_sales, sv.avg_vehicle_count, si.avg_income_lower, si.avg_income_upper, CASE WHEN sv.avg_vehicle_count >= 3 THEN 'High Vehicle Ownership' WHEN sv.avg_vehicle_count >= 1 THEN 'Moderate Vehicle Ownership' ELSE 'Low Vehicle Ownership' END AS vehicle_ownership_category FROM daily_sales_ma dsma INNER JOIN store s ON dsma.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk LEFT JOIN store_vehicle sv ON dsma.ss_store_sk = sv.ss_store_sk LEFT JOIN store_income si ON dsma.ss_store_sk = si.ss_store_sk ORDER BY s.s_store_id, dsma.ss_sold_date_sk

WITH sales_shipping AS (
    SELECT
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_state,
        w.w_city,
        ws.ws_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode_sk,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt,
        AVG(ws.ws_ext_ship_cost) AS avg_sales_ship_cost,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_ship_cost) AS total_sales_ship_cost
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_state, w.w_city, ws.ws_ship_mode_sk
),
returns_shipping AS (
    SELECT
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_state,
        w.w_city,
        cr.cr_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode_sk,
        COUNT(*) AS returns_cnt,
        AVG(cr.cr_return_ship_cost) AS avg_return_ship_cost,
        SUM(cr.cr_fee) AS total_return_fee,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_ship_cost) AS total_return_ship_cost
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_state, w.w_city, cr.cr_ship_mode_sk
)
SELECT
    s.w_warehouse_sk,
    s.w_state,
    s.w_city,
    s.ship_mode_sk,
    s.sales_cnt,
    s.avg_sales_ship_cost,
    r.returns_cnt,
    r.avg_return_ship_cost,
    r.total_return_fee,
    CASE
        WHEN s.avg_sales_ship_cost > 20 THEN 'Expensive Sales Shipping'
        WHEN s.avg_sales_ship_cost > 10 THEN 'Moderate Sales Shipping'
        ELSE 'Low Sales Shipping'
    END AS sales_ship_cost_category,
    CASE
        WHEN r.avg_return_ship_cost > 15 THEN 'Expensive Return Shipping'
        WHEN r.avg_return_ship_cost > 8 THEN 'Moderate Return Shipping'
        ELSE 'Low Return Shipping'
    END AS return_ship_cost_category,
    (s.avg_sales_ship_cost - COALESCE(r.avg_return_ship_cost, 0)) AS ship_cost_diff,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY (s.avg_sales_ship_cost - COALESCE(r.avg_return_ship_cost, 0)) DESC) AS ship_cost_diff_rank,
    SUM(s.total_sales_ship_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY s.w_warehouse_sk) AS warehouse_total_sales_ship_cost,
    SUM(COALESCE(r.total_return_ship_cost, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.w_warehouse_sk) AS warehouse_total_return_ship_cost
FROM sales_shipping s
LEFT JOIN returns_shipping r
    ON s.w_warehouse_sk = r.w_warehouse_sk
    AND s.ship_mode_sk = r.ship_mode_sk
WHERE s.sales_cnt > 0
ORDER BY s.w_warehouse_sk, ship_cost_diff_rank

WITH reason_loss AS (
    SELECT
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_state,
        w.w_city,
        r.r_reason_desc,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amt,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS return_events,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 20000 THEN 'Very High'
            WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 10000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 5000 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS loss_severity
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN reason r
        ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_state, w.w_city, r.r_reason_desc
)
SELECT
    w_warehouse_sk,
    w_state,
    w_city,
    r_reason_desc,
    total_return_qty,
    total_return_amt,
    total_net_loss,
    loss_severity,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS reason_rank_in_warehouse,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS global_reason_dense_rank
FROM reason_loss
WHERE total_return_qty > 0
ORDER BY w_warehouse_sk, reason_rank_in_warehouse

WITH sales_by_customer AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_state,
        w.w_city,
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_paid,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_txns
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    GROUP BY ws.ws_warehouse_sk, w.w_state, w.w_city, ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
),
returns_by_customer AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_state,
        w.w_city,
        cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS return_txns
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    GROUP BY cr.cr_warehouse_sk, w.w_state, w.w_city, cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(s.ws_warehouse_sk, r.cr_warehouse_sk) AS warehouse_sk,
    COALESCE(s.w_state, r.w_state) AS state,
    COALESCE(s.w_city, r.w_city) AS city,
    COALESCE(s.customer_sk, r.customer_sk) AS customer_sk,
    COALESCE(s.total_paid, 0) AS total_paid,
    COALESCE(s.total_profit, 0) AS total_profit,
    COALESCE(r.total_refunded_cash, 0) AS total_refunded_cash,
    COALESCE(r.total_loss, 0) AS total_loss,
    (COALESCE(s.total_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_loss, 0)) AS net_impact,
    CASE
        WHEN (COALESCE(s.total_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_loss, 0)) > 0 THEN 'Net Positive'
        WHEN (COALESCE(s.total_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_loss, 0)) < 0 THEN 'Net Negative'
        ELSE 'Neutral'
    END AS net_impact_category,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(s.ws_warehouse_sk, r.cr_warehouse_sk)
                 ORDER BY (COALESCE(s.total_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_loss, 0)) DESC) AS customer_profit_rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(s.total_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_loss, 0)) DESC) AS global_customer_dense_rank,
    SUM(COALESCE(s.total_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_loss, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(s.ws_warehouse_sk, r.cr_warehouse_sk)) AS warehouse_total_net_impact
FROM sales_by_customer s
FULL OUTER JOIN returns_by_customer r
    ON s.ws_warehouse_sk = r.cr_warehouse_sk
    AND s.customer_sk = r.customer_sk
WHERE COALESCE(s.total_profit, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(r.total_loss, 0) > 0
ORDER BY warehouse_sk, net_impact DESC

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_state,
        w.w_city,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_transactions
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_state, w.w_city, ws.ws_sold_date_sk
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_state,
        w.w_city,
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty,
        COUNT(*) AS return_transactions
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_state, w.w_city, cr.cr_returned_date_sk
)
SELECT
    s.w_warehouse_sk,
    s.w_state,
    s.w_city,
    s.date_sk,
    s.total_sales_amount,
    s.total_sales_profit,
    r.total_return_amount,
    r.total_return_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN s.total_sales_profit = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(r.total_return_loss / s.total_sales_profit, 4)
    END AS loss_to_profit_ratio,
    CASE
        WHEN s.total_sales_profit = 0 THEN 'No Sales'
        WHEN r.total_return_loss / s.total_sales_profit < 0.5 THEN 'Healthy'
        ELSE 'Alert'
    END AS profit_health_flag,
    SUM(s.total_sales_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY s.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY s.date_sk
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_sales_amount,
    LAG(s.total_sales_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY s.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY s.date_sk) AS previous_day_profit,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY s.total_sales_profit DESC) AS sales_profit_rank
FROM sales_agg s
LEFT JOIN returns_agg r
    ON s.w_warehouse_sk = r.w_warehouse_sk
    AND s.date_sk = r.date_sk
WHERE s.total_sales_amount > 0
ORDER BY s.w_warehouse_sk, s.date_sk

WITH yearly_item_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        d.d_year,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_tax) AS total_tax,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        AVG(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, d.d_year
),
item_inventory AS (
    SELECT
        i.inv_item_sk,
        MAX(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS max_quantity_on_hand
    FROM inventory i
    GROUP BY i.inv_item_sk
),
ranked_sales AS (
    SELECT
        yis.cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
        yis.d_year,
        yis.total_net_profit,
        yis.total_quantity,
        yis.total_sales,
        ROUND(yis.total_net_profit / NULLIF(yis.total_sales, 0) * 100, 2) AS profit_margin_pct,
        yis.avg_net_paid_inc_tax,
        ii.max_quantity_on_hand,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY yis.d_year ORDER BY yis.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
        SUM(yis.total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY yis.d_year) AS year_total_sales
    FROM yearly_item_sales yis
    LEFT JOIN item_inventory ii ON yis.cs_item_sk = ii.inv_item_sk
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    item_sk,
    total_net_profit,
    total_quantity,
    total_sales,
    profit_margin_pct,
    avg_net_paid_inc_tax,
    max_quantity_on_hand,
    profit_rank,
    ROUND(total_sales / NULLIF(year_total_sales, 0) * 100, 2) AS sales_share_pct
FROM ranked_sales
WHERE profit_rank <= 4
ORDER BY d_year, profit_rank

WITH yearly_item_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        d.d_year,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_tax) AS total_tax,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2020
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, d.d_year
),
item_inventory AS (
    SELECT
        i.inv_item_sk,
        MAX(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS max_quantity_on_hand,
        SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_quantity_on_hand
    FROM inventory i
    GROUP BY i.inv_item_sk
),
ranked_sales AS (
    SELECT
        yis.cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
        yis.d_year,
        yis.total_net_profit,
        yis.total_quantity,
        yis.total_sales,
        ROUND(yis.total_net_profit / NULLIF(yis.total_sales, 0) * 100, 2) AS profit_margin_pct,
        ii.max_quantity_on_hand,
        ii.total_quantity_on_hand,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY yis.d_year ORDER BY yis.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY yis.d_year ORDER BY yis.total_quantity DESC) AS quantity_rank
    FROM yearly_item_sales yis
    LEFT JOIN item_inventory ii ON yis.cs_item_sk = ii.inv_item_sk
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    item_sk,
    total_net_profit,
    total_quantity,
    total_sales,
    profit_margin_pct,
    max_quantity_on_hand,
    total_quantity_on_hand,
    profit_rank,
    quantity_rank
FROM ranked_sales
WHERE profit_rank <= 3 OR quantity_rank <= 3
ORDER BY d_year, profit_rank, quantity_rank

WITH daily_tax AS ( SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date, cp.cp_department, w.w_state, SUM(cr.cr_return_tax) AS total_return_tax, COUNT(*) AS return_count FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date_sk, d.d_date, cp.cp_department, w.w_state ), dept_daily_tax AS ( SELECT cp_department, w_state, d_date, total_return_tax, return_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department, w_state ORDER BY d_date DESC) AS rn FROM daily_tax ) SELECT cp_department, w_state, d_date, total_return_tax, return_count FROM dept_daily_tax WHERE rn <= 7 ORDER BY cp_department, w_state, d_date

WITH daily_tax AS ( SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date, cp.cp_department, w.w_state, SUM(cr.cr_return_tax) AS total_return_tax FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE cp.cp_type = 'Online' GROUP BY d.d_date_sk, d.d_date, cp.cp_department, w.w_state ), dept_daily_tax AS ( SELECT cp_department, w_state, d_date, total_return_tax, LAG(total_return_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department, w_state ORDER BY d_date) AS prior_day_tax FROM daily_tax ) SELECT cp_department, w_state, d_date, total_return_tax, prior_day_tax, CASE WHEN prior_day_tax IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (total_return_tax - prior_day_tax) / prior_day_tax * 100 END AS day_over_day_change_pct FROM dept_daily_tax WHERE d_date BETWEEN date_add('month', -6, current_date) AND current_date ORDER BY total_return_tax DESC LIMIT 100

WITH daily_tax AS ( SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date, cp.cp_department, w.w_state, SUM(cr.cr_return_tax) AS total_return_tax FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date_sk, d.d_date, cp.cp_department, w.w_state ), dept_daily_tax AS ( SELECT cp_department, w_state, d_date, total_return_tax, AVG(total_return_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department, w_state ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_7d FROM daily_tax ) SELECT cp_department, w_state, d_date, total_return_tax, moving_avg_7d, total_return_tax - moving_avg_7d AS diff_from_avg FROM dept_daily_tax WHERE d_date >= date_add('year', -1, current_date) ORDER BY cp_department, w_state, d_date DESC LIMIT 150

WITH daily_tax AS ( SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date, cp.cp_department, w.w_state, SUM(cr.cr_return_tax) AS total_return_tax FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date_sk, d.d_date, cp.cp_department, w.w_state ), tax_rank AS ( SELECT cp_department, w_state, d_date, total_return_tax, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY total_return_tax DESC) AS dept_rank FROM daily_tax ) SELECT cp_department, w_state, d_date, total_return_tax, dept_rank FROM tax_rank WHERE dept_rank <= 3 AND d_date BETWEEN date_add('year', -3, current_date) AND current_date ORDER BY cp_department, dept_rank, d_date DESC

WITH city_customer_counts AS ( SELECT s.s_city, sd.d_year AS store_closed_year, sd.d_moy AS store_closed_month, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk) AS customers_after_closure FROM store s JOIN date_dim sd ON s.s_closed_date_sk = sd.d_date_sk CROSS JOIN customer c JOIN date_dim fd ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk WHERE fd.d_date > sd.d_date GROUP BY s.s_city, sd.d_year, sd.d_moy ) SELECT ccc.s_city, ccc.store_closed_year, ccc.store_closed_month, ccc.customers_after_closure, CASE WHEN ccc.customers_after_closure > 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS volume_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ccc.customers_after_closure DESC) AS city_rank_by_customers FROM city_customer_counts ccc WHERE ccc.customers_after_closure > 0 ORDER BY ccc.customers_after_closure DESC

WITH month_returns AS ( SELECT d.d_year, d.d_moy AS month_of_year, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_return_tax) AS total_return_tax, SUM(cr.cr_fee) AS total_fee, COUNT(*) AS num_returns, AVG(d.d_year - c.c_birth_year) AS avg_customer_age_at_return FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_moy ), month_store_closings AS ( SELECT d.d_year, d.d_moy AS month_of_year, COUNT(s.s_store_sk) AS stores_closed_in_month FROM store s JOIN date_dim d ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_moy ) SELECT mr.d_year, mr.month_of_year, mr.total_return_amount, mr.total_return_tax, mr.total_fee, mr.num_returns, mr.avg_customer_age_at_return, COALESCE(msc.stores_closed_in_month, 0) AS stores_closed_in_month, CASE WHEN mr.total_return_amount > 100000 THEN 'High Volume' ELSE 'Normal' END AS volume_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY mr.total_return_amount DESC) AS return_amount_rank, SUM(mr.total_return_amount) OVER (ORDER BY mr.d_year, mr.month_of_year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return_amount FROM month_returns mr LEFT JOIN month_store_closings msc ON mr.d_year = msc.d_year AND mr.month_of_year = msc.month_of_year ORDER BY mr.d_year DESC, mr.month_of_year DESC

WITH store_closings AS ( SELECT s.s_closed_date_sk AS date_sk, COUNT(*) AS stores_closed_on_date FROM store s GROUP BY s.s_closed_date_sk ), customer_monthly_returns AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, d.d_year, d.d_moy AS month_of_year, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity, COUNT(*) AS num_returns, AVG(cr.cr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss, COALESCE(sc.stores_closed_on_date, 0) AS stores_closed_on_return_date FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk LEFT JOIN store_closings sc ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = sc.date_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, d.d_year, d.d_moy, sc.stores_closed_on_date ) SELECT cmr.c_customer_sk, cmr.c_first_name, cmr.c_last_name, cmr.d_year, cmr.month_of_year, cmr.total_net_loss, cmr.total_return_amount, cmr.total_return_quantity, cmr.num_returns, cmr.avg_net_loss, cmr.stores_closed_on_return_date, CASE WHEN cmr.total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'High Loss' ELSE 'Normal' END AS loss_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cmr.d_year ORDER BY cmr.total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank_year, SUM(cmr.total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cmr.d_year ORDER BY cmr.month_of_year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_year_net_loss FROM customer_monthly_returns cmr WHERE cmr.num_returns >= 5 ORDER BY cmr.d_year DESC, cmr.total_net_loss DESC

WITH aggregated_returns AS ( SELECT c.c_current_cdemo_sk AS cdemo_sk, c.c_current_hdemo_sk AS hdemo_sk, d.d_quarter_name, SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) / SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) END AS loss_to_refund_ratio FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY c.c_current_cdemo_sk, c.c_current_hdemo_sk, d.d_quarter_name HAVING SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 0 ), quarter_store_closings AS ( SELECT d.d_quarter_name, COUNT(s.s_store_sk) AS stores_closed_in_quarter FROM store s JOIN date_dim d ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_quarter_name ) SELECT ar.cdemo_sk, ar.hdemo_sk, ar.d_quarter_name, ar.total_refunded_cash, ar.total_net_loss, ar.loss_to_refund_ratio, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ar.d_quarter_name ORDER BY ar.total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank_in_quarter, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ar.total_net_loss DESC) AS overall_loss_percentile, COALESCE(qsc.stores_closed_in_quarter, 0) AS stores_closed_in_quarter FROM aggregated_returns ar LEFT JOIN quarter_store_closings qsc ON ar.d_quarter_name = qsc.d_quarter_name ORDER BY ar.d_quarter_name, ar.total_net_loss DESC

SELECT COALESCE(s.cp_department, r.cp_department) AS cp_department, COALESCE(s.sales_profit, 0) AS total_sales_profit, COALESCE(r.return_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss, (COALESCE(s.sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.return_loss, 0)) AS net_effect, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(s.sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.return_loss, 0)) > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS net_status, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(s.sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.return_loss, 0)) DESC) AS dept_rank FROM (SELECT cp.cp_department, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS sales_profit FROM catalog_page cp JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN cp.cp_start_date_sk AND cp.cp_end_date_sk JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = 2022 GROUP BY cp.cp_department) s FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT cp.cp_department, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS return_loss FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = 2022 GROUP BY cp.cp_department) r ON s.cp_department = r.cp_department
