WITH sales_monthly AS (SELECT cp.cp_department, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq AS month_num, d.d_current_month AS month_name, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS sales_profit FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN catalog_page cp ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN cp.cp_start_date_sk AND cp.cp_end_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = 2022 GROUP BY cp.cp_department, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, d.d_current_month), returns_monthly AS (SELECT cp.cp_department, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq AS month_num, d.d_current_month AS month_name, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS return_loss FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = 2022 GROUP BY cp.cp_department, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, d.d_current_month), combined AS (SELECT COALESCE(s.cp_department, r.cp_department) AS cp_department, COALESCE(s.d_year, r.d_year) AS year, COALESCE(s.month_num, r.month_num) AS month_num, COALESCE(s.month_name, r.month_name) AS month_name, COALESCE(s.sales_profit, 0) AS sales_profit, COALESCE(r.return_loss, 0) AS return_loss, (COALESCE(s.sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.return_loss, 0)) AS net_profit FROM sales_monthly s FULL OUTER JOIN returns_monthly r ON s.cp_department = r.cp_department AND s.d_year = r.d_year AND s.month_num = r.month_num) SELECT cp_department, year, month_num, month_name, sales_profit, return_loss, net_profit, net_profit - LAG(net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY year, month_num) AS mom_change, CASE WHEN net_profit - LAG(net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY year, month_num) > 0 THEN 'Increase' WHEN net_profit - LAG(net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY year, month_num) < 0 THEN 'Decrease' ELSE 'No Change' END AS change_indicator, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM combined ORDER BY cp_department, year, month_num

WITH returns_agg AS (SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, CASE WHEN AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) > 100 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Medium' END AS return_level, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) DESC) AS rnk FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = 2022 AND d.d_quarter_name = 'Q4' GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5), sales_agg AS (SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales_amount, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_sales_qty FROM catalog_page cp JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN cp.cp_start_date_sk AND cp.cp_end_date_sk JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = 2022 AND d.d_quarter_name = 'Q4' GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_sk) SELECT r.cp_catalog_page_id, r.cp_department, r.cp_catalog_page_number, r.avg_return_amount, r.return_cnt, r.return_level, r.rnk, COALESCE(s.total_sales_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(s.total_sales_qty, 0) AS total_sales_qty FROM returns_agg r LEFT JOIN sales_agg s ON r.cp_catalog_page_sk = s.cp_catalog_page_sk WHERE r.rnk <= 10 ORDER BY r.rnk, r.avg_return_amount DESC

WITH sales_agg AS (SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk AS customer_id, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales_amount, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_sales_qty FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = 2022 GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk), returns_dept_agg AS (SELECT rr.customer_id, rr.cp_department, SUM(rr.return_loss) AS dept_return_loss FROM (SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_id, cr.cr_net_loss AS return_loss, cp.cp_department FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = 2022 AND cr.cr_returning_customer_sk IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk AS customer_id, cr.cr_net_loss AS return_loss, cp.cp_department FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = 2022 AND cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk IS NOT NULL) rr GROUP BY rr.customer_id, rr.cp_department), returns_total AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(dept_return_loss) AS total_return_loss FROM returns_dept_agg GROUP BY customer_id), top_dept_per_customer AS (SELECT customer_id, cp_department, dept_return_loss, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY dept_return_loss DESC) AS rn FROM returns_dept_agg) SELECT COALESCE(s.customer_id, rt.customer_id) AS customer_id, COALESCE(s.total_sales_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(s.total_sales_qty, 0) AS total_sales_qty, COALESCE(rt.total_return_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss, (COALESCE(s.total_sales_amount, 0) - COALESCE(rt.total_return_loss, 0)) AS net_position, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.total_sales_amount, 0) > 10000 THEN 'Top Spender' WHEN COALESCE(rt.total_return_loss, 0) > 5000 THEN 'Frequent Returner' ELSE 'Regular' END AS customer_category, td.cp_department AS top_return_department, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(s.total_sales_amount, 0) - COALESCE(rt.total_return_loss, 0)) DESC) AS net_position_rank FROM sales_agg s FULL OUTER JOIN returns_total rt ON s.customer_id = rt.customer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT customer_id, cp_department FROM top_dept_per_customer WHERE rn = 1) td ON COALESCE(s.customer_id, rt.customer_id) = td.customer_id ORDER BY net_position_rank LIMIT 50

WITH customer_sales AS (SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_birth_month, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_city, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_birth_month, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_city), promo_counts AS (SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, CASE WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV' WHEN p.p_channel_email = 'Y' THEN 'Email' WHEN p.p_channel_radio = 'Y' THEN 'Radio' WHEN p.p_channel_press = 'Y' THEN 'Press' WHEN p.p_channel_catalog = 'Y' THEN 'Catalog' WHEN p.p_channel_dmail = 'Y' THEN 'DMail' WHEN p.p_channel_event = 'Y' THEN 'Event' ELSE 'Other' END AS promo_channel FROM web_sales ws JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk), customer_top_channel AS (SELECT customer_sk, promo_channel, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_sk ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn, COUNT(*) AS usage_count FROM promo_counts GROUP BY customer_sk, promo_channel) SELECT cs.c_customer_id, cs.c_first_name, cs.c_last_name, cs.ca_state, cs.ca_city, cs.total_net_profit, cs.order_count, cs.avg_discount, CASE WHEN cs.c_birth_month IN (12,1,2) THEN 'Winter' WHEN cs.c_birth_month IN (3,4,5) THEN 'Spring' WHEN cs.c_birth_month IN (6,7,8) THEN 'Summer' ELSE 'Fall' END AS birth_season, CASE WHEN cs.avg_discount > 5 THEN 'High Discount' ELSE 'Normal Discount' END AS discount_category, ct.promo_channel AS favorite_promo_channel, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM customer_sales cs LEFT JOIN customer_top_channel ct ON cs.c_customer_sk = ct.customer_sk AND ct.rn = 1 ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 10

WITH latest_quarter AS ( SELECT MAX(d_quarter_name) AS max_quarter FROM date_dim ), call_center_discount AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_tax_percentage, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_quarter_name = (SELECT max_quarter FROM latest_quarter) AND cs.cs_quantity > 5 GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_tax_percentage ) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, cc_state, cc_tax_percentage, total_discount, total_sales, txn_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_state ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS state_rank FROM call_center_discount WHERE txn_count >= 30 ORDER BY state_rank LIMIT 20

WITH store_metrics AS ( SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_state, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(sr.sr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash, SUM(sr.sr_store_credit) AS total_store_credit, COUNT(*) AS total_returns, AVG(2023 - c.c_birth_year) AS avg_customer_age FROM store_returns sr JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_state ) SELECT s_store_id, s_store_name, s_state, total_net_loss, total_return_amt, total_refunded_cash, total_store_credit, total_returns, avg_customer_age, (total_refunded_cash / NULLIF(total_refunded_cash + total_store_credit,0)) * 100 AS cash_refund_pct, CASE WHEN (total_refunded_cash / NULLIF(total_refunded_cash + total_store_credit,0)) * 100 >= 70 THEN 'High Cash Refund' WHEN (total_refunded_cash / NULLIF(total_refunded_cash + total_store_credit,0)) * 100 <= 30 THEN 'High Store Credit' ELSE 'Balanced' END AS refund_type_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_quartile FROM store_metrics ORDER BY net_loss_rank

WITH cust_returns AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_credit_rating, s.s_store_id, s.s_state, sr.sr_returned_date_sk, sr.sr_return_time_sk, sr.sr_return_amt, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_customer_id ORDER BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk, sr.sr_return_time_sk ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_return_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_customer_id ORDER BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk, sr.sr_return_time_sk) AS rn FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk LEFT JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk ) SELECT c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, cd_gender, rating_category, s_store_id, s_state, sr_returned_date_sk, sr_return_time_sk, sr_return_amt, cumulative_return_amt, prev_cumulative_return, incremental_return, churn_risk FROM ( SELECT c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, cd_gender, cd_credit_rating, s_store_id, s_state, sr_returned_date_sk, sr_return_time_sk, sr_return_amt, cumulative_return_amt, LAG(cumulative_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY c_customer_id ORDER BY sr_returned_date_sk, sr_return_time_sk) AS prev_cumulative_return, cumulative_return_amt - LAG(cumulative_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY c_customer_id ORDER BY sr_returned_date_sk, sr_return_time_sk) AS incremental_return, CASE WHEN cd_credit_rating IN ('A','A+') THEN 'Excellent' WHEN cd_credit_rating IN ('B','B+') THEN 'Good' ELSE 'Other' END AS rating_category, CASE WHEN cumulative_return_amt >= 2000 THEN 'High' WHEN cumulative_return_amt >= 1000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS churn_risk, rn FROM cust_returns ) t WHERE rn <= 20 ORDER BY c_customer_id, sr_returned_date_sk, sr_return_time_sk

WITH store_day AS (SELECT d.d_date AS activity_date, COUNT(s.s_store_sk) AS stores_closed, AVG(s.s_floor_space) AS avg_store_floor_space FROM store s JOIN date_dim d ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date), page_day AS (SELECT d.d_date AS activity_date, COUNT(wp.wp_web_page_id) AS pages_accessed, AVG(wp.wp_char_count) AS avg_page_char_count FROM web_page wp JOIN date_dim d ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date), site_day AS (SELECT d.d_date AS activity_date, COUNT(ws.web_site_id) AS sites_opened, AVG(ws.web_tax_percentage) AS avg_site_tax_pct FROM web_site ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date) SELECT COALESCE(s.activity_date, p.activity_date, w.activity_date) AS activity_date, COALESCE(s.stores_closed, 0) AS stores_closed, COALESCE(p.pages_accessed, 0) AS pages_accessed, COALESCE(w.sites_opened, 0) AS sites_opened, COALESCE(s.avg_store_floor_space, 0) AS avg_store_floor_space, COALESCE(p.avg_page_char_count, 0) AS avg_page_char_count, COALESCE(w.avg_site_tax_pct, 0) AS avg_site_tax_pct, (COALESCE(s.stores_closed, 0) + COALESCE(p.pages_accessed, 0) + COALESCE(w.sites_opened, 0)) AS total_activity, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(s.stores_closed, 0) + COALESCE(p.pages_accessed, 0) + COALESCE(w.sites_opened, 0)) > 100 THEN 'High Activity' WHEN (COALESCE(s.stores_closed, 0) + COALESCE(p.pages_accessed, 0) + COALESCE(w.sites_opened, 0)) BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN 'Medium Activity' ELSE 'Low Activity' END AS activity_level, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(s.stores_closed, 0) + COALESCE(p.pages_accessed, 0) + COALESCE(w.sites_opened, 0) DESC) AS activity_rank FROM store_day s FULL OUTER JOIN page_day p ON s.activity_date = p.activity_date FULL OUTER JOIN site_day w ON COALESCE(s.activity_date, p.activity_date) = w.activity_date WHERE COALESCE(s.activity_date, p.activity_date, w.activity_date) >= DATE '2020-01-01' ORDER BY activity_date DESC

WITH state_daily_metrics AS (SELECT s.s_state AS state, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_store_id) AS store_count, AVG(s.s_floor_space) AS avg_floor_space, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.web_site_id) AS website_count, AVG(ws.web_tax_percentage) AS avg_tax_pct, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_id) AS pages_accessed_on_closure_day, AVG(wp.wp_char_count) AS avg_char_count_on_closure_day FROM store s JOIN date_dim d ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_state = s.s_state AND ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_fy_year = 2021 GROUP BY s.s_state) SELECT state, store_count, avg_floor_space, website_count, avg_tax_pct, pages_accessed_on_closure_day, avg_char_count_on_closure_day, CASE WHEN pages_accessed_on_closure_day > 1000 THEN 'High Page Activity' WHEN pages_accessed_on_closure_day BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 THEN 'Medium Page Activity' ELSE 'Low Page Activity' END AS page_activity_level, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pages_accessed_on_closure_day DESC) AS page_activity_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_floor_space DESC) AS floor_space_state_rank, SUM(store_count) OVER (ORDER BY avg_floor_space DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_store_count_by_floor_space FROM state_daily_metrics ORDER BY page_activity_rank

WITH store_fy AS (SELECT d.d_fy_year AS fy_year, COUNT(s.s_store_id) AS stores_closed, AVG(s.s_floor_space) AS avg_floor_space FROM store s JOIN date_dim d ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_fy_year), site_fy AS (SELECT d.d_fy_year AS fy_year, COUNT(ws.web_site_id) AS sites_opened, AVG(ws.web_tax_percentage) AS avg_tax_pct FROM web_site ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_fy_year), page_fy AS (SELECT d.d_fy_year AS fy_year, COUNT(wp.wp_web_page_id) AS pages_created, AVG(wp.wp_char_count) AS avg_char_count FROM web_page wp JOIN date_dim d ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_fy_year) SELECT COALESCE(s.fy_year, w.fy_year, p.fy_year) AS fiscal_year, COALESCE(s.stores_closed, 0) AS stores_closed, COALESCE(w.sites_opened, 0) AS sites_opened, COALESCE(p.pages_created, 0) AS pages_created, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.stores_closed, 0) > COALESCE(w.sites_opened, 0) THEN 'More Stores Closed' WHEN COALESCE(s.stores_closed, 0) < COALESCE(w.sites_opened, 0) THEN 'More Sites Opened' ELSE 'Equal' END AS closure_vs_open_status, COALESCE(s.avg_floor_space, 0) AS avg_store_floor_space, COALESCE(w.avg_tax_pct, 0) AS avg_site_tax_pct, COALESCE(p.avg_char_count, 0) AS avg_page_char_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(s.stores_closed, 0) DESC) AS stores_closed_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(w.sites_opened, 0) DESC) AS sites_opened_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(p.pages_created, 0) DESC) AS pages_created_rank FROM store_fy s FULL OUTER JOIN site_fy w ON s.fy_year = w.fy_year FULL OUTER JOIN page_fy p ON COALESCE(s.fy_year, w.fy_year) = p.fy_year WHERE COALESCE(s.fy_year, w.fy_year, p.fy_year) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC

WITH pages_per_site AS (SELECT ws.web_site_id, COUNT(wp.wp_web_page_id) AS pages_created_on_open FROM web_site ws JOIN date_dim d_open ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk GROUP BY ws.web_site_id), store_counts AS (SELECT d.d_date AS open_date, COUNT(s.s_store_id) AS stores_closed_on_date FROM store s JOIN date_dim d ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date) SELECT ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, d_open.d_date AS open_date, d_close.d_date AS close_date, DATE_DIFF('day', d_open.d_date, COALESCE(d_close.d_date, CURRENT_DATE)) AS days_active, CASE WHEN d_close.d_date IS NULL OR d_close.d_date > CURRENT_DATE THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Closed' END AS site_status, sc.stores_closed_on_date, pp.pages_created_on_open, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ws.web_state ORDER BY DATE_DIFF('day', d_open.d_date, COALESCE(d_close.d_date, CURRENT_DATE)) DESC) AS state_website_activity_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY DATE_DIFF('day', d_open.d_date, COALESCE(d_close.d_date, CURRENT_DATE)) DESC) AS overall_site_activity_rank FROM web_site ws JOIN date_dim d_open ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN date_dim d_close ON ws.web_close_date_sk = d_close.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN pages_per_site pp ON ws.web_site_id = pp.web_site_id LEFT JOIN store_counts sc ON d_open.d_date = sc.open_date WHERE ws.web_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ws.web_state, days_active DESC

SELECT
    t_hour,
    t_meal_time,
    total_sales,
    total_profit,
    order_cnt,
    avg_sales_per_order,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_sales_per_order DESC) AS sales_rank,
    discount_flag,
    profit_indicator
FROM (
    SELECT
        t.t_hour,
        t.t_meal_time,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS order_cnt,
        AVG(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS avg_sales_per_order,
        CASE
            WHEN MAX(p.p_discount_active) = 'Y' THEN 'DiscountActive'
            ELSE 'NoDiscount'
        END AS discount_flag,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Profitable'
            ELSE 'Loss'
        END AS profit_indicator
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN time_dim t ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2022
    GROUP BY t.t_hour, t.t_meal_time
) sub
ORDER BY sales_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH promo_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_id,
        p.p_promo_name,
        p.p_cost,
        start_d.d_date AS start_date,
        end_d.d_date AS end_date,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(ws.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt,
        DATE_DIFF('day', start_d.d_date, end_d.d_date) + 1 AS promo_days,
        AVG(t.t_hour) AS avg_sale_hour
    FROM promotion p
    JOIN date_dim start_d ON p.p_start_date_sk = start_d.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim end_d ON p.p_end_date_sk = end_d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
        AND ws.ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN p.p_start_date_sk AND p.p_end_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN time_dim t ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_cost, start_d.d_date, end_d.d_date
)
SELECT
    p.p_promo_id,
    p.p_promo_name,
    p.start_date,
    p.end_date,
    p.total_sales,
    p.total_profit,
    p.p_cost,
    p.order_cnt,
    p.promo_days,
    p.avg_sale_hour,
    CASE 
        WHEN p.p_cost > 0 THEN p.total_profit / p.p_cost
        ELSE NULL
    END AS roi,
    CASE 
        WHEN p.p_cost > 0 AND p.total_profit / p.p_cost > 2 THEN 'High'
        WHEN p.p_cost > 0 AND p.total_profit / p.p_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS roi_category,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE 
        WHEN p.p_cost > 0 THEN p.total_profit / p.p_cost 
        ELSE NULL 
    END DESC) AS roi_rank
FROM promo_sales p
WHERE p.p_cost IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY roi_rank
LIMIT 20

WITH customer_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt,
        MIN(d.d_date) AS first_purchase_date,
        MAX(d.d_date) AS last_purchase_date,
        AVG(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS avg_order_value,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promo_order_cnt
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
),
customer_hour AS (
    SELECT
        customer_sk,
        t_hour,
        hour_cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_sk ORDER BY hour_cnt DESC) AS hr_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT
            ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
            t.t_hour,
            COUNT(*) AS hour_cnt
        FROM web_sales ws
        JOIN time_dim t ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
        GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk, t.t_hour
    ) agg
),
customer_rank AS (
    SELECT
        ca.*, 
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_profit DESC) AS pct_rank
    FROM customer_agg ca
)
SELECT
    cr.customer_sk,
    cr.total_profit,
    cr.order_cnt,
    cr.first_purchase_date,
    cr.last_purchase_date,
    cr.avg_order_value,
    cr.promo_order_cnt,
    CASE WHEN cr.order_cnt > 0 THEN cr.promo_order_cnt * 1.0 / cr.order_cnt ELSE 0 END AS promo_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cr.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    CASE 
        WHEN cr.pct_rank <= 0.10 THEN 'Platinum'
        WHEN cr.pct_rank <= 0.30 THEN 'Gold'
        ELSE 'Silver'
    END AS tier,
    ch.t_hour AS favorite_hour,
    ch.hour_cnt AS favorite_hour_orders
FROM customer_rank cr
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT customer_sk, t_hour, hour_cnt
    FROM customer_hour
    WHERE hr_rank = 1
) ch ON cr.customer_sk = ch.customer_sk
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH store_agg AS (
   SELECT ss_customer_sk,
          SUM(ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit,
          COUNT(*) AS store_sales_cnt
   FROM store_sales
   GROUP BY ss_customer_sk
),
web_agg AS (
   SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk,
          SUM(ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
          COUNT(*) AS web_sales_cnt
   FROM web_sales
   GROUP BY ws_bill_customer_sk
),
customer_total AS (
   SELECT c.c_customer_sk,
          c.c_customer_id,
          c.c_first_name,
          c.c_last_name,
          c.c_birth_month,
          cd.cd_gender,
          cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
          COALESCE(sa.store_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_profit, 0) AS total_net_profit,
          COALESCE(sa.store_sales_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_sales_cnt, 0) AS total_sales_cnt,
          CASE WHEN cd.cd_credit_rating = 'Excellent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_excellent_credit
   FROM customer c
   JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
   LEFT JOIN store_agg sa ON c.c_customer_sk = sa.ss_customer_sk
   LEFT JOIN web_agg wa ON c.c_customer_sk = wa.ws_bill_customer_sk
)
SELECT
   ct.c_customer_id,
   ct.c_first_name,
   ct.c_last_name,
   ct.c_birth_month,
   ct.cd_gender,
   ct.total_net_profit,
   ct.total_sales_cnt,
   ct.is_excellent_credit,
   RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ct.total_net_profit DESC) AS global_profit_rank,
   CASE 
      WHEN ct.total_net_profit > 20000 THEN 'Diamond'
      WHEN ct.total_net_profit > 10000 THEN 'Platinum'
      WHEN ct.total_net_profit > 5000 THEN 'Gold'
      ELSE 'Silver'
   END AS tier_label,
   CASE 
      WHEN ct.is_excellent_credit = 1 AND ct.total_sales_cnt > 20 THEN 'Prime'
      ELSE 'Standard'
   END AS segment
FROM customer_total ct
WHERE ct.total_sales_cnt >= 3 AND ct.total_net_profit > 0
ORDER BY ct.total_net_profit DESC, ct.total_sales_cnt ASC
LIMIT 25

WITH customer_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        cs.cs_order_number,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS order_profit,
        MAX(cs.cs_promo_sk) AS promo_sk,
        MAX(cs.cs_ship_mode_sk) AS ship_mode_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_order_number
),
customer_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cs.customer_sk,
        COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
        AVG(cs.order_profit) AS avg_profit_per_order,
        SUM(cs.order_profit) AS total_profit,
        MAX(cs.promo_sk) AS any_promo_sk
    FROM customer_sales cs
    GROUP BY cs.customer_sk
),
customer_primary_ship_mode AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_ship_mode_sk
)
SELECT
    ca.customer_sk,
    ca.total_orders,
    ca.avg_profit_per_order,
    ca.total_profit,
    CASE WHEN ca.any_promo_sk IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS used_promotion,
    p.p_promo_name,
    sm.sm_type AS most_frequent_ship_mode,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN ca.total_profit > 500000 THEN 'Platinum'
        WHEN ca.total_profit BETWEEN 200000 AND 500000 THEN 'Gold'
        WHEN ca.total_profit BETWEEN 50000 AND 200000 THEN 'Silver'
        ELSE 'Bronze'
    END AS customer_tier
FROM customer_agg ca
JOIN customer_primary_ship_mode cpsm ON ca.customer_sk = cpsm.customer_sk AND cpsm.rn = 1
JOIN ship_mode sm ON cpsm.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ca.any_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
ORDER BY ca.total_profit DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH item_rank AS (
    SELECT
        sm.sm_ship_mode_id,
        sm.sm_type,
        i.i_item_id,
        i.i_product_name,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(cs.cs_quantity), 0) > 100 THEN 'High'
            WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(cs.cs_quantity), 0) BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS profit_category,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.sm_ship_mode_id ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY sm.sm_ship_mode_id, sm.sm_type, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name
    HAVING SUM(cs.cs_quantity) > 0
)
SELECT
    sm_ship_mode_id,
    sm_type,
    i_item_id,
    i_product_name,
    total_net_profit,
    total_quantity,
    profit_category,
    profit_rank
FROM item_rank
WHERE profit_rank <= 5
ORDER BY sm_ship_mode_id, profit_rank

WITH monthly_category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_category,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS month_id,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS monthly_sales,
        MIN(sm.sm_type) AS ship_mode
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    GROUP BY i.i_category, cs.cs_sold_date_sk
)
SELECT
    mc.i_category,
    mc.month_id,
    mc.monthly_sales,
    LAG(mc.monthly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY mc.i_category ORDER BY mc.month_id) AS prior_month_sales,
    CASE
        WHEN LAG(mc.monthly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY mc.i_category ORDER BY mc.month_id) IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN LAG(mc.monthly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY mc.i_category ORDER BY mc.month_id) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (mc.monthly_sales - LAG(mc.monthly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY mc.i_category ORDER BY mc.month_id))
             / LAG(mc.monthly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY mc.i_category ORDER BY mc.month_id) * 100
    END AS month_over_month_growth_pct,
    CASE
        WHEN mc.monthly_sales > 100000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN mc.monthly_sales BETWEEN 50000 AND 100000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS sales_volume_category,
    mc.ship_mode,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mc.i_category ORDER BY mc.monthly_sales DESC) AS sales_rank
FROM monthly_category_sales mc
WHERE mc.monthly_sales > 0
ORDER BY mc.i_category, mc.month_id

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT cs.cs_call_center_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_call_center_sk ), reason_agg AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, r.r_reason_desc, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, r.r_reason_desc ) SELECT ra.cc_name, ra.cc_city, ra.r_reason_desc, ra.total_return_amount, ra.return_cnt, sa.total_sales, ra.total_return_amount / NULLIF(sa.total_sales, 0) AS return_to_sales_ratio, CASE WHEN ra.total_return_amount / NULLIF(sa.total_sales, 0) > 0.05 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_severity, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ra.cc_name ORDER BY ra.total_return_amount DESC) AS reason_rank_per_cc FROM reason_agg ra LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ra.cc_call_center_sk = sa.cs_call_center_sk WHERE sa.total_sales IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ra.cc_name, reason_rank_per_cc

WITH cc_perf AS ( SELECT cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_tax_percentage, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_tax_percentage ), reason_agg AS ( SELECT cc.cc_name, r.r_reason_desc, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS reason_return_amount FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_name, r.r_reason_desc ), reason_rank AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_name ORDER BY reason_return_amount DESC) AS rn FROM reason_agg ) SELECT p.cc_name, p.cc_city, p.cc_state, p.cc_tax_percentage, p.total_sales, p.total_profit, p.total_return_amount, p.total_net_loss, (p.total_profit - COALESCE(p.total_net_loss, 0)) / NULLIF(p.total_sales, 0) AS profit_margin, CASE WHEN (p.total_profit - COALESCE(p.total_net_loss, 0)) / NULLIF(p.total_sales, 0) >= 0.20 THEN 'High' WHEN (p.total_profit - COALESCE(p.total_net_loss, 0)) / NULLIF(p.total_sales, 0) >= 0.10 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY (p.total_profit - COALESCE(p.total_net_loss, 0)) / NULLIF(p.total_sales, 0) DESC ) AS profit_margin_rank, rr.r_reason_desc AS top_return_reason, rr.reason_return_amount AS top_reason_return_amount FROM cc_perf p LEFT JOIN reason_rank rr ON p.cc_name = rr.cc_name AND rr.rn = 1 WHERE p.total_sales > 0 ORDER BY profit_margin_rank

WITH sales_month AS ( SELECT cs.cs_call_center_sk AS call_center_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS sales_amount, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS profit_amount FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_call_center_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk ), returns_month AS ( SELECT cr.cr_call_center_sk AS call_center_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS net_loss_amount FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_call_center_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk ), reason_month AS ( SELECT cr.cr_call_center_sk AS call_center_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, r.r_reason_desc, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS return_amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cr.cr_call_center_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk ORDER BY SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) DESC) AS rn FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_call_center_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk, r.r_reason_desc ), combined AS ( SELECT cc.cc_market_manager, sm.date_sk, sm.sales_amount, sm.profit_amount, COALESCE(rm.return_amount, 0) AS return_amount, COALESCE(rm.net_loss_amount, 0) AS net_loss_amount, (sm.profit_amount - COALESCE(rm.net_loss_amount, 0)) AS net_profit_after_returns, CASE WHEN cc.cc_tax_percentage > 15 THEN 'High Tax' WHEN cc.cc_tax_percentage BETWEEN 5 AND 15 THEN 'Medium Tax' ELSE 'Low Tax' END AS tax_category, rr.r_reason_desc AS top_reason FROM call_center cc LEFT JOIN sales_month sm ON cc.cc_call_center_sk = sm.call_center_sk LEFT JOIN returns_month rm ON cc.cc_call_center_sk = rm.call_center_sk AND sm.date_sk = rm.date_sk LEFT JOIN reason_month rr ON cc.cc_call_center_sk = rr.call_center_sk AND sm.date_sk = rr.date_sk AND rr.rn = 1 WHERE sm.date_sk IS NOT NULL ) SELECT cc_market_manager, date_sk, sales_amount, profit_amount, return_amount, net_loss_amount, net_profit_after_returns, tax_category, top_reason, SUM(net_profit_after_returns) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_market_manager ORDER BY date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_profit_by_manager FROM combined ORDER BY cc_market_manager, date_sk

WITH sales_item AS ( SELECT cs.cs_call_center_sk AS call_center_sk, cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_qty, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, AVG(cs.cs_list_price) AS avg_list_price FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_call_center_sk, cs.cs_item_sk ), returns_item AS ( SELECT cr.cr_call_center_sk AS call_center_sk, cr.cr_item_sk AS item_sk, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_ret_qty, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_ret_amount FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_call_center_sk, cr.cr_item_sk ), item_reason AS ( SELECT cr.cr_item_sk AS item_sk, r.r_reason_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cr.cr_item_sk ORDER BY SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) DESC) AS rn FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk, r.r_reason_desc ), combined AS ( SELECT si.call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, si.item_sk, si.total_qty, si.total_sales_amount, si.avg_discount, si.avg_list_price, COALESCE(ri.total_ret_qty, 0) AS total_ret_qty, COALESCE(ri.total_ret_amount, 0) AS total_ret_amount, CASE WHEN si.total_qty = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(ri.total_ret_qty, 0) * 1.0 / si.total_qty END AS return_qty_ratio, CASE WHEN si.avg_list_price >= 500 THEN 'Premium' WHEN si.avg_list_price >= 200 THEN 'Midrange' ELSE 'Budget' END AS price_category, CASE WHEN CASE WHEN si.total_qty = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(ri.total_ret_qty, 0) * 1.0 / si.total_qty END > 0.20 THEN 'Problematic' ELSE 'Normal' END AS item_status, ir.r_reason_desc AS top_return_reason FROM sales_item si JOIN call_center cc ON si.call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk LEFT JOIN returns_item ri ON si.call_center_sk = ri.call_center_sk AND si.item_sk = ri.item_sk LEFT JOIN item_reason ir ON si.item_sk = ir.item_sk AND ir.rn = 1 ) SELECT call_center_sk, cc_name, item_sk, total_qty, total_sales_amount, avg_discount, avg_list_price, total_ret_qty, total_ret_amount, return_qty_ratio, price_category, item_status, top_return_reason, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_name ORDER BY return_qty_ratio DESC) AS return_ratio_rank FROM combined WHERE total_qty > 0 ORDER BY cc_name, return_ratio_rank LIMIT 100

WITH hourly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        td.t_hour,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY td.t_hour, ss.ss_store_sk
), ranked_sales AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t_hour ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t_hour ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS profit_percentile
    FROM hourly_sales
    WHERE total_quantity >= 10
)
SELECT
    t_hour,
    ss_store_sk,
    total_sales,
    total_discount,
    total_profit,
    total_quantity,
    sales_rank,
    profit_percentile
FROM ranked_sales
ORDER BY t_hour, sales_rank

WITH store_profit_by_hour AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        td.t_hour,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        AVG(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
        MAX(ss.ss_net_profit) AS max_profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, td.t_hour
    HAVING AVG(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 50
)
SELECT
    spb.ss_store_sk,
    spb.t_hour,
    spb.total_net_profit,
    spb.avg_sales_price,
    spb.total_discount,
    spb.max_profit,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY spb.t_hour ORDER BY spb.max_profit DESC) AS max_profit_rank
FROM store_profit_by_hour spb
WHERE spb.total_discount > 0
ORDER BY spb.t_hour, max_profit_rank

WITH cust_reviews AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_birth_country,
        ws.web_name,
        d_ship.d_date AS ship_date,
        d_review.d_date AS review_date,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_year,
        date_diff('day', d_ship.d_date, d_review.d_date) AS days_to_review,
        CASE WHEN d_ship.d_month_seq = d_review.d_month_seq THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS same_month_flag
    FROM customer c
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ship ON c.c_first_shipto_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_review ON c.c_last_review_date = d_review.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site ws ON c.c_first_shipto_date_sk BETWEEN ws.web_open_date_sk AND ws.web_close_date_sk
    WHERE d_ship.d_year = d_review.d_year
),
country_stats AS (
    SELECT
        cr.c_birth_country,
        COALESCE(cr.web_name, 'No Site') AS web_name,
        COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
        SUM(cr.same_month_flag) AS same_month_reviews,
        AVG(cr.days_to_review) AS avg_days_to_review
    FROM cust_reviews cr
    GROUP BY cr.c_birth_country, cr.web_name
)
SELECT
    c.c_birth_country,
    c.web_name,
    c.total_customers,
    c.same_month_reviews,
    ROUND(100.0 * c.same_month_reviews / NULLIF(c.total_customers,0), 2) AS same_month_pct,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.same_month_reviews DESC) AS same_month_rank,
    MAX(c.avg_days_to_review) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_birth_country) AS max_avg_days_country
FROM country_stats c
ORDER BY same_month_pct DESC
LIMIT 25

WITH cust_reviews AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_birth_country,
        ws.web_name,
        d_ship.d_date AS ship_date,
        d_review.d_date AS review_date,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_year,
        date_diff('day', d_ship.d_date, d_review.d_date) AS days_to_review,
        CASE WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS high_vehicle_flag
    FROM customer c
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ship ON c.c_first_shipto_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_review ON c.c_last_review_date = d_review.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site ws ON c.c_first_shipto_date_sk BETWEEN ws.web_open_date_sk AND ws.web_close_date_sk
    WHERE d_ship.d_year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2020
),
country_stats AS (
    SELECT
        cr.c_birth_country,
        COALESCE(cr.web_name, 'No Site') AS web_name,
        COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
        SUM(cr.high_vehicle_flag) AS high_vehicle_customers,
        AVG(cr.days_to_review) AS avg_days_to_review
    FROM cust_reviews cr
    GROUP BY cr.c_birth_country, cr.web_name
)
SELECT
    c.c_birth_country,
    c.web_name,
    c.total_customers,
    c.high_vehicle_customers,
    ROUND(c.avg_days_to_review, 2) AS avg_days_to_review,
    100.0 * c.high_vehicle_customers / NULLIF(c.total_customers, 0) AS high_vehicle_pct,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.high_vehicle_customers DESC) AS vehicle_rank,
    MAX(c.avg_days_to_review) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_birth_country) AS max_avg_days_country
FROM country_stats c
ORDER BY high_vehicle_pct DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH cust_reviews AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_birth_country,
        ws.web_name,
        d_ship.d_date AS ship_date,
        d_review.d_date AS review_date,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_year,
        date_diff('day', d_ship.d_date, d_review.d_date) AS days_to_review,
        CASE WHEN c.c_birth_year < 1980 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS senior_flag
    FROM customer c
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ship ON c.c_first_shipto_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_review ON c.c_last_review_date = d_review.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site ws ON c.c_first_shipto_date_sk BETWEEN ws.web_open_date_sk AND ws.web_close_date_sk
    WHERE ws.web_state = 'CA' OR ws.web_state IS NULL
),
country_stats AS (
    SELECT
        cr.c_birth_country,
        COALESCE(cr.web_name, 'No Site') AS web_name,
        COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
        SUM(cr.senior_flag) AS senior_customers,
        AVG(cr.days_to_review) AS avg_days_to_review
    FROM cust_reviews cr
    GROUP BY cr.c_birth_country, cr.web_name
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 8
)
SELECT
    c.c_birth_country,
    c.web_name,
    c.total_customers,
    c.senior_customers,
    ROUND(100.0 * c.senior_customers / NULLIF(c.total_customers,0), 2) AS senior_pct,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.senior_customers DESC) AS senior_rank,
    SUM(c.total_customers) OVER (ORDER BY c.senior_customers DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_customers
FROM country_stats c
ORDER BY senior_pct DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH aggregated AS (SELECT i.i_category, i.i_manufact, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM item i JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN web_site s ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = s.web_site_sk WHERE s.web_state = 'CA' GROUP BY i.i_category, i.i_manufact, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name) SELECT i_category, i_manufact, i_item_id, i_product_name, total_net_profit, total_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank, CASE WHEN total_net_profit / NULLIF(total_quantity,0) > 100 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN total_net_profit / NULLIF(total_quantity,0) BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS profit_per_unit_category FROM aggregated WHERE total_net_profit > 0 ORDER BY i_category, profit_rank LIMIT 10

WITH page_sales AS (SELECT wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url, wp.wp_image_count, wp.wp_link_count, s.web_site_id, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS order_count FROM web_page wp JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN web_site s ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = s.web_site_sk WHERE s.web_country = 'United States' GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url, wp.wp_image_count, wp.wp_link_count, s.web_site_id), ranked_pages AS (SELECT *, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_percentile, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wp_image_count DESC) AS image_count_rank FROM page_sales) SELECT wp_web_page_sk, wp_url, web_site_id, total_sales, avg_discount, order_count, sales_percentile, CASE WHEN sales_percentile <= 0.33 THEN 'TOP' WHEN sales_percentile <= 0.66 THEN 'MIDDLE' ELSE 'BOTTOM' END AS performance_bucket, image_count_rank FROM ranked_pages ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT ss_item_sk, SUM(ss_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold, SUM(ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0)) AS total_return_quantity, SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_return_loss, (SUM(ss_net_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(ss_quantity), 0)) AS avg_profit_per_unit, (SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(ss_quantity), 0)) AS return_rate, CASE WHEN (SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(ss_quantity), 0)) > 0.2 THEN 'High Return' ELSE 'Normal' END AS return_flag, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(ss_quantity), 0)) DESC) AS return_rate_rank FROM store_sales ss JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk GROUP BY ss_item_sk HAVING SUM(ss_quantity) > 0 ORDER BY return_rate_rank LIMIT 30

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_income_band_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit, SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_return_loss FROM store_sales ss JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk AND sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_income_band_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential ) SELECT s.hd_demo_sk, s.hd_income_band_sk, s.hd_buy_potential, s.total_sales_profit, s.total_return_loss, (s.total_sales_profit - s.total_return_loss) AS net_profit_after_returns, CASE WHEN s.hd_income_band_sk >= 8 THEN 'High Income' WHEN s.hd_income_band_sk >= 4 THEN 'Mid Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS income_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (s.total_sales_profit - s.total_return_loss) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM sales_agg s ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 20

WITH store_agg AS ( SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk, ss.ss_item_sk, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS store_quantity FROM store_sales ss JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY hd.hd_demo_sk, ss.ss_item_sk ), return_agg AS ( SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk, sr.sr_item_sk, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS return_net_loss, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS return_quantity FROM store_returns sr JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY hd.hd_demo_sk, sr.sr_item_sk ), web_agg AS ( SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk, ws.ws_item_sk, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS web_quantity FROM web_sales ws JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY hd.hd_demo_sk, ws.ws_item_sk ) SELECT s.hd_demo_sk, s.ss_item_sk AS item_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential, s.store_net_profit, COALESCE(r.return_net_loss, 0) AS return_net_loss, (s.store_net_profit - COALESCE(r.return_net_loss, 0)) AS net_profit_after_returns, COALESCE(w.web_net_profit, 0) AS web_net_profit, (s.store_net_profit - COALESCE(r.return_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_profit, 0)) AS overall_profit, CASE WHEN (s.store_net_profit - COALESCE(r.return_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_profit, 0)) > 20000 THEN 'Very High' WHEN (s.store_net_profit - COALESCE(r.return_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_profit, 0)) > 10000 THEN 'High' WHEN (s.store_net_profit - COALESCE(r.return_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_profit, 0)) > 0 THEN 'Moderate' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY hd.hd_buy_potential ORDER BY (s.store_net_profit - COALESCE(r.return_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_profit, 0)) DESC) AS profit_rank_within_buy_potential FROM store_agg s LEFT JOIN return_agg r ON s.hd_demo_sk = r.hd_demo_sk AND s.ss_item_sk = r.sr_item_sk LEFT JOIN web_agg w ON s.hd_demo_sk = w.hd_demo_sk AND s.ss_item_sk = w.ws_item_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON s.hd_demo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk ORDER BY overall_profit DESC LIMIT 50

WITH sales_month AS (
   SELECT 
      ((ss.ss_sold_date_sk / 1000) % 100) AS month,
      ss.ss_net_profit - ss.ss_ext_discount_amt AS net_gain,
      ss.ss_sold_time_sk AS time_sk
   FROM store_sales ss
   WHERE ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost IS NOT NULL AND ss.ss_net_profit > 0
   UNION ALL
   SELECT 
      ((ws.ws_sold_date_sk / 1000) % 100) AS month,
      ws.ws_net_profit - ws.ws_ext_discount_amt AS net_gain,
      ws.ws_sold_time_sk AS time_sk
   FROM web_sales ws
   WHERE ws.ws_ext_wholesale_cost IS NOT NULL AND ws.ws_net_profit > 0
),
monthly_stats AS (
   SELECT
      month,
      SUM(net_gain) AS total_gain,
      AVG(net_gain) AS avg_gain,
      COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt,
      COUNT(DISTINCT time_sk) AS distinct_time_slots
   FROM sales_month
   GROUP BY month
),
ranked_months AS (
   SELECT
      month,
      total_gain,
      avg_gain,
      distinct_time_slots,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_gain DESC) AS rn,
      NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_gain) AS gain_quintile
   FROM monthly_stats
),
selected_months AS (
   SELECT month, total_gain, avg_gain, distinct_time_slots
   FROM ranked_months
   WHERE gain_quintile = 5
)
SELECT 
   c.c_customer_id,
   c.c_first_name,
   c.c_last_name,
   c.c_birth_month,
   cd.cd_credit_rating,
   sm.total_gain AS birth_month_total_gain,
   sm.avg_gain AS birth_month_avg_gain,
   sm.distinct_time_slots AS birth_month_time_slots,
   CASE WHEN c.c_birth_month = sm.month THEN 'TopGainMonth' ELSE 'Other' END AS birthday_month_flag,
   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.month ORDER BY c.c_customer_id) AS row_num_in_month,
   MAX(c.c_login) OVER (PARTITION BY sm.month) AS latest_login_in_month
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN selected_months sm ON c.c_birth_month = sm.month
WHERE cd.cd_gender = 'F' AND c.c_email_address LIKE '%@example.com' AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
ORDER BY sm.total_gain DESC, c.c_customer_id
LIMIT 25

WITH sales_month AS (

),
monthly_stats AS (

      AVG(ss_net_profit) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity IS NOT NULL) AS avg_profit,

      SUM(ss_quantity) AS total_qty,
      COUNT(DISTINCT ss_sold_time_sk) AS distinct_time_slots,
      COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt
   FROM sales_month

),
ranked_months AS (
   SELECT

      avg_profit,
   avg_discount,
      distinct_time_slots,
      total_qty,

),
top_months AS (

SELECT

   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tm.month ORDER BY c.c_customer_id) AS row_num_in_month,
   MIN(c.c_login) OVER (PARTITION BY tm.month) AS earliest_login_in_month,
   COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY tm.month) AS customers_in_month
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN top_months tm ON c.c_birth_month = tm.month
WHERE cd.cd_gender = 'F' AND c.c_email_address LIKE '%@example.com' AND c.c_last_review_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY tm.avg_profit DESC, c.c_customer_id

WITH sales_month AS (
   SELECT 
      (ss.ss_sold_date_sk / 1000) % 100 AS month,
      ss.ss_net_profit,
      ss.ss_ext_discount_amt,
      ss.ss_sold_time_sk,
      DATE_PARSE(CONCAT('20', CAST(ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS VARCHAR)), '%Y%m%d') AS sold_date
   FROM store_sales ss
   WHERE ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost IS NOT NULL AND ss.ss_net_profit > 0
   UNION ALL
   SELECT 
      (ws.ws_sold_date_sk / 1000) % 100 AS month,
      ws.ws_net_profit,
      ws.ws_ext_discount_amt,
      ws.ws_sold_time_sk,
      DATE_PARSE(CONCAT('20', CAST(ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS VARCHAR)), '%Y%m%d') AS sold_date
   FROM web_sales ws
   WHERE ws.ws_ext_wholesale_cost IS NOT NULL AND ws.ws_net_profit > 0
),
monthly_stats AS (
   SELECT
      month,
      AVG(ss_net_profit) AS avg_profit,
      AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
      COUNT(DISTINCT ss_sold_time_sk) AS distinct_time_slots,
      COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt,
      MIN(sold_date) AS first_sale_date,
      MAX(sold_date) AS last_sale_date
   FROM sales_month
   GROUP BY month
),
ranked_months AS (
   SELECT
      month,
      avg_profit,
      avg_discount,
      distinct_time_slots,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_profit DESC) AS rn,
      NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY avg_profit) AS profit_tertile,
      DATE_DIFF('day', first_sale_date, last_sale_date) AS active_days
   FROM monthly_stats
),
selected_months AS (
   SELECT month, avg_profit, avg_discount, distinct_time_slots, active_days
   FROM ranked_months
   WHERE profit_tertile = 1 AND active_days > 30
)
SELECT 
   c.c_customer_id,

   c.c_last_name,
   c.c_birth_month,
   cd.cd_credit_rating,
   sm.avg_profit AS birth_month_avg_profit,
   sm.avg_discount AS birth_month_avg_discount,
   sm.distinct_time_slots AS birth_month_time_slots,
   sm.active_days AS birth_month_active_days,
   CASE WHEN c.c_birth_month = sm.month THEN 'TopTertileActiveMonth' ELSE 'Other' END AS birthday_month_flag,
   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.month ORDER BY c.c_customer_id) AS row_num_in_month,
   MIN(c.c_login) OVER (PARTITION BY sm.month) AS earliest_login_in_month
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN selected_months sm ON c.c_birth_month = sm.month
WHERE cd.cd_gender = 'F' AND c.c_email_address LIKE '%@example.com' AND cd.cd_credit_rating IN ('A', 'B')
ORDER BY sm.avg_profit DESC, c.c_customer_id
LIMIT 25

WITH city_customer_counts AS ( SELECT s.s_city, sd.d_year AS store_closed_year, sd.d_month_seq AS store_closed_month_seq, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk) AS customers_after_closure FROM store s JOIN date_dim sd ON s.s_closed_date_sk = sd.d_date_sk CROSS JOIN customer c JOIN date_dim fd ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk WHERE fd.d_date > sd.d_date AND s.s_state = 'CA' GROUP BY s.s_city, sd.d_year, sd.d_month_seq ) SELECT ccc.s_city, ccc.store_closed_year, ccc.store_closed_month_seq, ccc.customers_after_closure, CASE WHEN ccc.customers_after_closure >= 500 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS volume_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ccc.customers_after_closure ASC) AS city_rank_by_customers FROM city_customer_counts ccc WHERE ccc.customers_after_closure BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 ORDER BY ccc.store_closed_year, ccc.store_closed_month_seq

WITH city_customer_counts AS ( SELECT s.s_city, sd.d_year AS store_closed_year, sd.d_moy AS store_closed_month, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM store s JOIN date_dim sd ON s.s_closed_date_sk = sd.d_date_sk CROSS JOIN customer c JOIN date_dim fd ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk WHERE fd.d_date > sd.d_date AND cr.cr_return_amount > 0 GROUP BY s.s_city, sd.d_year, sd.d_moy ) SELECT ccc.s_city, ccc.store_closed_year, ccc.store_closed_month, ccc.total_return_qty, CASE WHEN ccc.total_return_qty > 10000 THEN 'High Returns' ELSE 'Low Returns' END AS return_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ccc.store_closed_year ORDER BY ccc.total_return_qty DESC) AS rank_within_year FROM city_customer_counts ccc WHERE ccc.total_return_qty IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ccc.store_closed_year DESC, ccc.total_return_qty DESC

WITH monthly_aggregates AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_birth_month,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        AVG(sr.sr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss,
        AVG(ib.ib_lower_bound) AS avg_income_lower_bound
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_birth_month
)
SELECT
    c_birth_month,
    total_quantity,
    avg_net_loss,
    avg_income_lower_bound,
    LAG(total_quantity) OVER (ORDER BY c_birth_month) AS prev_quantity,
    CASE 
        WHEN LAG(total_quantity) OVER (ORDER BY c_birth_month) IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE (total_quantity - LAG(total_quantity) OVER (ORDER BY c_birth_month)) / NULLIF(LAG(total_quantity) OVER (ORDER BY c_birth_month), 0)
    END AS pct_change_quantity,
    CASE WHEN total_quantity > 500 THEN 'Peak' ELSE 'Normal' END AS month_category
FROM monthly_aggregates
ORDER BY c_birth_month

WITH ordered_returns AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_birth_year,
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.c_customer_id
            ORDER BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cumulative_return_amt,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
), flagged AS (
    SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c_customer_id ORDER BY sr_returned_date_sk) AS rn
    FROM ordered_returns
    WHERE cumulative_return_amt >= 5000
)
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    c_first_name,
    c_last_name,
    c_birth_year,
    hd_income_band_sk,
    ib_lower_bound,
    ib_upper_bound,
    sr_returned_date_sk,
    cumulative_return_amt,
    CASE WHEN cumulative_return_amt >= 5000 THEN 'Churn Risk' ELSE 'Normal' END AS risk_category
FROM flagged
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY cumulative_return_amt DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH customer_returns AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_birth_year,
        ib.ib_income_band_sk,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        SUM(sr.sr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_birth_year,
        ib.ib_income_band_sk,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound
)
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    c_first_name,
    c_last_name,
    c_birth_year,
    ib_income_band_sk,
    ib_lower_bound,
    ib_upper_bound,
    total_return_amount,
    total_net_loss,
    total_refunded_cash,
    CASE WHEN total_return_amount > 1000 THEN 'High Value' ELSE 'Regular' END AS customer_category,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS return_amount_rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ib_income_band_sk ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS income_band_return_rank
FROM customer_returns
ORDER BY return_amount_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH cust_item AS (SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount, SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS discount_amount, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_qty, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS profit FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk, ws.ws_item_sk), cust_total AS (SELECT customer_sk, SUM(sales_amount) AS total_sales, SUM(discount_amount) AS total_discount, SUM(total_qty) AS total_quantity, SUM(profit) AS total_profit FROM cust_item GROUP BY customer_sk), cust_ranked AS (SELECT ct.customer_sk, ct.total_sales, ct.total_discount, ct.total_quantity, ct.total_profit, (ct.total_discount / NULLIF(ct.total_sales, 0)) AS discount_rate, CASE WHEN ct.total_profit >= 20000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN ct.total_profit >= 10000 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS profit_tier, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ct.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM cust_total ct), top_item_per_cust AS (SELECT ci.customer_sk, ci.item_sk, ci.total_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ci.customer_sk ORDER BY ci.total_qty DESC) AS rn FROM cust_item ci) SELECT cr.customer_sk AS customer_id, cr.total_sales, cr.total_discount, cr.discount_rate, cr.total_quantity, cr.total_profit, cr.profit_tier, cr.profit_rank, i.i_item_id AS top_item_id, i.i_product_name AS top_item_name, i.i_category AS top_item_category, ti.total_qty AS top_item_quantity FROM cust_ranked cr JOIN top_item_per_cust ti ON cr.customer_sk = ti.customer_sk AND ti.rn = 1 JOIN item i ON ti.item_sk = i.i_item_sk ORDER BY cr.profit_rank LIMIT 20

WITH sales_returns AS (SELECT ws.ws_ship_mode_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk, ws.ws_ext_sales_price, ws.ws_net_profit, COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax, 0) AS return_amt, COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss, 0) AS return_loss FROM web_sales ws LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number), agg_by_mode_date AS (SELECT sr.ws_ship_mode_sk, sr.ws_sold_date_sk, SUM(sr.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(sr.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(sr.return_amt) AS total_returns, SUM(sr.return_loss) AS total_loss FROM sales_returns sr GROUP BY sr.ws_ship_mode_sk, sr.ws_sold_date_sk), final AS (SELECT sm.sm_type AS shipping_mode, a.ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, a.total_sales, a.total_returns, a.total_loss, (a.total_profit - a.total_loss) AS profit_after_returns, SUM(a.total_profit - a.total_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY sm.sm_type ORDER BY a.ws_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.ws_sold_date_sk ORDER BY a.total_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM agg_by_mode_date a JOIN ship_mode sm ON a.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk) SELECT shipping_mode, sold_date_sk, total_sales, total_returns, total_loss, profit_after_returns, cumulative_profit, loss_rank FROM final WHERE loss_rank <= 3 ORDER BY sold_date_sk, loss_rank

WITH sales_agg AS (SELECT ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_ship_mode_sk, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_ship_mode_sk), returns_agg AS (SELECT wr.wr_item_sk, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_returns, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_loss, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM web_returns wr GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk), item_ship AS (SELECT s.ws_item_sk, s.ws_ship_mode_sk, s.total_sales, s.total_profit, s.total_quantity, COALESCE(r.total_returns, 0) AS total_returns, COALESCE(r.total_loss, 0) AS total_loss, COALESCE(r.total_return_qty, 0) AS total_return_qty, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_brand, i.i_category, sm.sm_type AS shipping_mode FROM sales_agg s LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON s.ws_item_sk = r.wr_item_sk JOIN item i ON s.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON s.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk) SELECT i_item_id, i_product_name, i_brand, i_category, shipping_mode, total_sales, total_profit, total_returns, total_loss, (total_profit - total_loss) AS profit_after_returns, CASE WHEN (total_profit - total_loss) >= 10000 THEN 'High' WHEN (total_profit - total_loss) >= 5000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (total_profit - total_loss) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM item_ship ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 100

WITH total_sales AS (SELECT ws.ws_item_sk, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_qty FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk), total_returns AS (SELECT wr.wr_item_sk, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_loss FROM web_returns wr GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk), ship_mode_counts AS (SELECT ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_ship_mode_sk, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS qty_by_mode, COUNT(*) AS sales_rows FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_ship_mode_sk), top_ship_mode AS (SELECT smc.ws_item_sk, smc.ws_ship_mode_sk, smc.qty_by_mode, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY smc.ws_item_sk ORDER BY smc.qty_by_mode DESC) AS rn FROM ship_mode_counts smc), item_metrics AS (SELECT i.i_item_sk, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_brand, COALESCE(s.total_qty, 0) AS total_qty, COALESCE(r.total_return_qty, 0) AS total_return_qty, COALESCE(r.total_loss, 0) AS total_loss, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.total_qty, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(r.total_return_qty, 0) / CAST(COALESCE(s.total_qty, 0) AS DOUBLE) END AS return_rate, CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.total_return_qty, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(r.total_loss, 0) / CAST(COALESCE(r.total_return_qty, 0) AS DOUBLE) END AS avg_loss_per_return FROM item i LEFT JOIN total_sales s ON i.i_item_sk = s.ws_item_sk LEFT JOIN total_returns r ON i.i_item_sk = r.wr_item_sk), ranked_items AS (SELECT im.*, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY im.return_rate DESC) AS return_rate_rank, CASE WHEN im.return_rate > 0.2 THEN 'High Return' WHEN im.return_rate > 0.1 THEN 'Medium Return' ELSE 'Normal Return' END AS return_category FROM item_metrics im) SELECT ri.i_item_id, ri.i_product_name, ri.i_category, ri.i_brand, ri.total_qty, ri.total_return_qty, ri.return_rate, ri.return_category, ri.return_rate_rank, ri.avg_loss_per_return, sm.sm_type AS predominant_ship_mode FROM ranked_items ri JOIN top_ship_mode tsm ON ri.i_item_sk = tsm.ws_item_sk AND tsm.rn = 1 JOIN ship_mode sm ON tsm.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk WHERE ri.return_rate_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ri.return_rate_rank

WITH daily_returns AS ( SELECT inv.inv_warehouse_sk, inv.inv_date_sk, SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_qty_on_hand, COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt),0) AS total_return_amt FROM inventory inv JOIN item i ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON i.i_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk AND inv.inv_date_sk = wr.wr_returned_date_sk GROUP BY inv.inv_warehouse_sk, inv.inv_date_sk ) SELECT dr.inv_warehouse_sk, dr.inv_date_sk, dr.total_qty_on_hand, dr.total_return_amt, AVG(dr.total_return_amt) OVER ( PARTITION BY dr.inv_warehouse_sk ORDER BY dr.inv_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_return_amt_last_3_days, CASE WHEN dr.total_qty_on_hand = 0 THEN NULL ELSE dr.total_return_amt / dr.total_qty_on_hand END AS return_per_qty, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dr.inv_warehouse_sk ORDER BY dr.inv_date_sk DESC) AS recent_date_rank FROM daily_returns dr ORDER BY dr.inv_warehouse_sk, dr.inv_date_sk

SELECT i.i_category, i.i_brand, SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand * i.i_current_price) AS inventory_sales_value, SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand * i.i_wholesale_cost) AS inventory_wholesale_cost, COALESCE(SUM(p.p_cost),0) AS total_promo_cost, COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt),0) AS total_return_amount, (SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand * i.i_current_price) - SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand * i.i_wholesale_cost) - COALESCE(SUM(p.p_cost),0) - COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt),0)) AS net_profit, CASE WHEN (SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand * i.i_current_price) - SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand * i.i_wholesale_cost) - COALESCE(SUM(p.p_cost),0) - COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt),0)) > 0 THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_status, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand * i.i_current_price) - SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand * i.i_wholesale_cost) - COALESCE(SUM(p.p_cost),0) - COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt),0)) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM item i LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON i.i_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON i.i_item_sk = p.p_item_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON i.i_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_category, i.i_brand HAVING SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) > 0 ORDER BY net_profit DESC

SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_brand, i.i_wholesale_cost, COALESCE(SUM(p.p_cost),0) AS total_promo_cost, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(p.p_cost),0) > 2 * i.i_wholesale_cost THEN 'High Discount' ELSE 'Normal Discount' END AS discount_level, SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_on_hand, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, CASE WHEN SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS DOUBLE) / SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) END AS return_to_inventory_ratio, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS DOUBLE) / SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) END DESC) AS ratio_rank FROM item i LEFT JOIN promotion p ON i.i_item_sk = p.p_item_sk LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON i.i_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON i.i_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_brand, i.i_wholesale_cost HAVING COALESCE(SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand),0) > 0 ORDER BY return_to_inventory_ratio DESC LIMIT 20

WITH catalog_cust AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS catalog_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt,
        MAX(i.i_brand) AS top_brand
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2450800
    GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
),
web_cust AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS web_return_amount,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt,
        MAX(i.i_brand) AS top_brand
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2450800
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk
    HAVING SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) > 200
),
combined_cust AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(c.customer_sk, w.customer_sk) AS customer_sk,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_amount, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_amount, 0) AS total_return_amount,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_cnt, 0) AS total_return_cnt,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 12000 THEN 'Very High Loss'
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 6000 THEN 'High Loss'
            ELSE 'Low/Medium Loss'
        END AS loss_category,
        COALESCE(c.top_brand, w.top_brand) AS dominant_brand
    FROM catalog_cust c
    FULL OUTER JOIN web_cust w ON c.customer_sk = w.customer_sk
)
SELECT
    customer_sk,
    total_return_amount,
    total_net_loss,
    total_return_cnt,
    loss_category,
    dominant_brand,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS amt_rank,
    CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_cume_dist,
    SUM(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY loss_category ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_by_category
FROM combined_cust
WHERE loss_category <> 'Low/Medium Loss'
ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 12

WITH catalog_cust AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS catalog_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt,
        MIN(i.i_color) AS first_color
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_returned_date_sk >= 2450200
    GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk
    HAVING SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) > 800
),
web_cust AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS web_return_amount,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt,
        MIN(i.i_color) AS first_color
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_returned_date_sk >= 2450200
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
combined_cust AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(c.customer_sk, w.customer_sk) AS customer_sk,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_amount, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_amount, 0) AS total_return_amount,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_cnt, 0) AS total_return_cnt,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 9000 THEN 'Very High Loss'
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 4000 THEN 'High Loss'
            ELSE 'Low/Medium Loss'
        END AS loss_category,
        COALESCE(c.first_color, w.first_color) AS representative_color
    FROM catalog_cust c
    FULL OUTER JOIN web_cust w ON c.customer_sk = w.customer_sk
)
SELECT
    customer_sk,
    total_return_amount,
    total_net_loss,
    total_return_cnt,
    loss_category,
    representative_color,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS return_amount_percentile,
    SUM(total_net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_loss
FROM combined_cust
WHERE total_return_cnt >= 3 AND loss_category = 'High Loss'
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 8

WITH catalog_cust AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS catalog_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i.i_category) FILTER (WHERE i.i_category IS NOT NULL) AS catalog_categories
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2450500 AND 2451500
    GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk
    HAVING SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) BETWEEN 500 AND 2000
),
web_cust AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS web_return_amount,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt,
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i.i_category) FILTER (WHERE i.i_category IS NOT NULL) AS web_categories
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2450500 AND 2451500
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
),
combined_cust AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(c.customer_sk, w.customer_sk) AS customer_sk,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_amount, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_amount, 0) AS total_return_amount,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_cnt, 0) AS total_return_cnt,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 15000 THEN 'Very High Loss'
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 8000 THEN 'High Loss'
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 2000 THEN 'Medium Loss'
            ELSE 'Low Loss'
        END AS loss_category,
        ARRAY_JOIN(COALESCE(c.catalog_categories, ARRAY[]), ', ') AS catalog_categories_str,
        ARRAY_JOIN(COALESCE(w.web_categories, ARRAY[]), ', ') AS web_categories_str
    FROM catalog_cust c
    FULL OUTER JOIN web_cust w ON c.customer_sk = w.customer_sk
)
SELECT
    customer_sk,
    total_return_amount,
    total_net_loss,
    total_return_cnt,
    loss_category,
    catalog_categories_str,
    web_categories_str,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY loss_category ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS loss_category_rank,
    NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_quartile,
    AVG(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY loss_category) AS avg_return_by_loss
FROM combined_cust
WHERE total_return_cnt >= 2 AND loss_category IN ('High Loss', 'Very High Loss')
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH catalog_cust AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS catalog_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT i.i_brand) AS distinct_brand_cnt
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2450300 AND 2450900
    GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.i_brand) >= 2
),
web_cust AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS web_return_amount,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT i.i_brand) AS distinct_brand_cnt
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2450300 AND 2450900
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk
    HAVING SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) > 500
),
combined_cust AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(c.customer_sk, w.customer_sk) AS customer_sk,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_amount, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_amount, 0) AS total_return_amount,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_cnt, 0) AS total_return_cnt,
        COALESCE(c.distinct_brand_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(w.distinct_brand_cnt, 0) AS total_distinct_brands,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 11000 THEN 'Very High Loss'
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 6000 THEN 'High Loss'
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 2000 THEN 'Medium Loss'
            ELSE 'Low Loss'
        END AS loss_category
    FROM catalog_cust c
    FULL OUTER JOIN web_cust w ON c.customer_sk = w.customer_sk
)
SELECT
    customer_sk,
    total_return_amount,
    total_net_loss,
    total_return_cnt,
    total_distinct_brands,
    loss_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY loss_category ORDER BY total_distinct_brands DESC) AS brand_rank,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_percentile,
    SUM(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY loss_category ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_amount_by_category
FROM combined_cust
WHERE total_distinct_brands >= 3
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 14

WITH address_item_returns AS (SELECT ca.ca_address_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_country, ca.ca_zip, i.i_category, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS address_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, AVG(sr.sr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_address_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_country, ca.ca_zip, i.i_category) SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_city, ca_state, ca_country, ca_zip, i_category, address_net_loss, return_cnt, avg_return_amt, city_avg_net_loss, CASE WHEN address_net_loss > city_avg_net_loss THEN 'Above City Avg' ELSE 'At/Below City Avg' END AS net_loss_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY address_net_loss DESC) AS state_net_loss_rank FROM (SELECT ari.ca_address_sk, ari.ca_city, ari.ca_state, ari.ca_country, ari.ca_zip, ari.i_category, ari.address_net_loss, ari.return_cnt, ari.avg_return_amt, AVG(ari.address_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY ari.ca_city) AS city_avg_net_loss FROM address_item_returns ari) t ORDER BY ca_state, state_net_loss_rank
