WITH returns_enriched AS (SELECT sr.sr_store_sk, sr.sr_item_sk, sr.sr_return_amt, sr.sr_net_loss, sr.sr_return_quantity, i.i_category, i.i_class, i.i_current_price, i.i_wholesale_cost, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state, s.s_country, ca.ca_city AS cust_city, ca.ca_state AS cust_state, CASE WHEN i.i_current_price >= 100 THEN 'High' WHEN i.i_current_price >= 50 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS price_tier, CASE WHEN sr.sr_return_quantity > 5 THEN 'Bulk' ELSE 'Single' END AS return_type FROM store_returns sr JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk) SELECT s_store_name, s_city, s_state, cust_city, cust_state, price_tier, return_type, return_cnt, total_return_amount, total_net_loss, avg_return_qty, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY price_tier ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank_by_tier, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS overall_return_amount_rank FROM (SELECT s_store_name, s_city, s_state, cust_city, cust_state, price_tier, return_type, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, SUM(sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, AVG(sr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_qty FROM returns_enriched GROUP BY s_store_name, s_city, s_state, cust_city, cust_state, price_tier, return_type) t ORDER BY price_tier, net_loss_rank_by_tier

WITH item_returns AS (SELECT sr.sr_store_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, ca.ca_city AS cust_city, i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name, i.i_current_price, i.i_wholesale_cost, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, CASE WHEN (i.i_current_price - i.i_wholesale_cost) >= 50 THEN 'High Margin' WHEN (i.i_current_price - i.i_wholesale_cost) >= 20 THEN 'Medium Margin' ELSE 'Low Margin' END AS margin_category FROM store_returns sr JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, ca.ca_city, i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name, i.i_current_price, i.i_wholesale_cost) SELECT s_store_name, s_city, cust_city, i_product_name, margin_category, total_return_qty, total_return_amt, qty_rank_per_store FROM (SELECT s_store_name, s_city, cust_city, i_product_name, margin_category, total_return_qty, total_return_amt, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_name ORDER BY total_return_qty DESC) AS qty_rank_per_store FROM item_returns) ranked WHERE qty_rank_per_store <= 5 ORDER BY s_store_name, qty_rank_per_store

WITH daily_store_loss AS (SELECT sr.sr_store_sk, s.s_store_name, sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS return_date, i.i_category, ca.ca_city AS address_city, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS daily_net_loss, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS daily_return_amt FROM store_returns sr JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk, s.s_store_name, sr.sr_returned_date_sk, i.i_category, ca.ca_city), cumulative_loss AS (SELECT sr_store_sk, s_store_name, return_date, i_category, address_city, daily_net_loss, daily_return_amt, SUM(daily_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY sr_store_sk ORDER BY return_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_loss, AVG(daily_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY sr_store_sk) * 1.5 AS high_loss_threshold FROM daily_store_loss), store_total AS (SELECT sr_store_sk, s_store_name, MAX(cumulative_net_loss) AS total_cumulative_net_loss, CASE WHEN MAX(cumulative_net_loss) >= 100000 THEN 'Very High' WHEN MAX(cumulative_net_loss) >= 50000 THEN 'High' WHEN MAX(cumulative_net_loss) >= 20000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS loss_category FROM cumulative_loss GROUP BY sr_store_sk, s_store_name) SELECT sr_store_sk, s_store_name, total_cumulative_net_loss, loss_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_cumulative_net_loss DESC) AS store_net_loss_rank FROM store_total ORDER BY store_net_loss_rank

WITH base AS (SELECT sr.sr_store_sk, sr.sr_returned_date_sk, sr.sr_net_loss, sr.sr_store_credit, r.r_reason_desc, c.c_preferred_cust_flag, cd.cd_credit_rating FROM store_returns sr JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk), daily_store AS (SELECT sr_store_sk, sr_returned_date_sk, cd_credit_rating, r_reason_desc, SUM(sr_net_loss) AS daily_net_loss, SUM(sr_store_credit) AS daily_store_credit, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' THEN c_preferred_cust_flag END) AS preferred_customers FROM base GROUP BY sr_store_sk, sr_returned_date_sk, cd_credit_rating, r_reason_desc), store_agg AS (SELECT sr_store_sk, sr_returned_date_sk, cd_credit_rating, r_reason_desc, daily_net_loss, daily_store_credit, SUM(daily_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY sr_store_sk ORDER BY sr_returned_date_sk ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_net_loss, SUM(daily_store_credit) OVER (PARTITION BY sr_store_sk ORDER BY sr_returned_date_sk ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_store_credit, SUM(daily_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY sr_store_sk, r_reason_desc) AS reason_net_loss_total, SUM(daily_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY sr_store_sk) AS store_net_loss_total, preferred_customers FROM daily_store) SELECT sr_store_sk, sr_returned_date_sk, cd_credit_rating, r_reason_desc, daily_net_loss, daily_store_credit, cumulative_net_loss, cumulative_store_credit, ROUND(100.0 * reason_net_loss_total / NULLIF(store_net_loss_total, 0), 2) AS reason_loss_pct, CASE WHEN cumulative_net_loss > 50000 THEN 'Critical' WHEN cumulative_net_loss > 20000 THEN 'Warning' ELSE 'Healthy' END AS store_health_status, preferred_customers FROM store_agg ORDER BY sr_store_sk, sr_returned_date_sk

WITH high_estimate_returns AS (SELECT sr.sr_net_loss, sr.sr_return_quantity, sr.sr_reason_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, r.r_reason_desc, c.c_preferred_cust_flag FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk WHERE cd.cd_purchase_estimate > 3000), reason_agg AS (SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, r_reason_desc, SUM(sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, COUNT(*) AS return_count, SUM(CASE WHEN c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS preferred_customer_count FROM high_estimate_returns GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, r_reason_desc), ranked_reasons AS (SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cd_gender ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS reason_rank, SUM(total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cd_gender ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_loss FROM reason_agg) SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, r_reason_desc, total_net_loss, total_return_qty, return_count, preferred_customer_count, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 20000 THEN 'Critical' WHEN total_net_loss > 10000 THEN 'High' WHEN total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS loss_severity, reason_rank, cumulative_net_loss FROM ranked_reasons ORDER BY cd_gender, reason_rank

WITH return_data AS (SELECT c.c_birth_month, c.c_birth_year, sr.sr_returned_date_sk, (sr.sr_return_amt + sr.sr_return_tax + sr.sr_reversed_charge) AS total_return_amount, cd.cd_purchase_estimate, r.r_reason_desc FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk), monthly_agg AS (SELECT c_birth_month, c_birth_year, sr_returned_date_sk, AVG(total_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount, CASE WHEN cd_purchase_estimate >= 5000 THEN 'High Estimate' WHEN cd_purchase_estimate >= 2000 THEN 'Medium Estimate' ELSE 'Low Estimate' END AS purchase_estimate_category FROM return_data GROUP BY c_birth_month, c_birth_year, sr_returned_date_sk, cd_purchase_estimate), monthly_moving AS (SELECT c_birth_month, c_birth_year, sr_returned_date_sk, avg_return_amount, purchase_estimate_category, AVG(avg_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c_birth_month ORDER BY sr_returned_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_7_periods FROM monthly_agg), reason_counts AS (SELECT c_birth_month, c_birth_year, sr_returned_date_sk, r_reason_desc, COUNT(*) AS reason_cnt FROM return_data GROUP BY c_birth_month, c_birth_year, sr_returned_date_sk, r_reason_desc), top_reason_per_month AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c_birth_month, sr_returned_date_sk ORDER BY reason_cnt DESC) AS rn FROM reason_counts) SELECT m.c_birth_month, m.c_birth_year, m.sr_returned_date_sk AS return_date_sk, m.avg_return_amount, m.moving_avg_7_periods, m.purchase_estimate_category, tr.r_reason_desc AS top_reason FROM monthly_moving m LEFT JOIN top_reason_per_month tr ON m.c_birth_month = tr.c_birth_month AND m.sr_returned_date_sk = tr.sr_returned_date_sk AND tr.rn = 1 ORDER BY m.c_birth_month, m.sr_returned_date_sk

WITH aggregated AS (SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_birth_month, c.c_birth_year, cd.cd_credit_rating, cd.cd_gender, c.c_customer_sk, r.r_reason_desc, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(sr.sr_store_credit) AS total_store_credit, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, COUNT(*) AS reason_cnt FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_birth_month, c.c_birth_year, cd.cd_credit_rating, cd.cd_gender, r.r_reason_desc, c.c_customer_sk), ranked_reasons AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c_customer_sk ORDER BY reason_cnt DESC) AS rn FROM aggregated), final_rank AS (SELECT c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, cd_credit_rating, cd_gender, total_net_loss, total_store_credit, total_return_qty, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 10000 THEN 'High' WHEN total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS loss_category, r_reason_desc AS top_return_reason, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM ranked_reasons WHERE rn = 1) SELECT * FROM final_rank WHERE loss_rank <= 5 ORDER BY loss_rank

WITH promo_start AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_cost, p.p_discount_active, d_start.d_date AS start_date, d_start.d_quarter_seq, d_start.d_year FROM promotion p JOIN date_dim d_start ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk ) SELECT ps.d_quarter_seq AS quarter_seq, ws.web_mkt_id, ws.web_mkt_desc, SUM(ps.p_cost) AS total_promo_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.p_promo_id) AS promo_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN ps.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_discount_cnt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.d_quarter_seq ORDER BY SUM(ps.p_cost) DESC) AS market_cost_rank, CASE WHEN SUM(ps.p_cost) > 50000 THEN 'Very High' WHEN SUM(ps.p_cost) > 20000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS cost_band FROM promo_start ps JOIN web_site ws ON 1=1 JOIN date_dim d_open ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_close ON ws.web_close_date_sk = d_close.d_date_sk WHERE ps.start_date BETWEEN d_open.d_date AND d_close.d_date GROUP BY ps.d_quarter_seq, ws.web_mkt_id, ws.web_mkt_desc ORDER BY ps.d_quarter_seq, market_cost_rank

WITH promo_dates AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_cost, d_start.d_date AS start_date, d_end.d_date AS end_date FROM promotion p JOIN date_dim d_start ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_end ON p.p_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk ) SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, d_closure.d_date AS closed_date, COALESCE(SUM(pd.p_cost), 0) AS total_promo_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT pd.p_promo_id) AS promo_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pd.p_cost), 0) DESC) AS cost_rank, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(pd.p_cost), 0) > 10000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS cost_category FROM store s JOIN date_dim d_closure ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_closure.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN promo_dates pd ON d_closure.d_date BETWEEN pd.start_date AND pd.end_date GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, d_closure.d_date ORDER BY total_promo_cost DESC

WITH promo_dates AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_cost, d_start.d_date AS start_date, d_end.d_date AS end_date FROM promotion p JOIN date_dim d_start ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_end ON p.p_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk ) SELECT ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, d_open.d_date AS open_date, d_close.d_date AS close_date, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT pd.p_promo_id), 0) AS promo_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT pd.p_promo_id) DESC) AS promo_rank, CASE WHEN ws.web_tax_percentage > 0.05 THEN 'High Tax' ELSE 'Low Tax' END AS tax_category FROM web_site ws JOIN date_dim d_open ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_close ON ws.web_close_date_sk = d_close.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN promo_dates pd ON pd.start_date >= d_open.d_date AND pd.end_date <= d_close.d_date GROUP BY ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, d_open.d_date, d_close.d_date, ws.web_tax_percentage ORDER BY promo_count DESC

WITH store_dates AS ( SELECT s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, d.d_date AS closed_date, s.s_state FROM store s JOIN date_dim d ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk ), website_intervals AS ( SELECT ws.web_site_sk, ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, d_open.d_date AS open_date, d_close.d_date AS close_date, ws.web_tax_percentage, ws.web_state FROM web_site ws JOIN date_dim d_open ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_close ON ws.web_close_date_sk = d_close.d_date_sk ), promo_intervals AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_cost, d_start.d_date AS start_date, d_end.d_date AS end_date FROM promotion p JOIN date_dim d_start ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_end ON p.p_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk ) SELECT sd.s_store_id, sd.s_store_name, sd.closed_date, wi.web_site_id, wi.web_name, wi.web_tax_percentage, COALESCE(SUM(pi.p_cost),0) AS total_active_promo_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT pi.p_promo_id) AS active_promo_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.s_store_id ORDER BY wi.web_tax_percentage DESC) AS website_tax_rank, CASE WHEN sd.s_state = 'CA' THEN 'West Coast' ELSE 'Other' END AS store_region FROM store_dates sd LEFT JOIN website_intervals wi ON sd.closed_date BETWEEN wi.open_date AND wi.close_date LEFT JOIN promo_intervals pi ON sd.closed_date BETWEEN pi.start_date AND pi.end_date GROUP BY sd.s_store_id, sd.s_store_name, sd.closed_date, wi.web_site_id, wi.web_name, wi.web_tax_percentage, sd.s_state ORDER BY sd.s_store_id, website_tax_rank

WITH ship_date_stats AS ( SELECT d.d_date AS ship_date, d.d_year, d.d_moy, d.d_day_name, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, AVG(cs.cs_coupon_amt) AS avg_coupon, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date, d.d_year, d.d_moy, d.d_day_name ), inventory_on_ship AS ( SELECT d.d_date, SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty FROM inventory i JOIN date_dim d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date ), website_dates AS ( SELECT ws.web_site_sk, open_d.d_date AS open_date, close_d.d_date AS close_date, ws.web_tax_percentage FROM web_site ws JOIN date_dim open_d ON ws.web_open_date_sk = open_d.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim close_d ON ws.web_close_date_sk = close_d.d_date_sk ), website_tax_on_ship AS ( SELECT sds.ship_date, AVG(wd.web_tax_percentage) AS avg_tax_pct FROM ship_date_stats sds LEFT JOIN website_dates wd ON sds.ship_date BETWEEN wd.open_date AND wd.close_date GROUP BY sds.ship_date ) SELECT sds.ship_date, sds.d_year, sds.d_moy, sds.d_day_name, sds.total_orders, sds.avg_discount, SUM(sds.total_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY sds.d_year) AS orders_by_year, COALESCE(ios.total_inventory_qty,0) AS total_inventory_qty, COALESCE(wts.avg_tax_pct,0) AS avg_tax_pct FROM ship_date_stats sds LEFT JOIN inventory_on_ship ios ON sds.ship_date = ios.d_date LEFT JOIN website_tax_on_ship wts ON sds.ship_date = wts.ship_date WHERE sds.total_orders BETWEEN 5 AND 50 ORDER BY sds.d_year, sds.avg_discount DESC LIMIT 15

WITH ship_date_stats AS ( SELECT d.d_date AS ship_date, d.d_year, d.d_moy, d.d_day_name, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, APPROX_PERCENTILE(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt, 0.5) AS median_discount, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, AVG(cs.cs_coupon_amt) AS avg_coupon FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date, d.d_year, d.d_moy, d.d_day_name ), inventory_on_ship AS ( SELECT d.d_date, SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty, AVG(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory_qty FROM inventory i JOIN date_dim d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date ), website_tax_on_ship AS ( SELECT sds.ship_date, MAX(ws.web_tax_percentage) AS max_tax_pct FROM ship_date_stats sds JOIN web_site ws ON sds.ship_date BETWEEN (SELECT d.d_date FROM date_dim d WHERE d.d_date_sk = ws.web_open_date_sk) AND (SELECT d.d_date FROM date_dim d WHERE d.d_date_sk = ws.web_close_date_sk) GROUP BY sds.ship_date ) SELECT sds.ship_date, sds.d_year, sds.d_moy, sds.d_day_name, sds.total_orders, sds.avg_discount, sds.median_discount, CASE WHEN sds.avg_discount >= 15 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS discount_flag, COALESCE(ios.total_inventory_qty,0) AS total_inventory_qty, COALESCE(ios.avg_inventory_qty,0) AS avg_inventory_qty, COALESCE(wts.max_tax_pct,0) AS max_tax_pct, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sds.d_year ORDER BY sds.median_discount DESC) AS year_median_rank FROM ship_date_stats sds LEFT JOIN inventory_on_ship ios ON sds.ship_date = ios.d_date LEFT JOIN website_tax_on_ship wts ON sds.ship_date = wts.ship_date WHERE sds.total_orders >= 20 AND sds.median_discount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sds.d_year, year_median_rank LIMIT 25

WITH promo_start AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_cost, p.p_discount_active, d_start.d_date AS start_date, d_start.d_quarter_seq, d_start.d_year FROM promotion p JOIN date_dim d_start ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk ) SELECT ps.d_quarter_seq, ws.web_mkt_id, ws.web_mkt_desc, SUM(ps.p_cost) AS total_promo_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.p_promo_id) AS promo_cnt, MAX(ps.p_cost) AS max_promo_cost, MIN(ps.p_cost) AS min_promo_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ws.web_mkt_id ORDER BY SUM(ps.p_cost) DESC) AS quarter_cost_rank FROM promo_start ps JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_city = 'New York' JOIN date_dim d_open ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_close ON ws.web_close_date_sk = d_close.d_date_sk WHERE ps.start_date BETWEEN d_open.d_date AND d_close.d_date AND ps.p_discount_active = 'N' GROUP BY ps.d_quarter_seq, ws.web_mkt_id, ws.web_mkt_desc ORDER BY quarter_cost_rank, ps.d_quarter_seq

WITH promo_start AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_cost, p.p_discount_active, d_start.d_date AS start_date, d_start.d_quarter_seq, d_start.d_year FROM promotion p JOIN date_dim d_start ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk ) SELECT ps.d_quarter_seq, ws.web_mkt_id, ws.web_mkt_desc, SUM(ps.p_cost) AS total_promo_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.p_promo_id) AS promo_cnt, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ws.web_mkt_id ORDER BY SUM(ps.p_cost)) AS cost_percentile FROM promo_start ps JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_gmt_offset BETWEEN -5 AND -3 JOIN date_dim d_open ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_close ON ws.web_close_date_sk = d_close.d_date_sk WHERE ps.start_date >= d_open.d_date AND ps.start_date <= d_close.d_date AND ps.p_cost BETWEEN 500 AND 5000 GROUP BY ps.d_quarter_seq, ws.web_mkt_id, ws.web_mkt_desc ORDER BY ws.web_mkt_id, ps.d_quarter_seq

WITH promo_start AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_cost, p.p_discount_active, d_start.d_date AS start_date, d_start.d_quarter_seq, d_start.d_year FROM promotion p JOIN date_dim d_start ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk ) SELECT ps.d_year, ws.web_mkt_id, ws.web_mkt_desc, SUM(ps.p_cost) AS total_promo_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.p_promo_id) AS promo_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN ps.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN ps.p_cost ELSE 0 END) AS active_discount_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.d_year ORDER BY SUM(ps.p_cost) DESC) AS market_cost_rank FROM promo_start ps JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_country = 'USA' JOIN date_dim d_open ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_close ON ws.web_close_date_sk = d_close.d_date_sk WHERE ps.start_date >= d_open.d_date AND ps.start_date <= d_close.d_date AND ws.web_mkt_id IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY ps.d_year, ws.web_mkt_id, ws.web_mkt_desc ORDER BY ps.d_year, market_cost_rank

WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS daily_net_paid,
        'catalog' AS channel
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    GROUP BY cs.cs_promo_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ws.ws_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS daily_net_paid,
        'web' AS channel
    FROM web_sales ws
    GROUP BY ws.ws_promo_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk
),
promo_daily AS (
    SELECT
        p.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
        ds.sold_date_sk,
        ds.channel,
        ds.daily_net_paid,
        SUM(ds.daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_promo_name, ds.channel ORDER BY ds.sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_paid,
        LAG(ds.daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_promo_name, ds.channel ORDER BY ds.sold_date_sk) AS prev_daily_net_paid
    FROM daily_sales ds
    JOIN promotion p ON ds.promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
)
SELECT
    promo_name,
    sold_date_sk,
    channel,
    daily_net_paid,
    cumulative_net_paid,
    CASE
        WHEN prev_daily_net_paid IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN prev_daily_net_paid = 0 THEN NULL
        WHEN (daily_net_paid - prev_daily_net_paid) / prev_daily_net_paid >= 0.2 THEN 'Significant Increase'
        ELSE 'Normal'
    END AS change_flag
FROM promo_daily
WHERE daily_net_paid > 0
ORDER BY promo_name, channel, sold_date_sk

WITH cs_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
        p.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
        sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        'catalog' AS channel
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, p.p_promo_name, sm.sm_type
),
ws_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
        p.p_promo_name AS promo_name,
        sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        'web' AS channel
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk, p.p_promo_name, sm.sm_type
),
combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM cs_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM ws_agg
)
SELECT
    item_sk,
    sold_date_sk,
    channel,
    promo_name,
    ship_mode_type,
    total_net_paid,
    total_net_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN total_net_paid = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE total_net_profit / total_net_paid
    END AS profit_margin,
    CASE
        WHEN total_net_paid = 0 THEN 'No Sales'
        WHEN (total_net_profit / total_net_paid) < 0.05 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN (total_net_profit / total_net_paid) < 0.15 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS margin_category,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sold_date_sk ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS daily_sales_rank
FROM combined
WHERE total_net_paid > 0
ORDER BY sold_date_sk DESC, daily_sales_rank

WITH catalog_sales_combined AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode_sk,
        cs.cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit,
        cs.cs_order_number AS order_number
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
),
web_sales_combined AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode_sk,
        ws.ws_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        ws.ws_net_profit AS net_profit,
        ws.ws_order_number AS order_number
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
),
all_sales AS (
    SELECT * FROM catalog_sales_combined
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM web_sales_combined
)
SELECT
    sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
    SUM(a.net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.order_number) AS distinct_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN a.net_profit ELSE 0 END) AS discount_active_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(a.net_profit) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN a.net_profit ELSE 0 END) / SUM(a.net_profit)
    END AS discount_active_profit_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(a.net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM all_sales a
JOIN promotion p ON a.promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm ON a.ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
GROUP BY sm.sm_type
ORDER BY profit_rank

WITH customer_page_counts AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_birth_month, c.c_birth_country, COUNT(wp.wp_web_page_sk) AS pages_accessed FROM customer c LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk LEFT JOIN date_dim d ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = EXTRACT(year FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_birth_month, c.c_birth_country ), group_stats AS ( SELECT c_birth_month, c_birth_country, SUM(pages_accessed) AS total_pages, COUNT(DISTINCT c_customer_sk) AS total_customers, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c_customer_sk) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(pages_accessed) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c_customer_sk) END AS avg_pages_per_customer FROM customer_page_counts GROUP BY c_birth_month, c_birth_country ) SELECT gs.c_birth_month, gs.c_birth_country, gs.total_pages, gs.total_customers, ROUND(gs.avg_pages_per_customer, 2) AS avg_pages_per_customer, CASE WHEN gs.avg_pages_per_customer >= 10 THEN 'High' WHEN gs.avg_pages_per_customer >= 5 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS access_tier, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY gs.avg_pages_per_customer DESC) AS tier_rank, CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY gs.avg_pages_per_customer DESC) AS cumulative_distribution FROM group_stats gs ORDER BY gs.avg_pages_per_customer DESC LIMIT 50

WITH promo_access AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_cost, p.p_purpose, d_start.d_date AS start_date, EXTRACT(year FROM d_start.d_date) AS start_year, EXTRACT(month FROM d_start.d_date) AS start_month, wp.wp_customer_sk FROM promotion p JOIN date_dim d_start ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_access_date_sk BETWEEN p.p_start_date_sk AND p.p_end_date_sk ), promo_summary AS ( SELECT pa.p_promo_id, pa.p_promo_name, pa.p_cost, pa.p_purpose, pa.start_year, pa.start_month, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.wp_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers, pa.p_cost / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT pa.wp_customer_sk), 0) AS cost_per_customer FROM promo_access pa GROUP BY pa.p_promo_id, pa.p_promo_name, pa.p_cost, pa.p_purpose, pa.start_year, pa.start_month ) SELECT ps.p_promo_id, ps.p_promo_name, ps.p_cost, CASE WHEN ps.p_purpose = 'Clearance' THEN 'Clearance' WHEN ps.p_purpose = 'Launch' THEN 'New Launch' ELSE 'Other' END AS purpose_category, ps.start_year, ps.start_month, ps.distinct_customers, ROUND(ps.cost_per_customer, 2) AS cost_per_customer, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ps.cost_per_customer DESC) AS cost_per_customer_rank FROM promo_summary ps ORDER BY cost_per_customer_rank LIMIT 10

WITH promo_window_access AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, d_start.d_date AS promo_start_date, c.c_preferred_cust_flag, COUNT(wp.wp_web_page_sk) AS access_count FROM promotion p JOIN date_dim d_start ON p.p_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk JOIN web_page wp ON TRUE JOIN date_dim d_access ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d_access.d_date_sk JOIN customer c ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk WHERE d_access.d_date BETWEEN d_start.d_date AND DATE_ADD('day', 90, d_start.d_date) GROUP BY p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, d_start.d_date, c.c_preferred_cust_flag ) SELECT pa.p_promo_id, pa.p_promo_name, pa.promo_start_date, CASE WHEN pa.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' THEN 'Preferred' ELSE 'Other' END AS cust_category, pa.access_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.c_preferred_cust_flag ORDER BY pa.access_count DESC) AS rank_by_category FROM promo_window_access pa ORDER BY pa.promo_start_date DESC, pa.access_count DESC LIMIT 30

WITH latest_wp AS ( SELECT wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_customer_sk, wp.wp_access_date_sk, wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wp.wp_customer_sk ORDER BY wp.wp_access_date_sk DESC) AS rn FROM web_page wp ) SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, lw.wp_web_page_id, d_access.d_date AS access_date, lw.wp_type, p.p_promo_name, p.p_discount_active, CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 'Discounted' ELSE 'Standard' END AS promo_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY d_access.d_date DESC) AS seq_num FROM latest_wp lw JOIN customer c ON lw.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN date_dim d_access ON lw.wp_access_date_sk = d_access.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON d_access.d_date_sk BETWEEN p.p_start_date_sk AND p.p_end_date_sk WHERE lw.rn = 1 ORDER BY access_date DESC LIMIT 20

WITH promo_agg AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_id AS p_id, p.p_promo_name AS p_name, s.web_state, CASE WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = 'Low' THEN 'Low' WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = 'Medium' THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Other' END AS buy_category, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount FROM web_sales ws JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN web_site s ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = s.web_site_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, s.web_state, CASE WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = 'Low' THEN 'Low' WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = 'Medium' THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Other' END ) SELECT p_id, p_name, web_state, buy_category, total_net_profit, total_sales, avg_discount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY web_state ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS state_promo_rank FROM promo_agg WHERE total_net_profit > 0 ORDER BY web_state, state_promo_rank LIMIT 100

WITH segment_metrics AS ( SELECT hd.hd_income_band_sk AS income_band, CASE WHEN hd.hd_dep_count = 0 THEN 'No Dependents' WHEN hd.hd_dep_count BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN '1-2 Dependents' ELSE '3+ Dependents' END AS dep_bucket, CASE WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV' WHEN p.p_channel_email = 'Y' THEN 'Email' WHEN p.p_channel_radio = 'Y' THEN 'Radio' ELSE 'Other' END AS promo_channel, SUM(p.p_response_target * ws.ws_net_profit) AS weighted_response, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, AVG(ws.ws_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit FROM web_sales ws JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN web_site s ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = s.web_site_sk WHERE p.p_purpose = 'Discount' GROUP BY hd.hd_income_band_sk, CASE WHEN hd.hd_dep_count = 0 THEN 'No Dependents' WHEN hd.hd_dep_count BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN '1-2 Dependents' ELSE '3+ Dependents' END, CASE WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV' WHEN p.p_channel_email = 'Y' THEN 'Email' WHEN p.p_channel_radio = 'Y' THEN 'Radio' ELSE 'Other' END ) SELECT income_band, dep_bucket, promo_channel, weighted_response, total_sales, avg_net_profit, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY weighted_response DESC) AS segment_rank FROM segment_metrics ORDER BY segment_rank LIMIT 50

WITH vehicle_bucket AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count = 0 THEN 'No Vehicle' WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN '1-2 Vehicles' WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count BETWEEN 3 AND 4 THEN '3-4 Vehicles' ELSE '5+ Vehicles' END AS vehicle_bucket, s.web_state, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, AVG(ws.ws_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit FROM web_sales ws JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_ship_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN web_site s ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = s.web_site_sk WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y' GROUP BY CASE WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count = 0 THEN 'No Vehicle' WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN '1-2 Vehicles' WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count BETWEEN 3 AND 4 THEN '3-4 Vehicles' ELSE '5+ Vehicles' END, s.web_state ) SELECT vehicle_bucket, web_state, total_sales, total_discount, CASE WHEN total_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE total_discount / total_sales END AS discount_ratio, avg_net_profit, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN total_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE total_discount / total_sales END DESC) AS discount_rank FROM vehicle_bucket ORDER BY discount_rank LIMIT 10

WITH monthly_sales AS ( SELECT s.web_site_id, hd.hd_income_band_sk, format('%04d-%02d', CAST(ws.ws_sold_date_sk / 10000 AS INTEGER), CAST((ws.ws_sold_date_sk % 10000) / 100 AS INTEGER)) AS month_ym, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_site s ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = s.web_site_sk JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'N' GROUP BY s.web_site_id, hd.hd_income_band_sk, format('%04d-%02d', CAST(ws.ws_sold_date_sk / 10000 AS INTEGER), CAST((ws.ws_sold_date_sk % 10000) / 100 AS INTEGER)) ) SELECT web_site_id, income_band, month_ym, total_sales, prev_sales, CASE WHEN prev_sales IS NULL OR prev_sales = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (total_sales - prev_sales) / prev_sales END AS growth_pct, CASE WHEN prev_sales IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN (total_sales - prev_sales) > 0 THEN 'Positive' WHEN (total_sales - prev_sales) < 0 THEN 'Negative' ELSE 'No Change' END AS growth_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY web_site_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN prev_sales IS NULL OR prev_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (total_sales - prev_sales) / prev_sales END DESC) AS growth_rank FROM ( SELECT web_site_id, hd_income_band_sk AS income_band, month_ym, total_sales, LAG(total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY web_site_id ORDER BY month_ym) AS prev_sales FROM monthly_sales ) ms WHERE total_sales > 0 ORDER BY web_site_id, month_ym LIMIT 200

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS distinct_orders
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    GROUP BY sm.sm_type
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_loss,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS distinct_return_orders
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    GROUP BY sm.sm_type
)
SELECT
    s.ship_mode_type,
    s.total_sales,
    s.total_profit,
    r.total_return_amount,
    r.total_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN r.total_loss = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE s.total_profit / r.total_loss
    END AS profit_loss_ratio,
    CASE
        WHEN s.total_profit > r.total_loss THEN 'Profit'
        ELSE 'Loss'
    END AS overall_status,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.ship_mode_type ORDER BY r.total_loss DESC) AS loss_rank_within_mode
FROM sales_agg s
LEFT JOIN returns_agg r
    ON s.ship_mode_type = r.ship_mode_type
ORDER BY sales_rank

WITH dept_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_department,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON sm.sm_ship_mode_sk = cr.cr_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    GROUP BY cp.cp_department
),
dept_returns AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_department,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_loss
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    GROUP BY cp.cp_department
)
SELECT
    ds.cp_department,
    ds.total_sales,
    ds.total_profit,
    dr.total_return_amount,
    dr.total_loss,
    (ds.total_sales - dr.total_return_amount) AS net_sales,
    (ds.total_profit - dr.total_loss) AS net_contribution,
    CASE
        WHEN (ds.total_profit - dr.total_loss) > 0 THEN 'Positive'
        ELSE 'Negative'
    END AS contribution_sign,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (ds.total_profit - dr.total_loss) DESC) AS profit_contrib_rank
FROM dept_sales ds
LEFT JOIN dept_returns dr
    ON ds.cp_department = dr.cp_department
ORDER BY profit_contrib_rank
LIMIT 10

SELECT
    cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
    cp.cp_catalog_page_number,
    cp.cp_department,
    sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,
    stats.avg_return_amount,
    stats.avg_sales_net_paid,
    stats.avg_sales_net_paid - stats.avg_return_amount AS diff,
    CASE
        WHEN stats.avg_sales_net_paid - stats.avg_return_amount > 0 THEN 'Advantageous'
        ELSE 'Disadvantageous'
    END AS diff_category,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY stats.avg_sales_net_paid - stats.avg_return_amount DESC) AS diff_rank
FROM catalog_page cp
JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = cr.cr_catalog_page_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        AVG(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) AS avg_sales_net_paid,
        AVG(cr2.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN ship_mode sm2
        ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm2.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr2
        ON cr2.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm2.sm_ship_mode_sk
    WHERE sm2.sm_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
      AND cr2.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
) stats
ORDER BY diff_rank
LIMIT 20

WITH daily_qty AS ( SELECT wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_web_page_id, ws.ws_web_site_sk AS web_site_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS date_key, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS daily_qty FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_web_page_id, ws.ws_web_site_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk ) SELECT dq.wp_web_page_id, wsite.web_name, dq.date_key, dq.daily_qty, LAG(dq.daily_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY dq.wp_web_page_sk ORDER BY dq.date_key) AS prev_daily_qty, dq.daily_qty - COALESCE(LAG(dq.daily_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY dq.wp_web_page_sk ORDER BY dq.date_key), 0) AS qty_change, CASE WHEN dq.daily_qty > 2 * COALESCE(LAG(dq.daily_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY dq.wp_web_page_sk ORDER BY dq.date_key), 0) THEN 'Spike' ELSE 'Normal' END AS sales_spike_flag FROM daily_qty dq JOIN web_site wsite ON dq.web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk WHERE dq.daily_qty > 0 ORDER BY dq.wp_web_page_sk, dq.date_key

WITH monthly_sales AS ( SELECT ws.ws_web_site_sk AS web_site_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS date_key, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS month_net_profit, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS month_sales_amount FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_web_site_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk ), monthly_returns AS ( SELECT ws.ws_web_site_sk AS web_site_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS date_key, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS month_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS month_net_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN web_sales ws ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk GROUP BY ws.ws_web_site_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk ) SELECT wsite.web_name, ms.date_key, ms.month_net_profit, mr.month_return_amt, ms.month_net_profit - COALESCE(mr.month_return_amt, 0) AS net_profit_after_returns, AVG(ms.month_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY wsite.web_name ORDER BY ms.date_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3_months, CASE WHEN ms.month_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_status FROM monthly_sales ms LEFT JOIN monthly_returns mr ON ms.web_site_sk = mr.web_site_sk AND ms.date_key = mr.date_key JOIN web_site wsite ON ms.web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk ORDER BY wsite.web_name, ms.date_key

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_type, ws.ws_web_site_sk AS web_site_sk, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_type, ws.ws_web_site_sk ), returns_agg AS ( SELECT wp.wp_web_page_sk, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt FROM web_returns wr JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_sk ) SELECT s.wp_web_page_id, s.wp_type, s.total_sales_profit, COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss, s.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) AS net_profit_after_returns, CASE WHEN s.wp_type = 'product' THEN 'Product Page' WHEN s.wp_type = 'category' THEN 'Category Page' ELSE 'Other Page' END AS page_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) DESC) AS loss_rank, wsite.web_name FROM sales_agg s LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON s.wp_web_page_sk = r.wp_web_page_sk LEFT JOIN web_site wsite ON s.web_site_sk = wsite.web_site_sk ORDER BY loss_rank LIMIT 20

WITH household_returns AS ( SELECT sr.sr_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential, d.d_fy_year, SUM(sr.sr_store_credit) AS total_store_credit, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_hdemo_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential, d.d_fy_year, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound ), ranked AS ( SELECT hd_demo_sk, hd_buy_potential, d_fy_year, total_store_credit, ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_fy_year ORDER BY total_store_credit DESC) AS credit_rank FROM household_returns ) SELECT d_fy_year, hd_demo_sk, total_store_credit, hd_buy_potential, CASE WHEN ib_lower_bound >= 100000 THEN 'Very High' WHEN ib_lower_bound >= 75000 THEN 'High' WHEN ib_lower_bound >= 50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS income_bracket, credit_rank FROM ranked WHERE credit_rank <= 5 ORDER BY d_fy_year, credit_rank

WITH monthly_loss AS ( SELECT d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, d.d_quarter_seq, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS month_net_loss, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS month_return_amt FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, d.d_quarter_seq, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound ) SELECT d_year, d_month_seq, ib_income_band_sk, month_net_loss, month_return_amt, CASE WHEN month_net_loss < 0 THEN 'Profit' WHEN month_net_loss < 1000 THEN 'Low Loss' WHEN month_net_loss < 5000 THEN 'Medium Loss' ELSE 'High Loss' END AS loss_category, SUM(month_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, d_quarter_seq ORDER BY d_month_seq) AS cumulative_quarter_loss, LAG(month_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, ib_income_band_sk ORDER BY d_month_seq) AS prev_month_loss, month_net_loss - LAG(month_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, ib_income_band_sk ORDER BY d_month_seq) AS month_loss_change FROM monthly_loss ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq, ib_income_band_sk

WITH enriched AS ( SELECT sr.sr_returned_date_sk, sr.sr_return_amt, sr.sr_net_loss, sr.sr_return_quantity, d.d_date, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, d.d_weekend, ib.ib_lower_bound FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk ), daily_agg AS ( SELECT d_date, d_year, d_month_seq, d_weekend, SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, AVG(sr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_qty, AVG(ib_lower_bound) AS avg_income_lower_bound FROM enriched GROUP BY d_date, d_year, d_month_seq, d_weekend ) SELECT d_date, d_year, d_month_seq, total_return_amt, total_net_loss, avg_return_qty, CASE WHEN d_weekend = 'Y' THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type, avg_income_lower_bound, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, d_month_seq ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC) AS month_return_rank FROM daily_agg ORDER BY d_date

WITH scored_returns AS ( SELECT sr.sr_ticket_number, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq, sr.sr_return_amt, sr.sr_fee, sr.sr_store_credit, sr.sr_net_loss, hd.hd_buy_potential, ib.ib_lower_bound, ( (COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss,0) * -1) + (COALESCE(sr.sr_fee,0) * -0.5) + (COALESCE(sr.sr_store_credit,0) * 0.3) + CASE WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = 'high' THEN 10 WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = 'medium' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END + (ib.ib_lower_bound / 10000) ) AS return_quality_score FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, d_quarter_seq ORDER BY return_quality_score DESC) AS rn FROM scored_returns ) SELECT d_year, d_quarter_seq, sr_ticket_number, return_quality_score, CASE WHEN return_quality_score >= 50 THEN 'Excellent' WHEN return_quality_score >= 30 THEN 'Good' WHEN return_quality_score >= 10 THEN 'Fair' ELSE 'Poor' END AS quality_category, rn FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 10 ORDER BY d_year, d_quarter_seq, rn

WITH item_promo_stats AS ( SELECT ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_promo_sk, t.t_shift, t.t_meal_time, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt, SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, AVG(ss.ss_net_profit) AS avg_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.t_shift ORDER BY SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank_by_shift FROM store_sales ss JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_promo_sk, t.t_shift, t.t_meal_time, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state ) SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_promo_sk, t_shift, t_meal_time, ca_city, ca_state, sales_cnt, total_discount, total_profit, avg_discount, avg_profit, profit_rank_by_shift, CASE WHEN avg_profit > 50 THEN 'Highly Profitable' WHEN avg_profit > 20 THEN 'Moderately Profitable' ELSE 'Low Profit' END AS profit_category FROM item_promo_stats WHERE profit_rank_by_shift <= 10 ORDER BY t_shift, profit_rank_by_shift

WITH ranked_sales AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_birth_month, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, t.t_hour, t.t_meal_time, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit, CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) >= 10000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) >= 5000 THEN 'Gold' ELSE 'Silver' END AS profit_tier, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_birth_month ORDER BY SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_birth_month, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, t.t_hour, t.t_meal_time ) SELECT * FROM ranked_sales WHERE profit_rank <= 3 ORDER BY c_birth_month, profit_rank

WITH sales_by_time AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_current_addr_sk, t.t_time_sk, t.t_hour, t.t_meal_time, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS qty, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS net_paid, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS ext_sales FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_current_addr_sk, t.t_time_sk, t.t_hour, t.t_meal_time ) SELECT s.c_customer_id, s.c_first_name, s.c_last_name, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, s.t_hour, s.t_meal_time, s.qty, s.net_paid, SUM(s.net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY s.c_customer_id ORDER BY s.t_time_sk) AS cumulative_net_paid, CASE WHEN SUM(s.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY s.c_customer_id) > 100 THEN 'Frequent Buyer' ELSE 'Occasional Buyer' END AS buyer_category FROM sales_by_time s JOIN customer_address ca ON s.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE s.net_paid > 0 ORDER BY s.c_customer_id, s.t_time_sk

SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales, COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt),0) AS total_returns, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) - COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt),0) AS net_revenue, CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) - COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt),0) > 100000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) - COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt),0) > 50000 THEN 'Gold' ELSE 'Silver' END AS revenue_tier, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) - COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt),0) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN time_dim t_sales ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t_sales.t_time_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AND cs.cs_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t_sales.t_time_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) > 0 ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT t.t_hour, ROUND(SUM(cs.cs_sales_price) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number),0),2) AS avg_sales_price, ROUND(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_order_number),0),2) AS avg_return_amount, ROUND(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) / NULLIF(SUM(cs.cs_sales_price),0),4) AS return_to_sales_ratio, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ROUND(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) / NULLIF(SUM(cs.cs_sales_price),0),4) DESC) AS ratio_rank, CASE WHEN ROUND(SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) / NULLIF(SUM(cs.cs_sales_price),0),4) > 0.15 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS ratio_flag FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY t.t_hour ORDER BY ratio_rank

SELECT i.i_category, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit, COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss),0) AS total_return_loss, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss),0) AS net_profit, CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss),0) > 20000 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss),0) > 5000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_class, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss),0) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY i.i_category ORDER BY profit_rank

WITH profit_by_hour AS (SELECT i.i_item_sk, i.i_item_id, t.t_hour, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS sales_profit, COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss),0) AS return_loss, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(wr.wr_net_loss),0) AS net_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_item_id, t.t_hour), trend_flag AS (SELECT p.i_item_sk, p.i_item_id, p.t_hour, p.net_profit, LAG(p.net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY p.i_item_sk ORDER BY p.t_hour) AS prev_net_profit, CASE WHEN p.net_profit < LAG(p.net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY p.i_item_sk ORDER BY p.t_hour) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS decreasing_flag FROM profit_by_hour p) SELECT tf.i_item_id, SUM(tf.decreasing_flag) AS decreasing_periods, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(tf.decreasing_flag) DESC) AS decreasing_rank, CASE WHEN SUM(tf.decreasing_flag) > 3 THEN 'Highly Volatile' WHEN SUM(tf.decreasing_flag) > 0 THEN 'Some Decline' ELSE 'Stable' END AS volatility_category FROM trend_flag tf GROUP BY tf.i_item_id HAVING SUM(tf.decreasing_flag) > 0 ORDER BY decreasing_rank LIMIT 20

WITH sales_data AS (SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_addr_sk, i.i_category, ss.ss_ext_sales_price AS sales_price, ss.ss_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt, ss.ss_ext_list_price AS list_price, CASE WHEN ss.ss_ext_list_price > 0 THEN ss.ss_ext_discount_amt / ss.ss_ext_list_price ELSE 0 END AS discount_rate FROM store_sales ss JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk), returns_data AS (SELECT sr.sr_store_sk, sr.sr_addr_sk, i.i_category, sr.sr_return_amt AS return_amount, sr.sr_return_quantity AS return_qty FROM store_returns sr JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk), store_category_stats AS (SELECT sd.ss_store_sk AS store_sk, ca.ca_state, sd.i_category, COUNT(*) AS transaction_cnt, SUM(sd.sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(sd.discount_amt) AS total_discount, AVG(sd.discount_rate) AS avg_discount_rate, SUM(rd.return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(rd.return_qty) AS total_return_qty FROM sales_data sd LEFT JOIN returns_data rd ON sd.ss_store_sk = rd.sr_store_sk AND sd.ss_addr_sk = rd.sr_addr_sk AND sd.i_category = rd.i_category JOIN customer_address ca ON sd.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY sd.ss_store_sk, ca.ca_state, sd.i_category) SELECT sc.store_sk, sc.ca_state, sc.i_category, sc.transaction_cnt, sc.total_sales, sc.total_discount, sc.avg_discount_rate, sc.total_return_amount, sc.total_return_qty, CASE WHEN sc.avg_discount_rate > 0.30 THEN 'High Discount' WHEN sc.avg_discount_rate BETWEEN 0.15 AND 0.30 THEN 'Medium Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_tier, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sc.i_category ORDER BY sc.avg_discount_rate DESC) AS discount_rank_by_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sc.total_sales DESC) AS overall_sales_rank FROM store_category_stats sc WHERE sc.total_sales > 5000 ORDER BY sc.i_category, discount_rank_by_category LIMIT 200

WITH sales_by_item AS (SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk, ss.ss_addr_sk AS addr_sk, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS quantity, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS profit FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_addr_sk), best_addr_per_item AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY sales_amount DESC) AS rn FROM sales_by_item), item_sales_agg AS (SELECT item_sk, SUM(sales_amount) AS total_sales, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(profit) AS total_profit FROM sales_by_item GROUP BY item_sk), returns_agg AS (SELECT sr.sr_item_sk AS item_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM store_returns sr GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk) SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_brand, s.total_sales, COALESCE(r.total_return_amt, 0) AS total_returns, s.total_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_amt, 0) AS net_profit, CASE WHEN s.total_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (s.total_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_amt, 0)) / s.total_sales END AS profit_margin, ca.ca_city AS top_city_by_sales, ca.ca_state AS top_state_by_sales, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_category ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.total_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (s.total_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_amt, 0)) / s.total_sales END DESC) AS category_profit_rank FROM item i LEFT JOIN item_sales_agg s ON i.i_item_sk = s.item_sk LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON i.i_item_sk = r.item_sk LEFT JOIN best_addr_per_item ba ON i.i_item_sk = ba.item_sk AND ba.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN customer_address ca ON ba.addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE i.i_category IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.i_category, category_profit_rank LIMIT 100

WITH address_sales AS (SELECT ss.ss_addr_sk AS addr_sk, i.i_category, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS sales_qty FROM store_sales ss JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_addr_sk, i.i_category), address_returns AS (SELECT sr.sr_addr_sk AS addr_sk, i.i_category, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS return_amount, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS return_qty FROM store_returns sr JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_addr_sk, i.i_category), combined AS (SELECT a.addr_sk, a.i_category, a.sales_amount, COALESCE(r.return_amount, 0) AS return_amount, a.sales_amount - COALESCE(r.return_amount, 0) AS net_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.addr_sk ORDER BY a.sales_amount - COALESCE(r.return_amount, 0) DESC) AS category_rank FROM address_sales a LEFT JOIN address_returns r ON a.addr_sk = r.addr_sk AND a.i_category = r.i_category) SELECT ca.ca_address_id, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, c.i_category AS top_category, c.sales_amount, c.return_amount, c.net_sales, CASE WHEN c.net_sales > 20000 THEN 'A' WHEN c.net_sales BETWEEN 10000 AND 20000 THEN 'B' WHEN c.net_sales BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'C' ELSE 'D' END AS performance_bucket, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.ca_state ORDER BY c.net_sales DESC) AS state_net_sales_rank FROM combined c JOIN customer_address ca ON c.addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE c.category_rank = 1 ORDER BY ca.ca_state, state_net_sales_rank LIMIT 150

SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit, SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_return_loss, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) - SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) AS net_margin, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) - SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) DESC) AS profit_rank, CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) - SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) > 100000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) - SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) BETWEEN 50000 AND 100000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS profit_category FROM store_sales ss LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk LEFT JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk WHERE i.i_category = 'Electronics' GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state HAVING SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) > 0 ORDER BY net_margin DESC

WITH agg_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_revenue, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers FROM catalog_sales cs WHERE cs.cs_quantity > 1 GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk ), avg_inventory AS ( SELECT inv_item_sk, AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY inv_item_sk ) SELECT it.i_item_id, it.i_product_name, it.i_category, a.total_revenue, a.total_profit, a.distinct_customers, a.total_profit / NULLIF(a.total_revenue,0) AS profit_margin, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY it.i_category ORDER BY a.total_revenue ASC) AS rev_rank_asc, i.avg_inventory_qty FROM agg_sales a JOIN item it ON a.cs_item_sk = it.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN avg_inventory i ON a.cs_item_sk = i.inv_item_sk WHERE i.avg_inventory_qty BETWEEN 10 AND 100 ORDER BY it.i_category, rev_rank_asc LIMIT 25

WITH agg_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_revenue, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt, MIN(cs.cs_sold_date_sk) AS first_sale_date FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk ), avg_inventory AS ( SELECT inv_item_sk, AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory_qty FROM inventory GROUP BY inv_item_sk ) SELECT it.i_item_id, it.i_product_name, it.i_category, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, a.total_revenue, a.total_profit, a.sales_cnt, a.first_sale_date, a.total_profit / NULLIF(a.total_revenue,0) AS profit_margin, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY it.i_category ORDER BY a.sales_cnt DESC) AS sales_cnt_rank, i.avg_inventory_qty FROM agg_sales a JOIN item it ON a.cs_item_sk = it.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd ON a.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk LEFT JOIN avg_inventory i ON a.cs_item_sk = i.inv_item_sk WHERE a.total_revenue > 1000 AND i.avg_inventory_qty IS NOT NULL GROUP BY it.i_item_id, it.i_product_name, it.i_category, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, a.total_revenue, a.total_profit, a.sales_cnt, a.first_sale_date, i.avg_inventory_qty ORDER BY profit_margin DESC LIMIT 30

WITH agg_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_revenue, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt FROM catalog_sales cs WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2450100 GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk ), avg_inventory AS ( SELECT inv_item_sk, AVG(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory_qty FROM inventory WHERE inv_quantity_on_hand > 0 GROUP BY inv_item_sk ) SELECT it.i_item_id, it.i_product_name, it.i_category, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, a.total_revenue, a.total_profit, a.total_profit / NULLIF(a.total_revenue,0) AS profit_margin, CASE WHEN a.total_profit / NULLIF(a.total_revenue,0) >= 0.25 THEN 'High' WHEN a.total_profit / NULLIF(a.total_revenue,0) >= 0.12 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_margin_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY it.i_category ORDER BY a.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_in_category, i.avg_inventory_qty, a.sales_cnt FROM agg_sales a JOIN item it ON a.cs_item_sk = it.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd ON a.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk LEFT JOIN avg_inventory i ON a.cs_item_sk = i.inv_item_sk WHERE i.avg_inventory_qty IS NOT NULL AND cd.cd_gender = 'F' GROUP BY it.i_item_id, it.i_product_name, it.i_category, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, a.total_revenue, a.total_profit, i.avg_inventory_qty, a.sales_cnt ORDER BY profit_margin DESC LIMIT 15

WITH returns AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender ), sales AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales, AVG(ws.ws_quantity) AS avg_qty FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk ) SELECT r.cd_gender, r.total_return_loss, s.total_sales, s.avg_qty, (r.total_return_loss / NULLIF(s.total_sales,0)) * 100 AS loss_percent, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.total_return_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM returns r JOIN sales s ON r.cd_demo_sk = s.cd_demo_sk WHERE s.avg_qty > 1.5 ORDER BY loss_percent DESC LIMIT 10

WITH returns AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status HAVING SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 500 ), sales AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk ), combined AS ( SELECT r.cd_demo_sk, r.cd_gender, r.cd_marital_status, r.total_return_loss, s.total_sales FROM returns r JOIN sales s ON r.cd_demo_sk = s.cd_demo_sk ) SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, total_return_loss, total_sales, total_return_loss - total_sales AS loss_vs_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cd_gender ORDER BY total_return_loss DESC) AS gender_loss_rank FROM combined WHERE total_sales IS NOT NULL ORDER BY loss_vs_sales DESC

WITH returns AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, MAX(cr.cr_return_amount) AS max_return_amount FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status ), sales AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS sales_orders FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk ) SELECT r.cd_gender, r.cd_marital_status, r.total_return_loss, r.max_return_amount, s.total_sales, s.sales_orders, CASE WHEN s.total_sales > 0 THEN r.total_return_loss / s.total_sales ELSE NULL END AS loss_to_sales_ratio, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.cd_gender ORDER BY r.max_return_amount DESC) AS gender_max_return_rank FROM returns r JOIN sales s ON r.cd_demo_sk = s.cd_demo_sk WHERE r.max_return_amount > 100 ORDER BY loss_to_sales_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15

WITH returns AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS return_orders FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE cr.cr_return_quantity > 1 GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status ), sales AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS sales_orders FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE ws.ws_quantity >= 2 GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk ) SELECT r.cd_gender, r.cd_marital_status, r.total_return_loss, s.total_sales, r.return_orders, s.sales_orders, CASE WHEN s.total_sales > 0 THEN r.total_return_loss / s.total_sales ELSE NULL END AS loss_to_sales_ratio, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.total_return_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM returns r JOIN sales s ON r.cd_demo_sk = s.cd_demo_sk WHERE r.total_return_loss BETWEEN 100 AND 10000 ORDER BY loss_rank LIMIT 20

WITH daily_profit AS (SELECT cs.cs_warehouse_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS daily_net_profit FROM catalog_sales cs WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 20210101 AND 20211231 GROUP BY cs.cs_warehouse_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk), profit_change AS (SELECT dp.cs_warehouse_sk, dp.cs_sold_date_sk, dp.daily_net_profit, LAG(dp.daily_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY dp.cs_warehouse_sk ORDER BY dp.cs_sold_date_sk) AS prev_daily_net_profit, dp.daily_net_profit - LAG(dp.daily_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY dp.cs_warehouse_sk ORDER BY dp.cs_sold_date_sk) AS profit_change FROM daily_profit dp) SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_state, pc.cs_sold_date_sk, pc.daily_net_profit, pc.prev_daily_net_profit, pc.profit_change, CASE WHEN pc.profit_change > 0 THEN 'Increase' WHEN pc.profit_change < 0 THEN 'Decrease' ELSE 'No Change' END AS profit_trend, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pc.cs_warehouse_sk ORDER BY ABS(pc.profit_change) DESC) AS rank_change_magnitude FROM profit_change pc JOIN warehouse w ON pc.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY w.w_warehouse_name, pc.cs_sold_date_sk LIMIT 200

WITH sales_agg AS (SELECT ca_bill.ca_state AS bill_state, ca_ship.ca_state AS ship_state, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_education_status, cd.cd_credit_rating, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(cs.cs_coupon_amt) AS total_coupon_amt, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY ca_bill.ca_state, ca_ship.ca_state, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_education_status, cd.cd_credit_rating HAVING SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) > 1000) SELECT bill_state, ship_state, cd_gender, cd_education_status, cd_credit_rating, total_sales, total_coupon_amt, order_cnt, CASE WHEN total_coupon_amt > 0 THEN 'Coupon Used' ELSE 'No Coupon' END AS coupon_flag, NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY bill_state ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_quartile, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cd_gender ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS gender_sales_rank FROM sales_agg ORDER BY bill_state, sales_quartile DESC LIMIT 150

WITH discount_agg AS (SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_state, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, COUNT(*) AS sale_cnt, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amt, AVG(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt / NULLIF(cs.cs_ext_sales_price, 0)) AS avg_discount_pct FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_state, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50) SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_state, cd_gender, cd_marital_status, sale_cnt, avg_discount_amt, avg_sales_price, avg_discount_pct, CASE WHEN avg_discount_pct >= 0.2 THEN 'High Discount' WHEN avg_discount_pct >= 0.1 THEN 'Medium Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w_state ORDER BY avg_discount_pct DESC) AS discount_rank_state, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w_state ORDER BY avg_discount_pct) AS discount_percentile_state FROM discount_agg ORDER BY w_state, discount_rank_state LIMIT 200

WITH agg AS (SELECT ca_bill.ca_state AS bill_state, ca_ship.ca_state AS ship_state, w.w_state AS warehouse_state, cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS bill_customer_id, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 20200101 AND 20201231 GROUP BY ca_bill.ca_state, ca_ship.ca_state, w.w_state, cs.cs_bill_customer_sk HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3) SELECT bill_state, ship_state, warehouse_state, bill_customer_id, orders, total_net_profit, CASE WHEN total_net_profit >= 20000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN total_net_profit >= 10000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN total_net_profit >= 5000 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY bill_state ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_state FROM agg ORDER BY bill_state, profit_rank_state LIMIT 100

SELECT cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name, ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, SUM(wr.wr_return_tax) AS total_return_tax, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_count, CASE WHEN SUM(wr.wr_return_tax) > 0 THEN 'Taxed' ELSE 'NoTax' END AS tax_indicator, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) DESC) AS return_amount_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc.cc_call_center_id ORDER BY SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) DESC) AS per_cc_rank FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim dr_ret ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dr_ret.d_date_sk JOIN call_center cc ON dr_ret.d_date_sk BETWEEN cc.cc_open_date_sk AND cc.cc_closed_date_sk JOIN web_site ws ON dr_ret.d_date_sk BETWEEN ws.web_open_date_sk AND ws.web_close_date_sk WHERE cc.cc_state = ws.web_state AND cc.cc_country = ws.web_country GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name, ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name HAVING SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) > 0 ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC LIMIT 10

WITH daily_returns AS (SELECT dr.d_date_sk, dr.d_date, dr.d_day_name, dr.d_weekend, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim dr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk GROUP BY dr.d_date_sk, dr.d_date, dr.d_day_name, dr.d_weekend) SELECT dr.d_date, dr.d_day_name, CASE WHEN dr.d_weekend = 'Y' THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type, dr.total_return_amt, dr.total_net_loss, dr.return_cnt, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY dr.total_return_amt DESC) AS return_amount_rank, SUM(dr.total_return_amt) OVER (ORDER BY dr.d_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_return_amt, cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name AS call_center_name, cc.cc_employees, ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, ws.web_state, ws.web_country FROM daily_returns dr LEFT JOIN call_center cc ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk OR cc.cc_closed_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN web_site ws ON ws.web_open_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk OR ws.web_close_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk WHERE dr.total_return_amt > 0 ORDER BY dr.total_return_amt DESC LIMIT 5

WITH site_monthly AS (SELECT ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, ws.web_state, ws.web_country, dr_ret.d_year, dr_ret.d_month_seq, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, AVG(wr.wr_return_tax) AS avg_return_tax FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim dr_ret ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dr_ret.d_date_sk JOIN web_site ws ON dr_ret.d_date_sk BETWEEN ws.web_open_date_sk AND ws.web_close_date_sk GROUP BY ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, ws.web_state, ws.web_country, dr_ret.d_year, dr_ret.d_month_seq) SELECT sm.web_site_id, sm.web_name, sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq, sm.total_return_amt, sm.avg_return_tax, LAG(sm.total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY sm.web_site_id ORDER BY sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq) AS prev_month_return_amt, CASE WHEN LAG(sm.total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY sm.web_site_id ORDER BY sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (sm.total_return_amt - LAG(sm.total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY sm.web_site_id ORDER BY sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq)) / LAG(sm.total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY sm.web_site_id ORDER BY sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq) * 100 END AS mom_growth_pct, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.web_site_id ORDER BY sm.total_return_amt DESC) AS return_amt_rank, CASE WHEN sm.total_return_amt > 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_category, (SELECT SUM(cc2.cc_employees) FROM call_center cc2 WHERE cc2.cc_state = sm.web_state AND cc2.cc_country = sm.web_country) AS total_employees_state FROM site_monthly sm ORDER BY sm.total_return_amt DESC LIMIT 20

WITH returns_by_cc AS (SELECT cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_country, dr_ret.d_year, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS yearly_net_loss, AVG(wr.wr_fee) AS avg_fee, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim dr_ret ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dr_ret.d_date_sk JOIN call_center cc ON dr_ret.d_date_sk BETWEEN cc.cc_open_date_sk AND cc.cc_closed_date_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_country, dr_ret.d_year) SELECT r.cc_call_center_id, r.cc_name, r.d_year, r.yearly_net_loss, r.avg_fee, r.return_cnt, LAG(r.yearly_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY r.cc_call_center_id ORDER BY r.d_year) AS prev_year_net_loss, SUM(r.yearly_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY r.cc_call_center_id ORDER BY r.d_year ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_net_loss, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.cc_call_center_id ORDER BY r.yearly_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank, CASE WHEN r.yearly_net_loss > 0 THEN 'Positive' ELSE 'Negative' END AS net_loss_sign, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM web_site ws WHERE ws.web_state = r.cc_state AND ws.web_country = r.cc_country) AS site_count FROM returns_by_cc r ORDER BY r.cc_call_center_id, r.d_year

WITH item_agg AS ( SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_current_price, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, SUM(COALESCE(p.p_cost,0)) AS total_promo_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_id) AS distinct_page_cnt FROM item i JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wr_web_page_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_current_price ), tier_stats AS ( SELECT price_tier, AVG(total_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt, SUM(total_promo_cost) AS sum_promo_cost FROM ( SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_current_price, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(COALESCE(p.p_cost,0)) AS total_promo_cost, CASE WHEN i.i_current_price < 20 THEN 'Low Price' WHEN i.i_current_price BETWEEN 20 AND 100 THEN 'Mid Price' ELSE 'High Price' END AS price_tier FROM item i JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_current_price ) t GROUP BY price_tier ) SELECT price_tier, avg_return_amt, sum_promo_cost FROM tier_stats ORDER BY avg_return_amt DESC

WITH item_agg AS ( SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_current_price, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, SUM(COALESCE(p.p_cost,0)) AS total_promo_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_id) AS distinct_page_cnt FROM item i JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wr_web_page_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_current_price ), windowed AS ( SELECT i_item_id, i_product_name, i_category, i_current_price, total_return_amt, total_return_qty, total_promo_cost, distinct_page_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC) AS cat_rank, SUM(total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category) AS cat_total_return FROM item_agg ) SELECT i_item_id, i_product_name, i_category, i_current_price, total_return_amt, total_return_qty, total_promo_cost, distinct_page_cnt, cat_rank, cat_total_return FROM windowed WHERE cat_rank <= 3 ORDER BY i_category, cat_rank

WITH item_agg AS ( SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_current_price, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, SUM(COALESCE(p.p_cost,0)) AS total_promo_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_id) AS distinct_page_cnt FROM item i JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wr_web_page_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk WHERE wr.wr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 20200101 AND 20201231 GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_current_price ), agg_by_price_tier AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN i_current_price < 20 THEN 'Low' WHEN i_current_price BETWEEN 20 AND 100 THEN 'Mid' ELSE 'High' END AS price_tier, COUNT(*) AS item_cnt, SUM(total_return_amt) AS tier_return_amt, AVG(total_promo_cost) AS avg_promo_cost FROM item_agg GROUP BY CASE WHEN i_current_price < 20 THEN 'Low' WHEN i_current_price BETWEEN 20 AND 100 THEN 'Mid' ELSE 'High' END ) SELECT price_tier, item_cnt, tier_return_amt, avg_promo_cost FROM agg_by_price_tier ORDER BY tier_return_amt DESC

WITH daily_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS daily_quantity_sold FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk ), inventory_daily AS ( SELECT inv_item_sk, inv_date_sk, SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_on_hand FROM inventory GROUP BY inv_item_sk, inv_date_sk ), merged AS ( SELECT ds.cs_item_sk, ds.cs_sold_date_sk, ds.daily_quantity_sold, inv.total_on_hand, ds.daily_quantity_sold / NULLIF(inv.total_on_hand,0) AS turnover_rate FROM daily_sales ds LEFT JOIN inventory_daily inv ON ds.cs_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk AND ds.cs_sold_date_sk = inv.inv_date_sk ), item_turnover AS ( SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, m.cs_sold_date_sk, m.daily_quantity_sold, m.total_on_hand, m.turnover_rate, LAG(m.total_on_hand) OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_item_id ORDER BY m.cs_sold_date_sk) AS prev_inventory, (m.total_on_hand - LAG(m.total_on_hand) OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_item_id ORDER BY m.cs_sold_date_sk)) AS inventory_change FROM merged m JOIN item i ON m.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk ) SELECT i_item_id, i_product_name, cs_sold_date_sk, daily_quantity_sold, total_on_hand, turnover_rate, prev_inventory, inventory_change, CASE WHEN inventory_change > 0 THEN 'Restocked' WHEN inventory_change < 0 THEN 'Sold' ELSE 'No Change' END AS inventory_action FROM item_turnover WHERE turnover_rate > 0.5 ORDER BY cs_sold_date_sk DESC LIMIT 100
