WITH daily_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS daily_quantity_sold FROM catalog_sales cs WHERE cs.cs_quantity > 0 GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk ), inventory_daily AS ( SELECT inv_item_sk, inv_date_sk, SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_on_hand FROM inventory GROUP BY inv_item_sk, inv_date_sk ), shipping_demo AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, MIN(cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk) AS ship_cdemo_sk FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk ), merged AS ( SELECT ds.cs_item_sk, ds.cs_sold_date_sk, ds.daily_quantity_sold, inv.total_on_hand, ds.daily_quantity_sold / NULLIF(inv.total_on_hand,0) AS turnover_rate, sd.ship_cdemo_sk FROM daily_sales ds LEFT JOIN inventory_daily inv ON ds.cs_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk AND ds.cs_sold_date_sk = inv.inv_date_sk LEFT JOIN shipping_demo sd ON ds.cs_item_sk = sd.cs_item_sk AND ds.cs_sold_date_sk = sd.cs_sold_date_sk WHERE inv.total_on_hand IS NOT NULL AND ds.daily_quantity_sold > 10 ), avg_turnover AS ( SELECT i.i_item_id, AVG(m.turnover_rate) AS avg_turnover_rate FROM merged m JOIN item i ON m.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_id ), ranked_items AS ( SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, a.avg_turnover_rate, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.avg_turnover_rate DESC) AS turnover_rank FROM avg_turnover a JOIN item i ON a.i_item_id = i.i_item_id ) SELECT r.i_item_id, r.i_product_name, r.avg_turnover_rate, r.turnover_rank FROM ranked_items r WHERE r.turnover_rank <= 20 ORDER BY r.turnover_rank

WITH page_income_stats AS ( SELECT wp.wp_type, hd.hd_income_band_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, AVG(wr.wr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_tax) AS total_return_tax, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS sum_return_inc_tax, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.cd_gender) AS distinct_refunded_genders FROM web_returns wr JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY wp.wp_type, hd.hd_income_band_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential ) SELECT wp_type, hd_income_band_sk, CASE WHEN hd_buy_potential LIKE '0-%' THEN 'LowPotential' WHEN hd_buy_potential LIKE '5000-10000' THEN 'MediumPotential' ELSE 'HighPotential' END AS potential_category, return_cnt, avg_return_amt, total_return_tax, sum_return_inc_tax, distinct_refunded_genders, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type ORDER BY avg_return_amt DESC) AS avg_return_amt_percentile, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type ORDER BY sum_return_inc_tax DESC) AS sum_return_inc_tax_rank FROM page_income_stats WHERE return_cnt > 5 ORDER BY wp_type, avg_return_amt_percentile DESC

WITH base_returns AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_credit_rating, hd.hd_income_band_sk, wp.wp_type, wr.wr_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY cd.cd_demo_sk) AS total_return_per_customer, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY cd.cd_demo_sk) AS return_cnt_per_customer FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk WHERE wr.wr_returned_date_sk IS NOT NULL ), ranked_returns AS ( SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_credit_rating, hd_income_band_sk, wp_type, total_return_per_customer, return_cnt_per_customer, CASE WHEN total_return_per_customer > 10000 THEN 'High' WHEN total_return_per_customer > 5000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_tier, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_per_customer DESC) AS return_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cd_gender ORDER BY total_return_per_customer DESC) AS gender_return_rank FROM base_returns ) SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_credit_rating, hd_income_band_sk, wp_type, total_return_per_customer, return_cnt_per_customer, return_tier, return_rank, gender_return_rank FROM ranked_returns WHERE return_rank <= 10 ORDER BY return_rank

WITH cust_return_stats AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, hd.hd_income_band_sk, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_type) AS distinct_page_types FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, hd.hd_income_band_sk ), ranked_customers AS ( SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_gender, cd_marital_status, hd_income_band_sk, return_cnt, total_net_loss, total_return_amt, total_return_qty, distinct_page_types, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'HighLoss' WHEN total_net_loss > 1000 THEN 'MediumLoss' ELSE 'LowLoss' END AS loss_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cd_gender ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank_by_gender, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC) AS overall_return_amount_rank FROM cust_return_stats WHERE return_cnt >= 3 ) SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_gender, cd_marital_status, hd_income_band_sk, return_cnt, total_net_loss, total_return_amt, total_return_qty, distinct_page_types, loss_category, loss_rank_by_gender, overall_return_amount_rank FROM ranked_customers WHERE loss_rank_by_gender <= 3 ORDER BY cd_gender, loss_rank_by_gender

WITH page_metrics AS ( SELECT wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url, wp.wp_type, COUNT(*) AS total_returns, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS sum_return_amt, AVG(wr.wr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss, COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk) AS distinct_refunded_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.cd_gender) AS distinct_refunded_genders, COUNT(DISTINCT hd.hd_income_band_sk) AS distinct_income_bands, (SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) * 0.6 + AVG(wr.wr_net_loss) * 0.4) AS composite_score FROM web_returns wr JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url, wp.wp_type ) SELECT wp_web_page_sk, wp_url, CASE WHEN wp_type = 'home' THEN 'LandingPage' WHEN wp_type = 'product' THEN 'ProductPage' ELSE 'OtherPage' END AS page_category, total_returns, sum_return_amt, avg_net_loss, distinct_refunded_customers, distinct_refunded_genders, distinct_income_bands, composite_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY composite_score DESC) AS composite_rank, SUM(composite_score) OVER (ORDER BY composite_score ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_composite_score FROM page_metrics WHERE total_returns > 0 ORDER BY composite_rank LIMIT 10

WITH item_return_stats AS ( SELECT i.i_category, i.i_class, i.i_brand, sm.sm_type, CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) > 5000 THEN 'HIGH_RETURN_VALUE' WHEN SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) BETWEEN 2000 AND 5000 THEN 'MEDIUM_RETURN_VALUE' ELSE 'LOW_RETURN_VALUE' END AS return_value_category, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY i.i_category, i.i_class, i.i_brand, sm.sm_type ) SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, sm_type, return_value_category, total_quantity, avg_return_amount, total_return_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY total_quantity DESC) AS qty_rank_in_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS global_return_amount_rank FROM item_return_stats WHERE total_quantity > 10 ORDER BY qty_rank_in_category, i_category FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_ship_cost) AS total_ship_cost, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(*) AS num_returns, CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 10000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS loss_category FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id ), customer_ship AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_sk, sm.sm_type, SUM(cr.cr_return_ship_cost) AS ship_cost_by_type, COUNT(*) AS ship_mode_return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, sm.sm_type ) SELECT ca.c_customer_id, ca.total_net_loss, ca.total_ship_cost, ca.total_quantity, ca.num_returns, ca.loss_category, cs.sm_type, cs.ship_cost_by_type, cs.ship_mode_return_cnt, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.loss_category ORDER BY ca.total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_category_rank FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN customer_ship cs ON ca.c_customer_sk = cs.c_customer_sk ORDER BY ca.total_net_loss DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS WITH TIES

WITH monthly_returns AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS return_date_sk, sm.sm_type, i.i_category, AVG(c.c_birth_year) AS avg_customer_birth_year, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, AVG(i.i_wholesale_cost) AS avg_wholesale_cost FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_returned_date_sk, sm.sm_type, i.i_category ) SELECT mr.return_date_sk, mr.sm_type, mr.i_category, mr.avg_customer_birth_year, mr.total_return_amount, mr.total_quantity, mr.return_cnt, mr.avg_wholesale_cost, LAG(mr.total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY mr.sm_type, mr.i_category ORDER BY mr.return_date_sk) AS prev_total_return_amount, CASE WHEN LAG(mr.total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY mr.sm_type, mr.i_category ORDER BY mr.return_date_sk) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ((mr.total_return_amount - LAG(mr.total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY mr.sm_type, mr.i_category ORDER BY mr.return_date_sk)) / LAG(mr.total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY mr.sm_type, mr.i_category ORDER BY mr.return_date_sk)) * 100 END AS pct_change_return_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY mr.sm_type ORDER BY mr.total_return_amount DESC) AS rank_by_ship_mode FROM monthly_returns mr WHERE mr.return_date_sk IS NOT NULL ORDER BY mr.sm_type, mr.i_category, mr.return_date_sk FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY

WITH brand_birth_ship_stats AS ( SELECT i.i_brand, c.c_birth_month, sm.sm_type, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS distinct_orders, AVG(cr.cr_return_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost, CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) > 20000 THEN 'VERY_HIGH' WHEN SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) BETWEEN 5000 AND 20000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS return_amount_category FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY i.i_brand, c.c_birth_month, sm.sm_type ) SELECT i_brand, c_birth_month, sm_type, total_return_amount, total_return_qty, distinct_orders, avg_ship_cost, return_amount_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_brand ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS rank_within_brand, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS global_rank, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS quartile FROM brand_birth_ship_stats WHERE total_return_qty > 0 ORDER BY i_brand, rank_within_brand FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY

WITH reason_sums AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_state,
        cc.cc_employees,
        cr.cr_reason_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_tax) AS total_return_tax
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN call_center cc
        ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN time_dim td
        ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    WHERE td.t_meal_time = 'Dinner'
    GROUP BY
        cc.cc_state,
        cc.cc_employees,
        cr.cr_reason_sk
)
SELECT
    rs.cc_state,
    rs.cr_reason_sk,
    rs.total_return_amount,
    rs.total_return_tax,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rs.cc_state ORDER BY rs.total_return_amount DESC) AS reason_rank,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rs.cc_state ORDER BY rs.total_return_amount DESC) AS pct_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN rs.cc_employees > 500 THEN 'LARGE'
        ELSE 'SMALL'
    END AS size_category
FROM reason_sums rs
WHERE rs.total_return_amount > 0
ORDER BY rs.cc_state, reason_rank

WITH hourly_stats AS (
    SELECT
        t.t_hour,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt,
        AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount,
        AVG(cr.cr_return_tax) AS avg_return_tax
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE hd.hd_vehicle_count > 2
    GROUP BY t.t_hour
)
SELECT
    h.t_hour,
    h.return_cnt,
    h.avg_return_amount,
    h.avg_return_tax,
    CASE
        WHEN h.avg_return_tax > 10 THEN 'HIGH_TAX'
        ELSE 'NORMAL_TAX'
    END AS tax_category,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY h.avg_return_amount DESC) AS amount_rank
FROM hourly_stats h
ORDER BY h.t_hour

SELECT
    cc.cc_name,
    cc.cc_state,
    t.t_hour,
    cr.cr_returned_time_sk,
    cr.cr_net_loss,
    LAG(cr.cr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cc.cc_call_center_sk ORDER BY t.t_hour) AS prev_net_loss,
    (cr.cr_net_loss - LAG(cr.cr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cc.cc_call_center_sk ORDER BY t.t_hour)) AS net_loss_change,
    CASE
        WHEN (cr.cr_net_loss - LAG(cr.cr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cc.cc_call_center_sk ORDER BY t.t_hour)) > 0 THEN 'INCREASE'
        ELSE 'DECREASE_OR_SAME'
    END AS trend,
    CASE
        WHEN cc.cc_tax_percentage > 5 THEN 'HIGH_TAX'
        ELSE 'LOW_TAX'
    END AS tax_bracket
FROM catalog_returns cr
JOIN call_center cc
    ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
JOIN time_dim t
    ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_ref
    ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_ref.hd_demo_sk
WHERE t.t_hour BETWEEN 0 AND 23
  AND cc.cc_state IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY cc.cc_name, t.t_hour

WITH filtered_returns AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returned_date_sk,
        cr.cr_returned_time_sk,
        cr.cr_call_center_sk,
        cr.cr_net_loss,
        cr.cr_return_quantity,
        cr.cr_return_amount,
        cr.cr_return_tax,
        cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk,
        cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    WHERE t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
      AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 20220101 AND 20221231
),
aggregate_by_cc AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cc_name,
        cc.cc_division,
        cc.cc_state,
        COUNT(*) AS total_returns,
        SUM(fr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss
    FROM filtered_returns fr
    JOIN call_center cc
        ON fr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
    JOIN household_demographics rd
        ON fr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = rd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics rf
        ON fr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = rf.hd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY
        cc.cc_name,
        cc.cc_division,
        cc.cc_state
    HAVING SUM(fr.cr_net_loss) > 0
)
SELECT
    agg.cc_name,
    agg.cc_division,
    agg.cc_state,
    agg.total_returns,
    agg.total_net_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN agg.total_net_loss > 100000 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN agg.total_net_loss > 50000 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS net_loss_category,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY agg.cc_division ORDER BY agg.total_net_loss DESC) AS division_rank
FROM aggregate_by_cc agg
ORDER BY agg.total_net_loss DESC

WITH type_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_type,
        cp.cp_department,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty,
        AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk) AS distinct_returning_customers
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    INNER JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    GROUP BY cp.cp_type, cp.cp_department
)
SELECT
    tm.cp_type,
    tm.cp_department,
    tm.total_return_qty,
    tm.avg_return_amount,
    tm.distinct_returning_customers,
    CASE
        WHEN tm.total_return_qty > 5000 THEN 'High Return Volume'
        WHEN tm.total_return_qty > 2000 THEN 'Medium Return Volume'
        ELSE 'Low Return Volume'
    END AS volume_category,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tm.total_return_qty) AS qty_percentile,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tm.total_return_qty DESC) AS qty_rank
FROM type_metrics tm

SELECT
    ca_bill.ca_city,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
    AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 50000 THEN 'High Performer'
        WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 20000 THEN 'Medium Performer'
        ELSE 'Low Performer'
    END AS profit_category
FROM web_sales ws
INNER JOIN customer_address ca_bill
    ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
GROUP BY ca_bill.ca_city

WITH returns_by_addr AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk AS address_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    GROUP BY cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk
),
sales_by_addr AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_ship_addr_sk AS address_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_sales_quantity
    FROM web_sales ws
    GROUP BY ws.ws_ship_addr_sk
)
SELECT
    ca.ca_city,
    rba.total_return_amount,
    sba.total_sales_amount,
    (sba.total_sales_amount - rba.total_return_amount) AS net_gain,
    CASE
        WHEN (sba.total_sales_amount - rba.total_return_amount) > 0 THEN 'Positive Net'
        WHEN (sba.total_sales_amount - rba.total_return_amount) < 0 THEN 'Negative Net'
        ELSE 'Break-even'
    END AS net_category,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (sba.total_sales_amount - rba.total_return_amount) DESC) AS net_gain_rank
FROM returns_by_addr rba
INNER JOIN sales_by_addr sba
    ON rba.address_sk = sba.address_sk
INNER JOIN customer_address ca
    ON rba.address_sk = ca.ca_address_sk

SELECT
    cp.cp_department,
    cp.cp_catalog_number,
    cp.cp_catalog_page_number,
    ca_ref.ca_city AS refunded_city,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 10000 THEN 'Critical'
        WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 5000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 1000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS loss_severity,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) DESC) AS loss_rank
FROM catalog_returns cr
INNER JOIN catalog_page cp
    ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
INNER JOIN customer_address ca_ref
    ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_ref.ca_address_sk
GROUP BY
    cp.cp_department,
    cp.cp_catalog_number,
    cp.cp_catalog_page_number,
    ca_ref.ca_city

WITH all_returns AS ( SELECT ca.ca_state AS state, cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss, cr.cr_return_amount + cr.cr_return_tax + cr.cr_return_ship_cost AS total_return, cr.cr_return_quantity AS return_quantity, cd.cd_credit_rating AS credit_rating, 'catalog' AS src FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_address ca ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk UNION ALL SELECT ca.ca_state AS state, sr.sr_net_loss AS net_loss, sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax AS total_return, sr.sr_return_quantity AS return_quantity, cd.cd_credit_rating AS credit_rating, 'store' AS src FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk ) SELECT state, SUM(net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(total_return) AS total_return_amount, SUM(return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT credit_rating) AS credit_rating_variants, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(net_loss) DESC) AS net_loss_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(net_loss) DESC) AS net_loss_percent_rank FROM all_returns GROUP BY state ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC LIMIT 10

WITH catalog AS ( SELECT cr.cr_item_sk AS item_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss, (cr.cr_return_amount + cr.cr_return_tax + cr.cr_return_ship_cost) AS return_amount, cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk AS demo_sk, cr.cr_returning_addr_sk AS addr_sk, 'catalog' AS src FROM catalog_returns cr ), store AS ( SELECT sr.sr_item_sk AS item_sk, sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, sr.sr_net_loss AS net_loss, sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax AS return_amount, sr.sr_cdemo_sk AS demo_sk, sr.sr_addr_sk AS addr_sk, 'store' AS src FROM store_returns sr ), combined AS ( SELECT * FROM catalog UNION ALL SELECT * FROM store ), joined AS ( SELECT c.item_sk, c.date_sk, c.net_loss, c.return_amount, d.cd_gender, a.ca_city, c.src FROM combined c LEFT JOIN customer_demographics d ON c.demo_sk = d.cd_demo_sk LEFT JOIN customer_address a ON c.addr_sk = a.ca_address_sk ) SELECT item_sk, cd_gender, ca_city, date_sk, net_loss, return_amount, LAG(net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk, cd_gender ORDER BY date_sk) AS prev_net_loss, CASE WHEN net_loss > COALESCE(LAG(net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk, cd_gender ORDER BY date_sk),0) THEN 'UP' WHEN net_loss < COALESCE(LAG(net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk, cd_gender ORDER BY date_sk),0) THEN 'DOWN' ELSE 'SAME' END AS net_loss_trend, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY net_loss DESC) AS rn_by_net_loss FROM joined WHERE date_sk IS NOT NULL ORDER BY item_sk, date_sk LIMIT 30

WITH reason_returns AS ( SELECT cr.cr_reason_sk AS reason_sk, cr.cr_return_amount + cr.cr_return_tax + cr.cr_return_ship_cost AS total_return, cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss, cr.cr_return_ship_cost AS ship_cost, ca.ca_state AS state, cd.cd_credit_rating AS credit_rating, 'catalog' AS src FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_address ca ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk UNION ALL SELECT sr.sr_reason_sk AS reason_sk, sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax AS total_return, sr.sr_net_loss AS net_loss, sr.sr_return_ship_cost AS ship_cost, ca.ca_state AS state, cd.cd_credit_rating AS credit_rating, 'store' AS src FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk ), aggregated AS ( SELECT reason_sk, src, SUM(total_return) AS sum_return, SUM(net_loss) AS sum_net_loss, AVG(ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost, COUNT(*) AS cnt_returns, MAX(credit_rating) AS max_credit_rating FROM reason_returns GROUP BY reason_sk, src ) SELECT reason_sk, src, sum_return, sum_net_loss, avg_ship_cost, cnt_returns, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY sum_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_quartile, max_credit_rating, CASE WHEN sum_net_loss > 50000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN sum_net_loss BETWEEN 20000 AND 50000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS loss_category FROM aggregated ORDER BY sum_net_loss DESC LIMIT 20

WITH catalog_customer AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS cust_sk, (cr.cr_return_amount + cr.cr_return_tax + cr.cr_return_ship_cost) AS total_return, cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss, cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk AS demo_sk, cr.cr_returning_addr_sk AS addr_sk, 'catalog' AS src FROM catalog_returns cr WHERE cr.cr_returning_customer_sk IS NOT NULL ), store_customer AS ( SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk AS cust_sk, sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax AS total_return, sr.sr_net_loss AS net_loss, sr.sr_cdemo_sk AS demo_sk, sr.sr_addr_sk AS addr_sk, 'store' AS src FROM store_returns sr WHERE sr.sr_customer_sk IS NOT NULL ), combined AS ( SELECT * FROM catalog_customer UNION ALL SELECT * FROM store_customer ) SELECT cust_sk, SUM(total_return) AS total_return_amount, SUM(net_loss) AS total_net_loss, d.cd_gender, d.cd_marital_status, a.ca_city, CASE WHEN SUM(total_return) > 10000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN SUM(total_return) BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS return_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(total_return) DESC) AS return_rank FROM combined c JOIN customer_demographics d ON c.demo_sk = d.cd_demo_sk JOIN customer_address a ON c.addr_sk = a.ca_address_sk GROUP BY cust_sk, d.cd_gender, d.cd_marital_status, a.ca_city ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC LIMIT 5

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_employees, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(CASE WHEN cs.cs_net_paid = 0 THEN 0 ELSE cs.cs_net_profit / cs.cs_net_paid END) AS profit_margin_ratio FROM call_center cc JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_employees ), returns_agg AS ( SELECT cr.cr_call_center_sk, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_call_center_sk ) SELECT s.cc_name, s.cc_employees, s.total_net_paid, s.total_net_profit, ROUND(s.profit_margin_ratio, 4) AS profit_margin_ratio, COALESCE(r.total_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss, CASE WHEN s.cc_employees < 50 THEN 'Small' WHEN s.cc_employees BETWEEN 50 AND 200 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS size_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM sales_agg s LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON r.cr_call_center_sk = s.cc_call_center_sk ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 10

WITH page_sales AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_item_sk) AS distinct_items_sold, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_return_amount), 0) AS total_returns FROM catalog_page cp JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department ) SELECT cp_catalog_page_id, cp_department, distinct_items_sold, total_sales, total_returns, total_sales - total_returns AS net_sales, CASE WHEN total_discount > 100 THEN 'High Discount' WHEN total_discount > 0 THEN 'Low Discount' ELSE 'No Discount' END AS discount_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY (total_sales - total_returns) DESC) AS dept_net_sales_rank FROM page_sales WHERE total_quantity > 0 ORDER BY dept_net_sales_rank LIMIT 20

WITH filtered_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_order_number, cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, cs.cs_net_profit, cs.cs_net_paid, cs.cs_quantity, cs.cs_call_center_sk, cs.cs_catalog_page_sk, cs.cs_item_sk FROM catalog_sales cs WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2450100 ), sales_with_returns AS ( SELECT fs.*, COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss, 0) AS net_loss, fs.cs_net_profit - COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss, 0) AS adjusted_net_profit FROM filtered_sales fs LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = fs.cs_order_number AND cr.cr_item_sk = fs.cs_item_sk ), customer_profit AS ( SELECT swr.cs_bill_customer_sk, SUM(swr.adjusted_net_profit) AS total_adjusted_profit FROM sales_with_returns swr GROUP BY swr.cs_bill_customer_sk ), ranked_customers AS ( SELECT cp2.cs_bill_customer_sk, cp2.total_adjusted_profit, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cp2.total_adjusted_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM customer_profit cp2 ) SELECT swr.cs_bill_customer_sk, cc.cc_name AS call_center_name, cp.cp_department, swr.cs_order_number, swr.cs_sold_date_sk, swr.adjusted_net_profit, SUM(swr.adjusted_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY swr.cs_bill_customer_sk ORDER BY swr.cs_sold_date_sk ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_adjusted_profit, CASE WHEN swr.cs_net_paid > 5000 THEN 'High Value' ELSE 'Regular' END AS purchase_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY swr.cs_bill_customer_sk ORDER BY swr.cs_sold_date_sk) AS purchase_sequence FROM sales_with_returns swr JOIN ranked_customers rc ON rc.cs_bill_customer_sk = swr.cs_bill_customer_sk JOIN call_center cc ON cc.cc_call_center_sk = swr.cs_call_center_sk JOIN catalog_page cp ON cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = swr.cs_catalog_page_sk WHERE rc.profit_rank <= 5 ORDER BY swr.cs_bill_customer_sk, swr.cs_sold_date_sk

WITH item_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, cc.cc_division, cc.cc_division_name, cp.cp_department, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_return_amount), 0) AS total_returns, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) - COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_return_amount), 0) AS net_revenue FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cc.cc_call_center_sk = cs.cs_call_center_sk JOIN catalog_page cp ON cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = cs.cs_catalog_page_sk LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cc.cc_division, cc.cc_division_name, cp.cp_department ) SELECT cs_item_sk, cc_division, cc_division_name, cp_department, total_sales, total_returns, net_revenue, CASE WHEN net_revenue >= 20000 THEN 'Very High' WHEN net_revenue >= 10000 THEN 'High' WHEN net_revenue >= 5000 THEN 'Medium' WHEN net_revenue > 0 THEN 'Low' ELSE 'None' END AS revenue_tier, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_revenue) AS revenue_percentile, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM item_sales WHERE total_sales > 0 ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 50

WITH merged_returns AS ( SELECT cr_returning_cdemo_sk AS demo_sk, cr_net_loss AS net_loss, cr_return_quantity AS qty, cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk FROM catalog_returns UNION ALL SELECT wr_returning_cdemo_sk AS demo_sk, wr_net_loss AS net_loss, wr_return_quantity AS qty, wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk FROM web_returns ), daily_agg AS ( SELECT demo_sk, date_sk, SUM(net_loss) AS daily_loss, SUM(qty) AS daily_qty FROM merged_returns GROUP BY demo_sk, date_sk ) SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_credit_rating, da.date_sk, da.daily_loss, da.daily_qty, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.cd_gender ORDER BY da.daily_loss DESC) AS loss_rank, AVG(da.daily_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cd.cd_gender ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_7day_loss FROM daily_agg da JOIN customer_demographics cd ON da.demo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE da.date_sk BETWEEN 20230101 AND 20231231 ORDER BY cd.cd_gender, loss_rank LIMIT 40

WITH loss_union AS ( SELECT cr_returning_cdemo_sk AS demo_sk, cr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM catalog_returns UNION ALL SELECT wr_returning_cdemo_sk AS demo_sk, wr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM web_returns ), loss_stats AS ( SELECT demo_sk, COUNT(*) AS loss_count, SUM(net_loss) AS total_loss, MIN(net_loss) AS min_loss, MAX(net_loss) AS max_loss FROM loss_union WHERE net_loss IS NOT NULL GROUP BY demo_sk ) SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, ls.loss_count, ls.total_loss, ls.min_loss, ls.max_loss, CASE WHEN ls.total_loss > 10000 THEN 'Critical' WHEN ls.total_loss > 5000 THEN 'Warning' ELSE 'Normal' END AS risk_level, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ls.total_loss DESC) AS overall_rank FROM loss_stats ls JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ls.demo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk ORDER BY overall_rank FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

WITH combined AS ( SELECT cr_returning_cdemo_sk AS demo_sk, cr_net_loss AS net_loss, cr_return_quantity AS qty FROM catalog_returns UNION ALL SELECT wr_returning_cdemo_sk AS demo_sk, wr_net_loss AS net_loss, wr_return_quantity AS qty FROM web_returns ), summary AS ( SELECT demo_sk, SUM(net_loss) AS total_loss, SUM(qty) AS total_qty, COUNT(*) AS transaction_cnt FROM combined GROUP BY demo_sk ) SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_credit_rating, s.total_loss, s.total_qty, s.transaction_cnt, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY s.total_loss DESC) AS loss_quartile, SUM(s.total_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cd.cd_gender) AS gender_total_loss FROM summary s JOIN customer_demographics cd ON s.demo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE s.transaction_cnt >= 5 ORDER BY loss_quartile, cd.cd_gender LIMIT 20

WITH scored_returns AS ( SELECT sr.sr_ticket_number, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq, sr.sr_return_amt, sr.sr_fee, sr.sr_store_credit, sr.sr_net_loss, hd.hd_buy_potential, ib.ib_lower_bound, ( (COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss,0) * -1) + (COALESCE(sr.sr_fee,0) * -0.6) + (COALESCE(sr.sr_store_credit,0) * 0.4) + CASE WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = 'high' THEN 8 WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = 'medium' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END + (ib.ib_lower_bound / 8000) ) AS return_quality_score FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk ), agg AS ( SELECT d_year, d_quarter_seq, AVG(return_quality_score) AS avg_score, SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount FROM scored_returns GROUP BY d_year, d_quarter_seq ) SELECT d_year, d_quarter_seq, avg_score, total_return_amount, CASE WHEN avg_score >= 35 THEN 'Strong' WHEN avg_score >= 20 THEN 'Moderate' ELSE 'Weak' END AS quarter_quality FROM agg ORDER BY d_year DESC, d_quarter_seq

WITH scored_returns AS ( SELECT sr.sr_ticket_number, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq, sr.sr_return_amt, sr.sr_fee, sr.sr_store_credit, sr.sr_net_loss, hd.hd_buy_potential, ib.ib_lower_bound, ( (COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss,0) * -1) + (COALESCE(sr.sr_fee,0) * -0.5) + (COALESCE(sr.sr_store_credit,0) * 0.3) + CASE WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = 'high' THEN 10 WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = 'medium' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END + (ib.ib_lower_bound / 10000) ) AS return_quality_score FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk ), windowed AS ( SELECT d_year, d_quarter_seq, sr_ticket_number, return_quality_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, d_quarter_seq ORDER BY return_quality_score ASC) AS asc_rn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, d_quarter_seq ORDER BY return_quality_score DESC) AS desc_rn FROM scored_returns ) SELECT d_year, d_quarter_seq, sr_ticket_number, return_quality_score, CASE WHEN asc_rn = 1 THEN 'Lowest' WHEN desc_rn = 1 THEN 'Highest' ELSE 'Mid' END AS rank_position FROM windowed WHERE asc_rn <= 3 OR desc_rn <= 3 ORDER BY d_year, d_quarter_seq, return_quality_score DESC

SELECT cc.cc_company_name, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_employees, od.d_date AS open_date, cd.d_date AS close_date, DATE_DIFF('day', od.d_date, COALESCE(cd.d_date, CURRENT_DATE)) AS days_open, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc.cc_state ORDER BY cc.cc_employees DESC) AS employee_rank_state, CASE WHEN cc.cc_employees >= 1000 THEN 'LARGE' WHEN cc.cc_employees >= 500 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS size_category FROM call_center cc JOIN date_dim od ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = od.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN date_dim cd ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = cd.d_date_sk WHERE od.d_year >= 2000

SELECT division, year, month, total_quantity, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY division ORDER BY total_quantity DESC) AS monthly_quantity_rank, CASE WHEN total_quantity >= 50000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN total_quantity >= 20000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS quantity_bucket, AVG(total_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY division) AS avg_quantity_per_month FROM (SELECT cc.cc_division AS division, d.d_year AS year, d.d_moy AS month, SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_quantity FROM inventory i JOIN date_dim d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN call_center cc ON i.inv_date_sk BETWEEN cc.cc_open_date_sk AND COALESCE(cc.cc_closed_date_sk, 2147483647) WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2022 GROUP BY cc.cc_division, d.d_year, d.d_moy) q ORDER BY division, year, month LIMIT 200

WITH cc_tax AS (SELECT cc.cc_state AS state, AVG(cc.cc_tax_percentage) AS avg_cc_tax, COUNT(*) AS cc_cnt FROM call_center cc JOIN date_dim d ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year >= 2010 GROUP BY cc.cc_state), ws_tax AS (SELECT ws.web_state AS state, AVG(ws.web_tax_percentage) AS avg_ws_tax, COUNT(*) AS ws_cnt FROM web_site ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year >= 2010 GROUP BY ws.web_state) SELECT cc.state, cc.avg_cc_tax, ws.avg_ws_tax, (cc.avg_cc_tax - ws.avg_ws_tax) AS tax_diff, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (cc.avg_cc_tax - ws.avg_ws_tax) DESC) AS tax_diff_rank, CASE WHEN (cc.avg_cc_tax - ws.avg_ws_tax) > 0.5 THEN 'HIGH_DIFF' ELSE 'MODERATE_DIFF' END AS diff_category, LAG(cc.avg_cc_tax) OVER (ORDER BY cc.state) AS prev_state_cc_tax FROM cc_tax cc JOIN ws_tax ws ON cc.state = ws.state ORDER BY tax_diff_rank LIMIT 30

WITH sales_address AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ca_bill.ca_state AS bill_state,
        ca_bill.ca_city AS bill_city,
        ca_ship.ca_state AS ship_state,
        ca_ship.ca_city AS ship_city,
        CAST(FLOOR(ws.ws_sold_date_sk / 100) AS INTEGER) AS year_month
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
),
monthly_site_sales AS (
    SELECT
        s.web_name,
        sa.year_month,
        SUM(sa.ws_ext_sales_price) AS month_sales,
        COUNT(*) AS orders,
        SUM(CASE WHEN sa.bill_state = sa.ship_state THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same_state_orders,
        SUM(CASE WHEN sa.bill_city = sa.ship_city THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same_city_orders
    FROM sales_address sa
    JOIN web_site s ON sa.ws_web_site_sk = s.web_site_sk
    GROUP BY s.web_name, sa.year_month
)
SELECT
    web_name,
    year_month,
    month_sales,
    orders,
    same_state_orders,
    same_city_orders,
    ROUND(100.0 * same_state_orders / orders, 2) AS pct_same_state,
    ROUND(100.0 * same_city_orders / orders, 2) AS pct_same_city,
    SUM(month_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY web_name ORDER BY year_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_sales,
    LAG(month_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY web_name ORDER BY year_month) AS prior_month_sales,
    CASE
        WHEN month_sales > COALESCE(LAG(month_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY web_name ORDER BY year_month), 0) THEN 'Increase'
        WHEN month_sales < COALESCE(LAG(month_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY web_name ORDER BY year_month), 0) THEN 'Decrease'
        ELSE 'Flat'
    END AS sales_trend
FROM monthly_site_sales
WHERE year_month >= 202201
ORDER BY web_name, year_month

WITH sales_monthly AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        i.i_brand,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_sales_price,
        CAST(FLOOR(ws.ws_sold_date_sk / 100) AS INTEGER) AS year_month
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
),
monthly_brand_agg AS (
    SELECT
        s.web_name,
        sm.year_month,
        sm.i_brand,
        SUM(sm.ws_ext_sales_price) AS monthly_sales,
        SUM(sm.ws_quantity) AS monthly_units,
        SUM(sm.ws_net_profit) AS monthly_profit,
        AVG(sm.ws_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price
    FROM sales_monthly sm
    JOIN web_site s ON sm.ws_web_site_sk = s.web_site_sk
    GROUP BY s.web_name, sm.year_month, sm.i_brand
    HAVING SUM(sm.ws_ext_sales_price) > 5000
),
ranked_brand AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY web_name, year_month ORDER BY monthly_sales DESC) AS brand_rank
    FROM monthly_brand_agg
)
SELECT
    web_name,
    year_month,
    i_brand,
    monthly_sales,
    monthly_units,
    monthly_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN avg_sales_price >= 100 THEN 'Premium'
        WHEN avg_sales_price >= 50 THEN 'Midrange'
        ELSE 'Budget'
    END AS price_tier,
    brand_rank
FROM ranked_brand
WHERE brand_rank = 1
ORDER BY web_name, year_month

WITH sales_by_address AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_ext_discount_amt,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ca_bill.ca_state AS bill_state,
        ca_bill.ca_city AS bill_city,
        ca_ship.ca_state AS ship_state,
        ca_ship.ca_city AS ship_city,
        i.i_brand,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN web_site s ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = s.web_site_sk
),
aggregated_sales AS (
    SELECT
        bill_state,
        bill_city,
        i_brand,
        ship_state,
        COUNT(*) AS orders,
        SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        AVG(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_profit
    FROM sales_by_address
    GROUP BY bill_state, bill_city, i_brand, ship_state
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
)
SELECT
    bill_state,
    bill_city,
    i_brand,
    orders,
    total_sales,
    avg_discount,
    total_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN bill_state = ship_state THEN 'Same_State'
        ELSE 'Different_State'
    END AS ship_bill_state_match,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY bill_state ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS state_sales_percentile
FROM aggregated_sales
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH site_item_profit AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_brand,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_sales_price,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_ext_discount_amt,
        ws.ws_ext_list_price,
        ws.ws_ext_wholesale_cost,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        ca.ca_state AS bill_state,
        ca.ca_city AS bill_city
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN web_site s ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = s.web_site_sk
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        s.web_name,
        p.i_product_name,
        p.i_brand,
        p.bill_state,
        SUM(p.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        SUM(p.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.ws_order_number) AS orders,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(p.ws_net_profit) > 100000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN SUM(p.ws_net_profit) > 50000 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS profit_category
    FROM site_item_profit p
    JOIN web_site s ON p.ws_web_site_sk = s.web_site_sk
    GROUP BY s.web_name, p.i_product_name, p.i_brand, p.bill_state
    HAVING SUM(p.ws_ext_sales_price) > 10000
)
SELECT
    web_name,
    i_product_name,
    i_brand,
    bill_state,
    total_net_profit,
    total_sales,
    orders,
    profit_category,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY web_name ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY web_name, profit_rank
LIMIT 50

WITH returns_agg AS ( SELECT cc.cc_name, dd.d_year, dd.d_quarter_name, cc.cc_tax_percentage, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, AVG(cr.cr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN date_dim dd ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_name, dd.d_year, dd.d_quarter_name, cc.cc_tax_percentage ) SELECT cc_name, d_year, d_quarter_name, total_return_amount, avg_net_loss, CASE WHEN cc_tax_percentage >= 10 THEN 'High Tax' WHEN cc_tax_percentage >= 5 THEN 'Medium Tax' ELSE 'Low Tax' END AS tax_bracket, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, d_quarter_name ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS return_amount_rank, SUM(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_name ORDER BY d_year, d_quarter_name ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return_amount FROM returns_agg ORDER BY d_year, d_quarter_name, return_amount_rank

WITH sales_by_center AS ( SELECT cc.cc_name, sd.d_year, sd.d_month_seq, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim sd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = sd.d_date_sk JOIN call_center cc ON sd.d_date_sk = cc.cc_open_date_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_name, sd.d_year, sd.d_month_seq ) SELECT cc_name, d_year, d_month_seq, total_sales, total_profit, (total_profit / NULLIF(total_sales, 0)) AS profit_margin, CASE WHEN (total_profit / NULLIF(total_sales, 0)) > 0.2 THEN 'High' WHEN (total_profit / NULLIF(total_sales, 0)) > 0.1 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, d_month_seq ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, d_month_seq ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM sales_by_center ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq, profit_rank

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk, sd.d_year, sd.d_month_seq, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim sd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = sd.d_date_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, sd.d_year, sd.d_month_seq ), returns_agg AS ( SELECT cr.cr_item_sk AS item_sk, dd.d_year, dd.d_month_seq, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS return_amount FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN date_dim dd ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk, dd.d_year, dd.d_month_seq ) SELECT COALESCE(s.item_sk, r.item_sk) AS item_sk, COALESCE(s.d_year, r.d_year) AS year, COALESCE(s.d_month_seq, r.d_month_seq) AS month, COALESCE(s.sales_amount, 0) - COALESCE(r.return_amount, 0) AS net_revenue, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.sales_amount, 0) - COALESCE(r.return_amount, 0) > 10000 THEN 'High' WHEN COALESCE(s.sales_amount, 0) - COALESCE(r.return_amount, 0) > 5000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS revenue_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(s.d_year, r.d_year), COALESCE(s.d_month_seq, r.d_month_seq) ORDER BY (COALESCE(s.sales_amount, 0) - COALESCE(r.return_amount, 0)) DESC) AS rn, SUM(COALESCE(s.sales_amount, 0) - COALESCE(r.return_amount, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(s.d_year, r.d_year) ORDER BY COALESCE(s.d_month_seq, r.d_month_seq)) AS cumulative_yearly_net FROM sales_agg s FULL OUTER JOIN returns_agg r ON s.item_sk = r.item_sk AND s.d_year = r.d_year AND s.d_month_seq = r.d_month_seq WHERE (COALESCE(s.sales_amount, 0) - COALESCE(r.return_amount, 0)) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY year, month, net_revenue DESC LIMIT 100

WITH sales_month AS ( SELECT sd.d_year, sd.d_month_seq, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim sd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = sd.d_date_sk GROUP BY sd.d_year, sd.d_month_seq ), returns_month_cc AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, dd.d_year, dd.d_month_seq, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN date_dim dd ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, dd.d_year, dd.d_month_seq ) SELECT rm.cc_name, rm.d_year, rm.d_month_seq, sm.total_sales, sm.total_profit, rm.total_return_amount, rm.total_return_loss, (sm.total_profit - rm.total_return_loss) AS net_profit_after_returns, LAG(sm.total_profit - rm.total_return_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY rm.cc_name ORDER BY rm.d_year, rm.d_month_seq) AS prior_month_profit, ( (sm.total_profit - rm.total_return_loss) - LAG(sm.total_profit - rm.total_return_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY rm.cc_name ORDER BY rm.d_year, rm.d_month_seq) ) AS month_over_month_change, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rm.d_year, rm.d_month_seq ORDER BY (sm.total_profit - rm.total_return_loss) DESC) AS profit_percentile, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rm.d_year, rm.d_month_seq ORDER BY (sm.total_profit - rm.total_return_loss) DESC) AS profit_rank, CASE WHEN (sm.total_profit - rm.total_return_loss) > 0 THEN 'Positive' ELSE 'Negative' END AS profit_indicator FROM returns_month_cc rm JOIN sales_month sm ON sm.d_year = rm.d_year AND sm.d_month_seq = rm.d_month_seq WHERE sm.total_sales > 0 ORDER BY rm.d_year, rm.d_month_seq, net_profit_after_returns DESC

WITH returns AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender ), sales AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk ) SELECT r.cd_gender, r.total_return_loss, s.total_sales, CASE WHEN s.total_sales > 0 THEN r.total_return_loss / s.total_sales ELSE NULL END AS loss_to_sales_ratio, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.total_return_loss) AS loss_percent_rank FROM returns r JOIN sales s ON r.cd_demo_sk = s.cd_demo_sk WHERE r.total_return_loss > 100 ORDER BY loss_to_sales_ratio ASC

WITH returns AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status ), sales AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk ) SELECT r.cd_gender, r.cd_marital_status, r.total_return_loss, s.total_sales, r.return_cnt, s.sales_cnt, CASE WHEN s.total_sales > 0 THEN r.total_return_loss / s.total_sales ELSE NULL END AS loss_to_sales_ratio, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.cd_gender ORDER BY r.return_cnt DESC) AS gender_return_cnt_rank FROM returns r JOIN sales s ON r.cd_demo_sk = s.cd_demo_sk WHERE r.total_return_loss > 0 AND s.total_sales > 0 GROUP BY r.cd_gender, r.cd_marital_status, r.total_return_loss, s.total_sales, r.return_cnt, s.sales_cnt ORDER BY loss_to_sales_ratio DESC

WITH returns AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status ), sales AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk ) SELECT r.cd_gender, r.cd_marital_status, r.total_return_loss, s.total_sales, (r.total_return_loss - s.total_sales) AS diff_loss_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.cd_gender ORDER BY r.total_return_loss DESC) AS gender_loss_rank FROM returns r JOIN sales s ON r.cd_demo_sk = s.cd_demo_sk WHERE r.total_return_loss > 0 ORDER BY diff_loss_sales DESC

WITH return_by_warehouse AS (
  SELECT cr.cr_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
         SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
         COUNT(*) AS return_events,
         AVG(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_qty
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  WHERE cr.cr_returned_date_sk >= 20000101
  GROUP BY cr.cr_warehouse_sk
),
sales_by_warehouse_site AS (
  SELECT ws.ws_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
         ws.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk,
         SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit,
         SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
         SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_sales_qty,
         MAX(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS max_paid_inc_tax
  FROM web_sales ws
  WHERE ws.ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 20000101 AND 20001231
  GROUP BY ws.ws_warehouse_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk
)
SELECT w.w_warehouse_sk,
       w.w_warehouse_name,
       r.total_return_loss,
       s.total_sales_profit,
       r.return_events,
       CASE WHEN s.total_sales_profit = 0 THEN NULL ELSE r.total_return_loss / s.total_sales_profit END AS loss_to_profit_ratio,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.total_return_loss DESC) AS loss_rank,
       site.web_name AS site_name,
       s.max_paid_inc_tax
FROM warehouse w
LEFT JOIN return_by_warehouse r ON w.w_warehouse_sk = r.warehouse_sk
JOIN sales_by_warehouse_site s ON w.w_warehouse_sk = s.warehouse_sk
JOIN web_site site ON s.site_sk = site.web_site_sk
WHERE r.total_return_loss IS NOT NULL
  AND w.w_state = 'CA'
ORDER BY loss_to_profit_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5

WITH return_by_warehouse AS (
  SELECT cr.cr_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
         SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
         SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty,
         MIN(cr.cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS min_return_amount
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  GROUP BY cr.cr_warehouse_sk
),
sales_by_warehouse_site AS (
  SELECT ws.ws_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
         ws.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk,
         SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit,
         SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
         SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_sales_qty,
         AVG(ws.ws_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price
  FROM web_sales ws
  GROUP BY ws.ws_warehouse_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk
)
SELECT w.w_warehouse_sk,
       w.w_city,
       r.total_return_qty,
       s.total_sales_qty,
       r.min_return_amount,
       s.avg_sales_price,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_state ORDER BY r.total_return_qty DESC) AS rn_by_state,
       site.web_name AS site_name
FROM warehouse w
LEFT JOIN return_by_warehouse r ON w.w_warehouse_sk = r.warehouse_sk
JOIN sales_by_warehouse_site s ON w.w_warehouse_sk = s.warehouse_sk
JOIN web_site site ON s.site_sk = site.web_site_sk
WHERE w.w_country = 'United States'
  AND r.total_return_qty > 0
ORDER BY rn_by_state
LIMIT 10

WITH return_by_warehouse AS (
  SELECT cr.cr_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
         SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
         COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_reason_sk) AS distinct_reason_cnt
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  WHERE cr.cr_return_quantity > 5
  GROUP BY cr.cr_warehouse_sk
),
sales_by_warehouse_site AS (
  SELECT ws.ws_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
         ws.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk,
         SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit,
         SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
         SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_sales_qty,
         SUM(ws.ws_coupon_amt) AS total_coupons
  FROM web_sales ws
  WHERE ws.ws_coupon_amt > 0
  GROUP BY ws.ws_warehouse_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk
)
SELECT w.w_warehouse_sk,
       w.w_warehouse_name,
       r.total_return_loss,
       r.distinct_reason_cnt,
       s.total_sales_amount,
       s.total_coupons,
       (r.total_return_loss - s.total_coupons) AS net_loss_after_coupons,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (r.total_return_loss - s.total_coupons) DESC) AS net_loss_rank,
       site.web_name AS site_name
FROM warehouse w
LEFT JOIN return_by_warehouse r ON w.w_warehouse_sk = r.warehouse_sk
JOIN sales_by_warehouse_site s ON w.w_warehouse_sk = s.warehouse_sk
JOIN web_site site ON s.site_sk = site.web_site_sk
WHERE r.total_return_loss IS NOT NULL
  AND w.w_gmt_offset BETWEEN -5 AND -3
ORDER BY net_loss_rank
LIMIT 7

WITH sales_agg AS (SELECT sm.sm_carrier, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_credit_rating, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY sm.sm_carrier, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_credit_rating), returns_agg AS (SELECT sm.sm_carrier, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_credit_rating, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount, SUM(sr.sr_return_tax) AS total_return_tax, SUM(sr.sr_return_ship_cost) AS total_return_ship_cost FROM store_returns sr JOIN catalog_sales cs ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk AND sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY sm.sm_carrier, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_credit_rating) SELECT s.sm_carrier, s.cd_gender, s.cd_marital_status, s.cd_credit_rating, s.total_sales, s.total_profit, COALESCE(r.total_return_amount,0) AS total_return_amount, (s.total_sales - COALESCE(r.total_return_amount,0)) AS net_sales, (s.total_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_tax + r.total_return_ship_cost,0)) AS net_profit, CASE WHEN s.total_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (s.total_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_tax + r.total_return_ship_cost,0)) / s.total_sales END AS profit_margin, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (s.total_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_tax + r.total_return_ship_cost,0)) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM sales_agg s LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON s.sm_carrier = r.sm_carrier AND s.cd_gender = r.cd_gender AND s.cd_marital_status = r.cd_marital_status AND s.cd_credit_rating = r.cd_credit_rating ORDER BY profit_rank

WITH sales_agg AS (SELECT sm.sm_carrier, cd.cd_gender, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY sm.sm_carrier, cd.cd_gender), returns_agg AS (SELECT sm.sm_carrier, cd.cd_gender, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity FROM store_returns sr JOIN catalog_sales cs ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk AND sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY sm.sm_carrier, cd.cd_gender) SELECT s.sm_carrier, s.cd_gender, s.total_sales, s.total_profit, s.total_quantity, COALESCE(r.total_return_quantity,0) AS total_return_quantity, CASE WHEN s.total_quantity = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(r.total_return_quantity,0) * 1.0 / s.total_quantity END AS return_rate, s.total_profit / NULLIF(s.total_sales,0) AS profit_margin, SUM(s.total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY s.sm_carrier ORDER BY s.cd_gender ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_profit_by_carrier, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_profit DESC) AS carrier_profit_rank FROM sales_agg s LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON s.sm_carrier = r.sm_carrier AND s.cd_gender = r.cd_gender ORDER BY s.sm_carrier, s.cd_gender

WITH sales_agg AS (SELECT cs.cs_ship_mode_sk, cd.cd_gender, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_ship_mode_sk, cd.cd_gender), returns_agg AS (SELECT cs.cs_ship_mode_sk, cd.cd_gender, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity, SUM(sr.sr_return_tax) AS total_return_tax, SUM(sr.sr_return_ship_cost) AS total_return_ship_cost FROM store_returns sr JOIN catalog_sales cs ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk AND sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_ship_mode_sk, cd.cd_gender) SELECT sm.sm_ship_mode_id, sm.sm_type, a.cd_gender, a.total_sales, a.total_profit, a.total_quantity, COALESCE(r.total_return_amount,0) AS total_return_amount, COALESCE(r.total_return_quantity,0) AS total_return_quantity, (a.total_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_tax + r.total_return_ship_cost,0)) AS net_profit, CASE WHEN (a.total_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_tax + r.total_return_ship_cost,0)) / NULLIF(a.total_sales,0) > 0.20 THEN 'High' WHEN (a.total_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_tax + r.total_return_ship_cost,0)) / NULLIF(a.total_sales,0) > 0.10 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.cd_gender ORDER BY (a.total_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_tax + r.total_return_ship_cost,0)) DESC) AS profit_rank_by_gender FROM sales_agg a LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON a.cs_ship_mode_sk = r.cs_ship_mode_sk AND a.cd_gender = r.cd_gender JOIN ship_mode sm ON a.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk ORDER BY a.cd_gender, profit_rank_by_gender

WITH customer_sales AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_coupon_amt) AS total_coupon_amount, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk), customer_shipmode AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_ship_mode_sk, COUNT(*) AS mode_count FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_ship_mode_sk), customer_returns AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity FROM store_returns sr JOIN catalog_sales cs ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk AND sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk), top_customers AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk, cs.total_net_paid, cs.total_coupon_amount, cs.total_quantity, COALESCE(cr.total_return_amount,0) AS total_return_amount, COALESCE(cr.total_return_quantity,0) AS total_return_quantity, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_net_paid DESC) AS rnk, SUM(cs.total_net_paid) OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_net_paid DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_net_paid FROM customer_sales cs LEFT JOIN customer_returns cr ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = cr.cs_bill_customer_sk) SELECT tc.cs_bill_customer_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_credit_rating, tc.total_net_paid, tc.total_coupon_amount, CASE WHEN tc.total_net_paid = 0 THEN 0 ELSE tc.total_coupon_amount / tc.total_net_paid END AS coupon_usage_ratio, tc.total_quantity, tc.total_return_amount, tc.total_return_quantity, sm.sm_type AS top_ship_mode_type, sm.sm_carrier AS top_ship_mode_carrier, tc.rnk AS net_paid_rank, tc.running_total_net_paid, ROUND(tc.total_net_paid / SUM(tc.total_net_paid) OVER () * 100, 2) AS pct_of_total_net_paid FROM top_customers tc JOIN customer_demographics cd ON tc.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk LEFT JOIN (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_ship_mode_sk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk ORDER BY cs.mode_count DESC) AS mode_rank FROM customer_shipmode cs) top_mode ON tc.cs_bill_customer_sk = top_mode.cs_bill_customer_sk AND top_mode.mode_rank = 1 LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm ON top_mode.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk WHERE tc.rnk <= 10 ORDER BY tc.rnk

SELECT cc_mkt_class, market_class_category, hd_income_band_sk, return_cnt, total_return_amount, avg_return_quantity, avg_purchase_estimate, ROUND(100.0 * total_return_amount / SUM(total_return_amount) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_total, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS market_income_rank FROM ( SELECT cc.cc_mkt_class, CASE WHEN cc.cc_mkt_class LIKE 'A%' THEN 'Class A' WHEN cc.cc_mkt_class LIKE 'B%' THEN 'Class B' ELSE 'Other' END AS market_class_category, hd.hd_income_band_sk, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, AVG(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_quantity, AVG(cd.cd_purchase_estimate) AS avg_purchase_estimate FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_mkt_class, hd.hd_income_band_sk ) agg WHERE return_cnt >= 30 ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC

SELECT rc_state, marital_status, gender, total_fee, total_net_loss, return_cnt, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_fee DESC) AS fee_quartile, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 0 THEN 'Loss' ELSE 'Profit' END AS loss_indicator FROM ( SELECT cc.cc_state AS rc_state, cd.cd_marital_status AS marital_status, cd.cd_gender AS gender, SUM(cr.cr_fee) AS total_fee, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_state, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_gender ) agg WHERE return_cnt >= 20 ORDER BY total_fee DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT agg.*, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY agg.total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_tax_percentage, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, AVG(cd.cd_purchase_estimate) AS avg_purchase_estimate, COUNT(*) AS total_returns, CASE WHEN cc.cc_tax_percentage > 20.0 THEN 'High Tax' WHEN cc.cc_tax_percentage BETWEEN 10.0 AND 20.0 THEN 'Medium Tax' ELSE 'Low Tax' END AS tax_category FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 0 GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_tax_percentage ) agg ) ranked WHERE loss_rank <= 10 ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC

WITH cs_ship AS (SELECT cs.cs_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode_sk, d.d_year AS year, SUM(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS total_ship_cost, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_ship_mode_sk, d.d_year), ws_ship AS (SELECT ws.ws_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode_sk, d.d_year AS year, SUM(ws.ws_ext_ship_cost) AS total_ship_cost, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY ws.ws_ship_mode_sk, d.d_year), combined_ship AS (SELECT ship_mode_sk, year, SUM(total_ship_cost) AS total_ship_cost, SUM(total_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM (SELECT * FROM cs_ship UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ws_ship) GROUP BY ship_mode_sk, year), efficiency AS (SELECT ship_mode_sk, year, total_ship_cost, total_quantity, CASE WHEN total_quantity = 0 THEN NULL ELSE total_ship_cost / total_quantity END AS cost_per_unit, AVG(CASE WHEN total_quantity = 0 THEN NULL ELSE total_ship_cost / total_quantity END) OVER (PARTITION BY year) AS avg_cost_per_unit_year, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY CASE WHEN total_quantity = 0 THEN NULL ELSE total_ship_cost / total_quantity END ASC) AS efficiency_rank, CASE WHEN total_quantity = 0 THEN 'NO_DATA' WHEN total_ship_cost / total_quantity > 5 THEN 'INEFFICIENT' ELSE 'EFFICIENT' END AS efficiency_flag FROM combined_ship) SELECT ship_mode_sk, year, total_ship_cost, total_quantity, cost_per_unit, avg_cost_per_unit_year, efficiency_rank, efficiency_flag, SUM(total_ship_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY ship_mode_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_ship_cost_year FROM efficiency ORDER BY year, efficiency_rank

SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, COALESCE(cs.year, ws.year) AS year, COALESCE(cs.total_cs_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(ws.total_ws_net_paid, 0) AS total_net_paid, COALESCE(cs.total_cs_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(ws.total_ws_net_profit, 0) AS total_net_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(cs.year, ws.year) ORDER BY COALESCE(cs.total_cs_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(ws.total_ws_net_paid, 0) DESC) AS revenue_rank, CASE WHEN COALESCE(cs.total_cs_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(ws.total_ws_net_profit, 0) > 0 THEN 'PROFITABLE' ELSE 'LOSS' END AS profit_status FROM (SELECT cs.cs_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, d.d_year AS year, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_cs_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_cs_net_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_warehouse_sk, d.d_year) cs FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT ws.ws_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, d.d_year AS year, SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_ws_net_paid, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_ws_net_profit FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY ws.ws_warehouse_sk, d.d_year) ws ON cs.warehouse_sk = ws.warehouse_sk AND cs.year = ws.year JOIN warehouse w ON COALESCE(cs.warehouse_sk, ws.warehouse_sk) = w.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY year, revenue_rank

WITH cs_sales AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, cs.cs_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit, cs.cs_net_paid AS net_paid, d.d_year FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk), ws_sales AS (SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, ws.ws_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, ws.ws_net_profit AS net_profit, ws.ws_net_paid AS net_paid, d.d_year FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk), sales AS (SELECT * FROM cs_sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ws_sales), cust_agg AS (SELECT customer_sk, SUM(net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(net_paid) AS total_net_paid FROM sales GROUP BY customer_sk), cust_state AS (SELECT s.customer_sk, w.w_state, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM sales s JOIN warehouse w ON s.warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk GROUP BY s.customer_sk, w.w_state), cust_top_state AS (SELECT customer_sk, w_state, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_sk ORDER BY order_cnt DESC) AS rn FROM cust_state), ranked AS (SELECT ca.customer_sk, ca.total_net_profit, ca.total_net_paid, ca.total_net_profit / NULLIF(ca.total_net_paid, 0) AS profit_ratio, CASE WHEN ca.total_net_profit / NULLIF(ca.total_net_paid, 0) >= 0.2 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN ca.total_net_profit / NULLIF(ca.total_net_paid, 0) >= 0.1 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS profit_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank, ts.w_state AS top_ship_state FROM cust_agg ca JOIN cust_top_state ts ON ca.customer_sk = ts.customer_sk AND ts.rn = 1) SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE profit_rank <= 10 ORDER BY profit_rank

WITH sales AS (SELECT w.w_state AS state, d.d_year, d.d_moy AS month, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS net_paid FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk GROUP BY w.w_state, d.d_year, d.d_moy UNION ALL SELECT w.w_state AS state, d.d_year, d.d_moy AS month, SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS net_paid FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk GROUP BY w.w_state, d.d_year, d.d_moy), monthly AS (SELECT state, d_year, month, SUM(net_paid) AS total_net_paid FROM sales GROUP BY state, d_year, month) SELECT state, d_year, month, total_net_paid, LAG(total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY d_year, month) AS prev_month_net_paid, CASE WHEN LAG(total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY d_year, month) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (total_net_paid - LAG(total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY d_year, month)) / LAG(total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY d_year, month) END AS mom_growth, AVG(total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY d_year, month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS three_month_moving_avg FROM monthly ORDER BY state, d_year, month

WITH returns_sum AS ( SELECT c.c_current_cdemo_sk, c.c_current_hdemo_sk, d.d_quarter_name, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS cash_sum FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY c.c_current_cdemo_sk, c.c_current_hdemo_sk, d.d_quarter_name ), store_stats AS ( SELECT d.d_quarter_name, AVG(s.s_number_employees) AS avg_employees FROM store s JOIN date_dim d ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_quarter_name ) SELECT rs.c_current_cdemo_sk AS cdemo_sk, rs.c_current_hdemo_sk AS hdemo_sk, rs.d_quarter_name, rs.return_cnt, rs.cash_sum, ss.avg_employees, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY rs.cash_sum DESC) AS cash_quartile FROM returns_sum rs LEFT JOIN store_stats ss ON rs.d_quarter_name = ss.d_quarter_name WHERE rs.return_cnt >= 5 ORDER BY rs.cash_sum DESC

WITH quarterly_returns AS ( SELECT c.c_current_cdemo_sk, c.c_current_hdemo_sk, d.d_quarter_name, SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS total_cash, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_loss, MAX(cr.cr_fee) AS max_fee FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY c.c_current_cdemo_sk, c.c_current_hdemo_sk, d.d_quarter_name ), store_closure_counts AS ( SELECT d.d_quarter_name, COUNT(s.s_store_sk) AS closed_cnt FROM store s JOIN date_dim d ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE s.s_market_desc LIKE '%Online%' GROUP BY d.d_quarter_name ) SELECT q.c_current_cdemo_sk AS cdemo_sk, q.c_current_hdemo_sk AS hdemo_sk, q.d_quarter_name, q.total_cash, q.total_loss, q.max_fee, closed_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY q.d_quarter_name ORDER BY q.max_fee DESC) AS fee_rank FROM quarterly_returns q LEFT JOIN store_closure_counts sc ON q.d_quarter_name = sc.d_quarter_name ORDER BY q.d_quarter_name, fee_rank

WITH aggregated AS ( SELECT c.c_current_cdemo_sk AS cdemo_sk, c.c_current_hdemo_sk AS hdemo_sk, d.d_quarter_name, SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_fee) AS total_fee FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE cr.cr_return_quantity > 1 GROUP BY c.c_current_cdemo_sk, c.c_current_hdemo_sk, d.d_quarter_name ), closings AS ( SELECT d.d_quarter_name, COUNT(*) AS stores_closed FROM store s JOIN date_dim d ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE s.s_rec_end_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.d_quarter_name ) SELECT a.cdemo_sk, a.hdemo_sk, a.d_quarter_name, a.total_refunded_cash, a.total_net_loss, a.total_fee, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.d_quarter_name ORDER BY a.total_fee DESC) AS fee_rank, SUM(a.total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY a.d_quarter_name) AS net_loss_sum_quarter, COALESCE(c.stores_closed, 0) AS stores_closed_in_quarter FROM aggregated a LEFT JOIN closings c ON a.d_quarter_name = c.d_quarter_name ORDER BY a.d_quarter_name, fee_rank

WITH agg_returns AS ( SELECT c.c_current_cdemo_sk AS cdemo_sk, c.c_current_hdemo_sk AS hdemo_sk, d.d_quarter_name, SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) / SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) END AS loss_to_refund_ratio FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 GROUP BY c.c_current_cdemo_sk, c.c_current_hdemo_sk, d.d_quarter_name HAVING SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) > 1000 ), store_closings AS ( SELECT d.d_quarter_name, COUNT(s.s_store_sk) AS stores_closed_in_quarter FROM store s JOIN date_dim d ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE s.s_state = 'CA' GROUP BY d.d_quarter_name ) SELECT ar.cdemo_sk, ar.hdemo_sk, ar.d_quarter_name, ar.total_refunded_cash, ar.total_net_loss, ar.loss_to_refund_ratio, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ar.d_quarter_name ORDER BY ar.loss_to_refund_ratio DESC) AS loss_ratio_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ar.total_net_loss ASC) AS loss_percentile_asc, COALESCE(sc.stores_closed_in_quarter, 0) AS stores_closed_in_quarter FROM agg_returns ar LEFT JOIN store_closings sc ON ar.d_quarter_name = sc.d_quarter_name ORDER BY ar.total_net_loss ASC

WITH sales_agg AS (SELECT sm.sm_carrier, cd.cd_gender, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, AVG(cs.cs_net_profit) AS avg_profit, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2453650 GROUP BY sm.sm_carrier, cd.cd_gender), returns_agg AS (SELECT sm.sm_carrier, cd.cd_gender, COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_ticket_number) AS distinct_returns FROM store_returns sr JOIN catalog_sales cs ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk AND sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY sm.sm_carrier, cd.cd_gender) SELECT s.sm_carrier, s.cd_gender, s.total_sales, s.avg_profit, s.total_quantity, COALESCE(r.distinct_returns,0) AS distinct_returns, CASE WHEN s.total_quantity = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(r.distinct_returns,0) * 1.0 / s.total_quantity END AS return_rate_per_quantity, s.avg_profit / NULLIF(s.total_sales,0) AS profit_per_sale, SUM(s.total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY s.sm_carrier ORDER BY s.cd_gender ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS rev_cumulative_by_carrier, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM sales_agg s LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON s.sm_carrier = r.sm_carrier AND s.cd_gender = r.cd_gender WHERE s.total_sales > 10000 ORDER BY s.total_sales DESC, s.sm_carrier

WITH sales_agg AS (SELECT sm.sm_carrier, cd.cd_gender, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_item_sk) AS distinct_items FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY sm.sm_carrier, cd.cd_gender), returns_agg AS (SELECT sm.sm_carrier, cd.cd_gender, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_item_sk) AS distinct_return_items FROM store_returns sr JOIN catalog_sales cs ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk AND sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY sm.sm_carrier, cd.cd_gender) SELECT s.sm_carrier, s.cd_gender, s.total_sales, s.total_profit, s.total_quantity, s.distinct_items, COALESCE(r.total_return_quantity,0) AS total_return_quantity, r.distinct_return_items, CASE WHEN s.distinct_items = 0 THEN 0 ELSE r.distinct_return_items * 1.0 / s.distinct_items END AS return_item_ratio, s.total_profit / NULLIF(s.total_sales,0) AS profit_margin, SUM(s.total_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY s.sm_carrier ORDER BY s.cd_gender ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_quantity_by_carrier, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_profit DESC) AS overall_profit_rank FROM sales_agg s LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON s.sm_carrier = r.sm_carrier AND s.cd_gender = r.cd_gender WHERE s.total_quantity > 0 ORDER BY s.sm_carrier, s.cd_gender

WITH demo_aggregates AS ( SELECT cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, hd.hd_buy_potential, AVG(cs.cs_net_paid) AS avg_net_paid, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, hd.hd_buy_potential ) SELECT da.hd_demo_sk, da.ib_lower_bound, da.ib_upper_bound, da.hd_buy_potential, da.avg_net_paid, da.avg_discount, CASE WHEN da.avg_discount >= 100 THEN 'High Discount' WHEN da.avg_discount >= 50 THEN 'Medium Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category, SUM(da.total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY da.hd_demo_sk ORDER BY da.avg_discount DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_total_net_paid_by_discount, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY da.avg_discount DESC) AS discount_rank FROM demo_aggregates da ORDER BY discount_rank LIMIT 20
