WITH sales_with_lag AS ( SELECT cs.cs_order_number, cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential, ib.ib_income_band_sk, t.t_time AS sale_time, cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax, cs.cs_net_profit, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk ORDER BY t.t_time ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_net_paid_by_customer, LAG(cs.cs_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk ORDER BY t.t_time) AS prev_net_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk WHERE cs.cs_bill_customer_sk IS NOT NULL ) SELECT cs_order_number, cs_bill_customer_sk, hd_buy_potential, ib_income_band_sk, sale_time, cs_net_paid_inc_tax, cs_net_profit, cumulative_net_paid_by_customer, prev_net_profit, CASE WHEN cs_net_profit > prev_net_profit THEN 'Improved' ELSE 'Not Improved' END AS profit_trend FROM sales_with_lag ORDER BY cs_bill_customer_sk, sale_time LIMIT 200

WITH meal_coupon AS ( SELECT t.t_meal_time, hd.hd_vehicle_count, ib.ib_income_band_sk, SUM(cs.cs_coupon_amt) AS total_coupon, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY t.t_meal_time, hd.hd_vehicle_count, ib.ib_income_band_sk ) SELECT t_meal_time, hd_vehicle_count, ib_income_band_sk, total_coupon, total_net_paid, CASE WHEN total_net_paid > 0 THEN total_coupon / total_net_paid ELSE NULL END AS coupon_to_net_paid_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_coupon DESC) AS coupon_rank, SUM(total_coupon) OVER (ORDER BY total_coupon DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_coupon_amount FROM meal_coupon WHERE total_coupon > 0 ORDER BY coupon_rank LIMIT 5

WITH hourly_income AS ( SELECT t.t_hour, ib.ib_income_band_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY t.t_hour, ib.ib_income_band_sk ) SELECT t_hour, ib_income_band_sk, total_net_paid, total_net_profit, CASE WHEN total_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS net_paid_rank FROM hourly_income ORDER BY net_paid_rank LIMIT 10

WITH cust AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        ca.ca_city,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        hd.hd_dep_count,
        CASE
            WHEN hd.hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'Low'
            WHEN hd.hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'High'
        END AS income_band_category,
        (year(current_date) - c.c_birth_year) AS age,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY hd.hd_vehicle_count DESC, (year(current_date) - c.c_birth_year)) AS vehicle_rank,
        SUM(hd.hd_vehicle_count) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.ca_city) AS city_total_vehicles
    FROM customer c
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
)
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    c_first_name,
    c_last_name,
    ca_city,
    hd_vehicle_count,
    hd_dep_count,
    income_band_category,
    age,
    vehicle_rank,
    city_total_vehicles
FROM cust
WHERE vehicle_rank <= 10
ORDER BY vehicle_rank

WITH cust_risk AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        ca.ca_country,
        d_last.d_date AS last_review_date,
        d_sales.d_date AS first_sales_date,
        date_diff('day', d_last.d_date, current_date) AS days_since_last_review,
        date_diff('day', d_sales.d_date, current_date) AS days_since_first_sales,
        CASE
            WHEN date_diff('day', d_last.d_date, current_date) > 1825 THEN 'High'
            WHEN date_diff('day', d_last.d_date, current_date) BETWEEN 730 AND 1825 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS churn_risk,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.ca_country ORDER BY date_diff('day', d_last.d_date, current_date) DESC) AS country_review_rank
    FROM customer c
    JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_last ON c.c_last_review_date = d_last.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_sales ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    WHERE hd.hd_buy_potential = 'High'
      AND date_diff('day', d_sales.d_date, current_date) > 1825
)
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    c_first_name,
    c_last_name,
    ca_country,
    days_since_last_review,
    days_since_first_sales,
    churn_risk,
    country_review_rank
FROM cust_risk
ORDER BY ca_country, country_review_rank

WITH cust_details AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        ca.ca_city,
        d_sales.d_year AS sales_year,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        hd.hd_dep_count,
        CASE
            WHEN date_diff('day', d_last.d_date, current_date) > 730 THEN 'Stale'
            ELSE 'Active'
        END AS review_status
    FROM customer c
    JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_sales ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d_last ON c.c_last_review_date = d_last.d_date_sk
),
city_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ca_city AS city,
        sales_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c_customer_id) AS total_customers,
        AVG(hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicles,
        AVG(hd_dep_count) AS avg_dep,
        SUM(CASE WHEN review_status = 'Stale' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stale_customers,
        SUM(CASE WHEN review_status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_customers
    FROM cust_details
    GROUP BY ca_city, sales_year
)
SELECT
    city,
    sales_year,
    total_customers,
    avg_vehicles,
    avg_dep,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_vehicles DESC) AS city_vehicle_rank,
    stale_customers,
    active_customers
FROM city_agg
ORDER BY city_vehicle_rank, city

SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS returning_customer_id,
        sm.sm_type,
        sm.sm_carrier,
        hd_ret.hd_buy_potential AS returning_buy_potential,
        hd_ref.hd_buy_potential AS refunded_buy_potential,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity,
        CASE
            WHEN hd_ret.hd_buy_potential = hd_ref.hd_buy_potential THEN 'Same Potential'
            ELSE 'Different Potential'
        END AS potential_match,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) DESC) AS rn
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ret
        ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_ret.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ref
        ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_ref.hd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk,
        sm.sm_type,
        sm.sm_carrier,
        hd_ret.hd_buy_potential,
        hd_ref.hd_buy_potential
) ranked
WHERE ranked.rn <= 10
ORDER BY ranked.total_return_quantity DESC

SELECT
    sm.sm_type,
    td.t_hour,
    hd_ret.hd_buy_potential AS returning_buy_potential,
    hd_ref.hd_buy_potential AS refunded_buy_potential,
    SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE CAST(SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS double) / SUM(cr.cr_return_amount)
    END AS refund_ratio,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY CASE
            WHEN SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE CAST(SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS double) / SUM(cr.cr_return_amount)
        END DESC
    ) AS ratio_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN hd_ret.hd_dep_count >= 3 THEN 'Large Household'
        ELSE 'Small Household'
    END AS returning_household_category,
    CASE
        WHEN hd_ref.hd_dep_count >= 3 THEN 'Large Refunded Household'
        ELSE 'Small Refunded Household'
    END AS refunded_household_category
FROM catalog_returns cr
JOIN ship_mode sm
    ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN time_dim td
    ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_ret
    ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_ret.hd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_ref
    ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_ref.hd_demo_sk
GROUP BY
    sm.sm_type,
    td.t_hour,
    hd_ret.hd_buy_potential,
    hd_ref.hd_buy_potential,
    hd_ret.hd_dep_count,
    hd_ref.hd_dep_count
HAVING SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) > 0
ORDER BY ratio_rank
LIMIT 10

SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        sm.sm_type,
        sm.sm_carrier,
        td.t_hour,
        hd_ret.hd_buy_potential,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 20000 THEN 'Very High'
            WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 10000 THEN 'High'
            ELSE 'Moderate'
        END AS loss_category,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) DESC) AS loss_rank
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN ship_mode sm
        ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN time_dim td
        ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd_ret
        ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_ret.hd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY
        sm.sm_type,
        sm.sm_carrier,
        td.t_hour,
        hd_ret.hd_buy_potential
) t
WHERE t.loss_rank <= 5
ORDER BY t.loss_rank

WITH ship_stats AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) AS total_revenue,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS total_ship_cost
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2022
    GROUP BY cs.cs_warehouse_sk, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq
)
SELECT
    cs_warehouse_sk,
    d_year,
    d_month_seq,
    total_quantity,
    total_revenue,
    total_ship_cost,
    CASE WHEN total_revenue = 0 THEN 0 ELSE total_quantity / total_revenue END AS quantity_per_dollar,
    CASE
        WHEN total_quantity / total_revenue < 0.01 THEN 'Very Low'
        WHEN total_quantity / total_revenue < 0.03 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN total_quantity / total_revenue < 0.06 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS efficiency_category,
    warehouse_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        cs_warehouse_sk,
        d_year,
        d_month_seq,
        total_quantity,
        total_revenue,
        total_ship_cost,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, d_month_seq ORDER BY total_quantity DESC) AS warehouse_rank
    FROM ship_stats
) ranked
WHERE warehouse_rank <= 5
ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq, warehouse_rank

WITH returns_detail AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date,
        d.d_holiday,
        wr.wr_reason_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS loss_by_reason,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS qty_by_reason,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt_by_reason
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_date, d.d_holiday, wr.wr_reason_sk
),
ranked_reason AS (
    SELECT
        d_date,
        CASE WHEN d_holiday = 'Y' THEN 'Holiday' ELSE 'Non-Holiday' END AS holiday_flag,
        wr_reason_sk,
        loss_by_reason,
        qty_by_reason,
        cnt_by_reason,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN d_holiday = 'Y' THEN 'Holiday' ELSE 'Non-Holiday' END ORDER BY loss_by_reason DESC) AS reason_rank
    FROM returns_detail
)
SELECT
    holiday_flag,
    d_date,
    wr_reason_sk,
    loss_by_reason,
    qty_by_reason,
    cnt_by_reason,
    reason_rank
FROM ranked_reason
WHERE reason_rank <= 3
ORDER BY holiday_flag, reason_rank

WITH page_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_number,
        cp.cp_department,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2022
    GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_department
)
SELECT
    cp_catalog_page_id,
    cp_catalog_page_number,
    cp_department,
    total_net_paid,
    total_net_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN total_net_paid = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE total_net_profit / total_net_paid
    END AS profit_margin,
    CASE
        WHEN total_net_paid = 0 THEN 'No Sales'
        WHEN total_net_profit / total_net_paid < 0.1 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN total_net_profit / total_net_paid < 0.3 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS margin_category,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS revenue_rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN total_net_paid = 0 THEN 0 ELSE total_net_profit / total_net_paid END DESC) AS margin_rank
FROM page_sales
ORDER BY revenue_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH page_period AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_number,
        cp.cp_department,
        sd.d_date AS start_date,
        ed.d_date AS end_date,
        date_diff('day', sd.d_date, ed.d_date) + 1 AS active_days
    FROM catalog_page cp
    JOIN date_dim sd ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = sd.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim ed ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = ed.d_date_sk
),
sales_daily AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_catalog_page_sk,
        d.d_date,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS daily_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS daily_discount_amt,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS daily_quantity
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY cs.cs_catalog_page_sk, d.d_date
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        pp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
        pp.cp_catalog_page_id,
        pp.cp_catalog_page_number,
        pp.cp_department,
        pp.start_date,
        pp.end_date,
        pp.active_days,
        SUM(sd.daily_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(sd.daily_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
        SUM(sd.daily_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM page_period pp
    JOIN sales_daily sd ON sd.cs_catalog_page_sk = pp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE sd.d_date BETWEEN pp.start_date AND pp.end_date
    GROUP BY pp.cp_catalog_page_sk, pp.cp_catalog_page_id, pp.cp_catalog_page_number, pp.cp_department, pp.start_date, pp.end_date, pp.active_days
),
page_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        pp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty
    FROM page_period pp
    JOIN web_returns wr ON TRUE
    JOIN date_dim rd ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = rd.d_date_sk
    WHERE rd.d_date BETWEEN pp.start_date AND pp.end_date
    GROUP BY pp.cp_catalog_page_sk
),
final_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        sa.cp_catalog_page_id,
        sa.cp_catalog_page_number,
        sa.cp_department,
        sa.start_date,
        sa.end_date,
        sa.active_days,
        sa.total_net_paid,
        sa.total_discount,
        CASE
            WHEN sa.total_discount / NULLIF(sa.total_net_paid, 0) > 0.2 THEN 'High Discount'
            ELSE 'Normal Discount'
        END AS discount_flag,
        COALESCE(pr.total_return_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss,
        COALESCE(pr.total_return_qty, 0) AS total_return_qty,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sa.cp_department ORDER BY sa.total_net_paid / NULLIF(sa.active_days, 0) DESC) AS revenue_per_day_rank
    FROM sales_agg sa
    LEFT JOIN page_returns_agg pr ON sa.cp_catalog_page_sk = pr.cp_catalog_page_sk
)
SELECT
    cp_catalog_page_id,
    cp_catalog_page_number,
    cp_department,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    active_days,
    total_net_paid,
    total_discount,
    discount_flag,
    total_return_loss,
    total_return_qty,
    revenue_per_day_rank
FROM final_metrics
ORDER BY revenue_per_day_rank
LIMIT 20

WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
        cp.cp_type,
        cc.cc_division_name,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_current_month,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS monthly_net_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON d.d_date_sk BETWEEN cp.cp_start_date_sk AND cp.cp_end_date_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON d.d_date_sk BETWEEN cc.cc_open_date_sk AND cc.cc_closed_date_sk
    GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_type, cc.cc_division_name, d.d_year, d.d_current_month
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) > 0
),
monthly_with_lag AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(monthly_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_catalog_page_id ORDER BY d_year, d_current_month) AS prev_month_net_paid
    FROM monthly_sales
)
SELECT
    cp_catalog_page_id,
    cp_type,
    cc_division_name,
    d_year,
    d_current_month,
    monthly_net_paid,
    total_discount,
    prev_month_net_paid,
    CASE 
        WHEN prev_month_net_paid IS NULL OR prev_month_net_paid = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ((monthly_net_paid - prev_month_net_paid) / prev_month_net_paid) * 100
    END AS mom_growth_pct,
    CASE WHEN total_discount > 1000 THEN 'High Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, d_current_month ORDER BY monthly_net_paid DESC) AS monthly_sales_rank
FROM monthly_with_lag
ORDER BY d_year, d_current_month, monthly_sales_rank
LIMIT 200

WITH item_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_quarter_seq,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON d.d_date_sk BETWEEN cc.cc_open_date_sk AND cc.cc_closed_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON d.d_date_sk BETWEEN cp.cp_start_date_sk AND cp.cp_end_date_sk
    WHERE cp.cp_type = 'Promotion'
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq
),
ranked_items AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, d_quarter_seq ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS quarterly_rank
    FROM item_quarter_sales
),
avg_discount_per_item AS (
    SELECT
        ss_item_sk,
        AVG(total_discount / NULLIF(sales_cnt, 0)) AS avg_discount_per_sale
    FROM item_quarter_sales
    GROUP BY ss_item_sk
)
SELECT
    ri.ss_item_sk,
    ri.d_year,
    ri.d_quarter_seq,
    ri.total_net_paid,
    ri.total_discount,
    ri.sales_cnt,
    CASE 
        WHEN ad.avg_discount_per_sale IS NULL THEN 'No Discount Data'
        WHEN (ri.total_discount / NULLIF(ri.sales_cnt, 0)) > ad.avg_discount_per_sale THEN 'Above Avg Discount'
        ELSE 'Below Avg Discount'
    END AS discount_flag,
    ad.avg_discount_per_sale,
    ri.quarterly_rank
FROM ranked_items ri
JOIN avg_discount_per_item ad ON ri.ss_item_sk = ad.ss_item_sk
WHERE ri.quarterly_rank <= 5
ORDER BY ri.d_year, ri.d_quarter_seq, ri.quarterly_rank

WITH sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        d_open.d_year AS cc_open_year,
        cc.cc_division,
        cc.cc_division_name,
        AVG(cc.cc_employees) AS avg_employees,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ss.ss_net_profit > 0 THEN ss.ss_net_profit ELSE 0 END) AS total_positive_profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
    JOIN call_center cc ON d_sold.d_date_sk BETWEEN cc.cc_open_date_sk AND cc.cc_closed_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_open ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON d_sold.d_date_sk BETWEEN cp.cp_start_date_sk AND cp.cp_end_date_sk
    WHERE cp.cp_type = 'Promotion'
    GROUP BY d_open.d_year, cc.cc_division, cc.cc_division_name
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ss.ss_net_profit > 0 THEN ss.ss_net_profit ELSE 0 END) > 0
)
SELECT
    cc_open_year,
    cc_division,
    cc_division_name,
    avg_employees,
    total_positive_profit,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_open_year ORDER BY total_positive_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_by_year,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_employees DESC) AS employee_density_rank
FROM sales_agg
ORDER BY cc_open_year, profit_rank_by_year

WITH sales_agg AS (SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name AS call_center_name, ca.ca_state, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS sales_transactions FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, ca.ca_state), returns_agg AS (SELECT ca.ca_state, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_returns, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_transactions FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_state) SELECT s.call_center_name, s.ca_state, s.total_sales, s.total_profit, s.sales_transactions, COALESCE(r.total_returns,0) AS total_returns, COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0) AS total_return_loss, COALESCE(r.return_transactions,0) AS return_transactions, CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0) > 0.3 * s.total_profit THEN 'High Return Loss' WHEN s.total_sales > 50000 THEN 'High Sales Volume' ELSE 'Normal' END AS performance_category, ROUND(100.0 * s.total_sales / SUM(s.total_sales) OVER (), 2) AS sales_percentage_of_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.ca_state ORDER BY s.total_sales DESC) AS state_sales_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_profit DESC) AS profit_dense_rank FROM sales_agg s LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON s.ca_state = r.ca_state WHERE s.total_sales > 0 ORDER BY s.total_sales DESC LIMIT 30

WITH sales AS (SELECT cs.cs_call_center_sk, cs.cs_order_number, cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_net_paid, cs.cs_net_profit, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_tax_percentage, cc.cc_employees, ca_bill.ca_state AS bill_state, ca_ship.ca_state AS ship_state FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk), returns AS (SELECT wr.wr_order_number, wr.wr_item_sk, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss FROM web_returns wr GROUP BY wr.wr_order_number, wr.wr_item_sk) SELECT s.cs_call_center_sk AS call_center_sk, s.cc_name AS call_center_name, CASE WHEN s.cc_tax_percentage > 20 THEN 'High Tax' WHEN s.cc_tax_percentage > 10 THEN 'Medium Tax' ELSE 'Low Tax' END AS tax_category, SUM(s.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(s.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COALESCE(SUM(r.total_return_loss),0) AS total_return_loss, SUM(s.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(r.total_return_loss),0) AS net_profit_after_returns, SUM(s.cs_net_paid) / NULLIF(s.cc_employees,0) AS avg_paid_per_employee, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(s.cs_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(r.total_return_loss),0)) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM sales s LEFT JOIN returns r ON s.cs_order_number = r.wr_order_number AND s.cs_item_sk = r.wr_item_sk GROUP BY s.cs_call_center_sk, s.cc_name, s.cc_tax_percentage, s.cc_employees ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 10

WITH sales_by_addr AS (SELECT ca.ca_address_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_zip, cc.cc_name AS call_center_name, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_address_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_zip, cc.cc_name), returns_by_addr AS (SELECT ca.ca_address_sk, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_address_sk) SELECT s.ca_city, s.ca_state, s.ca_zip, s.call_center_name, s.total_sales, s.total_profit, s.sales_cnt, COALESCE(r.total_return_amount,0) AS total_return_amount, COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0) AS total_return_loss, COALESCE(r.return_cnt,0) AS return_cnt, CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0) > 0.2 * s.total_profit THEN 'High Return Impact' ELSE 'Normal' END AS return_impact_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank, AVG(s.total_profit) OVER (ORDER BY s.total_sales ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS profit_moving_avg FROM sales_by_addr s LEFT JOIN returns_by_addr r ON s.ca_address_sk = r.ca_address_sk WHERE s.total_sales > 0 ORDER BY sales_rank LIMIT 20

WITH item_sales AS (SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name AS call_center_name, cc.cc_tax_percentage, ca.ca_state AS address_state, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS item_sales, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS item_profit, COUNT(*) AS sale_transactions, MAX(cs.cs_sold_date_sk) AS latest_sold_date_sk FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_tax_percentage, ca.ca_state), item_returns AS (SELECT wr.wr_item_sk, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS item_return_amount, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS item_return_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_transactions FROM web_returns wr GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk) SELECT i.cs_item_sk AS item_sk, i.call_center_name, i.address_state, i.item_sales, i.item_profit, COALESCE(r.item_return_amount,0) AS total_return_amount, COALESCE(r.item_return_loss,0) AS total_return_loss, i.item_sales - COALESCE(r.item_return_amount,0) AS net_sales_after_returns, CASE WHEN i.item_profit - COALESCE(r.item_return_loss,0) > 1000 THEN 'Highly Profitable' WHEN i.item_profit - COALESCE(r.item_return_loss,0) < 0 THEN 'Loss Making' ELSE 'Moderately Profitable' END AS profitability_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (i.item_profit - COALESCE(r.item_return_loss,0)) DESC) AS profit_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.cs_item_sk ORDER BY i.latest_sold_date_sk DESC) AS recent_sale_seq FROM item_sales i LEFT JOIN item_returns r ON i.cs_item_sk = r.wr_item_sk WHERE i.item_sales > 0 ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 15

WITH item_agg AS ( SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_current_price, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, SUM(COALESCE(p.p_cost,0)) AS total_promo_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_id) AS distinct_page_cnt FROM item i JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wr_web_page_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_current_price ) SELECT i_item_id, i_product_name, i_category, i_current_price, total_return_amt, total_return_qty, total_promo_cost, distinct_page_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY total_return_qty ASC) AS cat_rank, AVG(total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category) AS cat_avg_return FROM item_agg WHERE i_category IN ('Sports','Books') ORDER BY i_category DESC, cat_rank

WITH item_agg AS ( SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_current_price, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, SUM(COALESCE(p.p_cost,0)) AS total_promo_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_id) AS distinct_page_cnt FROM item i JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wr_web_page_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_current_price ) SELECT i_item_id, i_product_name, i_category, i_current_price, total_return_amt, total_return_qty, total_promo_cost, distinct_page_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC) AS cat_rank, SUM(total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY i_current_price ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return FROM item_agg WHERE total_promo_cost > 0 ORDER BY i_category, cumulative_return DESC

SELECT s.s_store_id,
       s.s_store_name,
       s.s_city,
       s.s_state,
       COUNT(DISTINCT sw.ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets,
       SUM(sw.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
       SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt, 0)) AS total_returns_amount,
       SUM(sw.ss_ext_sales_price) - SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt, 0)) AS net_sales,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_state ORDER BY SUM(sw.ss_ext_sales_price) DESC) AS state_sales_rank
FROM store s
JOIN (SELECT ss.*, t.t_shift FROM store_sales ss JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk) sw
  ON sw.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
  ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  AND sr.sr_ticket_number = sw.ss_ticket_number
  AND sr.sr_item_sk = sw.ss_item_sk
WHERE sw.t_shift = 'Morning'
  AND s.s_state NOT IN ('CA', 'NY')
GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state
HAVING SUM(sw.ss_ext_sales_price) > 500000
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 25

SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_state, s.s_city, SUM(sw.ss_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit,
       COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) AS total_return_loss,
       SUM(sw.ss_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) AS net_margin,
       CASE WHEN SUM(sw.ss_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) >= 300000 THEN 'VERY HIGH'
            WHEN SUM(sw.ss_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) BETWEEN 150000 AND 299999.99 THEN 'HIGH'
            WHEN SUM(sw.ss_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) BETWEEN 50000 AND 149999.99 THEN 'MEDIUM'
            ELSE 'LOW' END AS profit_tier,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(sw.ss_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(sr.sr_net_loss), 0) DESC) AS profit_rank,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_state ORDER BY SUM(sw.ss_net_profit) DESC) AS state_store_rank
FROM store s
JOIN (SELECT ss.*, t.t_shift FROM store_sales ss JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk) sw
  ON sw.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
  ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  AND sr.sr_ticket_number = sw.ss_ticket_number
  AND sr.sr_item_sk = sw.ss_item_sk
WHERE sw.t_shift IN ('Evening', 'Night')
  AND s.s_country = 'United States'
GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_state, s.s_city
ORDER BY net_margin DESC
LIMIT 30

SELECT s.s_store_id,
       s.s_store_name,
       s.s_city,
       s.s_state,
       SUM(sw.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
       SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_loss,
       SUM(sw.ss_net_profit) - SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) AS net_margin,
       CASE WHEN SUM(sw.ss_net_profit) - SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) >= 250000 THEN 'A'
            WHEN SUM(sw.ss_net_profit) - SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) >= 150000 THEN 'B'
            WHEN SUM(sw.ss_net_profit) - SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) >= 50000 THEN 'C'
            ELSE 'D' END AS tier,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(sw.ss_net_profit) - SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0))) ASC) AS profit_rank_asc,
       SUM(sw.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold,
       SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) FILTER (WHERE sr.sr_return_quantity IS NOT NULL) AS total_return_quantity
FROM store s
JOIN (SELECT ss.*, t.t_shift FROM store_sales ss JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk) sw
  ON sw.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
  ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  AND sr.sr_ticket_number = sw.ss_ticket_number
  AND sr.sr_item_sk = sw.ss_item_sk
WHERE sw.t_shift = 'Midday' AND s.s_state = 'TX'
GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state
ORDER BY tier, net_margin DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH store_promo_agg AS (
    SELECT ss_promo_sk,
           SUM(ss_ext_discount_amt) AS store_total_discount,
           SUM(ss_net_profit) AS store_total_net_profit,
           COUNT(*) AS store_txn_cnt
    FROM store_sales
    GROUP BY ss_promo_sk
),
web_promo_agg AS (
    SELECT ws_promo_sk,
           SUM(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS web_total_discount,
           SUM(ws_net_profit) AS web_total_net_profit,
           COUNT(*) AS web_txn_cnt
    FROM web_sales
    GROUP BY ws_promo_sk
)
SELECT
    p.p_promo_id,
    p.p_promo_name,
    p.p_cost,
    CASE WHEN p.p_cost > 1000 THEN 'High Cost' ELSE 'Low Cost' END AS cost_category,
    COALESCE(spa.store_total_discount, 0) + COALESCE(wpa.web_total_discount, 0) AS total_discount,
    COALESCE(spa.store_total_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wpa.web_total_net_profit, 0) AS total_net_profit,
    CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS discount_status,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(spa.store_total_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wpa.web_total_net_profit, 0) DESC) AS profit_dense_rank,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(spa.store_total_discount, 0) + COALESCE(wpa.web_total_discount, 0) DESC) AS discount_rank
FROM promotion p
LEFT JOIN store_promo_agg spa ON p.p_promo_sk = spa.ss_promo_sk
LEFT JOIN web_promo_agg wpa ON p.p_promo_sk = wpa.ws_promo_sk
WHERE p.p_promo_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY profit_dense_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH daily_store AS (
    SELECT ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
           SUM(ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ss_customer_sk) AS store_customer_cnt
    FROM store_sales
    GROUP BY ss_sold_date_sk
),
 daily_web AS (
    SELECT ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
           SUM(ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ws_bill_customer_sk) AS web_customer_cnt
    FROM web_sales
    GROUP BY ws_sold_date_sk
),
 daily_combined AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(ds.date_sk, dw.date_sk) AS date_sk,
           COALESCE(ds.store_net_profit, 0) AS store_net_profit,
           COALESCE(dw.web_net_profit, 0) AS web_net_profit,
           COALESCE(ds.store_customer_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(dw.web_customer_cnt, 0) AS total_customer_cnt,
           COALESCE(ds.store_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(dw.web_net_profit, 0) AS total_net_profit
    FROM daily_store ds
    FULL OUTER JOIN daily_web dw ON ds.date_sk = dw.date_sk
)
SELECT
    date_sk,
    store_net_profit,
    web_net_profit,
    total_customer_cnt,
    total_net_profit,
    moving_avg_7d,
    CASE WHEN total_net_profit >= moving_avg_7d THEN 'Above Avg' ELSE 'Below Avg' END AS profit_vs_mavg,
    profit_rank,
    active_promo_cnt
FROM (
    SELECT
        dc.date_sk,
        dc.store_net_profit,
        dc.web_net_profit,
        dc.total_customer_cnt,
        dc.total_net_profit,
        AVG(dc.total_net_profit) OVER (ORDER BY dc.date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_7d,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY dc.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promotion p WHERE dc.date_sk BETWEEN p.p_start_date_sk AND p.p_end_date_sk) AS active_promo_cnt
    FROM daily_combined dc
) t
ORDER BY date_sk
LIMIT 200

WITH cust_sales AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk,
           c.c_customer_id,
           c.c_first_name,
           c.c_last_name,
           c.c_birth_country,
           SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit,
           SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS store_discount,
           SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS store_net_paid,
           COUNT(*) AS store_txn_cnt
    FROM customer c
    LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_birth_country
),
 cust_web AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk,
           SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
           SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS web_discount,
           SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS web_net_paid,
           COUNT(*) AS web_txn_cnt
    FROM customer c
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk
),
 promo_cost_store AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk AS c_customer_sk,
           SUM(p.p_cost) AS promo_cost_store
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk
),
 promo_cost_web AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS c_customer_sk,
           SUM(p.p_cost) AS promo_cost_web
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
),
 cust_promo_cost AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(s.c_customer_sk, w.c_customer_sk) AS c_customer_sk,
           COALESCE(s.promo_cost_store, 0) + COALESCE(w.promo_cost_web, 0) AS total_promo_cost
    FROM promo_cost_store s
    FULL OUTER JOIN promo_cost_web w ON s.c_customer_sk = w.c_customer_sk
),
 combined AS (
    SELECT
        cs.c_customer_id,
        cs.c_first_name,
        cs.c_last_name,
        cs.c_birth_country,
        cs.store_net_profit + cw.web_net_profit AS total_net_profit,
        cs.store_discount + cw.web_discount AS total_discount,
        cs.store_net_paid + cw.web_net_paid AS total_net_paid,
        cs.store_txn_cnt + cw.web_txn_cnt AS total_txn_cnt,
        cp.total_promo_cost,
        (cs.store_net_profit + cw.web_net_profit) - cp.total_promo_cost AS adjusted_profit,
        CASE WHEN (cs.store_discount + cw.web_discount) > 0 THEN 'Discounted' ELSE 'No Discount' END AS discount_flag,
        CASE WHEN (cs.store_discount + cw.web_discount) / NULLIF(cs.store_net_paid + cw.web_net_paid, 0) > 0.05 THEN 'Effective' ELSE 'Ineffective' END AS promo_effectiveness,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.c_birth_country ORDER BY (cs.store_net_profit + cw.web_net_profit) - cp.total_promo_cost DESC) AS country_rank
    FROM cust_sales cs
    JOIN cust_web cw ON cs.c_customer_sk = cw.c_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN cust_promo_cost cp ON cs.c_customer_sk = cp.c_customer_sk
)
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    c_first_name,
    c_last_name,
    c_birth_country,
    total_net_profit,
    total_discount,
    total_net_paid,
    total_promo_cost,
    adjusted_profit,
    discount_flag,
    promo_effectiveness,
    country_rank
FROM combined
WHERE country_rank <= 5
ORDER BY c_birth_country, country_rank

WITH store_agg AS (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk,
           SUM(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS store_net_paid,
           SUM(ss_ext_discount_amt) AS store_discount,
           COUNT(*) AS store_txn_cnt
    FROM store_sales
    GROUP BY ss_customer_sk
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk AS ws_customer_sk,
           SUM(ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS web_net_paid,
           SUM(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS web_discount,
           COUNT(*) AS web_txn_cnt
    FROM web_sales
    GROUP BY ws_bill_customer_sk
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    CASE WHEN c.c_birth_year >= 1990 THEN 'Young' ELSE 'Mature' END AS age_group,
    COALESCE(sa.store_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_paid, 0) AS total_net_paid,
    COALESCE(sa.store_discount, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_discount, 0) AS total_discount,
    (COALESCE(sa.store_discount, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_discount, 0)) /
        NULLIF(COALESCE(sa.store_txn_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_txn_cnt, 0), 0) AS avg_discount_per_txn,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_birth_month ORDER BY COALESCE(sa.store_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_paid, 0) DESC) AS month_sales_rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.c_birth_year) AS birth_year_dense_rank,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_sales ss2
            JOIN promotion p2 ON ss2.ss_promo_sk = p2.p_promo_sk
            WHERE ss2.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
              AND p2.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        )
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_sales ws2
            JOIN promotion p3 ON ws2.ws_promo_sk = p3.p_promo_sk
            WHERE ws2.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
              AND p3.p_discount_active = 'Y'
        )
        THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_promo
FROM customer c
LEFT JOIN store_agg sa ON c.c_customer_sk = sa.ss_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN web_agg wa ON c.c_customer_sk = wa.ws_customer_sk
ORDER BY c.c_birth_month, month_sales_rank
LIMIT 200

WITH all_sales_raw AS (SELECT cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, cs_net_paid AS net_paid, cs_net_profit AS net_profit, cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk, cs_bill_customer_sk AS cust_sk FROM catalog_sales UNION ALL SELECT ss_sold_date_sk, ss_net_paid, ss_net_profit, ss_promo_sk, ss_customer_sk FROM store_sales), sales_with_promo AS (SELECT a.*, p.p_channel_tv FROM all_sales_raw a JOIN promotion p ON a.promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk WHERE a.sold_date_sk BETWEEN p.p_start_date_sk AND p.p_end_date_sk), daily_agg AS (SELECT sold_date_sk, SUM(net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT promo_sk) AS distinct_promo_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_sk) AS distinct_customer_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT p_channel_tv) AS distinct_tv_channel_cnt FROM sales_with_promo GROUP BY sold_date_sk) SELECT sold_date_sk, total_net_paid, total_net_profit, distinct_promo_cnt, distinct_customer_cnt, distinct_tv_channel_cnt, ROUND(AVG(total_net_paid) OVER (ORDER BY sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS net_paid_7day_ma, ROUND(AVG(total_net_profit) OVER (ORDER BY sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS net_profit_7day_ma, LAG(total_net_paid) OVER (ORDER BY sold_date_sk) AS prev_day_net_paid, CASE WHEN LAG(total_net_paid) OVER (ORDER BY sold_date_sk) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (total_net_paid - LAG(total_net_paid) OVER (ORDER BY sold_date_sk)) / LAG(total_net_paid) OVER (ORDER BY sold_date_sk) * 100 END AS pct_change_vs_prev_day, CASE WHEN total_net_paid > 20000 THEN 'High' WHEN total_net_paid > 10000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS sales_level FROM daily_agg ORDER BY sold_date_sk DESC LIMIT 30

WITH catalog_promo AS (SELECT cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk, COUNT(*) AS catalog_txn_cnt, SUM(cs_net_profit) AS catalog_net_profit, SUM(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS catalog_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT cs_bill_customer_sk) AS catalog_customer_cnt FROM catalog_sales GROUP BY cs_promo_sk), store_promo AS (SELECT ss_promo_sk AS promo_sk, COUNT(*) AS store_txn_cnt, SUM(ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit, SUM(ss_ext_discount_amt) AS store_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT ss_customer_sk) AS store_customer_cnt FROM store_sales GROUP BY ss_promo_sk), promo_agg AS (SELECT COALESCE(cp.promo_sk, sp.promo_sk) AS promo_sk, COALESCE(cp.catalog_txn_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(sp.store_txn_cnt, 0) AS total_txn_cnt, COALESCE(cp.catalog_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(sp.store_net_profit, 0) AS total_net_profit, COALESCE(cp.catalog_discount, 0) + COALESCE(sp.store_discount, 0) AS total_discount, COALESCE(cp.catalog_customer_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(sp.store_customer_cnt, 0) AS total_customer_cnt FROM catalog_promo cp FULL OUTER JOIN store_promo sp ON cp.promo_sk = sp.promo_sk), promo_birth AS (SELECT promo_sk, AVG(c_birth_year) AS avg_birth_year FROM (SELECT cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk, c.c_birth_year FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk UNION ALL SELECT ss_promo_sk AS promo_sk, c.c_birth_year FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk) bc GROUP BY promo_sk) SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, pa.total_txn_cnt, pa.total_net_profit, pa.total_discount, CASE WHEN pa.total_txn_cnt = 0 THEN 0 ELSE pa.total_discount / pa.total_txn_cnt END AS avg_discount_per_txn, pa.total_customer_cnt, ROUND(pa.total_net_profit * 100.0 / SUM(pa.total_net_profit) OVER (), 2) AS profit_pct_of_total, pb.avg_birth_year, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pa.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank, CASE WHEN pa.total_net_profit > 50000 THEN 'High' WHEN pa.total_net_profit > 20000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category FROM promo_agg pa JOIN promotion p ON pa.promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk LEFT JOIN promo_birth pb ON pa.promo_sk = pb.promo_sk ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 20

WITH catalog_agg AS (SELECT cs_bill_customer_sk AS cust_sk, SUM(cs_net_paid) AS catalog_net_paid, SUM(cs_net_profit) AS catalog_net_profit, SUM(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS catalog_discount FROM catalog_sales GROUP BY cs_bill_customer_sk), store_agg AS (SELECT ss_customer_sk AS cust_sk, SUM(ss_net_paid) AS store_net_paid, SUM(ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit, SUM(ss_ext_discount_amt) AS store_discount FROM store_sales GROUP BY ss_customer_sk), customer_totals AS (SELECT COALESCE(ca.cust_sk, sa.cust_sk) AS cust_sk, COALESCE(ca.catalog_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(sa.store_net_paid, 0) AS total_net_paid, COALESCE(ca.catalog_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(sa.store_net_profit, 0) AS total_net_profit, COALESCE(ca.catalog_discount, 0) + COALESCE(sa.store_discount, 0) AS total_discount FROM catalog_agg ca FULL OUTER JOIN store_agg sa ON ca.cust_sk = sa.cust_sk), top_promo AS (SELECT cust_sk, promo_sk, cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cust_sk ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT cs_bill_customer_sk AS cust_sk, cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM catalog_sales GROUP BY cs_bill_customer_sk, cs_promo_sk UNION ALL SELECT ss_customer_sk AS cust_sk, ss_promo_sk AS promo_sk, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM store_sales GROUP BY ss_customer_sk, ss_promo_sk) AS promo_counts) SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ct.total_net_paid, ct.total_net_profit, ROUND(CASE WHEN ct.total_net_paid = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ct.total_discount / ct.total_net_paid END, 4) AS avg_discount_ratio, CASE WHEN ct.total_net_paid > 10000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN ct.total_net_paid > 5000 THEN 'Gold' ELSE 'Silver' END AS customer_tier, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ct.total_net_paid DESC) AS net_paid_rank, p.p_promo_name AS top_promo_name FROM customer_totals ct JOIN customer c ON ct.cust_sk = c.c_customer_sk LEFT JOIN top_promo tp ON tp.cust_sk = ct.cust_sk AND tp.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN promotion p ON tp.promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk ORDER BY net_paid_rank LIMIT 10

WITH all_sales AS (SELECT cs_bill_customer_sk AS cust_sk, cs_item_sk AS item_sk, cs_net_paid AS net_paid, cs_quantity AS quantity, cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk, cs_list_price AS list_price FROM catalog_sales UNION ALL SELECT ss_customer_sk, ss_item_sk, ss_net_paid, ss_quantity, ss_promo_sk, ss_list_price FROM store_sales), customer_item_agg AS (SELECT cust_sk, item_sk, SUM(net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(list_price) AS avg_list_price, COUNT(*) AS purchase_cnt FROM all_sales GROUP BY cust_sk, item_sk), customer_item_rank AS (SELECT cust_sk, item_sk, total_net_paid, total_quantity, avg_list_price, purchase_cnt, NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_sk ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS net_paid_quartile, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cust_sk ORDER BY total_quantity DESC) AS quantity_rank FROM customer_item_agg), customer_top_promo AS (SELECT cust_sk, promo_sk, COUNT(*) AS promo_use_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cust_sk ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS promo_rank FROM all_sales GROUP BY cust_sk, promo_sk) SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, cir.item_sk, cir.total_net_paid, cir.total_quantity, cir.net_paid_quartile, CASE WHEN cir.avg_list_price > (SELECT AVG(list_price) FROM all_sales a2 WHERE a2.cust_sk = cir.cust_sk) THEN 'Expensive' ELSE 'Standard' END AS price_category, p.p_promo_name AS top_promo_name, ct.promo_use_cnt FROM customer_item_rank cir JOIN customer c ON cir.cust_sk = c.c_customer_sk LEFT JOIN customer_top_promo ct ON ct.cust_sk = cir.cust_sk AND ct.promo_rank = 1 LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ct.promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk WHERE cir.net_paid_quartile = 1 ORDER BY c.c_customer_sk, cir.total_net_paid DESC LIMIT 50

WITH returns_by_hd AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk, COUNT(*) AS num_returns, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk ) SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_dep_count, hd.hd_vehicle_count, hd.hd_buy_potential, rbd.num_returns, rbd.total_net_loss, rbd.total_return_amount, CASE WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count >= 3 THEN 'HighVehicle' WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count = 2 THEN 'MediumVehicle' ELSE 'LowVehicle' END AS vehicle_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rbd.total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM household_demographics hd JOIN returns_by_hd rbd ON hd.hd_demo_sk = rbd.hd_demo_sk ORDER BY loss_rank LIMIT 20

WITH promo_sales AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_discount_active, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit, AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers FROM web_sales ws JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_discount_active ) SELECT psk.p_promo_id, psk.p_promo_name, psk.total_sales, psk.total_profit, psk.avg_discount, psk.distinct_customers, CASE WHEN psk.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS promo_status, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY psk.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM promo_sales psk ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 15

WITH daily_hd_losses AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returned_date_sk, cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS daily_net_loss FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_returned_date_sk, cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk ), ranked_losses AS ( SELECT d.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.cr_returned_date_sk ORDER BY d.daily_net_loss DESC) AS rn, LAG(d.daily_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY d.hd_demo_sk ORDER BY d.cr_returned_date_sk) AS prev_daily_net_loss FROM daily_hd_losses d ) SELECT rl.cr_returned_date_sk, rl.hd_demo_sk, rl.daily_net_loss, hd.hd_vehicle_count, hd.hd_dep_count, hd.hd_buy_potential, CASE WHEN rl.prev_daily_net_loss IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN rl.daily_net_loss > rl.prev_daily_net_loss THEN 'Increase' ELSE 'Decrease or Same' END AS loss_trend, rl.rn FROM ranked_losses rl JOIN household_demographics hd ON rl.hd_demo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk WHERE rl.rn <= 3 ORDER BY rl.cr_returned_date_sk, rl.rn

WITH returns_agg AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_net_loss FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk ), promo_agg AS ( SELECT ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk AS hd_demo_sk, SUM(p.p_cost) AS total_promo_cost FROM web_sales ws JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk ) SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential, hd.hd_vehicle_count, hd.hd_dep_count, COALESCE(r.return_cnt,0) AS return_cnt, COALESCE(r.total_return_amount,0) AS total_return_amount, COALESCE(r.total_return_net_loss,0) AS total_return_net_loss, COALESCE(s.sales_cnt,0) AS sales_cnt, COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit,0) AS total_sales_profit, COALESCE(p.total_promo_cost,0) AS total_promo_cost, CASE WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = 'High' THEN 3 WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS buy_potential_score, (COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit,0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_net_loss,0)) AS net_contribution, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit,0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_net_loss,0)) DESC) AS net_contribution_rank FROM household_demographics hd LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON hd.hd_demo_sk = r.hd_demo_sk LEFT JOIN sales_agg s ON hd.hd_demo_sk = s.hd_demo_sk LEFT JOIN promo_agg p ON hd.hd_demo_sk = p.hd_demo_sk ORDER BY net_contribution_rank LIMIT 25

WITH latest_quarter AS (SELECT MAX(d_quarter_seq) AS max_q FROM date_dim), sales_q AS (SELECT ca.ca_city AS city, i.i_item_id AS item_id, i.i_product_name AS product_name, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_revenue, CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 100000 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS revenue_category FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN latest_quarter lq ON dd.d_quarter_seq = lq.max_q GROUP BY ca.ca_city, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name) SELECT * FROM (SELECT city, item_id, product_name, total_revenue, revenue_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM sales_q) q WHERE revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY city, revenue_rank

WITH high_price_sales AS (SELECT ca.ca_address_id AS address_id, dd.d_year AS year, dd.d_week_seq AS week_seq, dd.d_weekend AS weekend_flag, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS weekly_sales, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS weekly_qty FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk WHERE i.i_current_price > 100 GROUP BY ca.ca_address_id, dd.d_year, dd.d_week_seq, dd.d_weekend), weekly_growth AS (SELECT address_id, year, week_seq, weekend_flag, weekly_sales, LAG(weekly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY address_id ORDER BY year, week_seq) AS prev_week_sales, CASE WHEN LAG(weekly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY address_id ORDER BY year, week_seq) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (weekly_sales - LAG(weekly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY address_id ORDER BY year, week_seq)) / NULLIF(LAG(weekly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY address_id ORDER BY year, week_seq), 0) END AS sales_growth_pct, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY address_id ORDER BY year DESC, week_seq DESC) AS recent_week_rank FROM high_price_sales) SELECT address_id, year, week_seq, weekend_flag, weekly_sales, prev_week_sales, sales_growth_pct, CASE WHEN sales_growth_pct > 0.10 THEN 'Strong Growth' WHEN sales_growth_pct > 0.00 THEN 'Growth' WHEN sales_growth_pct <= 0 THEN 'Decline' ELSE NULL END AS growth_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sales_growth_pct DESC) AS overall_growth_rank FROM weekly_growth WHERE recent_week_rank = 1 ORDER BY sales_growth_pct DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

WITH monthly_discount AS (SELECT ss.ss_store_sk AS store_sk, dd.d_year AS year, month(dd.d_date) AS month, i.i_class AS product_class, ca.ca_state AS state, SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS monthly_discount, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS monthly_sales FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, dd.d_year, month(dd.d_date), i.i_class, ca.ca_state) SELECT store_sk, year, month, product_class, state, monthly_discount, monthly_sales, CASE WHEN monthly_discount > 0.2 * monthly_sales THEN 'High' WHEN monthly_discount > 0.1 * monthly_sales THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS discount_category, SUM(monthly_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY store_sk ORDER BY year, month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_store_discount FROM monthly_discount ORDER BY store_sk, year, month, product_class, state

WITH yearly_metrics AS (SELECT ca.ca_state AS state, i.i_class AS product_class, dd.d_year AS year, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price), 0) AS profit_margin FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_state, i.i_class, dd.d_year), ranked_metrics AS (SELECT state, product_class, year, total_profit, total_sales, profit_margin, LAG(total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY state, product_class ORDER BY year) AS prev_year_profit, LAG(profit_margin) OVER (PARTITION BY state, product_class ORDER BY year) AS prev_year_margin, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_class ORDER BY profit_margin DESC) AS state_margin_rank, CASE WHEN profit_margin >= 0.30 THEN 'Excellent' WHEN profit_margin >= 0.20 THEN 'Good' ELSE 'Average' END AS margin_category FROM yearly_metrics) SELECT state, product_class, year, total_profit, total_sales, profit_margin, margin_category, state_margin_rank, (total_profit - prev_year_profit) / NULLIF(prev_year_profit, 0) AS profit_yoy_change, (profit_margin - prev_year_margin) / NULLIF(prev_year_margin, 0) AS margin_yoy_change FROM ranked_metrics WHERE year >= (SELECT MAX(d_year) - 1 FROM date_dim) ORDER BY product_class, state_margin_rank

WITH item_agg AS ( SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_current_price, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, SUM(COALESCE(p.p_cost,0)) AS total_promo_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_id) AS distinct_page_cnt FROM item i JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wr_web_page_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_current_price ) SELECT i_item_id, i_product_name, i_category, i_current_price, total_return_amt, total_return_qty, total_promo_cost, distinct_page_cnt, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC) AS cat_rank_amt, AVG(total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category) AS avg_return_amt, SUM(total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY i_current_price ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return FROM item_agg WHERE total_promo_cost > 0 GROUP BY i_item_id, i_product_name, i_category, i_current_price, total_return_amt, total_return_qty, total_promo_cost, distinct_page_cnt ORDER BY i_category, avg_return_amt DESC

WITH item_agg AS ( SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_current_price, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, SUM(COALESCE(p.p_cost,0)) AS total_promo_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_id) AS distinct_page_cnt FROM item i JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wr_web_page_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk WHERE i.i_category NOT IN ('Home', 'Electronics') GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_current_price ) SELECT i_item_id, i_product_name, i_category, i_current_price, total_return_amt, total_return_qty, total_promo_cost, distinct_page_cnt, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY distinct_page_cnt DESC) AS page_rank, SUM(total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY total_return_amt ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return_by_amt FROM item_agg WHERE total_promo_cost > 0 AND total_return_amt > 50 ORDER BY i_category, page_rank

WITH latest_year AS ( SELECT MAX(d_year) AS max_year FROM date_dim ), call_center_sales AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk AS cc_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT w.w_warehouse_id) AS distinct_warehouses, MIN(cs.cs_sold_time_sk) AS first_sale_time FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk CROSS JOIN latest_year ly WHERE d.d_year = ly.max_year AND cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax > 0 GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state ) SELECT cc_sk, cc_name, cc_city, cc_state, total_net_paid, total_discount, total_orders, distinct_warehouses, first_sale_time, NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS sales_tile FROM call_center_sales WHERE total_discount > 1000 ORDER BY sales_tile, total_net_paid DESC LIMIT 12

WITH latest_year AS ( SELECT MAX(d_year) AS max_year FROM date_dim ), call_center_sales AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk AS cc_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_price, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT w.w_warehouse_id) AS distinct_warehouses FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk CROSS JOIN latest_year ly WHERE d.d_year = ly.max_year AND cs.cs_quantity >= 2 GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state ) SELECT cc_sk, cc_name, cc_city, cc_state, total_sales_price, total_discount, distinct_orders, distinct_warehouses, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_state ORDER BY total_sales_price DESC) AS state_rank FROM call_center_sales WHERE total_sales_price > 20000 ORDER BY state_rank, total_sales_price DESC LIMIT 20

WITH latest_year AS ( SELECT MAX(d_year) AS max_year FROM date_dim ), call_center_sales AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk AS cc_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_net_paid_inc_tax, AVG(cs.cs_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT w.w_warehouse_id) AS distinct_warehouses FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk CROSS JOIN latest_year ly WHERE d.d_year = ly.max_year AND cs.cs_coupon_amt > 5 GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state ) SELECT cc_sk, cc_name, cc_city, cc_state, total_net_paid_inc_tax, avg_net_profit, total_orders, distinct_warehouses, NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_net_paid_inc_tax ASC) AS sales_quartile, CASE WHEN avg_net_profit >= 0 THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profitability FROM call_center_sales WHERE total_net_paid_inc_tax BETWEEN 5000 AND 20000 ORDER BY sales_quartile, total_net_paid_inc_tax DESC LIMIT 10

WITH store_shift_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        td.t_shift,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_ext_sales,
        AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN cd.cd_credit_rating = 'Excellent' THEN 1 END) AS excellent_credit_customers,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS preferred_customer_count
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, td.t_shift
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 0
)
SELECT
    ssa.ss_store_sk,
    ssa.t_shift,
    ssa.total_ext_sales,
    ssa.avg_discount,
    ssa.distinct_customers,
    ssa.excellent_credit_customers,
    ssa.preferred_customer_count,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ssa.t_shift ORDER BY ssa.total_ext_sales DESC) AS store_rank_in_shift,
    CASE
        WHEN ssa.avg_discount > 20 THEN 'High Discount'
        WHEN ssa.avg_discount BETWEEN 10 AND 20 THEN 'Medium Discount'
        ELSE 'Low Discount'
    END AS discount_category
FROM store_shift_agg ssa
ORDER BY ssa.t_shift, store_rank_in_shift

WITH demo_profit AS (
    SELECT
        cd.cd_marital_status,
        cd.cd_gender,
        cd.cd_credit_rating,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        AVG(ss.ss_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
        SUM(CASE WHEN td.t_shift = 'Morning' THEN ss.ss_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS morning_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' THEN c.c_customer_id END) AS preferred_customers
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_credit_rating
)
SELECT
    dp.cd_marital_status,
    dp.cd_gender,
    dp.cd_credit_rating,
    dp.total_net_profit,
    dp.avg_net_profit,
    dp.total_quantity,
    dp.distinct_customers,
    dp.morning_quantity,
    ROUND(dp.morning_quantity * 100.0 / dp.total_quantity, 2) AS morning_qty_pct,
    dp.preferred_customers,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY dp.total_net_profit) AS profit_percentile,
    CASE
        WHEN dp.cd_credit_rating IN ('Excellent', 'Good') THEN 'High Credit'
        WHEN dp.cd_credit_rating = 'Fair' THEN 'Medium Credit'
        ELSE 'Low Credit'
    END AS credit_category,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dp.cd_marital_status ORDER BY dp.total_quantity DESC) AS qty_rank_within_marital_status
FROM demo_profit dp
WHERE dp.total_quantity > 0
ORDER BY dp.total_net_profit DESC

WITH customer_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_birth_month,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        AVG(cd.cd_purchase_estimate) AS avg_purchase_estimate,
        SUM(CASE WHEN td.t_meal_time = 'Lunch' THEN ss.ss_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS lunch_qty,
        SUM(CASE WHEN td.t_meal_time = 'Dinner' THEN ss.ss_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS dinner_qty
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_birth_month
)

SELECT
    cs.c_customer_id,
    cs.c_first_name,
    cs.c_last_name,
    cs.c_birth_month,
    cs.total_net_profit,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.c_birth_month ORDER BY cs.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_in_month,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.avg_purchase_estimate DESC) AS purchase_estimate_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN cs.total_net_profit >= 5000 THEN 'Platinum'
        WHEN cs.total_net_profit >= 2000 THEN 'Gold'
        WHEN cs.total_net_profit >= 1000 THEN 'Silver'
        ELSE 'Bronze'
    END AS profit_tier,
    cs.lunch_qty,
    cs.dinner_qty
FROM customer_sales cs
WHERE cs.total_net_profit > 0
ORDER BY cs.c_birth_month, profit_rank_in_month

WITH sales_with_time AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        ss.ss_quantity,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        td.t_hour,
        td.t_minute,
        td.t_shift,
        cd.cd_credit_rating,
        ss.ss_customer_sk,
        (td.t_hour * 60 + td.t_minute) AS minutes_of_day
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
),
sales_with_lag AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(minutes_of_day) OVER (PARTITION BY c_customer_id ORDER BY ss_sold_date_sk, minutes_of_day) AS prev_minutes_of_day,
        LAG(ss_sold_date_sk) OVER (PARTITION BY c_customer_id ORDER BY ss_sold_date_sk, minutes_of_day) AS prev_sold_date_sk
    FROM sales_with_time
)
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    c_first_name,
    c_last_name,
    ss_ticket_number,
    ss_store_sk,
    ss_item_sk,
    ss_quantity,
    ss_net_profit,
    t_shift,
    cd_credit_rating,
    minutes_of_day,
    prev_minutes_of_day,
    (minutes_of_day - COALESCE(prev_minutes_of_day, minutes_of_day)) AS minutes_since_last_sale,
    CASE
        WHEN (minutes_of_day - COALESCE(prev_minutes_of_day, minutes_of_day)) <= 30 THEN 'Frequent Buyer'
        ELSE 'Infrequent Buyer'
    END AS buyer_frequency_flag,
    SUM(ss_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY c_customer_id ORDER BY ss_sold_date_sk, minutes_of_day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_profit,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c_customer_id ORDER BY ss_sold_date_sk DESC, minutes_of_day DESC) AS recent_sale_rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c_customer_id ORDER BY (minutes_of_day - COALESCE(prev_minutes_of_day, minutes_of_day))) AS interval_rank
FROM sales_with_lag
WHERE ss_quantity > 0
ORDER BY c_customer_id, ss_sold_date_sk, minutes_of_day

WITH promo_period AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, CASE WHEN p.p_channel_email = 'Y' THEN 'Email' WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV' WHEN p.p_channel_radio = 'Y' THEN 'Radio' ELSE 'Other' END AS primary_channel, CASE WHEN ss.ss_sold_date_sk < p.p_start_date_sk THEN 'pre' ELSE 'post' END AS period, COUNT(*) AS sales_count, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, AVG(ss.ss_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amt FROM store_sales ss JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk WHERE ss.ss_item_sk = p.p_item_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_channel_email, p.p_channel_tv, p.p_channel_radio, CASE WHEN ss.ss_sold_date_sk < p.p_start_date_sk THEN 'pre' ELSE 'post' END ) SELECT pp.p_promo_id, pp.p_promo_name, pp.primary_channel, pp.period, pp.sales_count, pp.total_sales, pp.avg_sales_price, pp.avg_discount_amt, LAG(pp.avg_sales_price) OVER (PARTITION BY pp.p_promo_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN pp.period = 'pre' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS prev_avg_price, CASE WHEN pp.period = 'post' AND LAG(pp.avg_sales_price) OVER (PARTITION BY pp.p_promo_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN pp.period = 'pre' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) IS NOT NULL THEN (pp.avg_sales_price - LAG(pp.avg_sales_price) OVER (PARTITION BY pp.p_promo_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN pp.period = 'pre' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)) / LAG(pp.avg_sales_price) OVER (PARTITION BY pp.p_promo_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN pp.period = 'pre' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) * 100 ELSE NULL END AS price_uplift_pct FROM promo_period pp ORDER BY pp.p_promo_id, pp.period

WITH store_item_sales AS ( SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_item_sk, CASE WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV' WHEN p.p_channel_email = 'Y' THEN 'Email' WHEN p.p_channel_radio = 'Y' THEN 'Radio' WHEN p.p_channel_dmail = 'Y' THEN 'DirectMail' ELSE 'Other' END AS promo_channel, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_city, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amt FROM store_sales ss LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk LEFT JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_item_sk, CASE WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV' WHEN p.p_channel_email = 'Y' THEN 'Email' WHEN p.p_channel_radio = 'Y' THEN 'Radio' WHEN p.p_channel_dmail = 'Y' THEN 'DirectMail' ELSE 'Other' END, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_city ), ranked_items AS ( SELECT sis.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sis.ss_store_sk ORDER BY sis.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM store_item_sales sis ) SELECT ri.ss_store_sk, ri.ss_item_sk, ri.promo_channel, ri.ca_state, ri.ca_city, ri.total_quantity, ri.total_sales, ri.avg_discount_amt, ri.sales_rank FROM ranked_items ri WHERE ri.sales_rank <= 3 ORDER BY ri.ss_store_sk, ri.sales_rank

WITH demo_state_sales AS ( SELECT c.c_current_cdemo_sk AS demo_sk, ca.ca_state, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(ss.ss_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y' GROUP BY c.c_current_cdemo_sk, ca.ca_state ) SELECT ds.demo_sk, ds.ca_state, ds.total_quantity, ds.avg_net_profit, ds.total_sales, CASE WHEN ds.total_quantity >= 1000 THEN 'High Volume' WHEN ds.total_quantity >= 500 THEN 'Medium Volume' ELSE 'Low Volume' END AS volume_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ds.demo_sk ORDER BY ds.total_quantity DESC) AS state_quantity_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ds.demo_sk ORDER BY ds.avg_net_profit DESC) AS profit_dense_rank FROM demo_state_sales ds ORDER BY ds.demo_sk, state_quantity_rank LIMIT 100

WITH customer_sales AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_state, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amt FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk AND p.p_discount_active = 'Y' GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_state ) SELECT cs.c_customer_id, cs.c_first_name, cs.c_last_name, cs.ca_state, cs.total_net_profit, cs.total_quantity, cs.avg_discount_amt, CASE WHEN cs.total_net_profit >= 100000 THEN 'High' WHEN cs.total_net_profit >= 50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN cs.total_net_profit >= 100000 THEN 'High' WHEN cs.total_net_profit >= 50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END ORDER BY cs.total_net_profit DESC) AS category_rank FROM customer_sales cs ORDER BY cs.total_net_profit DESC LIMIT 20

WITH quarterly_discount AS ( SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq, SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) / NULLIF(SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price), 0) AS discount_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' THEN c.c_customer_sk END) AS preferred_customer_cnt FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq ), ranked_quarterly AS ( SELECT qd.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY qd.d_year, qd.d_quarter_seq ORDER BY qd.discount_ratio DESC) AS discount_rank FROM quarterly_discount qd ) SELECT rq.d_year, rq.d_quarter_seq, rq.hd_demo_sk, rq.hd_buy_potential, ROUND(rq.discount_ratio * 100, 2) AS avg_discount_pct, rq.preferred_customer_cnt, rq.discount_rank, CASE WHEN rq.discount_rank <= 5 THEN 'Top5' ELSE 'Other' END AS top5_flag FROM ranked_quarterly rq WHERE rq.discount_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rq.d_year, rq.d_quarter_seq, rq.discount_rank

WITH sales_2021 AS ( SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk, ws.ws_net_profit, ws.ws_ext_sales_price, ws.ws_ext_discount_amt, ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk, d_sold.d_date AS sold_date, d_ship.d_date AS ship_date FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_ship ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk WHERE d_sold.d_year = 2021 ) SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_birth_country, hd.hd_income_band_sk, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, AVG(date_diff('day', ws.sold_date, ws.ship_date)) AS avg_shipping_days, CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 10000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 5000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 1000 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS profit_tier, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_birth_country ORDER BY SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank_in_country, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_birth_country ORDER BY CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 10000 THEN 4 WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 5000 THEN 3 WHEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 1000 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) AS tier_dense_rank FROM sales_2021 ws JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_birth_country, hd.hd_income_band_sk

WITH shipping_data AS ( SELECT c.c_birth_month, c.c_preferred_cust_flag, hd.hd_buy_potential, ws.ws_ext_discount_amt, ws.ws_ext_sales_price, d_sold.d_date AS sold_date, d_ship.d_date AS ship_date, date_diff('day', d_sold.d_date, d_ship.d_date) AS shipping_delay_days FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_ship_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_ship_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_ship ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk WHERE ws.ws_ext_sales_price > 0 ), agg_delays AS ( SELECT sd.c_birth_month, sd.c_preferred_cust_flag, sd.hd_buy_potential, AVG(sd.shipping_delay_days) AS avg_shipping_delay, AVG(sd.ws_ext_discount_amt / NULLIF(sd.ws_ext_sales_price, 0)) * 100 AS avg_discount_pct, CASE WHEN AVG(sd.shipping_delay_days) > 7 THEN 'Long Delay' WHEN AVG(sd.shipping_delay_days) BETWEEN 4 AND 7 THEN 'Medium Delay' ELSE 'Short Delay' END AS delay_category FROM shipping_data sd GROUP BY sd.c_birth_month, sd.c_preferred_cust_flag, sd.hd_buy_potential ), ranked_delays AS ( SELECT a.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.avg_shipping_delay DESC) AS delay_rank FROM agg_delays a ) SELECT rd.c_birth_month, rd.c_preferred_cust_flag, rd.hd_buy_potential, rd.avg_shipping_delay, rd.avg_discount_pct, rd.delay_category, rd.delay_rank FROM ranked_delays rd WHERE rd.delay_rank <= 3 ORDER BY rd.delay_rank

WITH catalog_agg AS (SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk, sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type, hd.hd_income_band_sk AS income_band, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS cat_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS cat_qty FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, sm.sm_type, hd.hd_income_band_sk), store_agg AS (SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk AS customer_sk, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_net_loss, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS store_qty FROM store_returns sr GROUP BY sr.sr_customer_sk) SELECT ca.customer_sk, ca.ship_mode_type, ca.income_band, ca.cat_net_loss, ca.cat_qty, COALESCE(sa.store_net_loss, 0) AS store_net_loss, COALESCE(sa.store_qty, 0) AS store_qty, CASE WHEN (ca.cat_net_loss + COALESCE(sa.store_net_loss, 0)) > 1500 THEN 'High' WHEN (ca.cat_net_loss + COALESCE(sa.store_net_loss, 0)) BETWEEN 500 AND 1500 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS total_loss_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.ship_mode_type ORDER BY (ca.cat_net_loss + COALESCE(sa.store_net_loss, 0)) DESC) AS loss_rank FROM catalog_agg ca LEFT JOIN store_agg sa ON ca.customer_sk = sa.customer_sk ORDER BY ca.ship_mode_type, loss_rank LIMIT 20

WITH base AS (SELECT sr.sr_store_sk, sr.sr_returned_date_sk, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_store_sk ORDER BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_store_loss, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_store_sk ORDER BY cr.cr_returned_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_catalog_loss, CASE WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_store_sk ORDER BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) > SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_store_sk ORDER BY cr.cr_returned_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) THEN 'Store Higher' ELSE 'Catalog Higher' END AS loss_comparison, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_store_sk) AS total_store_loss, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_store_sk) AS total_catalog_loss FROM store_returns sr JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk AND cr.cr_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk WHERE hd.hd_vehicle_count > 0 AND sm.sm_type IS NOT NULL) SELECT sr_store_sk, sr_returned_date_sk, cum_store_loss, cum_catalog_loss, loss_comparison, total_store_loss + total_catalog_loss AS total_loss, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_store_loss + total_catalog_loss DESC) AS overall_loss_rank FROM base ORDER BY sr_store_sk, sr_returned_date_sk LIMIT 200
