WITH cat_counts AS (SELECT cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk AS demo_sk, cr.cr_ship_mode_sk, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS cat_loss FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk, cr.cr_ship_mode_sk), cat_top AS (SELECT demo_sk, cat_loss, cnt, cr_ship_mode_sk FROM (SELECT demo_sk, cat_loss, cnt, cr_ship_mode_sk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY demo_sk ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS rn FROM cat_counts) t WHERE rn = 1), store_agg AS (SELECT sr.sr_hdemo_sk AS demo_sk, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_loss, COUNT(*) AS store_cnt FROM store_returns sr GROUP BY sr.sr_hdemo_sk) SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_income_band_sk, COALESCE(cat_top.cat_loss,0) + COALESCE(store_agg.store_loss,0) AS total_loss, CASE WHEN COALESCE(cat_top.cat_loss,0) > COALESCE(store_agg.store_loss,0) THEN 'Catalog Dominates' WHEN COALESCE(store_agg.store_loss,0) > COALESCE(cat_top.cat_loss,0) THEN 'Store Dominates' ELSE 'Equal' END AS dominant_source, sm.sm_type AS top_ship_mode, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(cat_top.cat_loss,0) + COALESCE(store_agg.store_loss,0)) DESC) AS loss_rank FROM household_demographics hd LEFT JOIN cat_top ON hd.hd_demo_sk = cat_top.demo_sk LEFT JOIN store_agg ON hd.hd_demo_sk = store_agg.demo_sk LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm ON cat_top.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk WHERE hd.hd_buy_potential IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_loss DESC LIMIT 15

WITH agg AS (SELECT sm.sm_type, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS catalog_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_ticket_number) AS store_tickets, AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_catalog_return_amt, AVG(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS avg_store_return_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN cr.cr_return_ship_cost > 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_ship_cost_returns FROM ship_mode sm JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk WHERE hd.hd_dep_count BETWEEN 1 AND 4 GROUP BY sm.sm_type HAVING COUNT(*) > 20) SELECT sm_type, catalog_orders, store_tickets, ROUND(avg_catalog_return_amt, 2) AS avg_catalog_return_amt, ROUND(avg_store_return_amt, 2) AS avg_store_return_amt, CASE WHEN avg_catalog_return_amt > avg_store_return_amt THEN 'Catalog Higher' ELSE 'Store Higher' END AS higher_source, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_catalog_return_amt DESC) AS catalog_return_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_store_return_amt DESC) AS store_return_rank, high_ship_cost_returns FROM agg ORDER BY catalog_return_rank LIMIT 10

WITH cust_sales AS ( SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_sales_paid, SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets, CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) > 5000 THEN 'HighValue' ELSE 'LowValue' END AS customer_segment FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state ), cust_returns AS ( SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, SUM(sr.sr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash FROM store_returns sr GROUP BY sr.sr_customer_sk ) SELECT cs.ss_customer_sk, cs.ca_city, cs.ca_state, cs.total_sales_paid, COALESCE(cr.total_return_loss,0) AS total_return_loss, (cs.total_sales_paid - COALESCE(cr.total_return_loss,0)) AS net_revenue, cs.total_discount, cs.customer_segment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.ca_city ORDER BY (cs.total_sales_paid - COALESCE(cr.total_return_loss,0)) DESC) AS city_rank, AVG(cs.total_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.customer_segment) AS avg_discount_by_segment FROM cust_sales cs LEFT JOIN cust_returns cr ON cs.ss_customer_sk = cr.sr_customer_sk WHERE cs.customer_segment = 'HighValue' ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 10

WITH daily_sales AS ( SELECT ca.ca_address_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, ss.ss_sold_date_sk, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS daily_sales_amount, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS daily_net_profit, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_address_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, ss.ss_sold_date_sk ), daily_returns AS ( SELECT ca.ca_address_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, sr.sr_returned_date_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS daily_return_amount, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS daily_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_address_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, sr.sr_returned_date_sk ) SELECT ds.ca_city, ds.ca_state, ds.ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, ds.daily_sales_amount, COALESCE(dr.daily_return_amount,0) AS daily_return_amount, (ds.daily_net_profit - COALESCE(dr.daily_net_loss,0)) AS net_profit, ds.avg_discount, SUM(ds.daily_net_profit - COALESCE(dr.daily_net_loss,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY ds.ca_city, ds.ca_state ORDER BY ds.ss_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_profit, LAG(ds.daily_net_profit - COALESCE(dr.daily_net_loss,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY ds.ca_city, ds.ca_state ORDER BY ds.ss_sold_date_sk) AS prev_day_net_profit, CASE WHEN (ds.daily_net_profit - COALESCE(dr.daily_net_loss,0)) > COALESCE(LAG(ds.daily_net_profit - COALESCE(dr.daily_net_loss,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY ds.ca_city, ds.ca_state ORDER BY ds.ss_sold_date_sk),0) THEN 'Up' WHEN (ds.daily_net_profit - COALESCE(dr.daily_net_loss,0)) < COALESCE(LAG(ds.daily_net_profit - COALESCE(dr.daily_net_loss,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY ds.ca_city, ds.ca_state ORDER BY ds.ss_sold_date_sk),0) THEN 'Down' ELSE 'Flat' END AS net_profit_trend, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ds.ss_sold_date_sk ORDER BY (ds.daily_sales_amount - COALESCE(dr.daily_return_amount,0)) DESC) AS sales_volume_rank FROM daily_sales ds LEFT JOIN daily_returns dr ON ds.ca_address_sk = dr.ca_address_sk AND ds.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.sr_returned_date_sk ORDER BY ds.ca_city, ds.ca_state, ds.ss_sold_date_sk

WITH promo_sales AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt FROM store_sales ss JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name ), promo_returns AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM store_returns sr JOIN store_sales ss ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk ) SELECT ps.p_promo_sk, ps.p_promo_name, ps.total_sales_amount, COALESCE(pr.total_return_amount,0) AS total_return_amount, CASE WHEN ps.total_sales_amount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (COALESCE(pr.total_return_amount,0) / ps.total_sales_amount) * 100 END AS return_rate_pct, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(pr.total_return_amount,0) / NULLIF(ps.total_sales_amount,0)) < 0.05 THEN 'Effective' ELSE 'Ineffective' END AS promo_effectiveness, ps.total_net_profit, AVG(ps.total_net_profit) OVER () AS avg_net_profit_all, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN ps.total_sales_amount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (COALESCE(pr.total_return_amount,0) / ps.total_sales_amount) END ASC) AS return_rate_rank FROM promo_sales ps LEFT JOIN promo_returns pr ON ps.p_promo_sk = pr.p_promo_sk ORDER BY return_rate_rank

SELECT t.customer_sk, t.c_customer_id, t.c_first_name, t.c_last_name, t.cd_gender, t.total_sales, t.total_discount, t.total_coupon, t.total_net_profit, t.total_return_loss, t.net_profit_after_returns, t.adjusted_profit, t.gender_rank, t.running_total_adj_profit_gender FROM ( SELECT ca.customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, cd.cd_gender, ca.total_sales, ca.total_discount, ca.total_coupon, ca.total_net_profit, ca.total_return_loss, ca.total_net_profit - ca.total_return_loss AS net_profit_after_returns, CASE WHEN (ca.total_discount / NULLIF(ca.total_sales,0)) > 0.2 THEN (ca.total_net_profit - ca.total_return_loss) * 0.9 ELSE (ca.total_net_profit - ca.total_return_loss) END AS adjusted_profit, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.cd_gender ORDER BY CASE WHEN (ca.total_discount / NULLIF(ca.total_sales,0)) > 0.2 THEN (ca.total_net_profit - ca.total_return_loss) * 0.9 ELSE (ca.total_net_profit - ca.total_return_loss) END DESC) AS gender_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN (ca.total_discount / NULLIF(ca.total_sales,0)) > 0.2 THEN (ca.total_net_profit - ca.total_return_loss) * 0.9 ELSE (ca.total_net_profit - ca.total_return_loss) END) OVER (PARTITION BY cd.cd_gender ORDER BY CASE WHEN (ca.total_discount / NULLIF(ca.total_sales,0)) > 0.2 THEN (ca.total_net_profit - ca.total_return_loss) * 0.9 ELSE (ca.total_net_profit - ca.total_return_loss) END ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_total_adj_profit_gender FROM ( SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(cs.cs_coupon_amt) AS total_coupon, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss,0)) AS total_return_loss, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS total_return_orders FROM catalog_sales cs LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk ) ca JOIN customer c ON ca.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE ca.total_sales > 0 ) t WHERE t.gender_rank <= 5 ORDER BY t.cd_gender, t.gender_rank

WITH customer_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS total_orders, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales_amount FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk ), customer_returns AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS total_returns, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk ), customer_metrics AS ( SELECT cs.customer_sk, cs.total_orders, cs.total_quantity_sold, cs.total_sales_amount, COALESCE(cr.total_returns,0) AS total_returns, COALESCE(cr.total_return_quantity,0) AS total_return_quantity, COALESCE(cr.total_return_loss,0) AS total_return_loss, CASE WHEN cs.total_orders = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(cr.total_returns,0) * 1.0 / cs.total_orders END AS return_rate, CASE WHEN cs.total_sales_amount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(cr.total_return_loss,0) * 1.0 / cs.total_sales_amount END AS loss_rate FROM customer_sales cs LEFT JOIN customer_returns cr ON cs.customer_sk = cr.customer_sk ) SELECT cm.customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cm.total_orders, cm.total_returns, cm.return_rate, cm.loss_rate, CASE WHEN cm.return_rate > 0.5 THEN 'Very High' WHEN cm.return_rate > 0.2 THEN 'High' WHEN cm.return_rate > 0.1 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_rate_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cm.return_rate DESC) AS return_rate_rank FROM customer_metrics cm JOIN customer c ON cm.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE cm.total_orders > 0 ORDER BY return_rate_rank LIMIT 20

WITH sales_monthly AS ( SELECT cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_key, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS orders_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN cd.cd_gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN cd.cd_gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_customers FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk ), returns_monthly AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS date_key, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_returns, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS return_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk) AS distinct_refunded_customers FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_returned_date_sk ), combined AS ( SELECT COALESCE(s.date_key, r.date_key) AS date_key, COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) AS total_sales, COALESCE(r.total_returns, 0) AS total_returns, COALESCE(s.orders_count,0) AS orders_count, COALESCE(r.return_orders,0) AS return_orders, COALESCE(s.distinct_customers,0) AS distinct_customers, COALESCE(r.distinct_refunded_customers,0) AS distinct_refunded_customers, COALESCE(s.male_customers,0) AS male_customers, COALESCE(s.female_customers,0) AS female_customers FROM sales_monthly s FULL OUTER JOIN returns_monthly r ON s.date_key = r.date_key ) SELECT c.date_key, c.total_sales, c.total_returns, c.total_sales - c.total_returns AS net_sales, c.orders_count, c.return_orders, c.distinct_customers, c.distinct_refunded_customers, c.male_customers, c.female_customers, LAG(c.total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY c.date_key) AS prev_month_sales, LAG(c.total_returns) OVER (ORDER BY c.date_key) AS prev_month_returns, CASE WHEN LAG(c.total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY c.date_key) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (c.total_sales - LAG(c.total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY c.date_key)) / LAG(c.total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY c.date_key) END AS sales_monthly_pct_change, AVG(c.total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY c.date_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sales_3mo_moving_avg, CASE WHEN (c.total_sales - LAG(c.total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY c.date_key)) / NULLIF(LAG(c.total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY c.date_key),0) < -0.1 THEN 'Sales Drop >10%' ELSE 'Stable/Increase' END AS sales_trend_flag FROM combined c ORDER BY c.date_key

WITH order_metrics AS ( SELECT cs.cs_order_number, cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales, SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss, 0)) AS total_return_loss, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) - SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss,0)) AS net_profit_after_returns, CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) - SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss,0))) / SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) END AS profit_margin FROM catalog_sales cs LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_order_number, cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk ) SELECT om.cs_order_number, c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name || ' ' || c.c_last_name AS customer_name, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, om.total_sales, om.total_return_loss, om.net_profit_after_returns, om.profit_margin, CASE WHEN om.profit_margin >= 0.2 THEN 'High' WHEN om.profit_margin >= 0.1 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY om.net_profit_after_returns DESC) AS profit_rank FROM order_metrics om LEFT JOIN customer c ON om.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk LEFT JOIN customer_demographics cd ON om.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 10

WITH sales_by_day AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        d.d_date,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS daily_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS daily_orders
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk, d.d_date
),
customer_agg AS (
    SELECT
        customer_sk,
        SUM(daily_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d_date) AS active_days,
        SUM(daily_orders) AS total_orders,
        AVG(daily_profit) AS avg_daily_profit,
        SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM d_date) IN (6,7) THEN daily_orders ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_orders
    FROM sales_by_day
    GROUP BY customer_sk
),
customer_rank AS (
    SELECT
        ca.*, 
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_profit DESC) AS cum_dist
    FROM customer_agg ca
)
SELECT
    cr.customer_sk,
    cr.total_profit,
    cr.active_days,
    cr.total_orders,
    cr.avg_daily_profit,
    cr.weekend_orders,
    CASE WHEN cr.total_orders > 0 THEN cr.weekend_orders * 1.0 / cr.total_orders ELSE 0 END AS weekend_order_ratio,
    cr.profit_rank,
    CASE 
        WHEN cr.cum_dist <= 0.10 THEN 'Top 10%'
        WHEN cr.cum_dist <= 0.40 THEN 'Top 40%'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS segment
FROM customer_rank cr
WHERE cr.profit_rank <= 200
ORDER BY cr.profit_rank

WITH customer_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt,
        MIN(d.d_date) AS first_purchase_date,
        MAX(d.d_date) AS last_purchase_date,
        AVG(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS avg_order_value,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promo_order_cnt,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2022
    GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
),
customer_hour AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        t.t_hour,
        COUNT(*) AS hour_cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS hr_rank
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN time_dim t ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk, t.t_hour
),
customer_rank AS (
    SELECT
        ca.*, 
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_profit DESC) AS pct_rank,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_profit DESC) AS profit_quartile
    FROM customer_agg ca
)
SELECT
    cr.customer_sk,
    cr.total_profit,
    cr.order_cnt,
    cr.first_purchase_date,
    cr.last_purchase_date,
    cr.avg_order_value,
    cr.promo_order_cnt,
    cr.total_discount,
    CASE WHEN cr.order_cnt > 0 THEN cr.promo_order_cnt * 1.0 / cr.order_cnt ELSE 0 END AS promo_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cr.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    CASE 
        WHEN cr.pct_rank <= 0.10 THEN 'Platinum'
        WHEN cr.pct_rank <= 0.30 THEN 'Gold'
        ELSE 'Silver'
    END AS tier,
    CASE profit_quartile WHEN 1 THEN 'Top 25%' WHEN 2 THEN '25-50%' WHEN 3 THEN '50-75%' ELSE 'Bottom 25%' END AS profit_bucket,
    ch.t_hour AS favorite_hour,
    ch.hour_cnt AS favorite_hour_orders
FROM customer_rank cr
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT customer_sk, t_hour, hour_cnt
    FROM customer_hour
    WHERE hr_rank = 1
) ch ON cr.customer_sk = ch.customer_sk
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws.ws_order_number,
        d.d_date,
        p.p_discount_active,
        t.t_hour
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
    JOIN time_dim t ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    WHERE d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 202201 AND 202212
),
customer_agg AS (
    SELECT
        customer_sk,
        SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ws_order_number) AS order_cnt,
        MIN(d_date) AS first_purchase_date,
        MAX(d_date) AS last_purchase_date,
        AVG(ws_ext_sales_price) AS avg_order_value,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promo_order_cnt
    FROM base
    GROUP BY customer_sk
),
favorite_hour AS (
    SELECT
        customer_sk,
        t_hour,
        COUNT(*) AS hour_cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_sk ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
    FROM base
    GROUP BY customer_sk, t_hour
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ca.*, 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_profit DESC) AS pct_rank
    FROM customer_agg ca
)
SELECT
    r.customer_sk,
    r.total_profit,
    r.order_cnt,
    r.first_purchase_date,
    r.last_purchase_date,
    r.avg_order_value,
    r.promo_order_cnt,
    CASE WHEN r.order_cnt > 0 THEN r.promo_order_cnt * 1.0 / r.order_cnt ELSE 0 END AS promo_ratio,
    r.profit_rank,
    CASE 
        WHEN r.pct_rank <= 0.05 THEN 'Elite'
        WHEN r.pct_rank <= 0.25 THEN 'Preferred'
        ELSE 'Standard'
    END AS tier,
    fh.t_hour AS favorite_hour,
    fh.hour_cnt AS favorite_hour_orders
FROM ranked r
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT customer_sk, t_hour, hour_cnt
    FROM favorite_hour
    WHERE rn = 1
) fh ON r.customer_sk = fh.customer_sk
ORDER BY r.profit_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH customer_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS total_orders, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales_amount FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk ), customer_returns AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS total_returns, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk ), customer_metrics AS ( SELECT cs.customer_sk, cs.total_orders, cs.total_quantity_sold, cs.total_sales_amount, COALESCE(cr.total_returns,0) AS total_returns, COALESCE(cr.total_return_quantity,0) AS total_return_quantity, COALESCE(cr.total_return_loss,0) AS total_return_loss, CASE WHEN cs.total_orders = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(cr.total_returns,0) * 1.0 / cs.total_orders END AS return_rate, CASE WHEN cs.total_sales_amount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(cr.total_return_loss,0) * 1.0 / cs.total_sales_amount END AS loss_rate FROM customer_sales cs LEFT JOIN customer_returns cr ON cs.customer_sk = cr.customer_sk ) SELECT cm.customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cm.total_orders, cm.total_returns, cm.total_quantity_sold, cm.total_sales_amount, cm.return_rate, cm.loss_rate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cm.loss_rate ASC) AS loss_rank FROM customer_metrics cm JOIN customer c ON cm.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE cm.total_orders > 0 AND cm.return_rate BETWEEN 0.05 AND 0.3 GROUP BY cm.customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cm.total_orders, cm.total_returns, cm.total_quantity_sold, cm.total_sales_amount, cm.return_rate, cm.loss_rate ORDER BY loss_rank LIMIT 15

WITH ship_mode_perf AS ( SELECT sm.sm_type, sm.sm_carrier, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, AVG(cr.cr_return_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost, AVG(cr.cr_fee) AS avg_fee, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY sm.sm_type, sm.sm_carrier ) SELECT sm_type, sm_carrier, total_net_loss, avg_ship_cost, avg_fee, return_cnt, CASE WHEN avg_ship_cost > 50 THEN 'Expensive' WHEN avg_ship_cost BETWEEN 20 AND 50 THEN 'Moderate' ELSE 'Cheap' END AS ship_cost_category, SUM(total_net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_loss, LAG(total_net_loss, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS previous_net_loss, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_dense_rank FROM ship_mode_perf ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC

WITH city_returns AS ( SELECT ca_ref.ca_city AS refunded_city, ca_ref.ca_state AS refunded_state, ca_ret.ca_city AS returning_city, ca_ret.ca_state AS returning_state, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash, SUM(cr.cr_fee) AS total_fee, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_address ca_ref ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_ref.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_address ca_ret ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_ret.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca_ref.ca_city, ca_ref.ca_state, ca_ret.ca_city, ca_ret.ca_state ) SELECT refunded_city, refunded_state, returning_city, returning_state, total_return_amount, total_refunded_cash, total_fee, return_cnt, CASE WHEN total_return_amount > 5000 THEN 'High Return City' WHEN total_return_amount BETWEEN 2000 AND 5000 THEN 'Medium Return City' ELSE 'Low Return City' END AS return_city_category, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS return_amount_percentile, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY refunded_state ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS city_rank_within_state FROM city_returns WHERE total_return_amount > 0 ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC LIMIT 20

WITH category_loss AS ( SELECT i.i_category, i.i_class, sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY i.i_category, i.i_class, sm.sm_type ) SELECT i_category, i_class, ship_mode_type, total_net_loss, total_return_qty, CASE WHEN total_net_loss < 1000 THEN 'Low' WHEN total_net_loss BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS net_loss_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM category_loss ORDER BY loss_rank LIMIT 10

WITH order_summary AS ( SELECT cr.cr_order_number, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, AVG(i.i_wholesale_cost) AS avg_wholesale_cost, MIN(sm.sm_type) AS ship_mode_type, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_item_sk) AS distinct_items, MAX(cr.cr_returned_date_sk) AS last_return_date_sk FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_order_number ) SELECT cr_order_number, total_return_amount, total_return_qty, total_net_loss, avg_wholesale_cost, ship_mode_type, distinct_items, last_return_date_sk, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 1000 THEN 'Severe Loss' WHEN total_net_loss BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 THEN 'Moderate Loss' ELSE 'Low Loss' END AS loss_severity, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_return_qty DESC) AS qty_quartile, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ship_mode_type ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS rank_within_ship_mode FROM order_summary WHERE total_return_qty > 0 ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT
    s_store_id,
    d_year,
    total_net_loss,
    total_returns,
    pct_damaged_returns,
    store_status_at_last_return,
    net_loss_rank_in_year
FROM (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_sk,
        d.d_year,
        MAX(d.d_date_sk) AS max_return_date_sk,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS total_returns,
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.r_reason_desc = 'Damaged' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS pct_damaged_returns,
        CASE 
            WHEN s.s_closed_date_sk IS NOT NULL AND MAX(d.d_date_sk) >= s.s_closed_date_sk THEN 'Closed'
            ELSE 'Open'
        END AS store_status_at_last_return,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) DESC) AS net_loss_rank_in_year
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2020
    GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_sk, s.s_closed_date_sk, d.d_year
) t
ORDER BY d_year, net_loss_rank_in_year

WITH daily_totals AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_month_seq,
        d.d_day_name,
        d.d_weekend,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN r.r_reason_desc = 'Customer Not Satisfied' THEN sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax ELSE 0 END) AS amount_not_satisfied,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq ORDER BY SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) DESC) AS day_rank_in_month
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    WHERE s.s_state = 'CA'
    GROUP BY d.d_date, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, d.d_day_name, d.d_weekend
)
SELECT
    d_date,
    d_year,
    d_month_seq,
    d_day_name,
    d_weekend,
    total_return_amount,
    amount_not_satisfied,
    day_rank_in_month
FROM daily_totals
WHERE day_rank_in_month <= 5
ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq, day_rank_in_month

SELECT
    s.s_store_id,
    d.d_date,
    s.s_city,
    s.s_state,
    CASE 
        WHEN s.s_floor_space >= 50000 THEN 'Large'
        WHEN s.s_floor_space >= 20000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Small'
    END AS store_tier,
    sr.sr_net_loss,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_id ORDER BY d.d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_loss,
    AVG(sr.sr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_id ORDER BY d.d_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_7day_avg_net_loss,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_store_id ORDER BY d.d_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_7day_return_qty
FROM store_returns sr
JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2022
  AND (s.s_closed_date_sk IS NULL OR d.d_date_sk <= s.s_closed_date_sk)
ORDER BY s.s_store_id, d.d_date

SELECT
    r.r_reason_desc,
    d.d_year,
    d.d_quarter_seq,
    s.s_market_desc,
    COUNT(*) AS total_returns,
    SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
    AVG(sr.sr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss,
    approx_percentile(sr.sr_return_amt, 0.5) AS median_return_amount,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq ORDER BY AVG(sr.sr_net_loss) DESC) AS net_loss_reason_rank,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) > 500000 THEN 'High Volume'
        ELSE 'Normal Volume'
    END AS volume_category
FROM store_returns sr
JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
WHERE d.d_year >= 2019
  AND (s.s_closed_date_sk IS NULL OR d.d_date_sk <= s.s_closed_date_sk)
GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq, s.s_market_desc
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq, net_loss_reason_rank

WITH promo_sales AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS cs_discount, SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS ws_discount, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS cs_profit, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS ws_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS cs_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS ws_orders FROM promotion p LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name ) SELECT ps.p_promo_sk, ps.p_promo_name, COALESCE(ps.cs_discount,0) + COALESCE(ps.ws_discount,0) AS total_discount, COALESCE(ps.cs_profit,0) + COALESCE(ps.ws_profit,0) AS total_profit, (COALESCE(ps.cs_discount,0) + COALESCE(ps.ws_discount,0)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(ps.cs_orders,0) + COALESCE(ps.ws_orders,0),0) AS avg_discount_per_order, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(ps.cs_profit,0) + COALESCE(ps.ws_profit,0) DESC) AS profit_rank, CASE WHEN COALESCE(ps.cs_profit,0) + COALESCE(ps.ws_profit,0) > 50000 THEN 'Highly Profitable' WHEN COALESCE(ps.cs_profit,0) + COALESCE(ps.ws_profit,0) > 20000 THEN 'Moderately Profitable' ELSE 'Low Profit' END AS profit_category FROM promo_sales ps WHERE (COALESCE(ps.cs_discount,0) + COALESCE(ps.ws_discount,0)) > 0 ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 20

WITH unified_sales AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, cs.cs_order_number AS order_number, cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit, cs.cs_coupon_amt AS coupon_amt, cs.cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk, 'Catalog' AS channel FROM customer c JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk UNION ALL SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ws.ws_order_number AS order_number, ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, ws.ws_net_profit AS net_profit, ws.ws_coupon_amt AS coupon_amt, ws.ws_promo_sk AS promo_sk, 'Web' AS channel FROM customer c JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk ) SELECT us.c_customer_id, us.c_first_name, us.c_last_name, us.channel, us.order_number, us.sold_date_sk, us.net_profit, CASE WHEN us.coupon_amt > 0 THEN 'Coupon' ELSE 'NoCoupon' END AS coupon_flag, p.p_promo_name, SUM(us.net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY us.c_customer_sk ORDER BY us.sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY us.c_customer_sk ORDER BY us.net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_per_customer, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY us.c_customer_sk ORDER BY us.sold_date_sk) AS sale_sequence FROM unified_sales us LEFT JOIN promotion p ON us.promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk WHERE us.net_profit IS NOT NULL ORDER BY us.c_customer_id, us.sold_date_sk LIMIT 100

SELECT sm.sm_type,
       sm.sm_carrier,
       td.t_meal_time,
       hd_ret.hd_buy_potential,
       SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
       PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cr.cr_net_loss)) AS loss_percentile,
       CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 18000 THEN 'Severe'
            WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 9000 THEN 'High'
            ELSE 'Normal' END AS loss_category
FROM catalog_returns cr
JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_ret ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_ret.hd_demo_sk
WHERE cr.cr_return_quantity > 1
GROUP BY sm.sm_type, sm.sm_carrier, td.t_meal_time, hd_ret.hd_buy_potential
HAVING COUNT(*) > 50
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 7

SELECT sm.sm_type,
       sm.sm_carrier,
       td.t_hour,
       hd_ret.hd_buy_potential,
       SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
       SUM(cr.cr_fee) AS total_fee,
       CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 22000 THEN 'Very High'
            WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 11000 THEN 'High'
            ELSE 'Medium' END AS loss_category,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.sm_type ORDER BY SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) DESC) AS type_rank,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cr.cr_fee) DESC) AS fee_rank
FROM catalog_returns cr
JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_ret ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_ret.hd_demo_sk
WHERE td.t_am_pm = 'PM'
GROUP BY sm.sm_type, sm.sm_carrier, td.t_hour, hd_ret.hd_buy_potential
HAVING SUM(cr.cr_fee) > 500
ORDER BY type_rank, fee_rank

SELECT sm.sm_type,
       sm.sm_carrier,
       td.t_hour,
       hd_ret.hd_buy_potential,
       COUNT(*) AS return_count,
       AVG(cr.cr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss,
       SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
       CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 30000 THEN 'Extreme'
            WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 15000 THEN 'Very High'
            WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 5000 THEN 'High'
            ELSE 'Low' END AS loss_category,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.sm_type ORDER BY SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) DESC) AS loss_rank_by_type
FROM catalog_returns cr
JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_ret ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_ret.hd_demo_sk
WHERE td.t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 20
GROUP BY sm.sm_type, sm.sm_carrier, td.t_hour, hd_ret.hd_buy_potential
HAVING SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 2000
ORDER BY loss_rank_by_type
LIMIT 10

WITH site_profit AS (
  SELECT ws.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk,
         SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
         SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
         SUM(ws.ws_ext_tax) AS total_tax,
         AVG(ws.ws_quantity) AS avg_quantity
  FROM web_sales ws
  WHERE ws.ws_sold_date_sk >= 2450000   -- filter recent sales
  GROUP BY ws.ws_web_site_sk
),
site_return_loss AS (
  SELECT ws.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk,
         SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
         COUNT(cr.cr_order_number) AS return_cnt
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  WHERE cr.cr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2451000
  GROUP BY ws.ws_web_site_sk
),
site_combined AS (
  SELECT sp.site_sk,
         sp.total_profit,
         sp.total_sales,
         sp.total_tax,
         sp.avg_quantity,
         COALESCE(srl.total_return_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss,
         COALESCE(srl.return_cnt, 0) AS return_cnt,
         sp.total_profit - COALESCE(srl.total_return_loss, 0) AS net_contribution
  FROM site_profit sp
  LEFT JOIN site_return_loss srl ON sp.site_sk = srl.site_sk
)
SELECT t.site_sk,
       site.web_name,
       site.web_city,
       t.total_profit,
       t.total_return_loss,
       t.return_cnt,
       t.net_contribution,
       PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t.net_contribution DESC) AS net_contrib_percentile,
       CASE WHEN t.net_contribution > 0 THEN 'Positive' ELSE 'Negative' END AS contribution_sign
FROM site_combined t
JOIN web_site site ON t.site_sk = site.web_site_sk
ORDER BY t.net_contribution DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH site_sales AS (
  SELECT ws.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk,
         SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
         SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_paid_inc_tax,
         COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS orders_cnt
  FROM web_sales ws
  WHERE ws.ws_ship_mode_sk IN (1,2,3)
  GROUP BY ws.ws_web_site_sk
),
site_returns AS (
  SELECT ws.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk,
         SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
         AVG(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_qty
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  GROUP BY ws.ws_web_site_sk
),
site_metrics AS (
  SELECT s.site_sk,
         s.total_sales,
         s.total_paid_inc_tax,
         s.orders_cnt,
         COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0) AS total_return_loss,
         COALESCE(r.avg_return_qty,0) AS avg_return_qty,
         (s.total_sales - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0)) / NULLIF(s.total_sales,0) AS sales_return_ratio
  FROM site_sales s
  LEFT JOIN site_returns r ON s.site_sk = r.site_sk
)
SELECT sm.site_sk,
       site.web_name,
       site.web_state,
       sm.total_sales,
       sm.total_return_loss,
       sm.sales_return_ratio,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sm.sales_return_ratio DESC) AS rn
FROM site_metrics sm
JOIN web_site site ON sm.site_sk = site.web_site_sk
WHERE sm.sales_return_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY rn
LIMIT 15

WITH profit_by_site AS (
  SELECT ws.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk,
         SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS profit,
         SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
         MAX(ws.ws_net_paid) AS max_paid
  FROM web_sales ws
  GROUP BY ws.ws_web_site_sk
),
loss_by_site AS (
  SELECT ws.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk,
         SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS loss,
         MIN(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS min_return_qty
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  GROUP BY ws.ws_web_site_sk
)
SELECT p.site_sk,
       site.web_name,
       site.web_city,
       p.profit,
       l.loss,
       p.profit - l.loss AS net_profit,
       NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY (p.profit - l.loss) DESC) AS profit_quartile,
       CASE WHEN (p.profit - l.loss) > 0 THEN 'Gain' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_status
FROM profit_by_site p
LEFT JOIN loss_by_site l ON p.site_sk = l.site_sk
JOIN web_site site ON p.site_sk = site.web_site_sk
ORDER BY net_profit DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH base AS (
  SELECT ws.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk,
         SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
         SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
         SUM(ws.ws_ext_tax) AS total_tax,
         COUNT(*) AS trans_cnt
  FROM web_sales ws
  WHERE ws.ws_sold_time_sk % 2 = 0   -- only even time slots
  GROUP BY ws.ws_web_site_sk
),
returns AS (
  SELECT ws.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk,
         SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_loss,
         COUNT(cr.cr_order_number) AS return_cnt,
         SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  GROUP BY ws.ws_web_site_sk
)
SELECT b.site_sk,
       site.web_name,
       site.web_country,
       b.total_sales,
       b.total_profit,
       r.total_loss,
       (b.total_profit - r.total_loss) / NULLIF(b.total_sales,0) AS profit_margin,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (b.total_profit - r.total_loss) DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN returns r ON b.site_sk = r.site_sk
JOIN web_site site ON b.site_sk = site.web_site_sk
WHERE b.total_sales > 100000
ORDER BY profit_margin DESC
LIMIT 12

WITH item_discounts AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, CASE WHEN cs.cs_ext_list_price = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (cs.cs_ext_list_price - cs.cs_ext_sales_price) / cs.cs_ext_list_price END AS discount_ratio, p.p_discount_active FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y' ) SELECT cs_item_sk, AVG(discount_ratio) AS avg_discount_ratio, COUNT(*) AS sales_count, CASE WHEN AVG(discount_ratio) >= 0.3 THEN 'High' WHEN AVG(discount_ratio) >= 0.1 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS discount_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(discount_ratio) DESC) AS discount_rank FROM item_discounts GROUP BY cs_item_sk HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY discount_rank LIMIT 10

WITH promo_profit AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, COALESCE(cs.cs_sold_date_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk) AS sold_date_sk, SUM(COALESCE(cs.cs_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(ss.ss_net_profit, 0)) AS total_net_profit FROM promotion p LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL OR ss.ss_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, COALESCE(cs.cs_sold_date_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk) ) SELECT p_promo_id, p_promo_name, sold_date_sk, total_net_profit, LAG(total_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY p_promo_id ORDER BY sold_date_sk) AS prev_net_profit, CASE WHEN LAG(total_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY p_promo_id ORDER BY sold_date_sk) IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN total_net_profit > LAG(total_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY p_promo_id ORDER BY sold_date_sk) THEN 'Improving' ELSE 'Declining' END AS trend FROM promo_profit ORDER BY p_promo_id, sold_date_sk

WITH daily_sales AS ( SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS daily_net_paid, SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS daily_discount, CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS promo_status FROM store s JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, ss.ss_sold_date_sk, p.p_discount_active ), cumulative AS ( SELECT ds.*, SUM(daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_id ORDER BY sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_net_paid FROM daily_sales ds ) SELECT s_store_id, s_store_name, sold_date_sk, daily_net_paid, cum_net_paid, daily_discount, promo_status, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cum_net_paid DESC) AS store_cum_rank FROM cumulative WHERE sold_date_sk = (SELECT MAX(ss_sold_date_sk) FROM store_sales) ORDER BY store_cum_rank

WITH agg AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, s.s_store_id, SUM(COALESCE(cs.cs_net_profit, 0)) AS catalog_net_profit, SUM(COALESCE(ss.ss_net_profit, 0)) AS store_net_profit, SUM(COALESCE(cs.cs_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(ss.ss_net_profit, 0)) AS total_net_profit FROM promotion p JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk WHERE p.p_start_date_sk IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, s.s_store_id ), ranked AS ( SELECT agg.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY agg.s_store_id ORDER BY agg.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM agg ) SELECT profit_rank, p_promo_id, p_promo_name, s_store_id, catalog_net_profit, store_net_profit, total_net_profit FROM ranked WHERE profit_rank <= 5 ORDER BY s_store_id, profit_rank

WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year AS year,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d.d_date) AS month,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2022-01-01' AND DATE '2023-12-31'
    GROUP BY d.d_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d.d_date)
)
SELECT
    year,
    month,
    total_net_paid,
    total_net_profit,
    CASE WHEN total_net_paid = 0 THEN 0 ELSE total_net_profit / total_net_paid END AS profit_margin,
    LAG(total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_net_paid,
    total_net_paid - LAG(total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY month) AS net_paid_change,
    CASE
        WHEN LAG(total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY month) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (total_net_paid - LAG(total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY month)) /
             LAG(total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY month)
    END AS mom_growth_pct,
    SUM(total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_net_paid
FROM monthly_sales
ORDER BY year, month

WITH discount_data AS (
    SELECT
        sm.sm_type,
        d.d_quarter_name AS quarter,
        cs.cs_ext_discount_amt,
        cs.cs_ext_list_price,
        CASE
            WHEN cs.cs_ext_discount_amt >= 20 THEN 'High'
            WHEN cs.cs_ext_discount_amt >= 10 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS discount_level,
        cd.cd_gender
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
)
SELECT
    sm_type,
    quarter,
    discount_level,
    COUNT(*) AS orders,
    SUM(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount_amount,
    AVG(CASE WHEN cs_ext_list_price = 0 THEN NULL ELSE cs_ext_discount_amt / cs_ext_list_price END) AS avg_discount_pct,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cd_gender) AS gender_count,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY quarter ORDER BY SUM(cs_ext_discount_amt) DESC) AS discount_rank,
    SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY quarter) AS total_orders_quarter,
    (COUNT(*) * 100.0) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY quarter) AS pct_of_quarter_orders
FROM discount_data
GROUP BY sm_type, quarter, discount_level
ORDER BY quarter, discount_rank

WITH item_sales AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_quarter_name AS quarter,
        cs.cs_item_sk AS item_id,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(cs.cs_quantity), 0) AS avg_ship_cost_per_unit,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cd.cd_gender) AS distinct_shipping_genders,
        sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_ship_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_quarter_name, cs.cs_item_sk, sm.sm_type
),
ranked_items AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY quarter ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS rn,
        MAX(total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY quarter) AS max_sales_in_quarter,
        CASE WHEN total_profit < 0 THEN 'Loss' ELSE 'Profit' END AS profit_status,
        CASE
            WHEN total_profit / NULLIF(total_sales, 0) >= 0.2 THEN 'High Margin'
            WHEN total_profit / NULLIF(total_sales, 0) >= 0.1 THEN 'Medium Margin'
            ELSE 'Low Margin'
        END AS margin_category
    FROM item_sales
)
SELECT
    quarter,
    item_id,
    total_sales,
    total_profit,
    profit_status,
    margin_category,
    avg_ship_cost_per_unit,
    total_quantity,
    distinct_shipping_genders,
    ship_mode_type,
    max_sales_in_quarter,
    total_sales * 100.0 / max_sales_in_quarter AS sales_share_pct
FROM ranked_items
WHERE rn <= 5
ORDER BY quarter, rn

WITH customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS bill_cust_id,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_paid,
        AVG(cs.cs_coupon_amt) AS avg_coupon_amount,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
        MAX(d.d_date) AS last_purchase_date,
        cd.cd_gender,
        cd.cd_marital_status,
        cd.cd_education_status,
        cd.cd_credit_rating
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, cd.cd_credit_rating
),
ship_mode_counts AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS bill_cust_id,
        sm.sm_type,
        COUNT(*) AS mode_cnt
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
    GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, sm.sm_type
),
customer_ship_mode AS (
    SELECT
        bill_cust_id,
        sm_type,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bill_cust_id ORDER BY mode_cnt DESC) AS rn
    FROM ship_mode_counts
)
SELECT
    cm.bill_cust_id,
    cm.total_profit,
    cm.total_paid,
    cm.avg_coupon_amount,
    cm.total_quantity,
    cm.total_orders,
    cm.last_purchase_date,
    cm.cd_gender,
    cm.cd_marital_status,
    cm.cd_education_status,
    cm.cd_credit_rating,
    sm.sm_type AS most_frequent_ship_mode,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cm.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN cm.total_profit > 50000 THEN 'Platinum'
        WHEN cm.total_profit > 20000 THEN 'Gold'
        ELSE 'Silver'
    END AS profit_tier
FROM customer_metrics cm
LEFT JOIN customer_ship_mode sm
    ON cm.bill_cust_id = sm.bill_cust_id AND sm.rn = 1
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH return_by_warehouse AS (
  SELECT cr.cr_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
         SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
         SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty,
         MIN(cr.cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS min_return_amount
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  GROUP BY cr.cr_warehouse_sk
),
sales_by_warehouse_site AS (
  SELECT ws.ws_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
         ws.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk,
         SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit,
         SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount,
         SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_sales_qty,
         AVG(ws.ws_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
         SUM(ws.ws_ext_tax) AS total_sales_tax
  FROM web_sales ws
  GROUP BY ws.ws_warehouse_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk
)
SELECT w.w_warehouse_sk,
       w.w_city,
       r.total_return_qty,
       s.total_sales_qty,
       r.min_return_amount,
       s.avg_sales_price,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_state ORDER BY (s.total_sales_amount - r.total_return_loss) DESC) AS profit_rank,
       site.web_name AS site_name,
       CONCAT(w.w_state, '-', site.web_state) AS combined_state
FROM warehouse w
LEFT JOIN return_by_warehouse r ON w.w_warehouse_sk = r.warehouse_sk
JOIN sales_by_warehouse_site s ON w.w_warehouse_sk = s.warehouse_sk
JOIN web_site site ON s.site_sk = site.web_site_sk
WHERE w.w_country = 'United States'
  AND (s.total_sales_amount - r.total_return_loss) > 0
ORDER BY profit_rank, w.w_city
LIMIT 12

WITH hourly AS ( SELECT t.t_hour, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_tax) AS total_return_tax, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_weekend = 'Y' THEN wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_return_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_weekend = 'N' THEN wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_return_amt FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN time_dim t ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY t.t_hour ) SELECT h.t_hour, h.total_return_amt, h.total_return_tax, h.total_quantity, h.weekend_return_amt, h.weekday_return_amt, SUM(h.total_return_amt) OVER (ORDER BY h.t_hour) AS cumulative_return_amt, CASE WHEN h.total_return_amt > 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS volume_category FROM hourly h ORDER BY h.t_hour

WITH daily_loss AS ( SELECT wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS cust_id, d.d_date, i.i_category AS item_category, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS daily_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk, d.d_date, i.i_category ), cumulative AS ( SELECT cust_id, d_date, item_category, daily_loss, SUM(daily_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id, item_category ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_loss, LAG(daily_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id, item_category ORDER BY d_date) AS prior_daily_loss, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cust_id, item_category ORDER BY d_date DESC) AS rn_desc FROM daily_loss ), latest_time AS ( SELECT wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS cust_id, MAX(t.t_hour) AS latest_return_hour FROM web_returns wr JOIN time_dim t ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk ) SELECT c.cust_id, c.d_date, c.item_category, c.daily_loss, c.cumulative_loss, c.prior_daily_loss, CASE WHEN c.prior_daily_loss IS NULL THEN 'Start' WHEN c.daily_loss > c.prior_daily_loss THEN 'Increase' WHEN c.daily_loss < c.prior_daily_loss THEN 'Decrease' ELSE 'No Change' END AS change_indicator, lt.latest_return_hour, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.cumulative_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM cumulative c JOIN latest_time lt ON c.cust_id = lt.cust_id WHERE c.rn_desc = 1 ORDER BY loss_rank LIMIT 10

WITH category_perf AS ( SELECT d.d_year, d.d_quarter_name, i.i_category, AVG(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS avg_return_amt, AVG(wr.wr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss, COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_order_number) AS distinct_orders, AVG(t.t_hour) AS avg_return_hour, CASE WHEN AVG(wr.wr_net_loss) > 500 THEN 'High Loss' WHEN AVG(wr.wr_net_loss) BETWEEN 100 AND 500 THEN 'Medium Loss' ELSE 'Low Loss' END AS loss_category FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN time_dim t ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_quarter_name, i.i_category ) SELECT cp.d_year, cp.d_quarter_name, cp.i_category, cp.avg_return_amt, cp.avg_net_loss, cp.distinct_orders, cp.avg_return_hour, cp.loss_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp.d_year, cp.d_quarter_name ORDER BY cp.avg_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM category_perf cp ORDER BY cp.d_year, cp.d_quarter_name, loss_rank

WITH monthly_returns AS ( SELECT d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(DISTINCT cc.cc_call_center_sk) AS active_call_centers, AVG(cc.cc_tax_percentage) AS avg_tax_percentage FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN call_center cc ON d.d_date_sk BETWEEN cc.cc_open_date_sk AND cc.cc_closed_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_month_seq ) SELECT d_year, d_month_seq, total_return_amt, total_net_loss, active_call_centers, CASE WHEN avg_tax_percentage > 10 THEN 'High Tax' WHEN avg_tax_percentage > 5 THEN 'Medium Tax' ELSE 'Low Tax' END AS tax_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC) AS return_amount_rank, SUM(total_return_amt) OVER (ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_return_amt FROM monthly_returns ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq

WITH city_returns AS ( SELECT ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(sr.sr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = 2022 GROUP BY ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state ) SELECT ca_city, ca_state, total_return_amt, total_quantity, avg_return_amt, CASE WHEN total_return_amt > 100000 THEN 'Very High' WHEN total_return_amt > 50000 THEN 'High' WHEN total_return_amt > 20000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC) AS city_return_rank, SUM(total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_return_by_state FROM city_returns ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC

WITH cc_quarterly_loss AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_company_name, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_name, d.d_quarter_seq, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS quarter_net_loss, COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_store_sk) AS distinct_store_count FROM call_center cc JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk BETWEEN cc.cc_open_date_sk AND cc.cc_closed_date_sk JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_company_name, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_name, d.d_quarter_seq ), cc_quarterly_with_lag AS ( SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_company_name, d_year, d_quarter_name, quarter_net_loss, distinct_store_count, LAG(quarter_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_sk ORDER BY d_year, d_quarter_seq) AS prev_quarter_net_loss FROM cc_quarterly_loss ) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_company_name, d_year, d_quarter_name, quarter_net_loss, distinct_store_count, prev_quarter_net_loss, CASE WHEN prev_quarter_net_loss IS NULL OR prev_quarter_net_loss = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((quarter_net_loss - prev_quarter_net_loss) / prev_quarter_net_loss) * 100 END AS pct_change_from_prev_quarter, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN prev_quarter_net_loss IS NULL OR prev_quarter_net_loss = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((quarter_net_loss - prev_quarter_net_loss) / prev_quarter_net_loss) * 100 END DESC) AS net_loss_growth_rank, CASE WHEN quarter_net_loss > 50000 THEN 'High Loss' WHEN quarter_net_loss > 20000 THEN 'Medium Loss' ELSE 'Low Loss' END AS loss_category FROM cc_quarterly_with_lag WHERE quarter_net_loss IS NOT NULL ORDER BY net_loss_growth_rank LIMIT 20

WITH cc_returns AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_country, cc.cc_employees, CASE WHEN cc.cc_employees < 100 THEN 'Small' WHEN cc.cc_employees BETWEEN 100 AND 500 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS employee_bracket, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(DISTINCT sr.sr_store_sk) AS distinct_store_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN ca.ca_country = cc.cc_country THEN sr.sr_return_amt ELSE 0 END) AS in_country_return_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN ca.ca_country <> cc.cc_country OR ca.ca_country IS NULL THEN sr.sr_return_amt ELSE 0 END) AS out_country_return_amt FROM call_center cc JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk BETWEEN cc.cc_open_date_sk AND cc.cc_closed_date_sk JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_country, cc.cc_employees ), country_loss AS ( SELECT cc_country, SUM(total_net_loss) AS country_net_loss, CASE WHEN SUM(total_net_loss) > 200000 THEN 'Critical' WHEN SUM(total_net_loss) > 100000 THEN 'Warning' ELSE 'Normal' END AS loss_severity FROM cc_returns GROUP BY cc_country ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT cr.cc_name, cr.cc_country, cr.employee_bracket, cr.total_return_amt, cr.total_net_loss, cr.distinct_store_cnt, cr.in_country_return_amt, cr.out_country_return_amt, cl.loss_severity, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cr.employee_bracket ORDER BY cr.total_return_amt DESC) AS rn FROM cc_returns cr JOIN country_loss cl ON cr.cc_country = cl.cc_country ) t WHERE t.rn <= 5 ORDER BY t.employee_bracket, t.rn

WITH customer_return_stats AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        COUNT(sr.sr_ticket_number) AS total_returns,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount,
        AVG(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS avg_return_amount,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN customer c
        ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, hd.hd_income_band_sk
), ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_return_amount DESC) AS avg_amount_rank
    FROM customer_return_stats
    WHERE total_returns >= 10
)
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    c_first_name,
    c_last_name,
    hd_income_band_sk,
    total_returns,
    total_return_amount,
    avg_return_amount,
    CASE WHEN avg_return_amount > 1000 THEN 'VIP' ELSE 'Regular' END AS customer_tier,
    avg_amount_rank
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE avg_amount_rank <= 5
ORDER BY avg_amount_rank

WITH cur_daily AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date_sk,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_moy,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS daily_return_amount,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS daily_net_loss,
        AVG(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_count,
        d.d_same_day_ly AS prev_date_sk
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_date_sk, d.d_year, d.d_moy, d.d_same_day_ly
), prev_daily AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date_sk,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS prev_daily_return_amount,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS prev_daily_net_loss,
        AVG(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS prev_avg_vehicle_count
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_date_sk
), monthly_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cd.d_year,
        cd.d_moy AS month,
        SUM(cd.daily_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(pd.prev_daily_return_amount) AS total_prev_return_amount,
        SUM(cd.daily_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        SUM(pd.prev_daily_net_loss) AS total_prev_net_loss,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(pd.prev_daily_return_amount) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (SUM(cd.daily_return_amount) - SUM(pd.prev_daily_return_amount)) / SUM(pd.prev_daily_return_amount) * 100
        END AS growth_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(pd.prev_daily_return_amount) = 0 THEN 'No Prior Data'
            WHEN (SUM(cd.daily_return_amount) - SUM(pd.prev_daily_return_amount)) / SUM(pd.prev_daily_return_amount) * 100 > 20 THEN 'High Growth'
            WHEN (SUM(cd.daily_return_amount) - SUM(pd.prev_daily_return_amount)) / SUM(pd.prev_daily_return_amount) * 100 < -20 THEN 'Decline'
            ELSE 'Stable'
        END AS growth_category,
        AVG(cd.avg_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_count_current_month
    FROM cur_daily cd
    LEFT JOIN prev_daily pd ON cd.prev_date_sk = pd.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY cd.d_year, cd.d_moy
    HAVING SUM(cd.daily_return_amount) > 0
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    month,
    total_return_amount,
    total_prev_return_amount,
    total_net_loss,
    total_prev_net_loss,
    growth_pct,
    growth_category,
    avg_vehicle_count_current_month,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY COALESCE(growth_pct, 0) DESC) AS month_growth_rank
FROM monthly_agg
ORDER BY d_year, month

WITH returns_detail AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_birth_month,
        c.c_birth_country,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        sr.sr_ticket_number,
        sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax,
        sr.sr_net_loss,
        rd.d_date AS return_date,
        fd.d_date AS first_sales_date
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN customer c
        ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim rd
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = rd.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim fd
        ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
), aggregated_returns AS (
    SELECT
        c_birth_month AS birth_month,
        c_birth_country AS birth_country,
        hd_buy_potential,
        COUNT(sr_ticket_number) AS total_returns,
        SUM(sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount,
        AVG(sr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss,
        AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', first_sales_date, return_date)) AS avg_days_to_return,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(sr_return_amt_inc_tax) > 50000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN SUM(sr_return_amt_inc_tax) BETWEEN 20000 AND 50000 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS return_volume_category
    FROM returns_detail
    GROUP BY c_birth_month, c_birth_country, hd_buy_potential
    HAVING COUNT(sr_ticket_number) >= 10
)
SELECT
    birth_month,
    birth_country,
    hd_buy_potential,
    total_returns,
    total_return_amount,
    avg_net_loss,
    return_volume_category,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS country_return_rank,
    avg_days_to_return
FROM aggregated_returns
ORDER BY country_return_rank

WITH monthly_customer_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_moy AS month,
        COUNT(sr.sr_ticket_number) AS return_cnt,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount,
        AVG(sr.sr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss,
        CASE
            WHEN d.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 'Q1'
            WHEN d.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 'Q2'
            WHEN d.d_moy BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 'Q3'
            ELSE 'Q4'
        END AS quarter
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2020
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, d.d_year, d.d_moy
)
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    d_year,
    month,
    return_cnt,
    total_net_loss,
    total_return_amount,
    avg_net_loss,
    quarter,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, month ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank_month,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank_year
FROM monthly_customer_agg
WHERE return_cnt > 5
ORDER BY d_year, month, net_loss_rank_month

WITH ship_quarter AS ( SELECT cr.cr_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq, AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_ship_mode_sk, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq ) SELECT ship_mode, d_year, d_quarter_seq, avg_return_amount, return_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ship_mode ORDER BY d_year, d_quarter_seq) AS seq_num FROM ship_quarter WHERE return_cnt >= 5 ORDER BY ship_mode, seq_num

WITH ship_quarter AS ( SELECT cr.cr_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_ship_mode_sk, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq ) SELECT ship_mode, d_year, d_quarter_seq, total_return_amount, return_cnt, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ship_mode ORDER BY total_return_amount) AS return_amount_percentile FROM ship_quarter ORDER BY ship_mode, return_amount_percentile

WITH ship_quarter AS ( SELECT cr.cr_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_ship_mode_sk, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq ) SELECT ship_mode, d_year, d_quarter_seq, total_return_amount, return_cnt, MAX(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ship_mode) AS max_return_by_mode FROM ship_quarter WHERE d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 ORDER BY max_return_by_mode DESC, ship_mode

WITH base_returns AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_credit_rating, hd.hd_income_band_sk, wp.wp_type, wr.wr_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY cd.cd_demo_sk) AS total_return_per_customer, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY cd.cd_demo_sk) AS return_cnt_per_customer FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk WHERE wr.wr_returned_date_sk IS NOT NULL ), tiered AS ( SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_credit_rating, hd_income_band_sk, wp_type, total_return_per_customer, return_cnt_per_customer, CASE WHEN total_return_per_customer >= 20000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN total_return_per_customer >= 10000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN total_return_per_customer >= 5000 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS tier FROM base_returns ), summary AS ( SELECT tier, COUNT(*) AS customer_cnt, SUM(total_return_per_customer) AS tier_total_return FROM tiered GROUP BY tier ) SELECT tier, customer_cnt, tier_total_return, ROUND(tier_total_return * 1.0 / NULLIF(customer_cnt,0), 2) AS avg_return_per_customer FROM summary ORDER BY CASE tier WHEN 'Platinum' THEN 1 WHEN 'Gold' THEN 2 WHEN 'Silver' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

WITH base_returns AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_credit_rating, hd.hd_income_band_sk, wp.wp_type, wr.wr_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY cd.cd_demo_sk) AS total_return_per_customer, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY cd.cd_demo_sk) AS return_cnt_per_customer FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk WHERE wr.wr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 20200101 AND 20201231 ), agg AS ( SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_credit_rating, hd_income_band_sk, wp_type, SUM(total_return_per_customer) AS sum_returns, AVG(return_cnt_per_customer) AS avg_return_cnt FROM base_returns GROUP BY cd_demo_sk, cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_credit_rating, hd_income_band_sk, wp_type ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY sum_returns DESC) AS return_quartile FROM agg ) SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_credit_rating, hd_income_band_sk, wp_type, sum_returns, avg_return_cnt, return_quartile FROM ranked WHERE return_quartile = 1 ORDER BY sum_returns DESC

WITH cust_profit AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_birth_year,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_paid,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_birth_year
)
SELECT
    cp.c_customer_id,
    cp.c_first_name,
    cp.c_last_name,
    cp.c_birth_year,
    cp.total_paid,
    cp.total_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN cp.total_profit >= 5000 THEN 'Platinum'
        WHEN cp.total_profit >= 2000 THEN 'Gold'
        WHEN cp.total_profit >= 500 THEN 'Silver'
        ELSE 'Bronze'
    END AS profit_tier,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cp.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    LAG(cp.total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.c_birth_year ORDER BY cp.total_profit) AS prev_profit_same_birthyear
FROM cust_profit cp
ORDER BY cp.total_profit DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH store_combined AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_store_sk AS store_sk,
        sr.sr_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        sr.sr_net_loss AS return_loss,
        ws.ws_net_profit AS sales_profit,
        ws.ws_net_paid AS sales_paid
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN web_sales ws
        ON sr.sr_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
        AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
)
SELECT
    sc.store_sk,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sc.customer_sk) AS unique_customers,
    SUM(sc.return_loss) AS total_return_loss,
    SUM(sc.sales_profit) AS total_sales_profit,
    SUM(sc.sales_paid) AS total_sales_paid,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(sc.return_loss) > 10000 THEN 'High Loss'
        WHEN SUM(sc.return_loss) > 5000 THEN 'Medium Loss'
        ELSE 'Low Loss'
    END AS loss_category,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(sc.return_loss) DESC) AS loss_rank,
    ROUND((SUM(sc.return_loss) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.sales_paid), 0)) * 100, 2) AS loss_pct_of_sales
FROM store_combined sc
GROUP BY sc.store_sk
HAVING SUM(sc.sales_paid) > 0
ORDER BY loss_rank

WITH sales AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS sales_amount
    FROM web_sales ws
    GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk
),
returns AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS return_amount
    FROM store_returns sr
    GROUP BY sr.sr_customer_sk, sr.sr_returned_date_sk
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(s.customer_sk, r.customer_sk) AS customer_sk,
        COALESCE(s.date_sk, r.date_sk) AS date_sk,
        COALESCE(s.sales_amount, 0) AS sales_amount,
        COALESCE(r.return_amount, 0) AS return_amount,
        COALESCE(s.sales_amount, 0) - COALESCE(r.return_amount, 0) AS net_contribution
    FROM sales s
    FULL OUTER JOIN returns r
        ON s.customer_sk = r.customer_sk
        AND s.date_sk = r.date_sk
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    comb.date_sk,
    comb.sales_amount,
    comb.return_amount,
    comb.net_contribution,
    AVG(comb.net_contribution) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_customer_id ORDER BY comb.date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3_dates,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_customer_id ORDER BY comb.net_contribution DESC) AS net_contribution_rank
FROM combined comb
JOIN customer c ON comb.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE comb.net_contribution <> 0
ORDER BY c.c_customer_id, comb.date_sk

SELECT
    c.c_birth_month,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    COUNT(*) AS return_count,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 10000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 5000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS loss_category,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_birth_month ORDER BY SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) DESC) AS loss_rank_month,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) DESC) AS loss_rank_overall
FROM store_returns sr
JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
GROUP BY c.c_birth_month, r.r_reason_desc
HAVING SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 0
ORDER BY c.c_birth_month, loss_rank_month

WITH hourly_store_profit AS ( SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, t.t_hour, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS hour_net_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS unique_customers FROM store_sales ss JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk WHERE c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, t.t_hour ) SELECT hsp.s_store_id, hsp.s_store_name, hsp.t_hour, hsp.hour_net_profit, hsp.unique_customers, SUM(hsp.hour_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY hsp.s_store_id ORDER BY hsp.t_hour ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_profit, LAG(hsp.hour_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY hsp.s_store_id ORDER BY hsp.t_hour) AS previous_hour_net_profit, CASE WHEN hsp.hour_net_profit >= 15000 THEN 'BIG_HOUR' WHEN hsp.hour_net_profit >= 5000 THEN 'NORMAL_HOUR' ELSE 'SMALL_HOUR' END AS hour_category FROM hourly_store_profit hsp ORDER BY hsp.s_store_id, hsp.t_hour

WITH profit_by_store_country AS ( SELECT s.s_store_id, MAX(s.s_store_name) AS store_name, c.c_birth_country, AVG(ss.ss_net_profit) AS avg_profit, COUNT(*) AS sales_count FROM store_sales ss JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk WHERE t.t_meal_time = 'Dinner' GROUP BY ROLLUP (s.s_store_id, c.c_birth_country) ) SELECT p.s_store_id, p.store_name, p.c_birth_country, p.sales_count, p.avg_profit, AVG(p.avg_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY p.s_store_id) AS store_avg_profit, CASE WHEN p.avg_profit > 1.5 * AVG(p.avg_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY p.s_store_id) THEN 'ABOVE_AVG' ELSE 'NORMAL_OR_BELOW' END AS profit_category, ROUND(p.avg_profit / NULLIF(AVG(p.avg_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY p.s_store_id), 0), 2) AS profit_ratio FROM profit_by_store_country p ORDER BY p.s_store_id, p.c_birth_country

WITH store_shift_stats AS ( SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, t.t_shift, c.c_birth_country, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers FROM store_sales ss JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, t.t_shift, c.c_birth_country ) SELECT sss.s_store_id, sss.s_store_name, sss.t_shift, sss.c_birth_country, sss.total_net_profit, sss.total_quantity, sss.avg_discount, sss.distinct_customers, CASE WHEN sss.total_net_profit > 200000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN sss.total_net_profit > 100000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sss.t_shift ORDER BY sss.total_net_profit DESC) AS rank_within_shift FROM store_shift_stats sss WHERE sss.total_quantity > 0 ORDER BY sss.t_shift, rank_within_shift LIMIT 50

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_sales_qty, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(cs.cs_coupon_amt) AS avg_coupon_amt FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk ), returns_agg AS ( SELECT cr.cr_item_sk AS item_sk, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk ) SELECT s.item_sk, s.total_sales_qty, s.total_sales_amount, r.total_return_qty, r.total_return_amount, r.total_return_loss, p.p_discount_active, CASE WHEN r.total_return_amount > 0.2 * s.total_sales_amount THEN 'High Return' WHEN r.total_return_amount > 0.1 * s.total_sales_amount THEN 'Medium Return' ELSE 'Low Return' END AS return_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.total_return_amount DESC) AS return_rank FROM sales_agg s JOIN returns_agg r ON r.item_sk = s.item_sk JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = s.item_sk WHERE s.total_sales_qty > 0 ORDER BY r.total_return_amount DESC LIMIT 10
