WITH daily_sales_wh AS ( SELECT cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_key, cs.cs_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS daily_sales, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS daily_profit FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk, cs.cs_warehouse_sk ), daily_returns_wh AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS date_key, cr.cr_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS daily_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS daily_return_loss FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_returned_date_sk, cr.cr_warehouse_sk ) SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, ds.date_key, ds.daily_sales, ds.daily_profit, COALESCE(dr.daily_return_amount,0) AS daily_return_amount, COALESCE(dr.daily_return_loss,0) AS daily_return_loss, (ds.daily_profit - COALESCE(dr.daily_return_loss,0)) AS net_daily_contrib, CASE WHEN COALESCE(dr.daily_return_loss,0) > ds.daily_profit THEN 'Loss Exceeds Profit' ELSE 'Profit Dominant' END AS daily_status, AVG(ds.daily_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_name ORDER BY ds.date_key ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_sales_7d, AVG(ds.daily_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_name ORDER BY ds.date_key ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_profit_7d, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_name ORDER BY (ds.daily_profit - COALESCE(dr.daily_return_loss,0)) DESC) AS net_contrib_rank FROM daily_sales_wh ds JOIN warehouse w ON w.w_warehouse_sk = ds.warehouse_sk LEFT JOIN daily_returns_wh dr ON dr.date_key = ds.date_key AND dr.warehouse_sk = ds.warehouse_sk ORDER BY w.w_warehouse_name, ds.date_key

SELECT w_name, total_sales_profit, total_return_loss, total_promo_cost, net_contribution, CASE WHEN net_contribution > 10000 THEN 'High' WHEN net_contribution BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS contribution_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_contribution DESC) AS profit_rank FROM ( SELECT w.w_warehouse_name AS w_name, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, COALESCE(SUM(p.p_cost), 0) AS total_promo_cost, (SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) - COALESCE(SUM(p.p_cost), 0)) AS net_contribution FROM warehouse w LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_name ) t ORDER BY net_contribution DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, w.w_warehouse_name, COUNT(cs.cs_order_number) AS sales_transactions, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_return_amount),0) AS total_returns_amount, SUM(p.p_cost) AS total_promo_cost, (SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) - COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_return_amount),0) - SUM(p.p_cost)) AS net_gain, CASE WHEN SUM(p.p_cost) > 0 THEN (SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) - COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_return_amount),0) - SUM(p.p_cost)) / SUM(p.p_cost) ELSE NULL END AS roi, CASE WHEN SUM(p.p_cost) > 0 AND (SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) - COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_return_amount),0) - SUM(p.p_cost)) / SUM(p.p_cost) > 1 THEN 'Highly Profitable' WHEN SUM(p.p_cost) > 0 AND (SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) - COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_return_amount),0) - SUM(p.p_cost)) / SUM(p.p_cost) BETWEEN 0 AND 1 THEN 'Break-Even' ELSE 'Not Profitable' END AS roi_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN SUM(p.p_cost) > 0 THEN (SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) - COALESCE(SUM(cr.cr_return_amount),0) - SUM(p.p_cost)) / SUM(p.p_cost) ELSE 0 END DESC) AS roi_rank FROM promotion p JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN p.p_start_date_sk AND p.p_end_date_sk JOIN warehouse w ON w.w_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN p.p_start_date_sk AND p.p_end_date_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, w.w_warehouse_name HAVING COUNT(cs.cs_order_number) > 0 ORDER BY roi_rank LIMIT 10

WITH store_sales_inventory AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_city,
        d_sales.d_year,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        AVG(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory_on_hand,
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 200000 THEN 'Very High'
            WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 100000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 50000 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS profit_category
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN inventory inv 
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
       AND cs.cs_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
       AND inv.inv_date_sk <= cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_sales 
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s 
        ON (s.s_closed_date_sk IS NULL OR cs.cs_sold_date_sk <= s.s_closed_date_sk)
    GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_city, d_sales.d_year
)
SELECT
    s_store_id,
    s_city,
    d_year,
    total_profit,
    total_quantity,
    avg_inventory_on_hand,
    profit_category,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_year
FROM store_sales_inventory
ORDER BY d_year, profit_rank_year

WITH sales_monthly AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
        d_sales.d_year,
        d_sales.d_month_seq,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS month_sales_qty,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_store_id) AS store_count
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d_sales ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s ON (s.s_closed_date_sk IS NULL OR cs.cs_sold_date_sk <= s.s_closed_date_sk)
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_warehouse_sk, d_sales.d_year, d_sales.d_month_seq
),
inventory_monthly AS (
    SELECT
        inv.inv_item_sk,
        inv.inv_warehouse_sk,
        d_inv.d_year,
        d_inv.d_month_seq,
        AVG(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_on_hand
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN date_dim d_inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = d_inv.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY inv.inv_item_sk, inv.inv_warehouse_sk, d_inv.d_year, d_inv.d_month_seq
),
turnover_calculated AS (
    SELECT
        s.cs_item_sk,
        s.cs_warehouse_sk,
        s.d_year,
        s.d_month_seq,
        s.month_sales_qty,
        i.avg_on_hand,
        CASE 
            WHEN i.avg_on_hand > 0 THEN s.month_sales_qty / i.avg_on_hand
            ELSE NULL
        END AS turnover_ratio,
        s.store_count
    FROM sales_monthly s
    LEFT JOIN inventory_monthly i
        ON s.cs_item_sk = i.inv_item_sk
       AND s.cs_warehouse_sk = i.inv_warehouse_sk
       AND s.d_year = i.d_year
       AND s.d_month_seq = i.d_month_seq
)
SELECT
    cs_item_sk,
    cs_warehouse_sk,
    d_year,
    d_month_seq,
    turnover_ratio,
    CASE 
        WHEN turnover_ratio >= 2 THEN 'High'
        WHEN turnover_ratio >= 1 THEN 'Medium'
        WHEN turnover_ratio IS NOT NULL THEN 'Low'
        ELSE 'NoData'
    END AS turnover_category,
    store_count,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, d_month_seq ORDER BY turnover_ratio DESC) AS turnover_rank_month
FROM turnover_calculated
WHERE turnover_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq, turnover_rank_month
LIMIT 200

WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date,
        s.s_store_id,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS daily_net_paid,
        CASE WHEN d.d_dow IN (6,7) THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s ON (s.s_closed_date_sk IS NULL OR d.d_date_sk <= s.s_closed_date_sk)
    GROUP BY d.d_date, s.s_store_id, d.d_dow
),
 daily_inventory AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_date,
        SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN date_dim d ON inv.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY d.d_date
)
SELECT
    ds.d_date,
    ds.s_store_id,
    ds.day_type,
    ds.daily_net_paid,
    di.total_inventory_qty,
    SUM(ds.daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY ds.s_store_id ORDER BY ds.d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_paid,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ds.s_store_id ORDER BY ds.daily_net_paid DESC) AS daily_sales_rank
FROM daily_sales ds
LEFT JOIN daily_inventory di ON ds.d_date = di.d_date
WHERE ds.daily_net_paid > 0
ORDER BY ds.s_store_id, ds.d_date

WITH sales_inventory AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_city,
        d_sales.d_quarter_name,
        d_sales.d_quarter_seq,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_warehouse_sk,
        cs.cs_quantity,
        cs.cs_net_profit,
        cs.cs_ext_sales_price,
        d_sales.d_date AS sale_date,
        d_inv.d_date AS inventory_date,
        DATE_DIFF('day', d_inv.d_date, d_sales.d_date) AS inventory_age_days
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN inventory inv
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
       AND cs.cs_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
       AND inv.inv_date_sk <= cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_sales ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sales.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_inv ON inv.inv_date_sk = d_inv.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s ON (s.s_closed_date_sk IS NULL OR cs.cs_sold_date_sk <= s.s_closed_date_sk)
),
quarter_agg AS (
    SELECT
        s_store_id,
        s_city,
        d_quarter_name,
        d_quarter_seq,
        SUM(cs_quantity) AS total_qty,
        SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        AVG(inventory_age_days) AS avg_inventory_age,
        MIN(sale_date) AS first_sale_date,
        MAX(sale_date) AS last_sale_date
    FROM sales_inventory
    GROUP BY s_store_id, s_city, d_quarter_name, d_quarter_seq
)
SELECT
    s_store_id,
    s_city,
    d_quarter_name,
    total_qty,
    total_sales,
    total_profit,
    CASE 
        WHEN total_sales = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE total_profit / total_sales
    END AS profit_margin,
    avg_inventory_age,
    CASE 
        WHEN (total_profit / NULLIF(total_sales,0)) >= 0.2 THEN 'Excellent'
        WHEN (total_profit / NULLIF(total_sales,0)) >= 0.1 THEN 'Good'
        WHEN (total_profit / NULLIF(total_sales,0)) >= 0.05 THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Poor'
    END AS profit_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_id ORDER BY first_sale_date) AS first_sale_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_id ORDER BY last_sale_date DESC) AS last_sale_rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_quarter_name ORDER BY (total_profit / NULLIF(total_sales,0)) DESC) AS profit_rank_in_quarter
FROM quarter_agg
WHERE total_qty > 0
ORDER BY d_quarter_name, profit_rank_in_quarter
LIMIT 100

WITH combined_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk, cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax AS net_paid_inc_tax, cs.cs_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt FROM catalog_sales cs UNION ALL SELECT ss.ss_promo_sk, ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax, ss.ss_ext_discount_amt FROM store_sales ss ), promo_agg AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, p.p_channel_email, SUM(cs.net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_net_paid_inc_tax, SUM(cs.discount_amt) AS total_discount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, CASE WHEN SUM(cs.net_paid_inc_tax) > 500000 THEN 'TOP' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS promo_status FROM combined_sales cs JOIN promotion p ON cs.promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, p.p_channel_email ) SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_paid_inc_tax DESC) AS promo_rank, SUM(total_net_paid_inc_tax) OVER (ORDER BY total_net_paid_inc_tax DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_paid FROM promo_agg ORDER BY promo_rank

WITH catalog_item AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk, cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit, cs.cs_net_paid AS net_paid, cs.cs_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt, cs.cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk, 'catalog' AS sales_channel FROM catalog_sales cs ), store_item AS ( SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk, ss.ss_net_profit AS net_profit, ss.ss_net_paid AS net_paid, ss.ss_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt, ss.ss_promo_sk AS promo_sk, 'store' AS sales_channel FROM store_sales ss ), combined_item AS ( SELECT * FROM catalog_item UNION ALL SELECT * FROM store_item ), item_agg AS ( SELECT ci.item_sk, SUM(ci.net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(ci.net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(ci.discount_amt) AS total_discount, COUNT(*) AS sales_count, CASE WHEN SUM(ci.net_profit) > 0 THEN SUM(ci.net_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(ci.net_paid), 0) ELSE 0 END AS profit_margin, CASE WHEN SUM(ci.net_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(ci.net_paid), 0) > 0.2 THEN 'HIGH_MARGIN' WHEN SUM(ci.net_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(ci.net_paid), 0) > 0.1 THEN 'MEDIUM_MARGIN' ELSE 'LOW_MARGIN' END AS margin_category FROM combined_item ci GROUP BY ci.item_sk ) SELECT ia.item_sk, ia.total_net_profit, ia.total_net_paid, ia.total_discount, ia.sales_count, ia.profit_margin, ia.margin_category, p.p_promo_name, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ia.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM item_agg ia LEFT JOIN promotion p ON p.p_item_sk = ia.item_sk WHERE ia.total_net_paid > 0 ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 100

WITH warehouse_promo_sales AS ( SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_city, p.p_promo_name, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_city, p.p_promo_name ) SELECT wp.w_warehouse_name, wp.w_city, wp.p_promo_name, wp.total_net_profit, wp.avg_discount, CASE WHEN wp.avg_discount > 10 THEN 'BIG_DISCOUNT' ELSE 'SMALL_DISCOUNT' END AS discount_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY wp.w_warehouse_name ORDER BY wp.total_net_profit DESC) AS promo_profit_rank FROM warehouse_promo_sales wp ORDER BY wp.w_warehouse_name, promo_profit_rank

WITH catalog_daily AS ( SELECT cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax AS net_paid, w.w_warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, p.p_promo_name AS promo_name, 'catalog' AS source FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk ), store_daily AS ( SELECT ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax AS net_paid, NULL AS warehouse_name, NULL AS promo_name, 'store' AS source FROM store_sales ss ), daily_sales AS ( SELECT * FROM catalog_daily UNION ALL SELECT * FROM store_daily ), daily_agg AS ( SELECT ds.sold_date_sk, COALESCE(ds.warehouse_name, 'ALL') AS warehouse_group, SUM(ds.net_paid) AS total_net_paid, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ds.source = 'catalog' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS catalog_transactions, SUM(CASE WHEN ds.source = 'store' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS store_transactions, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.promo_name) FILTER (WHERE ds.promo_name IS NOT NULL) AS distinct_promos FROM daily_sales ds GROUP BY ds.sold_date_sk, COALESCE(ds.warehouse_name, 'ALL') ) SELECT da.sold_date_sk, da.warehouse_group, da.total_net_paid, da.transaction_count, da.catalog_transactions, da.store_transactions, da.distinct_promos, CASE WHEN da.total_net_paid > 1000000 THEN 'VERY_HIGH' WHEN da.total_net_paid > 500000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS sales_level, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY da.warehouse_group ORDER BY da.total_net_paid DESC) AS net_paid_rank_within_warehouse, SUM(da.total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY da.warehouse_group ORDER BY da.sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_paid FROM daily_agg da ORDER BY da.warehouse_group, da.sold_date_sk

WITH item_sales AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_transactions
    FROM store_sales ss
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk
),
item_returns AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_item_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS return_transactions
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk
),
item_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name,
        i.i_category,
        COALESCE(s.total_profit, 0) AS total_profit,
        COALESCE(r.total_loss, 0) AS total_loss,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(s.total_profit, 0) + COALESCE(r.total_loss, 0)) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE COALESCE(r.total_loss, 0) / (COALESCE(s.total_profit, 0) + COALESCE(r.total_loss, 0))
        END AS loss_ratio,
        (COALESCE(s.total_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_loss, 0)) AS net_gain
    FROM item i
    LEFT JOIN item_sales s ON i.i_item_sk = s.ss_item_sk
    LEFT JOIN item_returns r ON i.i_item_sk = r.cr_item_sk
)
SELECT
    im.i_item_sk,
    im.i_product_name,
    im.i_category,
    im.total_profit,
    im.total_loss,
    im.loss_ratio,
    CASE
        WHEN im.loss_ratio > 0.2 THEN 'ALERT'
        ELSE 'OK'
    END AS status,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY im.loss_ratio DESC) AS loss_rank
FROM item_metrics im
WHERE im.loss_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY loss_rank
LIMIT 5

WITH sales_with_time AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
        td.t_time AS time_of_day,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        i.i_category,
        i.i_item_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
),
cumulative_sales AS (
    SELECT
        swt.ss_store_sk,
        swt.i_category,
        swt.time_of_day,
        swt.ss_net_profit,
        SUM(swt.ss_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY swt.ss_store_sk, swt.i_category
                                     ORDER BY swt.time_of_day
                                     ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_category_profit,
        LAG(swt.ss_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY swt.ss_store_sk, swt.i_category ORDER BY swt.time_of_day) AS previous_profit
    FROM sales_with_time swt
    WHERE swt.ss_sold_date_sk = (SELECT MAX(ss2.ss_sold_date_sk) FROM store_sales ss2)
)
SELECT
    cs.ss_store_sk,
    cs.i_category,
    cs.time_of_day,
    cs.cumulative_category_profit,
    cs.previous_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN cs.previous_profit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE cs.ss_net_profit - cs.previous_profit
    END AS profit_change,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.ss_store_sk ORDER BY cs.cumulative_category_profit DESC) AS category_profit_rank
FROM cumulative_sales cs
ORDER BY cs.ss_store_sk, cs.i_category, cs.time_of_day

WITH sales_hourly AS (
    SELECT
        td.t_hour,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY td.t_hour
),
returns_hourly AS (
    SELECT
        td.t_hour,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS returns_cnt
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY td.t_hour
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(s.t_hour, r.t_hour) AS hour_of_day,
    COALESCE(s.total_profit, 0) AS profit,
    COALESCE(r.total_loss, 0) AS loss,
    (COALESCE(s.total_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_loss, 0)) AS net_contribution,
    CASE
        WHEN (COALESCE(s.total_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_loss, 0)) >= 50000 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN (COALESCE(s.total_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_loss, 0)) >= 20000 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS contribution_category,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(s.total_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_loss, 0)) DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM sales_hourly s
FULL OUTER JOIN returns_hourly r ON s.t_hour = r.t_hour
ORDER BY net_contribution DESC

WITH sales_by_customer AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt
    FROM store_sales ss
    GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk
),
returns_by_customer AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_refunded_cash,0) + COALESCE(cr.cr_store_credit,0) + COALESCE(cr.cr_reversed_charge,0) + COALESCE(cr.cr_fee,0)) AS total_refunds,
        COUNT(*) AS returns_cnt
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    GROUP BY cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk
),
customer_time_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        td.t_hour AS purchase_hour,
        COUNT(*) AS hour_cnt
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk, td.t_hour
),
customer_fav_hour AS (
    SELECT
        cts.customer_sk,
        cts.purchase_hour,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cts.customer_sk ORDER BY cts.hour_cnt DESC) AS rn
    FROM customer_time_stats cts
)
SELECT
    cn.customer_sk,
    cn.total_sales,
    cn.total_refunds,
    cn.net_spend,
    cn.sales_cnt,
    cn.returns_cnt,
    CASE
        WHEN cn.net_spend >= 100000 THEN 'Platinum'
        WHEN cn.net_spend >= 50000 THEN 'Gold'
        WHEN cn.net_spend >= 20000 THEN 'Silver'
        ELSE 'Bronze'
    END AS spend_tier,
    cfh.purchase_hour AS favorite_purchase_hour,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cn.net_spend DESC) AS net_spend_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(s.customer_sk, r.customer_sk) AS customer_sk,
        COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) AS total_sales,
        COALESCE(r.total_refunds, 0) AS total_refunds,
        (COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_refunds, 0)) AS net_spend,
        COALESCE(s.sales_cnt, 0) AS sales_cnt,
        COALESCE(r.returns_cnt, 0) AS returns_cnt
    FROM sales_by_customer s
    FULL OUTER JOIN returns_by_customer r ON s.customer_sk = r.customer_sk
) cn
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT customer_sk, purchase_hour
    FROM customer_fav_hour
    WHERE rn = 1
) cfh ON cn.customer_sk = cfh.customer_sk
WHERE cn.net_spend > 0
ORDER BY net_spend_rank
LIMIT 20

WITH customer_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales_amount FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk ), customer_returns AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk ), customer_metrics AS ( SELECT cs.customer_sk, cs.total_quantity_sold, cs.total_sales_amount, COALESCE(cr.total_return_quantity,0) AS total_return_quantity, COALESCE(cr.total_return_loss,0) AS total_return_loss, (cs.total_quantity_sold - COALESCE(cr.total_return_quantity,0)) AS net_quantity_sold, (cs.total_sales_amount - COALESCE(cr.total_return_loss,0)) AS net_sales_amount FROM customer_sales cs LEFT JOIN customer_returns cr ON cs.customer_sk = cr.customer_sk ) SELECT cm.customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, cd.cd_gender, SUM(cm.net_quantity_sold) OVER (PARTITION BY cd.cd_gender) AS gender_quantity_total, SUM(cm.net_sales_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY cd.cd_gender) AS gender_sales_total, cm.net_quantity_sold, cm.net_sales_amount FROM customer_metrics cm JOIN customer c ON cm.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE cm.net_sales_amount > 1000 ORDER BY cm.net_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 20

WITH cc_tax AS (SELECT cc.cc_state AS state, AVG(cc.cc_tax_percentage) AS avg_cc_tax, COUNT(*) AS cc_cnt FROM call_center cc JOIN date_dim d ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year >= 2010 AND MOD(cc.cc_division, 2) = 0 GROUP BY cc.cc_state), ws_tax AS (SELECT ws.web_state AS state, AVG(ws.web_tax_percentage) AS avg_ws_tax, COUNT(*) AS ws_cnt FROM web_site ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year >= 2010 AND ws.web_state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ws.web_state) SELECT cc.state, cc.avg_cc_tax, ws.avg_ws_tax, (cc.avg_cc_tax - ws.avg_ws_tax) AS tax_diff, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc.state ORDER BY cc.avg_cc_tax DESC) AS rn_state, SUM(cc.avg_cc_tax) OVER (ORDER BY cc.state ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_tax FROM cc_tax cc JOIN ws_tax ws ON cc.state = ws.state WHERE (cc.avg_cc_tax - ws.avg_ws_tax) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY tax_diff DESC LIMIT 15

WITH cc_tax AS (SELECT cc.cc_state AS state, AVG(cc.cc_tax_percentage) AS avg_cc_tax, COUNT(*) AS cc_cnt FROM call_center cc JOIN date_dim d ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year >= 2008 AND cc.cc_country = 'USA' GROUP BY cc.cc_state HAVING COUNT(*) > 10), ws_tax AS (SELECT ws.web_state AS state, AVG(ws.web_tax_percentage) AS avg_ws_tax, COUNT(*) AS ws_cnt FROM web_site ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year >= 2008 AND ws.web_country = 'USA' GROUP BY ws.web_state HAVING COUNT(*) > 10) SELECT cc.state, cc.avg_cc_tax, ws.avg_ws_tax, (cc.avg_cc_tax - ws.avg_ws_tax) AS tax_diff, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (cc.avg_cc_tax - ws.avg_ws_tax) ASC) AS tax_diff_rank_asc, CASE WHEN (cc.avg_cc_tax - ws.avg_ws_tax) BETWEEN -0.2 AND 0.2 THEN 'SIMILAR' ELSE 'DIFFERENT' END AS diff_category FROM cc_tax cc JOIN ws_tax ws ON cc.state = ws.state ORDER BY tax_diff_rank_asc LIMIT 30

WITH cc_tax AS (SELECT cc.cc_state AS state, AVG(cc.cc_tax_percentage) AS avg_cc_tax, SUM(cc.cc_employees) AS total_employees FROM call_center cc JOIN date_dim d ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2012 AND 2020 GROUP BY cc.cc_state), ws_tax AS (SELECT ws.web_state AS state, AVG(ws.web_tax_percentage) AS avg_ws_tax, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.web_site_id) AS site_cnt FROM web_site ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2012 AND 2020 GROUP BY ws.web_state) SELECT cc.state, cc.avg_cc_tax, ws.avg_ws_tax, (cc.avg_cc_tax - ws.avg_ws_tax) AS tax_diff, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (cc.avg_cc_tax - ws.avg_ws_tax) DESC) AS tax_diff_rank, CASE WHEN (cc.avg_cc_tax - ws.avg_ws_tax) > 0.7 THEN 'HIGH_DIFF' WHEN (cc.avg_cc_tax - ws.avg_ws_tax) > 0.3 THEN 'MEDIUM_DIFF' ELSE 'LOW_DIFF' END AS diff_category FROM cc_tax cc JOIN ws_tax ws ON cc.state = ws.state ORDER BY tax_diff_rank LIMIT 25

WITH cc AS (
    SELECT
        cc_market_manager AS manager,
        cc_rec_start_date AS rec_start_date,
        cc_employees AS employees,
        'Call Center' AS entity_type
    FROM call_center
),
st AS (
    SELECT
        s_market_manager AS manager,
        s_rec_start_date AS rec_start_date,
        s_number_employees AS employees,
        'Store' AS entity_type
    FROM store
),
combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM cc
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM st
),
with_dates AS (
    SELECT
        c.manager,
        c.rec_start_date,
        c.employees,
        c.entity_type,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_quarter_name
    FROM combined c
    LEFT JOIN date_dim d ON c.rec_start_date = d.d_date
),
lagged AS (
    SELECT
        manager,
        entity_type,
        rec_start_date,
        employees,
        d_year,
        d_quarter_name,
        LAG(employees) OVER (PARTITION BY manager, entity_type ORDER BY rec_start_date) AS prev_employees
    FROM with_dates
),
total_emp AS (
    SELECT
        manager,
        SUM(employees) AS total_employees
    FROM lagged
    GROUP BY manager
)
SELECT
    l.manager,
    l.entity_type,
    l.rec_start_date,
    l.employees,
    l.prev_employees,
    (l.employees - l.prev_employees) AS employee_change,
    CASE
        WHEN l.prev_employees IS NULL THEN 'N/A'
        WHEN l.employees > l.prev_employees THEN 'Growth'
        WHEN l.employees = l.prev_employees THEN 'Stable'
        WHEN l.employees < l.prev_employees THEN 'Decline'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS change_category,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t.total_employees DESC) AS manager_employee_rank
FROM lagged l
JOIN total_emp t ON l.manager = t.manager
WHERE l.employees IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY manager_employee_rank, l.manager, l.rec_start_date

WITH cc_data AS (
    SELECT
        cc_zip AS zip,
        cc_tax_percentage AS tax_pct,
        cc_employees AS employees,
        cc_sq_ft AS sq_ft
    FROM call_center
    WHERE cc_zip IS NOT NULL
),
store_data AS (
    SELECT
        s_zip AS zip,
        s_tax_percentage AS tax_pct,
        s_number_employees AS employees,
        s_floor_space AS sq_ft
    FROM store
    WHERE s_zip IS NOT NULL
),
web_data AS (
    SELECT
        web_zip AS zip,
        web_tax_percentage AS tax_pct,
        0 AS employees,
        0 AS sq_ft
    FROM web_site
    WHERE web_zip IS NOT NULL
),
combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM cc_data
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM store_data
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM web_data
),
agg_zip AS (
    SELECT
        zip,
        SUM(employees) AS total_employees,
        SUM(sq_ft) AS total_sq_ft,
        AVG(tax_pct) AS avg_tax_pct
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY zip
)
SELECT
    zip,
    total_employees,
    total_sq_ft,
    avg_tax_pct,
    CASE WHEN avg_tax_pct > 7 THEN 'High Tax' ELSE 'Low Tax' END AS tax_category,
    (total_employees + total_sq_ft / 100.0) AS combined_metric,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (total_employees + total_sq_ft / 100.0) DESC) AS zip_rank
FROM agg_zip
WHERE total_employees > 0 OR total_sq_ft > 0
ORDER BY zip_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH cc_q AS (
    SELECT
        cc_state AS state,
        od.d_year AS year,
        od.d_quarter_name AS quarter,
        cc_tax_percentage AS tax_pct,
        cc_employees AS employees,
        cc_sq_ft AS sq_ft
    FROM call_center
    LEFT JOIN date_dim od ON call_center.cc_open_date_sk = od.d_date_sk
),
store_q AS (
    SELECT
        s_state AS state,
        cd.d_year AS year,
        cd.d_quarter_name AS quarter,
        s_tax_percentage AS tax_pct,
        s_number_employees AS employees,
        s_floor_space AS sq_ft
    FROM store
    LEFT JOIN date_dim cd ON store.s_closed_date_sk = cd.d_date_sk
),
web_q AS (
    SELECT
        web_state AS state,
        od.d_year AS year,
        od.d_quarter_name AS quarter,
        web_tax_percentage AS tax_pct,
        0 AS employees,
        0 AS sq_ft
    FROM web_site
    LEFT JOIN date_dim od ON web_site.web_open_date_sk = od.d_date_sk
),
combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM cc_q
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM store_q
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM web_q
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        state,
        year,
        quarter,
        AVG(tax_pct) AS avg_tax_pct,
        SUM(employees) AS total_employees,
        SUM(sq_ft) AS total_sq_ft
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY state, year, quarter
)
SELECT
    state,
    year,
    quarter,
    avg_tax_pct,
    CASE WHEN avg_tax_pct > 5 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS tax_category,
    total_employees,
    total_sq_ft,
    total_employees / NULLIF(total_sq_ft, 0) AS employee_density,
    AVG(avg_tax_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY year, quarter ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_4q_avg_tax,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_employees / NULLIF(total_sq_ft, 0) DESC) AS density_rank_by_year
FROM agg
WHERE total_sq_ft > 0
ORDER BY state, year, quarter

WITH page_monthly AS ( SELECT d.d_year, d.d_moy AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_id) AS pages_created, SUM(wp.wp_link_count) AS total_links, SUM(wp.wp_image_count) AS total_images, AVG(wp.wp_char_count) AS avg_char_count FROM web_page wp JOIN date_dim d ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_moy ) SELECT d_year, month, pages_created, total_links, total_images, avg_char_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY total_links DESC) AS link_rank_in_year, SUM(total_links) OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_links, CASE WHEN total_links >= 1000 THEN 'High Activity' WHEN total_links >= 500 THEN 'Medium Activity' ELSE 'Low Activity' END AS activity_level FROM page_monthly ORDER BY d_year, month

WITH page_profit AS ( SELECT cp.cp_department, d.d_year, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, AVG(ss.ss_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price, CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_status FROM catalog_page cp JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN cp.cp_start_date_sk AND cp.cp_end_date_sk JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_department, d.d_year, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_catalog_page_number ), ranked_pages AS ( SELECT cp_department, d_year, cp_catalog_page_id, cp_catalog_page_number, total_net_profit, avg_sales_price, profit_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department, d_year ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM page_profit ) SELECT cp_department, d_year, cp_catalog_page_id, cp_catalog_page_number, total_net_profit, avg_sales_price, profit_status, profit_rank FROM ranked_pages WHERE profit_rank <= 5 ORDER BY cp_department, d_year, profit_rank

WITH customer_engagement AS ( SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk, d_sold.d_year, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_purchase, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT cp.cp_catalog_page_id) AS distinct_catalog_pages FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk JOIN web_page wp ON ss.ss_customer_sk = wp.wp_customer_sk AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk = wp.wp_access_date_sk JOIN catalog_page cp ON wp.wp_access_date_sk BETWEEN cp.cp_start_date_sk AND cp.cp_end_date_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk, d_sold.d_year ), ranked_customers AS ( SELECT ss_customer_sk, d_year, total_purchase, total_quantity, distinct_catalog_pages, CASE WHEN total_purchase >= 2000 THEN 'Big Spender' WHEN total_purchase >= 1000 THEN 'Medium Spender' ELSE 'Regular' END AS spender_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY total_purchase DESC) AS purchase_rank FROM customer_engagement ) SELECT ss_customer_sk, d_year, total_purchase, total_quantity, distinct_catalog_pages, spender_category, purchase_rank FROM ranked_customers WHERE purchase_rank <= 10 ORDER BY d_year, purchase_rank

WITH aggregated AS ( SELECT d.d_year AS year, d.d_quarter_name AS quarter, w.web_name AS website, r.r_reason_desc AS reason, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, AVG(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS distinct_orders, CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) > 50000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_amount_category FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN web_site w ON d.d_date_sk BETWEEN w.web_open_date_sk AND w.web_close_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_quarter_name, w.web_name, r.r_reason_desc HAVING SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) > 0 ) SELECT year, quarter, website, reason, total_return_amount, total_net_loss, avg_return_quantity, distinct_orders, return_amount_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year, website ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year, website ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank FROM aggregated ORDER BY year DESC, website, amount_rank

WITH website_aggregates AS ( SELECT w.web_name, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, AVG(cr.cr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN web_site w ON d.d_date_sk BETWEEN w.web_open_date_sk AND w.web_close_date_sk GROUP BY w.web_name ), website_reason_agg AS ( SELECT w.web_name, r.r_reason_desc, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS reason_return_amount FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN web_site w ON d.d_date_sk BETWEEN w.web_open_date_sk AND w.web_close_date_sk GROUP BY w.web_name, r.r_reason_desc ), website_reason_ranks AS ( SELECT web_name, r_reason_desc, reason_return_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY web_name ORDER BY reason_return_amount DESC) AS reason_rank FROM website_reason_agg ) SELECT wa.web_name, wa.total_return_amount, wa.avg_net_loss, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY wa.total_return_amount DESC) AS return_amount_quartile, wr.r_reason_desc AS top_reason, wr.reason_return_amount AS top_reason_amount FROM website_aggregates wa JOIN website_reason_ranks wr ON wa.web_name = wr.web_name WHERE wr.reason_rank = 1 ORDER BY return_amount_quartile, wa.total_return_amount DESC

WITH customer_yearly AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS returning_customer_id, d.d_year AS year, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS num_returns, AVG(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_quantity, w.web_state FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN web_site w ON d.d_date_sk BETWEEN w.web_open_date_sk AND w.web_close_date_sk WHERE w.web_country = 'United States' GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, d.d_year, w.web_state HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ) SELECT returning_customer_id, year, total_return_amount, total_net_loss, num_returns, avg_return_quantity, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 100000 THEN 'High Net Loss' ELSE 'Low Net Loss' END AS net_loss_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS amount_rank_in_year, ROUND(total_return_amount * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY year), 0), 2) AS pct_of_year_total_return, CASE WHEN web_state IN ('CA', 'NY', 'TX') THEN 'Major State' ELSE 'Other State' END AS state_category FROM customer_yearly ORDER BY year DESC, amount_rank_in_year

WITH daily_website_returns AS ( SELECT w.web_name, d.d_date, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS daily_return_amount FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN web_site w ON d.d_date_sk BETWEEN w.web_open_date_sk AND w.web_close_date_sk GROUP BY w.web_name, d.d_date ), daily_reason_totals AS ( SELECT w.web_name, d.d_date, r.r_reason_desc, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS reason_return_amount FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN web_site w ON d.d_date_sk BETWEEN w.web_open_date_sk AND w.web_close_date_sk GROUP BY w.web_name, d.d_date, r.r_reason_desc ), top_reason_per_day AS ( SELECT dr.web_name, dr.d_date, dr.r_reason_desc, dr.reason_return_amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dr.web_name, dr.d_date ORDER BY dr.reason_return_amount DESC) AS reason_rank FROM daily_reason_totals dr ) SELECT dwr.web_name, dwr.d_date, dwr.daily_return_amount, SUM(dwr.daily_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY dwr.web_name ORDER BY dwr.d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return_amount, LAG(dwr.daily_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY dwr.web_name ORDER BY dwr.d_date) AS previous_day_return, CASE WHEN LAG(dwr.daily_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY dwr.web_name ORDER BY dwr.d_date) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN LAG(dwr.daily_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY dwr.web_name ORDER BY dwr.d_date) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (dwr.daily_return_amount - LAG(dwr.daily_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY dwr.web_name ORDER BY dwr.d_date)) / LAG(dwr.daily_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY dwr.web_name ORDER BY dwr.d_date) * 100 END AS day_change_pct, trd.r_reason_desc AS top_reason, trd.reason_return_amount AS top_reason_amount FROM daily_website_returns dwr LEFT JOIN top_reason_per_day trd ON dwr.web_name = trd.web_name AND dwr.d_date = trd.d_date AND trd.reason_rank = 1 ORDER BY dwr.web_name, dwr.d_date

WITH store_stats AS ( SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amount, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM store_sales ss JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk WHERE ss.ss_ext_discount_amt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound ) SELECT ss_store_sk, ib_income_band_sk, transaction_count, total_sales, avg_discount_amount, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales) AS sales_quartile FROM store_stats WHERE transaction_count BETWEEN 5 AND 100 ORDER BY sales_quartile, total_sales DESC

WITH store_stats AS ( SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, COUNT(DISTINCT hd.hd_demo_sk) AS household_count, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amount, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) - SUM(ss.ss_ext_list_price) AS discount_vs_list, CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 2000000 THEN 'Very High Sales' WHEN SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 1000000 THEN 'High Sales' ELSE 'Moderate Sales' END AS sales_category FROM store_sales ss JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk WHERE hd.hd_dep_count >= 2 AND ss.ss_quantity > 5 GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound HAVING SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 500000 ) SELECT ss_store_sk, ib_income_band_sk, household_count, total_sales, discount_vs_list, sales_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sales_category ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS rn FROM store_stats ORDER BY rn LIMIT 20

WITH store_stats AS ( SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS unique_customers, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, MAX(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS max_discount FROM store_sales ss JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk WHERE ss.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2453650 GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound ) SELECT ss_store_sk, ib_income_band_sk, unique_customers, total_sales, max_discount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM store_stats WHERE max_discount > 50 ORDER BY sales_rank LIMIT 10

WITH promo_period AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, CASE WHEN p.p_channel_email = 'Y' THEN 'Email' WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV' WHEN p.p_channel_radio = 'Y' THEN 'Radio' ELSE 'Other' END AS primary_channel, CASE WHEN ss.ss_sold_date_sk < p.p_start_date_sk THEN 'pre' ELSE 'post' END AS period, COUNT(*) AS sales_count, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, AVG(ss.ss_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amt FROM store_sales ss JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk WHERE ss.ss_item_sk = p.p_item_sk AND ss.ss_net_profit > 0 GROUP BY p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_channel_email, p.p_channel_tv, p.p_channel_radio, CASE WHEN ss.ss_sold_date_sk < p.p_start_date_sk THEN 'pre' ELSE 'post' END ) SELECT pp.p_promo_id, pp.p_promo_name, pp.primary_channel, pp.period, pp.sales_count, pp.total_sales, pp.avg_sales_price, pp.avg_discount_amt, SUM(pp.total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY pp.primary_channel) AS channel_total_sales FROM promo_period pp WHERE pp.primary_channel IN ('Email','TV') ORDER BY channel_total_sales DESC, pp.p_promo_id

SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COUNT(cs.cs_order_number) AS total_orders, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amount, AVG(i.i_current_price) AS avg_item_price, CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 10000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 5000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 1000 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS profit_tier, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 20

WITH sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales_amount, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk ), returns AS ( SELECT wr.wr_item_sk AS item_sk, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity FROM web_returns wr GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk ) SELECT i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_brand, COALESCE(s.total_sales_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(r.total_return_amount, 0) AS total_return_amount, COALESCE(s.total_sales_amount, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_amount, 0) AS net_revenue, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.total_sales_amount, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_amount, 0) > 10000 THEN 'High' WHEN COALESCE(s.total_sales_amount, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_amount, 0) > 5000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS revenue_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_category ORDER BY COALESCE(s.total_sales_amount, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_amount, 0) DESC) AS category_rank FROM item i LEFT JOIN sales s ON i.i_item_sk = s.item_sk LEFT JOIN returns r ON i.i_item_sk = r.item_sk ORDER BY i.i_category, category_rank LIMIT 50

SELECT i.i_category, cd.cd_gender AS returning_gender, wr.wr_reason_sk, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity, AVG(wr.wr_return_tax) AS avg_return_tax, CASE WHEN SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) > 5000 THEN 'High Return' WHEN SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) > 2000 THEN 'Medium Return' ELSE 'Low Return' END AS return_severity, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_category ORDER BY SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) DESC) AS category_return_rank FROM web_returns wr JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY i.i_category, cd.cd_gender, wr.wr_reason_sk HAVING SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) > 0 ORDER BY i.i_category, category_return_rank LIMIT 100

WITH daily_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_call_center_sk AS call_center_sk, i.i_brand, cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, cd.cd_gender, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS daily_net_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_call_center_sk, i.i_brand, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, cd.cd_gender ), daily_returns AS ( SELECT cs.cs_call_center_sk AS call_center_sk, i.i_brand, cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS daily_return_loss FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN web_returns wr ON cs.cs_order_number = wr.wr_order_number JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_call_center_sk, i.i_brand, cs.cs_sold_date_sk ), combined_daily AS ( SELECT ds.call_center_sk, ds.i_brand, ds.sold_date_sk, ds.cd_gender, ds.daily_net_profit, COALESCE(dr.daily_return_loss, 0) AS daily_return_loss, ds.daily_net_profit - COALESCE(dr.daily_return_loss, 0) AS net_profit_after_returns FROM daily_sales ds LEFT JOIN daily_returns dr ON ds.call_center_sk = dr.call_center_sk AND ds.i_brand = dr.i_brand AND ds.sold_date_sk = dr.sold_date_sk ), cumulative AS ( SELECT call_center_sk, i_brand, cd_gender, sold_date_sk, net_profit_after_returns, SUM(net_profit_after_returns) OVER (PARTITION BY call_center_sk, i_brand ORDER BY sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_profit FROM combined_daily ) SELECT call_center_sk, i_brand, cd_gender, sold_date_sk, net_profit_after_returns, cumulative_net_profit, CASE WHEN net_profit_after_returns > 1000 THEN 'Excellent Day' WHEN net_profit_after_returns > 0 THEN 'Good Day' ELSE 'Loss Day' END AS day_performance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_brand ORDER BY cumulative_net_profit DESC) AS brand_center_cumulative_rank FROM cumulative ORDER BY i_brand, brand_center_cumulative_rank, sold_date_sk LIMIT 200

WITH combined_sales AS (
  SELECT
    p.p_promo_sk,
    p.p_promo_name,
    cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS revenue
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  INNER JOIN promotion p
    ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, cs.cs_item_sk
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    p.p_promo_sk,
    p.p_promo_name,
    ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS revenue
  FROM web_sales ws
  INNER JOIN promotion p
    ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, ws.ws_item_sk
),
agg_sales AS (
  SELECT
    p_promo_sk,
    p_promo_name,
    item_sk,
    SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
  FROM combined_sales
  GROUP BY p_promo_sk, p_promo_name, item_sk
),
ranked_sales AS (
  SELECT
    p_promo_name AS promo_name,
    item_sk,
    total_revenue,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p_promo_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank
  FROM agg_sales
)
SELECT
  promo_name,
  item_sk,
  total_revenue,
  revenue_rank
FROM ranked_sales
WHERE revenue_rank <= 5
ORDER BY promo_name, revenue_rank

WITH catalog_profit AS (
  SELECT
    cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
    p.p_promo_sk,
    p.p_promo_name,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_net_profit
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  INNER JOIN promotion p
    ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name
),
web_profit AS (
  SELECT
    ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
    p.p_promo_sk,
    p.p_promo_name,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit
  FROM web_sales ws
  INNER JOIN promotion p
    ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name
),
combined_profit AS (
  SELECT
    cp.item_sk,
    cp.p_promo_sk,
    cp.p_promo_name,
    cp.catalog_net_profit,
    wp.web_net_profit,
    CASE 
      WHEN wp.web_net_profit = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE cp.catalog_net_profit / wp.web_net_profit
    END AS profit_ratio
  FROM catalog_profit cp
  LEFT JOIN web_profit wp
    ON cp.item_sk = wp.item_sk
    AND cp.p_promo_sk = wp.p_promo_sk
)
SELECT
  item_sk,
  p_promo_name,
  catalog_net_profit,
  web_net_profit,
  profit_ratio,
  LAG(profit_ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY p_promo_name ORDER BY item_sk) AS prev_profit_ratio,
  profit_ratio - LAG(profit_ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY p_promo_name ORDER BY item_sk) AS profit_ratio_change
FROM combined_profit
WHERE profit_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p_promo_name, profit_ratio DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH catalog_agg AS (
  SELECT
    cp.cp_department,
    p.p_channel_tv,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  INNER JOIN catalog_page cp
    ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
  INNER JOIN promotion p
    ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  GROUP BY cp.cp_department, p.p_channel_tv
),
web_agg AS (
  SELECT
    'Web' AS cp_department,
    p.p_channel_tv,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit
  FROM web_sales ws
  INNER JOIN promotion p
    ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  GROUP BY p.p_channel_tv
)
SELECT
  department,
  channel_tv,
  total_profit,
  CASE WHEN total_profit >= 10000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_tv ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM (
  SELECT cp_department AS department, p_channel_tv AS channel_tv, total_profit
  FROM catalog_agg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cp_department AS department, p_channel_tv AS channel_tv, total_profit
  FROM web_agg
) AS combined
ORDER BY channel_tv, profit_rank

WITH discount_data AS (
  SELECT
    cp.cp_type,
    p.p_purpose,
    cs.cs_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
    cs.cs_order_number AS transaction_id
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  INNER JOIN catalog_page cp
    ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
  INNER JOIN promotion p
    ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Web' AS cp_type,
    p.p_purpose,
    ws.ws_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
    ws.ws_order_number AS transaction_id
  FROM web_sales ws
  INNER JOIN promotion p
    ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    cp_type,
    p_purpose,
    SUM(discount_amt) AS total_discount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_id) AS transaction_cnt,
    CASE
      WHEN SUM(discount_amt) > 5000 THEN 'High'
      WHEN SUM(discount_amt) > 1000 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Low'
    END AS discount_category
  FROM discount_data
  GROUP BY cp_type, p_purpose
)
SELECT
  cp_type,
  p_purpose,
  total_discount,
  transaction_cnt,
  total_discount / transaction_cnt AS avg_discount_per_txn,
  discount_category,
  SUM(total_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type ORDER BY p_purpose
                            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_discount_by_type
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY cp_type, total_discount DESC

WITH warehouse_stats AS (
    SELECT
        w.w_warehouse_id AS warehouse_id,
        w.w_state AS state,
        w.w_city AS city,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        SUM(cr.cr_fee) AS total_fee,
        AVG(cr.cr_return_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost,
        COUNT(*) AS return_txn_count,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_id, w.w_state, w.w_city
)
SELECT
    warehouse_id,
    state,
    city,
    total_net_loss,
    total_fee,
    avg_ship_cost,
    return_txn_count,
    total_return_quantity,
    CASE
        WHEN total_net_loss > 2000 THEN 'HIGH_LOSS'
        WHEN total_net_loss > 500 THEN 'MEDIUM_LOSS'
        ELSE 'LOW_LOSS'
    END AS loss_category,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY total_net_loss) AS net_loss_percentile_state,
    NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_quartile_state,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_fee DESC) AS fee_rank_global
FROM warehouse_stats
ORDER BY state, net_loss_percentile_state DESC

WITH daily_returns AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_type AS cp_type,
        i.i_category AS category,
        cp.cp_start_date_sk AS start_date_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS return_txn_cnt
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY cp.cp_type, i.i_category, cp.cp_start_date_sk
)
SELECT
    cp_type,
    category,
    start_date_sk,
    total_return_amount,
    total_net_loss,
    return_txn_cnt,
    SUM(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type ORDER BY start_date_sk
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return_amount_by_type,
    LAG(total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type, category ORDER BY start_date_sk) AS prev_net_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN LAG(total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type, category ORDER BY start_date_sk) IS NULL THEN 'N/A'
        WHEN total_net_loss > LAG(total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type, category ORDER BY start_date_sk) THEN 'INCREASE'
        ELSE 'DECREASE_OR_SAME'
    END AS net_loss_trend,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS return_amount_rank_within_type
FROM daily_returns
WHERE total_return_amount > 0
ORDER BY cp_type, start_date_sk

WITH item_aggregates AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id AS i_id,
        i.i_product_name AS product_name,
        i.i_category AS category,
        i.i_brand AS brand,
        i.i_current_price AS current_price,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity,
        AVG(cr.cr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS return_transactions
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_brand, i.i_current_price
)
SELECT
    i_id,
    product_name,
    category,
    brand,
    current_price,
    total_return_amount,
    total_return_quantity,
    avg_net_loss,
    return_transactions,
    CASE
        WHEN current_price < 20 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN current_price BETWEEN 20 AND 100 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS price_bucket,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS return_amount_rank,
    SUM(total_return_amount) OVER (
        PARTITION BY CASE
            WHEN current_price < 20 THEN 'Low'
            WHEN current_price BETWEEN 20 AND 100 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'High'
        END
        ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_return_amount_by_bucket
FROM item_aggregates
WHERE total_return_amount > 0
ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH page_returns AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_catalog_page_id AS cp_id,
        cp.cp_department AS department,
        cp.cp_type AS type,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_number AS page_number,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
        AVG(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_quantity,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_item_sk) AS distinct_items_returned,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cr.cr_return_amount > 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_value_returns
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_type, cp.cp_catalog_page_number
)
SELECT
    cp_id,
    department,
    type,
    page_number,
    total_net_loss,
    total_return_amount,
    avg_return_quantity,
    return_count,
    distinct_items_returned,
    high_value_returns,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS dept_net_loss_rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY type ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS type_return_amount_dense_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN total_net_loss > 1000 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS net_loss_category
FROM page_returns
ORDER BY department, dept_net_loss_rank

WITH site_monthly AS (SELECT ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, ws.web_state, ws.web_country, dr_ret.d_year, dr_ret.d_month_seq, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, MAX(wr.wr_return_tax) AS max_return_tax FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim dr_ret ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dr_ret.d_date_sk JOIN web_site ws ON dr_ret.d_date_sk BETWEEN ws.web_open_date_sk AND ws.web_close_date_sk WHERE dr_ret.d_year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2020 GROUP BY ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, ws.web_state, ws.web_country, dr_ret.d_year, dr_ret.d_month_seq) SELECT sm.web_site_id, sm.web_name, sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq, sm.total_return_amt, sm.return_cnt, sm.max_return_tax, LAG(sm.total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY sm.web_site_id ORDER BY sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq) AS prev_month_return_amt, ROUND((sm.total_return_amt - LAG(sm.total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY sm.web_site_id ORDER BY sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq)) / NULLIF(LAG(sm.total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY sm.web_site_id ORDER BY sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq),0) * 100, 2) AS mom_growth_pct, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.d_year ORDER BY sm.total_return_amt DESC) AS yearly_rank FROM site_monthly sm WHERE sm.total_return_amt > 500 ORDER BY sm.d_year, sm.total_return_amt DESC LIMIT 30

WITH site_monthly AS (SELECT ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, ws.web_state, ws.web_country, dr_ret.d_year, dr_ret.d_month_seq, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, AVG(wr.wr_return_tax) AS avg_return_tax FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim dr_ret ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dr_ret.d_date_sk JOIN web_site ws ON dr_ret.d_date_sk BETWEEN ws.web_open_date_sk AND ws.web_close_date_sk GROUP BY ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, ws.web_state, ws.web_country, dr_ret.d_year, dr_ret.d_month_seq) SELECT sm.web_site_id, sm.web_name, sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq, sm.total_return_amt, sm.avg_return_tax, FIRST_VALUE(sm.total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY sm.web_site_id ORDER BY sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_month_return, LAST_VALUE(sm.total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY sm.web_site_id ORDER BY sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_month_return, CASE WHEN sm.total_return_amt = FIRST_VALUE(sm.total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY sm.web_site_id ORDER BY sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq) THEN 'Start' ELSE 'Mid' END AS period_phase, (SELECT SUM(cc.cc_employees) FROM call_center cc WHERE cc.cc_state = sm.web_state) AS total_employees_state, (SELECT MIN(cc.cc_tax_percentage) FROM call_center cc WHERE cc.cc_country = sm.web_country) AS min_state_tax FROM site_monthly sm WHERE sm.total_return_amt BETWEEN 100 AND 5000 ORDER BY sm.total_return_amt DESC LIMIT 25

WITH site_monthly AS (SELECT ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, ws.web_state, ws.web_country, dr_ret.d_year, dr_ret.d_month_seq, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, AVG(wr.wr_return_tax) AS avg_return_tax FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim dr_ret ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dr_ret.d_date_sk JOIN web_site ws ON dr_ret.d_date_sk BETWEEN ws.web_open_date_sk AND ws.web_close_date_sk WHERE ws.web_state = 'CA' AND dr_ret.d_month_seq IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, ws.web_state, ws.web_country, dr_ret.d_year, dr_ret.d_month_seq) SELECT sm.web_site_id, sm.web_name, sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq, sm.total_return_amt, sm.avg_return_tax, SUM(sm.total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY sm.web_site_id ORDER BY sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return, CASE WHEN sm.avg_return_tax > 0.05 THEN 'HighTax' ELSE 'LowTax' END AS tax_category, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cc.cc_call_center_id) FROM call_center cc WHERE cc.cc_state = sm.web_state AND cc.cc_country = sm.web_country) AS call_center_cnt FROM site_monthly sm ORDER BY sm.total_return_amt ASC LIMIT 15

WITH site_monthly AS (SELECT ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, ws.web_state, ws.web_country, dr_ret.d_year, dr_ret.d_month_seq, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim dr_ret ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dr_ret.d_date_sk JOIN web_site ws ON dr_ret.d_date_sk BETWEEN ws.web_open_date_sk AND ws.web_close_date_sk WHERE wr.wr_return_amt > 0 GROUP BY ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, ws.web_state, ws.web_country, dr_ret.d_year, dr_ret.d_month_seq HAVING SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) > 2000) SELECT sm.web_site_id, sm.web_name, sm.d_year, sm.d_month_seq, sm.total_return_amt, NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY sm.d_year ORDER BY sm.total_return_amt DESC) AS quartile, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.web_site_id ORDER BY sm.total_return_amt DESC) AS site_rank, (SELECT AVG(cc.cc_sq_ft) FROM call_center cc WHERE cc.cc_state = sm.web_state) AS avg_sq_ft_state FROM site_monthly sm WHERE sm.d_year = 2021 ORDER BY sm.total_return_amt DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT sm.sm_type,
       sm.sm_carrier,
       td.t_meal_time,
       hd_ret.hd_buy_potential,
       SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
       AVG(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_qty,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS distinct_orders,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.sm_type ORDER BY SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) DESC) AS rn,
       CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 20000 THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 12000 THEN 'Elevated'
            ELSE 'Low' END AS loss_category
FROM catalog_returns cr
JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_ret ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_ret.hd_demo_sk
WHERE cr.cr_return_quantity BETWEEN 2 AND 5
GROUP BY sm.sm_type, sm.sm_carrier, td.t_meal_time, hd_ret.hd_buy_potential
HAVING SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 5000
ORDER BY avg_return_qty ASC, total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH combined_sales AS (
  SELECT
    cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
    cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax AS net_paid_inc_tax,
    'catalog' AS channel,
    cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
    ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax AS net_paid_inc_tax,
    'web' AS channel,
    ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk
  FROM web_sales ws
),
sales_by_date_category AS (
  SELECT
    cs.date_sk,
    i.i_category,
    cs.channel,
    SUM(cs.net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_net_paid_inc_tax
  FROM combined_sales cs
  JOIN item i ON cs.item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  GROUP BY cs.date_sk, i.i_category, cs.channel
),
running_totals AS (
  SELECT
    date_sk,
    i_category,
    channel,
    total_net_paid_inc_tax,
    SUM(total_net_paid_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_by_category
  FROM sales_by_date_category
)
SELECT
  date_sk,
  i_category,
  channel,
  total_net_paid_inc_tax,
  cumulative_by_category
FROM running_totals
ORDER BY i_category, date_sk

WITH brand_gmt_page_returns AS ( SELECT ca.ca_gmt_offset, i.i_brand, wp.wp_type, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_ret_qty, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, AVG(wr.wr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_gmt_offset, i.i_brand, wp.wp_type ) SELECT ca_gmt_offset, i_brand, wp_type, total_net_loss, total_ret_qty, return_cnt, avg_net_loss, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 200000 THEN 'HIGH_LOSS' WHEN total_net_loss BETWEEN 50000 AND 200000 THEN 'MEDIUM_LOSS' ELSE 'LOW_LOSS' END AS loss_category, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_gmt_offset ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_percentile, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_gmt_offset ORDER BY total_ret_qty DESC) AS qty_rank FROM brand_gmt_page_returns ORDER BY ca_gmt_offset, loss_percentile DESC

WITH page_return_metrics AS ( SELECT wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_type, wp.wp_url, wp.wp_creation_date_sk, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_ret_amt_inc_tax, AVG(i.i_wholesale_cost) AS avg_wholesale_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.ca_country) AS distinct_country_cnt, AVG(ca.ca_gmt_offset) AS avg_gmt_offset FROM web_returns wr JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_type, wp.wp_url, wp.wp_creation_date_sk ) SELECT wp_web_page_id, wp_type, wp_url, return_cnt, total_net_loss, total_ret_amt_inc_tax, avg_wholesale_cost, distinct_country_cnt, avg_gmt_offset, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 500000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN total_net_loss BETWEEN 100000 AND 500000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS net_loss_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank, total_net_loss * 100.0 / SUM(total_net_loss) OVER () AS pct_of_total_net_loss FROM page_return_metrics WHERE return_cnt > 5 ORDER BY net_loss_rank LIMIT 15

WITH item_state_returns AS ( SELECT i.i_category, ca.ca_state, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_brand, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_ret_amt_inc_tax, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_ret_qty, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, AVG(wr.wr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY i.i_category, ca.ca_state, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_brand ) SELECT i_category, ca_state, i_item_id, i_product_name, i_brand, total_ret_amt_inc_tax, total_ret_qty, total_net_loss, return_cnt, avg_net_loss, CASE WHEN total_ret_amt_inc_tax > 0 THEN total_net_loss / total_ret_amt_inc_tax END AS net_loss_ratio, category_rank FROM ( SELECT i_category, ca_state, i_item_id, i_product_name, i_brand, total_ret_amt_inc_tax, total_ret_qty, total_net_loss, return_cnt, avg_net_loss, CASE WHEN total_ret_amt_inc_tax > 0 THEN total_net_loss / total_ret_amt_inc_tax END AS net_loss_ratio, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY total_ret_amt_inc_tax DESC) AS category_rank FROM item_state_returns ) t WHERE category_rank <= 5 ORDER BY i_category, category_rank

WITH state_page_item_returns AS ( SELECT ca.ca_state, wp.wp_type, i.i_category, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amt_inc_tax, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, AVG(wr.wr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_state, wp.wp_type, i.i_category ) SELECT ca_state, wp_type, i_category, total_net_loss, total_return_amt_inc_tax, return_cnt, avg_net_loss, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 1000000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN total_net_loss BETWEEN 100000 AND 1000000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS net_loss_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS page_type_category_rank, total_net_loss * 100.0 / SUM(total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state) AS pct_of_state_net_loss FROM state_page_item_returns WHERE return_cnt > 5 ORDER BY ca_state, page_type_category_rank LIMIT 50

WITH hourly_sales AS (SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, td.t_hour, td.t_minute, SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_paid_inc_tax, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM web_sales ws JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_name, td.t_hour, td.t_minute) SELECT hs.w_warehouse_name, hs.t_hour, hs.t_minute, hs.total_paid_inc_tax, hs.transaction_count, LAG(hs.total_paid_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY hs.w_warehouse_name ORDER BY hs.t_hour, hs.t_minute) AS prev_total_paid_inc_tax, CASE WHEN LAG(hs.total_paid_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY hs.w_warehouse_name ORDER BY hs.t_hour, hs.t_minute) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ((hs.total_paid_inc_tax - LAG(hs.total_paid_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY hs.w_warehouse_name ORDER BY hs.t_hour, hs.t_minute)) / NULLIF(LAG(hs.total_paid_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY hs.w_warehouse_name ORDER BY hs.t_hour, hs.t_minute), 0)) * 100 END AS pct_change, CASE WHEN ((hs.total_paid_inc_tax - LAG(hs.total_paid_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY hs.w_warehouse_name ORDER BY hs.t_hour, hs.t_minute)) / NULLIF(LAG(hs.total_paid_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY hs.w_warehouse_name ORDER BY hs.t_hour, hs.t_minute), 0)) > 0.30 THEN 'Spike' ELSE 'Normal' END AS sales_spike_flag FROM hourly_sales hs WHERE hs.t_hour IS NOT NULL ORDER BY hs.w_warehouse_name, hs.t_hour, hs.t_minute

WITH daily_sales AS (SELECT ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_warehouse_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS qty_sold_on_date FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_warehouse_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk), avg_sales AS (SELECT ds.ws_item_sk, ds.ws_warehouse_sk, SUM(ds.qty_sold_on_date) AS total_qty, COUNT(ds.ws_sold_date_sk) AS days_with_sales, SUM(ds.qty_sold_on_date) / NULLIF(COUNT(ds.ws_sold_date_sk), 0) AS avg_daily_qty FROM daily_sales ds GROUP BY ds.ws_item_sk, ds.ws_warehouse_sk), inv_agg AS (SELECT inv.inv_item_sk, inv.inv_warehouse_sk, SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_on_hand FROM inventory inv GROUP BY inv.inv_item_sk, inv.inv_warehouse_sk) SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, i.inv_item_sk, i.total_on_hand, a.avg_daily_qty, CASE WHEN a.avg_daily_qty = 0 OR a.avg_daily_qty IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE i.total_on_hand / a.avg_daily_qty END AS days_of_supply, CASE WHEN i.total_on_hand / NULLIF(a.avg_daily_qty, 0) >= 30 THEN 'Low' WHEN i.total_on_hand / NULLIF(a.avg_daily_qty, 0) BETWEEN 10 AND 29 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS stockout_risk, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_name ORDER BY i.total_on_hand / NULLIF(a.avg_daily_qty, 0) ASC) AS risk_rank FROM inv_agg i JOIN avg_sales a ON i.inv_item_sk = a.ws_item_sk AND i.inv_warehouse_sk = a.ws_warehouse_sk JOIN warehouse w ON w.w_warehouse_sk = i.inv_warehouse_sk WHERE a.avg_daily_qty > 0 ORDER BY w.w_warehouse_name, risk_rank LIMIT 100

WITH transaction_prices AS (SELECT ws.ws_warehouse_sk, ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_sales_price, td.t_meal_time, td.t_hour, td.t_time_sk FROM web_sales ws JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk), price_percentiles AS (SELECT tp.ws_warehouse_sk, tp.ws_item_sk, tp.t_meal_time, tp.ws_sales_price, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY tp.ws_warehouse_sk, tp.ws_item_sk, tp.t_meal_time ORDER BY tp.ws_sales_price) AS price_percentile FROM transaction_prices tp) SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, pp.ws_item_sk, pp.t_meal_time, COUNT(*) AS trans_cnt, AVG(pp.ws_sales_price) AS avg_price, MAX(CASE WHEN pp.price_percentile > 0.90 THEN pp.ws_sales_price END) AS premium_price_cutoff, CASE WHEN AVG(pp.ws_sales_price) > MAX(CASE WHEN pp.price_percentile > 0.90 THEN pp.ws_sales_price END) THEN 'Premium' ELSE 'Standard' END AS price_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_name ORDER BY AVG(pp.ws_sales_price) DESC) AS warehouse_price_rank FROM price_percentiles pp JOIN warehouse w ON w.w_warehouse_sk = pp.ws_warehouse_sk GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_name, pp.ws_item_sk, pp.t_meal_time HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY w.w_warehouse_name, warehouse_price_rank LIMIT 150

WITH ws_agg AS (SELECT ws.ws_warehouse_sk, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold FROM web_sales ws JOIN time_dim td ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk GROUP BY ws.ws_warehouse_sk), inv_agg AS (SELECT inv.inv_warehouse_sk, SUM(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_qty FROM inventory inv GROUP BY inv.inv_warehouse_sk) SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_state, ws.total_net_profit, ws.total_quantity_sold, inv.total_inventory_qty, ws.total_net_profit / NULLIF(inv.total_inventory_qty, 0) AS profit_per_inventory, CASE WHEN ws.total_net_profit / NULLIF(inv.total_inventory_qty, 0) > 100 THEN 'High' WHEN ws.total_net_profit / NULLIF(inv.total_inventory_qty, 0) BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ws.total_net_profit / NULLIF(inv.total_inventory_qty, 0) DESC) AS profit_per_inventory_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ws.total_net_profit DESC) AS total_profit_rank FROM ws_agg ws JOIN inv_agg inv ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk JOIN warehouse w ON w.w_warehouse_sk = ws.ws_warehouse_sk ORDER BY profit_per_inventory_rank LIMIT 50

WITH item_metrics AS ( SELECT cs.cs_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cs.cs_item_sk, hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_vehicle_count, hd.hd_income_band_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(cs.cs_quantity), 0) AS profit_per_unit, CASE WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count > 2 AND hd.hd_income_band_sk > 5 THEN 'High Value' ELSE 'Standard' END AS customer_segment FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cs.cs_item_sk, hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_vehicle_count, hd.hd_income_band_sk ) SELECT cs_call_center_sk, cc_name, cs_item_sk, customer_segment, total_profit, total_quantity, profit_per_unit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cs_call_center_sk ORDER BY profit_per_unit DESC) AS profit_rank_within_cc, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY profit_per_unit) AS global_profit_percentile, CASE WHEN profit_per_unit > 100 THEN 'Very Profitable' WHEN profit_per_unit > 50 THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Less Profitable' END AS profit_category FROM item_metrics WHERE total_quantity > 0 ORDER BY profit_per_unit DESC LIMIT 50

WITH loss_stats AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cr.cr_returned_date_sk, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS daily_net_loss, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS daily_sales, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk WHERE cr.cr_returned_date_sk IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cr.cr_returned_date_sk ), cumulative AS ( SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, cr_returned_date_sk, daily_net_loss, daily_sales, daily_net_loss / NULLIF(daily_sales, 0) AS loss_to_sales_ratio, SUM(daily_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_sk ORDER BY cr_returned_date_sk) AS cumulative_net_loss FROM loss_stats ) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, cr_returned_date_sk, daily_net_loss, daily_sales, loss_to_sales_ratio, cumulative_net_loss, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cumulative_net_loss DESC) AS cumulative_loss_rank, CASE WHEN loss_to_sales_ratio > 0.5 THEN 'Severe' WHEN loss_to_sales_ratio > 0.2 THEN 'Moderate' ELSE 'Mild' END AS loss_category FROM cumulative ORDER BY cumulative_loss_rank LIMIT 15

WITH returns_sales AS ( SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential, cc.cc_name, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk WHERE cr.cr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 20000101 AND 20001231 GROUP BY hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential, cc.cc_name ) SELECT hd_demo_sk, hd_buy_potential, cc_name, total_return_amount, total_sales_amount, total_return_amount / NULLIF(total_sales_amount, 0) AS return_ratio, CASE WHEN total_return_amount / NULLIF(total_sales_amount, 0) > 0.2 THEN 'High' WHEN total_return_amount / NULLIF(total_sales_amount, 0) > 0.1 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS return_amount_rank FROM returns_sales ORDER BY return_amount_rank LIMIT 20

WITH class_sales AS (SELECT ca_state, i_class, t_shift, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount FROM store_sales JOIN customer_address ON ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk JOIN time_dim ON ss_sold_time_sk = t_time_sk GROUP BY ca_state, i_class, t_shift) SELECT ca_state, i_class, t_shift, total_sales, avg_discount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state, t_shift ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS class_sales_rank, SUM(total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state, t_shift ORDER BY total_sales DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_sales, CASE WHEN avg_discount > 10 THEN 'High Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category FROM class_sales ORDER BY ca_state, t_shift, class_sales_rank

WITH profit_by_shift AS (SELECT ca_address_id, ca_city, t_shift, CASE WHEN t_shift = 'Morning' THEN 1 WHEN t_shift = 'Afternoon' THEN 2 WHEN t_shift = 'Evening' THEN 3 WHEN t_shift = 'Night' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS shift_order, SUM(ss_net_profit) AS shift_profit, MIN(i_brand) AS example_brand FROM store_sales JOIN time_dim ON ss_sold_time_sk = t_time_sk JOIN customer_address ON ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk GROUP BY ca_address_id, ca_city, t_shift), profit_change AS (SELECT ca_address_id, ca_city, t_shift, shift_order, shift_profit, example_brand, LAG(shift_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_address_id ORDER BY shift_order) AS prev_shift_profit, (shift_profit - LAG(shift_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_address_id ORDER BY shift_order)) AS profit_change FROM profit_by_shift) SELECT ca_address_id, ca_city, t_shift, shift_profit, prev_shift_profit, profit_change, CASE WHEN profit_change > 0 THEN 'Increase' ELSE 'Decrease/No Change' END AS change_indicator, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY profit_change DESC) AS profit_change_rank FROM profit_change WHERE shift_order > 1 ORDER BY profit_change_rank LIMIT 10
