WITH sales_by_item AS (SELECT ca_city, t_shift, i_item_id, i_product_name, SUM(ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(ss_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount FROM store_sales JOIN customer_address ON ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk JOIN time_dim ON ss_sold_time_sk = t_time_sk GROUP BY ca_city, t_shift, i_item_id, i_product_name), ranked_items AS (SELECT ca_city, t_shift, i_item_id, i_product_name, total_net_profit, total_quantity, total_sales, total_discount, CASE WHEN total_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE total_net_profit / total_sales END AS profit_margin, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_city, t_shift ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank, CASE WHEN total_net_profit / NULLIF(total_sales,0) > 0.2 THEN 'High' WHEN total_net_profit / NULLIF(total_sales,0) > 0.1 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category FROM sales_by_item) SELECT ca_city, t_shift, i_item_id, i_product_name, total_net_profit, total_quantity, total_sales, total_discount, profit_margin, profit_rank, profit_category FROM ranked_items WHERE profit_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ca_city, t_shift, profit_rank

WITH hourly_brand_city AS (SELECT ca_city, i_brand, t_hour, SUM(ss_net_profit) AS hour_profit, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS hour_sales, SUM(ss_quantity) AS hour_quantity FROM store_sales JOIN customer_address ON ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk JOIN time_dim ON ss_sold_time_sk = t_time_sk GROUP BY ca_city, i_brand, t_hour) SELECT ca_city, i_brand, t_hour, hour_profit, hour_sales, hour_quantity, AVG(hour_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_city, i_brand ORDER BY t_hour ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_profit_5h, SUM(hour_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_city, i_brand ORDER BY t_hour ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_profit, CASE WHEN hour_sales = 0 THEN 'No Sales' WHEN hour_profit / hour_sales > 0.2 THEN 'High Margin Hour' WHEN hour_profit > 0 THEN 'Profit Hour' ELSE 'Loss Hour' END AS profit_category FROM hourly_brand_city ORDER BY ca_city, i_brand, t_hour

SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_brand, ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_quantity AS sold_quantity, COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0) AS returned_quantity, (ss.ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) AS net_profit_after_returns, CASE WHEN i.i_current_price > 0 THEN (ss.ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) / i.i_current_price ELSE NULL END AS profit_margin, r.r_reason_desc, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.ss_store_sk ORDER BY (ss.ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM store_sales ss JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk LEFT JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk WHERE ss.ss_quantity > 0 ORDER BY ss.ss_store_sk, profit_rank LIMIT 100

WITH page_stats AS ( SELECT wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_url, wp.wp_type, c.c_customer_id AS page_owner_id, cd.cd_gender AS owner_gender, cd.cd_marital_status AS owner_marital_status, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_revenue, SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers, SUM(wp.wp_image_count) AS total_images FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN customer c ON wp.wp_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_url, wp.wp_type, c.c_customer_id, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status ) SELECT ps.wp_web_page_id, ps.wp_url, ps.wp_type, ps.page_owner_id, ps.owner_gender, ps.owner_marital_status, ps.total_revenue, ps.total_discount, ps.avg_discount, ps.distinct_customers, ps.total_images, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ps.avg_discount ASC) AS discount_percentile, SUM(ps.total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY ps.owner_gender) AS gender_total_revenue FROM page_stats ps WHERE ps.wp_type = 'article' GROUP BY ps.wp_web_page_id, ps.wp_url, ps.wp_type, ps.page_owner_id, ps.owner_gender, ps.owner_marital_status, ps.total_revenue, ps.total_discount, ps.avg_discount, ps.distinct_customers, ps.total_images, ps.owner_gender HAVING SUM(ps.total_revenue) > 10000 ORDER BY ps.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 30

WITH sales_by_store_month AS (
  SELECT
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    d_sold.d_year,
    d_sold.d_month_seq,
    d_sold.d_current_month,
    i.i_category,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
    SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS num_orders
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN date_dim d_sold
    ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
  JOIN store s
    ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
  JOIN item i
    ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  GROUP BY
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    d_sold.d_year,
    d_sold.d_month_seq,
    d_sold.d_current_month,
    i.i_category
)
SELECT
  s_store_id,
  s_store_name,
  d_year,
  d_current_month,
  i_category,
  total_profit,
  total_quantity,
  num_orders,
  CASE
    WHEN total_profit > 100000 THEN 'HIGH'
    WHEN total_profit > 50000 THEN 'MEDIUM'
    ELSE 'LOW'
  END AS profit_category,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_id, i_category ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS profit_month_rank
FROM sales_by_store_month
ORDER BY s_store_id, i_category, profit_month_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH promo_state_weekly AS (
  SELECT
    ws.ws_promo_sk,
    s.s_state,
    d.d_fy_quarter_seq,
    d.d_week_seq,
    d.d_current_year,
    i.i_category,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS profit,
    SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_qty,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS orders,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN date_dim d_ship ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
  JOIN store s ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
  JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  GROUP BY ws.ws_promo_sk, s.s_state, d.d_fy_quarter_seq, d.d_week_seq, d.d_current_year, i.i_category
),
promo_state_rank AS (
  SELECT
    ws_promo_sk,
    s_state,
    d_fy_quarter_seq,
    d_current_year,
    i_category,
    profit,
    total_qty,
    orders,
    total_sales,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s_state, d_fy_quarter_seq, d_current_year ORDER BY profit DESC) AS rank_state_quarter,
    CASE
      WHEN profit > 50000 THEN 'HIGH'
      WHEN profit > 20000 THEN 'MEDIUM'
      ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS profit_category
  FROM promo_state_weekly
)
SELECT
  ws_promo_sk,
  s_state,
  i_category,
  d_fy_quarter_seq AS fiscal_quarter,
  d_current_year,
  profit,
  total_qty,
  orders,
  total_sales,
  profit_category,
  rank_state_quarter
FROM promo_state_rank
WHERE rank_state_quarter <= 3
ORDER BY s_state, d_current_year, d_fy_quarter_seq, rank_state_quarter

WITH class_state_daily AS (
  SELECT
    i.i_class,
    s.s_state,
    d_sold.d_date,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS daily_profit
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk
  JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d_ship ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
  JOIN store s ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk
  GROUP BY i.i_class, s.s_state, d_sold.d_date
),
cumulative_profit AS (
  SELECT
    i_class,
    s_state,
    d_date,
    daily_profit,
    SUM(daily_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY i_class, s_state ORDER BY d_date
                            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_profit
  FROM class_state_daily
)
SELECT
  i_class,
  s_state,
  d_date,
  daily_profit,
  cum_profit,
  CASE
    WHEN LAG(cum_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY i_class, s_state ORDER BY d_date) IS NULL THEN 'START'
    WHEN cum_profit > LAG(cum_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY i_class, s_state ORDER BY d_date) THEN 'UP'
    WHEN cum_profit < LAG(cum_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY i_class, s_state ORDER BY d_date) THEN 'DOWN'
    ELSE 'NO_CHANGE'
  END AS trend,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_date ORDER BY cum_profit DESC) AS daily_class_state_rank
FROM cumulative_profit
WHERE d_date = (SELECT MAX(d_date) FROM date_dim)
ORDER BY i_class, s_state

WITH promo_stats AS (
  SELECT
    p.p_promo_id,
    p.p_promo_name,
    p.p_start_date_sk,
    p.p_end_date_sk,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
    AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cd.cd_gender = 'M' THEN ws.ws_net_profit ELSE 0 END) AS male_profit,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cd.cd_gender = 'F' THEN ws.ws_net_profit ELSE 0 END) AS female_profit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN p.p_promo_id END) AS active_promo_cnt,
    CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS discount_status
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  GROUP BY p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_start_date_sk, p.p_end_date_sk, p.p_discount_active
)
SELECT
  p.*,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM promo_stats p
WHERE total_net_profit > 0
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH sales_with_date AS (
  SELECT
    ws.ws_net_profit,
    ws.ws_ext_discount_amt,
    ws.ws_sales_price,
    p.p_channel_tv,
    DATE_PARSE(CAST(ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS VARCHAR), '%Y%m%d') AS sold_date,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', DATE_PARSE(CAST(ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS VARCHAR), '%Y%m%d')) AS month_start
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_ship_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
),
monthly_channel AS (
  SELECT
    month_start,
    p_channel_tv,
    SUM(ws_net_profit) AS month_profit,
    SUM(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS month_discount,
    AVG(ws_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price
  FROM sales_with_date
  GROUP BY month_start, p_channel_tv
)
SELECT
  month_start,
  p_channel_tv,
  month_profit,
  month_discount,
  avg_sales_price,
  month_profit - LAG(month_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY p_channel_tv ORDER BY month_start) AS profit_change,
  SUM(month_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY p_channel_tv ORDER BY month_start ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3_month_profit,
  CASE WHEN month_profit > 0 THEN 'Positive' ELSE 'Negative' END AS profit_indicator
FROM monthly_channel
ORDER BY month_start DESC, p_channel_tv
LIMIT 100

WITH cust_agg AS (
  SELECT
    ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
    MIN(ws.ws_sold_date_sk) AS first_sold_date,
    MAX(ws.ws_sold_date_sk) AS last_sold_date,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
    SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity,
    AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN p.p_promo_id END) AS active_promo_cnt,
    cd.cd_gender,
    ca.ca_state,
    ca.ca_city,
    CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS discount_status
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk, cd.cd_gender, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_city, p.p_discount_active
),
cust_rank AS (
  SELECT
    ws_bill_customer_sk,
    total_net_profit,
    total_quantity,
    avg_discount,
    active_promo_cnt,
    cd_gender,
    ca_state,
    ca_city,
    discount_status,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    LAG(total_net_profit) OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS previous_profit
  FROM cust_agg
)
SELECT
  ws_bill_customer_sk,
  total_net_profit,
  total_quantity,
  avg_discount,
  active_promo_cnt,
  cd_gender,
  ca_state,
  ca_city,
  discount_status,
  profit_rank,
  previous_profit,
  CASE
    WHEN profit_rank = 1 THEN 'Top Customer'
    WHEN profit_rank <= 10 THEN 'Top 10'
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS profit_tier
FROM cust_rank
WHERE total_net_profit > 0
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 50

WITH city_channel_profit AS (
  SELECT
    ca.ca_city,
    p.p_channel_tv,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS city_channel_profit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS orders,
    AVG(ws.ws_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN ws.ws_ext_discount_amt ELSE 0 END) AS total_active_discount,
    AVG(cd.cd_purchase_estimate) AS avg_purchase_estimate,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cd.cd_demo_sk) AS distinct_demo_count,
    CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS discount_status
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
  GROUP BY ca.ca_city, p.p_channel_tv, p.p_discount_active
)
SELECT
  ca_city,
  p_channel_tv,
  city_channel_profit,
  orders,
  avg_sales_price,
  total_active_discount,
  avg_purchase_estimate,
  distinct_demo_count,
  discount_status,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_city ORDER BY city_channel_profit DESC) AS channel_rank_in_city,
  CASE WHEN total_active_discount > 0 THEN 'Has Discount' ELSE 'No Discount' END AS discount_flag
FROM city_channel_profit
WHERE city_channel_profit IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY city_channel_profit DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH cc_sales AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, AVG(cs.cs_net_paid) AS avg_net_paid, SUM(COALESCE(p.p_cost, 0)) AS total_promo_cost, AVG(i.i_wholesale_cost) AS avg_item_wholesale_cost, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk LEFT JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name ) SELECT cc_call_center_id, cc_name, total_net_profit, total_discount, avg_net_paid, total_promo_cost, avg_item_wholesale_cost, CASE WHEN total_net_profit > 1000000 THEN 'High' WHEN total_net_profit > 500000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM cc_sales ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 10

SELECT cs.cs_order_number, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, cs.cs_net_paid, cs.cs_net_profit, cc.cc_name AS call_center_name, p.p_promo_name, AVG(cs.cs_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_item_sk ORDER BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_profit_3, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_item_sk ORDER BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit, CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_item_sk ORDER BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) > 1000000 THEN 'Surpassed' ELSE 'Below' END AS profit_threshold_flag, CASE WHEN cs.cs_net_profit > 1000 THEN 'High' WHEN cs.cs_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Positive' ELSE 'Negative' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_item_sk ORDER BY cs.cs_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_within_item FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.i_item_id, cs.cs_sold_date_sk LIMIT 100

WITH agg_customer AS ( SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, AVG(cs.cs_net_paid) AS avg_net_paid, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(COALESCE(p.p_cost,0)) AS total_promo_cost, AVG(cs.cs_net_profit) AS avg_profit, AVG(i.i_current_price) AS avg_item_price FROM catalog_sales cs LEFT JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk LEFT JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk ), cust_cc_freq AS ( SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name, COUNT(*) AS orders_per_cc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name ) SELECT a.customer_sk, a.total_net_paid, a.total_discount, a.avg_net_paid, a.total_orders, a.total_promo_cost, a.avg_profit, a.avg_item_price, ROUND(a.total_discount / NULLIF(a.total_net_paid, 0), 4) AS discount_ratio, ROUND(a.avg_profit / NULLIF(a.avg_net_paid, 0), 4) AS profit_margin, CASE WHEN a.total_net_paid > 5000000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN a.total_net_paid > 2000000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN a.total_net_paid > 500000 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS customer_tier, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.total_net_paid DESC) AS revenue_rank, AVG(a.total_net_paid) OVER () AS avg_total_net_paid_all, CASE WHEN a.total_net_paid > AVG(a.total_net_paid) OVER () THEN 'Above Avg' ELSE 'Below Avg' END AS relative_performance, c.cc_name AS top_call_center_name, c.orders_per_cc AS top_cc_order_count FROM agg_customer a LEFT JOIN cust_cc_freq c ON a.customer_sk = c.customer_sk AND c.rn = 1 ORDER BY revenue_rank LIMIT 20

WITH item_sales AS ( SELECT i.i_item_sk, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_class, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(COALESCE(p.p_cost,0)) AS total_promo_cost, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MAX(p.p_channel_tv) AS channel_tv, MAX(p.p_channel_email) AS channel_email, MAX(p.p_channel_radio) AS channel_radio, MAX(p.p_channel_dmail) AS channel_dmail FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_class ), item_top_cc AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, cc.cc_name AS top_cc_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_item_sk ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) DESC) AS rn FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cc.cc_name ) SELECT s.i_item_id, s.i_product_name, s.i_category, s.i_class, s.total_sales, s.total_net_profit, s.total_discount, s.total_promo_cost, s.order_count, ROUND(s.total_net_profit / NULLIF(s.total_sales, 0), 4) AS profit_margin, CASE WHEN s.total_net_profit / NULLIF(s.total_sales,0) > 0.2 THEN 'High Margin' WHEN s.total_net_profit / NULLIF(s.total_sales,0) > 0.1 THEN 'Medium Margin' ELSE 'Low Margin' END AS margin_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.i_category ORDER BY s.total_net_profit DESC) AS category_item_rank, SUM(s.total_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY s.i_category) AS category_total_profit, CASE WHEN s.channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV' WHEN s.channel_email = 'Y' THEN 'Email' WHEN s.channel_radio = 'Y' THEN 'Radio' WHEN s.channel_dmail = 'Y' THEN 'Direct Mail' ELSE 'Other' END AS primary_promo_channel, COALESCE(cc.top_cc_name, 'Unknown') AS top_call_center_name FROM item_sales s LEFT JOIN item_top_cc cc ON s.i_item_sk = cc.cs_item_sk AND cc.rn = 1 ORDER BY s.i_category, category_item_rank LIMIT 50

WITH store_agg AS (
       SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
              SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_net_loss,
              COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sr.sr_fee > 0) AS fee_return_cnt
       FROM store_returns sr
       WHERE sr.sr_returned_date_sk >= 20200101
       GROUP BY sr.sr_customer_sk
   ),
   web_agg AS (
       SELECT wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
              SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
              COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE wr.wr_account_credit > 0) AS credit_return_cnt
       FROM web_returns wr
       WHERE wr.wr_returned_date_sk >= 20200101
       GROUP BY wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk
   ),
   page_agg AS (
       SELECT wp.wp_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
              COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_sk) AS page_cnt,
              SUM(wp.wp_image_count) AS total_image_count,
              MAX(wp.wp_char_count) AS max_char_count
       FROM web_page wp
       WHERE wp.wp_type = 'article'
       GROUP BY wp.wp_customer_sk
   )
SELECT c.c_customer_id,
       c.c_first_name,
       c.c_last_name,
       COALESCE(sa.store_net_loss, 0) AS store_net_loss,
       COALESCE(wa.web_net_loss, 0) AS web_net_loss,
       (COALESCE(sa.store_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_loss, 0)) * 1.1 AS adjusted_total_net_loss,
       COALESCE(pa.page_cnt, 0) AS page_count,
       COALESCE(pa.total_image_count, 0) AS total_image_count,
       SUM(COALESCE(sa.store_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_loss, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_birth_country) AS country_cumulative_loss,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_birth_month ORDER BY (COALESCE(sa.store_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_loss, 0)) DESC) AS month_loss_rank
FROM customer c
LEFT JOIN store_agg sa ON sa.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN web_agg wa ON wa.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN page_agg pa ON pa.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1970 AND 1990
ORDER BY adjusted_total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 75

WITH store_agg AS (
       SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
              SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_net_loss,
              COUNT(*) AS store_return_cnt
       FROM store_returns sr
       GROUP BY sr.sr_customer_sk
   ),
   web_agg AS (
       SELECT wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
              SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
              COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt
       FROM web_returns wr
       GROUP BY wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk
   ),
   page_agg AS (
       SELECT wp.wp_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
              COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_sk) AS page_cnt,
              SUM(wp.wp_image_count) AS total_image_count
       FROM web_page wp
       GROUP BY wp.wp_customer_sk
   )
SELECT c.c_customer_id,
       c.c_first_name,
       c.c_last_name,
       COALESCE(sa.store_net_loss, 0) AS store_net_loss,
       COALESCE(wa.web_net_loss, 0) AS web_net_loss,
       COALESCE(sa.store_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
       COALESCE(pa.page_cnt, 0) AS page_count,
       COALESCE(pa.total_image_count, 0) AS total_image_count,
       NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_birth_country ORDER BY COALESCE(sa.store_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_loss, 0) DESC) AS loss_quartile,
       LAG(COALESCE(sa.store_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(wa.web_net_loss, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_birth_month ORDER BY c.c_customer_id) AS previous_customer_loss
FROM customer c
LEFT JOIN store_agg sa ON sa.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN web_agg wa ON wa.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN page_agg pa ON pa.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM store_agg s WHERE s.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk AND s.store_net_loss > 200)
ORDER BY loss_quartile, previous_customer_loss NULLS LAST
OFFSET 20 ROWS FETCH NEXT 60 ROWS ONLY

WITH monthly_state_return AS ( SELECT d.d_current_year AS year, d.d_current_month AS month, ca.ca_state, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_inc_tax, AVG(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS avg_qty FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE ca.ca_state IN ('CA','NY','TX') GROUP BY d.d_current_year, d.d_current_month, ca.ca_state ), ranked_state_return AS ( SELECT year, month, ca_state, total_return_inc_tax, avg_qty, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_return_inc_tax DESC) AS year_state_rank FROM monthly_state_return ) SELECT year, month, ca_state, total_return_inc_tax, avg_qty, year_state_rank FROM ranked_state_return WHERE year_state_rank <= 3 ORDER BY year, month, total_return_inc_tax DESC

WITH monthly_state_return AS ( SELECT d.d_current_year AS year, d.d_current_month AS month, ca.ca_state, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_inc_tax FROM web_returns wr JOIN date_dim d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE d.d_weekend = 'Y' GROUP BY d.d_current_year, d.d_current_month, ca.ca_state ), state_growth AS ( SELECT year, month, ca_state, total_return_inc_tax, LAG(total_return_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY year, month) AS prev_month_return, (total_return_inc_tax - COALESCE(LAG(total_return_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY year, month),0)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(LAG(total_return_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY year, month),0),1) AS month_over_month_growth FROM monthly_state_return ), ranked_state_return AS ( SELECT year, month, ca_state, total_return_inc_tax, month_over_month_growth, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, month ORDER BY month_over_month_growth DESC) AS growth_rank FROM state_growth ) SELECT year, month, ca_state, total_return_inc_tax, month_over_month_growth, growth_rank FROM ranked_state_return WHERE growth_rank <= 5 ORDER BY year, month, growth_rank

WITH item_site AS ( SELECT ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk, s.web_site_id, s.web_name, w.w_state AS warehouse_state, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(ws.ws_sales_price) AS avg_price, MAX(p.p_discount_active) AS promo_discount_active FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_site s ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = s.web_site_sk JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk, s.web_site_id, s.web_name, w.w_state ), ranked_item_site AS ( SELECT i.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.ws_item_sk ORDER BY i.total_sales DESC) AS site_rank, CASE WHEN i.avg_price < 20 THEN 'Low' WHEN i.avg_price BETWEEN 20 AND 100 THEN 'Medium' WHEN i.avg_price > 100 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS price_bucket, CASE WHEN i.promo_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 'Discount Active' ELSE 'No Discount' END AS promo_status FROM item_site i ) SELECT r.ws_item_sk, r.web_site_id, r.web_name, r.warehouse_state, r.total_sales, r.total_quantity, r.avg_price, r.price_bucket, r.promo_status, r.site_rank FROM ranked_item_site r WHERE r.site_rank <= 3 ORDER BY r.ws_item_sk, r.site_rank

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_state AS warehouse_state, w.w_city AS warehouse_city, s.web_site_sk, s.web_state AS site_state, s.web_country, s.web_city AS site_city, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_promo_cnt FROM web_sales ws JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN web_site s ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = s.web_site_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_state, w.w_city, s.web_site_sk, s.web_state, s.web_country, s.web_city ) SELECT sa.w_warehouse_sk, sa.warehouse_state, sa.warehouse_city, sa.site_state, sa.site_city, sa.web_country, sa.total_sales, sa.total_profit, sa.active_promo_cnt, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sa.warehouse_state ORDER BY sa.total_sales DESC) AS warehouse_state_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sa.web_country ORDER BY sa.total_sales DESC) AS site_country_rank, CASE WHEN sa.total_sales > 1000000 THEN 'High' WHEN sa.total_sales > 500000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS sales_category FROM sales_agg sa ORDER BY sa.warehouse_state, warehouse_state_rank, sa.web_country, site_country_rank LIMIT 200

WITH promo_sales AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, CASE WHEN p.p_channel_tv IS NOT NULL THEN 'TV' WHEN p.p_channel_email IS NOT NULL THEN 'Email' WHEN p.p_channel_radio IS NOT NULL THEN 'Radio' WHEN p.p_channel_demo IS NOT NULL THEN 'Demo' ELSE 'Other' END AS promo_channel, w.w_state AS warehouse_state, s.web_state AS site_state, s.web_city AS site_city, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM web_sales ws JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN web_site s ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = s.web_site_sk WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y' GROUP BY p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, CASE WHEN p.p_channel_tv IS NOT NULL THEN 'TV' WHEN p.p_channel_email IS NOT NULL THEN 'Email' WHEN p.p_channel_radio IS NOT NULL THEN 'Radio' WHEN p.p_channel_demo IS NOT NULL THEN 'Demo' ELSE 'Other' END, w.w_state, s.web_state, s.web_city ) SELECT ps.p_promo_id, ps.p_promo_name, ps.promo_channel, ps.warehouse_state, ps.site_state, ps.site_city, ps.total_net_profit, ps.total_discount, ps.total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.promo_channel ORDER BY ps.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM promo_sales ps ORDER BY ps.promo_channel, profit_rank

WITH promo_daily AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_response_target, ws.ws_sold_date_sk, w.w_state AS warehouse_state, s.web_country AS site_country, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS daily_quantity, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS daily_sales, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS daily_profit FROM web_sales ws JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN web_site s ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = s.web_site_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_response_target, ws.ws_sold_date_sk, w.w_state, s.web_country ), promo_trend AS ( SELECT pd.*, SUM(daily_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY p_promo_sk ORDER BY ws_sold_date_sk) AS cumulative_quantity, SUM(daily_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY p_promo_sk ORDER BY ws_sold_date_sk) AS cumulative_sales, LAG(daily_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY p_promo_sk ORDER BY ws_sold_date_sk) AS prev_day_quantity, CASE WHEN LAG(daily_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY p_promo_sk ORDER BY ws_sold_date_sk) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE daily_quantity - LAG(daily_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY p_promo_sk ORDER BY ws_sold_date_sk) END AS quantity_change_vs_prev_day FROM promo_daily pd ) SELECT pt.p_promo_id, pt.p_promo_name, pt.p_response_target, pt.ws_sold_date_sk, pt.warehouse_state, pt.site_country, pt.daily_quantity, pt.daily_sales, pt.cumulative_quantity, pt.cumulative_sales, pt.quantity_change_vs_prev_day, CASE WHEN pt.cumulative_quantity >= pt.p_response_target THEN 'Target met' ELSE 'Target not met' END AS target_status FROM promo_trend pt WHERE pt.ws_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pt.p_promo_id, pt.ws_sold_date_sk

WITH profit_by_day AS (SELECT ws.ws_ship_mode_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS day_profit FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_ship_mode_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk), profit_with_lag AS (SELECT pbd.*, LAG(pbd.day_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY pbd.ws_ship_mode_sk, pbd.ws_web_site_sk ORDER BY pbd.ws_sold_date_sk) AS prev_day_profit FROM profit_by_day pbd) SELECT sm.sm_type, site.web_name, pwl.ws_sold_date_sk, pwl.day_profit, pwl.prev_day_profit, CASE WHEN pwl.prev_day_profit = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((pwl.day_profit - pwl.prev_day_profit) / NULLIF(pwl.prev_day_profit, 0)) * 100 END AS growth_pct, CASE WHEN pwl.prev_day_profit IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN ((pwl.day_profit - pwl.prev_day_profit) / NULLIF(pwl.prev_day_profit, 0)) * 100 > 10 THEN 'Strong Growth' WHEN ((pwl.day_profit - pwl.prev_day_profit) / NULLIF(pwl.prev_day_profit, 0)) * 100 < -10 THEN 'Decline' ELSE 'Stable' END AS growth_category FROM profit_with_lag pwl JOIN ship_mode sm ON pwl.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN web_site site ON pwl.ws_web_site_sk = site.web_site_sk ORDER BY sm.sm_type, site.web_name, pwl.ws_sold_date_sk

WITH page_ship AS (SELECT wp.wp_type, sm.sm_type AS ship_type, SUM(ws.ws_coupon_amt) AS total_coupon, AVG(ws.ws_coupon_amt) AS avg_coupon, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY wp.wp_type, sm.sm_type) SELECT ps.wp_type, ps.ship_type, ps.total_coupon, ps.avg_coupon, ps.order_cnt, ps.distinct_customers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ps.total_coupon DESC) AS coupon_rank, CASE WHEN ps.avg_coupon > 5 THEN 'High' WHEN ps.avg_coupon > 2 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS coupon_category FROM page_ship ps ORDER BY coupon_rank LIMIT 20

WITH ship_rev AS (SELECT ws.ws_ship_mode_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_revenue, AVG(ws.ws_net_profit) AS avg_profit, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_ship_mode_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk) SELECT sm.sm_type, site.web_name, sr.total_revenue, sr.avg_profit, sr.order_cnt, CASE WHEN sr.avg_profit > 500 THEN 'Very Profitable' WHEN sr.avg_profit > 0 THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Unprofitable' END AS profit_class, SUM(sr.total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY sm.sm_type ORDER BY sr.total_revenue DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_total_rev, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.sm_type ORDER BY sr.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM ship_rev sr JOIN ship_mode sm ON sr.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN web_site site ON sr.ws_web_site_sk = site.web_site_sk ORDER BY sm.sm_type, revenue_rank

WITH page_sales AS (SELECT ws.ws_web_page_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk, ws.ws_ship_mode_sk, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_web_page_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk, ws.ws_ship_mode_sk) SELECT ws_site.web_name, wp.wp_url, sm.sm_type, ps.total_sales, ps.order_cnt, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.ws_web_site_sk ORDER BY ps.total_sales DESC) AS page_rank, CASE WHEN ps.total_sales > 100000 THEN 'High' WHEN ps.total_sales > 50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS sales_category FROM page_sales ps JOIN web_page wp ON ps.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN web_site ws_site ON ps.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON ps.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk ORDER BY ws_site.web_name, page_rank

WITH page_metrics AS (SELECT cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_ext_wholesale_cost) AS total_wholesale_cost, (SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) - SUM(cs.cs_ext_wholesale_cost)) AS gross_margin FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_catalog_page_id) SELECT cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number, cp_catalog_page_id, total_net_paid, total_wholesale_cost, gross_margin, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY gross_margin DESC) AS margin_rank_in_dept, AVG(gross_margin) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY cp_catalog_page_number ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_margin FROM page_metrics ORDER BY cp_department, margin_rank_in_dept

SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_city, p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 'Active Discount' WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'N' THEN 'No Discount' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS discount_status, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) DESC) AS promo_rank_in_warehouse FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk WHERE cp.cp_type = 'Catalog' GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_city, p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_discount_active

WITH page_sales AS (SELECT cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, p.p_promo_id, CASE WHEN p.p_channel_email = 'Y' THEN 'Email' WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV' WHEN p.p_channel_radio = 'Y' THEN 'Radio' WHEN p.p_channel_catalog = 'Y' THEN 'Catalog' ELSE 'Other' END AS primary_channel, SUM(cs.cs_sales_price * cs.cs_quantity) AS total_sales FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, p.p_promo_id, p.p_channel_email, p.p_channel_tv, p.p_channel_radio, p.p_channel_catalog), ranked_pages AS (SELECT cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number, cp_catalog_page_id, primary_channel, total_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS rn FROM page_sales) SELECT cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number, cp_catalog_page_id, primary_channel, total_sales, rn AS dept_page_rank FROM ranked_pages WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY cp_department, rn

WITH promo_profit AS (SELECT w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_name, p.p_purpose, p.p_promo_id, p.p_start_date_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_name, p.p_purpose, p.p_promo_id, p.p_start_date_sk), warehouse_totals AS (SELECT w_warehouse_sk, SUM(total_net_profit) AS warehouse_total_profit FROM promo_profit GROUP BY w_warehouse_sk) SELECT pp.w_warehouse_name, pp.p_purpose, pp.p_promo_id, pp.total_net_profit, wt.warehouse_total_profit, (pp.total_net_profit / wt.warehouse_total_profit) * 100 AS profit_pct_of_warehouse, LAG(pp.total_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY pp.w_warehouse_sk, pp.p_purpose ORDER BY pp.p_start_date_sk) AS prev_promo_profit, CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY pp.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY pp.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_cume_dist FROM promo_profit pp JOIN warehouse_totals wt ON pp.w_warehouse_sk = wt.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY pp.w_warehouse_name, pp.p_purpose, pp.total_net_profit DESC

WITH order_summary AS ( SELECT cr.cr_order_number, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, AVG(i.i_wholesale_cost) AS avg_wholesale_cost, MAX(sm.sm_type) AS ship_mode_type, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_item_sk) AS distinct_items, MIN(cr.cr_returned_date_sk) AS first_return_date_sk FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_order_number ) SELECT cr_order_number, total_return_amount, total_return_qty, total_net_loss, avg_wholesale_cost, ship_mode_type, distinct_items, first_return_date_sk, CASE WHEN total_return_amount > 5000 THEN 'Very High Return' WHEN total_return_amount BETWEEN 2000 AND 5000 THEN 'High Return' ELSE 'Normal Return' END AS return_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS amount_rank, NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss ASC) AS loss_quartile, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ship_mode_type ORDER BY total_return_qty DESC) AS rank_within_ship_mode FROM order_summary WHERE total_return_amount > 0 AND total_return_qty > 2 ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC LIMIT 40

WITH order_summary AS ( SELECT cr.cr_order_number, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, AVG(i.i_wholesale_cost) AS avg_wholesale_cost, MIN(sm.sm_type) AS ship_mode_type, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_item_sk) AS distinct_items, MAX(cr.cr_returned_date_sk) AS last_return_date_sk FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_order_number, cr.cr_returned_date_sk ) SELECT cr_order_number, total_return_amount, total_return_qty, total_net_loss, avg_wholesale_cost, ship_mode_type, distinct_items, last_return_date_sk, CASE WHEN total_return_qty > 10 THEN 'Bulk Return' ELSE 'Standard Return' END AS return_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS amount_rownum, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ship_mode_type ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank_by_ship, NTILE(2) OVER (ORDER BY total_return_qty DESC) AS qty_half, SUM(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ship_mode_type) AS ship_mode_total_return FROM order_summary WHERE total_return_qty >= 1 AND total_net_loss <> 0 ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC LIMIT 20

WITH customer_sales AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_coupon_amt) AS total_coupon_amount, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk),
customer_shipmode AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_ship_mode_sk, COUNT(*) AS mode_count FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_ship_mode_sk),
customer_returns AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity FROM store_returns sr JOIN catalog_sales cs ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk AND sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk),
ranked_customers AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk, cs.total_net_paid, cs.total_coupon_amount, cs.total_quantity, COALESCE(cr.total_return_amount,0) AS total_return_amount, COALESCE(cr.total_return_quantity,0) AS total_return_quantity,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_net_paid DESC) AS net_paid_rank,
       SUM(cs.total_net_paid) OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_net_paid DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_net_paid,
       AVG(cs.total_quantity) OVER () AS avg_quantity_all_customers
FROM customer_sales cs LEFT JOIN customer_returns cr ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = cr.cs_bill_customer_sk)
SELECT rc.cs_bill_customer_sk,
       cd.cd_gender,
       cd.cd_credit_rating,
       rc.total_net_paid,
       rc.total_coupon_amount,
       CASE WHEN rc.total_net_paid = 0 THEN 0 ELSE rc.total_coupon_amount / rc.total_net_paid END AS coupon_usage_ratio,
       rc.total_quantity,
       rc.total_return_amount,
       rc.total_return_quantity,
       sm.sm_type AS top_ship_mode_type,
       sm.sm_carrier AS top_ship_mode_carrier,
       rc.net_paid_rank,
       rc.running_total_net_paid,
       ROUND(rc.total_net_paid / SUM(rc.total_net_paid) OVER () * 100, 2) AS pct_of_total_net_paid,
       rc.avg_quantity_all_customers
FROM ranked_customers rc
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON rc.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_ship_mode_sk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk ORDER BY cs.mode_count DESC) AS mode_rank
    FROM customer_shipmode cs
) top_mode ON rc.cs_bill_customer_sk = top_mode.cs_bill_customer_sk AND top_mode.mode_rank = 1
LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm ON top_mode.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
WHERE rc.net_paid_rank <= 10
ORDER BY rc.net_paid_rank

WITH customer_sales AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_coupon_amt) AS total_coupon_amount, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk),
customer_shipmode AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_ship_mode_sk, COUNT(*) AS mode_count FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_ship_mode_sk),
customer_returns AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity FROM store_returns sr JOIN catalog_sales cs ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk AND sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk),
aggregated AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk,
                    cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk,
                    cs.total_net_paid,
                    cs.total_coupon_amount,
                    cs.total_quantity,
                    COALESCE(cr.total_return_amount,0) AS total_return_amount,
                    COALESCE(cr.total_return_quantity,0) AS total_return_quantity,
                    MAX(cs.total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk) AS max_net_paid_in_demo,
                    MIN(cs.total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk) AS min_net_paid_in_demo
             FROM customer_sales cs LEFT JOIN customer_returns cr ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = cr.cs_bill_customer_sk)
SELECT a.cs_bill_customer_sk,
       cd.cd_gender,
       cd.cd_credit_rating,
       a.total_net_paid,
       a.total_coupon_amount,
       CASE WHEN a.total_net_paid = 0 THEN 0 ELSE a.total_coupon_amount / a.total_net_paid END AS coupon_usage_ratio,
       a.total_quantity,
       a.total_return_amount,
       a.total_return_quantity,
       sm.sm_type AS top_ship_mode_type,
       sm.sm_carrier AS top_ship_mode_carrier,
       a.max_net_paid_in_demo,
       a.min_net_paid_in_demo,
       ROUND(a.total_net_paid / a.max_net_paid_in_demo * 100, 2) AS pct_of_max_in_demo
FROM aggregated a
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON a.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_ship_mode_sk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk ORDER BY cs.mode_count DESC) AS mode_rank
    FROM customer_shipmode cs
) top_mode ON a.cs_bill_customer_sk = top_mode.cs_bill_customer_sk AND top_mode.mode_rank = 1
LEFT JOIN ship_mode sm ON top_mode.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
WHERE a.total_net_paid > (SELECT AVG(total_net_paid) FROM aggregated)
ORDER BY a.total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH wr_agg AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_item_sk,
        wr.wr_order_number,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss
    FROM web_returns wr
    GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk, wr.wr_order_number
),
ws_adj AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        ws.ws_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
        ws.ws_net_profit - COALESCE(wr_agg.total_return_loss, 0) AS profit_adj,
        ws.ws_sold_time_sk AS time_sk,
        'web' AS source
    FROM web_sales ws
    LEFT JOIN wr_agg
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr_agg.wr_item_sk
           AND ws.ws_order_number = wr_agg.wr_order_number
),
cs_adj AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        cs.cs_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS profit_adj,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk AS time_sk,
        'catalog' AS source
    FROM catalog_sales cs
),
promo_union AS (
    SELECT promo_sk, discount_amt, profit_adj, time_sk, source FROM cs_adj
    UNION ALL
    SELECT promo_sk, discount_amt, profit_adj, time_sk, source FROM ws_adj
),
promo_with_time AS (
    SELECT
        pu.promo_sk,
        pu.source,
        pu.discount_amt,
        pu.profit_adj,
        t.t_hour,
        t.t_shift
    FROM promo_union pu
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON pu.time_sk = t.t_time_sk
),
promo_agg AS (
    SELECT
        promo_sk,
        source,
        SUM(profit_adj) AS total_profit_adj,
        AVG(discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        SUM(profit_adj) / NULLIF(AVG(discount_amt), 0) AS profit_per_discount,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(profit_adj) / NULLIF(AVG(discount_amt), 0) >= 2 THEN 'Effective'
            ELSE 'Ineffective'
        END AS effectiveness
    FROM promo_with_time
    GROUP BY promo_sk, source
)
SELECT
    promo_sk,
    source,
    total_profit_adj,
    avg_discount,
    profit_per_discount,
    effectiveness,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY source ORDER BY profit_per_discount DESC) AS promo_rank
FROM promo_agg
ORDER BY source, promo_rank

WITH ws_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_order_number,
        t.t_hour,
        t.t_shift,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS ws_total_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS ws_total_paid
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY ws.ws_order_number, t.t_hour, t.t_shift
),
wr_agg AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_order_number,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amt
    FROM web_returns wr
    GROUP BY wr.wr_order_number
),
cs_hour_agg AS (
    SELECT
        t.t_hour,
        t.t_shift,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS cs_total_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY t.t_hour, t.t_shift
),
order_profit AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.t_hour,
        ws.t_shift,
        ws.ws_total_profit,
        COALESCE(wr.total_return_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss,
        cs.cs_total_profit,
        (ws.ws_total_profit - COALESCE(wr.total_return_loss, 0) + cs.cs_total_profit) AS net_profit_adj,
        CASE
            WHEN (ws.ws_total_profit - COALESCE(wr.total_return_loss, 0) + cs.cs_total_profit) >= 200000 THEN 'Very High'
            WHEN (ws.ws_total_profit - COALESCE(wr.total_return_loss, 0) + cs.cs_total_profit) >= 100000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN (ws.ws_total_profit - COALESCE(wr.total_return_loss, 0) + cs.cs_total_profit) >= 50000 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS profit_category,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (ws.ws_total_profit - COALESCE(wr.total_return_loss, 0) + cs.cs_total_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank
    FROM ws_agg ws
    LEFT JOIN wr_agg wr
        ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    JOIN cs_hour_agg cs
        ON ws.t_hour = cs.t_hour AND ws.t_shift = cs.t_shift
)
SELECT
    ws_order_number,
    t_hour,
    t_shift,
    ws_total_profit,
    total_return_loss,
    cs_total_profit,
    net_profit_adj,
    profit_category,
    profit_rank
FROM order_profit
WHERE profit_rank <= 10
ORDER BY profit_rank

WITH wr_agg AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_item_sk,
        wr.wr_order_number,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss
    FROM web_returns wr
    GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk, wr.wr_order_number
),
ws_events AS (
    SELECT
        t.t_time,
        ws.ws_net_profit - COALESCE(wr_agg.total_return_loss, 0) AS profit_adj
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    LEFT JOIN wr_agg
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr_agg.wr_item_sk
           AND ws.ws_order_number = wr_agg.wr_order_number
),
cs_events AS (
    SELECT
        t.t_time,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS profit_adj
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
),
combined AS (
    SELECT t_time, profit_adj FROM cs_events
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t_time, profit_adj FROM ws_events
)
SELECT
    t_time,
    profit_adj,
    SUM(profit_adj) OVER (ORDER BY t_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit,
    AVG(profit_adj) OVER (ORDER BY t_time ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_5,
    CASE WHEN profit_adj > 0 THEN 'Gain' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_sign
FROM combined
ORDER BY t_time

WITH cs_agg AS (
    SELECT
        t.t_hour,
        t.t_shift,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS cs_total_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY t.t_hour, t.t_shift
),
ws_agg AS (
    SELECT
        t.t_hour,
        t.t_shift,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS ws_total_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY t.t_hour, t.t_shift
),
wr_agg AS (
    SELECT
        t.t_hour,
        t.t_shift,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN time_dim t
        ON wr.wr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY t.t_hour, t.t_shift
)
SELECT
    cs.t_hour,
    cs.t_shift,
    cs.cs_total_profit,
    ws.ws_total_profit,
    wr.total_return_loss,
    (cs.cs_total_profit + ws.ws_total_profit - wr.total_return_loss) AS net_profit_adj,
    CASE
        WHEN (cs.cs_total_profit + ws.ws_total_profit - wr.total_return_loss) >= 100000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN (cs.cs_total_profit + ws.ws_total_profit - wr.total_return_loss) >= 50000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS profit_category,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (cs.cs_total_profit + ws.ws_total_profit - wr.total_return_loss) DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM cs_agg cs
JOIN ws_agg ws
    ON cs.t_hour = ws.t_hour AND cs.t_shift = ws.t_shift
JOIN wr_agg wr
    ON cs.t_hour = wr.t_hour AND cs.t_shift = wr.t_shift
ORDER BY profit_rank

WITH daily_cc_sales AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date, td.t_shift, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS daily_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS daily_net_profit, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, td.t_shift ), cum_metrics AS ( SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, sold_date, t_shift, daily_net_paid, daily_net_profit, txn_cnt, SUM(daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_sk ORDER BY sold_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_paid, AVG(daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_sk ORDER BY sold_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_7d, CASE WHEN daily_net_paid > AVG(daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_sk ORDER BY sold_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) * 1.2 THEN 'Spike' WHEN daily_net_paid < AVG(daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_sk ORDER BY sold_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) * 0.8 THEN 'Dip' ELSE 'Normal' END AS performance_flag FROM daily_cc_sales ) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, sold_date, t_shift, daily_net_paid, daily_net_profit, txn_cnt, cumulative_net_paid, moving_avg_7d, performance_flag FROM cum_metrics WHERE sold_date BETWEEN (SELECT MAX(cs_sold_date_sk) - 30 FROM catalog_sales) AND (SELECT MAX(cs_sold_date_sk) FROM catalog_sales) ORDER BY cc_call_center_sk, sold_date DESC LIMIT 100

WITH shipping_stats AS ( SELECT sm.sm_type, sm.sm_code, cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_tax_percentage, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS sum_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS sum_net_profit, AVG(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY sm.sm_type, sm.sm_code, cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_tax_percentage ), ranked_shipping AS ( SELECT sm_type, sm_code, cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, cc_tax_percentage, sum_net_paid, sum_net_profit, avg_net_paid_inc_tax, txn_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_sk ORDER BY sum_net_paid DESC) AS rank_by_sales, SUM(sum_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_sk ORDER BY sum_net_paid DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_paid FROM shipping_stats ) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, sm_type, sm_code, sum_net_paid, sum_net_profit, avg_net_paid_inc_tax, txn_count, rank_by_sales, cumulative_net_paid, CASE WHEN cc_tax_percentage > 10 THEN 'High Tax' WHEN cc_tax_percentage > 5 THEN 'Medium Tax' ELSE 'Low Tax' END AS tax_bracket FROM ranked_shipping WHERE rank_by_sales <= 5 ORDER BY cc_call_center_sk, rank_by_sales

WITH hourly_sales AS ( SELECT td.t_hour, cs.cs_item_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS item_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_price, COUNT(*) AS total_transactions, SUM(CASE WHEN sm.sm_type = 'AIR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS air_shipments, SUM(CASE WHEN sm.sm_type = 'RAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rail_shipments FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY td.t_hour, cs.cs_item_sk ), ranked_sales AS ( SELECT t_hour, cs_item_sk, item_net_paid, total_discount, total_sales_price, total_transactions, air_shipments, rail_shipments, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t_hour ORDER BY item_net_paid DESC) AS drk FROM hourly_sales ) SELECT t_hour, cs_item_sk, item_net_paid, total_discount, total_sales_price, total_transactions, air_shipments, rail_shipments, CASE WHEN total_discount / NULLIF(total_sales_price,0) > 0.20 THEN 'High Discount' WHEN total_discount / NULLIF(total_sales_price,0) > 0.10 THEN 'Medium Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category FROM ranked_sales WHERE drk <= 3 ORDER BY t_hour, drk

WITH sales_data AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cs.cs_net_paid, cs.cs_net_profit, sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type, td.t_hour, td.t_meal_time FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk WHERE td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17 ), aggregated AS ( SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, SUM(cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT ship_mode_type) AS distinct_ship_modes, MIN(t_hour) AS earliest_hour, MAX(t_hour) AS latest_hour FROM sales_data GROUP BY cc_call_center_sk, cc_name HAVING SUM(cs_net_paid) > 10000 ) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, total_net_paid, total_net_profit, ROUND(100.0 * total_net_paid / SUM(total_net_paid) OVER (), 2) AS contribution_pct, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS sales_rank, CASE WHEN total_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_status, distinct_ship_modes, earliest_hour, latest_hour FROM aggregated ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC

WITH ship_hh_sales AS (
    SELECT
        hd.hd_demo_sk,
        hd.hd_dep_count,
        hd.hd_vehicle_count,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS profit_on_date,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales_on_date,
        AVG(ws.ws_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_ship_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    GROUP BY hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_dep_count, hd.hd_vehicle_count, hd.hd_buy_potential,
             ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, ws.ws_sold_date_sk
),
hh_cumulative AS (
    SELECT
        hd_demo_sk,
        hd_dep_count,
        hd_vehicle_count,
        hd_buy_potential,
        ib_lower_bound,
        ib_upper_bound,
        ws_sold_date_sk,
        profit_on_date,
        sales_on_date,
        avg_sales_price,
        SUM(profit_on_date) OVER (PARTITION BY hd_demo_sk ORDER BY ws_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit
    FROM ship_hh_sales
)
SELECT
    hd_demo_sk,
    hd_dep_count,
    hd_vehicle_count,
    CASE
        WHEN hd_vehicle_count = 0 THEN 'NoVehicle'
        WHEN hd_vehicle_count <= 2 THEN 'FewVehicles'
        ELSE 'ManyVehicles'
    END AS vehicle_category,
    ib_lower_bound,
    ib_upper_bound,
    ws_sold_date_sk,
    profit_on_date,
    cumulative_profit,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cumulative_profit DESC) AS household_profit_rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY hd_dep_count DESC) AS dep_dense_rank
FROM hh_cumulative
WHERE hd_dep_count >= 2
ORDER BY household_profit_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH page_perf AS (
    SELECT
        wp.wp_web_page_id AS wp_id,
        wp.wp_type,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        AVG(ws.ws_coupon_amt) AS avg_coupon
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_type, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound
)
SELECT
    wp_id,
    wp_type,
    ib_lower_bound,
    ib_upper_bound,
    total_sales,
    total_profit,
    avg_coupon,
    CASE
        WHEN total_profit > 100000 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN total_profit > 50000 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS profit_category,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_dense_rank
FROM page_perf
WHERE total_sales > 10000
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 20

WITH profit_by_type_income AS (
    SELECT
        wp.wp_type,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_sk) AS distinct_pages,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        AVG(ws.ws_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    GROUP BY wp.wp_type, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound
),
ranked_profit AS (
    SELECT
        wp_type,
        ib_lower_bound,
        ib_upper_bound,
        distinct_pages,
        total_profit,
        avg_sales_price,
        total_sales,
        total_quantity,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_sales_price DESC) AS avg_price_dense_rank,
        SUM(total_profit) OVER (ORDER BY ib_lower_bound ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_profit_by_income
    FROM profit_by_type_income
)
SELECT
    wp_type,
    ib_lower_bound,
    ib_upper_bound,
    distinct_pages,
    total_profit,
    avg_sales_price,
    total_sales,
    total_quantity,
    profit_rank,
    avg_price_dense_rank,
    cum_profit_by_income,
    CASE
        WHEN total_profit > 200000 THEN 'Platinum'
        WHEN total_profit > 100000 THEN 'Gold'
        WHEN total_profit > 50000 THEN 'Silver'
        ELSE 'Bronze'
    END AS profit_tier
FROM ranked_profit
WHERE total_quantity > 100
ORDER BY profit_rank
LIMIT 30

WITH daily_coupon AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        wp.wp_type,
        ib.ib_lower_bound,
        ib.ib_upper_bound,
        SUM(ws.ws_coupon_amt) AS total_coupon,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
        AVG(ws.ws_coupon_amt) AS avg_coupon,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk
    GROUP BY ws.ws_sold_date_sk, wp.wp_type, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound
),
coupon_rank AS (
    SELECT
        ws_sold_date_sk,
        wp_type,
        ib_lower_bound,
        ib_upper_bound,
        total_coupon,
        txn_count,
        avg_coupon,
        total_sales,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type ORDER BY total_coupon DESC) AS coupon_dense_rank,
        SUM(total_coupon) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type ORDER BY ws_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_coupon
    FROM daily_coupon
)
SELECT
    ws_sold_date_sk,
    wp_type,
    ib_lower_bound,
    ib_upper_bound,
    total_coupon,
    txn_count,
    avg_coupon,
    total_sales,
    coupon_dense_rank,
    cumulative_coupon,
    CASE
        WHEN cumulative_coupon > 50000 THEN 'Very High'
        WHEN cumulative_coupon > 20000 THEN 'High'
        ELSE 'Normal'
    END AS cumulative_coupon_category
FROM coupon_rank
WHERE total_sales > 1000
ORDER BY wp_type, coupon_dense_rank
LIMIT 50

WITH store_daily AS (
    SELECT ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
           SUM(ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ss_customer_sk) AS store_customer_cnt,
           AVG(ss_sales_price) AS avg_store_price
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_quantity > 1
    GROUP BY ss_sold_date_sk
),
web_daily AS (
    SELECT ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
           SUM(ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ws_bill_customer_sk) AS web_customer_cnt,
           AVG(ws_sales_price) AS avg_web_price
    FROM web_sales
    WHERE ws_quantity BETWEEN 2 AND 10
    GROUP BY ws_sold_date_sk
),
combined AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(s.date_sk, w.date_sk) AS date_sk,
           COALESCE(s.store_net_profit, 0) AS store_net_profit,
           COALESCE(w.web_net_profit, 0) AS web_net_profit,
           COALESCE(s.store_customer_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_customer_cnt, 0) AS total_customer_cnt,
           COALESCE(s.avg_store_price, 0) AS avg_store_price,
           COALESCE(w.avg_web_price, 0) AS avg_web_price
    FROM store_daily s
    FULL JOIN web_daily w ON s.date_sk = w.date_sk
)
SELECT date_sk,
       store_net_profit,
       web_net_profit,
       total_customer_cnt,
       (store_net_profit + web_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
       (avg_store_price + avg_web_price) / 2 AS overall_avg_price,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (store_net_profit + web_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_row_num,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promotion p WHERE date_sk BETWEEN p.p_start_date_sk AND p.p_end_date_sk) AS active_promos
FROM combined
WHERE date_sk >= 2450000
ORDER BY date_sk DESC
LIMIT 150

WITH daily AS (
    SELECT ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
           SUM(ss_net_profit) AS store_profit,
           SUM(ss_ext_discount_amt) AS store_discount,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ss_customer_sk) AS store_customers
    FROM store_sales
    GROUP BY ss_sold_date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws_sold_date_sk,
           SUM(ws_net_profit),
           SUM(ws_ext_discount_amt),
           COUNT(DISTINCT ws_bill_customer_sk)
    FROM web_sales
    GROUP BY ws_sold_date_sk
),
agg AS (
    SELECT date_sk,
           SUM(store_profit) AS total_profit,
           SUM(store_discount) AS total_discount,
           SUM(store_customers) AS total_customers
    FROM daily
    GROUP BY date_sk
)
SELECT date_sk,
       total_profit,
       total_discount,
       total_customers,
       total_profit - total_discount AS net_after_discount,
       PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS profit_percentile,
       CASE WHEN total_profit > LAG(total_profit, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date_sk) THEN 'Increase' ELSE 'Decrease' END AS profit_trend,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promotion p WHERE date_sk BETWEEN p.p_start_date_sk AND p.p_end_date_sk) AS promos_active
FROM agg
WHERE total_customers > 50
ORDER BY total_profit ASC
LIMIT 100

WITH daily_metrics AS (
    SELECT ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
           SUM(ss_net_profit) AS profit,
           AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ss_customer_sk) AS cust_cnt
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_ext_wholesale_cost IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ss_sold_date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws_sold_date_sk,
           SUM(ws_net_profit),
           AVG(ws_ext_discount_amt),
           COUNT(DISTINCT ws_bill_customer_sk)
    FROM web_sales
    WHERE ws_ext_wholesale_cost IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ws_sold_date_sk
),
summary AS (
    SELECT date_sk,
           SUM(profit) AS total_profit,
           AVG(avg_discount) AS overall_avg_discount,
           SUM(cust_cnt) AS total_customers
    FROM daily_metrics
    GROUP BY date_sk
)
SELECT date_sk,
       total_profit,
       overall_avg_discount,
       total_customers,
       total_profit * overall_avg_discount AS discount_impact,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
       CASE WHEN total_profit > (SELECT AVG(total_profit) FROM summary) THEN 'Above Mean' ELSE 'Below Mean' END AS profit_vs_mean,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promotion p WHERE date_sk BETWEEN p.p_start_date_sk AND p.p_end_date_sk) AS promos_active
FROM summary
WHERE total_customers BETWEEN 20 AND 500
ORDER BY date_sk
LIMIT 120

WITH daily_type_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_type,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS daily_net_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS daily_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cd.cd_gender) AS gender_count
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY cp.cp_type, cs.cs_sold_date_sk
), with_totals AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type) AS total_net_by_type,
        MAX(daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type) AS max_daily_net,
        MIN(daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type) AS min_daily_net
    FROM daily_type_sales
)
SELECT
    cp_type,
    sold_date,
    daily_net_paid,
    daily_orders,
    distinct_customers,
    gender_count,
    total_net_by_type,
    max_daily_net,
    min_daily_net,
    CASE WHEN daily_net_paid = max_daily_net THEN 'Peak Day' WHEN daily_net_paid = min_daily_net THEN 'Low Day' ELSE 'Normal' END AS day_category,
    NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type ORDER BY daily_net_paid DESC) AS net_paid_quartile
FROM with_totals
WHERE daily_net_paid IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY cp_type, sold_date

WITH daily_type_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_type,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS daily_net_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS daily_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cd.cd_gender) AS gender_count,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS daily_discount_total
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY cp.cp_type, cs.cs_sold_date_sk
), with_totals AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type) AS total_net_by_type,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type ORDER BY sold_date DESC) AS rev_day_rank
    FROM daily_type_sales
)
SELECT
    cp_type,
    sold_date,
    daily_net_paid,
    daily_orders,
    distinct_customers,
    gender_count,
    daily_discount_total,
    CASE WHEN rev_day_rank = 1 THEN 'Latest Day' ELSE 'Prior Day' END AS day_position,
    SUM(daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type ORDER BY sold_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_paid,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type ORDER BY daily_net_paid DESC) AS net_paid_percentile
FROM with_totals
WHERE daily_net_paid > 0
ORDER BY cp_type, sold_date

WITH item_discount_stats AS (SELECT ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_ship_addr_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk, SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt + ws.ws_coupon_amt) AS total_discount_amount, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_price, COUNT(*) AS sales_count FROM web_sales ws JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk WHERE p.p_discount_active = 'Y' GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, ws.ws_ship_addr_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk), item_discount_ratio AS (SELECT ids.ws_item_sk, ids.sales_count, CASE WHEN ids.total_sales_price = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ids.total_discount_amount / ids.total_sales_price END AS avg_discount_ratio, ids.ws_ship_addr_sk, ids.ws_web_site_sk, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN ids.total_sales_price = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ids.total_discount_amount / ids.total_sales_price END DESC) AS discount_rank, CASE WHEN CASE WHEN ids.total_sales_price = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ids.total_discount_amount / ids.total_sales_price END > 0.2 THEN 'High Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category FROM item_discount_stats ids) SELECT idr.ws_item_sk, idr.sales_count, ROUND(idr.avg_discount_ratio, 4) AS avg_discount_ratio, idr.discount_rank, idr.discount_category, ca.ca_city AS ship_city, ca.ca_state AS ship_state, ws_site.web_name AS site_name FROM item_discount_ratio idr JOIN customer_address ca ON idr.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN web_site ws_site ON idr.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk WHERE idr.discount_rank <= 10 ORDER BY idr.discount_rank

WITH promo_profit AS (SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, ca.ca_state AS state, ws_site.web_name AS site_name, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit, CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS discount_status FROM web_sales ws JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, ca.ca_state, ws_site.web_name, p.p_discount_active), ranked AS (SELECT pp.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pp.state ORDER BY pp.total_profit DESC) AS state_promo_rank FROM promo_profit pp) SELECT r.p_promo_id, r.p_promo_name, r.state, r.site_name, r.total_profit, r.discount_status, r.state_promo_rank FROM ranked r WHERE r.state_promo_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.state, r.state_promo_rank

WITH city_state_profit AS (SELECT ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, ws_site.web_name AS site_name, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS city_total_profit, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM web_sales ws JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN web_site ws_site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk WHERE p.p_purpose = 'Clearance' GROUP BY ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, ws_site.web_name), city_ranked AS (SELECT csp.*, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY csp.ca_state ORDER BY csp.city_total_profit) AS profit_percentile, CASE WHEN csp.city_total_profit >= 15000 THEN 'High' WHEN csp.city_total_profit >= 5000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category FROM city_state_profit csp) SELECT cr.ca_city, cr.ca_state, cr.site_name, cr.city_total_profit, cr.total_orders, ROUND(cr.profit_percentile, 4) AS profit_percentile, cr.profit_category FROM city_ranked cr WHERE cr.city_total_profit > 0 ORDER BY cr.ca_state, cr.profit_percentile DESC

WITH sales_per_reason AS (SELECT wr.wr_reason_sk, SUM(ws.ws_sales_price * ws.ws_quantity) AS sales_amount FROM web_returns wr JOIN web_sales ws ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk GROUP BY wr.wr_reason_sk) SELECT r.r_reason_sk, r.r_reason_desc, COUNT(*) AS return_count, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COALESCE(s.sales_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, CASE WHEN SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) >= 100000 THEN 'Severe' WHEN SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) >= 50000 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) >= 10000 THEN 'Moderate' ELSE 'Low' END AS loss_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) DESC) AS return_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS return_count_dense_rank FROM web_returns wr JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk LEFT JOIN sales_per_reason s ON wr.wr_reason_sk = s.wr_reason_sk GROUP BY r.r_reason_sk, r.r_reason_desc, s.sales_amount ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC LIMIT 10

WITH site_sales AS (SELECT ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS daily_sales_profit, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS daily_sales_amount FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk GROUP BY ws.ws_sold_date_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk), site_returns AS (SELECT wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS daily_return_amount, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS daily_return_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN web_sales ws ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk GROUP BY wr.wr_returned_date_sk, ws.ws_web_site_sk) SELECT ss.date_sk, wsit.web_name, ss.site_sk, ss.daily_sales_profit, COALESCE(sr.daily_return_amount, 0) AS daily_return_amount, ss.daily_sales_profit - COALESCE(sr.daily_return_amount, 0) AS net_profit_after_returns, CASE WHEN COALESCE(sr.daily_return_amount, 0) > ss.daily_sales_profit THEN 'Return > Profit' ELSE 'Profit >= Return' END AS profit_return_flag, SUM(ss.daily_sales_profit - COALESCE(sr.daily_return_amount, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.site_sk ORDER BY ss.date_sk) AS cumulative_net_profit_site, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.site_sk ORDER BY ss.daily_sales_profit - COALESCE(sr.daily_return_amount, 0) DESC) AS daily_profit_rank FROM site_sales ss JOIN web_site wsit ON ss.site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk LEFT JOIN site_returns sr ON ss.date_sk = sr.date_sk AND ss.site_sk = sr.site_sk ORDER BY ss.site_sk, ss.date_sk

WITH customer_sales AS (SELECT ws.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk, ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_web_site_sk, ws.ws_bill_customer_sk), customer_returns AS (SELECT ws.ws_web_site_sk AS site_sk, ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss FROM web_returns wr JOIN web_sales ws ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk GROUP BY ws.ws_web_site_sk, ws.ws_bill_customer_sk) SELECT wsit.web_site_sk, wsit.web_name, cs.customer_sk, cs.total_sales_profit, COALESCE(cr.total_return_amount, 0) AS total_return_amount, cs.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(cr.total_return_amount, 0) AS net_profit_after_returns, CASE WHEN (cs.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(cr.total_return_amount, 0)) < 0 THEN 'Loss' WHEN (cs.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(cr.total_return_amount, 0)) BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 THEN 'Low Profit' WHEN (cs.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(cr.total_return_amount, 0)) BETWEEN 10001 AND 50000 THEN 'Medium Profit' ELSE 'High Profit' END AS profit_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY wsit.web_site_sk ORDER BY cs.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(cr.total_return_amount, 0) DESC) AS profit_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wsit.web_site_sk ORDER BY cs.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(cr.total_return_amount, 0) DESC) AS row_num FROM customer_sales cs JOIN web_site wsit ON cs.site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk LEFT JOIN customer_returns cr ON cs.site_sk = cr.site_sk AND cs.customer_sk = cr.customer_sk WHERE cs.total_sales_profit > 0 ORDER BY wsit.web_site_sk, profit_rank LIMIT 100

SELECT ws.web_site_sk AS site_sk, ws.web_name, ws.web_state, SUM(s.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COALESCE(SUM(r.wr_return_amt), 0) AS total_return_amount, SUM(s.ws_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(r.wr_return_amt), 0) AS net_profit_after_returns, CASE WHEN SUM(s.ws_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(r.wr_return_amt), 0) >= 50000 THEN 'Very High' WHEN SUM(s.ws_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(r.wr_return_amt), 0) >= 20000 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(s.ws_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(r.wr_return_amt), 0) >= 0 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_tier, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.ws_net_profit) - COALESCE(SUM(r.wr_return_amt), 0) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM web_sales s JOIN web_site ws ON s.ws_web_site_sk = ws.web_site_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns r ON s.ws_order_number = r.wr_order_number AND s.ws_item_sk = r.wr_item_sk GROUP BY ws.web_site_sk, ws.web_name, ws.web_state ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 20

WITH catalog_customer AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        'catalog' AS channel,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS net_paid_inc_tax,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS net_profit,
        w.w_state AS state,
        w.w_country AS country
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, w.w_state, w.w_country
),
web_customer AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        'web' AS channel,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS net_paid_inc_tax,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS net_profit,
        site.web_state AS state,
        site.web_country AS country
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_site site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = site.web_site_sk
    GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk, site.web_state, site.web_country
),
combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM catalog_customer
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM web_customer
)
SELECT
    customer_sk,
    channel,
    state,
    country,
    net_paid_inc_tax,
    net_profit,
    CASE WHEN net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_status,
