    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY net_paid_inc_tax DESC) AS channel_rank,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_paid_inc_tax DESC) AS overall_rank
FROM combined
ORDER BY overall_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH warehouse_profit AS (
    SELECT
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        w.w_city,
        w.w_state,
        w.w_gmt_offset,
        COUNT(DISTINCT site.web_site_sk) AS distinct_web_sites,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_net_profit,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) + SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws ON w.w_warehouse_sk = ws.ws_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_site site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = site.web_site_sk
    GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_city, w.w_state, w.w_gmt_offset
)
SELECT
    wp.w_warehouse_sk,
    wp.w_warehouse_name,
    wp.w_city,
    wp.w_state,
    wp.distinct_web_sites,
    wp.catalog_net_profit,
    wp.web_net_profit,
    wp.total_net_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN wp.total_net_profit >= 100000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN wp.total_net_profit >= 50000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS profit_category,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wp.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wp.w_gmt_offset) AS gmt_offset_dense_rank
FROM warehouse_profit wp
ORDER BY profit_rank

WITH combined_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
        cs.cs_ext_ship_cost AS ext_ship_cost,
        cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax AS net_paid_inc_ship_tax
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ws.ws_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
        ws.ws_ext_ship_cost AS ext_ship_cost,
        ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship_tax AS net_paid_inc_ship_tax
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN web_site site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = site.web_site_sk
),
 daily_agg AS (
    SELECT
        warehouse_sk,
        sold_date_sk,
        SUM(ext_ship_cost) AS total_ext_ship_cost,
        AVG(ext_ship_cost) AS avg_ext_ship_cost,
        SUM(net_paid_inc_ship_tax) AS total_net_paid_inc_ship_tax
    FROM combined_sales
    GROUP BY warehouse_sk, sold_date_sk
)
SELECT
    w.w_warehouse_sk,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    d.sold_date_sk,
    d.total_ext_ship_cost,
    CASE
        WHEN d.avg_ext_ship_cost >= 1000 THEN 'High'
        WHEN d.avg_ext_ship_cost >= 500 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS ship_cost_category,
    d.total_net_paid_inc_ship_tax,
    LAG(d.total_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY d.sold_date_sk) AS lag_total_net_paid,
    LEAD(d.total_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY d.sold_date_sk) AS lead_total_net_paid,
    AVG(d.total_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) OVER (
        PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_sk
        ORDER BY d.sold_date_sk
        ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS moving_avg_3_days
FROM daily_agg d
JOIN warehouse w ON d.warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
ORDER BY w.w_warehouse_sk, d.sold_date_sk
LIMIT 200

WITH promo_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        'catalog' AS channel,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        w.w_state AS state,
        w.w_country AS country
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    GROUP BY cs.cs_promo_sk, w.w_state, w.w_country
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ws.ws_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        'web' AS channel,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        w.w_state AS state,
        site.web_country AS country
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_site site ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = site.web_site_sk
    GROUP BY ws.ws_promo_sk, w.w_state, site.web_country
)
SELECT
    promo_sk,
    channel,
    state,
    country,
    total_discount,
    total_net_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN total_discount = 0 THEN 'No Discount'
        WHEN total_discount / NULLIF(total_net_profit, 0) > 2 THEN 'Aggressive'
        WHEN total_discount / NULLIF(total_net_profit, 0) > 1 THEN 'Moderate'
        ELSE 'Mild'
    END AS discount_intensity,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_discount DESC) AS discount_rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_dense_rank,
    SUM(total_net_profit) OVER (
        ORDER BY total_discount DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_net_profit_by_discount
FROM promo_agg
WHERE total_discount IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY discount_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH sales_data AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cs.cs_net_paid, cs.cs_net_profit, sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type, td.t_hour FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk WHERE td.t_meal_time = 'Lunch' ), aggregated AS ( SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, AVG(cs_net_paid) AS avg_net_paid, SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COUNT(*) AS sales_count FROM sales_data GROUP BY cc_call_center_sk, cc_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, avg_net_paid, total_net_profit, sales_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_net_paid DESC) AS row_num, CASE WHEN total_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_status FROM aggregated WHERE avg_net_paid > 0 ORDER BY row_num

WITH sales_data AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cs.cs_net_paid, cs.cs_net_profit, sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type, td.t_hour, td.t_meal_time FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk WHERE cs.cs_net_paid > 0 ), aggregated AS ( SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, SUM(cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT ship_mode_type) AS distinct_ship_modes, MIN(t_hour) AS earliest_hour, MAX(t_hour) AS latest_hour FROM sales_data GROUP BY cc_call_center_sk, cc_name ), final AS ( SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, total_net_paid, total_net_profit, distinct_ship_modes, earliest_hour, latest_hour, total_net_paid / SUM(total_net_paid) OVER () AS share_of_total, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS quartile FROM aggregated ) SELECT * FROM final WHERE quartile = 1 ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC

WITH sales_data AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cs.cs_net_paid, cs.cs_net_profit, sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type, td.t_hour, td.t_meal_time FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cs.cs_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN time_dim td ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk WHERE td.t_hour NOT BETWEEN 12 AND 13 ), aggregated AS ( SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, SUM(cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT ship_mode_type) AS distinct_ship_modes, MIN(t_hour) AS earliest_hour, MAX(t_hour) AS latest_hour FROM sales_data GROUP BY cc_call_center_sk, cc_name ) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, total_net_paid, total_net_profit, distinct_ship_modes, earliest_hour, latest_hour, total_net_paid / NULLIF(total_net_profit,0) AS paid_to_profit_ratio, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS dense_rank FROM aggregated WHERE total_net_profit <> 0 ORDER BY paid_to_profit_ratio DESC

WITH class_sales AS (
    SELECT ca_state,
           i_class,
           t_shift,
           SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
           AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
           MAX(ss_net_profit) AS max_profit
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN customer_address ON ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim ON ss_sold_time_sk = t_time_sk
    WHERE ca_state IN ('CA', 'NY', 'TX')               -- focus on three states
    GROUP BY ca_state, i_class, t_shift
)
SELECT ca_state,
       i_class,
       t_shift,
       total_sales,
       avg_discount,
       max_profit,
       PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY max_profit ASC) AS profit_percentile,
       CASE WHEN avg_discount BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN 'Low'
            WHEN avg_discount BETWEEN 5 AND 15 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'High' END AS discount_level
FROM class_sales
ORDER BY ca_state, profit_percentile DESC

WITH class_sales AS (
    SELECT ca_state,
           i_class,
           t_shift,
           SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
           AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN customer_address ON ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim ON ss_sold_time_sk = t_time_sk
    GROUP BY ca_state, i_class, t_shift
), ranked_sales AS (
    SELECT ca_state,
           i_class,
           t_shift,
           total_sales,
           avg_discount,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS state_dense_rank,
           NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_quartile
    FROM class_sales
)
SELECT ca_state,
       i_class,
       t_shift,
       total_sales,
       avg_discount,
       state_dense_rank,
       sales_quartile,
       CASE WHEN sales_quartile = 1 THEN 'Top Quartile' ELSE 'Other Quartile' END AS quartile_label
FROM ranked_sales
WHERE state_dense_rank <= 3                     -- keep only top‑3 classes per state
ORDER BY ca_state, state_dense_rank

WITH class_sales AS (
    SELECT ca_state,
           i_class,
           t_shift,
           SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
           AVG(ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
           COUNT(*) AS transaction_cnt
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN customer_address ON ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    JOIN time_dim ON ss_sold_time_sk = t_time_sk
    WHERE ss_ext_discount_amt > 0                     -- only sales with a discount
    GROUP BY ca_state, i_class, t_shift
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10                             -- keep only classes with at least 10 transactions
)
SELECT ca_state,
       i_class,
       t_shift,
       total_sales,
       avg_discount,
       transaction_cnt,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state, t_shift ORDER BY avg_discount ASC) AS discount_rank,
       SUM(total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state, t_shift ORDER BY total_sales DESC ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_sales
FROM class_sales
ORDER BY ca_state, t_shift, discount_rank

WITH monthly_store_profit AS (SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, d.d_current_month, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, d.d_current_month), monthly_growth AS (SELECT ss_store_sk, d_year, d_month_seq, d_current_month, total_profit, LAG(total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY ss_store_sk ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq) AS prev_month_profit, CASE WHEN LAG(total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY ss_store_sk ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN total_profit - LAG(total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY ss_store_sk ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (total_profit - LAG(total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY ss_store_sk ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq)) / NULLIF(LAG(total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY ss_store_sk ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq),0) END AS mom_growth FROM monthly_store_profit), store_avg AS (SELECT ss_store_sk, AVG(mom_growth) AS avg_monthly_growth FROM monthly_growth GROUP BY ss_store_sk) SELECT mg.ss_store_sk, mg.d_year, mg.d_current_month, mg.total_profit, mg.prev_month_profit, mg.mom_growth, CASE WHEN mg.prev_month_profit IS NULL THEN 'No Prior Data' WHEN mg.mom_growth > 0.1 THEN 'High Growth' WHEN mg.mom_growth > 0 THEN 'Moderate Growth' ELSE 'Decline' END AS growth_category, sa.avg_monthly_growth, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.avg_monthly_growth DESC) AS store_growth_rank FROM monthly_growth mg LEFT JOIN store_avg sa ON mg.ss_store_sk = sa.ss_store_sk WHERE mg.d_year = 2022 ORDER BY store_growth_rank, mg.ss_store_sk LIMIT 20

WITH sales_in_catalog AS (SELECT cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_start_date_sk, cp.cp_end_date_sk, d_start.d_date AS start_date, d_end.d_date AS end_date, ss.ss_net_profit, ss.ss_ext_sales_price FROM catalog_page cp JOIN date_dim d_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_end ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN cp.cp_start_date_sk AND cp.cp_end_date_sk) SELECT cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number, cp_catalog_page_id, start_date, end_date, SUM(ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_ext_sales, COUNT(*) AS total_transactions, CASE WHEN SUM(ss_net_profit) < 0 THEN 'Loss' WHEN SUM(ss_net_profit) BETWEEN 0 AND 1000 THEN 'Low' WHEN SUM(ss_net_profit) BETWEEN 1001 AND 5000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY SUM(ss_net_profit) DESC) AS dept_profit_rank FROM sales_in_catalog GROUP BY cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number, cp_catalog_page_id, start_date, end_date ORDER BY cp_department, dept_profit_rank

WITH catalog_sales AS (SELECT cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, d_start.d_current_month, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_ext_discount_amt, ss.ss_ext_sales_price FROM catalog_page cp JOIN date_dim d_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN cp.cp_start_date_sk AND cp.cp_end_date_sk) SELECT cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number, cp_catalog_page_id, d_current_month, ss_item_sk, SUM(ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount_amount, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount, CASE WHEN SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(ss_ext_discount_amt) / SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) END AS discount_rate, CASE WHEN SUM(ss_ext_discount_amt) / NULLIF(SUM(ss_ext_sales_price),0) > 0.2 THEN 'High Discount' WHEN SUM(ss_ext_discount_amt) / NULLIF(SUM(ss_ext_sales_price),0) > 0.1 THEN 'Medium Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY SUM(ss_ext_discount_amt) DESC) AS dept_discount_rank FROM catalog_sales GROUP BY cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number, cp_catalog_page_id, d_current_month, ss_item_sk HAVING SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) > 0 ORDER BY cp_department, dept_discount_rank LIMIT 50

WITH store_net_loss AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        d.d_date,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS net_loss
    FROM store s
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2021
    GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, d.d_date
)
SELECT
    snl.s_store_id,
    snl.s_store_name,
    snl.d_date,
    snl.net_loss,
    LAG(snl.net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY snl.d_date) AS prev_net_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN snl.net_loss > COALESCE(LAG(snl.net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY snl.d_date), 0) THEN 'INCREASED'
        ELSE 'DECREASED_OR_EQUAL'
    END AS net_loss_trend,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY snl.net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank
FROM store_net_loss snl
ORDER BY loss_rank

WITH store_quarter_returns AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        d.d_year,
        d.d_quarter_name,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_holiday = 'Y' THEN wr.wr_return_amt ELSE 0 END) AS holiday_return_amount
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN date_dim d
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store s
        ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year >= 2020
    GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_name
    HAVING SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) > 1000
)
SELECT
    sqr.s_store_id,
    sqr.s_store_name,
    sqr.d_year,
    sqr.d_quarter_name,
    sqr.return_count,
    sqr.total_return_amount,
    sqr.total_net_loss,
    sqr.holiday_return_amount,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sqr.d_year ORDER BY sqr.total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank_within_year
FROM store_quarter_returns sqr
ORDER BY sqr.d_year, loss_rank_within_year

WITH site_dates AS (
    SELECT
        ws.web_site_id,
        ws.web_name,
        d_open.d_date_sk AS open_sk,
        d_close.d_date_sk AS close_sk
    FROM web_site ws
    JOIN date_dim d_open
        ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_close
        ON ws.web_close_date_sk = d_close.d_date_sk
    WHERE d_open.d_date <= d_close.d_date
),
site_returns AS (
    SELECT
        sd.web_site_id,
        sd.web_name,
        d_ret.d_date,
        d_ret.d_date_sk,
        wr.wr_net_loss
    FROM site_dates sd
    JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN sd.open_sk AND sd.close_sk
    JOIN date_dim d_ret
        ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk
    WHERE d_ret.d_year = 2022
),
site_aggregates AS (
    SELECT
        web_site_id,
        web_name,
        SUM(wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss
    FROM site_returns
    GROUP BY web_site_id, web_name
)
SELECT
    sr.web_site_id,
    sr.web_name,
    sr.d_date,
    SUM(sr.wr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY sr.web_site_id ORDER BY sr.d_date_sk) AS cumulative_net_loss,
    sa.total_net_loss,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank
FROM site_returns sr
JOIN site_aggregates sa
    ON sr.web_site_id = sa.web_site_id
ORDER BY net_loss_rank, sr.web_site_id, sr.d_date

SELECT
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    ws.web_site_id,
    ws.web_name,
    d.d_year,
    d.d_quarter_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_returns,
    SUM(wr.wr_fee) AS total_fee,
    SUM(wr.wr_return_tax) AS total_tax,
    SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(wr.wr_fee) > 0 THEN SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) / SUM(wr.wr_fee)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS loss_per_fee_ratio,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_year ORDER BY SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) DESC) AS yearly_loss_rank
FROM store s
JOIN date_dim d
    ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN web_site ws
    ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN web_returns wr
    ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 2023
GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY yearly_loss_rank

WITH order_metrics AS ( SELECT cs.cs_order_number, cp.cp_department, ca_bill.ca_city AS billing_city, ca_ship.ca_state AS shipping_state, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_net_paid_inc_tax, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(cs.cs_coupon_amt) AS avg_coupon_amt, MIN(cs.cs_sold_date_sk) AS first_sold_date_sk FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_order_number, cp.cp_department, ca_bill.ca_city, ca_ship.ca_state ) SELECT om.cs_order_number, om.cp_department, om.billing_city, om.shipping_state, om.total_net_profit, om.total_net_paid_inc_tax, CASE WHEN om.total_net_paid_inc_tax = 0 THEN 0 ELSE om.total_net_profit / om.total_net_paid_inc_tax END AS profit_margin, om.total_quantity, om.avg_coupon_amt, CASE WHEN (om.total_net_profit / NULLIF(om.total_net_paid_inc_tax,0)) >= 0.2 THEN 'Very High' WHEN (om.total_net_profit / NULLIF(om.total_net_paid_inc_tax,0)) >= 0.1 THEN 'High' WHEN (om.total_net_profit / NULLIF(om.total_net_paid_inc_tax,0)) >= 0.05 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_margin_bucket, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY om.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_percentile, SUM(om.total_net_profit) OVER (ORDER BY om.first_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit_to_date FROM order_metrics om WHERE om.total_net_profit > 0 ORDER BY profit_percentile DESC LIMIT 50

WITH page_sales AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, ca.ca_city AS billing_city, cd.cd_gender AS billing_gender, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COUNT(*) AS total_sales, AVG(cs.cs_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit_per_sale FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, ca.ca_city, cd.cd_gender ), ranked AS ( SELECT ps.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ps.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM page_sales ps ) SELECT ranked.cp_catalog_page_id, ranked.cp_department, ranked.cp_catalog_page_number, ranked.billing_city, ranked.billing_gender, ranked.total_net_profit, ranked.total_sales, ranked.avg_net_profit_per_sale, CASE WHEN ranked.total_net_profit < 10000 THEN 'Low' WHEN ranked.total_net_profit < 50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS profit_bucket, ranked.profit_rank FROM ranked WHERE ranked.profit_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ranked.profit_rank

WITH state_ship AS ( SELECT ca.ca_state, cp.cp_type, cd.cd_credit_rating, SUM(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS total_ship_cost, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, AVG(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE cp.cp_type = 'Seasonal' GROUP BY ca.ca_state, cp.cp_type, cd.cd_credit_rating ) SELECT ss.ca_state, ss.cp_type, ss.cd_credit_rating, ss.total_ship_cost, ss.total_net_paid, ss.avg_ship_cost, CASE WHEN ss.total_net_paid = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ss.total_ship_cost / ss.total_net_paid END AS ship_to_paid_ratio, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_ship_cost DESC) AS ship_cost_rank, LAG(ss.total_ship_cost) OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_ship_cost DESC) AS lag_ship_cost, COALESCE(ss.total_ship_cost - LAG(ss.total_ship_cost) OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_ship_cost DESC), 0) AS ship_cost_change FROM state_ship ss ORDER BY ss.total_ship_cost DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT cp.cp_department, cd.cd_credit_rating, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_gender, CASE WHEN cd.cd_purchase_estimate >= 5000 THEN 'High-Value' WHEN cd.cd_purchase_estimate >= 2000 THEN 'Mid-Value' ELSE 'Low-Value' END AS purchase_segment, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_net_paid_inc_tax, AVG(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS avg_shipping_cost, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk WHERE ca_ship.ca_country = 'United States' GROUP BY cp.cp_department, cd.cd_credit_rating, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_gender, CASE WHEN cd.cd_purchase_estimate >= 5000 THEN 'High-Value' WHEN cd.cd_purchase_estimate >= 2000 THEN 'Mid-Value' ELSE 'Low-Value' END HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) > 1000 ORDER BY revenue_rank

WITH demo_item_agg AS (SELECT hd.hd_income_band_sk, i.i_category, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, AVG(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_quantity FROM store_returns sr JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk WHERE i.i_brand = 'Brand#23' GROUP BY hd.hd_income_band_sk, i.i_category) SELECT di.hd_income_band_sk, di.i_category, di.return_cnt, di.total_return_amount, di.avg_return_quantity, NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY di.hd_income_band_sk ORDER BY di.total_return_amount DESC) AS quartile, CASE WHEN di.return_cnt > 100 THEN 'Frequent' ELSE 'Infrequent' END AS frequency_flag FROM demo_item_agg di ORDER BY di.hd_income_band_sk, quartile LIMIT 30

WITH demo_item_agg AS (SELECT hd.hd_income_band_sk, i.i_category, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, AVG(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_quantity, AVG(s.s_floor_space) AS avg_floor_space FROM store_returns sr JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk GROUP BY hd.hd_income_band_sk, i.i_category) SELECT di.hd_income_band_sk, di.i_category, di.total_return_amount, di.total_net_loss, di.avg_return_quantity, di.avg_floor_space, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY di.i_category ORDER BY di.avg_return_quantity DESC) AS qty_rank_within_category, LAG(di.total_return_amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY di.hd_income_band_sk ORDER BY di.total_return_amount) AS prev_income_band_return, CASE WHEN di.avg_floor_space > 2000 THEN 'LargeStore' ELSE 'SmallStore' END AS store_size_category FROM demo_item_agg di ORDER BY di.hd_income_band_sk, qty_rank_within_category LIMIT 30

WITH demo_item_agg AS (SELECT hd.hd_income_band_sk, i.i_category, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, AVG(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_quantity, AVG(s.s_floor_space) AS avg_floor_space FROM store_returns sr JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk WHERE i.i_category IN ('Sports', 'Books') GROUP BY hd.hd_income_band_sk, i.i_category) SELECT di.hd_income_band_sk, di.i_category, di.total_return_amount, di.total_net_loss, di.avg_return_quantity, di.avg_floor_space, CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY di.hd_income_band_sk ORDER BY di.total_return_amount DESC) AS cumulative_distribution, CASE WHEN di.total_return_amount BETWEEN 20000 AND 50000 THEN 'MidRange' ELSE 'Other' END AS range_flag FROM demo_item_agg di ORDER BY di.hd_income_band_sk, cumulative_distribution DESC LIMIT 30

WITH store_profit_window AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        td.t_hour,
        ss.ss_net_profit,
        ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.ss_store_sk ORDER BY td.t_hour ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.ss_store_sk ORDER BY td.t_hour) AS hour_seq
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_net_profit <> 0
)
SELECT
    spw.ss_store_sk,
    spw.t_hour,
    spw.cumulative_profit,
    spw.hour_seq,
    CASE WHEN spw.cumulative_profit > 0 THEN 'Positive' ELSE 'Negative' END AS profit_trend
FROM store_profit_window spw
WHERE spw.hour_seq % 2 = 0
ORDER BY spw.ss_store_sk, spw.t_hour

WITH store_sales_summary AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        td.t_hour,
        COUNT(*) AS transactions,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_paid,
        AVG(ss.ss_sales_price) AS avg_price
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, td.t_hour
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 5000
)
SELECT
    sss.ss_store_sk,
    sss.t_hour,
    sss.transactions,
    sss.total_sales,
    sss.total_discount,
    sss.total_paid,
    sss.avg_price,
    NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY sss.t_hour ORDER BY sss.total_sales DESC) AS sales_quartile
FROM store_sales_summary sss
ORDER BY sss.t_hour, sales_quartile

WITH all_emp AS ( SELECT cc.cc_division AS division_id, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_name, cc.cc_employees AS employees FROM call_center cc JOIN date_dim d ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk UNION ALL SELECT s.s_division_id AS division_id, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_name, s.s_number_employees AS employees FROM store s JOIN date_dim d ON s.s_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk ), agg_emp AS ( SELECT division_id, d_year AS year, d_quarter_name AS quarter, SUM(employees) AS total_employees FROM all_emp GROUP BY division_id, d_year, d_quarter_name ) SELECT division_id, year, quarter, total_employees, CASE WHEN total_employees < 500 THEN 'Small' WHEN total_employees BETWEEN 500 AND 2000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS size_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year, quarter ORDER BY total_employees DESC) AS division_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_employees DESC) AS division_dense_rank_year FROM agg_emp WHERE year >= 2015 ORDER BY year, quarter, division_rank LIMIT 100

SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_company_name, cc.cc_division, d.d_year AS closed_year, cc.cc_employees, CASE WHEN cc.cc_tax_percentage > 5.00 THEN 'High Tax' ELSE 'Low Tax' END AS tax_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc.cc_division ORDER BY cc.cc_employees DESC) AS cc_emp_rank_in_division, s.s_store_sk, s.s_number_employees, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.s_number_employees DESC) AS store_emp_dense_rank FROM call_center cc JOIN date_dim d ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN store s ON s.s_division_id = cc.cc_division WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2020 ORDER BY cc.cc_division, cc_emp_rank_in_division LIMIT 200

WITH cp_joined AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_number, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, d_start.d_year AS start_year, d_start.d_quarter_name AS start_quarter, d_end.d_year AS end_year, d_end.d_quarter_name AS end_quarter, CASE WHEN cp.cp_type = 'promo' THEN 'Promotion' ELSE 'Regular' END AS page_category, cp.cp_start_date_sk FROM catalog_page cp JOIN date_dim d_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_end ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk ) SELECT cj.cp_catalog_number, cj.cp_catalog_page_number, cj.start_year, cj.start_quarter, cj.page_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cj.cp_catalog_number ORDER BY cj.cp_catalog_page_number DESC) AS page_rank_desc, SUM(cj.cp_catalog_page_number) OVER (PARTITION BY cj.start_year, cj.start_quarter ORDER BY cj.cp_catalog_page_number ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_sum_3_pages, AVG(cj.cp_catalog_page_number) OVER (PARTITION BY cj.start_year, cj.start_quarter) AS avg_page_number_in_quarter, cc.cc_company_name FROM cp_joined cj LEFT JOIN call_center cc ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = cj.cp_start_date_sk WHERE cj.cp_catalog_page_number IS NOT NULL ORDER BY cj.start_year, cj.start_quarter, cj.cp_catalog_page_number DESC LIMIT 150

WITH loss_by_center AS (
  SELECT
    cc.cc_call_center_sk,
    cc.cc_name,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity,
    AVG(hd_ref.hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_count,
    CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 0 THEN 'LOSS' ELSE 'PROFIT' END AS profit_status
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
  JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd_ref ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd_ref.hd_demo_sk
  GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, r.r_reason_desc
)
SELECT
  cc_call_center_sk,
  cc_name,
  r_reason_desc,
  total_net_loss,
  total_return_amount,
  total_return_quantity,
  avg_vehicle_count,
  profit_status,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r_reason_desc ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank_by_reason,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS overall_net_loss_dense_rank
FROM loss_by_center
WHERE total_return_quantity >= 5
ORDER BY r_reason_desc, net_loss_rank_by_reason
LIMIT 100

WITH reason_city_agg AS (
  SELECT
    cc.cc_city,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    hd_ret.hd_vehicle_count,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS sum_return_amt,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt_returns,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
  JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd_ret ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_ret.hd_demo_sk
  GROUP BY cc.cc_city, r.r_reason_desc, hd_ret.hd_vehicle_count
)
SELECT
  cc_city,
  r_reason_desc,
  hd_vehicle_count,
  sum_return_amt,
  cnt_returns,
  total_quantity,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_city ORDER BY sum_return_amt DESC) AS reason_rank_in_city,
  SUM(sum_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_city ORDER BY sum_return_amt DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return_amt,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sum_return_amt DESC) AS global_return_dense_rank
FROM reason_city_agg
WHERE cnt_returns >= 5
ORDER BY cc_city, reason_rank_in_city

WITH daily_stats AS (
  SELECT
    cc.cc_state,
    r.r_reason_desc,
    hd_ret.hd_vehicle_count,
    cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS return_date,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS daily_net_loss,
    AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS daily_return_cnt
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
  JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd_ret ON cr.cr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd_ret.hd_demo_sk
  GROUP BY cc.cc_state, r.r_reason_desc, hd_ret.hd_vehicle_count, cr.cr_returned_date_sk
)
SELECT
  cc_state,
  return_date,
  r_reason_desc,
  hd_vehicle_count,
  daily_net_loss,
  avg_return_amount,
  daily_return_cnt,
  LAG(daily_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_state ORDER BY return_date) AS prev_day_net_loss,
  CASE
    WHEN daily_net_loss > COALESCE(LAG(daily_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_state ORDER BY return_date), 0) THEN 'UP'
    ELSE 'DOWN_OR_EQUAL'
  END AS net_loss_trend,
  AVG(daily_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_state ORDER BY return_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_7d,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_state ORDER BY daily_net_loss DESC) AS loss_dense_rank_state
FROM daily_stats
WHERE daily_return_cnt >= 10
ORDER BY cc_state, return_date

WITH state_income_stats AS (
  SELECT
    cc.cc_state,
    hd.hd_income_band_sk,
    hd.hd_vehicle_count,
    CASE WHEN hd.hd_income_band_sk >= 5 THEN 'HIGH_INCOME' ELSE 'LOW_INCOME' END AS income_category,
    AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    COUNT(*) AS total_returns
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd ON cr.cr_refunded_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
  WHERE r.r_reason_desc NOT LIKE '%Cancelled%'
  GROUP BY cc.cc_state, hd.hd_income_band_sk, hd.hd_vehicle_count,
           CASE WHEN hd.hd_income_band_sk >= 5 THEN 'HIGH_INCOME' ELSE 'LOW_INCOME' END
)
SELECT
  cc_state,
  hd_income_band_sk,
  hd_vehicle_count,
  income_category,
  avg_return_amount,
  total_net_loss,
  total_returns,
  PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_state ORDER BY avg_return_amount DESC) AS pct_rank_avg_return,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS overall_net_loss_rank
FROM state_income_stats
WHERE total_returns >= 10
ORDER BY cc_state, income_category, pct_rank_avg_return DESC

SELECT
    w.w_warehouse_sk,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    w.w_city AS warehouse_city,
    w.w_state AS warehouse_state,
    ca_ship.ca_city AS ship_city,
    hd_ship.hd_vehicle_count,
    CASE
        WHEN hd_ship.hd_vehicle_count <= 1 THEN 'LOW_VEHICLE'
        WHEN hd_ship.hd_vehicle_count BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'MEDIUM_VEHICLE'
        ELSE 'HIGH_VEHICLE'
    END AS vehicle_category,
    cs.cs_ship_date_sk,
    cs.cs_net_paid,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) OVER (
        PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_sk
        ORDER BY cs.cs_ship_date_sk
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_net_paid,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_sk, hd_ship.hd_vehicle_count
        ORDER BY cs.cs_ship_date_sk DESC
    ) AS recent_ship_rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_sk
        ORDER BY cs.cs_net_paid DESC
    ) AS net_paid_rank
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN warehouse w
    ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd_ship
    ON cs.cs_ship_hdemo_sk = hd_ship.hd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca_ship
    ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk
WHERE cs.cs_ship_date_sk IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY w.w_warehouse_sk, cs.cs_ship_date_sk

WITH warehouse_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        w.w_city,
        w.w_state,
        ca.ca_city AS billing_city,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
        AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk) AS distinct_bill_households,
        AVG(hd_bill.hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_per_household,
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(cs.cs_net_paid), 0) > 0.20 THEN 'HIGH_PROFIT'
            ELSE 'NORMAL_PROFIT'
        END AS profit_category
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_bill
        ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY
        w.w_warehouse_sk,
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        w.w_city,
        w.w_state,
        ca.ca_city
)
SELECT
    wm.*,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wm.total_net_paid DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM warehouse_metrics wm
ORDER BY revenue_rank

WITH promo_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_promo_sk,
        ca.ca_state,
        w.w_state AS warehouse_state,
        hd_bill.hd_buy_potential,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_tax) AS total_tax,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_net_paid_inc_tax,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        AVG(cs.cs_quantity) AS avg_quantity
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer_address ca
        ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN warehouse w
        ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd_bill
        ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_bill.hd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY
        cs.cs_promo_sk,
        ca.ca_state,
        w.w_state,
        hd_bill.hd_buy_potential
)
SELECT
    pm.cs_promo_sk,
    pm.ca_state,
    pm.warehouse_state,
    pm.hd_buy_potential,
    pm.total_discount,
    pm.total_tax,
    pm.total_net_paid_inc_tax,
    pm.total_net_paid,
    pm.avg_quantity,
    CASE
        WHEN pm.total_discount / NULLIF(pm.total_net_paid, 0) > 0.15 THEN 'AGGRESSIVE'
        ELSE 'NORMAL'
    END AS promo_aggressiveness,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pm.ca_state ORDER BY pm.total_discount DESC) AS discount_rank_state,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pm.total_discount DESC) AS global_discount_rank,
    SUM(pm.total_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY pm.ca_state) AS state_total_discount
FROM promo_metrics pm
WHERE pm.total_discount / NULLIF(pm.total_net_paid, 0) > 0.15
ORDER BY pm.ca_state, discount_rank_state

WITH store_stats AS ( SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amount, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) - SUM(ss.ss_ext_list_price) AS discount_vs_list FROM store_sales ss JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk WHERE hd.hd_dep_count BETWEEN 1 AND 3 GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound ) SELECT ss_store_sk, ib_income_band_sk, ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound, transaction_count, avg_discount_amount, total_sales, discount_vs_list, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales ASC) AS low_sales_rank FROM store_stats WHERE avg_discount_amount > 0.05 ORDER BY low_sales_rank

WITH store_stats AS ( SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, COUNT(DISTINCT hd.hd_demo_sk) AS household_count, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amount, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) - SUM(ss.ss_ext_list_price) AS discount_vs_list, SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount FROM store_sales ss JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk WHERE ss.ss_net_profit > 0 GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT hd.hd_demo_sk) >= 5 ) SELECT ss_store_sk, ib_income_band_sk, ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound, household_count, avg_discount_amount, total_sales, discount_vs_list, total_discount, SUM(total_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY ib_income_band_sk) AS total_discount_by_income_band FROM store_stats ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 20

WITH store_stats AS ( SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, COUNT(DISTINCT hd.hd_demo_sk) AS household_count, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amount, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) - SUM(ss.ss_ext_list_price) AS discount_vs_list FROM store_sales ss JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk WHERE ss.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450815 AND 2450825 GROUP BY CUBE(ss.ss_store_sk, ib.ib_income_band_sk), ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound ) SELECT ss_store_sk, ib_income_band_sk, ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound, household_count, avg_discount_amount, total_sales, discount_vs_list, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_quartile FROM store_stats WHERE household_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sales_quartile

WITH cc_q AS (
    SELECT
        cc_state AS state,
        od.d_year AS year,
        od.d_quarter_name AS quarter,
        cc_tax_percentage AS tax_pct,
        cc_employees AS employees,
        cc_sq_ft AS sq_ft
    FROM call_center
    LEFT JOIN date_dim od ON call_center.cc_open_date_sk = od.d_date_sk
    WHERE cc_country = 'US'
),
store_q AS (
    SELECT
        s_state AS state,
        cd.d_year AS year,
        cd.d_quarter_name AS quarter,
        s_tax_percentage AS tax_pct,
        s_number_employees AS employees,
        s_floor_space AS sq_ft
    FROM store
    LEFT JOIN date_dim cd ON store.s_closed_date_sk = cd.d_date_sk
    WHERE s_country = 'US'
),
web_q AS (
    SELECT
        web_state AS state,
        od.d_year AS year,
        od.d_quarter_name AS quarter,
        web_tax_percentage AS tax_pct,
        0 AS employees,
        0 AS sq_ft
    FROM web_site
    LEFT JOIN date_dim od ON web_site.web_open_date_sk = od.d_date_sk
    WHERE web_country = 'US'
),
combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM cc_q
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM store_q
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM web_q
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        state,
        year,
        quarter,
        AVG(tax_pct) AS avg_tax_pct,
        SUM(employees) AS total_employees,
        SUM(sq_ft) AS total_sq_ft,
        COUNT(*) AS record_cnt
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY state, year, quarter
)
SELECT
    state,
    year,
    quarter,
    avg_tax_pct,
    total_employees,
    total_sq_ft,
    record_cnt,
    total_employees / NULLIF(total_sq_ft, 0) AS employee_density,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY avg_tax_pct DESC) AS tax_rank_state,
    MAX(avg_tax_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY year) AS max_tax_year
FROM agg
WHERE total_sq_ft > 0
ORDER BY state, year, quarter

WITH cc_q AS (
    SELECT
        cc_state AS state,
        od.d_year AS year,
        od.d_quarter_name AS quarter,
        cc_tax_percentage AS tax_pct,
        cc_employees AS employees,
        cc_sq_ft AS sq_ft,
        CASE WHEN cc_gmt_offset > 0 THEN 'East' ELSE 'West' END AS region
    FROM call_center
    LEFT JOIN date_dim od ON call_center.cc_open_date_sk = od.d_date_sk
    WHERE od.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1 AND 6
),
store_q AS (
    SELECT
        s_state AS state,
        cd.d_year AS year,
        cd.d_quarter_name AS quarter,
        s_tax_percentage AS tax_pct,
        s_number_employees AS employees,
        s_floor_space AS sq_ft,
        CASE WHEN s_gmt_offset > 0 THEN 'East' ELSE 'West' END AS region
    FROM store
    LEFT JOIN date_dim cd ON store.s_closed_date_sk = cd.d_date_sk
    WHERE cd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1 AND 6
),
web_q AS (
    SELECT
        web_state AS state,
        od.d_year AS year,
        od.d_quarter_name AS quarter,
        web_tax_percentage AS tax_pct,
        0 AS employees,
        0 AS sq_ft,
        CASE WHEN web_gmt_offset > 0 THEN 'East' ELSE 'West' END AS region
    FROM web_site
    LEFT JOIN date_dim od ON web_site.web_open_date_sk = od.d_date_sk
    WHERE od.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1 AND 6
),
combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM cc_q
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM store_q
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM web_q
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        state,
        region,
        year,
        quarter,
        SUM(employees) AS total_employees,
        SUM(sq_ft) AS total_sq_ft,
        AVG(tax_pct) AS avg_tax_pct
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY state, region, year, quarter
)
SELECT
    state,
    region,
    year,
    quarter,
    avg_tax_pct,
    total_employees,
    total_sq_ft,
    total_employees / NULLIF(total_sq_ft, 0) AS employee_density,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY total_employees DESC) AS emp_percent_rank,
    SUM(total_employees) OVER (PARTITION BY state) AS state_total_employees
FROM agg
WHERE total_sq_ft > 0
ORDER BY region, state, year, quarter

WITH cc_q AS (
    SELECT
        cc_state AS state,
        od.d_year AS year,
        od.d_quarter_name AS quarter,
        cc_tax_percentage AS tax_pct,
        cc_employees AS employees,
        cc_sq_ft AS sq_ft,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', cc_rec_start_date) AS start_month
    FROM call_center
    LEFT JOIN date_dim od ON call_center.cc_open_date_sk = od.d_date_sk
),
store_q AS (
    SELECT
        s_state AS state,
        cd.d_year AS year,
        cd.d_quarter_name AS quarter,
        s_tax_percentage AS tax_pct,
        s_number_employees AS employees,
        s_floor_space AS sq_ft,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', s_rec_start_date) AS start_month
    FROM store
    LEFT JOIN date_dim cd ON store.s_closed_date_sk = cd.d_date_sk
),
web_q AS (
    SELECT
        web_state AS state,
        od.d_year AS year,
        od.d_quarter_name AS quarter,
        web_tax_percentage AS tax_pct,
        0 AS employees,
        0 AS sq_ft,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', web_rec_start_date) AS start_month
    FROM web_site
    LEFT JOIN date_dim od ON web_site.web_open_date_sk = od.d_date_sk
),
combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM cc_q
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM store_q
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM web_q
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        state,
        year,
        quarter,
        AVG(tax_pct) AS avg_tax_pct,
        SUM(employees) AS total_employees,
        SUM(sq_ft) AS total_sq_ft,
        MIN(start_month) AS earliest_start_month
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY state, year, quarter
)
SELECT
    state,
    year,
    quarter,
    avg_tax_pct,
    total_employees,
    total_sq_ft,
    earliest_start_month,
    total_employees / NULLIF(total_sq_ft, 0) AS employee_density,
    CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY avg_tax_pct) AS tax_cume_dist,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY earliest_start_month) AS start_month_rank
FROM agg
WHERE total_sq_ft > 0
ORDER BY year, avg_tax_pct DESC

WITH daily_country AS ( SELECT wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS return_date, c.c_birth_country AS country, COUNT(*) AS returns, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, AVG(wr.wr_fee) AS avg_fee FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY wr.wr_returned_date_sk, c.c_birth_country ) SELECT return_date, country, returns, total_return_amount, total_net_loss, avg_fee, SUM(total_net_loss) OVER (ORDER BY return_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_loss, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY return_date ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS amount_rank, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 2000 THEN 'HIGH_LOSS' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS loss_flag FROM daily_country ORDER BY return_date, amount_rank LIMIT 100

SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_order_number) AS distinct_orders, CASE WHEN SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) > 1000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS loss_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) DESC) AS loss_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ib.ib_income_band_sk ORDER BY SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) DESC) AS income_band_rank FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk WHERE wr.wr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 20200101 AND 20201231 GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound HAVING SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) > 0 ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT c.c_birth_month, ib.ib_income_band_sk, CASE WHEN SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) < 100 THEN 'SMALL' WHEN SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) BETWEEN 100 AND 500 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LARGE' END AS return_size_category, COUNT(*) AS return_count, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, AVG(wr.wr_fee) AS avg_fee, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_birth_month ORDER BY SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) DESC) AS month_return_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk WHERE c.c_birth_month IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.c_birth_month, ib.ib_income_band_sk ORDER BY c.c_birth_month, total_return_amount DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, COUNT(*) AS total_returns, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(wr.wr_fee) AS avg_fee, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_amt_inc_tax, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers, CASE WHEN SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) > 100 THEN 'HIGH_VOLUME' ELSE 'LOW_VOLUME' END AS volume_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) DESC) AS quantity_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ib.ib_income_band_sk ORDER BY SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) DESC) AS income_band_amount_rank FROM web_returns wr JOIN household_demographics hd ON wr.wr_returning_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY hd.hd_demo_sk, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 10

WITH sales_by_customer AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk), returns_by_customer AS (SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk), combined AS (SELECT s.customer_sk, s.total_sales_profit, COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss, s.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) AS net_contribution FROM sales_by_customer s JOIN returns_by_customer r ON s.customer_sk = r.customer_sk) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT customer_sk, total_sales_profit, total_return_loss, net_contribution, CASE WHEN net_contribution >= 10000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN net_contribution >= 5000 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS tier, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_contribution DESC) AS contribution_rank FROM combined ) t WHERE contribution_rank <= 5 ORDER BY contribution_rank

WITH sales_agg AS (SELECT cs.cs_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS profit, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_paid FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_warehouse_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk), returns_agg AS (SELECT cr.cr_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_warehouse_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk), combined AS (SELECT COALESCE(s.warehouse_sk, r.warehouse_sk) AS warehouse_sk, COALESCE(s.date_sk, r.date_sk) AS date_sk, COALESCE(s.profit, 0) AS profit, COALESCE(r.loss, 0) AS loss, COALESCE(s.total_paid, 0) AS total_paid, COALESCE(r.total_return_amount, 0) AS total_return_amount FROM sales_agg s FULL OUTER JOIN returns_agg r ON s.warehouse_sk = r.warehouse_sk AND s.date_sk = r.date_sk) SELECT warehouse_sk, date_sk, profit, loss, profit - loss AS net, LAG(profit) OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_sk ORDER BY date_sk) AS prev_profit, LAG(loss) OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_sk ORDER BY date_sk) AS prev_loss, CASE WHEN LAG(profit) OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_sk ORDER BY date_sk) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN LAG(profit) OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_sk ORDER BY date_sk) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (profit - LAG(profit) OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_sk ORDER BY date_sk)) / LAG(profit) OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_sk ORDER BY date_sk) * 100 END AS profit_growth_pct, CASE WHEN LAG(loss) OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_sk ORDER BY date_sk) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN LAG(loss) OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_sk ORDER BY date_sk) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (loss - LAG(loss) OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_sk ORDER BY date_sk)) / LAG(loss) OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_sk ORDER BY date_sk) * 100 END AS loss_growth_pct, CASE WHEN LAG(profit) OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_sk ORDER BY date_sk) IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN profit > LAG(profit) OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_sk ORDER BY date_sk) * 1.2 THEN 'Significant Increase' WHEN profit < LAG(profit) OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_sk ORDER BY date_sk) * 0.8 THEN 'Significant Decrease' ELSE 'Stable' END AS profit_trend_flag FROM combined WHERE profit <> 0 OR loss <> 0 ORDER BY warehouse_sk, date_sk

WITH item_agg AS (SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) - SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS net_impact FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name) SELECT i_item_id, i_product_name, total_sales_profit, total_return_loss, net_impact, CASE WHEN net_impact < 0 THEN 'Loss' ELSE 'Profit' END AS profit_status, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_impact DESC) AS profit_rank FROM item_agg ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 20

WITH sales_qty AS (SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_sales_qty FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk) SELECT r.r_reason_desc, COUNT(*) AS return_count, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amt, SUM(sq.total_sales_qty) AS total_sales_qty, CASE WHEN SUM(sq.total_sales_qty) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) / SUM(sq.total_sales_qty) END AS return_ratio, CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN SUM(sq.total_sales_qty) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) / SUM(sq.total_sales_qty) END) > 0.1 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS ratio_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (CASE WHEN SUM(sq.total_sales_qty) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) / SUM(sq.total_sales_qty) END) DESC) AS ratio_rank FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN sales_qty sq ON cr.cr_item_sk = sq.cs_item_sk JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk WHERE i.i_category = 'Electronics' GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc ORDER BY ratio_rank LIMIT 10

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_sales, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(cs.cs_ext_tax) AS total_tax FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk ), returns_agg AS ( SELECT sr.sr_item_sk AS item_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_returns, SUM(sr.sr_return_tax) AS total_return_tax, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_loss FROM store_returns sr GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk ) SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_returns, 0) AS net_revenue, CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.total_loss, 0) > 0.1 * COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) THEN 'High Return Loss' ELSE 'Normal' END AS return_loss_flag, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_returns, 0)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM item i LEFT JOIN sales_agg s ON i.i_item_sk = s.item_sk LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON i.i_item_sk = r.item_sk WHERE i.i_category IS NOT NULL ORDER BY revenue_rank LIMIT 20

WITH sales_with_trend AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, i.i_product_name, w.w_warehouse_name, cs.cs_ext_discount_amt, LAG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_item_sk ORDER BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk) AS prev_discount, CASE WHEN cs.cs_ext_discount_amt > LAG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_item_sk ORDER BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk) THEN 'Increasing Discount' ELSE 'Stable/Decreasing' END AS discount_trend, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_item_sk) AS total_net_paid_per_item, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.cs_item_sk ORDER BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk DESC) AS recent_sale_rank FROM catalog_sales cs INNER JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk INNER JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk WHERE cs.cs_ext_discount_amt IS NOT NULL ) SELECT cs_item_sk, i_product_name, w_warehouse_name, cs_ext_discount_amt, prev_discount, discount_trend, total_net_paid_per_item FROM sales_with_trend WHERE recent_sale_rank = 1 ORDER BY total_net_paid_per_item DESC LIMIT 10

WITH category_profit AS ( SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, i.i_category, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS category_net_profit FROM catalog_sales cs INNER JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk INNER JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_name, i.i_category ) SELECT w_warehouse_name, i_category, category_net_profit, CASE WHEN category_net_profit > 100000 THEN 'High Profit' WHEN category_net_profit BETWEEN 50000 AND 100000 THEN 'Medium Profit' ELSE 'Low Profit' END AS profit_level, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w_warehouse_name ORDER BY category_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM category_profit ORDER BY w_warehouse_name, profit_rank

WITH sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_warehouse_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS sales_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS sales_net_profit, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_warehouse_sk ), returns AS ( SELECT sr.sr_item_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS returns_amt, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS returns_loss, COUNT(*) AS returns_cnt FROM store_returns sr GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk ), item_warehouse AS ( SELECT s.cs_item_sk, s.cs_warehouse_sk, i.i_item_id, i.i_category, w.w_warehouse_name, s.sales_net_paid, s.sales_net_profit, COALESCE(r.returns_amt, 0) AS returns_amt, COALESCE(r.returns_loss, 0) AS returns_loss, (s.sales_net_paid - COALESCE(r.returns_amt, 0)) AS net_revenue, CASE WHEN s.sales_net_paid = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (s.sales_net_profit - COALESCE(r.returns_loss, 0)) / s.sales_net_paid END AS profit_margin FROM sales s LEFT JOIN returns r ON s.cs_item_sk = r.sr_item_sk INNER JOIN item i ON s.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk INNER JOIN warehouse w ON s.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk ) SELECT i_item_id, i_category, w_warehouse_name, net_revenue, profit_margin, CASE WHEN profit_margin >= 0.30 THEN 'Excellent' WHEN profit_margin >= 0.20 THEN 'Good' WHEN profit_margin >= 0.10 THEN 'Average' ELSE 'Poor' END AS profit_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w_warehouse_name ORDER BY profit_margin DESC) AS warehouse_item_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY profit_margin DESC) AS overall_profit_percentile FROM item_warehouse WHERE net_revenue > 0 ORDER BY profit_margin DESC LIMIT 50

WITH store_shift_stats AS ( SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, t.t_shift, c.c_birth_country, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers FROM store_sales ss JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, t.t_shift, c.c_birth_country ) SELECT sss.s_store_id, sss.s_store_name, sss.t_shift, sss.c_birth_country, sss.total_net_profit, sss.total_quantity, sss.avg_discount, sss.distinct_customers, NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY sss.t_shift ORDER BY sss.total_quantity) AS quantity_quartile FROM store_shift_stats sss WHERE sss.total_net_profit BETWEEN 50000 AND 250000 ORDER BY sss.t_shift, quantity_quartile

WITH store_shift_stats AS ( SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, t.t_shift, c.c_birth_country, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers FROM store_sales ss JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, t.t_shift, c.c_birth_country HAVING SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) > 50000 ) SELECT sss.s_store_id, sss.s_store_name, sss.t_shift, sss.c_birth_country, sss.total_net_profit, sss.total_quantity, sss.avg_discount, sss.distinct_customers, CASE WHEN sss.total_quantity > 500 THEN 'BIG' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS quantity_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sss.c_birth_country ORDER BY sss.avg_discount ASC) AS discount_rank FROM store_shift_stats sss ORDER BY sss.total_net_profit DESC LIMIT 40

WITH brand_gmt_page_returns AS ( SELECT ca.ca_gmt_offset, i.i_brand, wp.wp_type, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_ret_qty, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk WHERE i.i_category = 'Electronics' GROUP BY ca.ca_gmt_offset, i.i_brand, wp.wp_type ) SELECT ca_gmt_offset, i_brand, wp_type, total_net_loss, total_ret_qty, return_cnt, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 180000 THEN 'HIGH_LOSS' WHEN total_net_loss BETWEEN 60000 AND 180000 THEN 'MEDIUM_LOSS' ELSE 'LOW_LOSS' END AS loss_category, NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_gmt_offset ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_quartile FROM brand_gmt_page_returns ORDER BY ca_gmt_offset, loss_quartile

WITH brand_gmt_page_returns AS ( SELECT ca.ca_gmt_offset, i.i_brand, wp.wp_type, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_ret_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_order_number) AS distinct_orders, AVG(wr.wr_return_tax) AS avg_tax FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk WHERE wr.wr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 20220101 AND 20221231 GROUP BY ca.ca_gmt_offset, i.i_brand, wp.wp_type HAVING SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) > 100 ) SELECT ca_gmt_offset, i_brand, wp_type, total_net_loss, total_ret_qty, distinct_orders, avg_tax, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 250000 THEN 'HIGH_LOSS' WHEN total_net_loss BETWEEN 80000 AND 250000 THEN 'MEDIUM_LOSS' ELSE 'LOW_LOSS' END AS loss_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_brand ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS brand_loss_rank FROM brand_gmt_page_returns ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC LIMIT 50

WITH brand_gmt_page_returns AS ( SELECT ca.ca_gmt_offset, i.i_brand, wp.wp_type, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_ret_qty, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk WHERE ca.ca_gmt_offset BETWEEN -5 AND 0 GROUP BY ca.ca_gmt_offset, i.i_brand, wp.wp_type ) SELECT ca_gmt_offset, i_brand, wp_type, total_net_loss, total_ret_qty, return_cnt, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 220000 THEN 'HIGH_LOSS' WHEN total_net_loss BETWEEN 70000 AND 220000 THEN 'MEDIUM_LOSS' ELSE 'LOW_LOSS' END AS loss_category, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY wp_type ORDER BY total_ret_qty DESC) AS qty_percentile, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_gmt_offset, i_brand ORDER BY total_net_loss ASC) AS asc_loss_rank FROM brand_gmt_page_returns ORDER BY ca_gmt_offset, qty_percentile DESC

WITH store_perf AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_sk,
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_city,
        s.s_state,
        COUNT(*) AS total_returns,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        AVG(sr.sr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amount,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN store s
        ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN customer c
        ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
    GROUP BY s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state
)
SELECT
    s_store_id,
    s_store_name,
    s_city,
    s_state,
    total_returns,
    total_net_loss,
    avg_return_amount,
    total_return_qty,
    CASE
        WHEN total_net_loss > 50000 THEN 'High Loss'
        WHEN total_net_loss > 20000 THEN 'Medium Loss'
        ELSE 'Low Loss'
    END AS loss_category,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank
FROM store_perf
ORDER BY loss_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH cust_refunds AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_email_address,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        hd.hd_income_band_sk,
        SUM(sr.sr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
        COUNT(*) AS num_returns,
        MIN(s.s_store_id) AS primary_store_id
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN customer c
        ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
        ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN store s
        ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_email_address,
             hd.hd_buy_potential, hd.hd_income_band_sk
)
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    c_first_name,
    c_last_name,
    c_email_address,
    hd_buy_potential,
    hd_income_band_sk,
    primary_store_id,
    total_refunded_cash,
    total_return_amount,
    num_returns,
    CASE
        WHEN total_refunded_cash >= 10000 THEN 'Platinum'
        WHEN total_refunded_cash >= 5000 THEN 'Gold'
        WHEN total_refunded_cash >= 1000 THEN 'Silver'
        ELSE 'Bronze'
    END AS refund_tier,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_refunded_cash DESC) AS refund_rank
FROM cust_refunds
WHERE total_refunded_cash > 0
ORDER BY refund_rank
LIMIT 20

WITH warehouse_agg AS (SELECT w.w_warehouse_id, w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_state, w.w_city, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit, AVG(CASE WHEN ws.ws_ext_sales_price > 0 THEN ws.ws_ext_discount_amt / ws.ws_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS avg_discount_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_promo_id) AS promo_cnt FROM web_sales ws JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk WHERE ws.ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2459999 GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_id, w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_state, w.w_city) SELECT wa.w_warehouse_id, wa.w_warehouse_name, wa.w_state, wa.w_city, wa.order_cnt, wa.total_profit, wa.avg_discount_rate, wa.promo_cnt, CASE WHEN wa.total_profit >= 2000000 THEN 'Very High' WHEN wa.total_profit >= 1000000 THEN 'High' WHEN wa.total_profit >= 500000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_band, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wa.total_profit DESC) AS profit_dense_rank, SUM(wa.total_profit) OVER (ORDER BY wa.total_profit DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit, approx_percentile(wa.total_profit, 0.5) OVER () AS median_total_profit FROM warehouse_agg wa ORDER BY wa.total_profit DESC LIMIT 100

WITH promo_agg AS (SELECT p.p_promo_id AS promo_id, p.p_promo_name AS promo_name, p.p_purpose AS purpose, w.w_state, wp.wp_type, CASE WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV' WHEN p.p_channel_email = 'Y' THEN 'Email' WHEN p.p_channel_radio = 'Y' THEN 'Radio' WHEN p.p_channel_press = 'Y' THEN 'Press' ELSE 'Other' END AS primary_channel, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS num_orders, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM web_sales ws JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_purpose, w.w_state, wp.wp_type, CASE WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV' WHEN p.p_channel_email = 'Y' THEN 'Email' WHEN p.p_channel_radio = 'Y' THEN 'Radio' WHEN p.p_channel_press = 'Y' THEN 'Press' ELSE 'Other' END) SELECT p.promo_id, p.promo_name, p.purpose, p.w_state, p.wp_type, p.primary_channel, p.num_orders, p.total_sales, p.total_profit, p.total_discount, p.total_quantity, CASE WHEN p.total_profit >= 1000000 THEN 'High' WHEN p.total_profit >= 500000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY p.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.primary_channel ORDER BY p.total_profit DESC) AS channel_profit_rank FROM promo_agg p ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 50

WITH state_promo AS (SELECT w.w_state, p.p_purpose, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS order_cnt, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, AVG(CASE WHEN ws.ws_ext_sales_price > 0 THEN ws.ws_ext_discount_amt / ws.ws_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS avg_discount_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_promo_id) AS distinct_promos, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_type) AS distinct_page_types FROM web_sales ws JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk WHERE ws.ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2459999 GROUP BY w.w_state, p.p_purpose) SELECT sp.w_state, sp.p_purpose, sp.order_cnt, sp.total_sales, sp.total_profit, sp.avg_discount_rate, sp.distinct_promos, sp.distinct_page_types, CASE WHEN sp.total_profit >= 2000000 THEN 'Very High' WHEN sp.total_profit >= 1000000 THEN 'High' WHEN sp.total_profit >= 500000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sp.p_purpose ORDER BY sp.total_profit DESC) AS state_profit_rank, SUM(sp.total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY sp.p_purpose ORDER BY sp.total_profit ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_profit, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sp.avg_discount_rate DESC) AS discount_rate_dense_rank FROM state_promo sp ORDER BY sp.p_purpose, sp.total_profit DESC LIMIT 100

WITH page_daily_sales AS (SELECT wp.wp_web_page_id AS wp_id, wp.wp_type, w.w_state, ws.ws_sold_date_sk, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS daily_sales, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS daily_quantity, SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) AS daily_net_paid_inc_ship_tax, CASE WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV' WHEN p.p_channel_email = 'Y' THEN 'Email' WHEN p.p_channel_radio = 'Y' THEN 'Radio' WHEN p.p_channel_press = 'Y' THEN 'Press' ELSE 'Other' END AS primary_channel FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_type, w.w_state, ws.ws_sold_date_sk, CASE WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV' WHEN p.p_channel_email = 'Y' THEN 'Email' WHEN p.p_channel_radio = 'Y' THEN 'Radio' WHEN p.p_channel_press = 'Y' THEN 'Press' ELSE 'Other' END), page_agg AS (SELECT wp_id, wp_type, w_state, primary_channel, SUM(daily_sales) AS total_sales, SUM(daily_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(daily_sales) AS avg_daily_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(daily_sales) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM page_daily_sales GROUP BY wp_id, wp_type, w_state, primary_channel) SELECT pds.wp_id, pds.wp_type, pds.w_state, pds.primary_channel, pa.total_sales, pa.total_quantity, pa.avg_daily_sales, pa.sales_rank, SUM(pds.daily_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY pds.wp_id ORDER BY pds.ws_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_7d_net_paid_inc_ship_tax, LAG(pds.daily_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY pds.wp_id ORDER BY pds.ws_sold_date_sk) AS prev_day_sales, LEAD(pds.daily_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY pds.wp_id ORDER BY pds.ws_sold_date_sk) AS next_day_sales FROM page_daily_sales pds JOIN page_agg pa ON pds.wp_id = pa.wp_id ORDER BY pa.sales_rank LIMIT 20

WITH returns_with_date AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, cr.cr_warehouse_sk, cr.cr_net_loss, cr.cr_returned_date_sk, date_parse(cast(cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS varchar), '%Y%m%d') AS return_date FROM catalog_returns cr ), returns_enriched AS ( SELECT r.*, c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_state FROM returns_with_date r JOIN customer c ON r.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN warehouse w ON r.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk ) SELECT re.c_customer_id, re.c_first_name, re.c_last_name, re.cd_gender, re.w_warehouse_name, re.w_state, re.return_date, re.cr_net_loss, SUM(re.cr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY re.cr_returning_customer_sk ORDER BY re.return_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_loss, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY re.cr_returning_customer_sk ORDER BY re.return_date) AS return_seq, CASE WHEN SUM(re.cr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY re.cr_returning_customer_sk ORDER BY re.return_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) > 2000 THEN 'VIP_RISK' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS risk_category FROM returns_enriched re WHERE re.return_date >= DATE '2022-01-01' ORDER BY re.c_customer_id, re.return_date LIMIT 100

WITH reason_gender AS ( SELECT cr.cr_reason_sk, cd.cd_gender AS gender, w.w_state, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_tax) AS total_tax, AVG(cr.cr_return_tax) AS avg_tax, AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_qty FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_reason_sk, cd.cd_gender, w.w_state ) SELECT rg.cr_reason_sk, rg.gender, rg.w_state, rg.return_cnt, rg.total_net_loss, rg.total_tax, CASE WHEN rg.avg_tax > 5.00 THEN 'HIGH_TAX' WHEN rg.avg_tax > 2.00 THEN 'MEDIUM_TAX' ELSE 'LOW_TAX' END AS tax_category, rg.avg_return_amount, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rg.gender ORDER BY rg.total_net_loss DESC) AS gender_net_loss_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rg.total_net_loss DESC) AS overall_net_loss_rank FROM reason_gender rg WHERE rg.return_cnt >= 5 ORDER BY rg.total_net_loss DESC LIMIT 15

WITH wh_returns AS ( SELECT cr.cr_warehouse_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk, cr.cr_net_loss, cr.cr_return_amount, cr.cr_return_quantity, cr.cr_returning_customer_sk FROM catalog_returns cr ), wh_gender AS ( SELECT wh.cr_warehouse_sk, cd.cd_gender AS gender, SUM(wh.cr_net_loss) AS gender_net_loss, SUM(wh.cr_return_amount) AS gender_return_amount, SUM(wh.cr_return_quantity) AS gender_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT wh.cr_returning_customer_sk) AS gender_customer_cnt FROM wh_returns wh JOIN customer c ON wh.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY wh.cr_warehouse_sk, cd.cd_gender ), wh_agg AS ( SELECT cr.cr_warehouse_sk, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, AVG(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk) AS distinct_returning_customers, MIN(cr.cr_returned_date_sk) AS first_return_date, MAX(cr.cr_returned_date_sk) AS last_return_date FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_warehouse_sk ) SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_city, w.w_state, wa.total_net_loss, wa.total_return_amount, wa.avg_return_qty, wa.distinct_returning_customers, CASE WHEN wa.total_net_loss > 10000 THEN 'ALERT' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS loss_flag, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wa.total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_state ORDER BY wa.total_net_loss DESC) AS state_net_loss_rank, wg.gender, wg.gender_net_loss, wg.gender_return_amount, wg.gender_qty, wg.gender_customer_cnt, SUM(wa.total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_state ORDER BY w.w_warehouse_name ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_state_net_loss FROM wh_agg wa JOIN warehouse w ON wa.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk LEFT JOIN wh_gender wg ON wg.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY wa.total_net_loss DESC LIMIT 20

WITH cust_ret AS ( SELECT cr_refunded_customer_sk AS cust_sk, cr_warehouse_sk, SUM(cr_net_loss) AS net_loss, SUM(cr_return_quantity) AS total_qty, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns GROUP BY cr_refunded_customer_sk, cr_warehouse_sk ), cust_agg AS ( SELECT cust_sk, SUM(net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(total_qty) AS total_qty, SUM(return_cnt) AS return_cnt FROM cust_ret GROUP BY cust_sk ), cust_best_wh AS ( SELECT cust_sk, cr_warehouse_sk, net_loss, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cust_sk ORDER BY net_loss DESC) AS rn FROM cust_ret ) SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, ca.total_net_loss, ca.total_qty, ca.return_cnt, CASE WHEN ca.total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS loss_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_net_loss DESC) AS overall_net_loss_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.cd_gender ORDER BY ca.total_net_loss DESC) AS gender_net_loss_rank, w.w_warehouse_name AS top_warehouse_by_loss FROM cust_agg ca JOIN customer c ON ca.cust_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk LEFT JOIN cust_best_wh cbw ON cbw.cust_sk = ca.cust_sk AND cbw.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON cbw.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY ca.total_net_loss DESC LIMIT 10

WITH wr_agg AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_item_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
        MAX(wr.wr_returned_date_sk) AS latest_return_date
    FROM web_returns wr
    GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk
),
ws_adj AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        ws.ws_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
        ws.ws_net_profit - COALESCE(wr_agg.total_return_loss, 0) AS profit_adj,
        ws.ws_sold_time_sk AS time_sk,
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD('day', ws.ws_sold_date_sk, DATE '1997-01-01'), '%Y-%m') AS sale_month,
        'web' AS source
    FROM web_sales ws
    LEFT JOIN wr_agg ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr_agg.wr_item_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_net_paid > 0
),
cs_adj AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        cs.cs_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS profit_adj,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk AS time_sk,
