        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD('day', cs.cs_sold_date_sk, DATE '1997-01-01'), '%Y-%m') AS sale_month,
        'catalog' AS source
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    WHERE cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax > 0
),
promo_union AS (
    SELECT promo_sk, discount_amt, profit_adj, time_sk, sale_month, source FROM cs_adj
    UNION ALL
    SELECT promo_sk, discount_amt, profit_adj, time_sk, sale_month, source FROM ws_adj
),
promo_with_time AS (
    SELECT
        pu.promo_sk,
        pu.source,
        pu.discount_amt,
        pu.profit_adj,
        pu.sale_month,
        t.t_shift,
        t.t_am_pm
    FROM promo_union pu
    JOIN time_dim t ON pu.time_sk = t.t_time_sk
),
promo_agg AS (
    SELECT
        promo_sk,
        source,
        sale_month,
        SUM(profit_adj) AS month_profit,
        AVG(discount_amt) AS month_avg_discount,
        SUM(profit_adj) / NULLIF(AVG(discount_amt), 0) AS profit_per_discount
    FROM promo_with_time
    GROUP BY promo_sk, source, sale_month
    HAVING SUM(profit_adj) <> 0
)
SELECT
    promo_sk,
    source,
    sale_month,
    month_profit,
    month_avg_discount,
    profit_per_discount,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY source ORDER BY profit_per_discount DESC) AS month_rank
FROM promo_agg
ORDER BY source, month_rank

WITH wr_agg AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_item_sk,
        wr.wr_order_number,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
        COUNT(DISTINCT wr.wr_returned_date_sk) AS distinct_return_days
    FROM web_returns wr
    WHERE wr.wr_fee > 0
    GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk, wr.wr_order_number
),
ws_adj AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        ws.ws_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
        ws.ws_net_profit - COALESCE(wr_agg.total_return_loss, 0) AS profit_adj,
        ws.ws_sold_time_sk AS time_sk,
        ws.ws_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode,
        'web' AS source
    FROM web_sales ws
    LEFT JOIN wr_agg ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr_agg.wr_item_sk AND ws.ws_order_number = wr_agg.wr_order_number
    WHERE ws.ws_ship_mode_sk IS NOT NULL
),
cs_adj AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        cs.cs_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS profit_adj,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk AS time_sk,
        cs.cs_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode,
        'catalog' AS source
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    WHERE cs.cs_ship_mode_sk IS NOT NULL
),
promo_union AS (
    SELECT promo_sk, discount_amt, profit_adj, time_sk, ship_mode, source FROM cs_adj
    UNION ALL
    SELECT promo_sk, discount_amt, profit_adj, time_sk, ship_mode, source FROM ws_adj
),
promo_with_time AS (
    SELECT
        pu.promo_sk,
        pu.source,
        pu.discount_amt,
        pu.profit_adj,
        pu.ship_mode,
        t.t_shift,
        t.t_hour
    FROM promo_union pu
    JOIN time_dim t ON pu.time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    WHERE t.t_shift = 'Evening'
),
promo_agg AS (
    SELECT
        promo_sk,
        source,
        ship_mode,
        SUM(profit_adj) AS total_profit,
        AVG(discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        SUM(profit_adj) / NULLIF(AVG(discount_amt), 0) AS profit_per_discount
    FROM promo_with_time
    GROUP BY promo_sk, source, ship_mode
)
SELECT
    promo_sk,
    source,
    ship_mode,
    total_profit,
    avg_discount,
    profit_per_discount,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY source ORDER BY profit_per_discount DESC) AS rank_by_ship_mode
FROM promo_agg
ORDER BY source, rank_by_ship_mode

WITH wr_agg AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_item_sk,
        wr.wr_order_number,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS return_cnt
    FROM web_returns wr
    WHERE wr.wr_return_quantity > 0
    GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk, wr.wr_order_number
),
ws_adj AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        ws.ws_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
        ws.ws_net_profit - COALESCE(wr_agg.total_return_loss, 0) AS profit_adj,
        ws.ws_sold_time_sk AS time_sk,
        ws.ws_quantity AS qty,
        'web' AS source
    FROM web_sales ws
    LEFT JOIN wr_agg
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr_agg.wr_item_sk
           AND ws.ws_order_number = wr_agg.wr_order_number
    WHERE ws.ws_quantity >= 1
),
cs_adj AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk,
        cs.cs_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
        cs.cs_net_profit AS profit_adj,
        cs.cs_sold_time_sk AS time_sk,
        cs.cs_quantity AS qty,
        'catalog' AS source
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    WHERE cs.cs_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 10
),
promo_union AS (
    SELECT promo_sk, discount_amt, profit_adj, time_sk, qty, source FROM cs_adj
    UNION ALL
    SELECT promo_sk, discount_amt, profit_adj, time_sk, qty, source FROM ws_adj
),
promo_with_time AS (
    SELECT
        pu.promo_sk,
        pu.source,
        pu.discount_amt,
        pu.profit_adj,
        pu.qty,
        t.t_hour,
        t.t_shift,
        t.t_meal_time
    FROM promo_union pu
    JOIN time_dim t ON pu.time_sk = t.t_time_sk
    WHERE t.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
),
promo_agg AS (
    SELECT
        promo_sk,
        source,
        SUM(profit_adj) AS total_profit_adj,
        AVG(discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        SUM(qty) AS total_qty,
        SUM(profit_adj) / NULLIF(AVG(discount_amt), 0) AS profit_per_discount,
        CASE WHEN SUM(profit_adj) > 0 THEN 'Positive' ELSE 'Negative' END AS profit_sign
    FROM promo_with_time
    GROUP BY promo_sk, source
)
SELECT
    promo_sk,
    source,
    total_profit_adj,
    avg_discount,
    total_qty,
    profit_per_discount,
    profit_sign,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY source ORDER BY total_profit_adj DESC) AS promo_rank
FROM promo_agg
ORDER BY source, promo_rank

WITH store_stats AS ( SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amount, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) - SUM(ss.ss_ext_list_price) AS discount_vs_list FROM store_sales ss JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN income_band ib ON hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk WHERE ib.ib_lower_bound >= 50000 GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ib.ib_income_band_sk, ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound ) SELECT ss_store_sk, ib_income_band_sk, ib_lower_bound, ib_upper_bound, transaction_count, avg_discount_amount, total_sales, discount_vs_list, SUM(total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY ss_store_sk) AS store_total_sales FROM store_stats WHERE transaction_count BETWEEN 10 AND 100 ORDER BY store_total_sales DESC

WITH store_metrics AS ( SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_promo_sk, SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS total_store_sales_price, COUNT(*) AS store_sales_count, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_store_quantity, AVG(ss.ss_sales_price) AS avg_store_price FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_promo_sk ), web_metrics AS ( SELECT ws.ws_promo_sk, SUM(ws.ws_sales_price) AS total_web_sales_price, COUNT(*) AS web_sales_count, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_web_quantity, AVG(ws.ws_sales_price) AS avg_web_price FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_promo_sk ) SELECT p.p_promo_id, sm.ss_store_sk AS store_id, sm.avg_store_price, sm.total_store_quantity, wm.avg_web_price, wm.total_web_quantity, CASE WHEN wm.avg_web_price > sm.avg_store_price THEN 'WebHigher' WHEN wm.avg_web_price < sm.avg_store_price THEN 'StoreHigher' ELSE 'Equal' END AS price_comparison, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.ss_store_sk ORDER BY sm.avg_store_price DESC) AS store_price_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (wm.avg_web_price - sm.avg_store_price) DESC) AS price_diff_rank FROM store_metrics sm JOIN promotion p ON sm.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk LEFT JOIN web_metrics wm ON sm.ss_promo_sk = wm.ws_promo_sk WHERE sm.total_store_quantity > 0 ORDER BY price_diff_rank LIMIT 50

WITH ss_agg AS ( SELECT ss_promo_sk, SUM(ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit, SUM(ss_ext_discount_amt) AS store_discount_amt, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales_amount FROM store_sales GROUP BY ss_promo_sk ), ws_agg AS ( SELECT ws_promo_sk, SUM(ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit, SUM(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS web_discount_amt, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales_amount FROM web_sales GROUP BY ws_promo_sk ) SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, COALESCE(ss_agg.store_net_profit, 0) AS total_store_net_profit, COALESCE(ws_agg.web_net_profit, 0) AS total_web_net_profit, COALESCE(ss_agg.store_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(ws_agg.web_net_profit, 0) AS total_net_profit, COALESCE(ss_agg.store_discount_amt, 0) + COALESCE(ws_agg.web_discount_amt, 0) AS total_discount_amount, CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS discount_status, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(ss_agg.store_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(ws_agg.web_net_profit, 0) DESC) AS promo_rank FROM promotion p LEFT JOIN ss_agg ON p.p_promo_sk = ss_agg.ss_promo_sk LEFT JOIN ws_agg ON p.p_promo_sk = ws_agg.ws_promo_sk ORDER BY promo_rank

WITH promo_sales AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_start_date_sk, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount FROM promotion p JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_start_date_sk ), promo_returns AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_sk, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount FROM promotion p JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN web_returns wr ON wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk ) SELECT ps.p_promo_id, ps.p_promo_name, ps.p_start_date_sk, ps.total_sales_amount, COALESCE(pr.total_return_amount, 0) AS total_return_amount, CASE WHEN ps.total_sales_amount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(pr.total_return_amount, 0) / ps.total_sales_amount END AS return_ratio, CASE WHEN CASE WHEN ps.total_sales_amount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(pr.total_return_amount, 0) / ps.total_sales_amount END > 0.1 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_level, SUM(ps.total_sales_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ps.p_promo_id ORDER BY ps.p_start_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_sales, SUM(COALESCE(pr.total_return_amount, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY ps.p_promo_id ORDER BY ps.p_start_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_returns, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN ps.total_sales_amount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(pr.total_return_amount, 0) / ps.total_sales_amount END DESC) AS return_ratio_rank FROM promo_sales ps LEFT JOIN promo_returns pr ON ps.p_promo_sk = pr.p_promo_sk ORDER BY return_ratio_rank

WITH store_cust AS ( SELECT ss_customer_sk AS cust_id, SUM(ss_net_profit) AS store_net_profit FROM store_sales GROUP BY ss_customer_sk ), web_cust AS ( SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk AS cust_id, SUM(ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit FROM web_sales GROUP BY ws_bill_customer_sk ), returns_cust AS ( SELECT wr_returning_customer_sk AS cust_id, SUM(wr_net_loss) AS return_net_loss FROM web_returns GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk ) SELECT COALESCE(sc.cust_id, wc.cust_id, rc.cust_id) AS customer_id, COALESCE(sc.store_net_profit, 0) AS store_net_profit, COALESCE(wc.web_net_profit, 0) AS web_net_profit, COALESCE(rc.return_net_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss, (COALESCE(sc.store_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wc.web_net_profit, 0) - COALESCE(rc.return_net_loss, 0)) AS net_gain, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(sc.store_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wc.web_net_profit, 0) - COALESCE(rc.return_net_loss, 0)) > 0 THEN 'Profit' ELSE 'Loss' END AS profit_status, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(sc.store_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wc.web_net_profit, 0) - COALESCE(rc.return_net_loss, 0)) DESC) AS gain_rank FROM store_cust sc FULL OUTER JOIN web_cust wc ON sc.cust_id = wc.cust_id FULL OUTER JOIN returns_cust rc ON COALESCE(sc.cust_id, wc.cust_id) = rc.cust_id WHERE COALESCE(sc.cust_id, wc.cust_id, rc.cust_id) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY gain_rank LIMIT 100

WITH cs_agg AS (SELECT cs_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, SUM(cs_net_profit) AS cs_total_profit, SUM(cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS cs_total_paid FROM catalog_sales GROUP BY cs_warehouse_sk), ws_agg AS (SELECT ws_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, SUM(ws_net_profit) AS ws_total_profit, SUM(ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS ws_total_paid FROM web_sales GROUP BY ws_warehouse_sk), page_agg AS (SELECT ws.ws_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_sk) AS distinct_page_cnt FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY ws.ws_warehouse_sk) SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_city, w.w_state, COALESCE(cs.cs_total_profit,0) + COALESCE(ws.ws_total_profit,0) AS total_profit, COALESCE(cs.cs_total_paid,0) + COALESCE(ws.ws_total_paid,0) AS total_paid, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(cs.cs_total_paid,0) + COALESCE(ws.ws_total_paid,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (COALESCE(cs.cs_total_profit,0) + COALESCE(ws.ws_total_profit,0)) / (COALESCE(cs.cs_total_paid,0) + COALESCE(ws.ws_total_paid,0)) END AS profit_margin, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(cs.cs_total_profit,0) + COALESCE(ws.ws_total_profit,0)) / NULLIF((COALESCE(cs.cs_total_paid,0) + COALESCE(ws.ws_total_paid,0)),0) >= 0.2 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN (COALESCE(cs.cs_total_profit,0) + COALESCE(ws.ws_total_profit,0)) / NULLIF((COALESCE(cs.cs_total_paid,0) + COALESCE(ws.ws_total_paid,0)),0) >= 0.1 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS profit_margin_category, COALESCE(p.distinct_page_cnt,0) AS distinct_web_pages, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(cs.cs_total_profit,0) + COALESCE(ws.ws_total_profit,0)) / NULLIF((COALESCE(cs.cs_total_paid,0) + COALESCE(ws.ws_total_paid,0)),0) DESC) AS profit_margin_rank FROM warehouse w LEFT JOIN cs_agg cs ON w.w_warehouse_sk = cs.warehouse_sk LEFT JOIN ws_agg ws ON w.w_warehouse_sk = ws.warehouse_sk LEFT JOIN page_agg p ON w.w_warehouse_sk = p.warehouse_sk ORDER BY profit_margin_rank LIMIT 20

WITH page_daily AS (SELECT ws.ws_web_page_sk AS web_page_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, ws.ws_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_web_page_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk, ws.ws_warehouse_sk), page_daily_lag AS (SELECT pd.*, LAG(pd.avg_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY pd.web_page_sk ORDER BY pd.sold_date_sk) AS prev_avg_discount, CASE WHEN LAG(pd.avg_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY pd.web_page_sk ORDER BY pd.sold_date_sk) IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN pd.avg_discount > LAG(pd.avg_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY pd.web_page_sk ORDER BY pd.sold_date_sk) THEN 'INCREASE' WHEN pd.avg_discount < LAG(pd.avg_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY pd.web_page_sk ORDER BY pd.sold_date_sk) THEN 'DECREASE' ELSE 'NO_CHANGE' END AS discount_trend FROM page_daily pd), page_overall AS (SELECT ws.ws_web_page_sk AS web_page_sk, AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS overall_avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS overall_sales_cnt FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_web_page_sk), page_catalog_qty AS (SELECT wp.wp_web_page_sk AS web_page_sk, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_catalog_qty FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = ws.ws_warehouse_sk GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_sk) SELECT wp.wp_web_page_id, wp.wp_url, wp.wp_type, w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_city, w.w_state, pd.sold_date_sk, pd.avg_discount, pd.prev_avg_discount, pd.discount_trend, po.overall_avg_discount, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY po.overall_avg_discount DESC) AS overall_discount_rank, pcq.total_catalog_qty FROM page_daily_lag pd JOIN web_page wp ON pd.web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN warehouse w ON pd.warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN page_overall po ON pd.web_page_sk = po.web_page_sk LEFT JOIN page_catalog_qty pcq ON pd.web_page_sk = pcq.web_page_sk WHERE pd.sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2450100 ORDER BY po.overall_avg_discount DESC LIMIT 100

WITH cat_item AS (SELECT cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk, cs.cs_quantity AS qty, cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax AS revenue, cs.cs_net_profit AS profit, cs.cs_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk FROM catalog_sales cs), web_item AS (SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk, ws.ws_quantity AS qty, ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax AS revenue, ws.ws_net_profit AS profit, ws.ws_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, ws.ws_web_page_sk AS web_page_sk FROM web_sales ws), combined_item AS (SELECT item_sk, qty, revenue, profit, warehouse_sk, NULL AS web_page_sk FROM cat_item UNION ALL SELECT item_sk, qty, revenue, profit, warehouse_sk, web_page_sk FROM web_item), item_agg AS (SELECT ci.item_sk, SUM(ci.qty) AS total_quantity, SUM(ci.revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(ci.profit) AS total_profit FROM combined_item ci GROUP BY ci.item_sk), item_warehouse_qty AS (SELECT ci.item_sk, ci.warehouse_sk, SUM(ci.qty) AS qty_by_wh FROM combined_item ci GROUP BY ci.item_sk, ci.warehouse_sk), item_top_warehouse AS (SELECT iuw.item_sk, iuw.warehouse_sk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY iuw.item_sk ORDER BY iuw.qty_by_wh DESC) AS rn FROM item_warehouse_qty iuw), item_page_cnt AS (SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_sk) AS distinct_page_cnt FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk), ranked_items AS (SELECT ia.item_sk, ia.total_quantity, ia.total_revenue, ia.total_profit, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ia.total_quantity DESC) AS quantity_dense_rank FROM item_agg ia) SELECT ri.item_sk, ri.total_quantity, ri.total_revenue, CASE WHEN ri.total_revenue = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ri.total_profit / ri.total_revenue END AS profit_margin, ri.quantity_dense_rank, CASE WHEN ri.quantity_dense_rank <= 10 THEN 'TOP' WHEN ri.quantity_dense_rank <= 100 THEN 'MID' ELSE 'LOW' END AS quantity_category, w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_city, w.w_state, ipc.distinct_page_cnt, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ri.total_quantity) AS quantity_percentile FROM ranked_items ri LEFT JOIN item_top_warehouse itw ON ri.item_sk = itw.item_sk AND itw.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON itw.warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk LEFT JOIN item_page_cnt ipc ON ri.item_sk = ipc.item_sk ORDER BY ri.total_quantity DESC LIMIT 100

WITH catalog_daily AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax AS net_paid, cs.cs_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk FROM catalog_sales cs), web_daily AS (SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax AS net_paid, ws.ws_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, ws.ws_web_page_sk AS web_page_sk FROM web_sales ws), combined AS (SELECT customer_sk, sold_date_sk, net_paid, warehouse_sk FROM catalog_daily UNION ALL SELECT customer_sk, sold_date_sk, net_paid, warehouse_sk FROM web_daily), customer_daily AS (SELECT customer_sk, sold_date_sk, SUM(net_paid) AS daily_net_paid, MAX(warehouse_sk) AS warehouse_sk FROM combined GROUP BY customer_sk, sold_date_sk), customer_trends AS (SELECT cd.*, LAG(cd.daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cd.customer_sk ORDER BY cd.sold_date_sk) AS prev_daily_net_paid, CASE WHEN LAG(cd.daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cd.customer_sk ORDER BY cd.sold_date_sk) IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN cd.daily_net_paid > LAG(cd.daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cd.customer_sk ORDER BY cd.sold_date_sk) THEN 'UP' WHEN cd.daily_net_paid < LAG(cd.daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cd.customer_sk ORDER BY cd.sold_date_sk) THEN 'DOWN' ELSE 'STABLE' END AS net_paid_trend, SUM(cd.daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cd.customer_sk) AS total_net_paid FROM customer_daily cd), customer_rank AS (SELECT ct.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ct.total_net_paid DESC) AS total_net_paid_rank FROM customer_trends ct), latest_warehouse AS (SELECT cr.customer_sk, cr.warehouse_sk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cr.customer_sk ORDER BY cr.sold_date_sk DESC) AS rn FROM customer_rank cr), customer_distinct_pages AS (SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_sk) AS distinct_page_cnt FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk), customer_catalog_orders AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, COUNT(*) AS catalog_order_cnt FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk) SELECT cr.customer_sk, w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_city, w.w_state, cr.sold_date_sk, cr.daily_net_paid, cr.prev_daily_net_paid, cr.net_paid_trend, cr.total_net_paid, cr.total_net_paid_rank, COALESCE(cdp.distinct_page_cnt,0) AS distinct_page_cnt, COALESCE(cco.catalog_order_cnt,0) AS catalog_order_cnt FROM customer_rank cr JOIN latest_warehouse lw ON cr.customer_sk = lw.customer_sk AND lw.rn = 1 JOIN warehouse w ON lw.warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk LEFT JOIN customer_distinct_pages cdp ON cr.customer_sk = cdp.customer_sk LEFT JOIN customer_catalog_orders cco ON cr.customer_sk = cco.customer_sk WHERE cr.total_net_paid_rank <= 50 ORDER BY cr.total_net_paid_rank LIMIT 50

SELECT ca.ca_state, wp.wp_type, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, AVG(wr.wr_return_tax) AS avg_return_tax, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.ca_state ORDER BY SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) DESC) AS net_loss_rank, CASE WHEN SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) > 5000 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) > 0 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS net_loss_category FROM web_returns wr JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_state, wp.wp_type HAVING SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) > 0 ORDER BY ca.ca_state, net_loss_rank

WITH cust_returns AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_id) AS distinct_pages, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, AVG(wr.wr_return_tax) AS avg_return_tax, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM customer c JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON c.c_customer_sk = wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state ) SELECT c.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC) AS return_amt_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_qty DESC) AS return_qty_dense_rank, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 10000 THEN 'High Loss' WHEN total_net_loss > 0 THEN 'Moderate Loss' ELSE 'No Loss' END AS loss_category FROM cust_returns c WHERE total_return_amt > 0 ORDER BY return_amt_rank LIMIT 20

WITH cust_daily_returns AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_state, wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS return_date, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS daily_return_amt, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_id) AS distinct_pages FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_state, wr.wr_returned_date_sk ), cust_trend AS ( SELECT *, LAG(daily_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY c_customer_id ORDER BY return_date) AS prev_daily_return_amt, CASE WHEN daily_return_amt > LAG(daily_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY c_customer_id ORDER BY return_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_increase FROM cust_daily_returns ) SELECT c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, ca_state, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_increase = 1) AS increase_days, SUM(daily_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, AVG(distinct_pages) AS avg_distinct_pages_per_day, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_increase = 1) DESC) AS increase_rank, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_increase = 1) >= 5 THEN 'Consistently Increasing' WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_increase = 1) >= 2 THEN 'Occasionally Increasing' ELSE 'Stable/Decreasing' END AS trend_category FROM cust_trend GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, ca_state HAVING SUM(daily_return_amt) > 0 ORDER BY increase_rank LIMIT 50

SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_email_address, ca_curr.ca_city, ca_curr.ca_state, COUNT(*) AS total_returns, SUM(CASE WHEN wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same_address_returns, SUM(CASE WHEN wr.wr_returning_addr_sk <> c.c_current_addr_sk THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS other_address_returns, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS same_address_return_pct, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) DESC) AS return_address_pct_rank, CASE WHEN 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) >= 90 THEN 'Very High Same Address' WHEN 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) >= 70 THEN 'High Same Address' WHEN 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) >= 50 THEN 'Moderate Same Address' ELSE 'Low Same Address' END AS same_address_category FROM web_returns wr JOIN customer c ON wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer_address ca_curr ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca_curr.ca_address_sk JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk WHERE wr.wr_return_amt > 0 GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_email_address, ca_curr.ca_city, ca_curr.ca_state HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY return_address_pct_rank LIMIT 30

WITH discount_data AS (
  SELECT
    cp.cp_type,
    p.p_purpose,
    cs.cs_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
    cs.cs_order_number AS transaction_id
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
  JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  WHERE cp.cp_type = 'Catalog'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Web' AS cp_type,
    p.p_purpose,
    ws.ws_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
    ws.ws_order_number AS transaction_id
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  WHERE ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > 0
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    cp_type,
    p_purpose,
    SUM(discount_amt) AS total_discount,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
    AVG(discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
    MAX(discount_amt) AS max_discount
  FROM discount_data
  GROUP BY cp_type, p_purpose
)
SELECT
  cp_type,
  p_purpose,
  total_discount,
  txn_count,
  avg_discount,
  max_discount,
  total_discount * 0.1 AS ten_percent_of_total,
  SUM(total_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type) AS total_by_type
FROM aggregated
WHERE txn_count >= 10
ORDER BY total_by_type DESC, cp_type

WITH discount_data AS (
  SELECT
    cp.cp_type,
    p.p_purpose,
    cs.cs_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
    cs.cs_order_number AS transaction_id,
    cs.cs_sold_time_sk AS sold_time_sk
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
  JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  WHERE cs.cs_ext_discount_amt IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Web' AS cp_type,
    p.p_purpose,
    ws.ws_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
    ws.ws_order_number AS transaction_id,
    ws.ws_sold_time_sk AS sold_time_sk
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  WHERE ws.ws_ext_discount_amt IS NOT NULL
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    cp_type,
    p_purpose,
    SUM(discount_amt) AS total_discount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_id) AS txn_cnt,
    MIN(sold_time_sk) AS first_time,
    MAX(sold_time_sk) AS last_time
  FROM discount_data
  GROUP BY cp_type, p_purpose
)
SELECT
  cp_type,
  p_purpose,
  total_discount,
  txn_cnt,
  total_discount / NULLIF(txn_cnt,0) AS avg_discount,
  DATE_DIFF('day', FROM_UNIXTIME(first_time), FROM_UNIXTIME(last_time)) AS active_days,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type ORDER BY total_discount DESC) AS rank_by_discount
FROM aggregated
WHERE total_discount > 2000
ORDER BY cp_type, rank_by_discount

WITH catalog_agg AS (
  SELECT
    cp.cp_department,
    p.p_channel_tv,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_inc_tax,
    MAX(cs.cs_net_profit) AS max_profit
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
  JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  GROUP BY cp.cp_department, p.p_channel_tv
  HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) > 20000
),
web_agg AS (
  SELECT
    'Web' AS cp_department,
    p.p_channel_tv,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_inc_tax,
    MAX(ws.ws_net_profit) AS max_profit
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  GROUP BY p.p_channel_tv
  HAVING SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax) > 20000
)
SELECT
  department,
  channel_tv,
  total_inc_tax,
  max_profit,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_tv ORDER BY max_profit DESC) AS profit_dense_rank
FROM (
  SELECT cp_department AS department, p_channel_tv AS channel_tv, total_inc_tax, max_profit FROM catalog_agg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cp_department AS department, p_channel_tv AS channel_tv, total_inc_tax, max_profit FROM web_agg
) u
ORDER BY channel_tv, profit_dense_rank

WITH catalog_agg AS (
  SELECT
    cp.cp_department,
    p.p_channel_tv,
    COUNT(*) AS sales_count,
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
  JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk >= 2450000
  GROUP BY cp.cp_department, p.p_channel_tv
),
web_agg AS (
  SELECT
    'Web' AS cp_department,
    p.p_channel_tv,
    COUNT(*) AS sales_count,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  WHERE ws.ws_sold_date_sk >= 2450000
  GROUP BY p.p_channel_tv
)
SELECT
  department,
  channel_tv,
  sales_count,
  total_discount,
  CASE WHEN total_discount > 5000 THEN 'Heavy' ELSE 'Light' END AS discount_level,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY sales_count DESC) AS dept_rank
FROM (
  SELECT cp_department AS department, p_channel_tv AS channel_tv, sales_count, total_discount FROM catalog_agg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cp_department AS department, p_channel_tv AS channel_tv, sales_count, total_discount FROM web_agg
) t
ORDER BY department, dept_rank

WITH catalog_agg AS (
  SELECT
    cp.cp_department,
    p.p_channel_tv,
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_list_price) AS total_list_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_item_sk) AS distinct_items
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
  JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  WHERE cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax BETWEEN 100 AND 1000
  GROUP BY cp.cp_department, p.p_channel_tv
),
web_agg AS (
  SELECT
    'Web' AS cp_department,
    p.p_channel_tv,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_list_price) AS total_list_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_item_sk) AS distinct_items
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  WHERE ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship_tax BETWEEN 100 AND 1000
  GROUP BY p.p_channel_tv
)
SELECT
  department,
  channel_tv,
  total_list_price,
  distinct_items,
  CASE WHEN distinct_items >= 50 THEN 'Broad' ELSE 'Narrow' END AS assortment_type,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY total_list_price DESC) AS list_price_rank
FROM (
  SELECT cp_department AS department, p_channel_tv AS channel_tv, total_list_price, distinct_items FROM catalog_agg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cp_department AS department, p_channel_tv AS channel_tv, total_list_price, distinct_items FROM web_agg
) v
ORDER BY department, list_price_rank

WITH catalog_agg AS (
  SELECT
    cp.cp_department,
    p.p_channel_tv,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_paid,
    AVG(cs.cs_net_profit) AS avg_profit
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  INNER JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
  INNER JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  WHERE cs.cs_quantity > 5
  GROUP BY cp.cp_department, p.p_channel_tv
),
web_agg AS (
  SELECT
    'Web' AS cp_department,
    p.p_channel_tv,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_paid,
    AVG(ws.ws_net_profit) AS avg_profit
  FROM web_sales ws
  INNER JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  WHERE ws.ws_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 10
  GROUP BY p.p_channel_tv
)
SELECT
  department,
  channel_tv,
  total_paid,
  avg_profit,
  NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_tv ORDER BY total_paid DESC) AS revenue_quartile
FROM (
  SELECT cp_department AS department, p_channel_tv AS channel_tv, total_paid, avg_profit FROM catalog_agg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cp_department AS department, p_channel_tv AS channel_tv, total_paid, avg_profit FROM web_agg
) AS combined
ORDER BY channel_tv, revenue_quartile

SELECT web_site_id, d_year, d_month_seq, monthly_sales, avg_coupon, weekend_sales, weekday_sales, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY monthly_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM ( SELECT ws.web_site_id, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS monthly_sales, AVG(cs.cs_coupon_amt) AS avg_coupon, SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_dow IN (1,7) THEN cs.cs_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_dow NOT IN (1,7) THEN cs.cs_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_sales FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN web_site ws ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = ws.web_open_date_sk WHERE ws.web_state = 'CA' GROUP BY ws.web_site_id, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq ) AS ws_monthly ORDER BY d_year, monthly_sales DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT cc_call_center_id, cc_name, cc_manager, total_profit, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank, CASE WHEN cc_tax_percentage > 5.00 THEN 'High Tax' ELSE 'Low Tax' END AS tax_bracket FROM ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_manager, cc.cc_tax_percentage, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = 2022 GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_manager, cc.cc_tax_percentage ) AS profit_by_cc ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 5

WITH cc_yearly_sales AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_id, d.d_year, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_net_paid FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_id, d.d_year ) SELECT ccy.cc_call_center_id, ccy.d_year, ccy.total_net_paid, LAG(ccy.total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY ccy.cc_call_center_id ORDER BY ccy.d_year) AS prev_year_net, CASE WHEN LAG(ccy.total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY ccy.cc_call_center_id ORDER BY ccy.d_year) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (ccy.total_net_paid - LAG(ccy.total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY ccy.cc_call_center_id ORDER BY ccy.d_year)) / LAG(ccy.total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY ccy.cc_call_center_id ORDER BY ccy.d_year) * 100 END AS yoy_growth_pct, ws_avg.avg_web_tax FROM cc_yearly_sales ccy LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.d_year, AVG(ws.web_tax_percentage) AS avg_web_tax FROM web_site ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_year ) ws_avg ON ccy.d_year = ws_avg.d_year WHERE ccy.d_year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2022 ORDER BY ccy.cc_call_center_id, ccy.d_year

SELECT cc_call_center_id, web_site_id, overlapping_days, employee_sqft_ratio, time_diff_indicator, overlap_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY overlapping_days DESC) AS overlap_rank FROM ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_id, ws.web_site_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.d_date_sk) AS overlapping_days, (cc.cc_employees * 1.0) / NULLIF(cc.cc_sq_ft,0) AS employee_sqft_ratio, CASE WHEN cc.cc_gmt_offset > ws.web_gmt_offset THEN 'CC Ahead' ELSE 'WS Ahead' END AS time_diff_indicator, COALESCE(SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price),0) AS overlap_sales FROM date_dim d JOIN call_center cc ON d.d_date_sk >= cc.cc_open_date_sk AND (cc.cc_closed_date_sk IS NULL OR d.d_date_sk <= cc.cc_closed_date_sk) JOIN web_site ws ON d.d_date_sk >= ws.web_open_date_sk AND (ws.web_close_date_sk IS NULL OR d.d_date_sk <= ws.web_close_date_sk) LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2022 GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_id, ws.web_site_id, cc.cc_employees, cc.cc_sq_ft, cc.cc_gmt_offset, ws.web_gmt_offset HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.d_date_sk) > 0 ) AS overlap_stats ORDER BY overlapping_days DESC LIMIT 10

WITH monthly_dept AS ( SELECT cp.cp_department, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS month_return_amount, AVG(cr.cr_return_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_department, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq ) SELECT cp_department, d_year, d_month_seq, month_return_amount, avg_ship_cost, SUM(month_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq) AS cumulative_return, month_return_amount - LAG(month_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq) AS month_over_month_diff, CASE WHEN month_return_amount > LAG(month_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq) * 1.2 THEN 'Spike' WHEN month_return_amount < LAG(month_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq) * 0.8 THEN 'Drop' ELSE 'Stable' END AS month_trend FROM monthly_dept ORDER BY cp_department, d_year, d_month_seq

WITH returns_q AS ( SELECT cr.cr_catalog_page_sk, cr.cr_net_loss, cr.cr_returned_date_sk, cr.cr_ship_mode_sk FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = 2022 AND d.d_quarter_seq = 2 ), aggregated AS ( SELECT cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_name, SUM(r.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, CASE WHEN SUM(r.cr_net_loss) > 10000 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(r.cr_net_loss) > 5000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS loss_category, sm.sm_carrier FROM returns_q r JOIN catalog_page cp ON r.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN date_dim d ON r.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON r.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_name, sm.sm_carrier ) SELECT cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number, cp_catalog_page_id, d_year, d_quarter_name, total_net_loss, loss_category, sm_carrier, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM aggregated ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT sm_carrier, sm_type, total_net_loss, total_return_qty, loss_severity, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_dense_rank FROM ( SELECT sm.sm_carrier, sm.sm_type, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 20000 THEN 'Critical' WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 10000 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 5000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS loss_severity FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2022 GROUP BY sm.sm_carrier, sm.sm_type ) t ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC

WITH page_item_returns AS ( SELECT cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cr.cr_item_sk, start_d.d_date AS page_start_date, MIN(ret_d.d_date) AS first_return_date, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, sm.sm_carrier AS shipping_carrier FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN date_dim start_d ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = start_d.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim ret_d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = ret_d.d_date_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cr.cr_item_sk, start_d.d_date, sm.sm_carrier ) SELECT cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number, cp_catalog_page_id, cr_item_sk, total_net_loss, total_return_qty, first_return_date, page_start_date, days_to_first_return, return_speed_category, shipping_carrier, dept_item_rank FROM ( SELECT cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number, cp_catalog_page_id, cr_item_sk, total_net_loss, total_return_qty, first_return_date, page_start_date, DATE_DIFF('day', page_start_date, first_return_date) AS days_to_first_return, CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', page_start_date, first_return_date) <= 30 THEN 'Fast' WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', page_start_date, first_return_date) <= 90 THEN 'Moderate' ELSE 'Slow' END AS return_speed_category, shipping_carrier, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS dept_item_rank FROM page_item_returns WHERE DATE_DIFF('day', page_start_date, first_return_date) IS NOT NULL ) t WHERE dept_item_rank <= 3 ORDER BY cp_department, dept_item_rank

WITH sales_data AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_sales_price,
        ws.ws_ext_discount_amt,
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        ws.ws_warehouse_sk,
        wr.wr_return_amt
    FROM web_sales ws
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
       AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
)
SELECT
    price_category,
    wsit.web_city,
    wh.w_city AS warehouse_city,
    AVG(ext_discount) AS avg_discount,
    AVG(return_amt) AS avg_return_amt,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY price_category ORDER BY AVG(ext_discount) DESC) AS city_discount_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN ws_sales_price >= 200 THEN 'Premium'
            WHEN ws_sales_price >= 100 THEN 'Standard'
            ELSE 'Budget'
        END AS price_category,
        ws_ext_discount_amt AS ext_discount,
        wr_return_amt AS return_amt,
        ws_web_site_sk,
        ws_warehouse_sk
    FROM sales_data
) s
JOIN web_site wsit ON s.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk
JOIN warehouse wh ON s.ws_warehouse_sk = wh.w_warehouse_sk
GROUP BY price_category, wsit.web_city, wh.w_city
ORDER BY price_category, city_discount_rank

WITH sales_adj AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_order_number,
        ws.ws_warehouse_sk,
        ws.ws_web_site_sk,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss, 0) AS net_loss,
        (ws.ws_net_profit - COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss, 0)) AS adj_net_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
       AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
),
profit_by_wh AS (
    SELECT
        wsit.web_name,
        wh.w_warehouse_name,
        SUM(sa.adj_net_profit) AS total_adj_profit,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(sa.adj_net_profit) > 100000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN SUM(sa.adj_net_profit) BETWEEN 50000 AND 100000 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS profit_category
    FROM sales_adj sa
    JOIN warehouse wh ON sa.ws_warehouse_sk = wh.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN web_site wsit ON sa.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk
    GROUP BY wsit.web_name, wh.w_warehouse_name
)
SELECT
    web_name,
    w_warehouse_name,
    total_adj_profit,
    profit_category,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY web_name ORDER BY total_adj_profit DESC) AS warehouse_rank
FROM profit_by_wh
ORDER BY web_name, warehouse_rank

WITH ship_stats AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        d.d_week_seq,
        cs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
        AVG(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost,
        AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        AVG(cs.cs_ext_tax) AS avg_tax,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) AS sum_net_paid_inc_ship_tax,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
        CASE
            WHEN AVG(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) < 8 THEN 'Low'
            WHEN AVG(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) BETWEEN 8 AND 25 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'High'
        END AS ship_cost_category
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_week_seq % 2 = 0   -- only even weeks
    GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_week_seq, cs.cs_ship_mode_sk
),
windowed_stats AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        d_week_seq,
        cs_ship_mode_sk,
        avg_ship_cost,
        avg_discount,
        avg_tax,
        sum_net_paid_inc_ship_tax,
        txn_count,
        ship_cost_category,
        SUM(sum_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY d_week_seq) AS cumulative_net_paid,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY avg_ship_cost DESC) AS cost_rank
    FROM ship_stats
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    d_week_seq,
    cs_ship_mode_sk,
    ROUND(avg_ship_cost, 2) AS avg_ship_cost,
    ROUND(avg_discount, 2) AS avg_discount,
    ROUND(avg_tax, 2) AS avg_tax,
    ROUND(sum_net_paid_inc_ship_tax, 2) AS sum_net_paid_inc_ship_tax,
    txn_count,
    ship_cost_category,
    ROUND(cumulative_net_paid, 2) AS cumulative_net_paid,
    cost_rank
FROM windowed_stats
WHERE cost_rank <= 5
ORDER BY d_year, cost_rank, d_week_seq

WITH ship_stats AS (
    SELECT
        d.d_year,
        d.d_week_seq,
        cs.cs_ship_mode_sk,
        AVG(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost,
        AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
        AVG(cs.cs_ext_tax) AS avg_tax,
        AVG(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) AS avg_net_paid_inc_ship_tax,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        CASE
            WHEN AVG(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) < 5 THEN 'Very Low'
            WHEN AVG(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) BETWEEN 5 AND 20 THEN 'Low'
            WHEN AVG(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) BETWEEN 20 AND 40 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'High'
        END AS ship_cost_category
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_site w ON w.web_open_date_sk <= cs.cs_ship_date_sk
        AND (w.web_close_date_sk IS NULL OR w.web_close_date_sk >= cs.cs_ship_date_sk)
    WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
    GROUP BY d.d_year, d.d_week_seq, cs.cs_ship_mode_sk
),
ranked_ship_stats AS (
    SELECT
        d_year,
        d_week_seq,
        cs_ship_mode_sk,
        avg_ship_cost,
        avg_discount,
        avg_tax,
        avg_net_paid_inc_ship_tax,
        total_quantity,
        ship_cost_category,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY avg_net_paid_inc_ship_tax DESC) AS yearly_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year, d_week_seq ORDER BY avg_ship_cost ASC) AS cost_rank
    FROM ship_stats
)
SELECT
    d_year,
    d_week_seq,
    cs_ship_mode_sk,
    ROUND(avg_ship_cost, 2) AS avg_ship_cost,
    ROUND(avg_discount, 2) AS avg_discount,
    ROUND(avg_tax, 2) AS avg_tax,
    ROUND(avg_net_paid_inc_ship_tax, 2) AS avg_net_paid_inc_ship_tax,
    total_quantity,
    ship_cost_category,
    yearly_rank,
    cost_rank
FROM ranked_ship_stats
WHERE yearly_rank <= 5 AND cost_rank <= 3
ORDER BY d_year, d_week_seq, yearly_rank

WITH page_period AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_number,
        cp.cp_department,
        sd.d_date AS start_date,
        ed.d_date AS end_date,
        date_diff('day', sd.d_date, ed.d_date) + 1 AS active_days
    FROM catalog_page cp
    JOIN date_dim sd ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = sd.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim ed ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = ed.d_date_sk
    WHERE cp.cp_department IN ('AUTOMOBILE', 'FURNITURE')
),
sales_daily AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_catalog_page_sk,
        d.d_date,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS daily_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS daily_quantity
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY cs.cs_catalog_page_sk, d.d_date
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        pp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
        pp.cp_catalog_page_id,
        pp.cp_catalog_page_number,
        pp.cp_department,
        pp.start_date,
        pp.end_date,
        pp.active_days,
        SUM(sd.daily_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(sd.daily_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        MAX(sd.daily_net_paid) AS peak_daily_net_paid
    FROM page_period pp
    JOIN sales_daily sd ON sd.cs_catalog_page_sk = pp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE sd.d_date BETWEEN pp.start_date AND pp.end_date
    GROUP BY pp.cp_catalog_page_sk, pp.cp_catalog_page_id, pp.cp_catalog_page_number, pp.cp_department, pp.start_date, pp.end_date, pp.active_days
),
page_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        pp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty
    FROM page_period pp
    JOIN web_returns wr ON TRUE
    JOIN date_dim rd ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = rd.d_date_sk
    WHERE rd.d_date BETWEEN pp.start_date AND pp.end_date
    GROUP BY pp.cp_catalog_page_sk
),
final_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        sa.cp_catalog_page_id,
        sa.cp_catalog_page_number,
        sa.cp_department,
        sa.start_date,
        sa.end_date,
        sa.active_days,
        sa.total_net_paid,
        sa.total_quantity,
        sa.peak_daily_net_paid,
        COALESCE(pr.total_return_amount, 0) AS total_return_amount,
        COALESCE(pr.total_return_qty, 0) AS total_return_qty,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.cp_department ORDER BY sa.total_net_paid DESC) AS revenue_quartile,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.peak_daily_net_paid DESC) AS global_peak_rank
    FROM sales_agg sa
    LEFT JOIN page_returns_agg pr ON sa.cp_catalog_page_sk = pr.cp_catalog_page_sk
)
SELECT
    cp_catalog_page_id,
    cp_catalog_page_number,
    cp_department,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    active_days,
    total_net_paid,
    total_quantity,
    peak_daily_net_paid,
    total_return_amount,
    total_return_qty,
    revenue_quartile,
    global_peak_rank
FROM final_metrics
WHERE revenue_quartile = 1                     -- top quartile only
ORDER BY global_peak_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH page_period AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_number,
        cp.cp_department,
        sd.d_date AS start_date,
        ed.d_date AS end_date,
        date_diff('day', sd.d_date, ed.d_date) + 1 AS active_days
    FROM catalog_page cp
    JOIN date_dim sd ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = sd.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim ed ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = ed.d_date_sk
    WHERE sd.d_month_seq >= 120 AND ed.d_month_seq <= 130   -- restrict to a range of months
),
sales_daily AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_catalog_page_sk,
        d.d_date,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS daily_net_paid_inc_tax,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS daily_sales_price
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY cs.cs_catalog_page_sk, d.d_date
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        pp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
        pp.cp_catalog_page_id,
        pp.cp_catalog_page_number,
        pp.cp_department,
        pp.start_date,
        pp.end_date,
        pp.active_days,
        SUM(sd.daily_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_net_paid_inc_tax,
        SUM(sd.daily_sales_price) AS total_sales_price,
        COUNT(*) AS sales_days
    FROM page_period pp
    JOIN sales_daily sd ON sd.cs_catalog_page_sk = pp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE sd.d_date BETWEEN pp.start_date AND pp.end_date
    GROUP BY pp.cp_catalog_page_sk, pp.cp_catalog_page_id, pp.cp_catalog_page_number, pp.cp_department, pp.start_date, pp.end_date, pp.active_days
),
page_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        pp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty,
        AVG(wr.wr_return_tax) AS avg_return_tax
    FROM page_period pp
    JOIN web_returns wr ON TRUE
    JOIN date_dim rd ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = rd.d_date_sk
    WHERE rd.d_date BETWEEN pp.start_date AND pp.end_date
    GROUP BY pp.cp_catalog_page_sk
),
final_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        sa.cp_catalog_page_id,
        sa.cp_catalog_page_number,
        sa.cp_department,
        sa.start_date,
        sa.end_date,
        sa.active_days,
        sa.total_net_paid_inc_tax,
        sa.total_sales_price,
        sa.sales_days,
        CASE WHEN sa.sales_days > 0 THEN sa.total_sales_price / sa.sales_days ELSE 0 END AS avg_daily_sales_price,
        COALESCE(pr.total_return_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss,
        COALESCE(pr.total_return_qty, 0) AS total_return_qty,
        COALESCE(pr.avg_return_tax, 0) AS avg_return_tax,
        LAG(sa.total_net_paid_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.cp_department ORDER BY sa.start_date) AS prev_dept_net_paid,
        (sa.total_net_paid_inc_tax - LAG(sa.total_net_paid_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.cp_department ORDER BY sa.start_date)) / NULLIF(LAG(sa.total_net_paid_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.cp_department ORDER BY sa.start_date),0) AS net_paid_growth
    FROM sales_agg sa
    LEFT JOIN page_returns_agg pr ON sa.cp_catalog_page_sk = pr.cp_catalog_page_sk
)
SELECT
    cp_catalog_page_id,
    cp_catalog_page_number,
    cp_department,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    active_days,
    total_net_paid_inc_tax,
    total_sales_price,
    avg_daily_sales_price,
    total_return_loss,
    total_return_qty,
    avg_return_tax,
    net_paid_growth
FROM final_metrics
WHERE net_paid_growth > 0.1                     -- only growing pages
ORDER BY net_paid_growth DESC
LIMIT 25

WITH page_period AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
        cp.cp_catalog_page_number,
        cp.cp_department,
        sd.d_date AS start_date,
        ed.d_date AS end_date,
        date_diff('day', sd.d_date, ed.d_date) + 1 AS active_days
    FROM catalog_page cp
    JOIN date_dim sd ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = sd.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim ed ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = ed.d_date_sk
    WHERE cp.cp_catalog_page_number % 2 = 0               -- even numbered pages only
),
sales_daily AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_catalog_page_sk,
        d.d_date,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS daily_net_paid,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS daily_discount
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY cs.cs_catalog_page_sk, d.d_date
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        pp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
        pp.cp_catalog_page_id,
        pp.cp_catalog_page_number,
        pp.cp_department,
        pp.start_date,
        pp.end_date,
        pp.active_days,
        SUM(sd.daily_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,
        SUM(sd.daily_discount) AS total_discount,
        COUNT(*) AS days_with_sales
    FROM page_period pp
    JOIN sales_daily sd ON sd.cs_catalog_page_sk = pp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE sd.d_date BETWEEN pp.start_date AND pp.end_date
    GROUP BY pp.cp_catalog_page_sk, pp.cp_catalog_page_id, pp.cp_catalog_page_number, pp.cp_department, pp.start_date, pp.end_date, pp.active_days
),
page_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT
        pp.cp_catalog_page_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount_inc_tax,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty
    FROM page_period pp
    JOIN web_returns wr ON TRUE
    JOIN date_dim rd ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = rd.d_date_sk
    WHERE rd.d_date BETWEEN pp.start_date AND pp.end_date
    GROUP BY pp.cp_catalog_page_sk
),
final_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        sa.cp_catalog_page_id,
        sa.cp_catalog_page_number,
        sa.cp_department,
        sa.start_date,
        sa.end_date,
        sa.active_days,
        sa.total_net_paid,
        sa.total_discount,
        CASE WHEN sa.total_discount / NULLIF(sa.total_net_paid,0) > 0.25 THEN 'Very High Discount' ELSE 'Standard' END AS discount_category,
        COALESCE(pr.total_return_amount_inc_tax,0) AS total_return_amount_inc_tax,
        COALESCE(pr.total_return_qty,0) AS total_return_qty,
        sa.days_with_sales,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sa.cp_department ORDER BY sa.total_net_paid) AS dept_net_paid_percentile,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (sa.total_net_paid - COALESCE(pr.total_return_amount_inc_tax,0)) DESC) AS net_profit_rank
    FROM sales_agg sa
    LEFT JOIN page_returns_agg pr ON sa.cp_catalog_page_sk = pr.cp_catalog_page_sk
)
SELECT
    cp_catalog_page_id,
    cp_catalog_page_number,
    cp_department,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    active_days,
    total_net_paid,
    total_discount,
    discount_category,
    total_return_amount_inc_tax,
    total_return_qty,
    days_with_sales,
    dept_net_paid_percentile,
    net_profit_rank
FROM final_metrics
WHERE net_profit_rank <= 30
ORDER BY net_profit_rank

WITH demog_returns AS ( SELECT cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk, cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk, cr.cr_ship_mode_sk, cr.cr_return_amount, cr.cr_refunded_cash, cr.cr_store_credit, cr.cr_net_loss, cd_ref.cd_gender AS refunded_gender, cd_ref.cd_credit_rating AS refunded_credit_rating, cd_ret.cd_gender AS returning_gender, cd_ret.cd_credit_rating AS returning_credit_rating, sm.sm_type FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_demographics cd_ref ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_ref.cd_demo_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd_ret ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_ret.cd_demo_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk ) SELECT returning_gender, returning_credit_rating, sm_type, SUM(cr_refunded_cash) AS total_refunded_cash, SUM(cr_store_credit) AS total_store_credit, SUM(cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY returning_gender ORDER BY SUM(cr_net_loss) DESC) AS net_loss_rank, CASE WHEN SUM(cr_net_loss) > 2000 THEN 'Critical' WHEN SUM(cr_net_loss) > 1000 THEN 'Serious' ELSE 'Normal' END AS net_loss_category FROM demog_returns GROUP BY returning_gender, returning_credit_rating, sm_type HAVING SUM(cr_net_loss) > 0 ORDER BY returning_gender, net_loss_rank LIMIT 50

WITH returns_joined AS ( SELECT cr.cr_return_amount, cr.cr_return_quantity, cr.cr_fee, cr.cr_net_loss, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_type, sm.sm_type, sm.sm_carrier, cd.cd_purchase_estimate, CASE WHEN cr.cr_return_quantity > 5 THEN 'Large' ELSE 'Small' END AS return_size_category FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk ) SELECT cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number, sm_type, SUM(cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, AVG(cr_fee) AS avg_fee, AVG(cd_purchase_estimate) AS avg_purchase_estimate, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cr_return_amount) DESC) AS return_amount_rank, CASE WHEN SUM(cr_return_amount) > 10000 THEN 'Very High' WHEN SUM(cr_return_amount) > 5000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Moderate' END AS return_amount_category FROM returns_joined GROUP BY cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number, sm_type HAVING SUM(cr_return_amount) > 0 ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC LIMIT 20

WITH dept_monthly_returns AS ( SELECT cp.cp_department, cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS month_id, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, AVG(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_qty, AVG(cd.cd_purchase_estimate) AS avg_purchase_estimate, sm.sm_type FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_department, cr.cr_returned_date_sk, sm.sm_type ), dept_monthly_lag AS ( SELECT cp_department, month_id, sm_type, total_return_amount, total_net_loss, avg_return_qty, avg_purchase_estimate, LAG(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY month_id) AS prev_return_amount, LAG(total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY month_id) AS prev_net_loss FROM dept_monthly_returns ) SELECT cp_department, month_id, sm_type, total_return_amount, total_net_loss, avg_return_qty, avg_purchase_estimate, prev_return_amount, prev_net_loss, total_return_amount - COALESCE(prev_return_amount,0) AS return_amount_change, total_net_loss - COALESCE(prev_net_loss,0) AS net_loss_change, CASE WHEN prev_return_amount IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN total_return_amount > prev_return_amount THEN 'Increase' WHEN total_return_amount < prev_return_amount THEN 'Decrease' ELSE 'No Change' END AS return_trend, CASE WHEN prev_net_loss IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN total_net_loss > prev_net_loss THEN 'Higher Loss' WHEN total_net_loss < prev_net_loss THEN 'Lower Loss' ELSE 'Same Loss' END AS net_loss_trend FROM dept_monthly_lag ORDER BY cp_department, month_id

WITH item_monthly_sums AS ( SELECT cr.cr_item_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS month_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_type, sm.sm_carrier, AVG(cd.cd_purchase_estimate) AS avg_purchase_estimate, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_type, sm.sm_carrier ), ranked_items AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_id ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS rn, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month_id ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM item_monthly_sums ) SELECT month_id, cr_item_sk, cp_department, cp_type, sm_carrier, avg_purchase_estimate, total_net_loss, total_return_qty, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'High Loss' WHEN total_net_loss > 1000 THEN 'Medium Loss' ELSE 'Low Loss' END AS loss_category, loss_rank FROM ranked_items WHERE rn <= 10 ORDER BY month_id, loss_rank

WITH call_center_discount AS ( SELECT cc.cc_name, t.t_time, t.t_shift, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(cs.cs_coupon_amt) AS total_coupon, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_name, t.t_time, t.t_shift ) SELECT cc_name, t_shift, t_time, total_sales, total_discount, total_coupon, ROUND(100.0 * total_discount / NULLIF(total_sales,0), 2) AS discount_pct, ROUND(100.0 * total_coupon / NULLIF(total_sales,0), 2) AS coupon_pct, CASE WHEN total_discount > 10000 THEN 'High' WHEN total_discount > 5000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS discount_category, SUM(total_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_name ORDER BY t_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_discount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_name ORDER BY total_discount DESC) AS discount_rank FROM call_center_discount WHERE total_sales > 0 ORDER BY cc_name, t_time

WITH cust_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, ca.ca_state, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_paid, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid * (1 + cc.cc_tax_percentage/100)) AS total_with_tax, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, ca.ca_state ), ranked_cust AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY total_with_tax DESC) AS rn FROM cust_sales ) SELECT customer_sk, ca_state, total_paid, total_with_tax, total_profit, CASE WHEN total_with_tax > 100000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN total_with_tax > 50000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN total_with_tax > 20000 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS customer_tier FROM ranked_cust WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY ca_state, total_with_tax DESC

WITH shipping_by_hour AS ( SELECT cc.cc_name, t.t_hour, SUM(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS total_ship_cost FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_name, t.t_hour ), shipping_with_lag AS ( SELECT cc_name, t_hour, total_ship_cost, LAG(total_ship_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_name ORDER BY t_hour) AS prev_ship_cost FROM shipping_by_hour ) SELECT cc_name, t_hour, total_ship_cost, prev_ship_cost, CASE WHEN prev_ship_cost IS NULL OR prev_ship_cost = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (total_ship_cost - prev_ship_cost) / prev_ship_cost, 2) END AS pct_change_vs_prev_hour FROM shipping_with_lag WHERE total_ship_cost > 0 ORDER BY cc_name, t_hour

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT cc.cc_name, ca.ca_state, CASE WHEN t.t_hour BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN 'Late Night' WHEN t.t_hour BETWEEN 6 AND 11 THEN 'Morning' WHEN t.t_hour BETWEEN 12 AND 17 THEN 'Afternoon' WHEN t.t_hour BETWEEN 18 AND 23 THEN 'Evening' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS time_bucket, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN time_dim t ON cs.cs_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cc.cc_name, ca.ca_state, CASE WHEN t.t_hour BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN 'Late Night' WHEN t.t_hour BETWEEN 6 AND 11 THEN 'Morning' WHEN t.t_hour BETWEEN 12 AND 17 THEN 'Afternoon' WHEN t.t_hour BETWEEN 18 AND 23 THEN 'Evening' ELSE 'Unknown' END HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) > 5000 ) SELECT cc_name, ca_state, time_bucket, total_net_paid, total_net_profit, ROUND(100 * total_net_profit / NULLIF(total_net_paid,0), 2) AS profit_margin_pct, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_state FROM sales_agg ORDER BY profit_margin_pct DESC, total_net_profit DESC

WITH monthly_sales AS ( SELECT wsit.web_zip, format('%s-%02d', d_sold.d_year, d_sold.d_moy) AS year_month, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(ws.ws_ext_ship_cost) AS total_ship_cost FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_ship ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk JOIN web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk GROUP BY wsit.web_zip, d_sold.d_year, d_sold.d_moy ), ranked_monthly AS ( SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year_month ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY web_zip ORDER BY year_month) AS prev_month_sales FROM monthly_sales ) SELECT web_zip, year_month, total_sales, total_discount, total_ship_cost, (total_discount / NULLIF(total_sales,0)) AS discount_share, CASE WHEN (total_discount / NULLIF(total_sales,0)) >= 0.20 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN (total_discount / NULLIF(total_sales,0)) >= 0.10 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS discount_category, sales_rank, CASE WHEN prev_month_sales IS NOT NULL AND total_sales > prev_month_sales THEN 'INCREASE' WHEN prev_month_sales IS NOT NULL AND total_sales < prev_month_sales THEN 'DECREASE' ELSE 'NO_CHANGE' END AS month_trend FROM ranked_monthly WHERE sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY year_month, sales_rank

WITH sales_by_site AS ( SELECT wsit.web_site_id, wsit.web_name, wsit.web_country, ca_bill.ca_country AS bill_country, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(ws.ws_sales_price) AS total_sales_price FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_ship ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk JOIN web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk WHERE d_sold.d_current_year = '2023' GROUP BY wsit.web_site_id, wsit.web_name, wsit.web_country, ca_bill.ca_country ), ranked_sites AS ( SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY web_country ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM sales_by_site ) SELECT web_site_id, web_name, web_country, bill_country, total_net_profit, total_sales_price, (total_net_profit / NULLIF(total_sales_price, 0)) AS profit_margin, CASE WHEN (total_net_profit / NULLIF(total_sales_price,0)) >= 0.20 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN (total_net_profit / NULLIF(total_sales_price,0)) >= 0.10 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS margin_category, profit_rank FROM ranked_sites WHERE profit_rank <= 5 ORDER BY web_country, profit_rank

WITH ship_monthly AS ( SELECT wsit.web_site_id, wsit.web_name, ca_ship.ca_state AS ca_state, format('%s-%02d', d_ship.d_year, d_ship.d_moy) AS year_month, SUM(ws.ws_ext_ship_cost) AS month_ship_cost, COUNT(*) AS month_orders, (SUM(ws.ws_ext_ship_cost) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)) AS avg_month_ship_cost FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_ship ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk JOIN web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk GROUP BY wsit.web_site_id, wsit.web_name, ca_ship.ca_state, d_ship.d_year, d_ship.d_moy ), state_site_agg AS ( SELECT web_site_id, web_name, ca_state, SUM(month_ship_cost) AS total_ship_cost, SUM(month_orders) AS total_orders, (SUM(month_ship_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(month_orders),0)) AS avg_ship_cost FROM ship_monthly GROUP BY web_site_id, web_name, ca_state ), state_site_rank AS ( SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY web_site_id ORDER BY avg_ship_cost ASC) AS ship_cost_rank, NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY web_site_id ORDER BY avg_ship_cost ASC) AS cost_quartile FROM state_site_agg ), latest_month_ship AS ( SELECT sm.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY web_site_id, ca_state ORDER BY year_month DESC) AS rn, LAG(avg_month_ship_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY web_site_id, ca_state ORDER BY year_month) AS prev_month_avg_ship_cost FROM ship_monthly sm ), state_month_trend AS ( SELECT web_site_id, ca_state, avg_month_ship_cost, prev_month_avg_ship_cost FROM latest_month_ship WHERE rn = 1 ) SELECT ssr.web_site_id, ssr.web_name, ssr.ca_state, ssr.avg_ship_cost, ssr.total_orders, ssr.ship_cost_rank, CASE WHEN ssr.cost_quartile = 1 THEN 'BEST' WHEN ssr.cost_quartile = 2 THEN 'GOOD' WHEN ssr.cost_quartile = 3 THEN 'AVERAGE' ELSE 'POOR' END AS cost_efficiency_category, smt.avg_month_ship_cost AS latest_month_avg_ship_cost, smt.prev_month_avg_ship_cost, CASE WHEN smt.prev_month_avg_ship_cost IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN smt.avg_month_ship_cost > smt.prev_month_avg_ship_cost THEN 'INCREASE' WHEN smt.avg_month_ship_cost < smt.prev_month_avg_ship_cost THEN 'DECREASE' ELSE 'NO_CHANGE' END AS month_ship_cost_trend FROM state_site_rank ssr LEFT JOIN state_month_trend smt ON ssr.web_site_id = smt.web_site_id AND ssr.ca_state = smt.ca_state ORDER BY ssr.web_site_id, ssr.ship_cost_rank

WITH address_monthly_sales AS ( SELECT ca_bill.ca_address_sk, ca_bill.ca_city, ca_bill.ca_state, format('%s-%02d', d_sold.d_year, d_sold.d_moy) AS year_month, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS month_sales FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_ship ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk JOIN web_site wsit ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = wsit.web_site_sk JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_address ca_ship ON ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_ship.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca_bill.ca_address_sk, ca_bill.ca_city, ca_bill.ca_state, d_sold.d_year, d_sold.d_moy ), address_sales_trend AS ( SELECT *, LAG(month_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_address_sk ORDER BY year_month) AS prev_month_sales, CASE WHEN month_sales > LAG(month_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_address_sk ORDER BY year_month) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS inc_flag FROM address_monthly_sales ), address_consecutive AS ( SELECT *, SUM(inc_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_address_sk ORDER BY year_month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS consecutive_increase FROM address_sales_trend ), address_total AS ( SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_city, ca_state, SUM(month_sales) AS total_sales FROM address_monthly_sales GROUP BY ca_address_sk, ca_city, ca_state ), ranked_addresses AS ( SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM address_total ) SELECT ac.ca_address_sk, ac.ca_city, ac.ca_state, ac.year_month, ac.month_sales, ac.prev_month_sales, ac.consecutive_increase, ra.total_sales, ra.sales_rank FROM address_consecutive ac JOIN ranked_addresses ra ON ac.ca_address_sk = ra.ca_address_sk WHERE ac.consecutive_increase = 3 ORDER BY ra.sales_rank, ac.ca_address_sk, ac.year_month

WITH sales_month AS (
   SELECT 
      mod(cast(ss.ss_sold_date_sk / 100 as integer), 100) AS month,
      ss.ss_net_profit AS net_profit,
      ss.ss_quantity AS qty,
      ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk
   FROM store_sales ss
   UNION ALL
   SELECT 
      mod(cast(ws.ws_sold_date_sk / 100 as integer), 100) AS month,
      ws.ws_net_profit AS net_profit,
      ws.ws_quantity AS qty,
      ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk
   FROM web_sales ws
),
monthly_stats AS (
   SELECT month,
          SUM(net_profit) AS total_profit,
          SUM(qty) AS total_qty,
          MAX(date_sk) AS last_sale_sk
   FROM sales_month
   GROUP BY month
),
recent_months AS (
   SELECT month, total_profit, total_qty,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY last_sale_sk DESC) AS recent_rank,
          PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_profit) AS profit_percentile
   FROM monthly_stats
)
SELECT 
   c.c_customer_id,
   c.c_first_name,
   c.c_last_name,
   cd.cd_education_status,
   rm.month,
   rm.total_profit,
   rm.total_qty,
   CASE WHEN rm.profit_percentile < 0.25 THEN 'LowProfit' WHEN rm.profit_percentile < 0.75 THEN 'MidProfit' ELSE 'HighProfit' END AS profit_category,
   COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY rm.month) AS customers_in_month
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN recent_months rm ON c.c_birth_month = rm.month
WHERE rm.recent_rank <= 6
GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, cd.cd_education_status, rm.month, rm.total_profit, rm.total_qty, rm.profit_percentile
ORDER BY rm.total_profit DESC
LIMIT 30

WITH sales_month AS (
   SELECT 
      mod(cast(ss.ss_sold_date_sk / 100 as integer), 100) AS month,
      ss.ss_net_profit AS net_profit,
      ss.ss_quantity AS qty,
      ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk
   FROM store_sales ss
   UNION ALL
   SELECT 
      mod(cast(ws.ws_sold_date_sk / 100 as integer), 100) AS month,
      ws.ws_net_profit AS net_profit,
      ws.ws_quantity AS qty,
      ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk
   FROM web_sales ws
),
monthly_stats AS (
   SELECT
      month,
      SUM(net_profit) AS total_profit,
      AVG(qty) AS avg_qty,
      COUNT(*) AS sale_days,
      MAX(date_sk) AS last_sale_sk
   FROM sales_month
   GROUP BY month
),
recent_months AS (
   SELECT month, total_profit, avg_qty,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY last_sale_sk DESC) AS recent_rank
   FROM monthly_stats
   WHERE total_profit > 0
)
SELECT 
   c.c_customer_id,
   c.c_first_name,
   c.c_last_name,
   c.c_birth_month,
   cd.cd_education_status,
   rm.total_profit,
   rm.avg_qty,
   CASE WHEN c.c_birth_month = rm.month THEN 'BirthMonthMatch' ELSE 'NoMatch' END AS match_flag,
   LAG(rm.total_profit) OVER (ORDER BY rm.month) AS prev_month_profit,
   LEAD(rm.total_profit) OVER (ORDER BY rm.month) AS next_month_profit
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN recent_months rm ON c.c_birth_month = rm.month
WHERE rm.recent_rank BETWEEN 1 AND 4
ORDER BY c.c_customer_id
LIMIT 30

WITH page_type_agg AS ( SELECT wp.wp_type, ws.ws_item_sk, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt, AVG(ws.ws_sales_price) AS avg_price FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY wp.wp_type, ws.ws_item_sk ) SELECT pta.wp_type, pta.ws_item_sk, pta.order_cnt, pta.avg_price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pta.wp_type ORDER BY pta.avg_price DESC) AS rn FROM page_type_agg pta WHERE pta.order_cnt > 100 ORDER BY pta.wp_type, rn LIMIT 15

WITH page_type_agg AS ( SELECT wp.wp_type, ws.ws_item_sk, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS qty_sum, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales_sum, MAX(ws.ws_net_profit) AS max_profit FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY wp.wp_type, ws.ws_item_sk HAVING SUM(ws.ws_quantity) > 400 ) SELECT pta.wp_type, pta.ws_item_sk, pta.qty_sum, pta.sales_sum, pta.max_profit, CASE WHEN pta.max_profit > 500 THEN 'High Profit' ELSE 'Low Profit' END AS profit_category FROM page_type_agg pta ORDER BY pta.max_profit DESC LIMIT 8

WITH page_type_agg AS ( SELECT wp.wp_type, ws.ws_item_sk, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS qty_sum, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales_sum FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk WHERE wp.wp_autogen_flag = 'Y' GROUP BY wp.wp_type, ws.ws_item_sk ) SELECT pta.wp_type, COUNT(DISTINCT pta.ws_item_sk) AS distinct_items, SUM(pta.qty_sum) AS total_qty, SUM(pta.sales_sum) AS total_sales, ROUND(AVG(pta.sales_sum), 2) AS avg_sales_per_item FROM page_type_agg pta GROUP BY pta.wp_type HAVING SUM(pta.sales_sum) > 5000 ORDER BY total_sales DESC

WITH shipping_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode_sk,
        cs_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
        cs_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
        cs_net_profit AS profit,
        cs_ship_addr_sk AS ship_addr_sk,
        'catalog' AS channel
    FROM catalog_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ws_ship_mode_sk,
        ws_ext_discount_amt,
        ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws_net_profit,
        ws_ship_addr_sk,
        'web' AS channel
    FROM web_sales
),
agg_shipping AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ship_mode_sk,
        ss.channel,
        ca.ca_state,
        COUNT(*) AS total_shipments,
        AVG(ss.discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amt,
        AVG(ss.sales_price) AS avg_sales_price,
        AVG(ss.profit) AS avg_profit
    FROM shipping_sales ss
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ship_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ship_mode_sk, ss.channel, ca.ca_state
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
)
SELECT
    a.ship_mode_sk,
    a.channel,
    a.ca_state,
    a.total_shipments,
    a.avg_discount_amt,
    a.avg_sales_price,
    a.avg_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN a.avg_profit = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE a.avg_discount_amt / a.avg_profit
    END AS discount_to_profit_ratio,
    CASE
        WHEN a.avg_discount_amt / NULLIF(a.avg_profit, 0) > 0.05 THEN 'Inefficient'
        WHEN a.avg_discount_amt / NULLIF(a.avg_profit, 0) > 0.02 THEN 'Moderate'
        ELSE 'Efficient'
    END AS efficiency_label,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.channel ORDER BY a.avg_discount_amt DESC) AS discount_rank_channel,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.avg_discount_amt DESC) AS global_discount_rank
FROM agg_shipping a
ORDER BY a.channel, discount_rank_channel
LIMIT 50

WITH catalog_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS catalog_net_paid,
        SUM(cs_net_profit) AS catalog_net_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS catalog_orders
    FROM catalog_sales
    GROUP BY cs_bill_customer_sk
),
web_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(ws_net_paid_inc_tax) AS web_net_paid,
        SUM(ws_net_profit) AS web_net_profit,
        COUNT(*) AS web_orders
    FROM web_sales
    GROUP BY ws_bill_customer_sk
),
customer_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_birth_month,
        ca.ca_state,
        COALESCE(ca_agg.catalog_net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(wa_agg.web_net_paid, 0) AS total_net_paid,
        COALESCE(ca_agg.catalog_net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wa_agg.web_net_profit, 0) AS total_net_profit,
        COALESCE(ca_agg.catalog_orders, 0) + COALESCE(wa_agg.web_orders, 0) AS total_orders
    FROM customer c
    LEFT JOIN catalog_agg ca_agg ON c.c_customer_sk = ca_agg.customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_agg wa_agg ON c.c_customer_sk = wa_agg.customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
)
SELECT
    cs.c_customer_sk,
    cs.c_first_name,
    cs.c_last_name,
    cs.ca_state,
    cs.total_net_paid,
    cs.total_net_profit,
    cs.total_orders,
    CASE WHEN cs.total_net_paid > 5000 THEN 'VIP' ELSE 'Regular' END AS customer_tier,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.ca_state ORDER BY cs.total_net_paid DESC) AS state_rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_net_paid DESC) AS global_rank
FROM customer_sales cs
