WHERE cs.total_orders > 0
ORDER BY cs.total_net_paid DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH unified_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
        cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
        cs_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
        cs_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt,
        cs_ext_list_price AS list_price,
        cs_net_profit AS net_profit,
        cs_ship_addr_sk AS ship_addr_sk,
        cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        'catalog' AS channel
    FROM catalog_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ws_item_sk,
        ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws_ext_sales_price,
        ws_ext_discount_amt,
        ws_ext_list_price,
        ws_net_profit,
        ws_ship_addr_sk,
        ws_bill_customer_sk,
        'web' AS channel
    FROM web_sales
),
agg_sales AS (
    SELECT
        us.item_sk,
        us.sold_date_sk,
        us.channel,
        ca.ca_state,
        SUM(us.sales_price) AS total_sales,
        SUM(us.discount_amt) AS total_discount,
        SUM(us.net_profit) AS total_profit,
        AVG(us.discount_amt / NULLIF(us.list_price, 0)) AS avg_discount_rate
    FROM unified_sales us
    JOIN customer_address ca ON us.ship_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer c ON us.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY us.item_sk, us.sold_date_sk, us.channel, ca.ca_state
    HAVING SUM(us.sales_price) > 0
)
SELECT
    a.item_sk,
    a.sold_date_sk,
    a.channel,
    a.ca_state,
    a.total_sales,
    a.total_discount,
    a.total_profit,
    a.avg_discount_rate,
    CASE
        WHEN a.avg_discount_rate > 0.3 THEN 'High Discount'
        WHEN a.avg_discount_rate > 0.1 THEN 'Medium Discount'
        ELSE 'Low Discount'
    END AS discount_category,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.sold_date_sk ORDER BY a.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_month,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.total_profit DESC) AS global_profit_rank
FROM agg_sales a
ORDER BY a.sold_date_sk, profit_rank_month
LIMIT 100

WITH all_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cs_order_number AS order_number,
        cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
        cs_sold_time_sk AS sold_time_sk,
        cs_net_paid_inc_tax AS net_paid,
        cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        cs_ship_addr_sk AS ship_addr_sk,
        'catalog' AS channel
    FROM catalog_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        ws_order_number,
        ws_sold_date_sk,
        ws_sold_time_sk,
        ws_net_paid_inc_tax,
        ws_bill_customer_sk,
        ws_ship_addr_sk,
        'web' AS channel
    FROM web_sales
),
ordered_sales AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_sk ORDER BY sold_date_sk, sold_time_sk, order_number) AS prev_net_paid
    FROM all_sales
)
SELECT
    os.customer_sk,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    ca.ca_state,
    os.order_number,
    os.sold_date_sk,
    os.channel,
    os.net_paid,
    os.prev_net_paid,
    CASE
        WHEN os.prev_net_paid IS NULL THEN 'First Purchase'
        WHEN os.net_paid > os.prev_net_paid THEN 'Increasing'
        ELSE 'Decreasing/Flat'
    END AS trend_indicator,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY os.customer_sk ORDER BY os.sold_date_sk, os.sold_time_sk) AS purchase_seq
FROM ordered_sales os
JOIN customer c ON os.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON os.ship_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
WHERE os.net_paid IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY os.customer_sk, os.sold_date_sk, os.sold_time_sk
LIMIT 200

WITH cust_sales AS (SELECT c.c_customer_sk,c.c_first_name,c.c_last_name,c.c_birth_country,sm.sm_type AS ship_mode_type,wp.wp_type AS page_type,SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit,COUNT(*) AS total_orders,AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk,c.c_first_name,c.c_last_name,c.c_birth_country,sm.sm_type,wp.wp_type) SELECT c_customer_sk,c_first_name,c_last_name,c_birth_country,ship_mode_type,page_type,total_profit,total_orders,CASE WHEN total_profit>=100000 THEN 'High' WHEN total_profit>=50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category,RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ship_mode_type ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS ship_mode_profit_rank FROM cust_sales WHERE total_orders>=5 ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 50

WITH page_stats AS (SELECT wp.wp_web_page_id,wp.wp_url,sm.sm_carrier,AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,COUNT(*) AS sales_count FROM web_sales ws JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk WHERE c.c_birth_month = 7 GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_id,wp.wp_url,sm.sm_carrier HAVING COUNT(*)>=10) SELECT wp_web_page_id,wp_url,sm_carrier,avg_discount,sales_count,DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_discount DESC) AS discount_rank FROM page_stats ORDER BY avg_discount DESC LIMIT 10

WITH daily AS (SELECT sm.sm_type,wp.wp_type,c.c_birth_country,ws.ws_sold_date_sk,SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS daily_profit,COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS daily_orders FROM web_sales ws JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY sm.sm_type,wp.wp_type,c.c_birth_country,ws.ws_sold_date_sk) SELECT sm_type,wp_type,c_birth_country,ws_sold_date_sk,daily_profit,daily_orders,SUM(daily_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY sm_type ORDER BY ws_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS profit_3day_rolling,CASE WHEN SUM(daily_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY sm_type ORDER BY ws_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 50000 THEN 'Strong' WHEN SUM(daily_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY sm_type ORDER BY ws_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 20000 THEN 'Moderate' ELSE 'Weak' END AS rolling_profit_category,RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sm_type ORDER BY daily_profit DESC) AS daily_profit_rank FROM daily ORDER BY sm_type,ws_sold_date_sk LIMIT 150

WITH customer_sales AS (SELECT c.c_customer_sk,c.c_customer_id,c.c_first_name,c.c_last_name,c.c_birth_country,sm.sm_carrier,ws.ws_order_number,ws.ws_ext_sales_price,ws.ws_net_paid,ws.ws_ext_discount_amt,ws.ws_quantity FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk), agg AS (SELECT c_customer_sk,c_customer_id,c_first_name,c_last_name,c_birth_country,sm_carrier,COUNT(DISTINCT ws_order_number) AS total_orders,SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,SUM(ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid,SUM(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,AVG(ws_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM customer_sales GROUP BY c_customer_sk,c_customer_id,c_first_name,c_last_name,c_birth_country,sm_carrier HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ws_order_number) > 2) SELECT c_customer_id,c_first_name,c_last_name,c_birth_country,sm_carrier,total_orders,total_sales,total_net_paid,total_discount,avg_quantity,CASE WHEN total_sales>=200000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN total_sales>=100000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN total_sales>=50000 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END AS customer_tier,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sm_carrier ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS carrier_sales_rank FROM agg ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 100

WITH address_monthly_sales AS ( SELECT ca_bill.ca_address_sk, ca_bill.ca_city, ca_bill.ca_state, date_trunc('month', d_sold.d_date) AS month_start, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS month_sales FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca_bill.ca_address_sk, ca_bill.ca_city, ca_bill.ca_state, date_trunc('month', d_sold.d_date) ), address_sales_trend AS ( SELECT *, LAG(month_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_address_sk ORDER BY month_start) AS prev_month_sales FROM address_monthly_sales ), address_total AS ( SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_city, ca_state, SUM(month_sales) AS total_sales, COUNT(*) AS active_months FROM address_monthly_sales GROUP BY ca_address_sk, ca_city, ca_state ), ranked_addresses AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM address_total ) SELECT a.ca_address_sk, a.ca_city, a.ca_state, a.month_start, a.month_sales, a.prev_month_sales, r.total_sales, r.active_months, r.sales_rank FROM address_sales_trend a JOIN ranked_addresses r ON a.ca_address_sk = r.ca_address_sk WHERE a.month_sales > 0 AND r.sales_rank <= 20 ORDER BY a.month_start DESC, a.ca_city

WITH address_monthly_sales AS ( SELECT ca_bill.ca_address_sk, ca_bill.ca_city, ca_bill.ca_state, format('%s-%02d', d_sold.d_year, d_sold.d_moy) AS year_month, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS month_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_item_sk) AS distinct_items FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca_bill.ca_address_sk, ca_bill.ca_city, ca_bill.ca_state, d_sold.d_year, d_sold.d_moy ), address_sales_trend AS ( SELECT *, LAG(month_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_address_sk ORDER BY year_month) AS prev_month_sales FROM address_monthly_sales ), address_total AS ( SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_city, ca_state, SUM(month_sales) AS total_sales, SUM(distinct_items) AS total_distinct_items FROM address_monthly_sales GROUP BY ca_address_sk, ca_city, ca_state ), ranked_addresses AS ( SELECT ca_address_sk, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM address_total ) SELECT a.ca_address_sk, a.ca_city, a.ca_state, a.year_month, a.month_sales, a.prev_month_sales, a.distinct_items, t.total_sales, t.total_distinct_items, r.sales_rank FROM address_sales_trend a JOIN address_total t ON a.ca_address_sk = t.ca_address_sk JOIN ranked_addresses r ON a.ca_address_sk = r.ca_address_sk WHERE a.month_sales > 0 AND r.sales_rank <= 15 ORDER BY a.month_sales DESC, a.year_month

WITH address_monthly_sales AS ( SELECT ca_bill.ca_address_sk, ca_bill.ca_city, ca_bill.ca_state, format('%s-%02d', d_sold.d_year, d_sold.d_moy) AS year_month, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS month_sales FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d_sold ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk JOIN customer_address ca_bill ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_bill.ca_address_sk WHERE d_sold.d_year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021 GROUP BY ca_bill.ca_address_sk, ca_bill.ca_city, ca_bill.ca_state, d_sold.d_year, d_sold.d_moy ), address_sales_trend AS ( SELECT *, LAG(month_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_address_sk ORDER BY year_month) AS prev_month_sales, CASE WHEN month_sales > COALESCE(LAG(month_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_address_sk ORDER BY year_month),0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS inc_flag FROM address_monthly_sales ), address_consecutive AS ( SELECT *, SUM(inc_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY ca_address_sk ORDER BY year_month ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS four_month_streak FROM address_sales_trend ), address_total AS ( SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_city, ca_state, SUM(month_sales) AS total_sales FROM address_monthly_sales GROUP BY ca_address_sk, ca_city, ca_state ), ranked_addresses AS ( SELECT ca_address_sk, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM address_total ) SELECT ac.ca_address_sk, ac.ca_city, ac.ca_state, ac.year_month, ac.month_sales, ac.prev_month_sales, ac.four_month_streak, at.total_sales, ra.sales_rank FROM address_consecutive ac JOIN address_total at ON ac.ca_address_sk = at.ca_address_sk JOIN ranked_addresses ra ON ac.ca_address_sk = ra.ca_address_sk WHERE ac.four_month_streak = 4 ORDER BY ra.sales_rank, ac.year_month

WITH daily_type_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_type,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS daily_net_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS daily_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cd.cd_gender) AS gender_count
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY cp.cp_type, cs.cs_sold_date_sk
), with_totals AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type) AS total_net_by_type,
        MAX(daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type) AS max_daily_net,
        MIN(daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type) AS min_daily_net,
        LAG(daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type ORDER BY sold_date) AS prev_day_net,
        LEAD(daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type ORDER BY sold_date) AS next_day_net
    FROM daily_type_sales
)
SELECT
    cp_type,
    sold_date,
    daily_net_paid,
    daily_orders,
    distinct_customers,
    gender_count,
    total_net_by_type,
    max_daily_net,
    min_daily_net,
    CASE 
        WHEN prev_day_net IS NOT NULL AND daily_net_paid > prev_day_net THEN 'Increase'
        WHEN prev_day_net IS NOT NULL AND daily_net_paid < prev_day_net THEN 'Decrease'
        ELSE 'No Change'
    END AS trend_vs_previous,
    NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type ORDER BY daily_net_paid DESC) AS net_paid_quartile
FROM with_totals
WHERE sold_date >= 20210101
ORDER BY cp_type, daily_net_paid DESC

WITH daily_type_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_type,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS daily_net_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS daily_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cd.cd_gender) AS gender_count
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY cp.cp_type, cs.cs_sold_date_sk
), with_totals AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type) AS total_net_by_type,
        AVG(daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type) AS avg_daily_net,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type ORDER BY daily_net_paid DESC) AS net_rank
    FROM daily_type_sales
)
SELECT
    cp_type,
    sold_date,
    daily_net_paid,
    daily_orders,
    distinct_customers,
    gender_count,
    total_net_by_type,
    avg_daily_net,
    net_rank,
    CASE WHEN net_rank = 1 THEN 'Top Day' ELSE '' END AS top_day_flag,
    NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type ORDER BY daily_net_paid) AS net_paid_quintile
FROM with_totals
WHERE daily_net_paid BETWEEN 1000 AND 50000
ORDER BY cp_type, net_rank

WITH daily_type_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_type,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS daily_net_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS daily_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cd.cd_gender) AS gender_count,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY cp.cp_type, cs.cs_sold_date_sk
), with_totals AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type) AS total_net_by_type,
        MAX(daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type) AS max_daily_net,
        MIN(daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type) AS min_daily_net,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type ORDER BY daily_net_paid) AS cum_dist
    FROM daily_type_sales
)
SELECT
    cp_type,
    sold_date,
    daily_net_paid,
    daily_orders,
    distinct_customers,
    gender_count,
    total_discount,
    total_net_by_type,
    max_daily_net,
    min_daily_net,
    CASE WHEN cum_dist <= 0.25 THEN 'Bottom Quartile' WHEN cum_dist >= 0.75 THEN 'Top Quartile' ELSE 'Mid Quartile' END AS quartile_category,
    NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type ORDER BY daily_net_paid DESC) AS net_paid_tertile
FROM with_totals
WHERE total_discount > 0
ORDER BY cp_type, cum_dist

WITH daily_type_sales AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_type,
        cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS daily_net_paid,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS daily_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cd.cd_gender) AS gender_count
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk >= 20200101 AND cs.cs_sold_date_sk <= 20201231
    GROUP BY cp.cp_type, cs.cs_sold_date_sk
), with_totals AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type) AS total_net_by_type,
        MAX(daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type) AS max_daily_net,
        MIN(daily_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type) AS min_daily_net,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type ORDER BY sold_date) AS day_seq
    FROM daily_type_sales
)
SELECT
    cp_type,
    sold_date,
    daily_net_paid,
    daily_orders,
    distinct_customers,
    gender_count,
    total_net_by_type,
    max_daily_net,
    min_daily_net,
    CASE WHEN day_seq = 1 THEN 'First Day' ELSE '' END AS first_day_flag,
    NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_type ORDER BY daily_net_paid DESC) AS net_paid_quartile
FROM with_totals
WHERE daily_net_paid > 0
ORDER BY cp_type, sold_date DESC

WITH sales_by_addr AS (SELECT ca.ca_address_sk AS address_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_address_sk, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state), returns_by_addr AS (SELECT ca.ca_address_sk AS address_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_returns, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, COUNT(*) AS returns_cnt FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_address_sk), top_return_reason AS (SELECT ca.ca_address_sk AS address_sk, r.r_reason_desc, COUNT(*) AS reason_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.ca_address_sk ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_address_sk, r.r_reason_desc) SELECT s.address_sk, s.ca_city, s.ca_state, s.total_sales, r.total_returns, CASE WHEN s.total_sales - COALESCE(r.total_returns, 0) > 50000 THEN 'High Value' WHEN s.total_sales - COALESCE(r.total_returns, 0) BETWEEN 20000 AND 50000 THEN 'Medium Value' ELSE 'Low Value' END AS value_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank, SUM(s.total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY s.ca_state) AS state_total_sales, SUM(COALESCE(r.total_returns, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.ca_state) AS state_total_returns, tr.r_reason_desc AS top_return_reason FROM sales_by_addr s LEFT JOIN returns_by_addr r ON s.address_sk = r.address_sk LEFT JOIN top_return_reason tr ON s.address_sk = tr.address_sk AND tr.rn = 1 ORDER BY sales_rank LIMIT 10

WITH item_sales AS (SELECT cs.cs_item_sk, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk), item_returns AS (SELECT sr.sr_item_sk AS cs_item_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amt, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM store_returns sr GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk), top_item_reason AS (SELECT sr.sr_item_sk AS cs_item_sk, r.r_reason_desc, COUNT(*) AS reason_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_item_sk ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM store_returns sr JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk, r.r_reason_desc), top_item_state AS (SELECT sr.sr_item_sk AS cs_item_sk, ca.ca_state, COUNT(*) AS state_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_item_sk ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk, ca.ca_state) SELECT s.cs_item_sk, s.total_sales, s.total_profit, COALESCE(r.total_return_amt, 0) AS total_return_amt, COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss, (s.total_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) AS net_contribution, CASE WHEN (s.total_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) < 0 THEN 'Loss' ELSE 'Profit' END AS contribution_flag, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (s.total_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) DESC) AS profit_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY (s.cs_item_sk % 10) ORDER BY (s.total_profit - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) DESC) AS bucket_rank, tir.r_reason_desc AS top_return_reason, tis.ca_state AS top_return_state FROM item_sales s LEFT JOIN item_returns r ON s.cs_item_sk = r.cs_item_sk LEFT JOIN top_item_reason tir ON s.cs_item_sk = tir.cs_item_sk AND tir.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN top_item_state tis ON s.cs_item_sk = tis.cs_item_sk AND tis.rn = 1 ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 20

WITH sales_state AS (SELECT ca.ca_state, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, SUM(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS total_ship_cost, AVG(cs.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_state), returns_state AS (SELECT ca.ca_state, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amt, AVG(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS avg_return_amt, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_state), top_reason_state AS (SELECT ca.ca_state, r.r_reason_desc, COUNT(*) AS reason_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.ca_state ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM store_returns sr JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_state, r.r_reason_desc) SELECT s.ca_state, s.total_discount, s.avg_discount, s.total_ship_cost, s.avg_ship_cost, r.total_return_amt, r.avg_return_amt, CASE WHEN s.avg_discount > 10 THEN 'High Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category, tr.r_reason_desc AS top_return_reason, SUM(s.total_discount) OVER (ORDER BY s.ca_state ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_discount, SUM(r.total_return_amt) OVER (ORDER BY s.ca_state ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_return FROM sales_state s LEFT JOIN returns_state r ON s.ca_state = r.ca_state LEFT JOIN top_reason_state tr ON s.ca_state = tr.ca_state AND tr.rn = 1 ORDER BY s.ca_state

WITH sales_state_month AS (SELECT ca.ca_state, cs.cs_sold_date_sk / 10000 AS year, (cs.cs_sold_date_sk % 10000) / 100 AS month, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS profit, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS paid, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_state, cs.cs_sold_date_sk / 10000, (cs.cs_sold_date_sk % 10000) / 100), returns_state_month AS (SELECT ca.ca_state, sr.sr_returned_date_sk / 10000 AS year, (sr.sr_returned_date_sk % 10000) / 100 AS month, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS return_amt, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_state, sr.sr_returned_date_sk / 10000, (sr.sr_returned_date_sk % 10000) / 100), top_reason_state_month AS (SELECT ca.ca_state, sr.sr_returned_date_sk / 10000 AS year, (sr.sr_returned_date_sk % 10000) / 100 AS month, r.r_reason_desc, COUNT(*) AS reason_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.ca_state, sr.sr_returned_date_sk / 10000, (sr.sr_returned_date_sk % 10000) / 100 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM store_returns sr JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_state, sr.sr_returned_date_sk / 10000, (sr.sr_returned_date_sk % 10000) / 100, r.r_reason_desc) SELECT s.ca_state, s.year, s.month, s.profit, s.paid, COALESCE(r.return_amt, 0) AS return_amt, COALESCE(r.loss, 0) AS loss, (s.profit - COALESCE(r.loss, 0)) AS net_contrib, LAG((s.profit - COALESCE(r.loss, 0))) OVER (PARTITION BY s.ca_state ORDER BY s.year, s.month) AS prev_month_contrib, CASE WHEN (s.profit - COALESCE(r.loss, 0)) > LAG((s.profit - COALESCE(r.loss, 0))) OVER (PARTITION BY s.ca_state ORDER BY s.year, s.month) THEN 'Increase' WHEN (s.profit - COALESCE(r.loss, 0)) < LAG((s.profit - COALESCE(r.loss, 0))) OVER (PARTITION BY s.ca_state ORDER BY s.year, s.month) THEN 'Decrease' ELSE 'Same' END AS trend, tr.r_reason_desc AS top_return_reason, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (s.profit - COALESCE(r.loss, 0)) DESC) AS overall_rank FROM sales_state_month s LEFT JOIN returns_state_month r ON s.ca_state = r.ca_state AND s.year = r.year AND s.month = r.month LEFT JOIN top_reason_state_month tr ON s.ca_state = tr.ca_state AND s.year = tr.year AND s.month = tr.month AND tr.rn = 1 WHERE s.year >= 2020 ORDER BY s.ca_state, s.year, s.month LIMIT 100

WITH aggregated AS ( SELECT i.i_category AS category, date_trunc('month', d.d_date) AS month_start, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, AVG(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_qty, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY i.i_category, date_trunc('month', d.d_date) ) SELECT category, format_datetime(month_start, 'yyyy-MM') AS year_month, total_return_amount, total_net_loss, avg_return_qty, return_cnt, total_return_amount / SUM(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY month_start) * 100 AS pct_of_monthly_returns, SUM(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY month_start ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_return_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month_start ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS category_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month_start ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_dense_rank FROM aggregated ORDER BY month_start, category_rank

WITH aggregated AS ( SELECT cr.cr_call_center_sk AS call_center_sk, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS total_returns, AVG(cr.cr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss, MAX(d.d_year) AS last_return_year FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_call_center_sk ) SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, open.d_date AS open_date, close.d_date AS closed_date, agg.total_net_loss, agg.total_returns, agg.avg_net_loss, CASE WHEN agg.total_net_loss < 1000 THEN 'Low' WHEN agg.total_net_loss < 10000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS loss_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY agg.total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM aggregated agg JOIN call_center cc ON agg.call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk LEFT JOIN date_dim open ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = open.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN date_dim close ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = close.d_date_sk ORDER BY loss_rank LIMIT 5

WITH cust_returns AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk, cr.cr_net_loss, cr.cr_return_amount, cr.cr_call_center_sk FROM catalog_returns cr ), cust_agg AS ( SELECT cr.customer_sk, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, COUNT(*) AS total_returns FROM cust_returns cr GROUP BY cr.customer_sk ), cust_cc_counts AS ( SELECT cr.customer_sk, cr.cr_call_center_sk, COUNT(*) AS cc_return_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cr.customer_sk ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM cust_returns cr GROUP BY cr.customer_sk, cr.cr_call_center_sk ), cust_top_cc AS ( SELECT customer_sk, cr_call_center_sk AS top_cc_sk FROM cust_cc_counts WHERE rn = 1 ), last_return AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk, MAX(d.d_date) AS last_return_date FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk ), cust_risk AS ( SELECT ca.customer_sk, ca.total_net_loss, ca.total_return_amount, ca.total_returns, ct.top_cc_sk, cc.cc_name, lr.last_return_date, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_percentile FROM cust_agg ca JOIN cust_top_cc ct ON ca.customer_sk = ct.customer_sk LEFT JOIN call_center cc ON ct.top_cc_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk LEFT JOIN last_return lr ON ca.customer_sk = lr.customer_sk ) SELECT customer_sk, total_net_loss, total_return_amount, total_returns, top_cc_sk, cc_name, last_return_date, net_loss_percentile, CASE WHEN net_loss_percentile >= 0.90 THEN 'High' WHEN net_loss_percentile >= 0.70 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS risk_level FROM cust_risk ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC LIMIT 20

WITH cc_dates AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_tax_percentage, open.d_date AS open_date, close.d_date AS close_date FROM call_center cc LEFT JOIN date_dim open ON cc.cc_open_date_sk = open.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN date_dim close ON cc.cc_closed_date_sk = close.d_date_sk ), cc_returns AS ( SELECT cr.cr_call_center_sk, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS total_returns, AVG(i.i_wholesale_cost) AS avg_wholesale_cost, SUM(i.i_wholesale_cost * cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_wholesale_cost FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_call_center_sk ), cc_efficiency AS ( SELECT d.cc_call_center_sk, d.cc_name, d.cc_tax_percentage, d.open_date, d.close_date, date_diff('day', d.open_date, COALESCE(d.close_date, CURRENT_DATE)) AS operational_days, COALESCE(r.total_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss, COALESCE(r.total_returns, 0) AS total_returns, CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.total_returns,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(r.total_net_loss,0) / COALESCE(r.total_returns,0) END AS avg_loss_per_return, CASE WHEN date_diff('day', d.open_date, COALESCE(d.close_date, CURRENT_DATE)) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(r.total_net_loss,0) / date_diff('day', d.open_date, COALESCE(d.close_date, CURRENT_DATE)) END AS loss_per_operational_day, r.avg_wholesale_cost, r.total_wholesale_cost FROM cc_dates d LEFT JOIN cc_returns r ON d.cc_call_center_sk = r.cr_call_center_sk ) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, cc_tax_percentage, open_date, close_date, operational_days, total_net_loss, total_returns, avg_loss_per_return, loss_per_operational_day, avg_wholesale_cost, total_wholesale_cost, CASE WHEN loss_per_operational_day IS NULL THEN 'Insufficient Data' WHEN loss_per_operational_day < 10 THEN 'Low' WHEN loss_per_operational_day < 100 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS loss_day_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY loss_per_operational_day DESC NULLS LAST) AS loss_day_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS total_loss_dense_rank FROM cc_efficiency ORDER BY loss_day_rank LIMIT 10

WITH returns_with_time AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_customer_sk,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        sr.sr_net_loss,
        sr.sr_return_quantity,
        td.t_hour,
        s.s_store_id
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN time_dim td ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    c.c_birth_country,
    c.c_birth_year,
    c.c_birth_month,
    SUM(rwt.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS total_returns,
    AVG(rwt.sr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rwt.t_hour BETWEEN 12 AND 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lunch_time_returns,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rwt.s_store_id) AS distinct_store_count,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(rwt.sr_return_amt) < 1000 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN SUM(rwt.sr_return_amt) BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS return_volume_category,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_birth_country ORDER BY SUM(rwt.sr_return_amt) DESC) AS country_return_rank
FROM returns_with_time rwt
JOIN customer c ON rwt.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
GROUP BY
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    c.c_birth_country,
    c.c_birth_year,
    c.c_birth_month
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY c.c_birth_country, country_return_rank
LIMIT 100

WITH hourly_agg AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_city,
        td.t_hour,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount_inc_tax,
        SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS preferred_return_count
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, td.t_hour
)
SELECT
    ha.s_store_id,
    ha.s_store_name,
    ha.s_city,
    ha.t_hour,
    ha.total_return_quantity,
    ha.total_return_amount_inc_tax,
    ha.total_net_loss,
    ha.preferred_return_count,
    SUM(ha.total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY ha.s_store_id ORDER BY ha.t_hour ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_loss,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ha.s_store_id ORDER BY ha.total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_hour_rank
FROM hourly_agg ha
ORDER BY ha.s_store_id, ha.t_hour

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_store_sk,
        sr.sr_net_loss,
        sr.sr_return_amt,
        sr.sr_return_quantity
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN time_dim td ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE td.t_hour BETWEEN 9 AND 17
      AND c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
)
SELECT
    t.s_store_id,
    t.s_store_name,
    t.s_city,
    t.s_state,
    t.total_net_loss,
    t.total_return_amount,
    t.avg_return_quantity,
    t.return_count,
    t.net_loss_category,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t.total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_city,
        s.s_state,
        SUM(f.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
        SUM(f.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount,
        AVG(f.sr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_quantity,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(f.sr_net_loss) > 50000 THEN 'HIGH'
            WHEN SUM(f.sr_net_loss) BETWEEN 20000 AND 50000 THEN 'MEDIUM'
            ELSE 'LOW'
        END AS net_loss_category
    FROM filtered f
    JOIN store s ON f.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state
) t
ORDER BY t.total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH filtered_returns AS (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_store_sk,
        sr.sr_refunded_cash,
        sr.sr_store_credit,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        td.t_shift
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN time_dim td ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
    WHERE td.t_shift = 'Evening'
),
classified AS (
    SELECT
        fr.sr_store_sk,
        fr.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        CASE
            WHEN fr.sr_refunded_cash > 0 AND fr.sr_store_credit = 0 THEN 'Full Refund'
            WHEN fr.sr_refunded_cash = 0 AND fr.sr_store_credit > 0 THEN 'Store Credit'
            WHEN fr.sr_refunded_cash > 0 AND fr.sr_store_credit > 0 THEN 'Mixed'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS return_type
    FROM filtered_returns fr
),
type_counts AS (
    SELECT
        cl.sr_store_sk,
        cl.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        cl.return_type,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count
    FROM classified cl
    GROUP BY cl.sr_store_sk, cl.c_preferred_cust_flag, cl.return_type
),
store_totals AS (
    SELECT
        sr_store_sk,
        SUM(return_count) AS total_returns
    FROM type_counts
    GROUP BY sr_store_sk
),
store_full_refund_pct AS (
    SELECT
        tc.sr_store_sk,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN tc.return_type = 'Full Refund' THEN tc.return_count END) * 100.0) / st.total_returns AS full_refund_pct
    FROM type_counts tc
    JOIN store_totals st ON tc.sr_store_sk = st.sr_store_sk
    GROUP BY tc.sr_store_sk, st.total_returns
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_id,
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_city,
    tc.c_preferred_cust_flag,
    tc.return_type,
    tc.return_count,
    (tc.return_count * 100.0) / st.total_returns AS pct_of_store,
    sfr.full_refund_pct,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sfr.full_refund_pct DESC) AS full_refund_pct_rank
FROM type_counts tc
JOIN store_totals st ON tc.sr_store_sk = st.sr_store_sk
JOIN store_full_refund_pct sfr ON tc.sr_store_sk = sfr.sr_store_sk
JOIN store s ON tc.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
WHERE tc.return_type IN ('Full Refund', 'Store Credit')
ORDER BY s.s_store_id, tc.return_type

WITH page_sales AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, ca.ca_city AS billing_city, cd.cd_gender AS billing_gender, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, COUNT(*) AS total_sales FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, ca.ca_city, cd.cd_gender ), ranked AS ( SELECT ps.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.cp_department ORDER BY ps.total_discount ASC) AS dept_discount_rank FROM page_sales ps ) SELECT ranked.cp_catalog_page_id, ranked.cp_department, ranked.cp_catalog_page_number, ranked.billing_city, ranked.billing_gender, ranked.total_discount, ranked.total_sales, CASE WHEN ranked.dept_discount_rank = 1 THEN 'Best Discount' ELSE 'Other' END AS discount_rank_label FROM ranked WHERE ranked.dept_discount_rank <= 3 ORDER BY ranked.cp_department, ranked.dept_discount_rank

WITH page_sales AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, ca.ca_city AS billing_city, cd.cd_gender AS billing_gender, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COUNT(*) AS total_sales FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, ca.ca_city, cd.cd_gender ), aggregated AS ( SELECT cp_department, SUM(total_net_profit) AS dept_profit, SUM(total_sales) AS dept_sales, AVG(total_net_profit) AS avg_profit_per_sale FROM page_sales GROUP BY cp_department ), ranked AS ( SELECT a.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.dept_profit DESC) AS dept_profit_rank FROM aggregated a ) SELECT r.cp_department, r.dept_profit, r.dept_sales, r.avg_profit_per_sale, r.dept_profit_rank FROM ranked r WHERE r.dept_profit_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.dept_profit_rank

WITH page_sales AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, ca.ca_city AS billing_city, cd.cd_gender AS billing_gender, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COUNT(*) AS total_sales, AVG(cs.cs_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit_per_sale FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE cd.cd_marital_status = 'M' GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, ca.ca_city, cd.cd_gender ), windowed AS ( SELECT ps.*, SUM(ps.total_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY ps.cp_department) AS dept_total_profit, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.cp_department ORDER BY ps.total_net_profit DESC) AS dept_rank FROM page_sales ps ) SELECT w.cp_catalog_page_id, w.cp_department, w.cp_catalog_page_number, w.billing_city, w.billing_gender, w.total_net_profit, w.total_sales, w.avg_net_profit_per_sale, w.dept_total_profit, w.dept_rank FROM windowed w WHERE w.dept_rank <= 2 ORDER BY w.cp_department, w.dept_rank

WITH page_sales AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, ca.ca_state AS billing_state, cd.cd_gender AS billing_gender, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, COUNT(*) AS total_sales, AVG(cs.cs_net_paid) AS avg_net_paid_per_sale FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE cs.cs_ship_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2450100 GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, ca.ca_state, cd.cd_gender ), ranked AS ( SELECT ps.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ps.total_net_paid DESC) AS paid_rank FROM page_sales ps ) SELECT ranked.cp_catalog_page_id, ranked.cp_department, ranked.cp_catalog_page_number, ranked.billing_state, ranked.billing_gender, ranked.total_net_paid, ranked.total_sales, ranked.avg_net_paid_per_sale, CASE WHEN ranked.total_net_paid < 20000 THEN 'Low' WHEN ranked.total_net_paid < 60000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS paid_bucket, ranked.paid_rank FROM ranked WHERE ranked.paid_rank <= 5 ORDER BY ranked.paid_rank

WITH brand_birth_ship_stats AS ( SELECT i.i_brand, c.c_birth_month, sm.sm_type, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS distinct_orders, AVG(cr.cr_return_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY i.i_brand, c.c_birth_month, sm.sm_type HAVING SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) >= 10 ) SELECT i_brand, c_birth_month, sm_type, total_return_amount, total_return_qty, distinct_orders, avg_ship_cost, CASE WHEN total_return_amount > 15000 THEN 'A' WHEN total_return_amount > 8000 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS amount_tier, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c_birth_month ORDER BY total_return_qty DESC) AS month_qty_rank FROM brand_birth_ship_stats ORDER BY month_qty_rank, i_brand FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS WITH TIES

WITH brand_birth_ship_stats AS ( SELECT i.i_brand, c.c_birth_month, sm.sm_type, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS distinct_orders, AVG(cr.cr_return_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY i.i_brand, c.c_birth_month, sm.sm_type ) SELECT i_brand, c_birth_month, sm_type, total_return_amount, total_return_qty, distinct_orders, avg_ship_cost, NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS quintile, SUM(total_return_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY i_brand) AS brand_total_qty FROM brand_birth_ship_stats WHERE total_return_amount BETWEEN 500 AND 20000 ORDER BY brand_total_qty DESC, total_return_amount ASC LIMIT 75

WITH brand_birth_ship_stats AS ( SELECT i.i_brand, c.c_birth_month, sm.sm_type, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS distinct_orders, AVG(cr.cr_return_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost, MIN(cr.cr_return_ship_cost) AS min_ship_cost, MAX(cr.cr_return_ship_cost) AS max_ship_cost FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY i.i_brand, c.c_birth_month, sm.sm_type ) SELECT i_brand, c_birth_month, sm_type, total_return_amount, total_return_qty, distinct_orders, avg_ship_cost, min_ship_cost, max_ship_cost, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS amount_dense_rank, LAG(total_return_amount,1) OVER (PARTITION BY i_brand ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS prev_amount FROM brand_birth_ship_stats WHERE distinct_orders >= 5 ORDER BY amount_dense_rank, i_brand FETCH FIRST 60 ROWS ONLY

WITH brand_birth_ship_stats AS ( SELECT i.i_brand, c.c_birth_month, sm.sm_type, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS distinct_orders, AVG(cr.cr_return_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost, CASE WHEN SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) > 20000 THEN 'VERY_HIGH' WHEN SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) BETWEEN 5000 AND 20000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS return_amount_category FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_refunded_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk WHERE c.c_birth_month BETWEEN 1 AND 6 GROUP BY i.i_brand, c.c_birth_month, sm.sm_type ) SELECT i_brand, c_birth_month, sm_type, total_return_amount, total_return_qty, distinct_orders, avg_ship_cost, return_amount_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i_brand ORDER BY total_return_qty DESC) AS qty_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount ASC) AS pct_rank FROM brand_birth_ship_stats WHERE total_return_amount > 1000 ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC LIMIT 100

WITH returns_detail AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returned_date_sk, cr.cr_net_loss, cr.cr_return_amount, sm.sm_type, sm.sm_carrier, cd.cd_credit_rating, cd.cd_gender FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk ) SELECT cr_returned_date_sk, sm_type, sm_carrier, cr_net_loss, AVG(cr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY sm_type) AS avg_net_loss_by_type, AVG(cr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY sm_type ORDER BY cr_returned_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_net_loss, LAG(cr_net_loss, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY sm_type ORDER BY cr_returned_date_sk) AS previous_net_loss, CASE WHEN cr_net_loss > 1.5 * AVG(cr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY sm_type) THEN 'Spike' ELSE 'Normal' END AS loss_flag FROM returns_detail WHERE cr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 20000101 AND 20231231 ORDER BY sm_type, cr_returned_date_sk DESC LIMIT 20

WITH demo_totals AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_sales_amount FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status ) SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, total_return_amount, total_sales_amount, CASE WHEN total_sales_amount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE total_return_amount / total_sales_amount END AS return_to_sales_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS return_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN total_sales_amount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE total_return_amount / total_sales_amount END DESC) AS ratio_dense_rank, CASE WHEN total_sales_amount = 0 THEN 'No Sales' WHEN total_return_amount / total_sales_amount > 0.2 THEN 'High Return Ratio' ELSE 'Normal' END AS ratio_category FROM demo_totals WHERE total_return_amount > 0 ORDER BY return_amount_rank LIMIT 5

WITH activity AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS activity_date_sk, ss.ss_net_profit AS profit, 0.0 AS loss FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk UNION ALL SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS activity_date_sk, 0.0 AS profit, cr.cr_net_loss AS loss FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk ), ordered_activity AS ( SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_gender, cd_marital_status, activity_date_sk, profit, loss, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd_demo_sk ORDER BY activity_date_sk DESC) AS rn FROM activity ), activity_with_cum AS ( SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_gender, cd_marital_status, activity_date_sk, profit, loss, SUM(profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cd_demo_sk ORDER BY activity_date_sk ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cum_profit, SUM(loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cd_demo_sk ORDER BY activity_date_sk ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cum_loss, rn FROM ordered_activity ) SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_gender, cd_marital_status, activity_date_sk, cum_profit, cum_loss, (cum_profit - cum_loss) AS net_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (cum_profit - cum_loss) DESC) AS net_balance_rank, CASE WHEN (cum_profit - cum_loss) < 0 THEN 'Deficit' ELSE 'Surplus' END AS balance_status FROM activity_with_cum WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY net_balance_rank LIMIT 10

WITH agg AS ( SELECT sm.sm_ship_mode_id, sm.sm_type, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_gender, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_order_number) AS return_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS sales_tickets FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN ship_mode sm ON cr.cr_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY sm.sm_ship_mode_id, sm.sm_type, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_gender ) SELECT sm_ship_mode_id, sm_type, cd_marital_status, cd_gender, total_net_loss, total_net_profit, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > total_net_profit THEN 'Loss > Profit' WHEN total_net_loss = total_net_profit THEN 'Break-even' ELSE 'Profit > Loss' END AS loss_vs_profit, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sm_type ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_by_type FROM agg WHERE total_net_loss IS NOT NULL ORDER BY loss_rank LIMIT 10

WITH sales_by_store_brand AS (SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk, i.i_brand, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS brand_sales, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS brand_profit FROM store_sales ss JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk, i.i_brand), store_daily_totals AS (SELECT ss_store_sk, ss_sold_date_sk, SUM(brand_sales) AS daily_sales FROM sales_by_store_brand GROUP BY ss_store_sk, ss_sold_date_sk) SELECT sbb.ss_store_sk, sbb.ss_sold_date_sk, sbb.i_brand, sbb.brand_sales, sbb.brand_profit, sbb.brand_sales / dt.daily_sales AS brand_sales_share, SUM(sbb.brand_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY sbb.ss_store_sk ORDER BY sbb.ss_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_store_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sbb.ss_sold_date_sk ORDER BY sbb.brand_sales DESC) AS brand_sales_rank_on_day, CASE WHEN sbb.brand_profit > 0 THEN 'POSITIVE' WHEN sbb.brand_profit = 0 THEN 'ZERO' ELSE 'NEGATIVE' END AS profit_status, CASE WHEN dt.daily_sales > 50000 THEN 'HIGH_VOLUME' ELSE 'LOW_VOLUME' END AS volume_category FROM sales_by_store_brand sbb JOIN store_daily_totals dt ON sbb.ss_store_sk = dt.ss_store_sk AND sbb.ss_sold_date_sk = dt.ss_sold_date_sk ORDER BY sbb.ss_store_sk, sbb.ss_sold_date_sk, sbb.i_brand LIMIT 500

WITH sales_agg AS (SELECT ss_customer_sk, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ss_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(ss_net_profit) AS total_profit FROM store_sales GROUP BY ss_customer_sk), returns_agg AS (SELECT sr_customer_sk, SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, SUM(sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity, SUM(sr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss FROM store_returns GROUP BY sr_customer_sk) SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, c.c_birth_month, COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) AS total_sales, COALESCE(r.total_return_amount, 0) AS total_return_amount, COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_amount, 0) AS net_sales, COALESCE(s.total_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) AS net_profit, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(s.total_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) DESC) AS profit_rank, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.total_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) > 10000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN COALESCE(s.total_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) > 5000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS profit_category FROM customer c LEFT JOIN sales_agg s ON c.c_customer_sk = s.ss_customer_sk LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON c.c_customer_sk = r.sr_customer_sk ORDER BY net_profit DESC LIMIT 100

WITH item_sales AS (SELECT ss_item_sk, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount, SUM(ss_quantity) AS quantity_sold, SUM(ss_net_profit) AS profit_amount FROM store_sales GROUP BY ss_item_sk), item_returns AS (SELECT sr_item_sk, SUM(sr_return_amt) AS return_amount, SUM(sr_return_quantity) AS return_quantity, SUM(sr_net_loss) AS return_loss FROM store_returns GROUP BY sr_item_sk) SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_brand, i.i_category, COALESCE(s.sales_amount, 0) AS sales_amount, COALESCE(r.return_amount, 0) AS return_amount, COALESCE(s.sales_amount, 0) - COALESCE(r.return_amount, 0) AS net_sales_amount, COALESCE(s.profit_amount, 0) - COALESCE(r.return_loss, 0) AS net_profit, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(s.profit_amount, 0) - COALESCE(r.return_loss, 0) DESC) AS profit_rank, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.profit_amount, 0) - COALESCE(r.return_loss, 0) > 5000 THEN 'PROFITABLE' WHEN COALESCE(s.profit_amount, 0) - COALESCE(r.return_loss, 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 5000 THEN 'BREAK_EVEN' ELSE 'LOSS' END AS profitability_label FROM item i LEFT JOIN item_sales s ON i.i_item_sk = s.ss_item_sk LEFT JOIN item_returns r ON i.i_item_sk = r.sr_item_sk WHERE COALESCE(s.sales_amount, 0) > 0 ORDER BY net_profit DESC LIMIT 200

WITH sales_data AS (SELECT c.c_birth_country, i.i_manufact, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS profit_amount FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY c.c_birth_country, i.i_manufact), returns_data AS (SELECT c.c_birth_country, i.i_manufact, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS return_amount, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS return_loss FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY c.c_birth_country, i.i_manufact) SELECT s.c_birth_country, s.i_manufact, s.sales_amount, COALESCE(r.return_amount, 0) AS return_amount, s.sales_amount - COALESCE(r.return_amount, 0) AS net_sales, s.profit_amount - COALESCE(r.return_loss, 0) AS net_profit, CASE WHEN s.sales_amount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (s.profit_amount - COALESCE(r.return_loss, 0)) / s.sales_amount END AS profit_margin, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.c_birth_country ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.sales_amount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (s.profit_amount - COALESCE(r.return_loss, 0)) / s.sales_amount END DESC) AS profit_margin_rank, CASE WHEN (s.profit_amount - COALESCE(r.return_loss, 0)) / NULLIF(s.sales_amount, 0) > 0.2 THEN 'EXCELLENT' WHEN (s.profit_amount - COALESCE(r.return_loss, 0)) / NULLIF(s.sales_amount, 0) > 0.1 THEN 'GOOD' ELSE 'POOR' END AS profit_category FROM sales_data s LEFT JOIN returns_data r ON s.c_birth_country = r.c_birth_country AND s.i_manufact = r.i_manufact ORDER BY s.c_birth_country, profit_margin_rank LIMIT 300

WITH demo_pair_agg AS (
  SELECT
    cd_ret.cd_marital_status AS returning_marital,
    cd_ret.cd_gender AS returning_gender,
    cd_ref.cd_marital_status AS refunded_marital,
    cd_ref.cd_gender AS refunded_gender,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS num_returns,
    AVG(cr.cr_fee) AS avg_fee
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN customer_demographics cd_ret ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd_ret.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd_ref ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd_ref.cd_demo_sk
  GROUP BY
    cd_ret.cd_marital_status,
    cd_ret.cd_gender,
    cd_ref.cd_marital_status,
    cd_ref.cd_gender
)
SELECT
  returning_marital,
  returning_gender,
  refunded_marital,
  refunded_gender,
  total_return_amount,
  num_returns,
  avg_fee,
  CASE
    WHEN total_return_amount < 1000 THEN 'Low'
    WHEN total_return_amount BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000 THEN 'Medium'
    ELSE 'High'
  END AS amount_category,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS amount_rank
FROM demo_pair_agg
WHERE total_return_amount > 0
ORDER BY amount_rank
LIMIT 20

WITH cust_total AS (
  SELECT
    cr.cr_returning_customer_sk,
    cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS total_return_cnt
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk
),
cust_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    ct.*, 
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS amount_rank,
    CASE
      WHEN total_return_amount >= 15000 THEN 'Platinum'
      WHEN total_return_amount >= 8000 THEN 'Gold'
      WHEN total_return_amount >= 3000 THEN 'Silver'
      ELSE 'Bronze'
    END AS tier
  FROM cust_total ct
),
cust_reason AS (
  SELECT
    cr.cr_returning_customer_sk,
    cr.cr_reason_sk,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS amount_by_reason,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt_by_reason
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, cr.cr_reason_sk
),
cust_category AS (
  SELECT
    cr.cr_returning_customer_sk,
    i.i_category,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS amount_by_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk ORDER BY SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) DESC) AS category_rank
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, i.i_category
)
SELECT
  cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS returning_customer_sk,
  cr.total_return_amount,
  cr.total_return_cnt,
  cr.tier,
  cr.amount_rank,
  cd.cd_marital_status,
  cd.cd_gender,
  cr_reason.cr_reason_sk,
  cr_reason.amount_by_reason,
  (cr_reason.amount_by_reason * 100.0) / cr.total_return_amount AS pct_of_total_by_reason,
  cat.i_category,
  cat.amount_by_category,
  (cat.amount_by_category * 100.0) / cr.total_return_amount AS pct_of_total_by_category
FROM cust_ranked cr
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN cust_reason cr_reason ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = cr_reason.cr_returning_customer_sk
JOIN (
  SELECT cr_returning_customer_sk, i_category, amount_by_category
  FROM cust_category
  WHERE category_rank = 1
) cat ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = cat.cr_returning_customer_sk
WHERE cr.amount_rank <= 5
ORDER BY cr.total_return_amount DESC

WITH item_agg AS (
  SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_product_name,
    i.i_wholesale_cost,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount,
    SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss,
    AVG(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_qty
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN warehouse w ON cr.cr_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_product_name, i.i_wholesale_cost, w.w_warehouse_name
)
SELECT
  i_item_id,
  i_product_name,
  w_warehouse_name,
  total_return_amount,
  total_net_loss,
  avg_return_qty,
  CASE
    WHEN i_wholesale_cost < 20 THEN 'Low'
    WHEN i_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 20 AND 50 THEN 'Medium'
    ELSE 'High'
  END AS wholesale_cost_category,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank
FROM item_agg
ORDER BY net_loss_rank
LIMIT 10

WITH unified_events AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS event_date_sk, ss.ss_net_profit - COALESCE(p.p_cost, 0) AS net_amount, 'sale' AS event_type FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk UNION ALL SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cr.cr_returned_date_sk AS event_date_sk, -cr.cr_net_loss AS net_amount, 'return' AS event_type FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk ), daily_aggregated AS ( SELECT ue.cd_demo_sk, ue.cd_gender, ue.event_date_sk, SUM(ue.net_amount) AS daily_net_amount FROM unified_events ue GROUP BY ue.cd_demo_sk, ue.cd_gender, ue.event_date_sk ) SELECT da.cd_demo_sk, da.cd_gender, da.event_date_sk, da.daily_net_amount, SUM(da.daily_net_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY da.cd_demo_sk ORDER BY da.event_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_net_total, AVG(da.daily_net_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY da.cd_demo_sk ORDER BY da.event_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3days, CASE WHEN SUM(da.daily_net_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY da.cd_demo_sk ORDER BY da.event_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) < 0 THEN 'Deficit' ELSE 'Positive' END AS net_status FROM daily_aggregated da WHERE da.daily_net_amount <> 0 ORDER BY da.cd_demo_sk, da.event_date_sk LIMIT 100

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT ss.ss_promo_sk, ss.ss_cdemo_sk, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit, SUM(ss.ss_ext_tax) AS total_sales_tax FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_promo_sk, ss.ss_cdemo_sk ), returns_agg AS ( SELECT cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk AS cdemo_sk, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM catalog_returns cr GROUP BY cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk ) SELECT p.p_promo_name, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, sa.total_sales_profit, ra.total_return_loss, (sa.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(ra.total_return_loss, 0)) AS net_contribution, CASE WHEN (sa.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(ra.total_return_loss, 0)) >= 10000 THEN 'High' WHEN (sa.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(ra.total_return_loss, 0)) BETWEEN 5000 AND 9999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS contribution_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (sa.total_sales_profit - COALESCE(ra.total_return_loss, 0)) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM sales_agg sa JOIN customer_demographics cd ON sa.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN promotion p ON sa.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk LEFT JOIN returns_agg ra ON ra.cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE p.p_start_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2451000 ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 20

WITH returns_demo AS ( SELECT cd.cd_demo_sk, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, COUNT(*) AS total_return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cr.cr_refunded_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_demo_sk ) SELECT p.p_promo_name, cd.cd_gender, AVG(ss.ss_net_profit) AS avg_profit, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity, CASE WHEN AVG(ss.ss_net_profit) >= 5000 THEN 'High Profit' WHEN AVG(ss.ss_net_profit) BETWEEN 2000 AND 4999 THEN 'Mid Profit' ELSE 'Low Profit' END AS profit_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.cd_gender ORDER BY AVG(ss.ss_net_profit) DESC) AS promo_rank_by_gender, COALESCE(SUM(r.total_return_loss), 0) AS total_return_loss, COALESCE(SUM(r.total_return_cnt), 0) AS total_return_cnt FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk LEFT JOIN returns_demo r ON cd.cd_demo_sk = r.cd_demo_sk WHERE ss.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2452000 GROUP BY p.p_promo_name, cd.cd_gender HAVING AVG(ss.ss_net_profit) > 0 ORDER BY cd.cd_gender, promo_rank_by_gender LIMIT 50

WITH demo_div_agg AS ( SELECT hd.hd_buy_potential, s.s_division_id, s.s_division_name, SUM(sr.sr_store_credit) AS total_store_credit, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, COUNT(*) AS total_returns FROM store_returns sr JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY hd.hd_buy_potential, s.s_division_id, s.s_division_name ), demo_div_reason AS ( SELECT hd.hd_buy_potential, r.r_reason_desc, COUNT(*) AS reason_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hd.hd_buy_potential ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM store_returns sr JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY hd.hd_buy_potential, r.r_reason_desc ) SELECT dda.hd_buy_potential, CASE WHEN dda.hd_buy_potential = 'High' THEN 'Premium' WHEN dda.hd_buy_potential = 'Medium' THEN 'Standard' ELSE 'Low' END AS buy_potential_category, dda.s_division_id, dda.s_division_name, dda.total_store_credit, dda.total_net_loss, dda.total_return_amount, dda.total_returns, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dda.hd_buy_potential ORDER BY dda.total_store_credit DESC) AS credit_rank, dr.r_reason_desc AS top_reason, dr.reason_cnt AS top_reason_count FROM demo_div_agg dda JOIN demo_div_reason dr ON dda.hd_buy_potential = dr.hd_buy_potential AND dr.rn = 1 ORDER BY dda.hd_buy_potential, credit_rank LIMIT 200

WITH store_metrics AS ( SELECT s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_state, s.s_city, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(sr.sr_fee) AS total_fee, SUM(sr.sr_store_credit) AS total_store_credit, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_quantity, COUNT(*) AS total_returns, AVG(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.r_reason_id = 'R001' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reason_r001_cnt FROM store_returns sr JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_state, s.s_city ) SELECT sm.s_store_sk, sm.s_store_name, sm.s_state, sm.s_city, sm.total_net_loss, sm.total_fee, sm.total_store_credit, sm.total_return_quantity, sm.avg_vehicle_count, sm.total_returns, (sm.total_net_loss * 0.4 + sm.total_fee * 0.3 + sm.total_store_credit * 0.2 + sm.total_return_quantity * 0.1) AS performance_score, CASE WHEN (sm.total_net_loss * 0.4 + sm.total_fee * 0.3 + sm.total_store_credit * 0.2 + sm.total_return_quantity * 0.1) < 5000 THEN 'Excellent' WHEN (sm.total_net_loss * 0.4 + sm.total_fee * 0.3 + sm.total_store_credit * 0.2 + sm.total_return_quantity * 0.1) < 15000 THEN 'Good' WHEN (sm.total_net_loss * 0.4 + sm.total_fee * 0.3 + sm.total_store_credit * 0.2 + sm.total_return_quantity * 0.1) < 30000 THEN 'Average' ELSE 'Poor' END AS performance_tier, (sm.reason_r001_cnt * 100.0 / sm.total_returns) AS pct_returns_r001, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.s_state ORDER BY (sm.total_net_loss * 0.4 + sm.total_fee * 0.3 + sm.total_store_credit * 0.2 + sm.total_return_quantity * 0.1) DESC) AS state_store_rank, AVG(sm.total_net_loss * 0.4 + sm.total_fee * 0.3 + sm.total_store_credit * 0.2 + sm.total_return_quantity * 0.1) OVER (PARTITION BY sm.s_state) AS avg_state_performance_score FROM store_metrics sm ORDER BY sm.s_state, state_store_rank LIMIT 100

WITH daily_agg AS ( SELECT sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS return_date, r.r_reason_desc, s.s_division_id, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amount, AVG(hd.hd_dep_count) AS avg_dep_count FROM store_returns sr JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk, r.r_reason_desc, s.s_division_id ) SELECT return_date, r_reason_desc, s_division_id, total_return_amount, LAG(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY r_reason_desc ORDER BY return_date) AS prev_day_amount, LEAD(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY r_reason_desc ORDER BY return_date) AS next_day_amount, total_return_amount - LAG(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY r_reason_desc ORDER BY return_date) AS diff_from_prev, CASE WHEN total_return_amount > 50000 THEN 'High' WHEN total_return_amount > 20000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS amount_category, AVG(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY r_reason_desc ORDER BY return_date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3days, avg_dep_count FROM daily_agg ORDER BY return_date, r_reason_desc LIMIT 200

WITH store_agg AS ( SELECT s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_market_id, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, AVG(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_count, CASE WHEN SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) > 100000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS net_loss_category FROM store_returns sr JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON sr.sr_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY s.s_store_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_market_id ), store_reason_rank AS ( SELECT sr.sr_store_sk, r.r_reason_desc, COUNT(*) AS reason_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_store_sk ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM store_returns sr JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk, r.r_reason_desc ) SELECT sa.s_store_sk, sa.s_store_name, sa.s_market_id, sa.total_net_loss, sa.total_return_amt, sa.return_cnt, sa.avg_vehicle_count, sa.net_loss_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sa.s_market_id ORDER BY sa.total_net_loss DESC) AS market_net_loss_rank, sr.r_reason_desc AS top_reason, sr.reason_cnt AS top_reason_count FROM store_agg sa JOIN store_reason_rank sr ON sa.s_store_sk = sr.sr_store_sk WHERE sr.rn = 1 ORDER BY sa.s_market_id, market_net_loss_rank LIMIT 100

SELECT
    hd.hd_demo_sk,
    hd.hd_income_band_sk,
    cd.cd_gender,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
    AVG(ss.ss_net_profit) AS avg_profit,
    AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ss.ss_ext_discount_amt > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_discount_txns,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN ss.ss_ext_discount_amt > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS pct_high_discount,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(ss.ss_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
GROUP BY
    hd.hd_demo_sk,
    hd.hd_income_band_sk,
    cd.cd_gender
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY profit_rank

WITH profit_by_cust AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_birth_month,
        cd.cd_credit_rating,
        cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_birth_month ORDER BY SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) DESC) AS drk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_birth_month,
        cd.cd_credit_rating,
        cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
        hd.hd_buy_potential
)
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    c_birth_month,
    cd_credit_rating,
    cd_purchase_estimate,
    hd_buy_potential,
    total_profit
FROM profit_by_cust
WHERE drk <= 5
ORDER BY c_birth_month, drk

SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    c.c_birth_year,
    cd.cd_gender,
    hd.hd_vehicle_count,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit,
    AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS ticket_count,
    CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'PROFIT' ELSE 'LOSS' END AS profit_flag,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_birth_year ORDER BY SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_birth_year
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
GROUP BY
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    c.c_birth_year,
    cd.cd_gender,
    hd.hd_vehicle_count

WITH cust_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
        hd.hd_buy_potential,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS actual_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit
    FROM customer c
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    WHERE cd.cd_credit_rating IN ('A', 'B')
      AND hd.hd_buy_potential = 'HIGH'
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
        hd.hd_buy_potential
)
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    c_first_name,
    c_last_name,
    cd_purchase_estimate,
    actual_sales,
    total_profit,
    CASE
        WHEN actual_sales > cd_purchase_estimate * 1.2 THEN 'OVERACHIEVER'
        WHEN actual_sales < cd_purchase_estimate * 0.8 THEN 'UNDERACHIEVER'
        ELSE 'ON_TARGET'
    END AS performance_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(actual_sales - cd_purchase_estimate) DESC) AS deviation_rank
FROM cust_sales
WHERE actual_sales > 0
ORDER BY deviation_rank
LIMIT 15

WITH warehouse_profit AS ( SELECT w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_state, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.cd_demo_sk) AS demo_count, AVG(CASE WHEN cd.cd_credit_rating = 'A' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS credit_a_ratio FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_state ) SELECT wp.w_warehouse_name, wp.w_state, wp.total_net_profit, wp.demo_count, wp.credit_a_ratio, CASE WHEN wp.total_net_profit < 0 THEN 'Loss' WHEN wp.total_net_profit < 5000 THEN 'Low' WHEN wp.total_net_profit < 20000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS profit_bracket, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY wp.w_state ORDER BY wp.total_net_profit DESC) AS state_rank FROM warehouse_profit wp ORDER BY wp.total_net_profit DESC LIMIT 20

WITH ws_enriched AS ( SELECT ws.ws_order_number, ws.ws_warehouse_sk, ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk, ws.ws_net_paid_inc_ship_tax, ws.ws_sales_price, ws.ws_list_price, ws.ws_ext_discount_amt, ws.ws_ext_list_price, cd.cd_gender, w.w_city, CASE WHEN ws.ws_list_price = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(((ws.ws_list_price - ws.ws_sales_price) / ws.ws_list_price) * 100, 2) END AS discount_pct FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk ) SELECT we.ws_order_number, we.ws_warehouse_sk, we.w_city, we.cd_gender, we.ws_net_paid_inc_ship_tax, we.discount_pct, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY we.ws_net_paid_inc_ship_tax DESC) AS net_paid_rank, LAG(we.ws_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) OVER (ORDER BY we.ws_net_paid_inc_ship_tax DESC) AS prev_net_paid, ROUND(we.ws_net_paid_inc_ship_tax - COALESCE(LAG(we.ws_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) OVER (ORDER BY we.ws_net_paid_inc_ship_tax DESC),0),2) AS diff_from_prev, SUM(we.ws_net_paid_inc_ship_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY we.ws_warehouse_sk ORDER BY we.ws_net_paid_inc_ship_tax DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_paid_by_warehouse FROM ws_enriched we WHERE we.discount_pct > 0 ORDER BY we.ws_net_paid_inc_ship_tax DESC LIMIT 15

WITH daily_warehouse_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, cs.cs_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS net_profit, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_qty, 'catalog' AS channel FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk, cs.cs_warehouse_sk UNION ALL SELECT ws.ws_sold_date_sk, ws.ws_warehouse_sk, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS net_profit, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_qty, 'web' AS channel FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_sold_date_sk, ws.ws_warehouse_sk ) SELECT dws.sold_date_sk, dws.warehouse_sk, w.w_state, dws.channel, dws.net_profit, dws.sales_amount, dws.total_qty, CASE WHEN dws.sales_amount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(dws.net_profit / dws.sales_amount * 100, 2) END AS profit_margin_pct, AVG(dws.net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY dws.warehouse_sk ORDER BY dws.sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_7day_profit, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dws.warehouse_sk ORDER BY dws.net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_within_warehouse FROM daily_warehouse_sales dws JOIN warehouse w ON dws.warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk WHERE dws.sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dws.sold_date_sk DESC, dws.warehouse_sk LIMIT 100

WITH unified_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_order_number AS order_number, cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit, cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax AS net_paid_inc_tax, cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk AS demo_sk, cd.cd_gender AS gender, cd.cd_marital_status AS marital_status, cd.cd_education_status AS education_status, 'catalog' AS channel FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk UNION ALL SELECT ws.ws_order_number, ws.ws_sold_date_sk, ws.ws_net_profit, ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax, ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, 'web' AS channel FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ws.ws_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk ) , daily_demo AS ( SELECT us.sold_date_sk, us.channel, us.gender, us.marital_status, us.education_status, SUM(us.net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(us.net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_paid, COUNT(DISTINCT us.order_number) AS order_cnt FROM unified_sales us GROUP BY us.sold_date_sk, us.channel, us.gender, us.marital_status, us.education_status ) SELECT dd.sold_date_sk, dd.channel, dd.gender, dd.marital_status, dd.education_status, dd.total_profit, dd.total_paid, dd.order_cnt, CASE WHEN dd.order_cnt = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(dd.total_profit / dd.order_cnt, 2) END AS profit_per_order, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dd.channel ORDER BY dd.total_profit DESC) AS channel_profit_rank, LAG(dd.total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY dd.channel, dd.gender, dd.marital_status, dd.education_status ORDER BY dd.sold_date_sk) AS prev_day_profit, CASE WHEN LAG(dd.total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY dd.channel, dd.gender, dd.marital_status, dd.education_status ORDER BY dd.sold_date_sk) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((dd.total_profit - LAG(dd.total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY dd.channel, dd.gender, dd.marital_status, dd.education_status ORDER BY dd.sold_date_sk)) / LAG(dd.total_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY dd.channel, dd.gender, dd.marital_status, dd.education_status ORDER BY dd.sold_date_sk) * 100, 2) END AS pct_change_from_prev_day FROM daily_demo dd WHERE dd.sold_date_sk >= (SELECT MAX(sold_date_sk) - 30 FROM daily_demo) ORDER BY dd.sold_date_sk DESC, dd.channel, dd.total_profit DESC LIMIT 200

WITH sales_agg AS (SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk), returns_agg AS (SELECT sr.sr_store_sk, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM store_returns sr GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk), top_reason AS (SELECT store_sk, reason_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_sk ORDER BY reason_cnt DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT sr.sr_store_sk AS store_sk, r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc, COUNT(*) AS reason_cnt FROM store_returns sr JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk, r.r_reason_desc) t) SELECT st.s_store_id, st.s_store_name, st.s_city, st.s_state, sa.total_net_profit, ra.total_net_loss, CASE WHEN ra.total_net_loss = 0 THEN 'N/A' WHEN sa.total_net_profit / ra.total_net_loss > 1 THEN 'Profit > Loss' ELSE 'Loss >= Profit' END AS profit_loss_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ra.total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank, tr.reason_desc AS top_return_reason FROM sales_agg sa JOIN returns_agg ra ON sa.ss_store_sk = ra.sr_store_sk JOIN store st ON st.s_store_sk = sa.ss_store_sk LEFT JOIN top_reason tr ON tr.store_sk = sa.ss_store_sk AND tr.rn = 1 ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 10
