WITH sales_daily AS (SELECT ss.ss_store_sk AS store_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS daily_profit FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk), returns_daily AS (SELECT sr.sr_store_sk AS store_sk, sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS daily_loss FROM store_returns sr GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk, sr.sr_returned_date_sk), combined_daily AS (SELECT COALESCE(sd.store_sk, rd.store_sk) AS store_sk, COALESCE(sd.date_sk, rd.date_sk) AS date_sk, COALESCE(sd.daily_profit, 0) AS daily_profit, COALESCE(rd.daily_loss, 0) AS daily_loss, COALESCE(sd.daily_profit, 0) - COALESCE(rd.daily_loss, 0) AS net_amount FROM sales_daily sd FULL OUTER JOIN returns_daily rd ON sd.store_sk = rd.store_sk AND sd.date_sk = rd.date_sk), top_reason_store AS (SELECT store_sk, reason_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_sk ORDER BY reason_loss DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT sr.sr_store_sk AS store_sk, r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS reason_loss FROM store_returns sr JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk, r.r_reason_desc) t) SELECT st.s_store_id, st.s_store_name, cd.date_sk, cd.daily_profit, cd.daily_loss, cd.net_amount, CASE WHEN cd.net_amount > 0 THEN 'Profit' WHEN cd.net_amount < 0 THEN 'Loss' ELSE 'Break-even' END AS day_status, SUM(cd.net_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY cd.store_sk ORDER BY cd.date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net, AVG(cd.net_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY cd.store_sk ORDER BY cd.date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_7d, tr.reason_desc AS top_return_reason FROM combined_daily cd JOIN store st ON st.s_store_sk = cd.store_sk LEFT JOIN (SELECT store_sk, reason_desc FROM top_reason_store WHERE rn = 1) tr ON tr.store_sk = cd.store_sk WHERE cd.date_sk IS NOT NULL ORDER BY st.s_store_id, cd.date_sk LIMIT 100

WITH customer_sales AS (SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_paid, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS sales_transactions FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk), customer_returns AS (SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk AS customer_sk, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_transactions FROM store_returns sr GROUP BY sr.sr_customer_sk), customer_metrics AS (SELECT cs.customer_sk, cs.total_paid, cs.total_profit, cs.avg_discount, cs.sales_transactions, COALESCE(cr.total_loss, 0) AS total_loss, COALESCE(cr.return_transactions, 0) AS return_transactions, CASE WHEN cs.sales_transactions = 0 THEN 0 ELSE cr.return_transactions * 1.0 / cs.sales_transactions END AS return_rate FROM customer_sales cs LEFT JOIN customer_returns cr ON cs.customer_sk = cr.customer_sk), store_counts AS (SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk, ss.ss_store_sk, COUNT(*) AS store_cnt FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk, ss.ss_store_sk), customer_top_store AS (SELECT customer_sk, ss_store_sk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_sk ORDER BY store_cnt DESC) AS rn FROM store_counts), reason_counts AS (SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk AS customer_sk, r.r_reason_desc, COUNT(*) AS reason_cnt FROM store_returns sr JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_customer_sk, r.r_reason_desc), customer_top_reason AS (SELECT customer_sk, r_reason_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_sk ORDER BY reason_cnt DESC) AS rn FROM reason_counts) SELECT cm.customer_sk, cm.total_paid, cm.total_profit, cm.avg_discount, cm.return_rate, CASE WHEN cm.total_profit > 10000 THEN 'VIP' WHEN cm.total_profit > 0 THEN 'Regular' ELSE 'Loss' END AS customer_segment, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cm.total_profit DESC) AS profit_dense_rank, LAG(cm.total_profit) OVER (ORDER BY cm.total_profit DESC) AS previous_profit, LEAD(cm.total_profit) OVER (ORDER BY cm.total_profit DESC) AS next_profit, st.s_store_id, st.s_store_name, tr.r_reason_desc AS top_return_reason FROM customer_metrics cm LEFT JOIN (SELECT customer_sk, ss_store_sk FROM customer_top_store WHERE rn = 1) ts ON cm.customer_sk = ts.customer_sk LEFT JOIN store st ON st.s_store_sk = ts.ss_store_sk LEFT JOIN (SELECT customer_sk, r_reason_desc FROM customer_top_reason WHERE rn = 1) tr ON cm.customer_sk = tr.customer_sk ORDER BY profit_dense_rank LIMIT 20

WITH promo_sales AS (SELECT ss.ss_promo_sk AS promo_sk, ss.ss_store_sk AS store_sk, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt, AVG(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS avg_coupon FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_promo_sk, ss.ss_store_sk), promo_returns AS (SELECT ss.ss_promo_sk AS promo_sk, sr.sr_store_sk AS store_sk, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM store_returns sr JOIN store_sales ss ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number GROUP BY ss.ss_promo_sk, sr.sr_store_sk), promo_combined AS (SELECT ps.promo_sk, ps.store_sk, ps.total_sales, ps.total_discount, ps.total_profit, ps.sales_cnt, ps.avg_coupon, COALESCE(pr.total_return_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss, COALESCE(pr.return_cnt, 0) AS return_cnt FROM promo_sales ps LEFT JOIN promo_returns pr ON ps.promo_sk = pr.promo_sk AND ps.store_sk = pr.store_sk), promo_reason_counts AS (SELECT ss.ss_promo_sk AS promo_sk, sr.sr_store_sk AS store_sk, r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc, COUNT(*) AS reason_cnt FROM store_returns sr JOIN store_sales ss ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_promo_sk, sr.sr_store_sk, r.r_reason_desc), promo_top_reason AS (SELECT promo_sk, store_sk, reason_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_sk, store_sk ORDER BY reason_cnt DESC) AS rn FROM promo_reason_counts) SELECT st.s_store_id, st.s_store_name, pc.promo_sk, pc.total_sales, pc.total_discount, pc.total_profit, pc.sales_cnt, pc.avg_coupon, pc.total_return_loss, pc.return_cnt, CASE WHEN pc.total_sales = 0 THEN 'No Sales' WHEN pc.total_discount / pc.total_sales > 0.2 THEN 'High Discount' WHEN pc.total_discount / pc.total_sales > 0.1 THEN 'Medium Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pc.store_sk ORDER BY pc.total_sales DESC) AS store_sales_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pc.total_profit DESC) AS overall_profit_rank, tr.reason_desc AS top_return_reason FROM promo_combined pc JOIN store st ON st.s_store_sk = pc.store_sk LEFT JOIN (SELECT promo_sk, store_sk, reason_desc FROM promo_top_reason WHERE rn = 1) tr ON tr.promo_sk = pc.promo_sk AND tr.store_sk = pc.store_sk WHERE pc.promo_sk IS NOT NULL ORDER BY overall_profit_rank LIMIT 50

WITH latest_year AS ( SELECT MAX(d_year) AS max_year FROM date_dim ), call_center_sales AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk AS cc_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, AVG(cs.cs_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders, DATE_TRUNC('quarter', d.d_date) AS sales_quarter FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk CROSS JOIN latest_year ly WHERE d.d_year = ly.max_year AND w.w_state = cc.cc_state GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, DATE_TRUNC('quarter', d.d_date) ) SELECT cc_sk, cc_name, cc_city, cc_state, sales_quarter, total_net_paid, avg_net_profit, distinct_orders, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_state ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS state_rank FROM call_center_sales ORDER BY cc_state, sales_quarter

WITH latest_year AS ( SELECT MAX(d_year) AS max_year FROM date_dim ), call_center_sales AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk AS cc_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_paid_inc_tax, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, DATE_TRUNC('month', d.d_date) AS sales_month FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk CROSS JOIN latest_year ly WHERE d.d_year = ly.max_year AND cc.cc_country = 'USA' GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, DATE_TRUNC('month', d.d_date) ) SELECT cc_sk, cc_name, cc_city, cc_state, sales_month, total_paid_inc_tax, total_discount, order_count, total_paid_inc_tax / NULLIF(order_count,0) AS avg_paid_per_order, SUM(total_paid_inc_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_city ORDER BY sales_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_city_sales FROM call_center_sales ORDER BY cc_state, sales_month DESC

WITH latest_year AS ( SELECT MAX(d_year) AS max_year FROM date_dim ), call_center_sales AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk AS cc_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, DATE_TRUNC('week', d.d_date) AS sales_week FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN call_center cc ON cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk CROSS JOIN latest_year ly WHERE d.d_year = ly.max_year AND w.w_zip LIKE '9%' GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, DATE_TRUNC('week', d.d_date) ) SELECT cc_sk, cc_name, cc_city, cc_state, sales_week, total_net_paid, total_net_profit, total_orders, total_net_paid / NULLIF(total_orders,0) AS avg_paid_per_order, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_state ORDER BY sales_week) AS week_seq FROM call_center_sales ORDER BY cc_state, sales_week

WITH cust_returns AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, COUNT(wp.wp_web_page_id) AS page_visits, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, MAX(wr.wr_return_tax) AS max_return_tax, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM customer c JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON c.c_customer_sk = wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state HAVING SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) > 0 ) SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca_state ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC) AS state_return_rank, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'High' WHEN total_net_loss > 0 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'None' END AS loss_level FROM cust_returns ORDER BY state_return_rank, total_return_amt DESC LIMIT 25

WITH cust_returns AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_id) AS distinct_pages, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, AVG(wr.wr_return_tax) AS avg_return_tax, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM customer c JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON c.c_customer_sk = wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state ) SELECT *, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC) AS return_quartile, CASE WHEN total_return_amt > 2000 THEN 'Large' WHEN total_return_amt > 500 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Small' END AS size_category FROM cust_returns WHERE ca_state IN ('CA','NY','TX') ORDER BY return_quartile, total_return_amt DESC LIMIT 40

WITH cust_returns AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, COUNT(DISTINCT wp.wp_web_page_id) AS distinct_pages, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, AVG(wr.wr_return_tax) AS avg_return_tax, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss FROM customer c JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON c.c_customer_sk = wr.wr_refunded_customer_sk LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wr.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk WHERE ca.ca_country = 'United States' GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state ) SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_qty DESC) AS qty_rank FROM cust_returns WHERE total_return_amt BETWEEN 100 AND 5000 ORDER BY qty_rank LIMIT 15

WITH cs_quarter AS (SELECT ca.ca_city AS city, d.d_year AS year, d.d_quarter_seq AS quarter_seq, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS cs_net_profit, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS cs_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS cs_quantity FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_city, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq), ss_quarter AS (SELECT ca.ca_city AS city, d.d_year AS year, d.d_quarter_seq AS quarter_seq, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS ss_net_profit, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS ss_net_paid, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS ss_quantity FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_city, d.d_year, d.d_quarter_seq), combined AS (SELECT COALESCE(cs.city, ss.city) AS city, COALESCE(cs.year, ss.year) AS year, COALESCE(cs.quarter_seq, ss.quarter_seq) AS quarter_seq, COALESCE(cs.cs_net_profit, 0) AS cs_net_profit, COALESCE(ss.ss_net_profit, 0) AS ss_net_profit, COALESCE(cs.cs_net_paid, 0) AS cs_net_paid, COALESCE(ss.ss_net_paid, 0) AS ss_net_paid, COALESCE(cs.cs_quantity, 0) AS cs_quantity, COALESCE(ss.ss_quantity, 0) AS ss_quantity FROM cs_quarter cs FULL OUTER JOIN ss_quarter ss ON cs.city = ss.city AND cs.year = ss.year AND cs.quarter_seq = ss.quarter_seq) SELECT city, year, quarter_seq, cs_net_profit, ss_net_profit, cs_net_profit + ss_net_profit AS total_net_profit, CASE WHEN ss_net_profit > cs_net_profit THEN 'Store Outperforms' WHEN ss_net_profit = cs_net_profit THEN 'Tie' ELSE 'Catalog Outperforms' END AS performance_label, SUM(cs_net_profit + ss_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY year, quarter_seq ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS three_quarter_cumulative_profit, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (cs_net_profit + ss_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM combined WHERE year >= 2015 ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 30

WITH cs_agg AS (SELECT ca.ca_city AS city, d.d_year AS year, d.d_moy AS month, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS net_profit, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS ext_discount_amt, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS quantity FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_city, d.d_year, d.d_moy), ss_agg AS (SELECT ca.ca_city AS city, d.d_year AS year, d.d_moy AS month, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS net_paid, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS net_profit, SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS ext_discount_amt, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS quantity FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_city, d.d_year, d.d_moy) SELECT COALESCE(cs.city, ss.city) AS city, COALESCE(cs.year, ss.year) AS year, COALESCE(cs.month, ss.month) AS month, COALESCE(cs.net_paid, 0) + COALESCE(ss.net_paid, 0) AS total_net_paid, COALESCE(cs.net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(ss.net_profit, 0) AS total_net_profit, (COALESCE(cs.ext_discount_amt, 0) + COALESCE(ss.ext_discount_amt, 0)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(cs.quantity, 0) + COALESCE(ss.quantity, 0), 0) AS avg_discount_per_qty, CASE WHEN COALESCE(cs.net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(ss.net_profit, 0) > 1000000 THEN 'High' WHEN COALESCE(cs.net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(ss.net_profit, 0) > 500000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(cs.net_profit, 0) + COALESCE(ss.net_profit, 0) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM cs_agg cs FULL OUTER JOIN ss_agg ss ON cs.city = ss.city AND cs.year = ss.year AND cs.month = ss.month ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 50

WITH unified_sales AS (SELECT cs.cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk, d.d_year AS year, d.d_moy AS month, cs.cs_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt, cs.cs_net_paid AS net_paid, cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit, cs.cs_quantity AS quantity, ca.ca_city AS city FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk UNION ALL SELECT ss.ss_promo_sk AS promo_sk, d.d_year AS year, d.d_moy AS month, ss.ss_ext_discount_amt AS discount_amt, ss.ss_net_paid AS net_paid, ss.ss_net_profit AS net_profit, ss.ss_quantity AS quantity, ca.ca_city AS city FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk), promo_summary_agg AS (SELECT promo_sk, SUM(discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity, CASE WHEN SUM(discount_amt) > 10000 THEN 'Heavy Discount' ELSE 'Normal' END AS discount_category, SUM(discount_amt) / NULLIF(SUM(net_paid), 0) AS discount_rate FROM unified_sales GROUP BY promo_sk), promo_summary AS (SELECT a.*, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.total_discount DESC) AS discount_rank FROM promo_summary_agg a), promo_top_city AS (SELECT promo_sk, city, SUM(discount_amt) AS city_discount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_sk ORDER BY SUM(discount_amt) DESC) AS rn FROM unified_sales GROUP BY promo_sk, city) SELECT ps.promo_sk, ps.total_discount, ps.total_net_paid, ps.total_net_profit, ps.total_quantity, ps.discount_category, ps.discount_rate, ps.discount_rank, ptc.city AS top_city, ptc.city_discount AS top_city_discount FROM promo_summary ps LEFT JOIN promo_top_city ptc ON ps.promo_sk = ptc.promo_sk AND ptc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ps.discount_rank LIMIT 30

WITH cs_ship AS (SELECT cs.cs_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, ca.ca_city AS ship_city, d_ship.d_date AS ship_date, d_sold.d_date AS sold_date, cs.cs_net_paid, cs.cs_net_profit, cs.cs_ext_discount_amt, cs.cs_quantity FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d_ship ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d_ship.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_sold ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d_sold.d_date_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk), warehouse_metrics AS (SELECT warehouse_sk, AVG(date_diff('day', sold_date, ship_date)) AS avg_shipping_days, SUM(cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(cs_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM cs_ship GROUP BY warehouse_sk), city_store_sales AS (SELECT ca.ca_city AS city, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS city_total_net_paid, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS city_total_net_profit, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS city_total_quantity, COUNT(*) AS city_sales_count FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca.ca_city) SELECT wm.warehouse_sk, wm.avg_shipping_days, wm.total_net_paid, wm.total_net_profit, wm.total_quantity, CASE WHEN wm.avg_shipping_days <= 2 THEN 'Fast' WHEN wm.avg_shipping_days <= 5 THEN 'Average' ELSE 'Slow' END AS shipping_speed_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wm.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank, cs.ship_city, csw.city_total_net_paid, csw.city_total_net_profit, csw.city_total_quantity, csw.city_sales_count FROM warehouse_metrics wm JOIN (SELECT warehouse_sk, ship_city FROM cs_ship GROUP BY warehouse_sk, ship_city) cs ON wm.warehouse_sk = cs.warehouse_sk LEFT JOIN city_store_sales csw ON cs.ship_city = csw.city ORDER BY wm.total_net_profit DESC LIMIT 20

WITH inv_agg AS (SELECT inv_warehouse_sk, SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_on_hand FROM inventory GROUP BY inv_warehouse_sk), page_sales AS (SELECT cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(COALESCE(i.total_inventory_on_hand,0)) AS total_inventory_on_hand FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk LEFT JOIN inv_agg i ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = i.inv_warehouse_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, cp.cp_catalog_page_id), ranked_pages AS (SELECT cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number, cp_catalog_page_id, total_net_paid, total_net_profit, total_quantity, total_inventory_on_hand, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS dept_page_rank, SUM(total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_paid, CASE WHEN total_inventory_on_hand = 0 THEN 'Out of Stock' WHEN total_inventory_on_hand < 500 THEN 'Low Stock' WHEN total_inventory_on_hand BETWEEN 500 AND 2000 THEN 'Adequate Stock' ELSE 'High Stock' END AS inventory_status FROM page_sales) SELECT cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number, cp_catalog_page_id, total_net_paid, total_net_profit, total_quantity, total_inventory_on_hand, inventory_status, dept_page_rank, cumulative_net_paid, CASE WHEN total_net_profit > 0 THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Unprofitable' END AS profit_status FROM ranked_pages WHERE dept_page_rank <= 5 ORDER BY cp_department, dept_page_rank

WITH inv_agg AS (SELECT inv_warehouse_sk, SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_on_hand FROM inventory GROUP BY inv_warehouse_sk), warehouse_sales AS (SELECT w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_state, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS net_paid_inc_tax, SUM(cs.cs_wholesale_cost * cs.cs_quantity) AS total_wholesale_cost, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS net_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT cp.cp_department) AS distinct_departments FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_sk, w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_state), warehouse_combined AS (SELECT ws.*, COALESCE(i.total_inventory_on_hand,0) AS total_inventory_on_hand FROM warehouse_sales ws LEFT JOIN inv_agg i ON ws.w_warehouse_sk = i.inv_warehouse_sk), warehouse_percentiles AS (SELECT wc.*, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_profit DESC) AS profit_percentile, CASE WHEN net_paid_inc_tax / NULLIF(total_wholesale_cost,0) > 5 THEN 'Excellent Ratio' WHEN net_paid_inc_tax / NULLIF(total_wholesale_cost,0) BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN 'Good Ratio' ELSE 'Needs Improvement' END AS ratio_category, CASE WHEN distinct_departments >= 5 THEN 'Diversified' WHEN distinct_departments BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN 'Moderately Diversified' ELSE 'Specialized' END AS diversification_category FROM warehouse_combined wc) SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_state, net_paid_inc_tax, total_wholesale_cost, net_profit, distinct_orders, distinct_departments, total_inventory_on_hand, profit_percentile, ratio_category, diversification_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY profit_percentile) AS percentile_rank FROM warehouse_percentiles WHERE profit_percentile >= 0.5 ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 15

WITH inv_max_per_wh AS (SELECT inv.inv_warehouse_sk, inv.inv_date_sk, inv.inv_quantity_on_hand, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inv.inv_warehouse_sk ORDER BY inv.inv_quantity_on_hand DESC) AS rn FROM inventory inv), sales_per_wh_date AS (SELECT cs.cs_warehouse_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, cp.cp_department, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid_inc_tax) AS total_net_paid_inc_tax, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_warehouse_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, cp.cp_department) SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_state, im.inv_date_sk AS inventory_date, im.inv_quantity_on_hand, sp.total_net_paid_inc_tax, sp.total_quantity_sold, sp.cp_department, CASE WHEN im.inv_quantity_on_hand > 1000 THEN 'High Stock' WHEN im.inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 THEN 'Medium Stock' ELSE 'Low Stock' END AS stock_level FROM inv_max_per_wh im JOIN warehouse w ON im.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk LEFT JOIN sales_per_wh_date sp ON im.inv_warehouse_sk = sp.cs_warehouse_sk AND im.inv_date_sk = sp.cs_sold_date_sk WHERE im.rn = 1 ORDER BY im.inv_quantity_on_hand DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inv_agg AS (SELECT inv_warehouse_sk, SUM(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory_on_hand FROM inventory GROUP BY inv_warehouse_sk), sales_by_dept_state AS (SELECT cp.cp_department, w.w_state, w.w_warehouse_sk, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt, AVG(cs.cs_net_paid) AS avg_net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_department, w.w_state, w.w_warehouse_sk) SELECT s.cp_department, s.w_state, s.total_net_profit, s.total_discount, s.sales_cnt, s.avg_net_paid, i.total_inventory_on_hand, CASE WHEN s.total_net_profit / NULLIF(s.total_discount,0) > 2 THEN 'High Margin' WHEN s.total_net_profit / NULLIF(s.total_discount,0) BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Medium Margin' ELSE 'Low Margin' END AS margin_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.avg_net_paid DESC) AS avg_paid_rank FROM sales_by_dept_state s LEFT JOIN inv_agg i ON s.w_warehouse_sk = i.inv_warehouse_sk ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 20

WITH sales_qty AS ( SELECT cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk, SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS qty, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS net_profit, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS net_paid, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt + cs.cs_coupon_amt) AS total_discount FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk ), store_qty AS ( SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS qty, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS net_profit, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS net_paid, SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt + ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS total_discount FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk ), combined AS ( SELECT item_sk, SUM(qty) AS total_qty, SUM(net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(total_discount) AS total_discount FROM ( SELECT * FROM sales_qty UNION ALL SELECT * FROM store_qty ) GROUP BY item_sk ), item_details AS ( SELECT i.i_item_sk, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_brand, i.i_color, i.i_size FROM item i ) SELECT i.i_product_name, i.i_category, i.i_brand, i.i_color, i.i_size, c.total_qty, c.total_net_profit, c.total_net_paid, ROUND(100.0 * c.total_net_profit / NULLIF(c.total_net_paid,0), 2) AS profit_margin_pct, ROUND(100.0 * c.total_discount / NULLIF(c.total_net_paid,0), 2) AS discount_pct, CASE WHEN c.total_net_profit / NULLIF(c.total_net_paid,0) > 0.30 THEN 'HIGH_PROFIT' WHEN c.total_net_profit / NULLIF(c.total_net_paid,0) > 0.15 THEN 'MEDIUM_PROFIT' ELSE 'LOW_PROFIT' END AS profit_tier, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.total_qty DESC) AS qty_rank FROM combined c JOIN item_details i ON c.item_sk = i.i_item_sk WHERE c.total_qty > 0 ORDER BY qty_rank LIMIT 20

WITH sales_by_promo AS ( SELECT cs.cs_promo_sk AS promo_sk, cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit, cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sale_date_sk FROM catalog_sales cs WHERE cs.cs_promo_sk IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT ss.ss_promo_sk AS promo_sk, ss.ss_net_profit AS net_profit, ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS sale_date_sk FROM store_sales ss WHERE ss.ss_promo_sk IS NOT NULL ), promo_sales_agg AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, p.p_start_date_sk, p.p_end_date_sk, p.p_channel_tv, p.p_channel_email, i.i_product_name, i.i_category, SUM(s.net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COUNT(*) AS sale_count FROM promotion p LEFT JOIN sales_by_promo s ON p.p_promo_sk = s.promo_sk LEFT JOIN item i ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, p.p_start_date_sk, p.p_end_date_sk, p.p_channel_tv, p.p_channel_email, i.i_product_name, i.i_category ), promo_cumulative AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_sk AS promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, p.p_start_date_sk, p.i_product_name, p.i_category, p.total_net_profit, SUM(p.total_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_promo_sk ORDER BY p.p_start_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_net_profit, LAG(p.total_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_promo_sk ORDER BY p.p_start_date_sk) AS prev_net_profit, CASE WHEN LAG(p.total_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_promo_sk ORDER BY p.p_start_date_sk) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE p.total_net_profit - LAG(p.total_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_promo_sk ORDER BY p.p_start_date_sk) END AS net_profit_change, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY p.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM promo_sales_agg p ) SELECT promo_sk, p_promo_name, i_product_name, i_category, p_start_date_sk, total_net_profit, cum_net_profit, prev_net_profit, net_profit_change, profit_rank, CASE WHEN profit_rank <= 5 THEN 'TOP_5' WHEN profit_rank <= 15 THEN 'TOP_15' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS promo_tier FROM promo_cumulative ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 30

WITH cs_join AS ( SELECT cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, i.i_category, cs.cs_net_paid AS net_paid, CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN cs.cs_net_paid ELSE 0 END AS promo_net_paid FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk ), ss_join AS ( SELECT ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, i.i_category, ss.ss_net_paid AS net_paid, CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN ss.ss_net_paid ELSE 0 END AS promo_net_paid FROM store_sales ss JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk ), combined AS ( SELECT * FROM cs_join UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ss_join ), daily_category AS ( SELECT date_sk, i_category, SUM(net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(promo_net_paid) AS total_promo_net_paid FROM combined GROUP BY date_sk, i_category ) SELECT date_sk, i_category, total_net_paid, total_promo_net_paid, total_net_paid - total_promo_net_paid AS non_promo_net_paid, AVG(total_net_paid) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_7d_by_cat, CASE WHEN total_net_paid > 1000000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS volume_flag FROM daily_category ORDER BY date_sk, i_category

WITH cs AS ( SELECT i.i_category, cs.cs_net_profit AS net_profit, CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN cs.cs_net_profit ELSE 0 END AS promo_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk ), ss AS ( SELECT i.i_category, ss.ss_net_profit AS net_profit, CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN ss.ss_net_profit ELSE 0 END AS promo_profit FROM store_sales ss JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk ), combined AS ( SELECT i_category, net_profit, promo_profit FROM cs UNION ALL SELECT i_category, net_profit, promo_profit FROM ss ) SELECT i_category, total_net_profit, promo_net_profit, promo_profit_pct, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM ( SELECT i_category, SUM(net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(promo_profit) AS promo_net_profit, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(promo_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(net_profit),0), 2) AS promo_profit_pct FROM combined GROUP BY i_category ) agg ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 20

WITH page_sales AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, ca.ca_state AS billing_state, cd.cd_marital_status AS billing_marital_status, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, COUNT(*) AS total_transactions, AVG(cs.cs_net_paid) AS avg_net_paid_per_transaction FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2450100 GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, ca.ca_state, cd.cd_marital_status ) SELECT cp_catalog_page_id, cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number, billing_state, billing_marital_status, total_net_paid, total_transactions, avg_net_paid_per_transaction, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS quartile FROM page_sales ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC LIMIT 15

WITH page_sales AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, ca.ca_city AS billing_city, cd.cd_gender AS billing_gender, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_order_number) AS distinct_orders FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE cs.cs_ext_discount_amt > 0 GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, ca.ca_city, cd.cd_gender ) SELECT cp_catalog_page_id, cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number, billing_city, billing_gender, total_discount, distinct_orders, CASE WHEN total_discount > 5000 THEN 'High Discount' WHEN total_discount > 2000 THEN 'Medium Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category FROM page_sales ORDER BY total_discount DESC LIMIT 10

WITH page_sales AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, ca.ca_city AS billing_city, cd.cd_gender AS billing_gender, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COUNT(*) AS total_sales FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, ca.ca_city, cd.cd_gender ), profit_trend AS ( SELECT ps.*, LAG(ps.total_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY ps.cp_department ORDER BY ps.cp_catalog_page_number) AS prev_profit, ps.total_net_profit - LAG(ps.total_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY ps.cp_department ORDER BY ps.cp_catalog_page_number) AS profit_change FROM page_sales ps ) SELECT cp_catalog_page_id, cp_department, cp_catalog_page_number, billing_city, billing_gender, total_net_profit, total_sales, profit_change, CASE WHEN profit_change > 0 THEN 'Increasing' WHEN profit_change < 0 THEN 'Decreasing' ELSE 'Stable' END AS profit_trend FROM profit_trend WHERE profit_change IS NOT NULL ORDER BY profit_change DESC LIMIT 10

WITH cs_join AS ( SELECT cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, i.i_category, cs.cs_net_paid AS net_paid, CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN cs.cs_net_paid ELSE 0 END AS promo_net_paid FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk ), ss_join AS ( SELECT ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, i.i_category, ss.ss_net_paid AS net_paid, CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN ss.ss_net_paid ELSE 0 END AS promo_net_paid FROM store_sales ss JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk ), combined AS ( SELECT * FROM cs_join UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ss_join ), daily_category AS ( SELECT date_sk, i_category, SUM(net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(promo_net_paid) AS total_promo_net_paid FROM combined GROUP BY date_sk, i_category ), final AS ( SELECT date_sk, i_category, total_net_paid, total_promo_net_paid, total_net_paid - total_promo_net_paid AS non_promo_net_paid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS net_rank FROM daily_category ) SELECT date_sk, i_category, total_net_paid, total_promo_net_paid, non_promo_net_paid, net_rank, CASE WHEN net_rank = 1 THEN 'TOP_DAY' ELSE NULL END AS top_day_flag FROM final WHERE net_rank <= 3 ORDER BY i_category, net_rank

WITH cs_join AS ( SELECT cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, i.i_category, cs.cs_net_paid AS net_paid, CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN cs.cs_net_paid ELSE 0 END AS promo_net_paid FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk ), ss_join AS ( SELECT ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, i.i_category, ss.ss_net_paid AS net_paid, CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN ss.ss_net_paid ELSE 0 END AS promo_net_paid FROM store_sales ss JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk ), combined AS ( SELECT * FROM cs_join UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ss_join ), daily_category AS ( SELECT date_sk, i_category, SUM(net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(promo_net_paid) AS total_promo_net_paid FROM combined GROUP BY date_sk, i_category ), agg AS ( SELECT i_category, SUM(total_net_paid) AS cat_total, AVG(total_net_paid) AS cat_avg FROM daily_category GROUP BY i_category ) SELECT d.date_sk, d.i_category, d.total_net_paid, d.total_promo_net_paid, d.total_net_paid - d.total_promo_net_paid AS non_promo_net_paid, a.cat_total, a.cat_avg, CASE WHEN d.total_net_paid > a.cat_avg * 2 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS volume_flag FROM daily_category d JOIN agg a ON d.i_category = a.i_category ORDER BY d.i_category, d.date_sk

WITH hourly_raw AS (SELECT t.t_hour, t.t_meal_time, d.d_day_name, r.r_reason_desc, sr.sr_return_amt, sr.sr_net_loss, sr.sr_store_credit FROM store_returns sr JOIN time_dim t ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk), hourly_agg AS (SELECT t_hour, t_meal_time, d_day_name, SUM(sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, AVG(sr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss, SUM(sr_store_credit) AS total_store_credit, COUNT(DISTINCT r_reason_desc) AS distinct_reason_cnt FROM hourly_raw GROUP BY t_hour, t_meal_time, d_day_name) SELECT t_hour, t_meal_time, d_day_name, total_return_amt, avg_net_loss, total_store_credit, SUM(total_store_credit) OVER (ORDER BY t_hour ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_store_credit, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC) AS return_amt_dense_rank, distinct_reason_cnt FROM hourly_agg ORDER BY t_hour

WITH curr AS (SELECT sr.sr_store_sk, d.d_date_sk AS cur_date_sk, d.d_date AS cur_date, t.t_meal_time, r.r_reason_desc, SUM(sr.sr_refunded_cash) AS cur_refunded_cash FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN time_dim t ON sr.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk JOIN reason r ON sr.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk, d.d_date_sk, d.d_date, t.t_meal_time, r.r_reason_desc), prev AS (SELECT cr.sr_store_sk, t.t_meal_time, r.r_reason_desc, d_prev.d_date AS prev_date, SUM(sr2.sr_refunded_cash) AS prev_refunded_cash FROM curr cr JOIN date_dim d_curr ON cr.cur_date_sk = d_curr.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_prev ON d_curr.d_same_day_ly = d_prev.d_date_sk JOIN store_returns sr2 ON sr2.sr_store_sk = cr.sr_store_sk AND sr2.sr_returned_date_sk = d_prev.d_date_sk JOIN time_dim t ON sr2.sr_return_time_sk = t.t_time_sk JOIN reason r ON sr2.sr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk WHERE t.t_meal_time = cr.t_meal_time AND r.r_reason_desc = cr.r_reason_desc GROUP BY cr.sr_store_sk, t.t_meal_time, r.r_reason_desc, d_prev.d_date) SELECT cur.sr_store_sk, cur.cur_date, cur.t_meal_time, cur.r_reason_desc, cur.cur_refunded_cash, prev.prev_refunded_cash, (cur.cur_refunded_cash - prev.prev_refunded_cash) AS cash_diff, CASE WHEN prev.prev_refunded_cash = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((cur.cur_refunded_cash - prev.prev_refunded_cash) / prev.prev_refunded_cash) * 100 END AS pct_change, LAG(cur.cur_refunded_cash) OVER (PARTITION BY cur.sr_store_sk, cur.t_meal_time, cur.r_reason_desc ORDER BY cur.cur_date) AS prev_day_refunded_cash, CASE WHEN prev.prev_refunded_cash > 0 AND (cur.cur_refunded_cash - prev.prev_refunded_cash) / prev.prev_refunded_cash > 0.20 THEN 'Increase >20%' ELSE 'Normal' END AS increase_flag FROM curr cur LEFT JOIN prev ON cur.sr_store_sk = prev.sr_store_sk AND cur.t_meal_time = prev.t_meal_time AND cur.r_reason_desc = prev.r_reason_desc AND cur.cur_date = prev.prev_date WHERE cur.cur_refunded_cash > 0 ORDER BY cur.cur_refunded_cash DESC LIMIT 100

WITH page_sales AS (SELECT p.wp_web_page_id, p.wp_url, p.wp_type, p.wp_image_count, p.wp_link_count, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, AVG(ws.ws_list_price) AS avg_list_price, SUM(CASE WHEN t.t_meal_time = 'Breakfast' THEN ws.ws_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS breakfast_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN t.t_meal_time = 'Lunch' THEN ws.ws_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS lunch_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN t.t_meal_time = 'Dinner' THEN ws.ws_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS dinner_sales FROM web_page p JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = p.wp_web_page_sk JOIN time_dim t ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY p.wp_web_page_id, p.wp_url, p.wp_type, p.wp_image_count, p.wp_link_count) SELECT wp_web_page_id, wp_url, wp_type, wp_image_count, wp_link_count, total_sales, avg_list_price, CASE WHEN wp_image_count + wp_link_count >= 100 THEN 'Highly Engaging' WHEN wp_image_count + wp_link_count >= 50 THEN 'Engaging' ELSE 'Low Engagement' END AS engagement_level, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank, SUM(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_sales, CASE WHEN breakfast_sales > lunch_sales AND breakfast_sales > dinner_sales THEN 'Breakfast Peak' WHEN lunch_sales > breakfast_sales AND lunch_sales > dinner_sales THEN 'Lunch Peak' WHEN dinner_sales > breakfast_sales AND dinner_sales > lunch_sales THEN 'Dinner Peak' ELSE 'Mixed' END AS peak_meal_time FROM page_sales ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT ship_c.c_customer_id AS ship_customer_id, ship_c.c_first_name AS ship_first_name, ship_c.c_last_name AS ship_last_name, COUNT(*) AS ship_orders, AVG(ws.ws_ext_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost, AVG(ws.ws_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit, AVG(ws.ws_net_profit) / NULLIF(AVG(ws.ws_ext_sales_price), 0) AS profit_margin, AVG(t.t_hour) AS avg_hour_of_sale, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(ws.ws_net_profit) / NULLIF(AVG(ws.ws_ext_sales_price), 0) DESC) AS profit_margin_rank, CASE WHEN AVG(ws.ws_net_profit) / NULLIF(AVG(ws.ws_ext_sales_price), 0) >= 0.2 THEN 'High Margin' WHEN AVG(ws.ws_net_profit) / NULLIF(AVG(ws.ws_ext_sales_price), 0) >= 0.1 THEN 'Medium Margin' ELSE 'Low Margin' END AS margin_category FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer ship_c ON ws.ws_ship_customer_sk = ship_c.c_customer_sk JOIN customer bill_c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = bill_c.c_customer_sk JOIN time_dim t ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY ship_c.c_customer_id, ship_c.c_first_name, ship_c.c_last_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY profit_margin_rank LIMIT 30

WITH combo_sales AS (SELECT c.c_birth_month, p.wp_type, CASE WHEN c.c_birth_country = 'USA' THEN 'Domestic' ELSE 'International' END AS region, SUM(ws.ws_net_paid_inc_tax + ws.ws_ext_ship_cost) AS total_net_paid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_id) AS distinct_customers, AVG(t.t_hour) AS avg_sale_hour FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN web_page p ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = p.wp_web_page_sk JOIN time_dim t ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY c.c_birth_month, p.wp_type, CASE WHEN c.c_birth_country = 'USA' THEN 'Domestic' ELSE 'International' END) SELECT c_birth_month, wp_type, region, total_net_paid, distinct_customers, avg_sale_hour, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS net_paid_percentile, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY total_net_paid DESC) AS region_rank, CASE WHEN total_net_paid > 100000 THEN 'Top Performer' WHEN total_net_paid > 50000 THEN 'Strong Performer' ELSE 'Average Performer' END AS performance_category FROM combo_sales ORDER BY c_birth_month, wp_type LIMIT 100

WITH sales_by_customer AS (SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_profit, AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, CASE WHEN t.t_meal_time = 'Breakfast' THEN 'Morning' WHEN t.t_meal_time = 'Lunch' THEN 'Midday' WHEN t.t_meal_time = 'Dinner' THEN 'Evening' ELSE 'Other' END AS sale_period, p.wp_type AS page_type FROM web_sales ws JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN time_dim t ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk JOIN web_page p ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = p.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, CASE WHEN t.t_meal_time = 'Breakfast' THEN 'Morning' WHEN t.t_meal_time = 'Lunch' THEN 'Midday' WHEN t.t_meal_time = 'Dinner' THEN 'Evening' ELSE 'Other' END, p.wp_type) SELECT c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, sale_period, page_type, total_profit, avg_discount, order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_discount DESC) AS discount_rank, CASE WHEN total_profit >= 50000 THEN 'High' WHEN total_profit >= 20000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category FROM sales_by_customer ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 50

WITH agg AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_tax_percentage, r.r_reason_desc, cp.cp_department, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amt_inc_tax, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(*) AS return_events FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_sk, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_tax_percentage, r.r_reason_desc, cp.cp_department ) SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_name, cc_city, cc_state, CASE WHEN cc_tax_percentage > 20 THEN 'HIGH_TAX' WHEN cc_tax_percentage BETWEEN 10 AND 20 THEN 'MED_TAX' ELSE 'LOW_TAX' END AS tax_category, r_reason_desc, cp_department, total_return_amount, total_return_amt_inc_tax, total_net_loss, total_quantity, return_events, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_sk ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS reason_net_loss_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS dept_return_amount_rank FROM agg WHERE total_return_amount > 0 ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC LIMIT 50

WITH cr_enriched AS ( SELECT cr.cr_call_center_sk, cr.cr_returned_date_sk, cr.cr_net_loss, cr.cr_return_amount, cr.cr_return_quantity, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_tax_percentage, cp.cp_type, r.r_reason_desc FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk ) SELECT cr_enriched.cr_call_center_sk AS cc_sk, cr_enriched.cc_name, cr_enriched.cc_state, cr_enriched.cp_type, cr_enriched.r_reason_desc, cr_enriched.cr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date, SUM(cr_enriched.cr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cr_enriched.cr_call_center_sk ORDER BY cr_enriched.cr_returned_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS net_loss_3day_sum, AVG(cr_enriched.cr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY cr_enriched.cr_call_center_sk ORDER BY cr_enriched.cr_returned_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS net_loss_3day_avg, CASE WHEN cr_enriched.cr_net_loss > 2000 THEN 'HIGH_LOSS' WHEN cr_enriched.cr_net_loss BETWEEN 1000 AND 2000 THEN 'MEDIUM_LOSS' ELSE 'LOW_LOSS' END AS loss_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cr_enriched.cr_call_center_sk ORDER BY cr_enriched.cr_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM cr_enriched WHERE cr_enriched.cr_returned_date_sk >= (SELECT MAX(cr_returned_date_sk) - 30 FROM catalog_returns) ORDER BY cc_sk, returned_date DESC LIMIT 200

WITH agg AS ( SELECT cc.cc_country AS country, cc.cc_state AS state, cp.cp_department AS department, r.r_reason_desc AS reason_desc, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, AVG(cr.cr_net_loss) AS avg_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt, CASE WHEN cc.cc_tax_percentage > 15 THEN 'HIGH_TAX' ELSE 'LOW_TAX' END AS cc_tax_category, CASE WHEN cp.cp_type = 'PROMO' THEN 'PROMOTION' ELSE 'REGULAR' END AS page_type_category FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN call_center cc ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_country, cc.cc_state, cp.cp_department, r.r_reason_desc, cc.cc_tax_percentage, cp.cp_type ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country, department ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS reason_rank FROM agg ) SELECT country, state, department, reason_desc, total_return_amount, total_net_loss, avg_net_loss, return_cnt, cc_tax_category, page_type_category, reason_rank, CASE WHEN total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'MAJOR_LOSS' WHEN total_net_loss BETWEEN 2000 AND 5000 THEN 'SIGNIFICANT_LOSS' ELSE 'MINOR_LOSS' END AS loss_severity FROM ranked WHERE reason_rank <= 3 ORDER BY country, department, reason_rank LIMIT 100

WITH daily_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_call_center_sk, i.i_brand, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, cd.cd_gender, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS daily_sales_amount FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_call_center_sk, i.i_brand, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, cd.cd_gender ), daily_returns AS ( SELECT cs.cs_call_center_sk, i.i_brand, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS daily_return_amount FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN web_returns wr ON cs.cs_order_number = wr.wr_order_number JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_call_center_sk, i.i_brand, cs.cs_sold_date_sk ), combined_daily AS ( SELECT ds.cs_call_center_sk AS call_center_sk, ds.i_brand, ds.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, ds.cd_gender, ds.daily_sales_amount, COALESCE(dr.daily_return_amount, 0) AS daily_return_amount, ds.daily_sales_amount - COALESCE(dr.daily_return_amount, 0) AS net_sales_after_returns FROM daily_sales ds LEFT JOIN daily_returns dr ON ds.cs_call_center_sk = dr.cs_call_center_sk AND ds.i_brand = dr.i_brand AND ds.cs_sold_date_sk = dr.cs_sold_date_sk ), cumulative AS ( SELECT call_center_sk, i_brand, cd_gender, sold_date_sk, net_sales_after_returns, SUM(net_sales_after_returns) OVER (PARTITION BY i_brand ORDER BY sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_brand_sales FROM combined_daily ) SELECT call_center_sk, i_brand, cd_gender, sold_date_sk, net_sales_after_returns, cumulative_brand_sales, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_brand ORDER BY cumulative_brand_sales) AS sales_percentile FROM cumulative WHERE net_sales_after_returns > 0 ORDER BY i_brand, sales_percentile DESC, sold_date_sk LIMIT 250

WITH daily_sales AS ( SELECT cs.cs_call_center_sk, i.i_brand, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, cd.cd_gender, SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) AS daily_net_paid FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_call_center_sk, i.i_brand, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, cd.cd_gender HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_paid) > 5000 ), daily_returns AS ( SELECT cs.cs_call_center_sk, i.i_brand, cs.cs_sold_date_sk, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS daily_return_amt FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN web_returns wr ON cs.cs_order_number = wr.wr_order_number JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY cs.cs_call_center_sk, i.i_brand, cs.cs_sold_date_sk ), combined_daily AS ( SELECT ds.cs_call_center_sk AS call_center_sk, ds.i_brand, ds.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk, ds.cd_gender, ds.daily_net_paid, COALESCE(dr.daily_return_amt, 0) AS daily_return_amt, ds.daily_net_paid - COALESCE(dr.daily_return_amt, 0) AS net_paid_after_returns FROM daily_sales ds LEFT JOIN daily_returns dr ON ds.cs_call_center_sk = dr.cs_call_center_sk AND ds.i_brand = dr.i_brand AND ds.cs_sold_date_sk = dr.cs_sold_date_sk ), cumulative AS ( SELECT call_center_sk, i_brand, cd_gender, sold_date_sk, net_paid_after_returns, AVG(net_paid_after_returns) OVER (PARTITION BY call_center_sk, i_brand ORDER BY sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_net_paid FROM combined_daily ) SELECT call_center_sk, i_brand, cd_gender, sold_date_sk, net_paid_after_returns, moving_avg_net_paid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i_brand ORDER BY moving_avg_net_paid DESC) AS brand_center_rank FROM cumulative WHERE moving_avg_net_paid IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i_brand, brand_center_rank LIMIT 100

WITH hourly_store_profit AS ( SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, t.t_hour, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS hour_net_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS unique_customers FROM store_sales ss JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk WHERE c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, t.t_hour HAVING SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) > 2000 ) SELECT hsp.s_store_id, hsp.s_store_name, hsp.t_hour, hsp.hour_net_profit, hsp.unique_customers, NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY hsp.s_store_id ORDER BY hsp.hour_net_profit DESC) AS profit_quartile FROM hourly_store_profit hsp ORDER BY hsp.s_store_id, hsp.t_hour

WITH hourly_store_profit AS ( SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, t.t_hour, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS hour_net_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS unique_customers FROM store_sales ss JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk WHERE c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1980 AND 1995 GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, t.t_hour ) SELECT hsp.s_store_id, hsp.s_store_name, hsp.t_hour, hsp.hour_net_profit, hsp.unique_customers, CASE WHEN hsp.hour_net_profit > (SELECT AVG(ss2.ss_net_profit) FROM store_sales ss2) THEN 'ABOVE_AVG' ELSE 'BELOW_AVG' END AS profit_vs_average FROM hourly_store_profit hsp ORDER BY hsp.s_store_id, hsp.t_hour DESC

WITH hourly_store_profit AS ( SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, t.t_hour, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS hour_net_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS unique_customers FROM store_sales ss JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk WHERE c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' AND s.s_state = 'CA' GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, t.t_hour ) SELECT hsp.s_store_id, hsp.s_store_name, hsp.t_hour, hsp.hour_net_profit, hsp.unique_customers, AVG(hsp.hour_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY hsp.s_store_id) AS avg_hourly_profit, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hsp.s_store_id ORDER BY hsp.hour_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM hourly_store_profit hsp ORDER BY hsp.s_store_id, hsp.t_hour

WITH hourly_store_profit AS ( SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, t.t_hour, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS hour_net_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS unique_customers FROM store_sales ss JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk WHERE c.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' AND t.t_meal_time = 'Dinner' GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, t.t_hour ) SELECT hsp.s_store_id, hsp.s_store_name, hsp.t_hour, hsp.hour_net_profit, hsp.unique_customers, SUM(hsp.hour_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY hsp.s_store_id ORDER BY hsp.t_hour ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_4hr_profit, LAG(hsp.unique_customers, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY hsp.s_store_id ORDER BY hsp.t_hour) AS prev_hour_customers FROM hourly_store_profit hsp ORDER BY hsp.s_store_id, hsp.t_hour

WITH weekly_store_sales AS ( SELECT ss.ss_store_sk AS store_sk, d.d_year AS year, d.d_week_seq AS week_seq, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS weekly_sales, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS weekly_profit, SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS weekly_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_promo_sk) AS promo_count FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, d.d_year, d.d_week_seq ) SELECT wss.store_sk, wss.year, wss.week_seq, wss.weekly_sales, wss.weekly_profit, wss.weekly_discount, CASE WHEN wss.promo_count > 0 THEN 'Promo' ELSE 'No Promo' END AS promo_flag, LAG(wss.weekly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY wss.store_sk ORDER BY wss.year, wss.week_seq) AS prev_week_sales, CASE WHEN LAG(wss.weekly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY wss.store_sk ORDER BY wss.year, wss.week_seq) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (wss.weekly_sales - LAG(wss.weekly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY wss.store_sk ORDER BY wss.year, wss.week_seq)) / NULLIF(LAG(wss.weekly_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY wss.store_sk ORDER BY wss.year, wss.week_seq), 0) END AS week_over_week_growth, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY wss.year, wss.week_seq ORDER BY wss.weekly_profit DESC) AS profit_rank_within_week FROM weekly_store_sales wss WHERE wss.year = 2023 ORDER BY wss.store_sk, wss.week_seq

WITH store_item_agg AS ( SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_profit, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales, MAX(d.d_date) AS last_store_sale_date FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk ), web_item_agg AS ( SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_profit, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales, MAX(d.d_date) AS last_web_sale_date FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk ) SELECT COALESCE(si.item_sk, wi.item_sk) AS item_sk, COALESCE(si.store_profit, 0) AS store_profit, COALESCE(wi.web_profit, 0) AS web_profit, (COALESCE(si.store_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wi.web_profit, 0)) AS total_profit, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(si.store_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wi.web_profit, 0)) > 1000000 THEN 'High' WHEN (COALESCE(si.store_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wi.web_profit, 0)) > 500000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_tier, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(si.store_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wi.web_profit, 0)) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(si.store_profit, 0) / (COALESCE(si.store_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wi.web_profit, 0)) END AS store_profit_share, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(si.store_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wi.web_profit, 0)) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(wi.web_profit, 0) / (COALESCE(si.store_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wi.web_profit, 0)) END AS web_profit_share, GREATEST(COALESCE(si.last_store_sale_date, DATE '1900-01-01'), COALESCE(wi.last_web_sale_date, DATE '1900-01-01')) AS last_sale_date, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(si.store_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wi.web_profit, 0)) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM store_item_agg si FULL OUTER JOIN web_item_agg wi ON si.item_sk = wi.item_sk WHERE (COALESCE(si.store_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wi.web_profit, 0)) > 0 ORDER BY total_profit DESC LIMIT 50

WITH store_daily AS ( SELECT ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS d_date_sk, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_profit, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS store_qty FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_sold_date_sk ), web_daily AS ( SELECT ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS d_date_sk, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS web_profit, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS web_qty FROM web_sales ws GROUP BY ws.ws_sold_date_sk ) SELECT d.d_date, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, d.d_day_name, CASE WHEN d.d_holiday = 'Y' THEN 'Holiday' WHEN d.d_weekend = 'Y' THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Regular' END AS day_type, COALESCE(sd.store_profit, 0) AS store_profit, COALESCE(wd.web_profit, 0) AS web_profit, (COALESCE(sd.store_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wd.web_profit, 0)) AS total_profit, SUM(COALESCE(sd.store_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wd.web_profit, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY d.d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_profit, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(sd.store_profit, 0) + COALESCE(wd.web_profit, 0)) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM date_dim d LEFT JOIN store_daily sd ON d.d_date_sk = sd.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN web_daily wd ON d.d_date_sk = wd.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2022-01-01' AND DATE '2022-12-31' ORDER BY d.d_date

WITH page_daily_sales AS ( SELECT wp.wp_web_page_sk, d.d_date, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS daily_sales FROM web_page wp JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY wp.wp_web_page_sk, d.d_date ), page_series AS ( SELECT wp_web_page_sk, d_date, daily_sales, SUM(daily_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_web_page_sk) AS total_sales, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_web_page_sk) AS active_days, AVG(daily_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_web_page_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_7day, SUM(daily_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY wp_web_page_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wp_web_page_sk ORDER BY d_date DESC) AS rn FROM page_daily_sales ) SELECT wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url, CASE WHEN wp.wp_type = 'home' THEN 'Home' WHEN wp.wp_type = 'product' THEN 'Product' ELSE 'Other' END AS page_category, ps.total_sales, ps.active_days, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ps.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank, ps.moving_avg_7day, ps.cumulative_sales FROM page_series ps JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = ps.wp_web_page_sk WHERE ps.rn = 1 AND ps.total_sales > 1000 ORDER BY ps.total_sales DESC LIMIT 20

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential, hd.hd_income_band_sk, ss.ss_customer_sk, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_spent, SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount FROM store_sales ss JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential, hd.hd_income_band_sk, ss.ss_customer_sk ), ranked_customers AS ( SELECT hd_demo_sk, hd_buy_potential, hd_income_band_sk, ss_customer_sk, total_quantity, total_spent, total_discount, CASE WHEN total_spent > 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS spend_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hd_demo_sk ORDER BY total_quantity DESC) AS rn FROM customer_agg ) SELECT hd_demo_sk, hd_buy_potential, hd_income_band_sk, ss_customer_sk, total_quantity, total_spent, total_discount, spend_category, rn AS customer_rank FROM ranked_customers WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY hd_demo_sk, customer_rank

WITH daily_store_demo AS ( SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, hd.hd_income_band_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS daily_net_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_promo_id) AS promo_count FROM store_sales ss JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, hd.hd_income_band_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk ) SELECT s_store_id, s_store_name, hd_income_band_sk, ss_sold_date_sk, daily_net_profit, promo_count, SUM(daily_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_id, hd_income_band_sk ORDER BY ss_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_profit, daily_net_profit - LAG(daily_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY s_store_id, hd_income_band_sk ORDER BY ss_sold_date_sk) AS net_profit_change, CASE WHEN daily_net_profit > 10000 THEN 'High' WHEN daily_net_profit > 5000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_level FROM daily_store_demo WHERE ss_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s_store_id, hd_income_band_sk, ss_sold_date_sk

WITH promo_agg AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_purpose, p.p_discount_active, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COUNT(*) AS total_transactions, AVG(ss.ss_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit_per_txn, AVG(s.s_floor_space) AS avg_store_floor_space, AVG(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_count FROM store_sales ss JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_purpose, p.p_discount_active ) SELECT p_promo_id, p_promo_name, p_purpose, CASE WHEN p_discount_active = 'Y' THEN 'Discounted' ELSE 'Full Price' END AS discount_type, total_net_profit, total_transactions, avg_net_profit_per_txn, avg_store_floor_space, avg_vehicle_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p_purpose ORDER BY avg_net_profit_per_txn DESC) AS purpose_rank FROM promo_agg WHERE total_net_profit > 0 ORDER BY p_purpose, purpose_rank

WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_item_sk,
           cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
           SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount,
           SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS units_sold,
           COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk) AS distinct_buyers
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk
),
 daily_returns AS (
    SELECT wr.wr_item_sk AS cs_item_sk,
           wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
           SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS return_amount,
           SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS units_returned,
           COUNT(*) AS return_events
    FROM web_returns wr
    GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk, wr.wr_returned_date_sk
),
 combined AS (
    SELECT s.cs_item_sk,
           s.date_sk,
           s.sales_amount,
           COALESCE(r.return_amount, 0) AS return_amount,
           s.units_sold,
           COALESCE(r.units_returned, 0) AS units_returned,
           s.distinct_buyers,
           COALESCE(r.return_events, 0) AS return_events
    FROM daily_sales s
    LEFT JOIN daily_returns r ON s.cs_item_sk = r.cs_item_sk AND s.date_sk = r.date_sk
),
 customer_demo_sales AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_item_sk,
           cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
           AVG(c.c_birth_month) AS avg_birth_month,
           MAX(c.c_birth_year) AS max_birth_year
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk
),
 most_return_page_counts AS (
    SELECT wr.wr_item_sk AS cs_item_sk,
           wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
           wr.wr_web_page_sk,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM web_returns wr
    GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk, wr.wr_returned_date_sk, wr.wr_web_page_sk
),
 most_return_page_per_product_date AS (
    SELECT cs_item_sk,
           date_sk,
           wr_web_page_sk
    FROM (
        SELECT cs_item_sk,
               date_sk,
               wr_web_page_sk,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cs_item_sk, date_sk ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS rn
        FROM most_return_page_counts
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT c.cs_item_sk,
       c.date_sk,
       c.sales_amount,
       c.return_amount,
       (c.sales_amount - c.return_amount) AS net_amount,
       c.distinct_buyers,
       c.return_events,
       SUM(c.sales_amount - c.return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.cs_item_sk ORDER BY c.date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net,
       AVG(c.sales_amount - c.return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.cs_item_sk ORDER BY c.date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS weekly_avg_net,
       d.avg_birth_month,
       d.max_birth_year,
       wp.wp_url AS top_return_page_url
FROM combined c
LEFT JOIN customer_demo_sales d ON c.cs_item_sk = d.cs_item_sk AND c.date_sk = d.date_sk
LEFT JOIN most_return_page_per_product_date mrp ON c.cs_item_sk = mrp.cs_item_sk AND c.date_sk = mrp.date_sk
LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON mrp.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
WHERE c.sales_amount > 0
  AND c.distinct_buyers >= 2
ORDER BY c.cs_item_sk, c.date_sk DESC
FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY

WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_item_sk,
           cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
           SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales_amount,
           SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS units_sold
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2450100
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk
),
 daily_returns AS (
    SELECT wr.wr_item_sk AS cs_item_sk,
           wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
           SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS return_amount,
           SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS units_returned
    FROM web_returns wr
    WHERE wr.wr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2450000 AND 2450100
    GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk, wr.wr_returned_date_sk
),
 combined AS (
    SELECT s.cs_item_sk,
           s.date_sk,
           s.sales_amount,
           COALESCE(r.return_amount, 0) AS return_amount,
           s.units_sold,
           COALESCE(r.units_returned, 0) AS units_returned
    FROM daily_sales s
    LEFT JOIN daily_returns r ON s.cs_item_sk = r.cs_item_sk AND s.date_sk = r.date_sk
),
 customer_demo_sales AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_item_sk,
           cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk,
           AVG(c.c_birth_month) AS avg_birth_month,
           COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk, cs.cs_sold_date_sk
),
 most_return_page_counts AS (
    SELECT wr.wr_item_sk AS cs_item_sk,
           wr.wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk,
           wr.wr_web_page_sk,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM web_returns wr
    GROUP BY wr.wr_item_sk, wr.wr_returned_date_sk, wr.wr_web_page_sk
),
 most_return_page_per_product_date AS (
    SELECT cs_item_sk,
           date_sk,
           wr_web_page_sk
    FROM (
        SELECT cs_item_sk,
               date_sk,
               wr_web_page_sk,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cs_item_sk, date_sk ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS rn
        FROM most_return_page_counts
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT c.cs_item_sk,
       c.date_sk,
       c.sales_amount,
       c.return_amount,
       (c.sales_amount - c.return_amount) AS net_amount,
       ROUND((c.sales_amount - c.return_amount) / NULLIF(c.sales_amount, 0) * 100, 2) AS net_margin_pct,
       SUM(c.sales_amount - c.return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.cs_item_sk ORDER BY c.date_sk) AS running_total_net,
       LAG(c.sales_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.cs_item_sk ORDER BY c.date_sk) AS prev_day_sales,
       CASE
           WHEN LAG(c.sales_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.cs_item_sk ORDER BY c.date_sk) IS NULL THEN 'N/A'
           WHEN (c.sales_amount - LAG(c.sales_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.cs_item_sk ORDER BY c.date_sk)) > 1000 THEN 'Big Jump'
           ELSE 'Stable'
       END AS sales_trend,
       d.avg_birth_month,
       d.distinct_customers,
       wp.wp_url AS top_return_page_url
FROM combined c
LEFT JOIN customer_demo_sales d ON c.cs_item_sk = d.cs_item_sk AND c.date_sk = d.date_sk
LEFT JOIN most_return_page_per_product_date mrp ON c.cs_item_sk = mrp.cs_item_sk AND c.date_sk = mrp.date_sk
LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON mrp.wr_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
WHERE c.sales_amount > 500
GROUP BY c.cs_item_sk, c.date_sk, c.sales_amount, c.return_amount, c.units_sold, c.units_returned, d.avg_birth_month, d.distinct_customers, wp.wp_url
ORDER BY net_amount DESC
LIMIT 50

WITH catalog_cust AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS catalog_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt,
        MIN(i.i_color) AS first_color
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2450500 AND 2450600
    GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
web_cust AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS web_return_amount,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt,
        MIN(i.i_color) AS first_color
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2450500 AND 2450600
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk
    HAVING SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) > 400
),
combined_cust AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(c.customer_sk, w.customer_sk) AS customer_sk,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_amount, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_amount, 0) AS total_return_amount,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_cnt, 0) AS total_return_cnt,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.first_color, w.first_color) = 'Red' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS red_color_flag,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 10000 THEN 'Very High'
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 5000 THEN 'High'
            ELSE 'Normal'
        END AS loss_category
    FROM catalog_cust c
    FULL OUTER JOIN web_cust w ON c.customer_sk = w.customer_sk
)
SELECT
    customer_sk,
    total_return_amount,
    total_net_loss,
    total_return_cnt,
    red_color_flag,
    loss_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY loss_category ORDER BY total_return_cnt DESC) AS cnt_rank,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY loss_category ORDER BY total_return_amount DESC) AS amount_percentile,
    SUM(total_return_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY loss_category ORDER BY total_return_amount ASC ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS reverse_cumulative_amount
FROM combined_cust
WHERE red_color_flag = 1
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH catalog_cust AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_catalog_return_amount,
        SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS catalog_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS catalog_return_cnt,
        MAX(i.i_brand) AS top_brand
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN item i ON cr.cr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2450300 AND 2450900
      AND cr.cr_return_quantity > 1
    GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk
    HAVING SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) > 2000
),
web_cust AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        AVG(wr.wr_return_amt) AS avg_web_return_amount,
        SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS web_net_loss,
        COUNT(*) AS web_return_cnt,
        MIN(i.i_brand) AS min_brand
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN item i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN 2450300 AND 2450900
      AND wr.wr_return_quantity > 1
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
),
combined_cust AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(c.customer_sk, w.customer_sk) AS customer_sk,
        COALESCE(c.avg_catalog_return_amount, 0) * COALESCE(w.avg_web_return_amount, 0) AS combined_avg_return_amount,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss,
        COALESCE(c.catalog_return_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_return_cnt, 0) AS total_return_cnt,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(c.top_brand, w.min_brand) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END AS has_brand_flag,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 12000 THEN 'Severe'
            WHEN COALESCE(c.catalog_net_loss, 0) + COALESCE(w.web_net_loss, 0) > 6000 THEN 'Moderate'
            ELSE 'Mild'
        END AS loss_category
    FROM catalog_cust c
    FULL OUTER JOIN web_cust w ON c.customer_sk = w.customer_sk
)
SELECT
    customer_sk,
    combined_avg_return_amount,
    total_net_loss,
    total_return_cnt,
    has_brand_flag,
    loss_category,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank,
    NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY combined_avg_return_amount DESC) AS quartile_return_amount,
    SUM(total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY loss_category) AS net_loss_by_category
FROM combined_cust
WHERE has_brand_flag = 1
ORDER BY total_net_loss DESC
LIMIT 12

WITH promo_sales AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, p.p_cost, i.i_brand, i.i_category, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS promo_sales, COUNT(*) AS promo_txns FROM promotion p JOIN item i ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, p.p_cost, i.i_brand, i.i_category ), item_sales_without_promo AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_sk, SUM(ss2.ss_ext_sales_price) AS no_promo_sales FROM promotion p JOIN item i ON p.p_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN store_sales ss2 ON ss2.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p2 ON ss2.ss_promo_sk = p2.p_promo_sk WHERE ss2.ss_promo_sk IS NULL OR ss2.ss_promo_sk <> p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk ) SELECT ps.p_promo_sk, ps.p_promo_name, ps.p_cost, ps.i_brand, ps.i_category, ps.promo_sales, iw.no_promo_sales, (ps.promo_sales - iw.no_promo_sales) AS incremental_sales, CASE WHEN ps.p_cost = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (ps.promo_sales - iw.no_promo_sales) / ps.p_cost END AS roi, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (ps.promo_sales - iw.no_promo_sales) DESC) AS sales_increment_rank, CASE WHEN (ps.promo_sales - iw.no_promo_sales) / NULLIF(ps.p_cost,0) > 2 THEN 'HIGH ROI' ELSE 'LOW ROI' END AS roi_category FROM promo_sales ps JOIN item_sales_without_promo iw ON ps.p_promo_sk = iw.p_promo_sk WHERE ps.promo_sales > 5000 ORDER BY sales_increment_rank LIMIT 10

WITH demo_sales AS ( SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_income_band_sk, hd.hd_vehicle_count, hd.hd_dep_count, CASE WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = 'HIGH' THEN 'H' WHEN hd.hd_buy_potential = 'MEDIUM' THEN 'M' ELSE 'L' END AS buy_potential_category, i.i_brand, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(ss.ss_net_paid) AS avg_net_paid, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers FROM store_sales ss JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_income_band_sk, hd.hd_vehicle_count, hd.hd_dep_count, hd.hd_buy_potential, i.i_brand ) SELECT hd_income_band_sk, hd_vehicle_count, hd_dep_count, buy_potential_category, i_brand, total_sales, total_quantity, avg_net_paid, distinct_customers, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY hd_income_band_sk ORDER BY total_quantity DESC) AS qty_rank_within_income, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_net_paid) AS net_paid_percentile, CASE WHEN total_sales > 10000 THEN 'HIGH_SPENDER' WHEN total_sales > 5000 THEN 'MEDIUM_SPENDER' ELSE 'LOW_SPENDER' END AS spender_category FROM demo_sales WHERE total_quantity > 0 ORDER BY hd_income_band_sk, qty_rank_within_income LIMIT 100

WITH sales_by_category AS ( SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, i.i_category, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_profit, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number) AS distinct_tickets, CASE WHEN SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'PROFITABLE' ELSE 'LOSS' END AS profit_flag FROM store_sales ss JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, i.i_category HAVING SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 1000 ) SELECT ss_store_sk, i_category, total_sales, total_profit, avg_discount, distinct_tickets, profit_flag, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss_store_sk ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM sales_by_category ORDER BY ss_store_sk, sales_rank

WITH state_returns AS ( SELECT ca_ret.ca_state AS returning_state, ca_ref.ca_state AS refunded_state, cr.cr_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_sk, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_ship_cost) AS total_ship_cost, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer_address ca_ret ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_ret.ca_address_sk JOIN customer_address ca_ref ON cr.cr_refunded_addr_sk = ca_ref.ca_address_sk GROUP BY ca_ret.ca_state, ca_ref.ca_state, cr.cr_warehouse_sk ) SELECT sr.returning_state, sr.refunded_state, w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_state AS warehouse_state, sr.total_net_loss, sr.total_ship_cost, sr.return_cnt, CASE WHEN sr.returning_state = sr.refunded_state THEN 'SAME_STATE' ELSE 'DIFFERENT_STATE' END AS state_relation, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sr.total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank, SUM(sr.total_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY sr.returning_state ORDER BY sr.total_net_loss DESC) AS cumulative_net_loss_by_return_state FROM state_returns sr JOIN warehouse w ON sr.warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY loss_rank LIMIT 20
